Without the mask he has messy shoulder length black hair and large green eyes with long eyelashes. He is described as having a girly looking face which greatly contrasts with his muscular body.  Inosuke is extremely short-tempered and proud, and makes a big deal out of fighting opponents stronger than him claiming that's his only hobby. He is a sore loser and is always trying to compete with Tanjiro and provoke him into fighting him, and usually failing. Due to growing up in the mountains by himself Inosuke has trouble interacting with others and only cares about himself most of the time. Though he's often seen with 2 swords in hand, Inosuke is left-handed.

characters.name: Zenitsu Agatsuma
characters.description: Height: 164 cm (5'4") Combat Style: Thunder Breathing Affiliation: Demon Slayer Corps Occupation: Demon Slayer  Zenitsu Agatsuma is one of the main protagonists of Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba and along with [Inosuke Hashibira](https://anilist.co/character/129130/Inosuke-Hashibira), a traveling companion of [Tanjiro Kamado](https://anilist.co/character/126071/Tanjirou-Kamado) and [Nezuko Kamado](https://anilist.co/character/127518/Nezuko-Kamado).

characters.name: Muzan Kibutsuji
characters.description: Height: 179 cm (5'10")  He is the Demon King, the first of his kind, and the progenitor of all other demons in existence. Muzan is also the leader of the Twelve Kizuki, an organization of the twelve strongest demons in existence that serve directly under him.  !A millennium ago, during the Heian Era, Muzan was turned into a demon during an experimental treatment trying to cure his terminal illness, and his goal since then was to live without the fear of death and become truly eternal. He believes that Sun Breathing users are his only threat. He has a grand total of seven hearts and five brains.!

characters.name: Kyoujurou Rengoku
characters.description: Height: 177 cm (5'10") Combat Style: Flame Breathing  He is greatly enthusiastic in regard to his duties as Flame Pillar and often cheerfully eccentric. He is amiable, kind and boasts extraordinary flame techniques and swordsmanship stemming from strict practice and discipline.   He is an honourable warrior who adheres to his code of morals and principles that was instilled into him by his mother at a young age - the most significant being that those who were born strong have a duty to protect the weak.

characters.name: Tanjirou Kamado
characters.description: Height: 165 cm (5'5") Combat Style: Water Breathing & !Sun Breathing!  Tanjirou is kind by nature and has been described by others as having very gentle eyes. He has a great deal of determination and will not give up once he has a goal to achieve, an example being finding a cure for [Nezuko](https://anilist.co/character/127518). Even though he is relatively strong on his own, he isn't opposed to asking others for help when he needs it. He is very protective of his friends and even more so of his younger sister. His biggest attribute is his ability to empathize with anyone, even demons.  !Eventually, he discovers that he is a legendary Sun Breathing user.!

characters.name: Shion
characters.description: "War Lord" Shion is Rimuru’s first servant to be in charge of his care as his personal secretary. She is also the leader of the Yomigaeri and also one of Rimuru's strongest fighters and is coveted by many of the Demon Lords who have met her.

characters.name: Veldora Tempest
characters.description: Height: 210 cm (human form), 100 m (dragon form) Species: True Dragon Blessing / Divine Protection: Storm Dragon's Grace, Demon Lord's Ally Disaster Rank: Catastrophe  Veldora Tempest is the youngest of the four strongest dragons (True Dragons). He is connected with [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962) by an agreement and was known to rampage here and there. He was the one to name Rimuru and Rimuru gave him his last name, since they share the same last name, Rimuru could technically be classified as Veldora's adoptive brother.

characters.name: Ranga
characters.description: "Star Lord" Ranga is a Wind Spirit Wolf and a loyal follower of [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Tempest-Rimuru). The leader of the Star Wolf Clan, and the son of the previous boss of the Direwolves. He is also one of Rimuru's Twelve Patrons who has been given the title of a "Lord".

characters.name: Milim Nava
characters.description: Kind: Inhabitant  "Destroyer" Milim Nava is one of the oldest and strongest Demon Lords. She is a Dragonoid. Her nickname, Destroyer, is not just for show. She is a demon lord one should never fight against.

characters.name: Shizu
characters.description: Shizu was the companion of the previous Hero and a Japanese Summoned One. She is also known as the "Explosive Monarch", an A ranked Adventurer of the Freedom Association's Headquarters, and the formal homeroom teacher of the Freedom Academy's S Class students.  She was also the mentor of several excellent pupils whom became important figures of society.

characters.name: Benimaru
characters.description: Benimaru is one of the third group of subordinate Monsters to be named by Rimuru Tempest. Originally an Ogre, he was uncertain of his servitude and intended for it to be temporary, but after being named, he evolved into a Kijin, immediately becoming Rimuru's most powerful subordinate for a time, and decided to serve him permanently. He lives in the Capital city of the Jura Tempest Federation: Rimuru City. Soon after, and became Commander-in-Chief, giving him direct command over Tempest's military forces. Upon Rimuru's ascension to a True Demon Lord, Benimaru evolved into a Fair Oni and reached the strength of a Disaster-Class Monster.

characters.name: Souei
characters.description: Height: 180 cm (Kijin), 190 cm (Ogre)  Souei is an Ogre that was among the third group of subordinates to be named by Rimuru Tempest. He is Rimuru's faithful shadow and the leader of the Shadow Squad of the Jura Tempest Federation.

characters.name: Shuna
characters.description: Shuna is one of the third group of subordinate Monsters to be named by [Rimuru](https://anilist.co/character/123962), evolving her from an Ogre to a Kijin. She was originally the princess of the Ogre tribe and even though she had the talent for using Magic, she was a sheltered girl, but quickly got along with the Goblinas  Shuna is the daughter of the late ogre chieftain and she is also [Benimaru](https://anilist.co/character/128038)'s younger sister, which is why she's nicknamed "Oni Princess" by Rimuru. Very skilled and knowledgeable in domestic matters, she essentially becomes Rimuru's chief economic advisor together with [Rigurd](https://anilist.co/character/129348).

characters.name: Rimuru Tempest
characters.description: Species:  Human (past life) → Slime Kind:  Reincarnated, Otherworlder  Rimuru Tempest, formerly known as Satoru Mikami, is the main protagonist of Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken. They are the founder and King of the monster country Tempest, situated in the Great Jura Forest, and the partner and sworn friend of Storm Dragon, [Veldora Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/128034/Veldora-Tempest).

characters.name: Daikenja
characters.description: Unique Skill Great Sage is one of the first two Unique Skills (the other being Predator) that [Rimuru Tempest](https://anilist.co/character/123962/Rimuru-Tempest) had upon being born into his new world. It had evolved from Extra Skill Sage during his death, as he thought since he was approaching his forties as a virgin, he must be something much greater than a mere wizard.   !During Rimuru's evolution into Demon Lord this Unique Skill evolved into the Ultimate Skill: Wisdom King Raphael.!  !Rimuru gave her a name and she evolved into a manas with the name Ciel!

characters.name: Rigurd
characters.description: Formerly the chief of the goblin village Rimuru comes across. He's now the acting prime minister of the Jura Tempest Federation. He evolved into a hobgoblin when Rimuru named him.

characters.name: Rigur
characters.description: Rigur was named after his late elder brother.  Rigur, after making Gobuta the garrison squad leader, has been supporting his father Rigurdo.

characters.name: Gobta
characters.description: Gobta is a hobgoblin and is one of Rimuru Tempest's followers. Though he seems to be air-headed he tends to be a hard-worker and dependable when the time calls for it.

characters.name: Myrd
characters.description: Myrd is younger brother of Garm and Dord. Though he was a dwarf of few words, he was an expert at what he does. Having knowledge in construction, and well-versed in the arts, he is a one of a kind genius. Myrd was appointed as the captain of the construction team.

characters.name: Kaijin
characters.description: Kaijin was a blacksmith of the Dwarven Kingdom, and the brother of Kaidou. After he was exiled from his own country, he became Rimuru Tempest's subordinate, and helped build the Monster City "Tempest", he acted as a builder, blacksmith, and craftsmen. He also was the former commander of the Dwargon Engineering Corps.

characters.name: Shigeo Kageyama
characters.description: **Height:** 157 cm  He is the assistant and disciple of [Arataka Reigen](https://anilist.co/character/89334/Reigen-Arataka). He is also the newest member of the Body Improvement Club.  Shigeo is a quiet and polite individual who tries to live a normal life despite having strong telepathic power, he wants to be seen as a good human among the people in his social life. This often makes him naive and gullible when those with malicious intent want to use him for a laugh or to cause trouble but Shigeo has very strong beliefs to never use his powers to hurt another person because of an altercation he faced once as a child.

characters.name: Ekubo
characters.description: Ekubo is a self-proclaimed upper-class evil spirit who has aligned himself with [Mob](https://anilist.co/character/89616) after being defeated by him.  Ekubo wants to be a god. Specifically, he wants to be worshipped by all humanity.  !Despite having that kind of ego, he didn't hesitate to put himself at Mob's mercy in the hopes of using the boy to his advantage. At first, he wanted to steal Mob's body and use it to become a god, but he eventually decided to try to make Mob a god instead.!

characters.name: Ritsu Kageyama
characters.description: Height: 159.4 cm  Ritsu is very clever and apparently serious, he also serves on the student council and excels in academics and everything else he tries. None of that matters to him as much as psychic power, however, his brother is more important to him than anyone or anything else.  !Before he awoke his own psychic powers, he longed for the esper abilities his brother has always had and was frustrated by his own inability to do things like bend spoons. He may have a habit of carrying spoons around with him, for bending purposes. He is a perfectionist with a not-so-hidden dark side. Unlike [Mob](https://anilist.co/character/89616/Kageyama-Shigeo), he finds it okay to use psychic violence against people when necessary.!

characters.name: Tenga Onigawara
characters.description: Tenga Onigawara is the leader of Salt Middle School and an unofficial member of the Body Improvement Club.

characters.name: Tome Kurata
characters.description: School: Salt Middle School School club: Telepathy Club (President)  Tome seems to be a slacker but is passionate about the possibility of using telepathy to contact extraterrestrials. However, when the Telepathy Club's research into the matter bears no results, she quickly gives up. When she learns that [Mob](https://anilist.co/character/89616/Kageyama-Shigeo) is an Esper, her passion is revitalized.

characters.name: Teruki Hanazawa
characters.description: Height: 161.4 cm  Hanazawa Teruki is an esper who was first introduced as an antagonist, but later became [Mob](https://anilist.co/character/89616/Kageyama-Shigeo)'s friend after being defeated by him. He was the shadow leader (urabanchou) of Black Vinegar Middle School, using his psychic powers to rule over the delinquents at his own school, as well as to defeat those from other schools.  Teruki is a talented, quick-thinking, and hardworking esper. In terms of raw power, he is nowhere near Mob's level, but he compensates for this by putting in effort and training diligently. He is able to analyze other espers' techniques and their weaknesses in a short amount of time, and often incorporates said techniques in his own fights. He is constantly training to improve himself, and is remarked by various espers as possessing a keen and powerful set of skills.

characters.name: Ichi Mezato
characters.description: Ichi Mezato is a  school girl who goes to Salt Middle School and is part of the News Club.  She is in class 2-1.

characters.name: Takane Tsubomi
characters.description: She is a middle schooler at Salt Middle School. Mob harbors a large crush on her.  !Most of what we know about Tsubomi's personality in the manga is from what Mob and other characters say about her. However, in the anime adaptation, there are extra scenes of Tsubomi that add to her character and personality and make her a more compassionate individual.!

characters.name: Gou Asahi
characters.description: Gou is an esper and one of the children who was invited to the Awakening Lab.

characters.name: Rei Kurosaki
characters.description: Rei is an esper and one of the children who was invited to the Awakening Lab

characters.name: Takeshi Hoshino
characters.description: Takeshi is an esper and one of the children who was invited to the Awakening Lab

characters.name: Musashi Gouda
characters.description: Musashi Goda is a student of Salt Middle School and the Body Improvement Club's President. Musashi has a strong sense of justice but strongly disagrees with senseless violence

characters.name: Arataka Reigen
characters.description: Height: 179 cm (5'10.5")  [Mob's](https://anilist.co/character/89616) mentor and boss in the Mob Psycho 100 series. He owns a business exorcising ghosts and is a self-proclaimed psychic.   He is Mob's moral compass. He was the first person to ever consider Mob as normal and his teachings have never failed Mob.

characters.name: Shou Suzuki
characters.description: !Sho Suzuki is the son of the leader of Claw. He led a direct resistance against his father's world domination plan.!

characters.name: Miyuki Shirogane
characters.description: Height: 175 cm  He is a second year student at Shuchi'in Academy and the president of the student council.  Miyuki is a handsome young man with blond hair and blue eyes. Due to his constant sleep deprivation and nearsightedness, his eyes appear to glare. He usually wears the regular Shuchi'in Academy black male uniform adorned with the Aiguilette, the golden chain-like accessory around his neck. The Aiguilette symbolizes his authority as student council president.  Shirogane is a diligent student who, despite his underprivileged background, climbed his way to the top of his class through hard work and determination. Shirogane holds himself in high regard, consistently working to maintain his perfect image. He is textbook workaholic, enjoying his part-time job and often putting his own health at risk for the sake of his work. Due to his poor background, Shirogane values money greatly and goes to great lengths to not be wasteful, and generally dislikes expensive gifts.  !Miyuki's mother left his family when he was a child. Miyuki's father's factory was shut down and currently has no stable employment. They live in an apartment that costs ￥50,000 (Approx $450) a month. Due to this grisly past, he has been led to a lifestyle of part time jobs and hard work. He passed the Level 2 Kanji Kentei exam and has passed Grade Pre 1 on Eiken. He has also got second place on the National mock exam.!  !Miyuki transferred into Shuchi'in Academy during his first year of high school on a scholarship. His first week was a disappointment in that a great majority of his peers were condescending to him because of transferring in. Miyuki was being recruited to serve as the new student council general affairs officer by the Previous Student Council President and helped clean up a swamp. There, he saw Kaguya Shinomiya saving a girl from drowning. It was at that moment where he was truly charmed by Kaguya. At the advice of fellow student council member Momo Ryuju, he adopted the confident genius personality he is shown to have at the story's beginning in order to attract her.!  Even though he is obviously in love with [Kaguya Shinomiya](https://anilist.co/character/120649/Shinomiya-Kaguya), her wealth and talents greatly intimidates him, leaving him utterly terrified at the idea of confessing to her. He fears that all of his actions will lead Kaguya to look down him, causing him to overthink in many situations. Shirogane has never had a girlfriend and thus is actually quite clueless when it comes to romance, though his dignified demeanor leaves most of the students to think otherwise. Although he excels at studying, Shirogane has proven to be painfully talentless in a variety of other activities, such as sports, singing, dancing and more.  Despite this, Shirogane is unwaveringly kind and virtuous, never putting any of his goals above the well-being of others. He is extremely supportive and generous, willing to help any students with their problems, and will put aside his quest to get Kaguya to confess if it even has a chance of hurting someone else.

characters.name: Yuu Ishigami
characters.description: The treasurer of the student council of the Shuchiin Academy. He's extremely valued by [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101), given that he single-handedly manages all the school's funds. He's also terrified of [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649), though no one else is sure why that is. Yuu keeps to himself and rarely speaks up, often getting into trouble when he does. He has a depressed outlook on life while having an inferiority complex. In contrast to his attitude, he is willing to help those in need and will sacrifice his pride if need be. Unlike his high school self, he had a much different outlook and demeanor during middle school.  Later in the series:  !Ishigami develops a crush on Tsubame that he inadvertently confesses his feelings for her at the school's cultural festival. Ishigami does not realize that his actions were perceived as a confession by the rest of the student body and is therefore oblivious to the implications of having given Tsubame a heart-shaped gift (considered akin to a confession in Shuchiin tradition). After some convincing by Kaguya, Tsubame decides to seriously consider Ishigami's confession, with her original intention being to let him down as gently as possible. It isn't until Ishigami watches Tsubame's performance of the traditional play that gave rise to the aforementioned tradition that he realizes his actions had unintended meaning. Even then, Ishigami's thickheaded nature prevented him from recognizing the full meaning of his actions: a straight confession!  !On the day of the third years' graduation ceremony, Tsubame finally has an answer for Ishigami's proposal. Despite Ishigami doing his best to convince Tsubame to accept him, Tsubame ultimately rejects Ishigami. Tsubame promises Ishigami that the two of them will remain friends and Ishigami sees her off with a smile and a gift of flowers. Afterwards, Ishigami breaks into tears, finally learning what heartbreak is like.!

characters.name: Chika Fujiwara
characters.description: The secretary of the Shuchiin Academy student council. She could not be predicted, her thoughts could not be read. A natural disaster who unconsciously threw everything into chaos simply by being present, also known as Subject F.  !In chapter 222 of the manga, Chika reveals that she played piano because she wanted to be perfect, and she becomes a prodigy at the piano. The expectations of her family and her fans rose, forcing her to practice more. She quit piano after Kaguya told her to just quit if she didn't like the piano. Soon after Chika challenged Kaguya to a game battle and if she won, she would get to become Kaguya's friend. In the end, she becomes Kaguya's first friend.!

characters.name: Ai Hayasaka
characters.description: Ai Hayasaka is a second-year student at Shuchiin Academy and a valet of the Shinomiya family. She is a member of the Hayasaka family, who have served the Shinomiya family for generations, gaining their trust.  Having been personally assigned to enter Shuchiin Academy with her, Ai supports [Kaguya Shinomiya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) in her high school life and has been a part of Kaguya's life for ten years. Because of their close relationship, Ai is one of the few people around to which Kaguya's amiability is not an act.  Even if she demonstrates maturity as a valet, Ai still has the concerns of a young girl, such as caring to be in fashion and going out with friends, even if she does not have much time for herself due to work.  Ai helps Kaguya with the struggles about her feelings for [Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101).  !She later leaves her job as a maid to Kaguya but still continues her friendship.!  !In the Doujin-ban universe, she starts dating and later gets engaged to Shirogane!

characters.name: Tsubame Koyasu
characters.description: Tsubame is a third-year student who is vice-captain of the cheer squad and a rhythmic gymnast. She is very popular. She encourages [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/121102) in the cheering activities.

characters.name: Tsubasa Tanuma
characters.description: He is a student in Shuchi'in highschool and always asks [Miyuki Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101) for advice about love. [Kashiwagi](https://anilist.co/character/134330)'s boyfriend.

characters.name: Moeha Fujiwara
characters.description: Moeha is [Chika](https://anilist.co/character/121103)'s little sister who is in junior high. She is the student council vice-president at the junior high. She admires [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101) as well and hopes to confess someday. She has a habit of voicing dark ideas, which unnerve [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) a great deal.

characters.name: Nagisa Kashiwagi
characters.description: Nagisa is a classmate who occasionally asks [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) about what to do in her relationships. [Tsubasa](https://anilist.co/character/134327)'s girlfriend.

characters.name: Kobachi Osaragi
characters.description: Kobachi is [Miko](https://anilist.co/character/125886)'s classmate with the glasses and a member of the disciplinary committee. She has been looking after Miko for over 10 years.  !Though she doesn't love him in a romantic way, she has liked Yu Ishigami since middle school. She believes that Tsubame Koyasu is a kind person and is therefore supportive of Ishigami's feelings for Tsubame, despite her friend Miko being in love with Ishigami as well.!

characters.name: Miko Iino
characters.description: Height: 147 cm (4'7")  She is a freshman at Shuchiin Private Academy and the Auditor of the Student Council. Miko has a strong sense of justice and will correct others on what's right and wrong. Unfortunately, this led to her being bullied, though she still continues to uphold her idea of "right". She idolizes [Chika Fujiwara](https://anilist.co/character/121103), listening to anything she says, even if it's for Chika's enjoyment.

characters.name: Kei Shirogane
characters.description: Kei Shirogane is [Miyuki Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101)'s little sister. She attends Shuchiin middle school and is the treasurer for the middle school student council.  She is a hard worker just like her brother and can be very prideful at times. She also inherited his sense of righteousness and hates it when someone doesn't do the right thing in a given situation. Like her brother, she likes helping out those who are in trouble even if it means going out of her way to do it. Since she grew up in a family that places emphasis on saving money, she normally carries coupons and works hard for the things she wants to buy.   She developed a prickly attitude towards her brother due to his over protectiveness. She's also entered a rebellious phase and due to her pride and she cannot get herself to have a lighthearted conversation with Miyuki, leading into the similar mind games that Miyuki and [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) play against each other, but her objective is to talk to Miyuki without making it look like she has a brother complex. She rarely speaks and most of the time it is only when she exchanges formalities at school or when she hurls abuses at her brother.

characters.name: Kaguya Shinomiya
characters.description: Height: 158 cm  The vice president of the student council of Shuchiin Academy, member of the wealthy Shinomiya family, she is a multi-talented genius who can do anything if she sets her mind to it. Due to the way she was raised, she instinctively looks down on others and thinks of ways to use them for her own benefit. Kaguya rarely interacted with other people before she joined the student council, but that has begun to change. She is an incredibly sheltered girl, resulting in her lacking in several pieces of what might be considered common sense. She still doesn’t understand love very well, and her main objective is to make [Miyuki Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101) fall in love and confess to her.  Later in the series: !She confesses her love to Miyuki Shirogane and they start dating.!   !In a Oshi no Ko special chapter, it was revealed that she married Miyuki and changed her surname to Kaguya Shirogane!

characters.name: Adolphe Pescarolo
characters.description: The Principal of Shuchi'in Academy He's strict regarding school regulations, but knows how to garner the favor of students nonetheless. He helped Yu Ishigami get enrolled to Shuchi'in despite not finishing his task of making an apology letter. Despite being an authority figure within the school, he has shown comical disregard for school rules and discipline when it comes to his own actions, having been openly caught playing Pokemon Go on more than one occasion on school grounds while chastising nearby students for doing the same.

characters.name: Shirogane no Chichi
characters.description: Father of [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101) and [Kei Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/126144).  !His wife left him and their factory shut down leaving him to not have any stable employment.!  !He later becomes a youtuber.!

characters.name: Kumin Tsuyuri
characters.description: Kumin is [Yuuta](https://anilist.co/character/65863)'s chill and carefree senpai who loves adventures, cats, and pillows. Spends most of the time in the club room napping. She adores any chuunibyous and once said that it would've been fun to have some delusions herself.

characters.name: Sanae Dekomori
characters.description: Sanae is an underclassman to the rest of the club members. She, like [Rikka](https://anilist.co/character/65865/Takanashi-Rikka), is a Chuunibyou. She claims that she is Rikka's servant and wants to take her master's place. Her "power" is Mjolnir, a pair of hair nunchucks. Despite being a Chuunibyou, she is top in her class. Little was known about her relatives but it's implied that she is from a rich family.    !She eventually becomes the student council president with [Nibutani](https://anilist.co/character/65871/Nibutani-Shinka) as her vice president. Her "nunchucks" are filled with candy, since her previous attempt with cookies didn't go well.! (Source: Anime News Network)

characters.name: Nanase Tsukumo
characters.description: Yuuta and Rikka's homeroom teacher, who is often kind, if sometimes a little sadistic in teasing her students, particularly Rikka. She is called Nana-chan by Yuuta and Rikka.

characters.name: Kuzuha Togashi
characters.description: Kuzuha is [Yuuta Togashi](https://anilist.co/character/65863/Togashi-Yuuta)'s younger sister who is in the first year of junior high school.  She knows Yuuta very well, especially how he acted during his Chuunibyou days in middle school as Dark Flame Master, though she always considered him embarrassing. Kuzuha got used to her older brother's delusions since she was young. Every once in a while she would ponder if her brother's acts were actually cool before immediately dismissing the thought as Yuuta would spectacularly embarrass himself yet again.

characters.name: Togashi no Haha
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Takanashi no Haha
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Yuuta Togashi
characters.description: A high school boy who used to be a delusional teen, believing himself to be the Dark Flame Master and becoming alienated from everyone as a result. Finding this to be embarrassing, he attempts to erase this past from existence, even choosing to go to a separate high school from all of his junior high school classmates. However, after encountering [Rikka](https://anilist.co/character/65865), his past delusions come back to haunt him.

characters.name: Rikka Takanashi
characters.description: Height: 150 cm (4'11")  Rikka Takanashi is an active Chuunibyou, who still has the syndrome. Her delusional syndrome involves her right eye which she calls her "Wicked Eye," which, according to her, wields darkness tamed by the power of a pure heart. In reality, her so-called "Wicked Eye" is nothing more than a colored contact lens which she conceals underneath an eyepatch. Despite being quite attached to [Yuuta](https://anilist.co/character/65863/Togashi-Yuuta), she is cautious of strangers and adopts a battle pose whenever she meets someone for the first time. She is also rather clumsy, often tripping over and forgetting things. She also doesn't have many friends, as shown that in her mobile phone only has her sister's email.    !Rikka's father died in the past, which she stubbornly denies. In the process, she one-sidedly met Yuuta, who was an active chuunibyou at that time, and was amazed by how cool Yuuta was as the Dark Flame Master. Her belief that her father is in the "horizon" is the cause of her chuunibyou.!  !Rikka eventually falls in love with Yuuta and makes a contract with him.!

characters.name: Makoto Isshiki
characters.description: Yuuta's classmate and friend. He created a "cutie poll" which ranked all the girls in class in terms of cuteness. However, because of this, his head was shaved into a crew cut. Later on he joins Rikka's club and develops a crush on Kumin.

characters.name: Shinka Nibutani
characters.description: A beautiful girl in [Yuuta](https://anilist.co/character/65863/Togashi-Yuuta)'s class. Shinka is Yuuta's classmate and class representative, who is also a cheerleader. One of the most popular girls in the class due to her looks, she is generally thought of a kind and gentle girl.   !She too suffered a case of eighth-grader syndrome, going by the name of Forest Summer. Like Yuuta, she chose a school that none of her former classmates were going to so she could escape from her embarrassing past.   When she is with Yuuta, [Rikka](https://anilist.co/character/65865/Takanashi-Rikka), and the others in the clubroom, her usual happy, sweet demeanor fades and she is blunt, edgy, and tends to fight with [Dekomori](https://anilist.co/character/67215/Dekomori-Sanae) quite a lot. This is because Dekomori admires Forest Summer (and does not believe Shinka is actually Forest Summer, constantly referring to Shinka as "fake Forest Summer") and has numerous copies of books, consisting of documents that Forest Summer had written, titled Mabinogion. Shinka seeks to destroy every last trace of her past, and Dekomori is a barrier against this, causing frequent fights between them.!

characters.name: Yumeha Togashi
characters.description: Yumeha is Yuuta's youngest sister.

characters.name: Touka Takanashi
characters.description: Older sister to [Rikka Takanashi](https://anilist.co/character/65865). According to Rikka, she is the alleged powerful and overseeing Priestess of the Deep Horizon. She uses a ladle as a weapon against Rikka's crazy antics. She works as a cook.   !Later in the story she moves to Italy for work and eventually marries there.!

characters.name: Takanashi no Sofu
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Takanashi no Sobo
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Lilia
characters.description: Lilia is a maid of the Greyrat household. She was [Paul](https://anilist.co/character/88347/Paul-Greyrat)'s classmate in a swordsman dojo. A crippling injury forces her to leave her position as a princess guard, and she becomes a maid to Paul and [Zenith](https://anilist.co/character/179855/Zenith-Greyrat).  !After working through the revelation with the family, she is taken in as Paul's second wife and becomes closer friends with Zenith. Lillia gets pregnant with Paul's daughter and becomes the mother of [Aisha Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145459/Aisha-Greyrat)!

characters.name: Zenith Greyrat
characters.description: Zenith Greyrat is the wife of [Paul Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88347) and the mother of [Rudeus Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88348) and [Norn Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145458/Norn-Greyrat).  !Zenith was born in the Holy Country of Milis, as the second daughter of an earl of Milis. She grew up following the Milis Church religion, never breaking the rules, getting good grade in school, and had nickname Milis young lady standard. But, when Zenith reached the age of 15, she rebelled against her parents and ran away from home.  While trying to find a job as a Healer, she was a solo adventurer for a time. However she was frequently conned out of a large amount of money due to the little knowledge she had on how expensive healer's are, but was saved by Paul Greyrat. She then join Paul's party, the Fangs of the Black Wolf, as a healer. She spent a long time in the party as a healer and gradually began to fall in love with Paul and wanted to marry him. However Paul was a womanizer who frequently slept with multiple women and she didn't want to be with someone like that so she told him if he promised to be faithful to her then she would sleep with him, to which he agreed. Shortly after, she became pregnant with Rudeus and as a result both her and Paul retired from adventuring and settled down in the countryside.!   Light Novel Volume 13 Spoiler !After being freed from the Teleport Labyrinth, she does not express emotions actively since she sees the world around her as if she were in a trance or dream. Occasionally she will display actions that show her emotions, such as when she smiled at Norn or hit Rudeus when he said he was going to add Eris to his family as a wife, which shows signs of her personality basically unchanged but hidden and suppressed by her dream state caused by her Miko Powers.!

characters.name: Sylphiette
characters.description: Sylphiette is [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat)' childhood friend who is part human, elf, and beast race.  !Following the teleportation incident, during which her hair turned white from mana exhaustion, she became Princess Ariel's personal bodyguard under the alias Fitz.!  !She is Rudeus' first wife and gives birth to their daughter Lucy and son Sieghardt. She is one of the three goddesses Rudeus worships in his religion. A cloth stained with her virgin blood that serves as a relic for the Goddess of Love is enshrined in the basement.!

characters.name: Paul Greyrat
characters.description: Paul Greyrat is the father of [Rudeus Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat), [Norn Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145458/Greyrat-Norn) and [Aisha Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145459/Greyrat-Aisha). He is both a talented man that became advanced in all three sword arts at a young age and a lustful man that attracts and sleeps with many women before [Zenith](https://anilist.co/character/179855/Zenith-Greyrat) chained him down.

characters.name: Rudeus Greyrat
characters.description: Height: 175 cm (5'9")  Rudeus is a tall, well-built, and cool-looking man. However, before his reincarnation, he was originally an overweight 34-year-old Japanese NEET who became a recluse following his high-school persecution. Because of his former life, he is careful not to get carried away and become arrogant. As a result, he is extremely self-aware and humble because he does not want to revert to his old self. He is a kind person, helping his friends and protecting his family whenever needed. Due to being capable in many fields, people have high expectations of him. His current body possesses a high affinity for magic even as a child. Rudeus is very polite to others, often making them uncomfortable.  Rudeus is one of the few people capable of using a voiceless incantation, and even rarer as a person who can use voiceless incantation with melded magics. He cannot use voiceless incantation for healing magic due to his lack of understanding in regards to how mana is manipulated to heal. A normal Magician takes at least five seconds for a simple spell, while for higher-level spells it's thirty to sixty seconds. Rudeus can do it almost instantly no matter what difficulty of the spell, with the exception of healing magic.

characters.name: Eris Boreas Greyrat
characters.description: Eris Boreas Greyrat is a noble girl and distant relative of [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat). She is a tsundere with a short temper but has potential in the Sword-God style.  !She is Rudeus' third wife and gives birth to their son Ars and daughter Christina. She is one of the three goddesses Rudeus worships in his religion. A wooden sword that serves as a relic for the Goddess of War is enshrined in the basement.!

characters.name: Roxy Migurdia
characters.description: Roxy Migurdia is a talented mage from the Migurd race, and a former magic tutor. Because she can't use telepathy, she left her village due to feeling isolated from her peers. Unable to make a stable living as an adventurer, she became a travelling tutor and eventually becomes [Rudeus'](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) teacher.  !She is Rudeus' second wife and gives birth to their daughter Lara & Lily. She is one of the three goddesses Rudeus worships in his religion. Her panties that serves as a relic for the Goddess of Wisdom is enshrined in the basement.!

characters.name: Ruijerd Superdia
characters.description: Ruijerd Superdia is the former leader of the Superd's Warrior group whom once served under Laplace with unwavering loyalty. He was accompanying [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) and [Eris](https://anilist.co/character/88349/Eris-Boreas-Greyrat).  !Laplace betrayed his group by giving them each a devil spear which made them ecstatic from killing, even their own family. After giving his son a fatal wound, his son managed to destroy the devil spear and Ruijerd finally wakes up from the brainwash. He considered committing suicide but decided not to and everyone of that warrior group swore revenged on Laplace.  He finally got his revenge after several years of hiding. He interfered in the battle between Laplace and the three heroes. But even if Laplace was defeated, there was no way to change the things that had already transpired.  After exacting his revenge, he now has a goal of removing the infamy the Superd race has.!

characters.name: Norn Greyrat
characters.description: Norn Greyrat is the daughter of [Zenith Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/179855/Zenith-Greyrat) and [Paul Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88347/Paul-Greyrat) and is the younger sister of [Rudeus Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88348) and older half-sister of [Aisha Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145459/Aisha-Greyrat).

characters.name: Aisha Greyrat
characters.description: Aisha Greyrat is the daughter of [Lilia](https://anilist.co/character/179854/Lilia) and [Paul Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88347/Paul-Greyrat) and is the younger half-sister of [Rudeus Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) and [Norn Greyrat](https://anilist.co/character/145458/Norn-Greyrat).

characters.name: Zanoba  Shirone
characters.description: Zanoba Shirone is a doll loving prince of Shirone. When he was three years old, he killed his brother, the Fourth prince, as if his brother was a doll. When he was 15 years old, he killed his wife, as if she was a doll.

characters.name: Shizuka Nanahoshi
characters.description: Light Novel Volume 9 spoiler  ! Nanahoshi Shizuka is a Japanese girl that was saved by [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) in his past life, but instead of reincarnating like Rudeus, she was teleported to Asura Kingdom and was saved by [Orsted](https://anilist.co/character/187382/Orsted). !

characters.name: Kishirika Kishirisu
characters.description: Kishirika Kishirisu is The Great Empress of the Demon Realm. She is the demon empress known for her demon eyes' powers and the ability to bestow others with demon eyes. She is engaged to [Badigadi](https://anilist.co/character/262620/Badigadi), the demon lord of immortality.  Light Novel Volume 4 Spoiler !Kishirika Kishirisu is the person that is responsible for giving [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) his demon eye, among other favors!

characters.name: Orsted
characters.description: Orsted is the current Dragon God, 2nd-ranked of the 7 World Powers, and the sworn enemy of [Hitogami](https://anilist.co/character/211165/Hitogami). Similar to other Dragon Race people such as [Perugius](https://anilist.co/character/209572/Perugius-Dola), he has silver hair and golden sanpaku eyes with an overpowering look. He carries no visible equipment and wears a white coat adorned with fur.  Orsted has a curse that makes every living being feel an overwhelming fear just from being within his presence. Strangely enough, this curse does not affect [Rudeus](https://anilist.co/character/88348/Rudeus-Greyrat) or [Nanahoshi](https://anilist.co/character/137816/Nanahoshi-Shizuka).

characters.name: Elinalise Dragonroad
characters.description: Elinalise is a former member of Paul's party. She has an erotic nature due to her curse. She is a warrior that is good at managing monster aggro but isn't a great fighter.

characters.name: Kojirou Sasaki
characters.description: He was summoned by [Caster](https://anilist.co/character/3440/Medea) as a guardian and watchmen for the front gate of the Ryudo Temple.  As an improper servant, Assassin is entirely dependent on Caster for mana and cannot move freely beyond the grounds of Ryudoji. Furthermore, he lacks most of the usual parameters and abilities granted to his class. Because of his limited status, Assassin cares little for the Holy Grail, and outside of his duties to Caster, he only seeks to enjoy a decent sword fight.

characters.name: Archer
characters.description: Height: 187 cm (6'1)  In Fate/stay night UBW:   !He is the Servant of one of the series' main heroines, [Rin Tousaka](https://anilist.co/character/498/Tohsaka-Rin). Due to an incomplete summon, he apparently has no memory of his previous life or identity. Archer is sarcastic and cynical but under his hardened exterior lies a complex and dark personality that unfolds throughout the story. Though skilled with ranged weapons, he can hold his own in melee combat. Archer considers [Shirou Emiya](https://anilist.co/character/496/Emiya-Shirou)'s idealism to be weak and delusional, recognizing the mentality of "wanting to save everyone" as naive and impossible.  Archer is actually a future version of Emiya Shirou, who became a hero through Emiya's wish to save innocent lives. After his death he became a Counter Guardian, a Spirit deployed to maintain balance and prevent humanity's extinction, but without the ability to act on his own he was forced to kill and face the fact that his ideals were not realizable time and time again.   To escape this cycle the only hope for EMIYA was to be summoned as a Heroic Spirit and kill his past self before he became a Counter Guardian, which would cause a time paradox and release him from the cycle.!  In Fate/Grand Order - First Order:  !EMIYA was Blackened, a process by which a being is tainted by an outside force, causing their personality to be reversed toward the orientation of evil!

characters.name: Soichirou Kuzuki
characters.description: A well-built man with angular glasses, Kuzuki is the strict homeroom instructor of [Rin's](https://anilist.co/character/498/Tohsaka-Rin) class. He primarily lectures on World History, though he also holds classes in Ethics. Kuzuki is well respected among staff and students, but he is widely regarded as austere and impersonal.  !A serial killer, he is [Caster's](https://anilist.co/character/3440/Medea) ally but acts more as her servant. He is in love with Caster although he hides it completely. He hid the fact that they had been defeated by the protagonists from Caster when she lay dying to spare her feelings; saying that victory was theirs he held her until she died, and perished himself immediately afterward.!

characters.name: Cú  Chulainn
characters.description: Born as Sètanta from a mortal woman, Deichtine, and the Sun God Lugh he's a Hero from the Ulster Cycle of Irish Mythology. He took the name Cú Chulainn after he killed the guard dog of the blacksmith Culann, said to be stronger than 10 men, when he was only a child. To make up to the old blacksmith he offered himself as a guard dog and since then was called Cú Chulainn, "Culann's savage dog".  Trained in the Arts of the Spear and magic Runes by Scáthach, he wields the cursed Gàe Bolg, the spear that inflicts wounds that never heal.    In Fate/Stay Night:  !  Originally the servant of [Bazett Fraga McRemitz](https://anilist.co/character/24332/Fraga-McRemitz-Bazett), he becomes the Servant of [Kirei Kotomine](https://anilist.co/character/506/Kotomine-Kirei) after Kirei fatally wounds Bazett and remains under his command for the duration of the War. !  In Fate/Grand Order -First Order: !  He is a Caster-class servant. Unlike the other Servants, he's not blackened and aids [Mash](https://anilist.co/character/120735/Kyrielight-Mash) and [Ritsuka](https://anilist.co/character/120734/Fujimaru-Ritsuka) in their task !  In Fate/hollow Ataraxia:   ! [Caren Hortensia](https://anilist.co/character/46957/Hortensia-Caren) acts as his Master.!

characters.name: Shinji Matou
characters.description: [Sakura Matou](https://anilist.co/character/500/Matou-Sakura)'s older brother, and a long-time friend of [Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496/Emiya-Shirou). Shinji is very popular as vice-captain of the archery dojo despite being chauvinistic and a narcissist. Like [Rin Tohsaka](https://anilist.co/character/498/Tohsaka-Rin), he is of a distinguished lineage of sorcerers, though the Matou blood has thinned and no longer produces heirs naturally capable of sorcery.  Shinji feels uncomfortable with his sister's daily visits to Shirou's home.  He has an open crush on Rin, but she does not return his favors.

characters.name: Medusa
characters.description: !Medusa is a Greek mythological figure described as a winged human female with living venomous snakes in place of hair. Those who gazed upon her face would turn to stone.   With her older sisters [Stheno](https://anilist.co/character/191058/Stheno) and [Euryale](https://anilist.co/character/191065/Euryale), they made up the three Gorgon Sisters who inhabited the Shapeless Isle. She came into existence thanks to the thoughts and prayers of humans, who desired a perfect goddess, but she was cursed for her beauty and turned into a monster hated by all. She is thus not a Heroic Spirit but a monster closer to a Divine Spirit.   Due to her nature, she can manifest through different aspects depending on which disposition is predominant (more or less monstrous)!   In Fate/stay night: !She is the Rider-class Servant of [Shinji Matou](https://anilist.co/character/501/Matou-Shinji) in the Fifth Holy Grail War of Fate/stay night.!  In Fate/stay night: Heaven's Feel: !She only truly acts as [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/500/Matou-Sakura)'s Servant when their connection is revealed in Heaven's Feel.!  In Fate/Grand Order - First Order: !She is a Lancer-class Servant. Medusa is Blackened, a process by which a being is tainted by an outside force, causing their personality to be reversed toward the orientation of evil.!  In Fate/Grand Order: Absolute Demonic Front Babylonia: !In this singularity Medusa manifests as two separate beings:   One is Ana, a Lancer-class Servant without a Master. This incarnation represents the young Medusa, from a time when she wasn't known as the monster inhabiting the Shapless Ile. Though still wary of humans for casting her away, she is much closer to the perfect Goddess she was supposed to be.  The other one is Gorgon, an Avenger-class Servant. This incarnation represents Medusa as a man-eating monster. The burning hatred against the humans that exiled her and her sisters led her to become the very monster they accused her to be. Gorgon wields Tiamat's Authority which grants her the ability to generate Demonic Beasts.!

characters.name: Heracles
characters.description: In Fate/Stay Night: !The Servant of [Illya](https://anilist.co/character/503/von-Einzbern-Illyasviel), he is a swarthy giant with adamantine skin and gross brawn. He wields a colossal stone Axe-Sword, and is capable of causing massive destruction with the mere backlash of his swings. As a Berserker, he was stripped of his sanity and reason, acting feral and animalistic in combat. Berserkers are praised as members of the "Strongest" class, though they are difficult to control. Illya, however, appears to have little trouble managing Berserker.!

characters.name: Taiga Fujimura
characters.description: Height: 165 cm   She is an English teacher at [Shirou's](https://anilist.co/character/496/Emiya-Shirou) school, homeroom instructor of Shirou's class and the supervising teacher for the archery dojo. After [Kiritsugu](https://anilist.co/character/10010/Emiya-Kiritsugu) died, Taiga became Shirou's guardian and has been living with him for several years. Taiga and Shirou are very close, and she regards him as a younger brother.  She's initially distrustful of [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria), believing that "some strange woman was trying to take Shirou from her" as she put it. She becomes exasperated whenever a new girl appears at Shirou's house, thinking he stashes girls at his house. Taiga always shows up for breakfast and dinner at Shirou's house to have some of [Sakura's](https://anilist.co/character/500/Matou-Sakura) cooking, and always saves some scraps from breakfast for her lunch.     !During Rider's Blood Fort attack on Shirou's school, Taiga was the only person who could still move around somewhat. Begging [Shinji Matou](https://anilist.co/character/501/Matou-Shinji) for help, he quickly kicks her in the head, knocking her unconscious. She recovers quickly though, even pigging-out on hospital food while recovering.!

characters.name: Eishi Tsukasa
characters.description: Eishi is a 90th Generation student of Tootsuki Culinary Academy and the current 1st seat of the Elite Ten Council.  Eishi, despite being the current 1st seat of the Elite Ten Council, is quite pessimistic, feeling that he does not deserve the 1st seat. He feels exasperated by the work forced upon him as the 1st seat and the workload caused by the two Shokugekis during the 43rd Annual Tootsuki Autumn Election.  (Source: Shokugeki no Souma Wikia)

characters.name: Tetsuji Kabutoyama
characters.description: Tetsuji Kabutoyama is a 91st Generation student of Totsuki Culinary Academy and the president of the Skewer RS.

characters.name: Erina Nakiri
characters.description: Height: 162 cm  One of the two main heroines in the manga, Erina is initially the primary antagonist of [Souma Yukihira](https://anilist.co/character/75216), until this develops into more of a friendship. Erina is the only daughter of [Azami Nakiri](https://anilist.co/character/156421) and an unnamed mother who is [Senzaemon](https://anilist.co/character/76028)'s biological daughter. Erina often detests whoever is considered "common" due to her regal pedigree and status within the Toutsuki organization. Her "God Tongue" can accurately describe the taste and composition of any food, and she gives harsh critiques to chefs and students alike. However, there have been rare occasions where she gives credit to chefs with skill. She had been promoted as the Elite Ten's 10th seat as a middle-schooler.

characters.name: Shouji  Satou
characters.description: Shōji Satō is a 92nd Tōtsuki Generation student and a resident of Polar Star Dormitory.

characters.name: Daigo  Aoki
characters.description: Daigo Aoki is a 92nd Tōtsuki Generation student and a resident of Polar Star Dormitory.

characters.name: Isami Aldini
characters.description: Isami is Takumi's brother, and the younger nephew of the owner of Trattoria Aldini. Unlike his brother, he has more of a Japanese appearance, with black hair and sharp eyes. Isami is originally shown to be overweight, with his eyes and mouth drawn in a simple fashion, although he briefly became much thinner during the Autumn Election preliminaries. Like Isami, he enrolled in Tōtsuki to hone his skills at the behest of their uncle.  Although an equally talented chef, Isami is shown to be less sophisticated than his brother. He was scolded for trying to (and failing to) revise a dish that Takumi had made during their time in the trattoria, and constantly sought to be praised for his cooking like Takumi. Though Isami is supportive of his brother, he does aim to eventually surpass him as a cook. Nonetheless, the brothers are very close.  !At the Autumn Election, he presented a tomato-curry calzone that was praised by the judges. He aimed to surpass his brother's score with the dish, but ultimately finished 5th in his block. He tried to support Takumi in his quarter-finals match against Subaru Mimasaka, and was devastated when Takumi lost to his own dish. He and Takumi opened a booth during the Moon Banquet Festival, naming it a branch of Trattoria Aldini, and gained first place in sales in their area. He is targeted as a rebel by the Azami Administration's Promotional Exams, defeated by Eishi on the third exam and expelled.!  Isami and Takumi are featured in the Shokugeki no Soma – Fratelli Aldini spinoff manga which focuses on their time in Italy before enrolling at Tōtsuki Academy.

characters.name: Terunori Kuga
characters.description: Couisine Style: Chinese  Terunori enrolled into Tōtsuki Culinary Academy as part of the 91st Generation and would later attain the 8th seat of the Elite Ten Council. As a second year student, Terunori completed the Tōtsuki Friendship and Rapport Training Camp and Stagiaire events in his first year. In his first year, he was one of the participants in the Main Tournament of the Tōtsuki Autumn Election.  He is a very competitive person and he has faith in his cooking style and abilities. He has a sadist nature which is one of the reason that he prefer Sezhwan spicy recipes because he likes his customers to sweat and turn red because of the strong taste, and yet keep going at it as the taste is still appealing . He is kind of arrogant too as he is seen boasting about his position and elite 10 at times and belittling the rest of the students.  !When Senzaemon Nakiri was replaced by Azami Nakiri as the new headmaster of the academy, Terunori and three of the other Elite Ten Council members voted against the proposed change in leadership. He was boycotted the subsequent meetings and relieved in his Elite Ten's duties. Four months after Rebeliants' victory, he regained a seat and has been promoted to the 3rd seat.!   (Source: Shokugeki no Soma Wikia)

characters.name: Souma Yukihira
characters.description: Height: 171 cm  He is the son of [Jouichirou Yukihira](https://anilist.co/character/77495) and, until it closed, worked at his father's restaurant, Restaurant Yukihira. Souma fight his odds in the elite school to becoming the best chef in the world even with strong background discrimination of his academy. He is currently a student at Tootsuki Culinary Academy and a resident of Polar Star Dormitory.    Souma is a rather energetic child who has the constant drive to move forward with his cooking, mostly due to his rivalry with his father. Due to his drive to move forward Souma is willing to try odd things with food including "Grilled Squid Tentacles Dressed in Peanut Butter," though these dishes usually don't go over too well. It is because the will of Soma to try to move forward, his dish often considered as creative and innovative by some peers and lecturers; lead his rivalry with all the students in the Tootsuki Culinary Academy even rough. Through all this Souma maintains a laid back attitude towards just about everything but cooking.  Souma can cook many different foods in many different styles, though he prefers what he calls "Yukihira Style," which is the cooking style which he learned from his father. Souma shows an immense capability for cooking and a special adaption with learning from his mistakes and improvising through learning from said mistakes. It is due to his creativity and also resourcefulness, Souma is able to create the same dish with different ways of cooking that would create even . Unlike most student whom used lavish ingredient, Souma didn't care about the classes of the ingredient which claimed that neither expensive ingredients nor classy background nor fancy technique made the food better, is the wise usage and alternatives made the food interesting and the customer's satisfaction about the food matters. Further more, he also claimed that undefeated food in just the looks and taste in regal made him bored, which the boredom would made the chef stop improvise their food. To eliminate such boredom, Souma would continued to search different style of cooking around the world in order to improvised his cooking skills.

characters.name: Akira Hayama
characters.description: An assistant of Professor [Jun Shiomi](https://anilist.co/character/144632/Shiomi-Jun), Akira comes from overseas; they met when he was an orphaned child and warned her about adultered spices in a market (presumably in India). Jun recognized the dormant talent in him and brought him back to Japan, where he was adopted by her teacher, Hayama. Akira quickly learned Japanese and studied spices and aroma under Shiomi. Jun became a mother figure for him, and his motivation to succeed at cooking stems from wanting to give something back to Jun. Akira specializes in curry dishes, with a wide knowledge of spices and aroma.  He is a tall and handsome man with tanned skin and silver hair. Like [Sōma](https://anilist.co/character/75216/Yukihira-Souma), he aims to be at the top of the Elite Ten. His nose is very sharp when it comes to spices, capable of identifying ingredients and grade of cooking by the first smell, considered a worthy match of Erina's God's Tongue and being identified as an "Aroma Master". Although Jun and Akira are both experts in spices, she uses theoretical knowledge while he depends on his sense of smell. In contrast to Jun's naive, ditzy, easily angered and dependent persona, Akira is mature, reliable, street smart, cool and down-to-earth.

characters.name: Subaru Mimasaka
characters.description: A heavily built student who is introduced during the Autumn Election. Despite his look, he's smarter than he appears and has a strong sense for details. He has no specialty, but painstakingly researches and copies the chefs he faces, predicting the exact dish they will make and marginally improving upon it. He loves intense cooking-duels and totally defeating his opponent, so he always bets his opponent's precious tool at Shokugekis. He is a gracious host and not averse to having a casual chat with future opponents. However, before and during a match he will mock, belittle and set out to destroy his opponent.  !Subaru first appears during the Autumn Election preliminaries, taking the fourth spot from Zenji Marui and Shun Ibusaki. He insults Takumi and his brother, provoking Takumi to bet his mezzaluna, and having previously stalked Takumi and investigated his preparations, Subaru copies Takumi's dish with a slight improvement. Although the judges dislike his actions and methods, Subaru's dish is judged superior. This leads Sōma to challenge Subaru to give back all 100 cooking tools he'd won, against the total defeat of Sōma quitting being a cook. Sōma circumvents Subaru's research method by waiting until the competition starts before thinking of ways to improve his dish, something Subaru didn't believe was possible. After his defeat, Subaru tries to leave Tōtsuki and quit as a cook but Sōma convinces him to continue his studies. Subaru later appears when Sōma asks for assistance at his stall during the Moon Banquet Festival. In preparation for this, Subaru went to the Yukihira diner in order to do his "image training", and was able to accurately copy Sōma, allowing the booth to increase production and sales.!  !During Azami's regime on "Promotional Exams", Subaru started out as neutral, until the third half where most of Soma's rebel friends except Takumi and Megumi are expelled, Subaru joins the rebel team led by Erina, as its 8th member during Regimental de Cuisine match as a mean to settle his debt he repaid to Sōma.!  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Hisako Arato
characters.description: Erina's secretary and close friend, Hisako specializes in medicinal-based dishes. She thinks of Erina as the best, that only she could be Erina's number two and nobody could ever get past her to Erina's level.

characters.name: Ikumi Mito
characters.description: She is one of the student of Tootsuki Culinary Academy whom is also a former rival to Yukihira Soma. As the sole successor of the meat culinary expert of the Mito family for abundance knowledge about the meat culinary (especially beef and donburi), Ikumi is responsible to hold the pride of her family's name and like any other students in Tootsuki Culinary Academy, Ikumi is extremely prejudice upon the society classes and use high class ingredient to make a high standard dish.  It is said that Ikumi's rigid family rules and regulations had made her cooking skill more elegant and grace like playing piano. Using all graces of cooking by using the high grade materials as well as expensive, Ikumi can almost made the dish as elegant as it look to impressed her clients.

characters.name: Jun Shiomi
characters.description: Shiomi is a 74th Generation Toutsuki Academy Alumnus and a former resident of the Polar Star Dormitory. She is one of the lecturers in Tootsuki Culinary Academy as well as the professor of the Shiomi Seminar. Shiomi Jun is leagal guardian of Hayama Akira.  Jun is the youngest lecturer in the academy, but is actually older than she physically appears. Despite the fact that she in her 30s, she is shorter than both Souma and Megumi and has a noticeably youthful face, causing both Souma and Megumi to mistake her as a middle school student of the academy.

characters.name: Megumi Tadokoro
characters.description: Height: 154 cm Cuisine Style: Hospitality  Megumi is from a cold harbor town in the Tōhoku region and enrolled into Tōtosuki's junior high program hoping to be able to help her family's bed-and-breakfast the Shokei'en Inn. Because of her stage fright and shyness she performs poorly and causes her to rank at the bottom of her class.   Megumi is clumsy and timid, thoughtful, kind and honest girl with polite manners. She is always looking out for others and is willing to assist them in any way she can. According to Gin Dōjima, Megumi's greatest gift is her warm hospitality as she cooks. She highly idolizes her mother.  Although Megumi is a capable chef, she does not fare well under pressure because she has stage fright. Because she is intimidated very easily, she makes simple mistakes when she cooks, causing many of her classmates to see her as a weak student. She is quick to panic when something goes awry and tends to over think situations when under pressure or stress, such as repeatedly packing and unpacking a suitcase to make sure she packed something, even though she did not need to pack a suitcase in the first place.  !Megumi eventually even becomes the 10th seat of the Elite Ten Council of the Tōtsuki Culinary Academy after the Promotion Exams Arc.!

characters.name: Issei Ryuudou
characters.description: Issei is the Student Body President of Shirō's school, and another close friend of [Shirō](https://anilist.co/character/496/Emiya-Shirou). Issei often asks Shirō to fix broken equipment for the Student Body to try and reduce save money on the school's bill. Issei and Shirō often have lunch together in the Student Body's office where they talk about what ever comes to mind.  His father is the head priest of Ryūdōji Temple, and his brother was a classmate of [Taiga](https://anilist.co/character/505/Fujimura-Taiga) and [Neko-san](https://anilist.co/character/187774/Hotaruzuka-Otoko).  He dislikes [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/498/Tohsaka-Rin) and seems to have some sort of fear of females, although he seems to be unusually at ease around [Saber](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria).  !Issei unknowingly tells Shirō that [Caster](https://anilist.co/character/3440/Medea) is at the Temple.!

characters.name: Medea
characters.description: Height: 163 cm  Servant type: Caster  !An honored guest of the Ryudou family​ permitted to live at their temple until the preparations for her marriage have been finalized. A gorgeous and talented yet mysterious woman of high stature, her presence has attracted the attention of many trainee monks.!

characters.name: Geld
characters.description: He is one of the fourth group of subordinates to be named by Rimuru Tempest. As the right-hand man of the deceased Orc Lord, he was given the same name as him, as a memento and token of appreciation, similar to how Rigur was named after his older brother.  As an Orc King, he is the leader of the Yellow Corps, that acts as both the last line of defense for Tempest as well as the main team of the country's Department of Construction and Manufacturing. Later on, he was given the Title of a "Lord" as one of Rimuru's Twelve Patrons.

characters.name: Gabiru
characters.description: The captain of the Hiryuu of Tempest, and the former lizardmen raid leader. He suffers from a superiority complex. The root of Gabil's pride and confidence​ is the thought that he is the chosen one.

characters.name: Hakurou
characters.description: Hakurou is a Fair Oni and is a loyal follower of Rimuru Tempest. He was one of the survivors of the Orc attack. He was also the teacher of the Dwarven King.

characters.name: Treyni
characters.description: Treyni is a dryad that resides in the Jura Forest.

characters.name: Ddraig
characters.description: He first appeared in volume 2 of the novel.    !Also known as the Welsh Dragon or the Sekiryutei (Red Dragon Emperor). One of the Two Heavenly Dragons along with the Vanishing Dragon Albion. The two dragons, with powers rivaling to gods, started fighting a long time ago for reasons even Ddraig forgot.   At that time, the angels, devils and fallen angels were waging a war against each other. The 3 factions believed that the fight the two dragons were having could spell disaster to the whole world so they set aside their war to stop the fight and seal the two dragons.   He now resides inside Issei's Sacred Gear as a result of being sealed in it. !

characters.name: Asia Argento
characters.description: Rank: Low-class  Devil Role: Bishop  Species: Reincarnated Devil (Former human)  Sacred Gear: Twilight Healing    A second-year student at Kuou Academy. Originally a sister who was known as a holy maiden due to her healing powers. She was raised in an orphanage and was taken in by the Church after her powers were discovered. However, she was kicked out of the Church for healing a Devil, and was taken in by people affiliated with the Fallen Angels. She starts living with Issei after being saved from the Fallen Angels' grasp. As a person raised in the Church, she lacks common sense.     !After she starts living with Issei, she shows that she has feelings for him but he dismisses this as her looking at him like a brother.  When Rias moves in, she becomes increasingly more daring in her attempts to win Issei and views Rias as a rival in spite of their sister-like relationship.  At the end of Volume 6, she kisses Issei and he realizes the true depths of her feelings.!

characters.name: Xenovia Quarta
characters.description: Rank: Low-class  Devil Role: Knight  Species: Reincarnated Devil (Former Human)  Weapon: Excalibur Destruction (Volume 3), The Holy Sword Durandal → Ex-Durandal.    A Holy Sword user who was sent from the Church along with Irina to destroy or retrieve the stolen Excalibur swords. After she finds out that the God in the Bible has died a long time ago, she decides to join the Occult Research Club as Rias's servant. She tries to seduce Issei whenever she can because she wants to give birth to a strong baby.

characters.name: Irina Shidou
characters.description: Rank: Angel (Former Human) Weapon: Excalibur Mimic  She is Xenovia's partner and Issei's childhood friend. After finding out that the God in the Bible is dead, she still follows the teaching and is under the direct command of Michael. She also has a crush on Issei and was shocked to find out he turned into a devil. They are still friends despite that flaw.

characters.name: Koneko Toujou
characters.description: Rank: Low-class devil (Former nekomata)/Rook Power: Youjutsu  A 10th grade student. Originally about to be executed by the devils after her sister, [Kuroka](https://anilist.co/character/88080/Kuroka-), kills her own master. The Satan, [Lucifer](https://anilist.co/character/58343/Sirzechs-Lucifer), protected her, and left her under his sister's, [Rias](https://anilist.co/character/50389/Rias-Gremory)' care - becoming her servant. She refused to use the power of youjutsu because she didn't want to become like her sister. She overcame her power along with [Akeno](https://anilist.co/character/51347/Akeno-Himejima) after [Issei](https://anilist.co/character/50387/Issei-Hyoudou) made her overcome her own powers. She doesn't show any emotion at all, and says harsh things and hits Issei when he is doing or thinking something perverted. She shows the most concern for her comrades when they are in trouble.  !At the end of Volume 5 she has warmed up significantly to Issei and even begins sitting on his lap and sneaking into his bed.  After this, she gradually develops romantic feelings towards him.!

characters.name: Yuuto Kiba
characters.description: Rank/Role: Mid-class devil (Former human)/Knight Sacred Gear: Sword Birth -> Sword of Betrayer (Balance-Break)  An 11th grade student. Self proclaimed best friend of Ise, and the school prince. He was a victim of the "Project: Holy Sword" where he was the only sole survivor. He became Rias's servant when she saved him from death, but still swore the accomplish his revenge to those who treated him as test subjects and disposed his friends. He also harbors a great hatred towards the holy sword Excalibur.

characters.name: Akeno Himejima
characters.description: Rank: Middle-class Devil Role: Queen Race: Reincarnated Devil (Former Half-Human/Half-Fallen Angel) Power: Elemental magic (mainly thunder), Holy Lightning (From Volume 5 onward)   A third-year student and one of the "Two Great Onee-samas" of Kuou Academy along with [Rias](https://anilist.co/character/50389). Called the ultimate "Queen" by other members. Born between a human mother and fallen angel father, after the death of her mother, she became Rias' servant. She is a friend close enough to call Rias by her name in private, yet calls her Buchou in presence of others and displays a master-servant relationship in public. She persistently refuses to use her power of light, inherited from her father, but starts using it after being convinced by [Issei](https://anilist.co/character/50387).

characters.name: Azazel
characters.description: Race: Fallen Angel   Ranking: Governor General of the Fallen Angels   Affiliations: Kuoh Academy (Teacher), Occult Research Club (Advisor)     It is hard to determine Azazel's personality, as he is laid back and serious, also wise and insane, all at the same time. Azazel is a research fanatic, especially on Sacred Gears. He is also pacifistic, preferring to talk his way out of troubles rather than resorting to violence. He has been shown to care deeply for his fellow Fallen Angels, Shemhazai and Baraqiel. He is also very charismatic, able to endear his Fallen Angel followers.   Azazel also has complicated feelings on the fact that many of his friends and acquaintances are all married and have a family. It is suggested that Azazel is a pervert, with his fondness for breasts, and the fact he has stated to have had harems over the millennia. Not to mention his stated reason for becoming a Fallen Angel all those millennia ago was lust.    (Source: Highschool DxD Wiki)

characters.name: Gasper Vladi
characters.description: Rank/Role: Low-class devil (Former human/vampire)/Bishop  Sacred Gear: Forbidden Balor View   A half-vampire male cross-dresser who has the ability to stop the time of those he sees but he is unable to control it. He is sealed by Rias as ordered by the elders till she has grown up enough to control him. He still is unable to have a full command on his powers but can improve a lot by drinking Ise's blood.

characters.name: Vali Lucifer
characters.description: Vali Lucifer is the leader of the Khaos Brigade's Vali Team. He is a descendant of the original Lucifer and the possessor of the Vanishing Dragon, Albion; wielding the Divine Dividing Sacred Gear. As such, he is the direct rival of Issei Hyoudou and Ddraig.

characters.name: Murayama
characters.description: Member of Kuoh Academy's Girls' Kendō Club, and are anime-exclusive characters. She and Katase are often subjected to Issei, Matsuda, and Motohama's lecherous peeping, in which they and the rest of the club retaliate by beating them with their shinai. They are also in the same class as the Perverted Trio.  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Issei Hyoudou
characters.description: A second-year high school student attending Kuou Academy. He is known to be stupid, lecherous and a pervert among his peers. A normal high school student born in a normal family, but is in possession of the Sacred Gear "Boosted Gear" which is listed as one of the ultimate Sacred Gears (Longinus). He was killed by his first girlfriend, a Fallen Angel, and was revived as a Devil and a servant of Rias Gremory, his new master. Now he aims to become a Harem King by gaining a peerage, unaware of himself attracting girls around him.

characters.name: Rias Gremory
characters.description: Height: 172 cm (5'8") Rank/Role: Top-class devil(Pure devil)/King Power: Power of destruction  A 12th grade student and the prettiest girl in the academy. Comes from the old noble of pure devils, the house of Gremory, a top-class devil who is called a genius nicknamed "Crimson Ruin Princess". Her brother is in fact one of the Yondai-Maou, [Lucifer](https://anilist.co/character/58343). Both of them possess the power of destruction. She revives [Issei](https://anilist.co/character/50387) as her servant after finding him dead, killed by a fallen-angel and possessing a rare Sacred Gear. Kind and soft to her servants, becomes a totally different person when training or fighting.  !She begins to develop romantic feelings for Issei in Volume 2 of the light novel and moves in with him at the volume's end.  In Volume 10, he confesses that he loves her and she returns his feelings. They begin dating after that.!

characters.name: Ophis
characters.description: Ophis is the Dragon God known as the Ouroboros Dragon and the Infinite Dragon God. She is one of the most powerful dragons in existence.  Being born from nothingness, Ophis rarely shows any sort of emotion, only wanting to get rid of the Great Red and return to the Dimensional Gap to obtain "silence".  (Source: Highschool DxD Wiki)

characters.name: Mutsu
characters.description: Height: 158 cm (5' 2")  Mutsu is the merchant fleet Kaientai's 2nd in Command, but is de facto the one running the company. This is because her "natural idiot" leader Sakamoto Tatsuma is always going MIA (missing in action). Things once got to the extent that she had to install a homing device in his pistol so that when he fired it, the homing device would indicate her to his whereabouts.

characters.name: Bansai Kawakami
characters.description: He is an assassin and is one of the strongest swordsmen of the Kiheitai, an extremist Joui faction bent on causing world destruction. He regularly keeps his headphones on, as well as sun glasses even while others are talking to him.  Bansai is shown to have an extremely calm demeanor, which covers up the fact that he has a vicious, almost cruel personality which actively seeks out conflict.   He carries and is skilled at playing a shamisen, which also doubles as a tool for tying others up or as a weapon similar to a garrote. On top of being famous as a skilled swordsman, Bansai is also a talented songwriter. He works as a music producer under the name "Tsunpo", and Otsu's newer songs are written by him.    !During a major fight in the Silver Soul War, Bansai sacrificed his life in order to protect his fellow members of the Kiheitai.!  Bansai's name is roughly based on that of a hitokiri of the Bakumatsu era, Kawakami Gensai, while his stage name is based on the musician Tsunku.

characters.name: Matako Kijima
characters.description: Height: 165 cm  Matako Kijima is the only female member of the Kiheitai and is skilled in using a pair of pistols. She is fiercely loyal to [Shinsuke Takasugi](https://anilist.co/character/2948), and appears to have a crush on him.  !She also gets angry and tells off [Nizou Okada](https://anilist.co/character/9534) after he goes on a rampage throughout Edo, trying to kill Takasugi's old comrades. She is quick-tempered and prone to screeching when she's upset. This is evident when she has a "spitting fight" with [Kagura](https://anilist.co/character/674) after she spat at her and when she starts yelling at Kagura after her underwear is said to be stained. She shoots Kagura through the shoulder when Kagura breaks onto the ship. She interacts the most with [Henpeita Takechi](https://anilist.co/character/9535), calling him 'senpai' and also calling him a 'pervert' and a 'lolicon' for sparing Kagura instead of killing her. At the end of the Benizakura arc, she is wounded by Okada after he loses control.!  Her name is roughly based on a samurai of the Bakumatsu era, Kijima Matabei.

characters.name: Zenzou Hattori
characters.description: Height: 175 cm  A highly skilled ninja who sports a light-brown/dark-blonde mop-top and a goatee.
