He hates Wei Wuxian for this reason, thinking that he was responsible for his parents' death.!

characters.name: Wuxian Wei
characters.description: Wei Wuxian is the founder of the Demonic Cultivation and a former disciple of the Yunmeng Jiang Sect. The son of Cangse-Sanren and Wei Changze.  Also known as the Yiling Patriarch, he died in the first siege of the Burial Mounds thirteen years prior to the start of the story. He was then reincarnated into the body of Mo Xuanyu through a sacrificial ritual.

characters.name: Wangji Lan
characters.description: Lan Wangji is the second young master of the Lan clan. Titled as HanGuang-Jun, Lan Wangji is one of the Two Jades of Lan alongside his older brother, Lan Xichen.

characters.name: Qiren Lan
characters.description: Lan Qiren is an elder of the Gusu Lan Sect known for producing outstanding students, even out of the most hopeless ones. He is the uncle of Lan Xichen and Lan Wangji.

characters.name: Fengmian Jiang
characters.description: Jiang Fengmian was the former leader of the Yunmeng Jiang Sect and the father of Jiang Cheng and Jiang Yanli. He also took Wei Wuxian under his care and considered him as his own child.  !He was killed during the Massacre at Lotus Cove when his Golden Core was melted by Wen Zhuliu!

characters.name: Zixuan Jin
characters.description: Jin Zixuan was Jiang Yanli's husband and the father of Jin Ling. He was Jin Guangshan's only legitimate child.  !He was killed at Qiongqi Path when his heart was pierced by Wen Ning's hand.!

characters.name: Ning Wen
characters.description: Wen Ning, courtesy name Wen Qionglin, was a member of the Qishan Wen Sect. He was a friend of Wei Wuxian's in life, and after death became the first fierce corpse created by Wei Wuxian to retain his sense of self. Known as the Ghost General, he served as Wei Wuxian's righthand man during his time as the Yiling Patriarch.

characters.name: Ziyuan Yu
characters.description: Yu Ziyuan was the wife of the former leader of the Yunmeng Jiang Sect, Jiang Fengmian, and the mother of Jiang Cheng and Jiang Yanli. She also went by the titles Madam Yu and the Violet Spider.  !She was killed during the Massacre at Lotus Pier when her Golden Core was melted by Wen Zhuliu!

characters.name: Yanli Jiang
characters.description: Jiang Cheng's sister, Wei Wuxian's sworn sister. She's a beautiful girl with a gentle and graceful personality, and really good culinary skills. Since young, she's been betrothed to Jin Zixuan, the young master of Lanling Jin clan. Treats Wei Wuxian like a brother.  !Yanli was killed when she was stabbed by a sword during a fight that occurred at the Pledge Conference at Nightless Sky!

characters.name: Wanyin Jiang
characters.description: Jiang Wanyin is the current leader of the Yunmeng Jiang Sect and the uncle of Jin Ling. He is more commonly known to other cultivators by his courtesy name, Jiang Wanyin, or his title, Sandu Shengshou.

characters.name: Sizhui Lan
characters.description: A junior disciple of the Gusu Lan Sect. Born Wen Yuan, he's the last remaining blood descendant of the now-extinct Qishan Wen Sect. He was one of the Wen clan remnants taken in by Wei Wuxian shortly before his death, but he lost his home for a second time in the first siege of the Burial Mounds.  Discovered by an injured Lan Wangji who came searching for Wei Wuxian's remains in the aftermath, the then-three-year-old boy fell into a high fever and lost all memories of his past. He was then re-named to Lan Yuan and later presumably given the courtesy name Sizhui in the same year that Wei Wuxian returned to the living world.

characters.name: Kazumi Akiyama
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Hiroshi Fumihiro
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Peko Pekoyama
characters.description: Height: 172 cm (5'6") Talent: Ultimate Swordswoman  A student of Hope's Peak Academy Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip featured in  _Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair_.   Peko initially appears to be rather serious and intimidating, expressing little emotion. However, she isn't unsociable and doesn't mean to act cold. For a long time she didn't smile because she thought it was unnecessary, and she says she eventually forgot how to. Even though she doesn't believe it herself, she is a very kindhearted and selfless person  who cares about her classmates, wishing nothing but good for them. She also loves animals, especially pandas, but most animals are scared of her and tend to run away.

characters.name: Kazuichi Souda
characters.description: Height: 172 cm (5'6") Talent: Ultimate Mechanic  A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip.   Kazuichi is a highly emotional character, though he tries to play it smooth and acts carefree at first. He is a very jumpy person, easily scared and often screaming in fear. People tend to note his intimidating appearance does not match his compulsive and cowardly personality. Naturally, he has a great fear of dying on the island during the Killing School Trip, which causes a lot of stress and panic for him. He also often blurts things out without thinking, seems to be a very bad liar, and tends to be slow-witted. Alongside [Mikan Tsumiki](https://anilist.co/character/90008/Tsumiki-Mikan), Kazuichi often ends up being the butt of [Monokuma](https://anilist.co/character/73235/Monokuma) and [Hiyoko Saionji](https://anilist.co/character/90017/Saionji-Hiyoko)'s jokes.  Kazuichi tends to carry around a wrench and he gets anxious if he cannot tinker with something. He has a great love for machinery, especially fast ones like rockets and bikes, which is ironic, since he suffers from awful motion sickness. He also likes girls a lot, though in a rather perverted and shallow way. He has taken a strong liking to [Sonia Nevermind](https://anilist.co/character/90015/Nevermind-Sonia), to an extent of being a pervert, and in constant jealousy of [Gundham Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/73213/Tanaka-Gundham). He claims that he's dreamed of a beautiful blonde girlfriend since he was a kid. Sonia dislikes this behavior and calls him a stalker.

characters.name: Mahiru Koizumi
characters.description: Height: 165cm (5'4") Talent: Ultimate Photographer  A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip featured in _Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair_.   Mahiru is optimistic, sensible, and unafraid to speak her mind. She's a reliable person who is prone to taking care of people, but won't hesitate to scold them either. Hajime has likened being scolded by her to being yelled at by his mom. Mahiru has high expectations of men and is quick to be abrasive towards them, while she is much more tolerant and friendly with girls. Likewise, the subjects of her photos are usually girls, as she gets bored photographing guys. Despite her love for photography, Mahiru believes her title is stupid compared to her classmates. She compares her photos to those of her mother, a famous war photographer whose career made her absent for much of Mahiru's life. Mahiru's father was a very poor parent, leaving housework entirely to her.   (Source: Danganronpa Wiki, edited)

characters.name: Chou Koukou Kyuu no Sagishi
characters.description: Talent: Ultimate Imposter  The Ultimate Imposter is a student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip featured in _Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair_. They impersonate Byakuya Togami as the Ultimate Affluent Progeny.  The Ultimate Imposter's real appearance is that of a person with long, black hair and green eyes with a heavy build. Their age and gender is unknown, but they are able to give off a largely male impression while disguised as Byakuya and even mimic his voice perfectly. In Danganronpa 3, their real voice is quite deep and masculine. However, originally in Danganronpa 2, the brief glimpse of their apparent real voice sounded notably different, more high-pitched and rather gender neutral. The Imposter also refused to go swimming in front of others, which implies that removing their clothes would reveal their true gender. Their true personality is also somewhat unclear as they spend most of their time mimicking someone else's behavior. However, they speak briefly without disguise and it's implied that their real nature is polite and meek. Most notably, they appear to be truly kind and caring, but also quite serious.  The Ultimate Imposter doesn't have a name, family register, relatives, and anything that could link them with their true identity. In order to have their existence acknowledged, they take other people's data and learn it so they can impersonate them flawlessly. No one can tell the difference between the Ultimate Imposter and the real person that they impersonate. According to Monokuma, even their noticeably heavy body build does not affect their ability to fool others. This, along with the fact that they are capable of changing their appearance extremely quickly without anyone noticing, implies that their talent is near superhuman.

characters.name: Nagito Komaeda
characters.description: Height: 180 cm (5'11") Talent: Ultimate Lucky Student  Nagito is a student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip.   On the surface, Nagito is friendly and easygoing. He genuinely cares for his classmates and holds a lot of respect for ideals like love, friendship, and teamwork. However, he doesn't care for "ordinary, untalented people" such as himself and is extremely self-deprecating; he sees himself as "worthless trash" whose life has no value, something he brings up often. Nagito is also highly intelligent, usually solving the murders long before anyone else, though he doesn't share his findings easily.  Nagito has an extreme, twisted obsession with hope. He believes that hope is an absolute good that will always win in the end, and that anything done in the name of hope, even murder, is virtuous. He sees Ultimates as the embodiments of hope that are chosen at birth, and thinks they can strengthen that hope by facing and overcoming despair. He doesn't consider himself to be a "real" Ultimate, and instead wishes to sacrifice himself so that they can shine.

characters.name: Makoto Naegi
characters.description: Height: 160 cm (5'3") Talent: Good Luck  Makoto is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. His talent is Super High School Level Good Luck (超高校級の幸運), meaning he got into Hope's Peak by winning a lottery, rather than being scouted for an extraordinary talent like everyone else. His title is the Ultimate Lucky Student in the English localization.  Makoto is friendly and a lot more down-to-earth than other students. He tends to act passively in conversation. According to him, his most distinguishing feature is his optimism.

characters.name: Ryouta Mitarai
characters.description: Height: 160 cm (5'2") Talent: Ultimate Animator  A character featured in _Danganronpa 3: The End of Hope's Peak High School_. During his time in Class 77-B at Hope's Peak Academy. He is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 10 Director. His responsibility as the director is assistance in reviving education and culture. He, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.  Ryota is a very timid, insecure, and rather asocial person. He holds anime in very high regard and is extremely passionate about it, considering it his savior during his harsh childhood. His life goal is to give others a similar sense of hope through his anime. However, this led him to shut himself in his room to work, frequently neglecting to eat or sleep as he wanted to spend all his time creating anime. Ryota suffers from extreme anxiety, worrying constantly, and lacks self-confidence, seeing himself as a burden who fails to protect everyone. He has a weak stomach and is easily startled. Though he's very hard on himself, he does his best when given a mission.

characters.name: Hajime Hinata
characters.description: Height: 179 cm (5'10") Talent: Ultimate ???  A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip featured in Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair. He doesn't remember his talent at the beginning of the Killing Game, so his title is the Ultimate ???.  Hajime seems cynical at first glance, but it would be better to describe him as a realist. He is quite skeptical and tends to worry more than the other students, but his worries are usually understandable. He is logical and smart; often annoyed by the idea of not being able to understand someone or something at all. He tends to be quite serious, but he does joke around and often goes along with his classmates' eccentric hobbies anyway, and sometimes smiles awkwardly and sheepishly while his friends engage in some of their usual weird behavior. He is sometimes annoyed by some of his classmates and can be snarky towards them in his thoughts as well as blunt while speaking to them, though he's more frank than sarcastic or mean-spirited. Though sometimes a bit submissive (especially with bossy girls), he is not afraid to speak his mind, and he can be rude if annoyed enough (for example, after enduring [Hiyoko](https://anilist.co/character/90017/Saionji-Hiyoko)'s attitude during her Free Time Events, he finally ends up stating "I don't even care anymore"). He can sometimes be short-tempered and snap at others, especially when he's tired or under pressure. He was also quite paranoid during the start of the game and didn't have much interest in friendship, but he later really wanted to believe in his classmates and felt bad about doubting them during the Class Trials, though he understood it was necessary.  !It was revealed in Chapter 4 by Nagito Komaeda that Hajime was actually a reserve course student who had no talent whatsoever and is not an Ultimate himself.!

characters.name: Mikan Tsumiki
characters.description: Height: 165 cm (5'4") Talent: Ultimate Nurse  A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip featured in _Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair_.

characters.name: Ibuki Mioda
characters.description: Height: 164cm / 5'5" Talent: Ultimate Musician  A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip featured in _Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair_.

characters.name: Fuyuhiko Kuzuryuu
characters.description: Height: 157cm (5'1") Talent: Ultimate Yakuza  A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip featured in _Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair_.   Fuyuhiko is initially incredibly stand-offish and rude to the other students. When he does interact with them, his attitude is combative and irritable. He was born as the heir of Kuzuryu Clan, but he thinks that his younger sister, Natsumi, deserves the title instead. Fuyuhiko states that he wants to be strong on his own and not rely on his family's power to get ahead. His goal is to be strong enough to lead his family, rather than to be strong _because_ he leads his family. He takes duty very seriously, and if there's someone who he can trust, he will open his heart and cooperate with them. Despite being a yakuza, Fuyuhiko has a somewhat pure heart and is very strict to the rules, taking honor and moral codes seriously. He is also particularly sensitive about his "baby face" looks.

characters.name: Nekomaru Nidai
characters.description: Height: 198cm (6'4) Talent: Ultimate Team Manager  Nekomaru Nidai is a student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B and a participant of the Killing School Trip featured in Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair.    Nekomaru is a vigorous, boisterous, openhearted student who is passionate about supporting athletes. He is very optimistic and his willpower is immeasurable, but he isn't very smart and is bad at lying. He enjoys fighting and often trains with [Akane Owari](https://anilist.co/character/90016/Akane-Owari). Many athletes have become elite and set new records under Nekomaru's guidance. He believes the bonds that are created between a manager and an athlete are the key to success.  Nekomaru was born with a heart defect that left him bedridden and confined to a hospital. The doctor who treated Nekomaru told him that he would only live to be 20. Because of his sickness, he never got to play sports and didn't participate in P.E. in school. He was also teased a lot when he was young, being unable to make friends, and making frequent trips to the hospital.While at the hospital, Nekomaru met a boy named Daisuke, who suffered from the same condition. Daisuke was a team manager. Nekomaru took notice of how many people came to visit him in the hospital. When Daisuke died without seeing the team he had been training reach their championship, Nekomaru was inspired to continue in his footsteps and honor Daisuke's dream by becoming a team manager himself.  Nekomaru quickly gained a reputation as a skilled team manager, turning around several poorly-trained teams and leading them to national recognition. His clients have included baseball stars, figure skaters, and rugby teams. His job ended up developing his muscles and learning a special massage for athletes by using his fingers. He previously attended First Yokoyama High School before enrolling in Hope's Peak Academy.

characters.name: Teruteru Hanamura
characters.description: Height: 133 cm Talent: Ultimate Cook  Teruteru says he wishes to be known under the title of the Ultimate Chef.

characters.name: Gundham Tanaka
characters.description: Height: 182 cm (5'11") Talent: Ultimate Animal Breeder  A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip. He is almost always seen with his extremely well-trained hamsters, the Four Dark Devas of Destruction: San-D (orange and white), Jum-P (grey and white), Maga-Z (tan fur with peach underbelly, chipped ear), and Cham-P (fat, orange).   Gundham is an eccentric chuunibyou who claims that he has been blessed with the evil powers of the underworld, referring to everyone else as "pathetic human beings" and often rambling about the dark arts, alchemy, and astral levels. He is often lost in his own world, paying more attention to himself and his hamsters than the things going on around him. Because of this, Gundham initially comes off as self-centered and aloof, however he seems to have serious problems with socializing and physical contact. He has been strict about not wanting to touch nor be touched by others since childhood, going as far as to avoid sports and playing with other children. In his typical manner, Gundham claims that his flesh is "poisoned" to disguise his fear of intimacy. He tells [Hajime](https://anilist.co/character/90007/Hinata-Hajime) that he can only be touched by very specific persons with astral levels that match his own.  Though he may be awkward around other people, Gundham deeply cares about animals (despite how he refers to them as his evil minions to stay in line with his overlord persona). He claims that anything that can talk "will eventually betray you" and prefers to trust animals for their loyalty and sincere nature. He has an informational website about breeding which he maintains carefully. He also gets offended when anyone looks down on the Devas or refers to them as simply average hamsters, as he claims that hamsters are merely their "temporary form".

characters.name: Sonia Nevermind
characters.description: Height: 174 cm (5'9") Talent: Ultimate Princess  A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip featured in _Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair_.   Sonia is princess of the Kingdom of Novoselic, a place with a very unique culture and traditions.

characters.name: Elizabeth
characters.description: Height: 180 cm  Elizabeth resembles a giant white duck or a giant penguin and is [Katsura](https://anilist.co/character/1533/Katsura-Kotarou)'s companion. Elizabeth was a present from [Tatsuma Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/2945/Sakamoto-Tatsuma), who presumably picked it up on his travels around space. Although many people consider Elizabeth to be insane and extraneous, Katsura has named the ambiguous avian "Elizabeth" and dotes on it. Elizabeth is something of a painter, and is surprisingly dexterous. Also, Elizabeth resorts to using signboards to "communicate", as well as an occasional means of attack. Elizabeth is also a skilled fighter, able to use signboards to fight off swordsmen.    Although the true identity of Elizabeth is uncertain, it appears to be a man wearing a duck costume. In its first appearance, hairy legs are seen underneath her sheet and the body of a humanoid with glowing eyes is revealed as her mouth is opened just as it fell during another battle between Gintoki and Katsura. Although Katsura seems shocked at what she really is, she has subsequently remained by his side. Episode 50 implies that the person inside Elizabeth is most likely the director (Gintoki was interrupted before he can finish being cut off at "Kanto-" ("Direc-"). Most of the characters seem to ignore this, or at least do not give it much thought, given at the episode was completely filler.

characters.name: Tatsuma Sakamoto
characters.description: Height: 181 cm  Sakamoto is a former member of the Joi. He is a good-natured man and optimistic to the point of being ridiculous, even in the most dangerous situations. His favorite phrase is "AHAHA! It must be ". He also has a tendency to misspell names; he calls Gintoki "Kintoki". Gintoki often corrects him, citing that if he were named Kintoki, they would be in some kind of hentai anime (because 'Kin' from 'Kintoki' instead of 'Gin' would make the title 'Kintama', which means 'testicles' instead of 'Gintama', which means 'silver soul').    Despite his goofy nature, Sakamoto is actually a successful businessman in the galaxy. He believes that business is a way of protecting his country. He has a private, well-equipped defensive business fleet. He believes that sacrifices should be made for the good of the community, which is why he chose to abandon his comrades on Earth to travel into space. Sakamoto is shown to be skilled with a pistol in an anime filler episode.  His name is based on the historical character Sakamoto Ryouma. He speaks in Tosa-ben, much like the inspiration for his character.

characters.name: Tae Shimura
characters.description: Height: 168 cm   Tae Shimura is [Shinpachi](https://anilist.co/character/673)'s older sister. She runs the Kakidokan Dojo—which was her father's failing dojo—with her brother. She is usually addressed as "Otae"; the "O" is an honorific used to refer to women. [Kagura](https://anilist.co/character/674) always addresses her as "big sister" (anego). Despite her sweet face, she is one of the most violent characters in _Gintama_ (and arguably strong too). She mercilessly beats up [Isao Kondo](https://anilist.co/character/2943) and [Gintoki Sakata](https://anilist.co/character/672) whenever they anger her; in episode 19, she mercilessly kicks the men out onto the road (namely her brother, Gintoki and [Taizou Hasegawa](https://anilist.co/character/3760)) so as to stop a car for a hitch ride. She often displays her trademark sweet-looking smile with her eyes closed before engaging in her violent activities. Her killer intent is so strong that on one occasion, a stare from her brings the entire Shinsengumi on their knees begging for mercy. Her weapon of choice seems to be a naginata, a Japanese spear.  Her cooking skills are terrible, seeing as her tamagoyaki (i.e. sweet fried egg) is so inedible that Kondo suffers amnesia after eating it and others are barely able to swallow it down. [Sagaru Yamazaki](https://anilist.co/character/4653) even describes it as "poison" after some of it accidentally gets into his eye. When Kagura tried to hypnotize herself into eating Otae's cooking, Shinpachi objected, saying that Otae's cooking is the reason for his poor eyesight.  She has, so far, been called flat-chested three times in the anime; another in 59 by Gintoki; and the third time by Shinpachi, who thought that [Kyubei Yagyu](https://anilist.co/character/6110) wanted to marry her because Kyubei took her as a male (that her chest is so flat that she looks like a guy). She has strong principles and believes in maintaining what is precious, even if it means throwing away honor and dignity. She once says that if apologies were enough, seppuku would not exist. Her favourite food is Häagen-Dazs ice-cream, but it is called Bargain Dash in the manga and anime.

characters.name: Shinsuke Takasugi
characters.description: Height: 170 cm  A former comrade of Gintoki and Katsura and a major antagonist. He is easily recognisable through his bandaged left eye, his colorful  kimono, his eerie smile, and the pipe he is often seen smoking. !He now leads a radical Joui faction called the Kiheitai and is known amongst the Shinsengumi as 'the most dangerous man in both the Joui faction and amongst the radicals'.!  He, Gintoki, and Katsura studied in the same temple elementary school when they were children, and he fought with them against the Amanto invasion during the latter part of the Joui war. After the war ended, he vanished, and has since gained a dangerous reputation due to his assassination of many of the Bakufu's main officers and his planning of a large-scale coup d'etat. Before his first appearance in both the anime and the manga, he was mentioned to have fled Edo and to have been hiding in Kyoto, although it is unclear how long before this was.  He now believes that the only way to save it is to destroy the "rotten" post-Joui war world.  He is shown to like festivals, although this is mainly due to the opportunity they provide for a large-scale terrorist attack: he appears to have an attraction to ruin that is almost nihilistic. He also appears to have considerable insight due to his 'seeing through Itou's heart' and subsequently planting him in the Shinsengumi's ranks.  It can be assumed that he is as skilled a swordsman as both Gintoki and Katsura, having fought alongside them as one of the 'heroes' of the Joui war. That aside, he appears to have at least considerable skill in playing the shamisen, and is shown at one point playing it with Bansai as they talk.

characters.name: Isao Kondou
characters.description: Height: 184 cm   Isao Kondo is the Commander of the Shinsengumi. When not working, he is the stalker of [Tae Shimura](https://anilist.co/character/2944), earning him the nickname Gorilla-stalker. His superior is [Katakuriko Matsudaira](https://anilist.co/character/5972), a high-ranking government officer under direct control of the Bakufu. Even though the Shinsengumi are loyal to Kondo, he often has to use Vice Commander [Toshiro Hijikata](https://anilist.co/character/2650) to settle them down (with harsh words or use of violence) before conducting a speech. Kondo is good friends with Toshiro and [Sougo Okita](https://anilist.co/character/2282), and if one of them ever strayed, then the other two would punch him back to where he belongs, as Kondo once told Sougo. Sougo also often remarks that Kondo's nice-guy attitude is also his weakness as he never notices negative points about other people. In the Mutiny arc, he was described by [Kamotaro Ito](https://anilist.co/character/11458) as honest, pure and unsullied. In the same arc, Toshiro described him as the soul of the Shinsengumi, and the rest of them being the sword that protects him. Toshiro also said that everybody joined the Shinsengumi so that they could be with Kondo, and that as long as he was there, the Shinsengumi would not be finished.  When Kondo once asked Tae Shimura whether she would still love her boyfriend if he had a hairy butt. She became the target of his stalking when she replied that she would love her boyfriend just as much, hairy butt and all. Being a stalker of Tae, Kondo is often seen getting beat up or threatened by her, as she highly disapproves of his stalking and affection towards her. In the Yagyuu arc, Kondo had his mind set on being [Shinpachi Shimura](https://anilist.co/character/673)'s brother-in-law, even going as far as saying Shinpachi was the only one he could entrust the Shinsengumi to, much to Shinpachi's annoyance, answering that he doesn't give a damn about the Shinsengumi.  During his childhood, Kondo was a member of a dojo in Bushuu. There, he would soon meet Sougo and Toshiro, recruiting them both into his dojo. Kondo would later on take all the members with him and move from Bushuu to Edo in search for success, becoming what is now the Shinsengumi. Some characters in the series often call him "gorilla" due to his hirsute nature and although he is angered with this nickname, he sometimes uses the same word to identify himself. Kondo is loosely based on the historical Kondo Isami, famed for his role as commander of the Shinsengumi during the Bakumatsu period.

characters.name: Sagaru Yamazaki
characters.description: Yamazaki is a spy, whose specialty is naturally gathering intelligence. Yamazaki is often caught by Hijikata playing badminton by himself, and he is subsequently beaten. He is often seen cosplaying as a badminton-playing version of Echizen Ryoma from The Prince of Tennis. In episode 62 he was caught saying "Mada mada dane", which is Ryoma Echizen's catchphrase.  His role as a ninja is roughly based on Yamazaki Susumu, but is never really exercised besides one unsuccessful attempt to spy on Gintoki. Despite having a rivalry with Shinpachi, they most often see eye-to-eye out of their respective groups.  Despite his lack of screen time, he came in 4th in the Gintama character popularity poll. But even with his popularity, Sorachi has clearly stated that he will never be on a cover of a Gintama volume.  Yamazaki's birthday is February 6. He is 169 cm, and he weighs 58 kg. His age has not yet been revealed.  His name is based on the historical Yamazaki Susumu.   !During the Silver Soul arc, he is confronted by Utsuro. In that moment, Yamazaki is frozen in fear, gets his throat slit, and dies. However, he is later remade into a cyborg.!

characters.name: Tama
characters.description: Height: 166 cm   Tama is an android that was found by Gintoki. At the time she was only a disembodied head. She was given her name by Kagura, who was obsessed with eating egg on rice at the time. She is an android maid currently working at Otose's Snack House. When she isn't cleaning or serving Otose's customers, she often visits the Yorozuya Gin-Chan to collect rent.  Tama was originally an android created by Professor Hayashi to provide his sickly daughter with a companion. But when the professor tried to implant the personality of his daughter into Tama, the experiment killed his daughter in the process. Tama however, possesses the element known as the "Seed", allowing her to retain some of Fuyou's personality and making her capable of human emotions.  Even though Tama is an android, she is capable of human emotions. Her interactions with living human beings, however, often seem to be severely limited by her lack of knowledge of the outside world. This is due to a memory loss she already suffered before her initial introduction. As the series progresses, however, it seems that Tama learns more and more just from being around the Yorozuya Gin-Chan. She also seems to have some rather strange main functions, such as imitating the Dragon Quest RPG.

characters.name: Catherine
characters.description: An amanto who resembles a cat. At first, she seems to be a diligent worker at Otose's snack shop who is trying to support her family, but soon reveals herself to be a thief. Despite this, Otose hired her again after she was released from prison. She used to work as a thief with three others vaguely resembling Arsène Lupin, Goemon Ishikawa, and Daisuke Jigen. She speaks Japanese with an accent, represented by katakana characters in the place of hiragana; she is the only member of her former crew to speak this way. Source: Wikipedia

characters.name: Kotarou Katsura
characters.description: Height: 175 cm (5'8")  Katsura is [Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672)'s former comrade during the Joi war. Even after the Amanto take-over of Japan, Katsura continues to resist the Amanto, and has amassed a band of followers.  He is a wanted man due to his involvement in terrorist activities against the Bakufu, and is constantly on the run from the Shinsengumi. Although his initial methods were originally more violent in nature (for instance, sending a bomb to an Amanto embassy), Katsura has gradually grown to believe that there are people important to him in Edo, and decides that he no longer wants to destroy the country, but believes there should be a way to change it without causing sacrifices.  Katsura seems to be highly respected by his followers, and has even been called the "Daybreak of the Joui Faction" by some. When people believed that Katsura had died during the Benizakura arc, even other terrorist groups tried to avenge his death. Since he is a wanted man, Katsura is often seen wearing disguises, although his identity is often still easily found out.   Katsura seems to possess a rather outdated sense of humour, and sometimes refers to things from a past era, such as when he tried to buy a Famicon when people were queuing up to buy the OwEe (a parody of the Wii). He also seems to have a tendency to make up dramatic stories, which moves others to tears when they hear them (except Gintoki). Katsura sometimes works odd jobs to raise money for his terrorist activities. He claims that his heart has started to be moved by [Ikumatsu](https://anilist.co/character/9515) and held his subsequent interview in her ramen restaurant.   His name is based on the historical Katsura Kogoro.

characters.name: Ayame Sarutobi
characters.description: Height: 169 cm  Sarutobi Ayame is a ninja from the Oniwabanshuu by training, but is currently working as an assassin. She also has a part-time job at the Kunoichi Café.  Since her initial appearance, she has developed a serious obsessive infatuation with [Sakata Gintoki](https://anilist.co/character/672/Sakata-Gintoki), to the point of even stalking him. She is severely myopic, to the point of being almost blind (cannot tell living things from inanimate objects) without her eyeglasses. It was also hinted that she doesn't see well even with her eyeglasses on, as she once mistook [Kagura](https://anilist.co/character/674/Kagura) (dressed up as Gintoki) for Gintoki himself. However, this could solely be due to her infatuation with him. She has frequently clashed with [Otae](https://anilist.co/character/2944/Shimura-Tae) for various reasons.  Ayame has a playful attitude but gets serious when it comes to her work. She also seems to enjoy bondage and S&M. Although Gintoki is indifferent to her affections and even treats her badly most times (e.g throwing things at her whenever he senses her stalker presence), her 'M' or masochistic personality only makes her enjoy the punishment, and his 'cruelty' only serves to encourage her.

characters.name: Kyouji Kawagoe
characters.description: Married and divorced five times, he's been given the title "Master of Love". One of several male assistants to Shido by giving a vote on the appropriate course of action Shido should take when acting.  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Mai Hazakura
characters.description: **Mai Hazakura** is a member of the female trio that Tohka is friends with.

characters.name: Mayuri
characters.description: Height: 154 cm  Species: Spirit  Mayuri is a Spirit born from the spirit mana that Tohka, Yoshino, Kotori, Kaguya, Yuzuru, and Miku unconsciously emitted due to their stress and desire to have Shido all to themselves. However, since she was born from spirit mana, she would eventually disappear.Mayuri is a calm girl that rarely shows her emotions. She usually follows Shido around to observe his dates with the Spirits; to fulfill her and her Angel's goal.

characters.name: Satoshi Isshiki
characters.description: He is a student at Totsuki Culinary Academy, a resident of Polar Star Dormitory and the current 7th seat of the Elite Ten Council. Aside from that, Satoshi's position as one of the Elite 10 also promote a strong determination for his kouhai(junior),Yukihira Soma to drive his dream to become one of the 10 seat and could be a potential challenge for Soma due to his natural cooking abilities.

characters.name: Zenji Marui
characters.description: He is a student at Totsuki Culinary Academyand a resident of Polar Star Dormitory. he and the other resident students from this hostel befriended with their fellow roommate/kouhai, Yukihira Soma whom also seen the amazing skill of the freshman. It is due to he rarely cooks, Zenji is considered as the weakest chef among the Polar Star Gang despite his brains has seemly possessed with infinite knowledge about cooking and black-&-white documents.

characters.name: Alice Nakiri
characters.description: Alice Nakiri is a 92nd Tōtsuki Generation student and [Erina Nakiri](https://anilist.co/character/75284/Nakiri-Erina)'s cousin, whose cooking style is specialized in Molecular Gastronomy.   Unlike her cousin though, Alice is much more friendly and cheery. She even will talk to her rivals casually, sometimes merely to poke fun at them, something she inherited from her mother. She is also a modern girl, eager to talk about love and gossip, even with the incredibly socially dense Erina. She is also very cunning, able to manipulate Erina using reverse psychology to keep her at a local public pool despite the latter's initial disgust at the location. She is quite bossy with [Ryō](https://anilist.co/character/88972/Kurokiba-Ryou), usually ordering him to do nearly everything for her. She tends to overreact when she is unhappy, throwing fits or snapping back at people. However, most of these are temporary and she will quickly return to normal in a few minutes.

characters.name: Ryouko Sakaki
characters.description: Ryouko is gentle and kind, responding to the eccentrics of the other Polar Star residents in a level-headed manner and comforting the other students when they are troubled. Ryōko's specialty is fermented foods due to her parents owning a well-known fermented-goods shop, and she maintains a workshop near the dorms to produce her own ingredients. She also keeps a bottle of "fermented rice drink" that she would sometimes bring out during parties and celebrations, which [Souma](https://anilist.co/character/75216/Yukihira-Souma) suspects is illegally brewed sake.  !During the Autumn Elections, she presented a "curry soy-natto rice" using charcoal-fermented natto and homemade rice-sauce fermented with koji. The dish garnered praise from the judges, who suddenly felt as if they were in a festival due to the quintessentially Japanese and festive taste of the dish. She ultimately took 7th place in her block.!

characters.name: Mitsuba Okita
characters.description: Height: 168 cm  Mitsuba is Sougo's older sister, and took care of him since their parents passed away when they were children. Sougo cares deeply for Mitsuba, and is uncharacteristically polite and docile when around her. She is acquainted with the rest of the Shinsengumi, and regularly brings them extra-spicy senbei, which she herself enjoys. She suffers from tuberculosis, and often requires medical treatment, which Sougo used to send money for. She has romantic feelings for Hijikata. Although it is revealed that Hijikata does in fact love her, he feels that he is unable to give her happiness, that is why he treats her coldly.   !She dies in chapter 132 of the manga (Episode 87 for the anime) after a brief conversation with her brother.! She is roughly based on Okita Mitsu, sister of Okita Sōji.  Historically though, it was Okita Sōji who suffered from tuberculosis.

characters.name: Tsuu Terakado
characters.description: An idol pop singer whose song lyrics are often very dirty or controversial. She started her career singing on the sides of streets. This was when Shinpachi met her and has followed her ever since, being captain of her fan club. Her talent was recognized by Bansai Kawakami (under his producer alias "Tsunpo"), and she has since gained popularity. Her mother manages her, and her father is currently serving time in prison. When she was younger, her father made a bet with her, saying that if she became famous, he would bring a number of roses to her first concert. He broke out of prison specially for the occasion, and although he couldn't give her the roses, he gave her a single flower. He donned a paper bag over his head, so he wouldn't trouble her with his presence, yet she knew it was him, and thanked him with tears in her eyes.  She had previously dated a man named Goemon, who worked in the entertainment industry alongside her. Tsu admired him greatly, as "he was the only person who was nice to her", but it was revealed that Goemon truly thought nothing of her, and even went as far as to send her threatening anonymous letters advising her to finish with him.  She became part of the Shinsengumi for a day, to raise morale.  She is often referred to as "Otsu" due to her habit of making words using the last letter of previous words (Terakad-O-Tsuu.)

characters.name: Soyo Tokugawa
characters.description: Height: 156 cm   Younger sister of [Tokugawa Shigeshige](https://anilist.co/character/7157/Tokugawa-Shigeshige).   Spent a day with [Kagura](https://anilist.co/character/674/Kagura), after she sneaked out of the palace due to boredom and loneliness. She surprisingly got hooked on sukonbu, thanks to Kagura's influence.  After her father died, [Rotten Maizou](https://anilist.co/character/77845/Rotten-Maizou) takes care of her as her guardian. Soyo views Maizou as a fatherly figure.

characters.name: Isaburo Sasaki
characters.description: Sasaki Isaburo is the commander of Mimawarigumi. His character is based on the leader of the real Mimawarigumi, Sasaki Tadasaburo.  Sasaki Isaburo was born into the elite samurai family Sasaki, as the main heir. He is also the half brother to Sasaki Tetsunosuke.  His personality is completely different when writing e-mails by cellphone. He insists people to call him Sabu-chan and states that he doesn't have many friends. He cannot express his feelings well by speaking, so he usually texts with his cellphone. He also has a need to express Mimawarigumi's eliteness.  Isaburo trusts Nobume's abilities as an assassin and as his most loyal member of the Mimawarigumi. He also seems to know very well about Nobume's love for donuts and uses it as a reward for her good work.

characters.name: Popura Taneshima
characters.description: Popura is a short 17-year-old high school student who works at Wagnaria. Ironically, she was named after the poplar tree so that she would grow tall. She is a hard worker, but she sometimes makes clumsy mistakes in her job. She is very sensitive about her small appearance; many customers usually mistake her to be younger than she really is. She often fails to gain respect from [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta), who is one year younger than her, as he usually regards her as an elementary school student. She is also unable to properly call him by his surname, saying "Katanashi" rather than "Takanashi", even when corrected.

characters.name: Souta Takanashi
characters.description: Height: 172 cm  Souta is a high school student recruited by [Popura](https://anilist.co/character/24417/Taneshima-Popura) to become a new employee at the family restaurant Wagnaria.  He is enamored by cute things and thus favors Poplar over the other employees due to her cute appearance. He voices his thoughts out loud and occasionally offends his co-workers, often resulting in him getting punished by them. He usually finds his co-workers and the rules of the restaurant to be strange, but he still has an attachment to his job. He can adapt quickly to his job at the restaurant.  He has three older sisters and it is because of them that caused his dislike for older women as he had been tormented by them all his life. He received hand-me-downs from his sisters when he was young, giving him the appearance of a little girl. He also has a younger sister in elementary school who is almost as tall as he is.  !Despite his problems, [Inami](https://anilist.co/character/24419/Inami-Mahiru) asks Souta to cross-dress, using the name Kotori, when her father comes to visit her at work.!

characters.name: Mahiru Inami
characters.description: Height: 166 cm  Inami is a timid girl who joins the rest of the employees at Wagnaria.  She has androphobia and is thus terrified of men; she punches any male that comes near her. This violent behavior arises from her belief that every man is ready to attack her, but instead, she is prone to violently attacking men at a moment's notice. This androphobia was caused by her father who did not want her to eventually wed due to jealousy and thus told her that males would attack her, which ended in her fearing men since then.  As she and [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta) usually share shifts, he takes the brunt of her attacks. However, she makes considerable progress with her fear of men by taking it out on Souta; she states that she can be about two meters close to guys without having the urge to hit them. Though this extends to only having fairly civil conversations (often ruined by Souta's rudeness) or if Inami launches an attack on him.  She wears a hairpin in her hair, which she changes every day due to Souta's compliment on it (according to Souma). At first, she begins to develop a crush, but later she falls in love with Souta when he confronts her father (as Kotori) about her androphobia.

characters.name: Aoi Yamada
characters.description: Aoi is a mysterious, self-proclaimed 16-year-old girl who [Otoo](https://anilist.co/character/32294/Otoo-Hyougo) meets on his travels to find his missing wife. He brings her back to Wagnaria where she starts working as a waitress and living in Wagnaria’s attic.  While she has great confidence in herself, during work she is an unhelpful troublemaker who gets yelled at by other staff members, especially [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta). Since she is in training, her position among the staff is low, which she complains about. She is bad with dealing with Souta’s constant complaints about her, but she does write down some of his suggestions (along with idle complaints).  She yearns for the idea of having a family, especially towards Otoo whom she sees as an ideal father figure, and goes as far as to apply to be adopted by him.  Her favorite food is natto.

characters.name: Kyouko Shirafuji
characters.description: Kyouko is the manager of Wagnaria.  She usually maintains a rather apathetic attitude about how the restaurant is run and almost never bothers to do any work herself. She is not beyond using violence to deal with unruly customers and firmly believes that employees come before the customers, as the employees are the ones doing all the work. She is 28 years old, but she becomes despondent whenever her age is mentioned.  Kyouko saved [Yachiyo](https://anilist.co/character/30905/Todoroki-Yachiyo) as a little girl from bullies, which is how they met.

characters.name: Maya Matsumoto
characters.description: Height: 167 cm   Maya is an 18-year-old glasses-wearing girl who works at Wagnaria. She professes that she is a "normal person" striving to be completely ordinary in work and life in general. She has a hard time understanding the other employees seeing how awkward all of them are and tries not to be too familiar with them. The irony is that because she tries too hard to be "normal", she ends up being pretty weird herself.

characters.name: Kirio Yamada
characters.description: [Aoi](https://anilist.co/character/32292/Yamada-Aoi)'s older brother who has been constantly searching for her. Like Aoi, his surname is an alias which coincidentally matches hers.  He is the captain of the karate club and is strong enough to defend himself against [Mahiru](https://anilist.co/character/24419/Inami-Mahiru), who he gains a crush on.

characters.name: Nazuna Takanashi
characters.description: Height: 170 cm  Nazuna is [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta)'s younger sister. She is very mature for her age and is already almost as tall as Souta even though she is only in elementary school. While a genuinely kind and caring person, she will manipulate other people to get her way.

characters.name: Haruna Otoo
characters.description: Haruna is [Hyougo Otoo](https://anilist.co/character/32294/Otoo-Hyougo)'s missing wife. She wanders the city by using manholes.

characters.name: Yachiyo Todoroki
characters.description: Yachiyo is another employee at the restaurant. She usually carries around a katana which, according to her, was made by her parents who used to be blacksmiths. Yachiyo is unaware that some of the customers, and even [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta), are intimidated by her blade.  She admires [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/24420/Shirafuji-Kyouko) considerably. She gets angry if anyone offers Kyouko food or tries to take her away, although is willing to allow Satou to feed her because she considers him trustworthy, much to his chagrin.

characters.name: Izumi Takanashi
characters.description: Height: 173 cm  Izumi, [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta)'s second eldest sister, is an author who tends to stay in her room for long periods of time focusing on working while ignoring the cleanliness of herself and her surroundings.

characters.name: Kazue Takanashi
characters.description: Kazue is [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta)'s eldest sister. She is a lawyer and has the tendency to hit Souta with a law book.

characters.name: Kozue Takanashi
characters.description: Height: 174 cm   Kozue is [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta)'s third eldest sister.  She's an alcoholic and appears to be drunk most of the time. She is a lonely girl who constantly faces rejection from other guys deep inside. She is also a very affectionate and physical girl who often hugs people around her.

characters.name: Jun Satou
characters.description: A chef who works in the kitchen, Satou is a helpful but intimidating individual.  He is in love with [Yachiyo](https://anilist.co/character/30905/Todoroki-Yachiyo), but has problems expressing it. Of course, because she is so devoted to [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/24420/Shirafuji-Kyouko), she fails to recognize any hints he attempts to make.  He likes to take out his anger on [Popura](https://anilist.co/character/24417/Taneshima-Popura) by messing with her or bending the truth, to which Popura naively believes. When [Souma](https://anilist.co/character/30686/Souma-Hiroomi) tries to help with Satou's development with Yachiyo, Satou unrelentingly hits him with a pan, showing that he is sensitive about his feelings for Yachiyo.  !In chapter 219, he confessed his feelings to Yachiyo and asked if he could bring her to see the outside world (AKA asking her out). Yachiyo gladly agreed. While the rest of the staff are happy, Kyouko isn't pleased. Thankfully, she gradually accepted their relationship.!

characters.name: Hiroomi Souma
characters.description: A chef who works in the kitchen, he is a young man with an easygoing attitude.  He often blackmails other workers to do his job for him and pass it off as a form of modesty from the other employees. He can blackmail anyone except [Inami](https://anilist.co/character/24419/Inami-Mahiru), who punches him even before he manages to talk to her. He is terrified of Inami's urges and is thankful for [Souta](https://anilist.co/character/24418/Takanashi-Souta)'s existence in the restaurant since Inami is taking out her urges all on Souta and not him.

characters.name: Ushikao no Chuukyuu Youkai
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Hitotsume no Chuukyuu Youkai
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Seiji Matoba
characters.description: Age: 22 Birthday: November 1 Height: 174cm   The head of one of the major exorcism clans, the Matoba Clan. In order to hunt them, he shows ayakashi, and sometimes even humans, no mercy. He takes great interest in Natsume.   ! Cold hearted and rational. He uses ayakashi as bait to exorcise other ones and wants stronger ones to protect humans (although he doesn't mind hurting humans too when they're in his way). Ayakashis are just replaceable tools for him. He mainly uses a bow and arrow against them and if he finds their sealing troublesome, he prefers eliminating them.   In the past one of the Matoba clan offered his right eye to an ayakashi for assistance, but in the end he never gave it. Ever since than the heads of the clan has had their right eye targetted by that ayakashi. Matoba Seiji still has his eye, but (according to his words) has a horrible scar. !

characters.name: Koharu Hidaka
characters.description: A girl in [Haruo](https://anilist.co/character/127767)'s class throughout junior high. Goes to an all-girl school with Onizuka throughout high school. Previously an introverted girl who spent much of her time studying alone, she develops into a more sociable person and develops an interest in gaming after spending time with Haruo over a new Neo Geo MVS that gets installed in front of her family's store. !She has a natural instinct for fighting games, which transforms her into a powerful forced to be reckoned with as both a gamer, and a rival for Haruo's affections. After a fateful showdown at her and Haruo's usual stomping grounds, she developed a bit of a sadistic side whenever Haruo's around. This frightening skill garnered the attention of the "Mizonokuchi Force" leader, Nikotama, who helped Koharu truly awaken her love for fighting games.!

characters.name: Moemi Gouda
characters.description: Moemi is the personal instructor serving the Ōno Zaibatsu. She at times abuses her powers as an instructor and makes Ono suffer from overworking such as studying and practice with no tolerance of gaming.  She is extremely strict with Ono because of her position in the Ono family but is shown to care for her, sometimes she comes off rude because of her position and her wanting the daughters of the Ono family to be prepared for their future.

characters.name: Guile
characters.description: Guile is a Sergeant in the United States Air Force. He has pride in both the Air Force and his men, and frequently goes out drinking with them whenever they can. He and his partner, Nash, have served together for many years in various missions and military conflicts. As a military person he is regularly found working out and lifting weights.He has won at least one boxing tournament and probably others not mentioned in the show. His martial art style that he uses in combat is loosely based on U.S. Military Combatives, the official martial arts styles that the U.S military teaches to its soldiers     (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Zangief
characters.description: Height: 214 cm (7')  This massive Russian makes up for his obvious mental shortcomings with sheer size and an unadulterated zeal for fighting. A former employee of the Russian Wrestling Federation who enjoys wrestling bears in his free time; Zangief now takes his orders from the masterminds controlling the insidious Shadowlaw organization. Though not evil, the simple-minded Zangief is unable to distinguish loyalty from true friendship.

characters.name: Shougakkou no Sensei
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Akira Oono
characters.description: **Likes**: Video games, snacks **Dislikes**: Horror **Relatives**: [Makoto Oono](https://anilist.co/character/132445/Makoto-Oono) (older sister), unnamed parents  Akira Oono is the silent daughter of the Oono family. Akira is popular at school for being multi-talented but sneaks away to play arcade games to escape the harsh environment at home.  Akira is good at everything she does, including study, drawing, music, martial arts, and video games. Despite being very smart, she never talks. Haruo can read her facial expressions to guess what she's thinking and wanting. She makes small voices like "Umm", nodding, and shaking her head as a way to say yes or no. Sometimes she points her finger at things she wants. She uses violence sometimes (mostly on Haruo) when she feels angry, jealous, or scared.  Akira is good at almost every game on the Arcade platform. For fighting games, she uses huge power-type characters such as [Zangief](https://anilist.co/character/9317/Zangief) and [Edmond Honda](https://anilist.co/character/9477/Edmond-Honda). She also loves characters that have similarities to Zangief's cyclone ability. She doesn't have any game consoles at home, so she's not good at using a controller at first. She doesn't like horror games either.

characters.name: Koutarou Miyao
characters.description: He is Yaguchi Haruo's best friend. They became friends in middle school and stayed in the same school all through high school. He is shown to care very much for Haruo. He shows signs of having non-platonic feelings for him, the first sign being him telling Haruo that if he didn't explain himself about Ono, he would kiss him. He pulled it off as a joke, but his facial expression showed signs of seriousness. Another sign is when he said "My Haruo", which Haruo caught, even looking up questioningly at him. He also covered for Haruo when he was confronted with Ono and Hidaka. He also seems uncomfortable when it comes to the two girls, who both love Haruo.

characters.name: Felicia Futakotamagawa
characters.description: Nikotama is a outgoing girl with her acquaintances but with other persons she tends to be reserved. She was not seen in action however her showed had a great knowledge about various games and tactics. Felicia is a great observer too,demonstrating this in a lot of moments, principalyl in the confrontation between Haruo and Hidaka.

characters.name: Haruo Yaguchi
characters.description: A young man who is dismal in various facets of life: He's not academic, he's not athletic, and he's not very attractive. The only thing he's got going for him is an insane amount of mad gamer skills. He rules the arcade scene as "Beastly Fingers Haruo", until he meets his match during a fateful encounter with [Akira Oono](https://anilist.co/character/126962/Oono-Akira) while playing Street Fighter II. Undeterred, he seeks to challenge and one day out play her, considering her his rival.  While he starts off as a snarky brat with an ego bigger than any winning streak he could rack up in Street Fighter, he eventually grows out of it. However, he never abandons his dedication and love for gaming, which almost borders on unhealthy obsession. On the bright side, this pure passion for gaming is what leads him to finding some of his closest friends.

characters.name: Namie Yaguchi
characters.description: Appearance: Namie is usually seen wearing her red overall dress and a white long sleeve with blue sandals or slippers.  Personality: Even though she can be very strange and makes jokes to her annoyed son, it's very clear she cares lots about Haruo and Even ono as well. She tends to "beat up" or punish Haruo when he does something rude or gets bad grades as shown in a few episodes.

characters.name: Reiko Tonoo
characters.description: Reiko is Yaguchi Haruo and Hidaka Koharu's homeroom teacher in Middle School.

characters.name: Jiiya
characters.description: Jīya is the butler of the Ouno resident, and the driver serving Ouno Akira. He shows very deep feelings for Akira, being her personal driver for many years. He goes out of his way to bring Ono to arcades around the town, even going as far as to defend her against her strict tutor.

characters.name: Genta Doi
characters.description: Genta is one of the Elementary School classmates of Ōno Akira and Yaguchi Haruo. He admires Akira for her beauty, smartness, and the fact that she's rich. He aims to make Akira his fiancé but keeps getting rejected.  Doi reunites with Haruo again in highschool where they enroll in the same school.

characters.name: Makoto Oono
characters.description: Appearance: Makoto is a college student who almost looks like her younger sister Akira, except her hair is a bit more curly, and her face is very similar to Akira’s.  Personality: She is like the polar opposite of Akira. She's loquacious, carefree, and a little bit of a tomboy. She makes it no secret that she dislikes the parenting of her family and frequently runs away from Gōda Moemi, to the point that Moemi decides to give up on Makoto.

characters.name: Chihiro Onizuka
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Chino Kafuu
characters.description: Height: 144 cm  Chino is a girl whose dream job is to become an amazing barista of Rabbit House. Chino, being reserved and quiet, found it difficult at first to open up to [Cocoa](https://anilist.co/character/84491/Cocoa-Hoto) when she first moved over to Rabbit House and being the energetic girl [Cocoa](https://anilist.co/character/84491/Cocoa-Hoto) is, she often tried acting as the bigger sister of Chino. Chino has an extremely low tolerance for alcohol, and will turn into a cute little sister character when she so much as smells alcohol from chocolate. She is the type to remember everything she did after she is no longer intoxicated. Chino looks up to [Syaro](https://anilist.co/character/88033/Syaro-Kirima), [Rize](https://anilist.co/character/88034/Rize-Tedeza), [Cocoa](https://anilist.co/character/84491/Cocoa-Hoto), [Chiya](https://anilist.co/character/88035/Chiya-Ujimatsu), and [Mocha](https://anilist.co/character/89519/Mocha-Hoto), as they are older and they act as role models for her. Her two friends of age are [Maya](https://anilist.co/character/89520/Maya-Jouga) and [Megu](https://anilist.co/character/89445/Megumi-Natsu).

characters.name: Syaro Kirima
characters.description: **Height:** 151 cm  [Chiya](https://anilist.co/character/88035/Chiya-Ujimatsu)'s childhood friend who lives next door to the Ama Usa An and works at a herbal tea café, Fleur de Lapin.   Syaro is a sensitive and bashful girl who has insecurities when it comes to her image. She is easily flustered and worries that her friends think she is a rich and sophisticated lady when in actuality she is a regular girl living in a humble home. She is [Rize](https://anilist.co/character/88034/Rize-Tedeza)'s underclassman at an elite school, though she is generally poor herself, and has a crush on her.   She also has a major fear of rabbits, and becomes hyper whenever she drinks coffee.

characters.name: Rize Tedeza
characters.description: Height: 160 cm  Rize is a tough and headstrong girl. She secretly holds insecurity of not fitting in and can sometimes feel lonely; for example, while she is an independent and physically strong person, she tries to act like an average teenage girl (even going as far as to pretend she can't lift a bag of coffee beans) so that she can appear more relatable to her friends. Rize can be blunt with her opinions and often acts as the voice of common sense in the group.  She is a part-time worker at the Rabbit House Cafe, alongside [Chino](https://anilist.co/character/88032/Chino-Kafuu) and [Cocoa](https://anilist.co/character/84491/Cocoa-Hoto). [Her father](https://anilist.co/character/206902/Rize-no-Chichi) is a soldier, which is why she is quite strict and carries around a pistol for protection; however, Rize is quite vulnerable against cute things, and she has a vivid imagination which can run away with her sometimes.

characters.name: Chiya Ujimatsu
characters.description: **Height:** 157 cm  Chiya is a very well-spoken, gentle, and empathic girl, who genuinely strives to make her business successful and accepts tasks that may nurture her abilities to be the head of an organization, as she considers it good practice. She's often seen to be a jokester, who fools around with [Cocoa](https://anilist.co/character/84491/Cocoa-Hoto), and gives her menú strange names. However, she is very mature and helps out her friends whenever they are in a slump, trying her best to give them pieces of advice or cheer them up. It has been said that Chiya is only goofing off and an airhead when [Cocoa](https://anilist.co/character/84491/Cocoa-Hoto) is around, however, if that is not the case, she is quite reliable and gives off the vibe of a very dependable person.

characters.name: Megumi Natsu
characters.description: Height: 145 cm  Megumi is gentle and friendly with a light personality. She is sweet and always in a good mood, but she is genuinely shy about doing things before others. Although she doesn't show it off often, she is a talented ballet dancer and is noted for being really graceful.

characters.name: Cocoa Hoto
characters.description: **Height:** 154 cm  Cocoa is a very extroverted girl, who has many dreams that she'd like to pursue, such as an international lawyer, novelist and a baker. Her motto is that everyone is a friend of hers after a mere few seconds. Because of her very optimistic, laid back and cheerful personality, she fills the people around her with happiness. Even though she is very clumsy and airheaded at times, she always strives to become a reliable big sister figure to those younger than her, especially if it's about [Chino](https://anilist.co/character/88032/Chino-Kafuu).   Despite that, she is very skilled at mathematics and physics and loves to count prime numbers.

characters.name: Mocha Hoto
characters.description: [Cocoa](https://anilist.co/character/84491/Cocoa-Hoto)'s older sister.

characters.name: Maya Jouga
characters.description: Height: 140 cm  Maya is the excitable and mischievous friend of [Chino](https://anilist.co/character/88032/Chino-Kafuu) and [Megumi](https://anilist.co/character/89445/Megumi-Natsu). Like [Cocoa](https://anilist.co/character/84491/Cocoa-Hoto), she's energetic, and strives toward goals that may or may not be out of reach. She is usually in a perky mood.  She admires [Rize](https://anilist.co/character/88034/Rize-Tedeza) for her cool attitude and fast-thinking, and while she is loving towards her friends, she can show a blunt side with them. At home, she is shown to be a bit lazy as well, often relying on her older brother to do things for her.  Even though she often acts like a "fool", it is said that she is actually very inquisitive and has very good grades.

characters.name: Midori Aoyama
characters.description: Height: 163 cm  Despite her usually childish, airheaded and laid back personality, she can be very mature and can read and analyze people very well.  Even though Aoyama is a famous novelist, she often struggles to come up with an idea for her stories, often only getting done with her work on the day of her deadline or even past it. However once she has started and has figured the story out, she works very fast. To find crucial ideas, she roams around the timbered town, searching for interesting and useable ideas to cross with. That being said, she often visits the Ama Usa An and the Fleur de Lapin to find such things, often using the people around her to write her stories about. In the past, she was a regular in the Rabbit House as well, until she was too busy to visit it anymore because of her rising popularity. The school she visited in the past was also the same as [Rize](https://anilist.co/character/88034/Rize-Tedeza)'s and [Syaro](https://anilist.co/character/88033/Syaro-Kirima)'s.

characters.name: Tippy
characters.description: The cafe mascot for Rabbit House. Tippy is a female angora rabbit, who likes to rest on people's heads.  !In reality, Tippy is [Takahiro](https://anilist.co/character/89523/Takahiro-Kafuu)'s father, and [Chino](https://anilist.co/character/88032/Chino-Kafuu)'s grandfather.!  !In season 1 episode 6 after the end credits it is heavily hinted that he was turned into a rabbit when "his cafe was suffering from financial difficulty, he complained he'd rather be a rabbit".!

characters.name: Takahiro Kafuu
characters.description: [Chino](https://anilist.co/character/88032/Chino-Kafuu)'s father. He works in the bar after closing Rabbit House for the evening.

characters.name: Rin Mate
characters.description: Rin Mate is [Aoyama](https://anilist.co/character/89521/Midori-Aoyama)'s editor and friend from high school. Rin is strict when it comes to [Aoyama](https://anilist.co/character/89521/Midori-Aoyama) and keeps a watch over her. She has no problem threatening to give [Aoyama](https://anilist.co/character/89521/Midori-Aoyama) a hard time, should she approach the deadline and not be finished with her work yet.

characters.name: Rize no Chichi
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Erika Ainsworth
characters.description: ! Her true name is Pandora !  Illya describes Erika as a "twisted child" whose innocence can fool people into thinking that Erika is harmless when she really has a cunning side of her that can potentially make her very dangerous; however, she is indeed a child that is afraid to be alone and tries to use any method, albeit rough, to avoid being lonely.  ! Pandora was created by the Twelve Olympians six thousand years before the events of PRISMA☆ILLYA. Differing from other worlds, Pandora's Box was never opened in Miyu's World, so Pandora was left unable to die because her "death" itself is also within the box. She was given knowledge by the gods that she had to wait until humanity perished so that she can finally open the box and release the world's true potential. Because of her immortality, Pandora suffered greatly as people unreasonably tried to kill the undying mud doll whenever they discovered she wasn't human. After so many years of suffering, Pandora began questioning on why she had to go through this for humans.  Having been found by Darius Ainsworth one thousand years before the events of PRISMA☆ILLYA, Pandora has lived with the Ainsworths since then. She has taken on various names over the generations, the most recent being Erika. !

characters.name: Magical Ruby
characters.description: Originally the magical wand of Rin Toshaka. She broke up contract with Rin due to her personal conflict with Luviagelita Edelfelt and also for not cooperating together to fulfill the goal of capturing all magical cards of all classes.  It then formed contract with Illya that made her a magical girl - A dream come true?

characters.name: Bazett Fraga McRemitz
characters.description: Height: 172 cm  Bazett is a serious, kind, and hardworking individual who possesses a strong sense of justice. She can be short-tempered, but calculating. While she presents herself as a strong-willed and mature woman with an independent streak, she is actually rather lonely.   Bazett had always intended to summon [Cú Chulainn](https://anilist.co/character/499/Chulainn-C) for the Fifth Holy Grail War. The reason behind her motive was her desire to save him since childhood. Having had a dispassionate and socially desolate childhood, Bazett found herself immersed with the story of Cú Chulainn. She grieved for the tragedy of his legend, but at the same time felt that it gave her a sense of purpose. She strove to become a strong magus, gambling on the wild hope of summoning him and using the Holy Grail as a means of "saving" him from his inevitable fate.   Bazett was born in a coastal village in Ireland as a descendant of an old family of magi that had detached itself from the Mage's Association and lived in the shadows quietly. Wishing to pursue a different path than that of her ancestors, she chose to join the Association when she was 15. Despite Bazett's rare lineage, her skills were not judged as being particularly useful and she was dismissed. Instead, she employed her abilities to become a hunter of those that had been given a Sealing Designation.

characters.name: Chloe von Einzbern
characters.description: **Height:** 133 cm  Kuro, initially referred to as Dark Illya, is a being created from [Illya](https://anilist.co/character/503/von-Einzbern-Illyasviel)'s hidden power and the Archer Class Card.  !She comes into existence after Illya uses the Class Card in order to save herself, and afterward, she falls unconscious and wakes up to find the card missing and an exact duplicate of herself, with the exception of dark skin and the Archer outfit, in its place. Kuro immediately escapes and makes various attempts on Illya's life, stating that they cannot both freely exist. She is eventually captured and has a seal placed upon her that forces her to share all sensations with Illya, including injuries and pain. Unable to freely fulfill her goal, she attends Illya's school as her cousin, Kuro, though she still holds resentment towards Illya. She is at odds with [Miyu](https://anilist.co/character/21728/Edelfelt-Miyu), who wishes to kill Kuro in order to protect Illya.!  !The nature of her existence is eventually revealed to be Illya's sealed memories as a Holy Grail. When [Kiritsugu](https://anilist.co/character/10010/Emiya-Kiritsugu) and [Irisviel](https://anilist.co/character/15164/von-Einzbern-Irisviel) stole Illya from the Einzbern family before she could be fully configured as a Grail, they also sealed her memories of these events to help her have a normal life. Unbeknownst to them, however, these sealed memories continued to exist, becoming a hidden second personality within Illya's mind. Eventually, this personality became powerful enough to harness the Archer class card and create a body for itself, becoming Kuro. Kuro is deeply bitter as a result, both towards her parents for sealing her, and toward Illya for wishing to be 'normal' (and thus indirectly wishing for Kuro, the manifestation of her past as part of a Magus clan) to not exist. She eventually comes to terms with her anger after Illya finally accepts her, only to begin breaking down shortly after. Although on the verge of death, Illya is able to convince her to fight for her new life, making her admit that what she wants most is not to be a Magus, nor to kill anyone, nor even to be accepted: most of all, she just wants the chance to live. This admission is enough for her powers as an incomplete Grail to activate, granting her wish to live and stabilizing her body.  She is then formally adopted into the extended Einzbern family, being introduced to [Shirou](https://anilist.co/character/496/Emiya-Shirou) as Illya's cousin.!

characters.name: Darius  Ainsworth
characters.description: Darius Ainsworth is the first head of the Ainsworth family. He has "lived" for one thousand years through the means of a curse upon his descendants that overlay them with a "Conceptual Replacement." His current host is Julian Ainsworth.  (Source: TYPE-MOON Wiki)

characters.name: Tanaka
characters.description: Tanaka is amnesiac woman who tends to forget a lot of things except for her name. However she is upbeat, cheerful, she is also considered the comic relief when she's not serious. She tends to sleep when she doesn't understand what people are trying to explain. Tanaka has a mind of a child which was stated by Illya. For some reason, Tanaka likes to wear work out clothes instead of wearing regular clothes.

characters.name: Angelica Ainsworth
characters.description: Angelica is a member of the Ainsworth. She appears to be an emotional, calm, and serious person.

characters.name: Julian Ainsworth
characters.description: Head of the Ainsworth family.

characters.name: Ogata
characters.description: Ogata is an ex-racer who participated in MFG in the past. He seems to now work as a mechanic, tuning cars rather than racing them. Ogata loves petrol cars and considers electric cars garbage.

characters.name: Ren Saionji
characters.description: Ren Saionji is the daughter of the family that main character, Kanata Rivington moves in with. She is the main female protagonist and has had feelings for Kanata since the day they met, even though she didn't believe in such a thing as "love at first sight".

characters.name: Kanata Rivington
characters.description: Car: Toyota GT86  Kanata Rivington is a rookie racer who came to Japan from the United Kingdom in order to find his lost father. His mother is British, while his father is Japanese. He graduated from Royal Donington Park Racing School, a famous and prestigious racing school in the UK.

characters.name: Shun Aiba
characters.description: Car: Nissan GT-R R35 Nismo  Shun Aiba is a racer who participates in MFG. He drives car number 9. He ranked 9th in MFG Year 3 and intends on ranking in the top 5 in MFG Year 4. He is the only racer to drive a Japanese domestic car that ranked in the top 10 (MFG Year 3).  (Source: MF Ghost Wiki)

characters.name: Takuya Yanagida
characters.description: Car: BMW M6 Coupe (Modified)  A "Godly Fifteen" racer who participates in MFG.

characters.name: Hiroya Okuyama
characters.description: Hiroya Okuyama is the number 1 driver of Team Spiral, also known as "Zero 1". Okuyama too believes in Ikeda's "Zero Theory" and is disappointed when he won't be able to use his car's full potential due to the fog. Okuyama, unlike Ikeda is very arrogant and confident in his abilities. He also refuses to greet Project D upon meeting them.  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Daigo Ooishi
characters.description: Car: Lamborghini Huracán LP 610-4 (Modified)  A "Godly Fifteen" racer who participates in MFG. He was born into a wealthy family and is a Lamborghini supremacist.

characters.name: Michael Beckenbauer
characters.description: Car: Porsche 718 Cayman S (982)  Michael Beckenbauer is a racer who participates in MFG. He drives car number 12.

characters.name: Kuramoto
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Ilulu
characters.description: Ilulu is a female dragon who belongs to the Chaos Faction. Originally, she came to [Kobayashi's](https://anilist.co/character/120969) world to destroy [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970) and then tries to drive Kobayashi away from Tohru. After a change of heart, she begins to live with Kobayashi as her third dragon resident.  She has a caring personality and loves children. Later on, her personality leads her to taking over the running of a candy store from an old lady, who's looking for her replacement.

characters.name: Kobayashi
characters.description: Kobayashi is a computer programmer and office worker. She finds herself living with a dragon named [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru).  Even though Kobayashi maintains a cool demeanor, she has been regarded as kind-hearted and reliable among her friends and colleagues. Level-headed and pragmatic, she stands as the source of reason when dealing with her dragon friends. However, when intoxicated, she tends to become rowdy and aggressive, especially in her interests in maids, and is not above subjecting Tohru to her drunken whims.  Before meeting Tohru, Kobayashi would don a stoic expression on her face. Now, she is more approachable and open to others, often seen smiling contentedly. Kobayashi often chastised Tohru for her lack of propriety on human standards.
