However, as time passes by, she grows accustomed to Tohru's quirks and would sometimes show small signs of affection and gratitude for the dragon, such as holding Tohru's hand or going out of her way to fulfill some of Tohru's wishes to ease her troubles.

characters.name: Tohru
characters.description: Faction: Chaos Relatives: [Damocles](https://anilist.co/character/172721/Damocles) (father)  Tohru is a female dragon with the ability to transform into a human girl. After [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi) rescues her, she falls in love with her and decides to work for her as a maid.  As a Chaos Dragon, Tohru was raised to hate humans and was supposed to be a fierce and dangerous force of evil with nothing other than destruction in mind. However, this all changed when she met Kobayashi. She is now cheerful and kind to every human she meets, except for those who are real, or as it is in most cases, imaginary, threats to her love interest Kobayashi (such as [Makoto Takiya](https://anilist.co/character/120976/Makoto-Takiya)). She is also quickly influenced by what she sees on television or the internet and shares a fiery relationship with her rival, [Elma](https://anilist.co/character/120977/Elma).  As Kobayashi's maid, Tohru is a hard worker and cares deeply for the household, tending to all aspects of daily life, although this will often lead to trouble, such as when Tohru tries to feed her tail to Kobayashi, or when she molests Kobayashi's dirty laundry. Still, Kobayashi always shows her appreciation for Tohru's efforts and does her best to guide Tohru in the ways of modern life and human culture on Earth. Tohru is very protective of [Kanna](https://anilist.co/character/120974/Kanna-Kamui) and is essentially her mother figure and big sister combined. Having been accepted by Kobayashi even in her dragon form, Tohru quickly fell deeply in love with her. Even faced with Kobayashi's stoic character and often unrequited advances, Tohru never fails to make her unending love for Kobayashi known. Tohru's equally strong sexual attraction to Kobayashi often drives her to trickery, such as making a chocolate heart with a love potion secretly added, or finding different ways to attempt making Kobayashi eat her tail.

characters.name: Fafnir
characters.description: An old friend of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru), he is a male dragon with a strong distrust for humans which leads to him questioning much of Tohru's actions and ideals in his earlier appearances. He shares some resemblance to the traits of his namesake, such as his cold demeanour and disdainful mentality. He appears as a refined young man with long black hair and red eyes in his human form. !After Tohru's attempts to find a place to stay for him (under the name Takeshi Ooyama), Fafnir eventually comes to live with [Takiya](https://anilist.co/character/120976/Takiya-Makoto), becoming obsessed with video games and popular culture.!

characters.name: Riko Saikawa
characters.description: **Relatives**: [Georgie Saikawa](https://anilist.co/character/120978/Georgie-Saikawa) (older sister)  Riko Saikawa is [Kanna](https://anilist.co/character/120974/Kanna-Kamui)'s friend and classmate in elementary school. A running gag involves her becoming overwhelmingly flushed with bliss every time she and Kanna make physical contact, along with her shiny forehead.  At first glance, Riko seems bossy and mean, but over time, she seems nicer as shown with Kanna, and very polite around people like [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969/Kobayashi), although she originally mistook Kobayashi for Kanna's mother. She has a crush on Kanna and enjoys being around her. When being touched by Kanna or when she receives praise from her, she tends to grin goofily and get red in the face, becoming overwhelmed with excitement.  Though she initially tries to pick a fight with Kanna for her sudden popularity on the first day of her transfer to the school, she quickly becomes good friends with her. They often spend time with each other, walking home together from school and picking the other as their partner during school activities.

characters.name: Shouta Magatsuchi
characters.description: Relatives: [Mr. Magatsuchi](https://anilist.co/character/248474) (father), Saori Magatsuchi (mother)  Shouta Magatsuchi is a young boy born into a family of mages in the modern world. He has shown to possess enough knowledge on the arcane arts to attempt summoning a demon. [Lucoa](https://anilist.co/character/120975) came out of a summoning portal Shouta created and starts living with him.  Shouta is an elementary school boy in 5th grade with both purple hair and eyes. His bangs reach well below his eyebrows. His appearance looks partly androgynous.  Shouta is quiet and shy most of the time when seen with Lucoa. When Lucoa attempts to seduce Shouta, he would run away with embarrassment and accuse Lucoa of being a demon.  As his father is [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969)'s manager, she's asked to look after Shouta at times.

characters.name: Kanna Kamui
characters.description: [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970)'s friend from the dragon realm who got exiled from her world and wound up living with [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969) as well. She is very young by dragon standards, equivalent to a primary school student, which she attends as a third-year student bearing Kobayashi's surname later in the series. She initially assumes that Kobayashi seduced Tohru into staying and wanted her to return to their original world. !She grows attached to Kobayashi as the series progresses, viewing her as a mother figure.! Kanna's basis and tribal attire are inspired by the culture of the indigenous natives of Hokkaido and claims to be from Ushishir. She bears feather-like horns and a thin tail ending in a bulb, and is capable of charging with electricity.

characters.name: Chloe
characters.description: She is an American who befriends Kanna when she had quarreled with Kobayashi.

characters.name: Elma
characters.description: **Faction**: Harmony  Elma is a female dragon from the Harmony faction, the opposing faction of Chaos, which [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru) belongs to. She adopts the name Elma Joui as her human alias after she finds that she is unable to return to her world. Elma is the only dragon of the main cast who lives on her own in the human world.  Elma usually takes the form of a human woman with short black hair, large breasts, blue eyes, and a long spiral unicorn-like horn (which she can freely hide). In the anime and [Elma’s Office Lady Diary](https://anilist.co/manga/100756/Miss-Kobayashis-Dragon-Maid-Elmas-Office-Lady-Diary/), her hair also has purple tips. At work, she wears round glasses. She also wears a business suit which consists of a white shirt, light blue tie, a loose blue sweater, a grey blazer, and a dark grey knee-length skirt with light grey socks and black heels. Her casual attire in the anime consists of olive-green skin-tight trousers, a light blue jacket, a dark blue vest, and a yellow scarf. Her first outfit, which she also wears in her world while in human form, consists of a light tan scarf with a dark blue (sometimes black) leotard. She wears a purple kimono with pink piping and a dark blue sash over the leotard, with the top pulled down. She has bandages around her legs and sandals. She can be seen with a cobalt blue and turquoise tail (which she can freely hide). Sometimes, she carries around a long, brown trident.  In Elma's dragon form, she's a blue sea serpent with a brown horn protruding from her forehead and her brown trident is her tail. She can freely move around in the water because she is a water dragon.

characters.name: Makoto Takiya
characters.description: [Kobayashi](https://anilist.co/character/120969)'s co-worker who is initially believed by [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970) to be a rival for Kobayashi's affections, but is really just an otaku who likes to talk about maids with her. Kobayashi helps him set up during Comiket every year.  ![Fafnir](https://anilist.co/character/120971) eventually decides to live with him to stay in the human world.!

characters.name: Quetzalcoatl
characters.description: **Faction**: Spectation  Quetzalcoatl often referred to as Lucoa, is a former dragon goddess and an old friend of [Tohru](https://anilist.co/character/120970/Tohru). She was exiled from her seat after consuming cursed liquor that led her into a scandalous affair. As a member of the spectating faction, she does not interfere with any events involving the dragons or gods. She's by far the most powerful dragon in the series.  Quetzalcoatl appears to be laid-back and carefree who is rarely seen without a smile. She is wise, kind, and nurturing who often has advice for her younger kin. As a former goddess, she is better tuned to human customs, as seen when she explains to Tohru why Kobayashi was not receptive to Tohru's initial cleaning regimen. Despite this, however, Lucoa seems to lack some sense of dignity severely. She is not above using her body as a means of getting what she wants, as shown when she attempts to use her alluring figure as an offering to [Shouta](https://anilist.co/character/120973/Shouta-Magatsuchi), hoping to allow her to stay in his home.  Quetzalcoatl lives with Shouta but does not work for her stay. The two have a complicated relationship as Shouta sees Quetzalcoatl as a succubus or demon rather than a dragon. Quetzalcoatl will often try to get Shouta's attention, but due to her massive breasts, she often ends up flustering and embarrassing him instead.

characters.name: Hachisuka
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Taketo Aida
characters.description: Taketo Aida is the grandson of Miss Aida, the owner of the candy store where Ilulu ends up getting a job. Although he starts off being suspicious of Ilulu they end up becoming friends after he's shown her kind side. He's shown to be supportive and kind as he's willing to go out of his way to lend a helping hand.

characters.name: Kuroda
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Hiyori Kazane
characters.description: Hiyori is introduced as a second-year student at Tomoki's school. She has feelings for Tomoki and joins the New Continent Discovery Club just to get closer to him.   !In actuality, Hiyori is an angel who was first seen when Sugata went to Synapse. She was inside some sort of a sleeping chamber that connected her to her body on Earth, which functions like an avatar.  Sugata was hesitant on letting her join the New Continent Discovery Club, since there are still a lot of things he does not know about what she really is. However, he welcomes her anyway, since her membership will allow his club to receive more funding. Thus far, nobody, except Sugata, is aware of Hiyori's true identity.  When Hiyori's body in Synapse awakened, the Hiyori on Earth "died" and everybody forgot her. In Synapse, she was turned into a Weather Weapon Angeloid called Zeta, and was ordered to destroy the humans by decreasing the air pressure. Ikaros, Nymph and Astraea tried to fight against her, but they couldn´t because she was their friend. Nymph tried to hack but Zeta have a much more powerful ability to counter-hack Nymph. Ikaros, Astrea and Nymph team up together to destroy the machine that is latched onto Zeta's back, thinking that it will stop her. After the machine is destroyed, Zeta's necklace start a countdown, a time wraping bomb. Ikaros used Aegis around Zeta and she also when into it, saying that she doesn't want Zeta to die alone. Tomoki intercepted saying he would not want both to die. Zeta was woken up by memories when Tomoki talk to her, she know that she is going to die. She hack Ikaros and told her to bring Tomoki to safety. Zeta imploded to Tomoki's despair She also knows who Tomoki likes (and it isn't her). At the ending of the movie, they show that Zeta and Tomoki have actually met eachother when they were young. After the credits of the movie, Tomoki is shown standing on the aforementioned hill, when suddenly feathers fall all around him, as he turns around he starts smiling. After the screen fades out, the sound of Hiyori's bells is heard. Hinting that she is still alive, just like in the manga where the implosion (from the movie) never happened and was prevented by Nymph. After which Hiyori comes back to school as an Angeloid.!

characters.name: Astraea
characters.description: Height: 159cm  Species: Angeloid    Introduced as the "Delta Angeloid: Close Combat Type". She is something of an airhead and has limited intelligence, due to having low processing power to be able to have high combat abilities and emotions. She weighs 48 kilograms, stands at 159cm, and her wing type is stated to be "Not Variable" and "Super Acceleration".  !She is sent by Synapse to dispose of Tomoki after he violates one of their rules.  However, when she is ordered to eliminate Nymph, she breaks off her chain and betrays Synapse, engaging in combat with Chaos. ! Astraea has been described as having greater battle capabilities than Ikaros, and possesses two equipments: the super-oscillating photon blade 'Chrysaor', and a shield said to surpass the defensive power of Ikaros' 'Aegis', 'Aegis L'. However, unlike 'Aegis', 'Aegis L' is unable to cover every angle possible, only being able to block certain directions at a time, and it covers about half the area of 'Aegis' in terms of angles. Astraea's weak point is that she was made entirely for close-combat, and thus is extremely disadvantaged against opponents with long-range weapons or attacks, as she has no ranged attacks whatsoever.

characters.name: Gene Smilas
characters.description: General of the E.U. Army. He appears to be a sort of mentor to Leila Malcal, offering advice and praising her on her accomplishments, as well as being generally supportive of her ideas.  (Source: Code Geass Wikia)

characters.name: Kate Novak
characters.description: A medical subordinate trained under Sophie Randall.  (Source: Code Geass Wikia)

characters.name: Chloe Winkel
characters.description: Anna Clement's assistant.

characters.name: Hilda Fagan
characters.description: An assistant to Anna Clement. She calls Anna "boss" during their conversations.  (Source: Code Geass Wikia)

characters.name: Suzaku Kururugi
characters.description: Height: 176 cm (5'9")          Nationality: Japanese          Known Relatives: Genbu Kururugi (father, deceased), Kaguya Sumeragi (cousin) Knightmare Frame: Lancelot and Lancelot Albion  Lelouch's childhood friend and son of Japan's last prime minister. After Britannia's takeover of Japan, Suzaku joins the Britannia Army and becomes an Honorary Britannian. He agrees with Zero (Lelouch in disguise, unknown to Suzaku) with his assertion that the Britannia Empire is not worth serving, but nevertheless wishes to implement changes and improvements from within the empire, all the while trying not to lose sight of his goals lest his father's death have been in vain. He has a strong sense of justice and is the only one known to be able to pilot the elite Britannian Knightmare Frame, Lancelot. He always keeps with him a broken pocket watch, a memento of his deceased father.

characters.name: Ayano Kousaka
characters.description: Ayano Kousaka is a girl who is also in Ryou's group.   She is constantly practicing Japanese Martial Arts and carries a kodachi.

characters.name: Sarah Danes
characters.description: An Operator working with W-0. She has a businesslike attitude towards her work.  (Source: Code Geass Wikia)

characters.name: Ryou Sayama
characters.description: Ryo Sayama is the leader of a particular group that opposes the Mafia. He's plotting an attack on the E.U. general, Sumairasu.

characters.name: Akito Hyuuga
characters.description: Height: 175 cm  An Eleven belonging to the EU army. During year 2017, in the hellish European battlefront, he takes up a military operation with 5% survival rate as a soldier who has lost his hometown.     !He seems to be under the effect of some kind of "Geass". The appearance of red rings around the cornea of his eyes is a sign and seems exactly like the red rings that appears in Suzaku's eyes due to Lelouch's "command" given to him "To Live!"!

characters.name: Leila Malcal
characters.description: Leila is a former Britannian aristocrat and a military officer in the E.U. Army. She works under Gene Smilas and is Akito Hyuga's superior and the Commander of the W-0 Unit comprised of Japanese teenagers who recklessly plunge into a battlefield where the survival rate is extremely low. They fight for their freedom, so that they can have a country that they can return to that feels like “home”. Thus begins their fight against the adult world.    Leila Malcal is the daughter of a Britannian noble family that disagreed with the dated system of rule in the empire, which made them defect to the E.U. as exiles. She was originally an adjutant to Commander Anou in the W-0 Unit during a military operation, but Leila confronted him over the use of Japanese youngsters for suicide attacks and finally removed Anou from his position. From the recent trailers and previews, it's hinted that Leila may possibly have some form of Geass.

characters.name: Yukiya Naruse
characters.description: Yukiya Naruse is a boy who belongs to Ryou's group. He excels at collecting data and handling explosives.

characters.name: Shin Hyuuga Shaing
characters.description: A Britannian knight and the leader of the Knights of St. Michael.  He Possess the power of Geass, the exact "nature" of the power is still unknown but it seems a bit like Lelouch's power of Absolute Obedience.

characters.name: Klaus Warrick
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Sophie Randal
characters.description: A civilian brain science expert who was recruited from the private sector to work with the military group, "W-0." She also looks after her husband who has been in a coma following an experiment gone wrong involving brainwaves.  (Source: Code Geass Wikia)

characters.name: Anna Clement
characters.description: Anna Clement is a genius scientist and the developer of the "Alexander." She is a childhood friend of Leila Malkal.

characters.name: Haruichi Izumo
characters.description: Height: 178 cm  Haruichi Izumo is a wealthy young man and a prominent member of the Third Division of the Defense Force. Haruichi is also the scion of Izumo Tech.

characters.name: Kaijuu 10-gou
characters.description: Kaiju Juu-gou is an Identified Kaiju who attacked Tachikawa Base. It is created by [Kaijuu Kyuu-gou](https://anilist.co/character/259598/Kaijuu-Kyuugou) and is considered a "prototype". !It was then weaponized into Numbers Weapon 10, currently used by [Soushirou Hoshina](https://anilist.co/character/205579/Soushirou-Hoshina).!   !Its fight with Soushirou Hoshina managed to excite it so much that, even after being defeated, it still felt linked to Soushirou and wished to be turned into a weapon for him, to fight with him once more. Kaiju Juu-gou seems to be a rather independent individual, easily betraying its progenitor Kaijuu Kyuu-gou just to get closer to Soushirou.!   Kaiju Juu-gou is a extremely powerful Identified Kaiju, with a fortitude level of 8.3 when it first appeared, !and 9.0 after growing larger in size.!

characters.name: Bakko
characters.description: Bakko is a tiger owned by [Mina Ashiro](https://anilist.co/character/180693/Mina-Ashiro)  Bakko seems to be rather calm and totally obedient to his owner Mina.  Always present at Mina's side, even in battle, Bakko is inferred to be strong enough to take on and possibly eliminate kaiju.

characters.name: Soushirou Hoshina
characters.description: Height: 171 cm  Soushirou is a Vice-Commander of the Defense Force's Third Division. Despite his laid back nature, he is shown to be very powerful, specializing with bladed weapons.  Soushirou comes from a family of Kaijuu slayers dating back to the Muromachi Period.

characters.name: Kaijuu Kyuu-gou
characters.description: The main antagonist in the manga Kaiju No. 8. Kaiju No. 9 is a humanoid numbered Daikaiju who goes around reviving the kaiju killed by the Defense Force. He previously infiltrated Professional Kaiju Cleaning Company Monster Sweeper.  ! In his fused form with an Ant-type kaiju, No. 9 has the lower part of his body replaced by an Ant kaiju which he controls and uses to move around. In this form, No. 9 lacks forearms and hands. ! ! After fusing with Kaiju No. 2, No. 9 is now much larger than before, keeping his darker skin tone, with a long tail, three sets of eyes, and only protuberance on his head instead of two. !

characters.name: Aoi Kaguragi
characters.description: Height: 183 cm  Aoi Kaguragi is a young member of the Third Division of the Defense Force.  !After the destruction of Tachikawa Base, he was transferred to the Second Division.!  !Aoi was a rising star on Japan Ground Self-Defense Force, but turned down his future in the JGSDF to apply to the Defense Force.!

characters.name: Akari Minase
characters.description: Height: 153 cm  Akari Minase is a Defense Force officer of the Third Division.

characters.name: Kikoru Shinomiya
characters.description: Height: 157 cm  She is the young daughter of Defense Force Director General [Isao Shinomiya](https://anilist.co/character/257340) and a member of the Third Division. After Tachikawa Base was destroyed, Kikoru was transferred to the First Division.

characters.name: Kafka Hibino
characters.description: Height: 181 cm  Kafka Hibino, also known as Monster #8, is a Defense Force member and a former worker for the Professional Kaiju Cleaning Company "Monster Sweeper Inc.". Kafka's personality is a bit childish and funny, as well as a very determined and dedicated person who loves his comrades dearly.  After a kaijuu managed to enter his body, he obtained the ability to turn himself into a humanoid kaijuu.

characters.name: Mina Ashiro
characters.description: Mina is a very talented member of the Defense Force and an extremely talented marksman. She is the captain of the Defense Force's Third Division. When she was a child, she and [Kafka](https://anilist.co/character/180692/Kafka-Hibino) met each other after a Kaiju attack, swearing that they will both join the Defense Force and fight Kaiju alongside each other.

characters.name: Reno Ichikawa
characters.description: He briefly worked at Monster Sweeper Inc, where he met and befriended [Kafka Hibino](https://anilist.co/character/180692/Hibino-Kafka). After witnessing Kafka's transformation, Reno helped him enter the Defense Force and joined with him. !He was a member of the Third Division and after destruction of Tachikawa Base he was transferred to the Fourth Division.!

characters.name: Iharu Furuhashi
characters.description: Height: 177 cm  Iharu Furuhashi is a young officer of the Third Division of the Defense Force.  !After the destruction of Tachikawa Base, he was transferred to the Fourth Division.!  !Back when Iharu was still in middle school, he was saved from a kaiju by [Mina Ashiro](https://anilist.co/character/180693/Mina-Ashiro). This event would later inspire him to become a Defense Force member.!

characters.name: Konomi Okonogi
characters.description: Height: 149 cm Occupation: Third Division Operations Leader  Konomi is a determined and professional person. She doesn't seem to approve of [Soushirou Hoshina](https://anilist.co/character/205579/Soushirou-Hoshina)'s unprofessional remarks and blurts of laughter, caring deeply for him and for everyone else when they are in danger. In return, she's held in high regard by Soushirou.  While working, Konomi displays a professional and serious behavior, quickly getting a grasp of the current situation to offer support to her comrades. She also displayed remarkable levels of intuition and analytical skills.

characters.name: Hiroto Mori
characters.description: Hiroto Mori is a man working at Professional Kaiju Cleanup Company Monster Sweeper Inc.

characters.name: Astraia Tor Deikun
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Crowley Hamon
characters.description: The elegant and attractive Crowley Hamon serves as an aide to [Ramba Ral](https://anilist.co/character/16282/Ral-Ramba). Crowley is also Ramba Ral's lover and he affectionately refers to her as "Lady Hamon".   Crowley Hamon mainly stays on the bridge of the Gallop and helps to coordinate Ramba Ral's attacks while he was out fighting.

characters.name: Sasro Zabi
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Zeon Zum Deikun
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Jimba Ral
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Garma Zabi
characters.description: Garma Zabi is the youngest son of [Degwin Sodo Zabi](https://anilist.co/character/17498/Zabi-Degwin-Sodo), commander of Zeon forces in North America, and academy classmate and friend of [Char Aznable](https://anilist.co/character/1336/Aznable-Char).   Garma first appears after Char forces the Federation ship White Base off course during reentry into Earth's atmosphere and landed the heart of Zeon-controlled territory. Eager to prove himself to his older sister [Kycilia](https://anilist.co/character/35020/Zabi-Kycilia), Garma pursues White Base with the full support of Char, unaware of Char's treachery.

characters.name: Dozle Zabi
characters.description: Dozle Zabi is the second oldest son of Degwin Sodo Zabi and the Principality of Zeon's Space Attack Force Commander. His job during the war was to move fleets to and from various points in space to help the Zeon secure victory during the One Year War. Dozle is revered by his troops in the Space Attack Force for personally leading them in battle. Dozle pilots the mobile suit MA-08 Big Zam. !Dozle in his last moments exits the cockpit of the Big Zam and fires a machinegun at the Gundam, causing Amuro to temporarily be stricken with fear and doubt. He was caught in the subsequent explosion of the Big Zam and killed. His death marked the beginning of the end for Zeon forces in space.!

characters.name: Gihren Zabi
characters.description: One of the heads of the Principality of Zeon, Gihren is the oldest son of Degwin Sodo Zabi. Giren was gifted with a high IQ (240) and ingenious oratory abilities. He and his sister Kycilia were constantly at odds with each other as both had similar political goals but different methods. Although Gihren was successful in reducing his father's role to that of a figurehead ruler, he must still endure Degwin's criticisms and scorn.

characters.name: Gou Matsuoka
characters.description: [Rin Matsuoka](https://anilist.co/character/83019/Matsuoka-Rin)’s little sister. She's [Hazuki](https://anilist.co/character/83021/Hazuki-Nagisa)'s classmate and 1st-year in Iwatobi high school. She has a refreshing personality in school but is always worried about her brother, Rin.

characters.name: Ikuya Kirishima
characters.description: Height: 143 cm; 173 cm  Attended Iwatobi Junior High School with [Haru](https://anilist.co/character/83023/Haruka-Nanase) and [Makoto](https://anilist.co/character/83027/Makoto-Tachibana), was in the same class as [Asahi](https://anilist.co/character/127135/Asahi-Shiina), [Kisumi](https://anilist.co/character/88489/Kisumi--Shigino) and Haru. Was in the swimming club with Haru, Makoto and Asahi. [Natsuya's](https://anilist.co/character/121623/Natsuya-Kirishima) little brother. Left to America with him during junior high school days. He is an excellent swimmer, but has health issues due to his perfectionism and over-training. Swims breaststroke and individual medley.  !Ikuya's health is fragile, and he has some fear of water due to the fact that he nearly drowns several times. Yet, being a determined athlete and not wishing to disappoint his brother, he pushes himself endlessly, often suffering from oxygen deprivation from over-training in the pool. This drive is due to his belief that swimming and competition are to be mastered, as indicated by the anime's depiction of water being an "enemy" that binds him. In this way, he is shown to be both similar to and different from Haru - both genius swimmers with radically different approaches to their sport.!

characters.name: Sousuke Yamazaki
characters.description: He is the butterfly and freestyle swimmer on Samezuka Academy's swim team and a 3rd year high school student at Samezuka Academy. Sosuke is a close elementary school friend of Rin Matsuoka, and the person who understands him the most.

characters.name: Gorou Sasabe
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Seijuurou Mikoshiba
characters.description: The captain of the swim team at Sametsuka Academy.

characters.name: Aiichirou Nitori
characters.description: A member of the swim team at Samezuka Academy. He is a first year and [Rin Matsuoka](https://anilist.co/character/83019/Matsuoka-Rin)'s roommate.

characters.name: Momotarou Mikoshiba
characters.description: Seijuurou's younger brother. He's a first-year student at Samezuka Academy and specializes in swimming the backstroke.

characters.name: Rin Matsuoka
characters.description: Height: 177 cm (5'10"); 179 cm (5'10") Swim Style: Butterfly (specialty), breaststroke, individual medley  The rival swimmer from Sametsuka Academy.  Rin Matsuoka is [Haruka](https://anilist.co/character/83023/Nanase-Haruka)'s rival who is also in 11th grade. He had gone abroad to study swimming, but his personality changed immensely by the time he had returned to Japan and for this reason he often perplexes his former teammates.  Rin goes to all-boys school.

characters.name: Kisumi  Shigino
characters.description: Kisumi Shigino was the first-year junior high student who debuted in the second volume of the light novel High☆Speed! written by [Kouji Ouji](https://anilist.co/staff/186223/).   Kisumi was the part of the basketball club back at Iwatobi Junior High School. He is said to be a refreshing boy and was very popular among females.  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Nagisa Hazuki
characters.description: Height: 165 cm (5'5"); 167 cm (5'6") Swim Style: Breastroke (Specialty)  Breaststroke swimmer of the Iwatobi High School swimming team. [Haruka](https://anilist.co/character/83023/Nanase-Haruka)'s kouhai and a first year. He is a straight-forward person and his actions are faster than his words. He admires Haruka's swimming; it's the reason for him to start swimming. He enters Iwatobi High School because Haruka is there.

characters.name: Haruka Nanase
characters.description: Height: 175 cm (5'9"); 177 cm (5'10") Swim Style: Freestyle  Freestyle swimmer (crawl) of the Iwatobi High School swimming team. Haruka Nanase is an 11th grader who loves to swim. His strong and quiet swimming style fascinates many, and he holds a strong fixation on freestyle swimming.  His best friends include [Makoto Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/83027/Tachibana-Makoto) & [Nagisa Hazuki](https://anilist.co/character/83021/Hazuki-Nagisa) from Grade School, then he later befriends [Rei Ryuugazaki](https://anilist.co/character/83025/Ryuugazaki-Rei). He used to be best friends with [Rin Matsuoka](https://anilist.co/character/83019/Matsuoka-Rin), but now Rin has become Haruka's rival. Haruka has created the Iwatobi High School Swimming Club along with his other friends to take down Rin.

characters.name: Rei Ryuugazaki
characters.description: Height: 177 cm (5'10") Swimming style: Butterfly stroke  A freshman who joins the Iwatobi High School swim team.  Rei Ryuugazaki is a classmate of [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/83021/Hazuki-Nagisa)'s in 10th grade. He was originally a member of the track team, but decided to join the swimming club instead. A handsome, intelligent young man who often gets manipulated by [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/83019/Matsuoka-Rin) for some reason.  (Source: ANN)

characters.name: Makoto Tachibana
characters.description: Height: 183 cm (6'0")    Backstroke swimmer of the Iwatobi High School swimming team.  Makoto Tachibana is [Haruka](https://anilist.co/character/83023/Nanase-Haruka)'s inseparable best friend since 11th grade. He understands Haruka's good points, and is often forced to speak as his spokesman. He is very kind and considerate, but is also very easily scared and weak-hearted.

characters.name: Natsuya Kirishima
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Miho Amakata
characters.description: [Haruka Nanase](https://anilist.co/character/83023/Nanase-Haruka) and [Makoto Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/83027/Tachibana-Makoto)'s homeroom teacher and classic literature teacher. She seems to have been an office lady in Tokyo in the past, but no one knows the details. She utters the words of great figures from ages past. Due to her personality, when she asks something of someone, they can't refuse.

characters.name: Oscar Hamel
characters.description: The vice captain of the Guard Troops in Castle Weisswolf, which is in the "W-0" base.  (Source: Code Geass Wikia)

characters.name: Ferirri Baltrow
characters.description: One of Sophie Randall's subordinates and co-workers from the Private Sector.  (Source: Code Geass Wikia)

characters.name: Jean Lowe
characters.description: A member of Shin's staff.

characters.name: Ashley Ashra
characters.description: Ashley uses a uniquely customised red Gloucester (knightmare). The Gloucesters used by the knights seem to prefer swords over lances. Ashley loves wars and is a very skilled knightmare pilot.

characters.name: Michele Manfredi
characters.description: Manfredi was one of the few Britannians that did not discriminate against non-Britannians; in fact, he considered Shin Hyuga Shing, an Eleven adopted by a Britannian family, as close to him as any brother, and apparently took an interest in those with oriental backgrounds. As his subordinates are known for their boldness as knights, it is possible that Manfredi was also a bold person.  He was a member of the Knights of the Round in the past, likely succeeding !Marianne vi Britannia! as the Knight of Two. Manfredi commissioned the construction of his personal Knightmare Frame, the Sagramore, shortly before he left the Rounds, as its name was later changed to Vercingetorix while still in development when he left them out of his loyalty to Augusta Henry Velaines , Archduke of Verance, and transfered to Euro Britannia to become the head of the Knights of St. Michael.  (Source: Code Geass Wikia)

characters.name: Akari Akaza
characters.description: Akari is a polite red-haired girl who is supposedly the main protagonist of the series. However, due to her rather small presence and plain personality, she is often forgotten about or pushed into the background. S  he is often thought of as having the ability to fire her hair dumplings and turn invisible whilst shouting "Akkarin!". [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/35871) and [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/35874) are her childhood friends, while [Chinatsu](https://anilist.co/character/35875), [Sakurako](https://anilist.co/character/35878) and [Himawari](https://anilist.co/character/35879) are her classmates.

characters.name: Yui Funami
characters.description: A cool-headed girl who often acts as the voice of reason, usually when it comes to keeping [Kyouko](https://anilist.co/character/35871) in check. She is a reliable friend and usually lives alone in an apartment complex, but actually feels lonely without anyone else around. Although generally quiet, she will sometimes burst into laughter upon hearing [Ayano](https://anilist.co/character/35876)'s puns. She likes playing video games.

characters.name: Chinatsu Yoshikawa
characters.description: Akari's pink haired classmate who originally wanted to join the Tea Ceremony Club, but ended up joining the Amusement Club as the Tea Ceremony Club was already abolished. She is often chased after by Kyōko due to her resemblance to Mirakurun, though she herself has a passionate crush on Yui. She generally acts cute, especially in the presence of Yui, but she occasionally shows dark thoughts and a terrifying lack of artistic skills.

characters.name: Ayano Sugiura
characters.description: Sugiura Ayano is the vice president of the student council. Gallant and filled with a powerful sense of justice, she happens to be popular with other female students. She's always thinking about Kyouko... or, to put it more bluntly, she's a pure-hearted maiden who is falling in love.

characters.name: Nadeshiko Oomuro
characters.description: Height: 165 cm  Sakurako's older sister. She's always quiet and has a cool demeanor.   !Nadeshiko is dating a girl, whose identity is currently unknown; it is one of the main mysteries of the Ohmuro-ke manga. It is hinted that the girlfriend might be one of her three classmates –with whom she is on good terms with– after a phone call that revealed that the two girls visit the same school.!

characters.name: Sakurako Oomuro
characters.description: Height: 153 cm  She has a tsundere type personality and aims to be the next student council vice president. She and Himawari are childhood friends.

characters.name: Chitose Ikeda
characters.description: Height: 155cm  Ikeda Chitose is a member of the student council. She is a helpful character whose extreme yuri fantasies make the yuri quotient of the story rise dramatically. While fantasizing, she removes her glasses to block her vision so she can concentrate, causing intense nose bleeds. She is really fond of the Ayano x Kyouko pairing. She speaks in soft Kansai dialect and likes tsukemono (pickled things).

characters.name: Himawari Furutani
characters.description: Height: 158 cm  A candidate for the student council vice-president. She has blue hair and large breasts. She always speaks in feminine and polite speech.

characters.name: Hanako Oomuro
characters.description: Height: 127 cm  Sakurako's younger sister who is an elementary school student.

characters.name: Mari Funami
characters.description: The daughter of one of Yui's relatives who often visits Yui. She is a fan of Mirakurun, though does not take kindly to Chinatsu after learning her personality doesn't match her image. Her favorite food is sea urchin and she is very smart for her age.

characters.name: Kaede Furutani
characters.description: [Himawari](https://anilist.co/character/35879/Himawari-Furutani)'s sister.

characters.name: Nana Nishigaki
characters.description: Nana Nishigaki is a science teacher who loves to invent things and explosions. She has a close relationship with [Rise Matsumoto](https://anilist.co/character/45531/Matsumoto-Rise) and is the only one who can understand her.

characters.name: Rise Matsumoto
characters.description: The current student council president who has very little presence and often speaks in a whispery quiet voice that only a few people such as [Nana](https://anilist.co/character/45529/Nishigaki-Nana) can understand.

characters.name: Akane Akaza
characters.description: Akari's big sister. Akane has a huge obsession with her little sister, but Akari herself knows nothing about that. She collects anything related to Akari, in a result leaving Kyouko extremely shocked when she stumbled across Akane's room.

characters.name: Kyouko Toshinou
characters.description: Toshinou Kyouko is the founder of the amusement club. Goes so wild that no one can keep up with her, but it's not as if anyone even tries in the first place, so it's ultimately no big deal. She is actually an otaku who creates her own doujinshi of Mirakurun, an anime character in Yuru Yuri. Her favorite ice cream is rum raisin.

characters.name: Yuuta Okkotsu
characters.description: Species: Human Occupation: Sorcerer, Student Affiliation: Jujutsu High Grade: Special Grade Sorcerer  The main protagonist of Jujutsu Kaisen prequel series [Tokyo Metropolitan Curse Technical School](https://anilist.co/manga/105469/Tokyo-Toritsu-Jujutsu-Kodo-Senmon-Gakko). He was initially a Special Grade Cursed Victim haunted by his late childhood friend, [Rika Orimoto](https://anilist.co/character/208533/Orimoto-Rika). [Satoru Gojou](https://anilist.co/character/127691/Satoru-Gojou) mentored Yuuta and enrolled him at Tokyo Jujutsu High.

characters.name: Sukuna
characters.description: Species: Human, Reincarnated Sorcerer  According to the legend, Sukuna was a demon with four arms and two faces who lived in the golden era of sorcery 1000 years ago. Sorcerers of the era gave their all to defeat him, but to no avail. Without ever being defeated, his body was split into 20 separate indestructible cursed objects, which allowed him to live on and traverse the ages to come. In 2018, [Yuuji Itadori](https://anilist.co/character/127212/Itadori-Yuuji) consumed one of the aforementioned cursed objects, and Sukuna was reincarnated.   !In reality, Sukuna was not a demon, but rather a deformed human sorcerer. His body was able to be split up into 20 cursed objects because he received assistance from [Kenjaku](https://anilist.co/character/289584).!  Sukuna is hedonistic and has no regard for the suffering of others, believing that suffering is natural for the weak. He is selfish, and always wants to stay in control of the situation without caring about the consequences.

characters.name: Takuma Ino
characters.description: Species: Human Occupation: Sorcerer Affiliation: Jujutsu High Grade: Grade 2 Sorcerer  Takuma Ino is a grade 2 jujutsu sorcerer and a close associate of Kento Nanami who operates out of Tokyo Jujutsu High.  Takuma Ino is a genuine and cheerful person with a more positive outlook on things than most jujutsu sorcerers. He doesn't believe he's the smartest person around and has a lot of respect for Nanami. Whenever Ino finds himself in a tough situation, he asks himself what would Nanami do.

characters.name: Maki Zenin
characters.description: Height: 170 cm (5'7")  Maki Zenin is the older twin sister of [Mai Zenin](https://anilist.co/character/134168/Mai-Zenin). Maki is a grade 4 sorcerer and a second-year at Tokyo Metropolitan Jujutsu Technical High School. She is from the main branch of the Zenin clan, one of the "Prominent Three Families" of the Jujutsu world.  She left the Zenin family in order to prove herself capable of being a Sorcerer after being deemed uncapable, since she lacks Cursed Energy.  !Because Mai and Maki are monozygotic twins, their strength is considerably limited to one another. Monozygotic twins are considered as a single individual in the Jujutsu world and are a sign of bad omen.!  !After the death of her twin sister Mai, Maki has lost all of her cursed energy and gained a Heavenly Restriction. This causes her skills and human capabilities to be on par with [Toji Fushiguro's](https://anilist.co/character/162722/Touji-Fushiguro).!

characters.name: Toge Inumaki
characters.description: Species: Human Occupation: Sorcerer, Student Affiliation: Jujutsu High Grade: Grade 2 Sorcerer Cursed Technique: Cursed Speech  He is a second-year at Tokyo Metropolitan Jujutsu Technical High School. Due to his curse ability, he is only willing to communicate with ingredients used to make rice balls.

characters.name: Chousou
characters.description: Chousou is half human and half cursed spirit and the first of the Death Painting Wombs with a Special Grade rank. He and his two brothers, [Kechizu](https://anilist.co/character/210832/Kechizu) and [Eso](https://anilist.co/character/210831/Esou) are Cursed Womb: Death Paintings who have sided with [Mahito](https://anilist.co/character/133702/Mahito)'s group.  Chousou bears strong attachments to his brothers and is very overprotective of them. !However, after receiving a vision during his battle with Itadori, Chousou was eventually convinced that Sukuna's vessel was actually one of his younger brothers. He then became furious at Mahito and the other cursed spirits for manipulating him into harming Itadori.!  !Chousou is one of nine death painting wombs that came from a woman capable of giving birth to cursed spirit children. At some point, Chousou and his brothers were stored at the Jujutsu High, along with some of Sukuna's fingers.  As stated by Chousou himself, Noritoshi Kamo, the man who experimented on his mother is in fact his third "parent" due to him having mixed in his own blood into Chousou when his mother was pregnant with him. Although seemingly not remembering much about his own past, it is evident that Chousou himself remembers Noritoshi and holds a grudge against him for toying with his mother and siblings' lives.!

characters.name: Aoi Toudou
characters.description: Species: Human Height: 190 cm Occupation: Sorcerer, Student Affiliation: Kyoto Jujutsu Technical High School Grade: Grade 1 Sorcerer  Toudou is a third-year student at Kyoto Jujutsu Technical High School who possesses inhuman physical strength, durability, and speed.   !He is able to use a technique called Boogie Woogie, in which he can switch the position of two things that posses a certain amount of curse energy within his range.!

characters.name: Rin Itoshiki
characters.description: Nozomu's younger sister, a seventeen-year-old ikebana master. When her name is written horizontally it resembles zetsurin ("unequaled"), which describes her exceptional talent in various skills; however, calling her zetsurin evokes her fury, as the word is often used as slang for sexual prowess.  She has revealed her willingness to marry out of the Itoshiki family in the hope of abandoning her unwanted name. Rin eventually transfers to Nozomu's school and becomes a student in his class, after which she frequently faces the readers/audience with her backside (in a parody Shin-chan, who is also voiced by Akiko Yajima). She also happens to own a chocolate factory.

characters.name: Nozomu Itoshiki
characters.description: A high school teacher and the youngest son of the Itoshiki family. He always wears a hakama and kimono abroad, preferring flippant casual western clothing in his hometown. When his name is written horizontally it resembles zetsubou ("beyond hope" or "despair"), befitting his extremely negative, paranoid and pessimistic attitude.  He often shouts "I'm in despair!" and attempts suicide several times, though rarely with serious intent. Most of the main girls seem to have feelings for him, but only because they misunderstand what he said to each of them (during the episodes introducing them).   His negative personality started blossoming when he was in his first year of high school when he "accidentally" joined a "Negative Club". He is based upon the main character from Dazai Osamu's No Longer Human, which is both Nozomu's and the author's favorite novel.

characters.name: Kafuka Fuura
characters.description: A somewhat strange and exceedingly optimistic student who always sees everything in the single most positive light possible: the polar opposite of Nozomu, who sees only the dark side of things and is constantly in despair. She often has bizarre, childishly optimistic explanations for grim situations, calling suicide by hanging "becoming taller" and the act of stalking "deep love." She enjoys giving whimsical nicknames to people (much to their annoyance), and has a strange obsession with aliens. Once she turned in a briefcase full of money to the police.    !Her cheerfulness apparently conceals a traumatic past. Her father tried to hang himself all the time, as did her mom once. At one point her mother was possessed by demons. In addition, her recent actions; watching the school burn down with a satisfied grin, and the more harmless act of disguising herself as a college girl and making food for her teacher and his nephew hint at a much darker personality. Another hint is the fact that one or more of the other characters are mortally terrified of her; for example, when Kafuka teaches Meru about communication through eye contact, Meru can sense only bloodlust in her eyes. Another episode hinted that she was slitting her wrists as it is shown that her wrists were wrapped in bandages.!    Kafuka Fuura is a pen name, taken from the name of author Franz Kafka, and is quite at odds with her sunny attitude. Her real name is has not been officially revealed; however,  !she was referred to as "An-chan" in a flashback, and the surname "Akagi" appears in the attendance book, leading fans to speculate that her real name is An Akagi. This would parallel Nozomu's comment in the first chapter about her personality resembling Anne of Green Gables (赤毛のアン, Akage no An).!

characters.name: Harumi Fujiyoshi
characters.description: A fan of BL and cat ears, and the classroom's resident illustrator. She has an innate coupling instinct, imagining slash pairings between all sorts of (male) characters, her favorite couple being Pine × Napple; she has also imagined pairings between Nozomu and his friend with rather explicit content. Her tastes are considered unusual, even abnormal, which often puts her at odds with Chiri   She possesses amazing athletic abilities, causing her to be recruited into various athletic clubs. Her three older brothers are all involved in the anime industry. Apparently, according to her mom, Harumi was an accidental child.  Her name is a combination of fujoshi (BL fangirl, sometimes romanized as fujyoshi) and Harumi, the previous site of Comiket before it moved to Tokyo Big Sight.

characters.name: Matoi Tsunetsuki
characters.description: A girl with short, straight-fringed hair who stalks whoever she falls in love with. She is also known for changing her manner of dress to partner those of her current love interest. She falls in love with Nozomu after misinterpreting one of his statements as a confession of love, and follows him wherever he goes, much to his dismay; even dressing up in a kimono similar to Nozomu and performing many of the duties of a Japanese wife (walking three steps behind, always by his side, etc). She has admitted to having read through Nozomu's mail and disposing of them before he gets a chance to read them. Her name is a pun on tsune tsukimatoi, which means "always dangling after".

characters.name: Meru Otonashi
characters.description: A very shy girl who does not talk and only communicates via text messaging on her cell phone; she is notably and viciously abusive in her e-mails. Her family name, Otonashi, means "soundless", and her given name derives from the loan word "mail". Her e-mail address is "hazukashigariyasan", which means "full of shyness". She is called "MeruMeru" by her father  Aside from a few weak sounds and squeaks, she is essentially mute, and any attempt to speak will cause her to uncontrollably sputter in a horrific language. Her family also seems ridiculously rich, as her father is able to set up an audition for people to try and dub her voice in real time. In the anime, her voice actress changes every episode and is chosen at random, and is credited with, at most, a short sequence of nonsense characters  with the exception of episode six of Zoku, where she is voiced by Chiwa Saito.

characters.name: Kagerou Usui
characters.description: The actual class president of 2-He, who is ignored to the point of vanishing into thin air; only when his baldness is exposed does he become visible to others. In the anime, he has a major crush on Abiru, but leers after most female students (especially Kaere), who naturally do not notice he is there.  His name is a pun on the phrase kage ga usui ("overshadowed"), referring to his lack of presence. (The usui also refers to his thinning hairline.)

characters.name: Chiri Kitsu
characters.description: A student who demands all things in her life to be precise, equal, and conforming. This is most notable in her hairstyle​, which was originally curly and is parted in the center. She often tries to set things straight and is usually extremely cruel and violent in her ways. She is also very knowledgeable in areas that revolve around violent international historical events. She hides numerous razors and knives within her bra, but her favorite weapon of choice is a spade. The kanji of her first name can be joined together to form the first character of "to bury".  Despite being the most combative against Nozomu and his antics as well as usually being the most level headed of the class, she often demands him to marry her after they accidentally took a nap together in the same bed. Although she is not the class representative, she is often called so because of her exacting behavior. She is revealed to have an older sister. Her name derives from the Japanese word kicchiri (precisely). She occasionally displays psychic abilities via a third eye; her name contains two of the kanji in the word "clairvoyance".

characters.name: Tarou Sekiutsu
characters.description: An illegal immigrant of unknown nationality. She is nicknamed "Mataro" by Kafuka, although she refers to herself (as do most others) as simply "Maria". She purchased the birth certificate of a male student and is attending school under his name.  She is fascinated by "Japan's abundance" and hoards food and refuse she finds on the ground or in garbage cans. While Maria frequently displays wild behavior and an unusual abhorrence to panties and shoes, her impoverished appearance and illegal status, coupled with a bright smile, often encourage people to give her things.  The name "Sekiutsu Tarō" derives from seki-uttarō, which means "You sold your own register, didn't you?" or "I'll sell you my register". Because of their optimistic personalities, Kafuka and Maria get along quite well. Although Maria is legally a boy (since she bought the birth certificate of a male student), she is actually a girl.

characters.name: Jinroku
characters.description: School teacher, Nozomu's colleague. He is generally gentle, but has a tattoo at his back, suggesting he has a past with the yakuza. He is a fan of Nightmare.

characters.name: Kuniya Kino
characters.description: Kuniya is described in episode 10 of the second season as "Library commitee member, hates losing. Supposed to appear as a rival character to Jun Kudō, but his strange clothes and interest in Ai Kaga are now his most notable traits." His fashion sense is terrible; a scene in the manga showed strange underwear hanging from his balcony. His name comes from the Books Kinokuniya chain.

characters.name: Kaere Kimura
characters.description: A returnee to Japan suffering from dissociative identity disorder. One is an ultimately Japanese woman named Kaede, a very gentle personality well-versed in Japanese culture. The other is a foreigner named Kaere who is disgusted by Japanese culture and touts the bizarre ways of the country she is from, which is America. Kaere is easily offended and constantly threatens to sue everyone. She unfortunately adopts the latter personality more often.  Her given name derives from Japanese kaere, the imperative form of the verb kaeru (to return, to go back), and also from Kaela Kimura, a Japanese idol. She provides many panty shots, often with strange images on her panties. It is interesting to note that she possessed a third personality, a balance between the two, until she came to this class, and the students triggered a psychotic breakdown.

characters.name: Kiri Komori
characters.description: Height: 165 cm  A beautiful, fair-skinned girl whose looks are hidden behind her long hair and the blanket she wears most of the time. She is a hikikomori, but [Kafuka](https://anilist.co/character/3170/Fuura-Kafuka) believes her to be a zashiki-warashi. [Nozomu](https://anilist.co/character/3169/Itoshiki-Nozomu) and Kafuka unintentionally frighten her out of her home during an attempt to persuade her to resume attending her classes, and she now takes up permanent residence in school. She also falls for Nozumu when he was judging her as a good double suicide partner. She spends most of her time in an unused room, but turns up every now and then in odd places such as school lockers or toilet cubicles. Her name is derived from komorikiri, which means "always stays indoors".

characters.name: Manami Ookusa
characters.description: A married high-schooler who works multiple jobs to pay off her husband's debts. Her name derives from okusama-nami (奥様な身, "a married person").    It is revealed in episode 5 of Zan that her husband is unfaithful and she's aware of it.

characters.name: Ikkyu
characters.description: The self-proclaimed "old friend" of Nozomu Itoshiki, who, like Nozomu, likes old things. It is later found out that they weren't old friends but rather "one day friends" in elementary school. His name is a reference to the anime series Ikkyū-san. He attempted to marry Rin, thus gaining an "old name" and becoming a member of an "old family", but Kafuka thwarted him in his advances.

characters.name: Margarete Wien
characters.description: Height: 161cm  Margarete Wien is a first-year student at Yuigaoka Girls' High School and a third-generation member of Liella! and KALEIDOSCORE. Her image color is elegant purple.  Wien is a cold-blooded, passionate and stoic girl, and doesn't seem to express much emotion, but can act recklessly or overdramatically when fussy. She's strongly confident in her abilities and talents, always delivering powerful performances, and never wanting to be compared to other idols, especially Kanon. She takes her aspirations very seriously, and isn't afraid to affront others she deems lower than her level.

characters.name: Keke Tang
characters.description: Height: 159 cm Hobby: Cosplay, costume making Special Skill: Remaking used clothing  Keke Tang is a main character in Love Live! Superstar!!. She is currently a third year student at Yuigaoka Girls' High School. She is the founder and a first-generation member of Liella! and a member of the sub-unit KALEIDOSCORE. Her image color is pastel blue.  A fun-loving and energetic optimist, Keke holds that the most important things in life are passion and a smiling face. To her, anything is possible if one never gives up, such as being a school idol.

characters.name: Sumire  Heanna
characters.description: Height: 161 cm Special Skill: Selfies  Sumire Heanna is a main character in Love Live! Superstar!!. She is currently a third year student at Yuigaoka Girls' High School. She is a first-generation member of Liella! and a member of the sub-unit CatChu!. Her image color is melon green.  Being in the entertainment world for so long, Sumire believes her experience and knowledge of its workings is second to none. Somewhat of a prima donna, Sumire assumes that most people already know her name. Somehow attached to the idea of her own stardom, Sumire dreams of becoming a famous school idol not just in Japan, but "across the galaxy."

characters.name: Kanon Shibuya
characters.description: Height: 159 cm Hobby: Collecting owl goods and listening to songs Special Skill: Latte art  Kanon Shibuya is the primary protagonist in Love Live! Superstar!!. She is currently a third year student at Yuigaoka Girls' High School. She is a first-generation member and the leader of Liella!, as well as a member of the sub-unit CatChu!. Her image color is marigold.  Kanon is seen as being somewhat shy and flustered, admitting that she is not good at communicating in front of others. However, while walking in town Kanon would often listen to music on her headphones, and would usually find herself singing the words to a song. Although she yearns to sing in front of people, Kanon is particularly nervous about doing so. Despite seeing herself as being very ordinary - having no particular talents or aspirations for her life - Kanon wishes to cheer people up through her favorite songs.  Kanon, despite being more shy than previous protagonists, has nonetheless a natural charisma and people orientation. She is very kind-hearted, friendly, cheerful, passionate and supportive.

characters.name: Chisato Arashi
characters.description: Height: 155 cm Hobby: Moving, dancing Special Skill: To get along with a child you meet for the first time  Chisato Arashi is a main character in Love Live! Superstar!!. She is currently a third year student at Yuigaoka Girls' High School. She is a first-generation member of Liella! and a member of the sub-unit 5yncri5e!. Her image color is peach pink.  Chisato is very kind, sweet, loyal and supportive towards [Kanon](https://anilist.co/character/170243/Shibuya-Kanon) - and later all the other group members. Although she describes herself as having a friendly and congenial personality, Chisato admits that others would find her "scary" whenever she gets angry - a thought that rarely crosses her mind. She loves to converse with her friends and go shopping together. Chisato is also very well-attuned to the latest news and rumors traveling within her school, seemingly to the extent that she might one day become Yuigaoka's official gossip girl.

characters.name: Ren Hazuki
characters.description: Height: 163 cm  Ren Hazuki is a main character in Love Live! Superstar!!. She is currently a third year student at Yuigaoka Girls' High School. She is a first-generation member of Liella! and a member of the sub-unit KALEIDOSCORE. Her image color is sapphire blue.  Ren is polite and speaks with a very formal tone, although she is not quite used to handling casual conversations. Having been told as a child to refrain from spending too much time online, she also has difficulty communicating on camera. But considering that Ren is a fairly disciplined individual who manages her time well, she could easily dispense with any form of small talk. Ren believes that she mainly takes after her own mother, given her own unwavering commitment towards making Yuigaoka the number one school in her city.  While she was a bit too serious at first, Ren mellows out since joining Liella! and shows her true personality; she's certainly responsible and diligent, but also friendly, kind, and good-natured, also showing quite a playful streak. She also seems to have quite the naïve side to her, shown through her curiosity and innocence of video games and many other things. She's easily slightly embarrassed about these traits, her formal tone sometimes falling apart. Overall, she is still very responsible, reliant, resilient, and one for order, and is accepted by the members of Liella! and those who respect her.

characters.name: Natsumi Onitsuka
characters.description: **Height:** 152cm  Natsumi Onitsuka is a main character in Love Live! Superstar!!. She is currently a second year student at Yuigaoka Girls' High School. She is both a second-generation member of Liella! and a member of the sub-unit 5yncri5e!. Her image color is pink.  Natsumi is a cheerful, energetic yet mischievous, greedy and selfish girl who is fixated on earning money. She is always shown to be doing anything she can to earn it.

characters.name: Kinako Sakurakouji
characters.description: **Height:** 159cm  Kinako Sakurakoji is a main character in Love Live! Superstar!!. She is currently a second year student at Yuigaoka Girls' High School. She is both a second-generation member of Liella! and a member of the sub-unit 5yncri5e!. Her image color is yellow.  Kinako transferred to Yuigaoka in Tokyo from the boonies of Hokkaido. She thinks school idols are really pretty but thought it would be impossible to become one herself. But she decided to give it a go after seeing how dazzling Liella! was on stage.  Kinako isn't athletic, and her grades are average. She is very good at understanding animals and how they're feeling. She's very kind, sweet and cheerful, and always happy to offer her support to the group. Despite being sociable, she's also a little shy and awkward at times.

characters.name: Mei Yoneme
characters.description: **Height:** 155cm  Mei Yoneme is a main character in Love Live! Superstar!!. She is currently a second year student at Yuigaoka Girls' High School. She is both a second-generation member of Liella! and a member of the sub-unit CatChu!. Her image color is red.  When Mei was younger, she was told she had a scary look, and all of her friends were scared of her. Mei is very shy and doesn't like it when people say nasty things about her. She doesn't like being stared at. She also does not like being called "cute", since it makes her embarrassed.

characters.name: Shiki Wakana
characters.description: **Height:** 161 cm  Shiki Wakana is a main character in Love Live! Superstar!!. She is currently a second year student at Yuigaoka Girls' High School. She is both a second-generation member of Liella! and a member of the sub-unit 5yncri5e!. Her image color is mint green.  Shiki isn't very fond of loud places. Her favorite things are [Mei](https://anilist.co/character/272552/Yoneme-Mei), stag beetles and butterflies. She appears to have a calm demeanor and is quiet most of the time. She also does not smile much, but the reason why is yet to be determined. She is also very conscious of her surroundings, as she easily noticed Mei looking at her from the Science Club room while she is with the other Liella! members at the rooftop.

characters.name: Saya
characters.description: A maid working for the Hazuki household

characters.name: Kanon no Haha
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Rijichou
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Yae
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Aria Shibuya
characters.description: [Kanon's](https://anilist.co/character/170243) younger sister.

characters.name: Hitori no Fan 2-gou
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Yukito Orikasa
characters.description: Yukito Orikasa or mostly known by his stage name Yuki, is the cool and collected member of the duo, Re:vale! Yuki is always apologizing for Momo’s antics. He’s the tsukkomi, the straight man, of the pair, and follows through with pointing out the idiocy Momo currently has on display.  Surprisingly, Yuki is actually very easy to laugh or otherwise lose composure, usually as a result of the very actions of Momo’s he’s trying to correct. He takes great care after those in the industry who came after them (aka his kouhai), and is actually remarkably kind.

characters.name: Riku Nanase
characters.description: Height: 173 cm  Riku Nanase has a cute and energetic disposition that belies how frail his body actually is. Despite that, he works hard to do what he can do, and doesn’t want to be a burden to others. Due to living most of his early life in and out of hospitals, there’s a lot Riku doesn’t quite know about the world, and his naivety often shows itself because he wears his heart on his sleeve.

characters.name: Mitsuki Izumi
characters.description: Height: 165 cm  Mitsuki Izumi is a positive ray of energy for most of the other members of IDOLiSH7. He takes on the role of the older brother for many of the younger members as well as his own younger brother Iori Izumi.

characters.name: Sougo Osaka
characters.description: Height: 175 cm  Sougo Osaka is a very calm and soothing, if sometimes unsure, presence most of the time. He’s very reserved, though, and prioritizes being polite and following the order of things over what he himself may desire. However, he does have a switch, and if you press it Sougo very quickly turns into one of the most menacing members of IDOLiSH7.

characters.name: Nagi Rokuya
characters.description: Height: 180 cm  Nagi Rokuya remarkably good looks and high charisma combine to turn him into a bit of a flirting machine, he's often see flirting with women. His charisma is a double-edged sword, however, as his personality and looks combined made it so he didn’t have many friends growing up. As a result, he loves IDOLiSH7 more than anyone else. In times of strife, it’s usually Nagi’s very obvious love for his friends that manages to bring smiles back to their faces.

characters.name: Tenn Kujo
characters.description: **Height:** 173 cm  He has an outward appearance of a little devil kind of character, is a perfectionist and is strict when it comes to competency. He vowed to himself that whenever he is in public, 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, he will give his best for a perfect performance. Because of his high level of professionalism, even for those who knew him previously, it is easily misunderstand that he has a cold personality.

characters.name: Gaku Yaotome
characters.description: Height: 183 cm  Gaku Yaotome is rough-spoken and has a fairly intimidating aura about him, so there are a lot of rumors swirling around about how nasty the president of Yaotome Pro’s son must be. For his fans, he’s the sexy guy they want to embrace them the most.

characters.name: Ryuunosuke Tsunashi
characters.description: Height: 190 cm  Ryunosuke Tsunashi is actually a very shy and timid soul, who has a difficult time talking with women due to growing up with his brothers. There’s also a good argument for Ryuu’s naivete, if his comments to the woman at his father’s hotel are any indication. He’s very kind and understanding to those younger than him, acting like an older brother to just about everyone.

characters.name: Iori Izumi
characters.description: He's Mitsuki Izumi's younger brother who has a "cool" personality. His parents run a cake shop called “Fonte Chocolat”, and the interior is decorated cutely, which influences him to like cute things in the end.

characters.name: Tamaki Yotsuba
characters.description: Height: 183 cm

characters.name: Tsumugi Takanashi
characters.description: Tsumugi Takanashi is the manager of the male idol group IDOLiSH7. She is a very polite and kind girl. She works at the music agency Takanashi Productions which is owned by her father.

characters.name: Banri Oogami
characters.description: Banri is a staff member working at the music agency Takanashi Productions, he is a kind man who is very helpful to the agency.

characters.name: Kaoru Anesagi
characters.description: Manager for the idol group TRIGGER.

characters.name: Yamato Nikaidou
characters.description: Yamato Nikaido comes across as very lazy and easy-going, but he is very passionate about what he does and cares a lot about the other members of IDOLiSH7. He took up the position of “Leader” only because he was the oldest in the group, he actually considered pulling himself out of the audition for IDOLiSH7.

characters.name: Momose Sunohara
characters.description: Momose Sunohara or mostly known by his stage name Momo, is the energetic, cute member of the duo, Re:vale! Momo has a bit of a mischievous side and seems to drag Yuki into his schemes. He’s the boke, the idiot, of the pair, constantly making off the wall comments.  However, Momo is remarkably observant of his surroundings and of other people, and seems to go to great lengths to watch over others. In turn, he’s actually fairly bad about himself.

characters.name: Ryouga Hibiki
characters.description: Ryouga is Ranma Saotome's eternal rival and a friend to him, the only one he has outright stated to truly consider as such, arguably the tritagonist, and one of the most powerful fighters in the series. Ryouga's most notable characteristic is that, like his parents (and even his entire family), he has no sense of direction whatsoever. He is unable to go the right way, often sticking to the letter of any directions given to him, regardless of whether the path eventually turns. He has an inability to understand even the simplest of directions or draw any legible maps, once running the wrong way at the start of a three-legged race or getting lost in Shampoo's house for hours; looking for the exit. He cannot even follow someone pointing in the correct direction.   (Source: Ranma Wiki)

characters.name: Ukyo Kuonji
characters.description: Ten years ago, on a training trip in the country, Genma stole Ukyo's father's okonomiyaki yatai (food cart), leaving her behind and breaking the arrangement he and her father made. However, before this Ranma and Ukyo were friends, though Ranma never knew she was a girl. Shamed and ridiculed by her peers, Ukyo decided she wouldn't like boys, dressed and lived as one, and devoted herself to okonomiyaki-style martial arts. After a heated battle, Ranma discovers her true sex. Meanwhile, she discovers that he does not get along with his "uncute" fiancée, Akane. They reconcile, and she falls in love with him again. Ranma still treats her as only an old friend, and her plots to win him over are usually less violent than those of his other suitors. Although she lives to cook okonomiyaki and runs a restaurant, "Ucchan's," to that end, Ukyo would give it all up to marry Ranma.    [Wikipedia]

characters.name: Nodoka Saotome
characters.description: Nodoka is Ranma's loving mother. She hasn't seen him and Genma in over a decade though, when they left on their training trip. Stating that a doting mother would hinder Ranma's training, Genma made a contract with her to raise Ranma as "man amongst men", and if he failed, he and Ranma were to commit seppuku. However, because Ranma's curse makes him a woman half the time, they spent most of Nodoka's appearances hiding from her as Ranko Tendo and her pet, Mr. Panda. Nodoka's heart was constantly broken by knowing that she wanted nothing more than to see her son again. Eventually in the manga, she did meet Ranma and Genma and discovers their curses. However, she was more accepting than they expected. Mostly because she eventually began to suspect that Ranma and Ranko were, in fact, the same person.  (Wikipedia)

characters.name: Azusa Shiratori
characters.description: Azusa Shiratori is the female half of "The Golden Pair of Kolhotz High School". She is well known for her obsession for collecting things that she regards as being cute and then giving them names, usually with a French origin. "Azusa" means "catalpa tree" while "Shiratori" means "white bird".  Azusa is very unintelligent (a "half-wit" in the words of Kuno) and strange even by the standards of the series. Shiratori is a kleptomaniac and feels the need to take random objects and people regardless of ownership. If Azusa is denied, she will throw a childish tantrum and resort to violence, until she either has the object returned or is shouted at to stop.  It is worthy of note that the "level" of Azusa's kleptomania varies between the manga and anime continuities, with her being only shown to have in her possession one object at a time in the manga (the only possible exception being her having "Françoise" and "Charlotte" at the same time, although Akane was technically in possession of "Charlotte" at the time). In contrast, the anime shows Azusa as having multiple objects in her possession at the same time, each with it's own name (Azusa will also greet each object individually in the morning and evening) all of which reside in her home.

characters.name: Kodachi Kunou
characters.description: The captain of the gymnastics team of the St. Bacchus' School for Girls, who is referred to as "The Black Rose," likely due to her signature theatrical style of exiting a scene by leaving behind a swirling trail of black roses accompanied by high-octave laughter.  Kodachi is an expert in Martial Arts Rhythmic Gymnastics, making her skilled in acrobatics and the use of balls, clubs, hoops, ribbons, and ropes as weapons. She is very agile, and she is not averse to using unorthodox methods in combat such as rigged weapons, explosives and various poisons.  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Nabiki Tendou
characters.description: The second daughter of Soun Tendo. The most important thing to her is money and she'd do anything to achieve it, including blackmailing her own family members. In some stories, she plays an important role in trying to extort money or placing bets just for her own amusement.  She has a sarcastic, materialistic, egoistic, manipulative, sadistic and completely amoral attitude that is a sharp contrast to her older sister.  She can in fact, be seen as the most intelligent character in both manga and anime.

characters.name: Kasumi Tendou
characters.description: Eldest of the Tendo girls and is the most gentle of the lot. She has graduated high school and spends most of her day looking after the Tendo household, acting as the family's substitute "matriarch" ever since her mother's untimely death; by cooking, cleaning and helping her family.  Kasumi is portrayed as the perfect lady, with a very sweet, caring and self-sacrificing personality. Probably because of her extremely lovely nature, she is seldom affected by most of the crazy happenings around her and is wise in seeing through Nabiki's schemes.

characters.name: Tatewaki Kunou
characters.description: Tatewaki Kuno is an upperclassman at Furinkan High and was the big man on campus – at least until Ranma came along. Hailing from a very wealthy family, he is also captain of the kendo club and wields both his fortune and sword with equal ease. Given to spouting off Shakespearesque poetry (he quotes Confucius in the Japanese original), he is madly in love with Akane. He also falls for Ranma’s female half and never realizes that she is really his mortal enemy in girl form. He once overhears her called by name, and attempts to write it down for future reference, but never makes a connection and continues to refer to her as a "goddess in pig-tails" for the entire series. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Shampoo
characters.description: Shampoo is a Chinese Amazon from Joketsuzoku. She is one of the main three fiancées of [Ranma Saotome.](https://anilist.co/character/668/Ranma-Saotome) She is manipulative. She has repeatedly shown as devious and strategic as well as not being above scheming, play-acting, or completely ruthless behavior to advance her position towards the object of her attention. However, Shampoo does seem to enjoy having fun from the trouble she causes, particularly if it means she can get close to Ranma as a result.

characters.name: Hikaru Gosunkugi
characters.description: Gosunkugi is a classmate of [Ranma](https://anilist.co/character/668/Ranma-Saotome) and [Akane.](https://anilist.co/character/669/Akane-Tendou) Like many of the other male characters in the series, Gosunkugi is in love with Akane even though he is too shy to tell her. He also realizes that he would never stand a chance against her other suitors like [Ryoga](https://anilist.co/character/2369/Ryouga-Hibiki) and [Kuno.](https://anilist.co/character/7699/Tatewaki-Kunou) Gosunkugi often tries to sneakily get the upperhand on his rivals, though often this backfires. Most of his classmates are completely unaware of him, and certainly unaware of his ambitions to move them out of the way so he might have a moment with Akane. In the original anime, most of Gosunkugi's parts were given to [Sasuke Sagurature.](https://anilist.co/character/27796/Sasuke-Sarugakure) (Source: Rumic World)

characters.name: Genma Saotome
characters.description: Genma Saotome is very much like his son, [Ranma.](https://anilist.co/character/668/Ranma-Saotome) He is somewhat arrogant when it comes to his martial arts abilities, which he rarely showcases due to cowardice or laziness. It was Genma that took Ranma to Jusenkyo. Because he was unable to read the pamphlet, which was in Chinese, he had no idea of the curses that existed there.  When splashed with cold water Genma transforms into a panda. When in this form, he uses signs with written messages on them to communicate. Although he often tries to rid himself of his curse, he doesn't seem to mind it as much as Jusenkyo's other victims.
