Mei's personality is a direct opposite of that of her brother, Youhei. She can be very nosy about things, like trying to further Tomoya's relationship with Nagisa by becoming their cupid angel or learning Youhei's current situation.

characters.name: Sanae Furukawa
characters.description: **Height:** 158 cm (5' 2")  Sanae is Nagisa's mother. Normally she's very childish and a cry-baby, but when needed she can be very strong-willed and dependable. She runs the Furukawa Bakery with her husband Akio. She often tries out strange concepts to make breads that are anything but edible and never get sold. Outside of the bakery, she tutors children. She's quite proud of the way people often mistake her for Nagisa's older sister because of her youthful appearance.    !Sanae plays a larger role in After Story, often comes to Tomoya's aid when Nagisa is sick and needs to be accompanied, especially during Nagisa's pregnancy. Before being a baker at the Furukawa Bakery, she was a junior-high teacher, and had to quit her job due to Nagisa's health. Sanae is the mastermind behind Tomoya and Ushio's trip to the flower cape, in hope for them to reconcile. She knows Shino, Tomoya's grandmother in his father's side, although it is never revealed how they met. !

characters.name: Kouko Ibuki
characters.description: Kouko is Fuko's older sister. She used to be an art teacher at Tomoya's school, and she treats everyone kindly. Kouko is one of the familiar faces in the Furukawa Bakery, and Nagisa admires her very much, being her former art teacher. Currently she is engaged with Yusuke Yoshino.    !and is the major reason why Fuko still exists in the school, despite still sleeping in the hospital.!    In the movie, Kouko was a drama teacher instead of an art teacher. She, along with Youhei and Tomoya helped supervise and revive the drama club for Nagisa.

characters.name: Akio Furukawa
characters.description: **Height:** 175 cm (5' 9")  Akio is Nagisa's father.   Although he often talks and plays rough, he is kind and sympathetic. His childish side makes it easy for people to befriend him. He runs the Furukawa Bakery with his wife [Sanae](https://anilist.co/character/6831/Sanae-Furukawa). In his spare time, Akio plays baseball with children in the small park next to the bakery, and indulges in the Gundam fandom. He is often the victim of Sanae's bread, having to eat her bread in front of her while claiming that he loves it.  !  During the School Life arc, Akio reveals that he was an actor in a theatrical company, but has to quit his job due to Nagisa's health. Akio replaces Youhei's role as the comic relief during the After Story arc, however, he can be serious when needed, as he often gives advice to Tomoya on what it is like to become a man. He tells the story about how Nagisa almost died due to their unintended negligence, and how her life is connected to the city after getting saved from her fever.  !

characters.name: Yusuke Yoshino
characters.description: Yusuke is an electrician who once attended Tomoya's high school and lived as a rock musician. He is admired by Mei for his infrequent rock play. Tomoya first met Yusuke during a street light accident involving a person's car, and assists Yusuke in his work. Through Yusuke, he realizes the pain of working in society. Yusuke is engaged to Kouko, and is also one of the reasons why Fuko exists in the school.   Clannad After-Story:  ! He plays a more prominent role in After Story, giving Tomoya a job as an assistant electrician in his company, and sometimes gives him advice. Due to Tomoya's interest in him, Yusuke tells him of his past - how he became a rock musician, rose in fame, and ended due to his loss of his original motivation, along with stress and drugs. After being rehabilitated, no one wanted him anymore, except for Kouko, who had encouraged him to become a rock musician during his high school days. Throwing away his past, he now works as an electrician. Realizing that there are people who still love his music through Tomoya, Yusuke decides to create another music CD that sings his love for the city.  !

characters.name: Fuuko Ibuki
characters.description: Height: 150 cm  Fuko is a first year student at Tomoya's school (Technically, her age is same as Tomoya's), but she is always alone by herself, making wood carvings of starfish with a small knife to give to others as presents for her sister's upcoming wedding. Whenever Fuko sees something she thinks is incredibly cute she completely loses awareness of her surroundings, which Tomoya takes advantage of by playing a variety of pranks on her.

characters.name: Kotomi Ichinose
characters.description: Height: 160 cm (5'3'')  Kotomi is another schoolmate of [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/4606/Okazaki-Tomoya)'s in the same year, but, like [Kyou](https://anilist.co/character/4605/Fujibayashi-Kyou), is in a separate class from Tomoya. The "Koto" in Kotomi is derived from the Japanese musical stringed instrument of the same name. She is in the top ten for every subject throughout the whole country in standardized exam results—she always goes to library to read extra materials, especially books in foreign languages. Kotomi is a very quiet girl and it is quite difficult to communicate with her. In her spare time, she plays the violin, although she is very poor at it to the point of causing pain to those who hear her play.

characters.name: Tomoyo Sakagami
characters.description: Height: 161 cm  Tomoyo transferred to [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/4606/Okazaki-Tomoya)'s school as a second year student during spring. Although Tomoya is older than her, Tomoyo does not show him his due respect as a senior student. She has a younger brother named [Takafumi](https://anilist.co/character/9301/Sakagami-Takafumi).  She is rumored to be violent and to have a misconduct record for fighting. These rumors are later confirmed, when she beats up several delinquents from her previous school at a day during school hours. [Youhei](https://anilist.co/character/4610/Sunohara-Youhei) challenges Tomoyo, unable to believe what he saw. After several meetings with Tomoyo, Tomoya learns from Tomoyo that she wants to be a student council president, and later, her reason of wanting to be one.

characters.name: Nagisa Furukawa
characters.description: Height: 155 cm  Nagisa is the daughter of [Akio](https://anilist.co/character/7095/Furukawa-Akio) and [Sanae Furukawa](https://anilist.co/character/6831/Furukawa-Sanae). Though she is in her senior year, Nagisa is one year older than her classmates; she had to repeat her third year again after an illness that lasted nine months. Nagisa meets [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/4606/Okazaki-Tomoya) on the first day of this year.  Nagisa is very timid, and has a habit of saying the names of food that she wants to eat as a way of motivating herself. She wants to reestablish the suspended Theater Club, but does not have enough self-confidence to do so.

characters.name: Kyou Fujibayashi
characters.description: Height: 160 cm  Kyou is a bad-mouthed and aggressive girl well known as a good cook. She was in Tomoya's class in their second year, and has maintained a steady friendship with Tomoya even though they are put in different classes on their third year. She is currently the class representative of her class. She has a pet baby boar named Botan. She owns a scooter and she throws various types of dictionaries towards anyone she gets furious with, especially Youhei.

characters.name: Tomoya Okazaki
characters.description: Height: 173cm Class: 3-D  Tomoya Okazaki is the protagonist of Clannad. Due to his habit of always arriving late to school, skipping classes during the day, and staying out all night, he has been labeled as a delinquent.

characters.name: Yukine Miyazawa
characters.description: Yukine is a second year student who hangs around in the library's reference room during lunchtime. She takes care of many newcomers from other schools who also happen to be delinquents - in particular, people who knew her brother. She's very kind, and avails [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/4606) and [Youhei](https://anilist.co/character/4610) an instruction book for magical spells for them to try.  !Yukine is actually involved deeply with the story relating to the delinquents. Her brother is well known for being a delinquent, and this sometimes gets her into different situations involving the delinquents of the town. It is later revealed, in After Story, that her brother died and nobody knew that other than the group of people that reside on her brother's side. Yukine later helps reunite the members of opposite gangs, and they all end up being friends.!

characters.name: Zaratras
characters.description: Zaratras was a Great Holy Knight and was once the strongest in the order of Liones' Holy Knights before his death ten years prior to the beginning of series. He is also the father of the Holy Knight, Gilthunder, and was the Seven Deadly Sins' superior.

characters.name: Raph
characters.description: A monster Naofumi created using his shield.

characters.name: Rishia Ivyred
characters.description: Race: Human  Rishia is the daughter of the House of Ivyred, a noble family. Due to an unfortunate string of events, the family had grown poor and she was forcefully taken as ransom by a neighboring family in exchange for gold. She was rescued by The Bow Hero, whom she would later devote her life to.  !To show her gratitude and support for her savior, Rishia would go on to join Itsuki's party. She would then be treated as an errand girl, carrying food and supplies for the Bow Hero's party, leaving her talent in magic unused and untapped.!

characters.name: Beloukas
characters.description: The slave dealer that sells Naofumi Iwatani many slaves. He also conducts slave and monster seal rituals. Despite his appearance and his trade, he is an honest salesman. Upon Naofumi’s request, he searches for and collects slaves who were former villagers of Raphtalia’s village

characters.name: Raphtalia
characters.description: **Race:** Raccoon & Tanuki  Raphtalia is a Tanuki-type Demi-Human who was the first real member of the Shield Hero's party after he purchased her as a slave.  !Raphtalia later obtain one of the eight vassal weapons from another world granting her the title of Vassal Weapon Wielder and Katana Hero. Due to the passive effects of the Vassal Weapons her slave curse seal was removed.!

characters.name: Filo
characters.description: **Age:** <1 (mentally), 10 (physically) **Race:** Filolial  Filo was originally hatched from a monster egg which Naofumi purchased from the slave trader.  Filo grew at an abnormally fast rate and in just a few days grown into a fully grown Filolial later developing into a rare species of Filolial Queen where she was later given the ability to transform into a humanoid form strongly resembling a Angel and the ability to talk due to her association with the Shield Hero and the effects of the Legendary Shield.

characters.name: Joou no kage
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Naofumi Iwatani
characters.description: A university student that was summoned to another world as the Shield Hero. Typically unsociable, he's friendly and easy-going to those close to him.  !After being abandoned by [Malty](https://anilist.co/character/129808) and being treated as a criminal by the people of the world, He unlocked the curse series. The sin he has unlocked is Wrath (against the people of the world).!

characters.name: Ren Amaki
characters.description: A high school student who was summoned to another world as the Sword Hero. He's considered a bishounen and tends to stay quiet.  !After his companions die, he fell into despair, and, thus, he followed [Malty](https://anilist.co/character/129808) when she offered kind words to him. After being abandoned by her, he had a brief stint as a bandit, after which he came under the Female Knight's tutelage. He also unlocked the curse series after being abandoned by Malty. His sins are Greed (For Power) and Gluttony (For Power).!

characters.name: Melty Q Melromarc
characters.description: The second princess of Melromarc.  Melty is in many ways the exact opposite of her sister, Malty. This includes their personality, appearance, magic specialty (water vs fire), and color schemes (blue and white against red and brown).

characters.name: Itsuki Kawasumi
characters.description: A high school student summoned to another world as the Bow Hero. He is usually calm and well-mannered. However, He has a messiah complex, and is pretty much a justice maniac. He vanquishes evildoers without thinking of the consequences of his actions. However, this is just because he is immature. He doesn't actually have any bad intentions.  !When the Spirit Turtle revived, Itsuki and the party was forced to challenge it, but the party ran away, leaving him as a sacrifice to the Turtle.!

characters.name: Fitoria
characters.description: Fitoria is the queen of the Filolials, who rules over them all.  She has silver hair with thin streaks of light blue, cut in a short bob with three tufts of hair standing up vertically from the crown of her head, like cowlicks. Her eyes are red and her face is small and well composed. She's dressed in a red and white gothic lolita-style dress. She's about the same height as Filo.

characters.name: Keel
characters.description: Race: Wanui !Gender: Female!  Keel was born and raised in the same village as Raphtalia. Naofumi purchased them as a slave in order to rebuild the village destroyed by the first wave.

characters.name: Erhard
characters.description: Erhard is a blacksmith and a weapon shop owner in the castle town of Melromarc. His shop is the only shop in Melromarc to sell shields while others don't for religious reasons.

characters.name: Aki Adagaki
characters.description: Height: 162 cm  Aki comes from a well off family and is known for her brutal treatment of men. As a result, she has gained the nickname "Cruel Princess" from her classmates. She allegedly rejected [Masamune-kun](https://anilist.co/character/81967/Makabe-Masamune) and gave him the nickname "Piggy" when the two were children leading to his transformation and commitment to revenge.   !It was later revealed though that her hatred towards men is because her childhood crush Masamune left without saying anything which left her heartbroken. When Masamune finally confronts her about the past she tells him that she never gave him the nickname "piggy" in the first place, and never heard of that nickname before. As Aki learns Masamune's identity and situation, she attempts to make him the same chubby boy he used to be. Aki mentions that she found his chubbiness "cute" and overall as a symbol of wealth implying that chubby guys are her type.!

characters.name: Chinatsu Hayase
characters.description: She is the younger sister of Masamune Makabe and currently attends middle school as a second year. She does not possess the same surname as her brother due to Masamune's choice of changing from Hayase to Makabe.

characters.name: Masamune Makabe
characters.description: Height: 178 cm  A narcissistic boy who is obsessed with the idea of getting revenge. His feelings of revenge are aimed towards the popular rich girl, [Adagaki Aki](https://anilist.co/character/76364/Adagaki-Aki). Despite his handsome appearance now, he was once a chubby kid who people liked to make fun of.   !It is shown later on that the reason he hates Adagaki Aki so much was because she rejected his feelings for her and nicknamed him "Piggy". Later on, in order to get revenge on Aki, Makabe teams up with [Koiwai Yoshino](https://anilist.co/character/121008/Koiwai-Yoshino), Aki's maid.!

characters.name: Yoshino Koiwai
characters.description: Yoshino is [Aki](https://anilist.co/character/76364/Adagaki-Aki)'s maid and follower. She seems to be a clumsy girl. However, beneath her clumsy and shy appearance she is actually extremely deceptive and cold, able to deceive and hurt Aki without a second thought. Unlike Aki, Yoshino easily gained weight from sweets.  !Later it was revealed that Yoshino had disguised herself as Aki eight years before, rejected Masamune, and gave him the nickname "Piggy" due to jealously towards Aki's affection to him, but soon realized that her actions caused Aki to become estrange towards men. She has been regretting this and attempted to repay what she has done after Aki and Masamune reunited in high school.!  !She later falls in love with Makabe Masamune.!

characters.name: Tae Futaba
characters.description: Masamune's class rep. She loves Yaoi and likes pairing Masamune to Kojuurou.  !She confessed her feelings to Masamune once, but got rejected.!

characters.name: Kikune Kiba
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Kojuurou Shuri
characters.description: **Height:** 155 cm  Masamune's best friend who looks like a girl, but is actually a boy. !He has a small crush on Neko.!

characters.name: Sonoka Kaneko
characters.description: Kaneko Sonoka is one of the girls who have self-proclaimed themselves as [Aki Adagaki](https://anilist.co/character/76364/)'s bodyguards and the Vice President of Yasaka High School Student Council.  Kaneko is a cute and fairly short girl. She has dirty-blonde hair that has two pink ribbons tying up two straps of her hair into ring-shaped like while the rest of her hair reaches her chest and pink eyes. She wears the Yasaka High School uniform which consists of a pink shirt, black vest with the school symbol on it, a striped yellow skirt and a blue and yellow ribbon.

characters.name: Neko Fujinomiya
characters.description: **Height:** 159 cm  Neko Fujinomiya is a cute and cheerful rich girl who transferred school after [Masamune Makabe](https://anilist.co/character/81967/Makabe-Masamune) "gave her his coat on Christmas Eve" and fell in love with him. She has a frail body, needing to consume many drugs although she often makes jokes about it. Due to her habit of not wearing any panties, [Aki](https://anilist.co/character/76364/Adagaki-Aki) and [Yoshino](https://anilist.co/character/121008/Koiwai-Yoshino) nicknamed her "Pantie-less Woman".  !While claiming that she just needs Masamune to pretend that their first encounter were real, Neko is actually genuinely in love with Masamune when he's still chubby, although it is never revealed how. After Masamune rejected her, Neko's condition got worse and she underwent a surgery abroad, and then came back with better health and thus continue to support Masamune.!

characters.name: Mari Mizuno
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Kinue Hayase
characters.description: Height: 138 cm Occupation: Housewife  She has light brown hair that curls at the tips and brown eyes. She wears a headband that has a dog footprint on and she usually is seen wearing an apron. She is very short, has a small body, and can be easily mistaken for a child, even though she is 42 years old. She is also the mother of Makabe Masamune.

characters.name: Kanetsugu Gasou
characters.description: Gender: !Female!   !Kanetsugu Gasou is a daughter of a family which used to be rich. She was one of Aki's love interests. Kanetsugu pretends to be Aki's childhood friend "Masamune" to gain funding for her little sister and home.!

characters.name: Yuisaki Midori
characters.description: Midori Yuisaki is one of Aki Adagaki's maids.

characters.name: Narino Koiwai
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Akane Aoi
characters.description: Akane Aoi is a first year student at Kamome Academy's High School division as one of Nene's classmates, and the student council's vice president. !He is secretly a supernatural who controls the present, as one of the three Clock Keepers along with Kako and Mirai.!

characters.name: Tsuchigomori
characters.description: Age: !70+! Height: 6' 0"+ Occupation: Teacher (disguise), 5th Mystery Representative Status: !Disconnected (as a supernatural)!  Tsuchigomori is a science teacher at Kamome Academy. He is secretly a supernatural, representing and curating the academy's 5th School Wonder, the 4PM Bookstacks. He is also Kou's current homeroom teacher.  While Tsuchigomori seems like a normal, caring and somewhat meek teacher in his human disguise, he is actually sarcastic, mischievous and quite short-tempered. He's also shown to be quite sadistic, having fun with threatening and scaring Nene and Kou ― although he quickly stops after a light warning from Hanako. Although he is a teacher, he is shown to dislike children because of their noisy attitudes. Tsuchigomori also has an odd sense of humor and likes to joke around, such as saying that he likes to eat human children, only to be met with terrified looks in response.  Despite him claiming that he only pretends to care about his students, he has been shown to actually genuinely care about them on various occasions. When asked why he makes his teacher persona so different than his actual personality as a supernatural, he answers that it's simply because he feels like it.   !As the curator of the 4PM Bookstacks, he has access to the entire body of knowledge surrounding the school, along with the present, past, and future. He seems to know everything about every student that has ever attended the school. Even after his yorishiro and boundary were broken, his powers still allow him ways to retrieve the books in the library. He mentions that because of his position, it's possible for him to alter the future, but he does not plan to do so because any curator who does will be erased from existence.!

characters.name: Tsukasa Yugi
characters.description: Yugi Tsukasa is a ghost haunting Kamome Academy. He currently resides at the school's broadcasting club room, with its members Sakura and Natsuhiko. !He is the younger twin brother of Amane Yugi. He is said to be the polar opposite of Hanako. Where Hanako grants the wish of a living person, Tsukasa grants the wish of a dead person's lingering spirit!

characters.name: Kou Minamoto
characters.description: Minamoto Kou is a student at Kamome Academy's Middle School Division, and a member of a renowned family of exorcists, the Minamoto Clan.

characters.name: Sakura Nanamine
characters.description: Nanamine Sakura is a 3rd-year student at Kamome Academy's High School division. She made a contract with Tsukasa and is now bound to him. She is a member of the school's broadcasting club.

characters.name: Lemon Yamabuki
characters.description: Yamabuki Lemon is a first year student at Kamome Academy's High School divison and Nene, Aoi and Akane's classmate.

characters.name: Yako
characters.description: The fox statue spirit that holds the title of Number Two of The Seven Wonders (二番目の七不思議. Romaji: _Ni-ban me no Nanafushigi_) as the Misaki's Stair ghost. She took on the form of a beautiful lady inside her territory while outside, she took the form of a kitsune spirit.  !She spirited humans into her realm in hopes of them making an appropriate vessel for her deceased human teacher, Misaki.!

characters.name: Hanako
characters.description: Age of Death: 13  Hanako is a ghost haunting the old building of Kamome Academy. He resides on the third floor female bathroom, in the toilet of the third stall. He governs over the Seven Mysteries as School Mystery Number 7.  !Hanako's real name is Yugi Amane. He attended Kamome Academy as a student and his goal was to become an astronaut and go to the moon someday. He was to become a science teacher at Kamome Academy as an adult, but his future changed for unknown reasons. He ended up with the fate of killing his own twin brother, of dying as a kid, and of then becoming one of the Seven Mysteries to protect the students and to fulfill their wishes in order to atone for his sins.!   !It is hinted multiple times that Hanako has romantic feelings for [Yashiro](https://anilist.co/character/128652/Yashiro-Nene), and that he is madly in love with her.!  !He confesses his love to Nene Yashiro and gives her a kiss.!

characters.name: Nene Yashiro
characters.description: Yashiro Nene is a normal student, and one day she listens to a rumor about ''Hanako-san'' who makes wishes for anyone, but the wishes come with a price. She visits him in the hope of getting her crush to fall in love with her. She becomes friends with Hanako-san soon after meeting him then. She is in the gardening club.

characters.name: Teru Minamoto
characters.description: Minamoto Teru is a 2nd year student at Kamome Academy's High School Division and the school's Student Council President. He is also a member of a renowned family of exorcists, the Minamoto Clan. Teru is Kou's older brother.

characters.name: Mokke
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Sousuke Mitsuba
characters.description: Mitsuba, real name Mitsuba Sousuke is a ghost haunting Kamome Academy Middle School's lockers. He was a student at Kamome Academy's Middle School division and a member of the photography club before his death.  !After being recreated by Tsukasa, he consumed the at-the-time School Mystery No.3's heart and is now the current representative of the 3rd School Mystery!

characters.name: Aoi Akane
characters.description: Akane Aoi is a first year student at Kamome Academy's High School Division and Nene's friend.

characters.name: Kodama
characters.description: Kodama is known as the Confession Tree and a supernatural that only appears in front of couples and brings all love confessed below it to fruition.

characters.name: Leon Kuwata
characters.description: Height: 175 cm (5'9") Talent: Baseball  Leon is a student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. He is the Super High School Level Baseball Player (超高校級の野球選手), or the Ultimate Baseball Star in the English localization.  Leon is passionate and hot-blooded. He often slacks off from studying and baseball training. However, he never encountered any problem with his attitude due to his status as the Super High School Level Baseball Player. He claims that he actually never liked baseball, and he is determined to change his title to "Super High School Level Musician" to win a heart of a girl that he happened to meet at the hair salon. Later, Leon actually states that he somewhat missed playing baseball; something that he did all the time since he was young.

characters.name: Mondo Oowada
characters.description: Height: 187 cm (6'2") Talent: Biker Gang Leader  Mondo is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. He is the Super High School Level Biker Gang Leader (超高校級の暴走族), or Ultimate Biker Gang Leader in the English localization.  Mondo is the second leader of the Crazy Diamonds, Japan's largest and most feared biker gang. He has ​high respect for his brother from whom he inherited the gang from after he died. Mondo acts tough and has a strong sense of honor and loyalty to his companions. After he finishes his role as a gang member, he wants to become a carpenter.

characters.name: Kyouko Kirigiri
characters.description: Height: 167 cm (5'5") Talent: ???  Kyouko is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. Her talent is unknown.  Kyouko is a mysterious, stoic, and independent person who deliberately masks her feelings so that others won't be able to read her. Because of this, she has a cold demeanor and appears to remain calm and collected in most situations. Despite this, however, she can sometimes let her emotions get the best of her when she's especially upset. Though aloof and slow to trust others, Kyouko is adept at noticing things that the other students don't, which proves vital once bodies start turning up. She often advises Makoto on conducting investigations.  !Her actual talent is the Super High School Level Detective (超高校級の探偵), or the Ultimate Detective in the English localization.!

characters.name: Byakuya Togami
characters.description: Height: 185 cm (6'1") Talent: Heir  Byakuya is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. He is the Super High School Level Heir (超高校級の御曹司), or the Ultimate Affluent Progeny in the English localization.  Byakuya is arrogant, seeing himself superior to his peers due to having fought to become the heir to his family's massive financial conglomerate. However, he is a sensible student who holds a truthful, albeit cynical, outlook on the world. He is ruthlessly honest about his opinions and often hurts others with his blunt remarks. Despite his negative attitude, he does occasionally lend a hand to other characters.

characters.name: Kiyotaka Ishimaru
characters.description: Height: 176 cm (5'9") Talent: Disciplinary Committee Member  Kiyotaka is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. He is the Super High School Level Disciplinary Committee Member (超高校級の風紀委員), or Ultimate Moral Compass in the English localization.  Kiyotaka is righteous and values order above all else. He is also a hard worker, believing that one can achieve anything through hard work. In fact, he earned his title by the same means too. Due to his extreme dedication to studying and proper conduct, he has difficulties in making friends and could not even hold a ‘normal’ conversation with another person. Kiyotaka is very expressive and intense in his manner of speech.

characters.name: Sayaka Maizono
characters.description: Height: 165 cm (5'5") Talent: Idol  Sayaka is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Idol (超高校級のアイドル), or the Ultimate Pop Sensation in the English localization.  She is the lead singer of an incredibly popular idol group. She and Makoto were classmates in middle school.

characters.name: Sakura Oogami
characters.description: Height: 192 cm (6'4") Talent: Martial Arts  Sakura is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Martial Artist (超高校級の格闘家), or Ultimate Martial Artist in the English localization.  Contrary to what her appearance might suggest, Sakura is a kind and level-headed girl. She rarely loses her nerve and seems able to maintain clarity in almost any situation. During more rare moments, she can lose her temper completely and become extremely intense, particularly when her friends get hurt. She also gets impatient if she cannot properly train for a long period of time. She is known for her love of protein and enjoys exercising early in the morning before a large breakfast.  Due to her more old-fashioned upbringing, Sakura has a habit of talking in an old-fashioned, formal manner. Being raised as the sole heir to a dojo with a three-hundred-year history, she believes that being a martial artist is simply her destiny. Along with learning martial arts, she learned to respect nature and animals, being particularly fond of rabbits as they never seem to get frightened when she holds them.  Along with protecting her legacy as her sworn duty, Sakura wants to prove that a woman can be the Strongest Person Alive. She also believes that she must work harder than men to achieve this goal. As a result of striving to be strong, Sakura is embarrassed about her own softer feelings and being feminine, assuming that other people would laugh at her if they knew.

characters.name: Chihiro Fujisaki
characters.description: Height: 148 cm (4'9") Talent: Programming  A student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. Chihiro is the Super High School Level Programmer, or the Ultimate Programmer in the English localization.  Chihiro is a computer genius behind numerous innovative software. Has a very timid, meek personality, crying easily and apologizing often. However, Chihiro loves to talk about programming and becomes much livelier when it's brought up.   As a kid, Chihiro spent most of the time on the computer. Chihiro's father, [Taichi Fujisaki](https://anilist.co/character/174957/Fujisaki-Taichi), was a software engineer who developed many major computer programs. While using his computer one day, Chihiro ended up modifying one of Taichi's incomplete programs and soon realized that she could write programs, after that, Chihiro became absorbed in programming and became famous for creating cutting-edge programs, including top-secret AI programs for an unnamed company, and gained many fans for resembling a "timid little bunny".

characters.name: Monokuma
characters.description: Height: 75 cm (2'6") (DR1 & DRV3), 65 cm (2'2") (DR2)  A stuffed robotic bear and the self-proclaimed Headmaster of Hope's Peak Academy who instigates the various killing games in the Danganronpa series. Monokuma is often described as easygoing and cheerful at first glance, but with a very sinister undertone.. He loves hysteria, violence, chaos, and most of all, despair.

characters.name: Celestia Ludenberg
characters.description: Height: 164 cm (5'5") Talent: Gambling  Celestia is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Gambler, or the Ultimate Gambler in the English localization.  Also known as the "Queen of Liars", Celestia is renowned for her exemplary luck in games of chance. She's accumulated a sizable fortune by robbing anyone stupid enough to challenge her blind. She speaks softly and smiles often, but in a way that tends to creep out everyone around her. She also hides a surprisingly short temper and will start shouting (usually at [Hifumi](https://anilist.co/character/65535/Yamada-Hifumi)) if she isn't pleased.    !Her true name is Taeko Yasuhiro.!

characters.name: Touko Fukawa
characters.description: Height: 165 cm  (5'5") Talent: Literature  Touko is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Literary Girl, or the Ultimate Writing Prodigy in the English localization.  Due to her severe persecution complex that originates from the bullying she suffered at a young age, Touko is highly suspicious of other people, frequently accusing them of thinking bad things about her. She has also caused others to give a bad first impression of her as she is known to blatantly insult others, even though it is the very first time they have met. Despite her young age, she has already won several awards for her writing, and her works are constantly on top of selling lists. She is also in love with [Byakuya Togami](https://anilist.co/character/65541/Togami-Byakuya), constantly swooning over him and acting extremely submissive towards him, although her affection is one-sided.  !Touko actually has two different identities, the other being the infamous serial killer, Genocider Sho.!

characters.name: Aoi Asahina
characters.description: Height: 160 cm (5'3") Talent: Swimming  Aoi is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Swimmer (超高校級のスイマー), or Ultimate Swimming Pro in the English localization.  Always energetic and friendly, Asahina is also a bit airheaded. She has difficulty remembering names.

characters.name: Yasuhiro Hagakure
characters.description: Height: 180 cm (5'11") Talent: Fortune Telling  Yasuhiro is a student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. He is the Super High School Level Fortune Teller, or Ultimate Clairvoyant in the English localization.  Yasuhiro is cheery, laid-back, and a bit of a conspiracy theorist. He isn't very well-liked by the other students, and Yasuhiro himself has admitted that he is quite cowardly, lazy, slow-witted, and has a habit to act selfishly. Notably, he is mentioned to be very clumsy with money and he has constant problems with massive debts.

characters.name: Hifumi Yamada
characters.description: Height: 170 cm (5'7") Talent: Creating Doujins  Hifumi is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. He is the Super High School Level Doujin Author (超高校級の同人作家), or Ultimate Fanfic Creator in the English localization.  Hifumi comes across as creepy and perverted, and he has a habit of referencing anime and video games. He loves Buko, the female lead in his favorite anime series, Heretic Angel ☆ Mochi Mochi Princess. He has a particular dislike toward people who supposedly don’t understand the true meaning of doujin. His dream is to ‘save’ other people by making a doujin that will inspire them to create their own.

characters.name: Ushio Okazaki
characters.description: Ushio is [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/4606) and [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/4604)'s daughter. She is a well-behaved, well-loved girl who is very curious about the world around her. Tomoya notes that she does not act like other girls her age. For example, most girls would want to have dolls; however, when Tomoya goes on a trip with her, he buys her a robot with which she is fascinated. Tomoya, finding it strange that she would prefer this type of toy, learns that Ushio has some interest in robots; thus he also calls her "boyish". Ushio also appears to like baseball. Ushio's interest has been influenced by her grandfather who teaches her to imitate famous baseball players. She refers to [Akio](https://anilist.co/character/7095) as "Akii" and calls her grandmother by her given name "Sanae".  In the few earlier episodes of the stories, Ushio stays with [Sanae](https://anilist.co/character/6831) and Akio. During her time with her grandparents, she learns to be a baseball addict like Akio, Ushio also learns strict disciplines from Sanae not to cry unless it is in the restroom.  !As the story progresses on with Tomoya's recovery, she starts to live with her father. As she lives with her father, she later becomes friends with [Fuuko](https://anilist.co/character/4601), the sister of her mother's old teacher, [Kouko](https://anilist.co/character/6971). Due to the lack of time Tomoya can spend with Ushio, she sneaks out of her father's house to view a hospital she refers as "pleasant." This is the place that Akio once took Nagisa to beg for her life.!   !One day, Ushio falls dangerously ill, and the doctor's conclude that she has contracted the same mysterious illness that Nagisa once had. To support his daughter, Tomoya quits his job and chooses to stay with Ushio as she unsuccessfully fights for her life. Ushio asks Tomoya to take her on a trip like the last one they went to, but he refuses, saying she needs to heal first. Tomoya finally gives in the second time she asks. As they walk towards the train station in the snow, Ushio collapses, whispers "I love you" to her father, before dying in his arms.   In the extra ending of Clannad: After Story, Nagisa and Ushio do not die and live happily with Tomoya.!  !At the edge of death after failing to get away from the world, it is revealed that she is actually the Girl in the Illusionary World who had lost her memory after dying in the real world.!

characters.name: Kyouka Izumi
characters.description: Height: 148cm (4'10")  A docile young lady who dresses in a kimono, but also a member of Port Mafia. As she holds a killing ability, she was found by the organization and raised as an assassin.  !She later joins the Armed Detective Agency.!

characters.name: Michizou Tachihara
characters.description: Height: 176 cm Ability: Midwinter Memento  A commander of the Black Lizards, the Port Mafia's squad of hitmen. Though he puts up a tough and violent front, he cares deeply for his friends. Very skilled gunner, especially when dual wielding.

characters.name: Ichiyou Higuchi
characters.description: A beautiful and intelligent woman who wears pants. She belongs to a commando unit that answers to the leader of Port Mafia, and has authority over the military group "Black Lizard." She adores Akutagawa and calls him "senpai."

characters.name: Atsushi Nakajima
characters.description: Height: 170 cm (5'7") Ability: Beast Beneath the Moonlight  He came to Yokohama after being driven out of a poor orphanage that was attacked by a man-eating tiger. On the verge of starvation, he meets [Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198/Dazai-Osamu) and gets a job helping at the detective agency. Because he's never had friends or family and was labeled as "useless," he lacks self-confidence.

characters.name: Osamu Dazai
characters.description: **Height:** 181 cm (5'11") **Ability:** No Longer Human  A member of the Armed Detective Agency. He's a suicide enthusiast who searches for a place to die. However, he doesn't like pain, and would prefer a lovers' suicide with a beautiful woman. He's aimless, elusive, nonchalant, and jokes around normally, but, when he is serious, it is clear that he is an insightful and intelligent individual. He loves to annoy his fellow Agency member, [Kunikida](https://anilist.co/character/89200).  !He was a former Executive of the city's worst underworld organization, the Port Mafia.!

characters.name: Ryuunosuke Akutagawa
characters.description: Height: 172cm (5'8") Likes: Curios and antiques, tea, figs Dislikes: Bonsai trees, dogs, baths  "The weak will die. Die, and make way for others." A member of the notorious "Port Mafia" that operates by the harbor. Akutagawa has a black and white "survival of the fittest" view of the world, claiming that weak people should die and give way to the stronger ones. His ability is called "Rashōmon" (羅生門).  He is not afraid of pain and defeat, if only to hear a word from a "certain person". His ruthless, vicious nature makes him one of the Port Mafia's most dangerous members, feared by both ally and foe. Much of the obedience he receives from subordinates of Black Lizard , and the Mafia in general, largely stems from fear of his short temper and general intolerance of incompetence.   In chapter 87, !it is revealed that Akutagawa doesn't have much time left to live, as he is suffering from a vital lung disease.!  In chapter 88 of the manga, !Akutagawa turns undead, being bitten by Bram Stoker after a fatal blow which results in his death.!  (Source: Bungou Stray Doys Wiki, Anime News Network)

characters.name: Ranpo Edogawa
characters.description: Height: 168 cm (5'6")  The great detective of the Armed Detective Agency. He possesses sharp observation skills that are acknowledged by his coworkers, and he settles difficult cases at the request of the police. Because of his self-confidence, his speech is brazen and child-like. His motto is "If you'll have me, everything will be ok!" He likes logical thinking and fantastic tales.

characters.name: Ougai Mori
characters.description: Height: 175 cm Ability: Vita Sexualis  Ougai Mori is the boss of the Port Mafia. Ougai is analytical and tactical. He often puts on overdramatic acts but rarely breaks his composure internally.   He has been shown to be somewhat ruthless and unfaltering when it comes to violence. He hasn't, however, shown any particular enjoyment from killing. His ruthlessness comes from his pragmaticism.  Although he can be intimidating at times and emit a scary formal aura, he is often polite to the point of seeming approachable. He is polite to allies and enemies alike.

characters.name: Nathaniel Hawthorne
characters.description: Height: 188cm Likes: God, the Bible, faith, purity Dislikes: The Devil, heresy Ability: The Scarlet Letter  He has the ability to convert his own blood into holy words and control them.

characters.name: Arthur Rimbaud
characters.description: Ability: Illuminations  He, along with his partner Paul Verlaine came from Europe to infiltrated the Japanese Military to spy (and steal) the mysterious project, Arahabaki

characters.name: Elise
characters.description: Member of Port Mafia, a young girl usually seen with Ougai Mori.  !She is the ability of Mori Ougai!

characters.name: Chuuya Nakahara
characters.description: Height: 160 cm (5'3")  Chuuya is a Port Mafia member who detests [Osamu Dazai](https://anilist.co/character/89198) for betraying the mafia and joining the Armed Detective Agency. He's also constantly teased by Dazai what makes him hate Dazai even more. Chuuya is short but he's quick and uses powerful martial arts.   His ability, "For The Tainted Sorrow," revolves around gravity manipulation, allowing him to manipulate and alter the gravity of anything he touches, keeping it that way until a certain period of time.

characters.name: Motojirou Kajii
characters.description: Height: 180 cm (5'11")  A member of Port Mafia. He's a bomber wanted for the explosion at the Maruzen Building. He's an enthusiastic scientist who boasts that "death" is the "ultimate experiment."

characters.name: Ariel Asura
characters.description: Second Princess of the Asura Kingdom. She is hardly ever seen without her two bodyguards, [Luke](https://anilist.co/character/226703) and "[Silent Fitz](https://anilist.co/character/88346)". After surviving many assassination attempts, she and her bodyguards flee to The Magic City of Sharia and enroll at  the Ranoa Magic Academy.

characters.name: Luke Notos Greyrat
characters.description: Luke Notos Greyrat is the second prince of the Asura kingdom Ariel Anemoi Asura's personal guardian and also holds the status of Knight.  He's also the cousin of Rudeus Greyrat, but from another of the four different branch families in the Greyrat genus, namely the Notos family.

characters.name: Pursena Adoldia
characters.description: Together with Linia Dedoldia they are the two troublemakers in Ranoa Magic Academy, but when it comes to fulfilling her dreams of becoming the Village Chief she will do her best. She likes eating meat.

characters.name: Cliff Grimoire
characters.description: Cliff Grimoire is the Grandson of the Pope, and a friend of Rudeus.   Cliff has a very high amount of pride, so much so that he will proudly tell people when they ask him for help. Though this trait may irk many people it cannot be said that he is arrogant since he is shown to be constantly studying to improve himself showing that he is very diligent as well. He is also very loyal to his friends, since it is shown that if he is asked for help, then that becomes his main priority

characters.name: Linia Dedoldia
characters.description: Linia Dedoldia is the granddaughter of the Village Chief, Gustav, of the Doldia Tribe.  !She later becomes the slave of Rudeus Greyrat for buying/saving her from the slave trader.!

characters.name: Biblia Gakuenchou
characters.description: Master Biblia is a Paladin-Class mage and is the headmaster who presides over the Biblia Magic Academy.

characters.name: Ilias Fragment
characters.description: Ilias Fragment, is a grimoire that was owned by Hijiri. She took on Hijiri's memories and appearance and acted as a substitute. Whenever Hijiri was out of the house on magus duty, she would take her place and cook for Arata or do the household chores. She is a support type grimoire. She is able to transfer all her energy to her owner.

characters.name: Hijiri Kasuga
characters.description: [Arata](https://anilist.co/character/42391/Kasuga-Arata)'s cousin and childhood friend.

characters.name: Lugh
characters.description: She is a member of Iscariot, magus of the Invidia Archive and a thief.

characters.name: Lieselotte Sherlock
characters.description: Lieselotte is a beautiful young lady, who has flowing, long blonde hair that is tied up in twin tail. She has purple eyes compared to her sister who has blue eyes. She is also very voluptuous. Her main attire consists of thigh boots, opera gloves, shorts, and a cape-like dress that leaves her midriff open that is held by two strings attached to her choker.

characters.name: Lilith Asami
characters.description: Lilith is a teacher at the Magic Academy, Lillith possess the ability to manipulate magical energy into her "Thema," a sort of basic will that she uses to create an effect.  She is the one who introduced Arata to the magic world, she becomes one of his earliest allies and friends, watching and supporting him since meeting him.  !Her real name is Azazel Lilith, daughter of a demon king who had her memories changed traveling through two worlds.!

characters.name: Levi Kazama
characters.description: Levi Kazama is a ninja and the Trinity Seven of Invidia, as well as a student at the Royal Biblia Academy. As a user of Shamanic Spells, she is considered to be one of world's top three fighters, becoming one of Arata's earliest allies.

characters.name: Sora
characters.description: The Astil Manuscript or Sora, as affectionately named by Arata, is a legendary grimoire said to contain information about another world. Originally belonging to Hijiri, Sora has since contracted with Arata, supporting and protecting him after becoming a magus.

characters.name: Arata Kasuga
characters.description: Kasuga Arata used to live with his cousin and childhood friend [Kasuga Hijiri](https://anilist.co/character/135746/Kasuga-Hijiri), but one day something happened to the city he lives in, and an object was given to him by his cousin. When he finds out she could be alive he tries to become a magician, meeting with the Trinity Sevens in order to become a "Magus" and save Hijiri.

characters.name: Selina Sherlock
characters.description: Selina Sherlock is the younger twin sister of Lieselotte, and a student reporter at Royal Biblia Academy. Because her elder sister is a member of Trinity Seven, Selina becomes closely affiliated with some of the other members and later Arata Kasuga as well.

characters.name: Akio Fudou
characters.description: Akio Fudou is the partner of Mira in operating Grimoire Security as well as a member of the Trinity Seven. Akio won't let anyone get close to her based purely on offensive power.

characters.name: Mira Yamana
characters.description: Mira Yamana is the Head of Grimoire Security and one of the Trinity Seven.

characters.name: Yui Kurata
characters.description: Yui is a special mage, as she can only communicate with others through dreams. She also lives in the dungeon underneath the academy. After she was rescued by Arata and other Trinity Seven members (except for Lieselotte due to her disappearance) Yui can return to a normal life with other people and Levi as her close friend. She has a little-sister-personality and is extremely close to Arata, calling him "Onii-chan" and exclaims her love for him constantly. Yui is a member of Trinity Seven, too, embodying Greed.

characters.name: Arin Kannazuki
characters.description: Archive: Ira (wrath) Thema: ruina, paratum, victoria (temporary) Grimoire: Laguna Yggdrasil  A mysterious girl who claims Arata to be her husband. She looks like Hijiri, Arata's cousin and childhood friend. Arin rarely shows emotion, and cares little what others think of her. Her first meeting with Arata occurred when she was bathing in the men's bath because she preferred the quiet (very few men attend the academy due to the fact females are usually more attuned to magic) despite being discovered by Arata she acts casual as if nothing had happened. Although she shows little emotion of her own she is quick to notice it in others. Arin has no memory before the age of 8 she remembers a void of nothingness, slowly becoming aware of the world around her she began to cry, then started wandering and eventually was discovered by the headmaster who took her to the school, she has been there ever since.  Arin believes herself to be the magic king/demon lord's wife although no official marriage has been arranged, thus she becomes quite jealous of anyone flirting with Arata, however she has stated that she doesn't mind the trinity seven because they are all friends. As time progresses Arin starts to show a little more emotion, such as smiling and blushing when speaking to Arata, the other trinty seven members have commented on this saying that they prefer this side of her.  Arin's Magic is mostly spell based. her branch is chaotic rune which is said to manifest the power of the gods, her magic is capable of overpowering the magic king/demon lord canadit's power once enhanced, and is activated by writing Norse runes in the air. Her magic is highly compatible with Yui's arc symphony.

characters.name: Rika Shinozaki
characters.description: A mace wielder that runs a blacksmith shop in Aincrad on the 48th floor. She made [Asuna](https://anilist.co/character/36828)’s rapier ‘Lament Light’ and one day got a request from [Kirito](https://anilist.co/character/36765) to make him a sword with similar or better quality than his one handed long sword ‘Elucidator’ that he got from a monster drop. She told him that if she had the right materials she could make weapons that would break any sword, so they formed a party and went on a journey to find the material she needed. Because of that journey she came to the conclusion that she felt lonely and yearned for warmth. In ALO she is Leprechaun race blacksmith.   !She comes to realize that she loves Kirito but after finding out that the one Asuna had feelings for was in fact Kirito she decided to give up on him despite how she feels so Asuna could express her feelings, however during the moments after Kirito's victory and SAO's announcement that the game has been cleared she shouts at the top of her lungs that she loves Kirito and that she will meet him again in the real world, which after the ALO incident she actually does, going to school with him and Asuna.!

characters.name: Eiji Nochizawa
characters.description: Eiji is a mysterious young swordsman, who is the top ranked player in Ordinal Scale.

characters.name: Siune
characters.description: She was the second sub-leader of the Sleeping Knights, a guild of terminally ill patients who met in Serene Garden and played various virtual reality games as a form of palliative care. An Si-eun had played a variety of virtual reality games, including Insect Site, until the guild eventually arrived to ALfheim Online, where An Si-eun chose to be an Undine.

characters.name: Keiko Ayano
characters.description: She is a middle level dagger user. She is a very cheerful and sweet girl. She has a very rare familiar, a feathery dragon that she named [Pina](https://anilist.co/character/212810/Pina) after her cat in the real world. She treasured Pina a lot and was the reason she survived in the game. Aside from being a female player, she is also a Beast Tamer and thus perceived as an idol amongst the middle level players. She received endless invitations from parties and guilds who wanted an idol player to join them to get more fame. Because of the attention she got, she became overly proud of herself and left a party one time after a misunderstanding. She got surrounded by monsters and lost Pina in the end. She was then rescued by [Kirito](https://anilist.co/character/36765/Kirigaya-Kazuto) who was passing by and helped her to resurrect the dead familiar.

characters.name: Yui
characters.description: A young and cheerful girl with long black hair who looks no older than 10 years old. [Kirito](https://anilist.co/character/36765) and [Asuna](https://anilist.co/character/36828) found her in a forest on the 22nd floor of Aincrad. !Her true identity is actually a players' self-regulation program for mental maintenance, Mental Health Counseling Program or MHCP. After being forbidden by the game master [Akihiko Kayaba](https://anilist.co/character/36829) to come close to the players at the beginning of the death game, she was flooded with errors and broke down. In the process she became an AI that possesses actual intelligence. When the Cardinal system governing *Sword Art Online* decided to erase her, Kirito turned her into a tear shaped crystal pendant. He actually converted her to a part of environmental data for the client program and was saved to his NerveGear's local memory.!  !In *ALfheim Online*, she was able to return to her normal form because ALO was based on a copy of the SAO server. She supports Kirito there as a Navigation Pixie. Kirito and Asuna still treat her as their daughter.!

characters.name: Yuuna Shigemura
characters.description: Height: 160 cm  Yuuna Shigemura is one of the main characters of the Ordinal Scale arc in Sword Art Online, also known as Yuna. During her childhood, the girl found a passion for singing, especially for the pop genre.

characters.name: Yunyun
characters.description: Yunyun is a member of the Crimson Magic Clan, and she and [Megumin](https://anilist.co/character/89361) are friends as well as rivals.

characters.name: Chomusuke
characters.description: Chomusuke acts as [Megumin](https://anilist.co/character/89361)'s familiar. She is a black cat with a red cross-shaped marking on her forehead and bat like wings. She cannot speak human language, but she seems to be fairly intelligent and can understand human speech to some extent.    !She is actually the other half of Lady Wolbach, who was sealed in the Crimson Demon Village.!

characters.name: Vanir
characters.description: Demon King's army ex-general.

characters.name: Aoi Saitou
characters.description: Instrument: Tenor Saxophone  She is a third-year student who quit the Kitauji brass band, having played the tenor saxophone since junior high school.  Aoi was Kumiko Oumae and Shuuichi Tsukamoto's childhood friend, two years older than them. They lived in the same neighborhood, and often played together, but grew apart as they got older.

characters.name: Mildred F. Fujimura
characters.description: Holding the rank of "second-class non commissioned officer", she is described as a girl with blue eyes and blond hair who wears glasses. She often goes by the nickname "Mily". Her chronological age is close to Origami's thus leading her to have a strange attraction to Origami. She is a mechanic who occasionallyhe gets delusional about others for her own personal fantasy.  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Maki Shijo
characters.description: Maki is a classmate and friend of [Nagisa](https://anilist.co/character/134330). She has short hair styled in short pigtails. She is friends with Nagisa and is secretly jealous of Nagisa's relationship with her boyfriend, as she too liked Kashiwagi's Boyfriend, but could not confess before. As a branch member of the Shinomiya clan, she is [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649)'s second cousin twice removed so she sometimes refers to Kaguya as "Auntie". [Miyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121101) and [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/121102/Yuu-Ishigami) observe she acts very tsundere (cold on the outside but wanting to be affectionate), and similar to Kaguya in personality. She declares Yuu and Miyuki as her friends, due to their support in helping her process her failed romance, much to Kaguya's horror

characters.name: Mafuyu Kirisu
characters.description: Student Counselor at [Yuiga](https://anilist.co/character/121777)'s school and one of [Rizu](https://anilist.co/character/121776) and [Fumino](https://anilist.co/character/121775)'s ex-tutors.  She is a pink-haired individual whose clumsiness (ie. misplacing her keys and a messy house) and being reckless (ie. Can drive at "normal levels" in which it frightens Yuiga) is part of her overall personality. Being a person who isn't close to her parents, she was once a professional skater until she abruptedly stopped due to the fact that her parents had the expectation of being a skater when she only wanted to be a teenage schoolgirl. She tends to give out tough love by sending out mixed signals. She is also abhors cockroaches and had asked Yuiga to stay with her while getting rid of the cockroach with the promise of doing anything for him. Even mentioning cockroach would make Mafuyu scared that she has to interrupt anyone from saying the animal outloud.

characters.name: Asumi Kominami
characters.description: Part-time worker at a maid café called High Stage and classmates with [Yuiga](https://anilist.co/character/121777) at a summer cram school.

characters.name: Chinami Umihara
characters.description: Member of Uruka's swim squad.

characters.name: Fumino Furuhashi
characters.description: **Height:** 165cm  Fumino is a genius with liberal arts but terrible with math. Left-handed. She is a blue-haired girl whose dream is to be able to reach for the stars just as how her mother dreamt of studying the stars. Her father is a professor and teaches Math, but she genetically relates to her mother where they both can't do math. Along with being one of the main heroines of the series, she teaches [Yuiga](https://anilist.co/character/121777) about the feelings of a woman, not knowing that she would later fall for him in the series. She is quite insecure with her chest size, and tends to hurt anyone who makes fun of it, such as [Ogata](https://anilist.co/character/121776) comparing her test scores in which she thought it was a comparison between their chests.

characters.name: Rizu Ogata
characters.description: **Height:** 143cm  Rizu is a genius with math and science but terrible with liberal arts.  Rizu is one of the four students that is being tutored by Yuiga in Liberal Arts. She is smart when it comes to Science and Math, but is terrible with liberal arts. She is also terrible at understanding people's feelings and reading the mood of the conversation. She tends to see everything in a logical manner whenever something related to emotions such love and awkwardness arise.

characters.name: Nariyuki Yuiga
characters.description: Yuiga has been appointed by the principal as [Rizu](https://anilist.co/character/121776) and [Fumino](https://anilist.co/character/121775)'s tutor to get them into their desired universities. Later is also asked to tutor [Uruka](https://anilist.co/character/121778).

characters.name: Uruka Takemoto
characters.description: Uruka is a genius when it comes to sports, having earned several titles in freestyle swimming, but her lazy nature and hatred for studying has made her terrible with her other academics.

characters.name: Mizuki Yuiga
characters.description: She is the younger sister of Nariyuki.

characters.name: Sawako Sekijou
characters.description: She is the President of the chemistry club.

characters.name: Hazuki Yuiga
characters.description: She is a younger sister of [Nariyuki](https://anilist.co/character/121777/Nariyuki-Yuiga) and [Mizuki Yuiga](https://anilist.co/character/129715/Mizuki-Yuiga), and the older twin sister of [Kazuki Yuiga](https://anilist.co/character/205465/Kazuki-Yuiga).

characters.name: Kazuki Yuiga
characters.description: Kazuki Yuiga is the younger brother of Nariyuki Yuiga and the twin brother of Hazuki Yuiga who always try to match Nariyuki with one of his female acquaintances.

characters.name: Ayuko Kuwase
characters.description: Uruka's teammate on the swim team

characters.name: Kashima
characters.description: She is a 3rd-year student who is trying to make sure Fumino doesn't fall in love with someone who clearly has different motives. !She misunderstood the relationship between Nariyuki and Fumino in Question 24, and it seems she still does in another way.!

characters.name: Hassan-i-Sabbah
characters.description: One of the nineteen leaders of the Hashshashin sect who took the name Hassan-i-Sabbah and the mantle of Old man of the Mountain.  In battle, this individual employs throwing daggers and has modified his body with the hand of an evil spirit which curses humans to death.

characters.name: Zouken Matou
characters.description: A shrewd, powerful, but ancient sorcerer, Zoken is the patriarch of the Matou family and is known to be the grandfather of Shinji and Sakura. He has amassed a large and extensive library of sorcerous knowledge, yet his lessons are strict and harsh. Zoken considers Shinji to be a disgrace of a sorcerer and believes Sakura may have more potential than her brother.

characters.name: Benimaru Shinmon
characters.description: Benimaru Shinmon is a hybrid Second and Third Generation, as well as the Captain of Special Fire Force Company 7. Benimaru is regarded as the strongest Fire Officer in the Special Fire Force. He is known as "Asakusa's King of Destruction" because of the devastating power that he is capable of unleashing. He is also an extremely skilled hand-to-hand combatant, as shown when he easily outmaneuvered and overpowered the combined might of [Maki Oze](https://anilist.co/character/130713), [Shinra Kusakabe](https://anilist.co/character/120462), [Tamaki Kotatsu](https://anilist.co/character/130751), [Arthur Boyle](https://anilist.co/character/130715), and [Takehisa Hinawa](https://anilist.co/character/130714). He possesses the rare trait of being a Second and Third Generation, which ultimately allows him to ignite his own flames willingly, and also control flames from an external source. He can use his brigade's matoi as a pole to fly to long-distance areas, and by using his Second Generation ability, can control the flames of other ignited matoi and direct them to a certain place. He can control the direction and speed of bullets in the same fashion as Takehisa. He is also capable of unleashing an immensely powerful blast that resembles a crimson-coloured moon, which is strong enough to kill a Demon Infernal.  Benimaru is a practitioner of the iaido martial arts. Instead of using a sword, he can create a sharp blade of flames, a technique branching from his unique Iai Hand-Sword: First Form fighting style.

characters.name: Leonard Burns
characters.description: He is a Third Generation pyrokinetic, and the Captain of Special Fire Force Company 1.

characters.name: Tooru Kishiri
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Huo Yan Li
characters.description: Height: 184 cm (6' 0½") Affiliation: Special Fire Force Company 1  Huo Yan Li is a Third Generation pyrokinetic and member of the Special Fire Force Company 1.  In contrast to his long-time friends and team-mates Karim Flam and Rekka Hoshimiya, Huo Yan is a rather laid-back and responsible individual, who doesn't like to get worked-up and waste time with meaningless fighting. He abides to the etiquette of the 1st Special Fire Brigade strongly, going as far as to point out formalities, such as a dress code. Despite the revelation of the Church's wrongdoing, Yan still abides by the institution because it gives people hope during tragedies and worships the Sun and Sun God and the good it brings to the world and humanity instead of the malicious ideals of the White Clad and the Evangelist.

characters.name: Tamaki Kotatsu
characters.description: Height: 156 cm (5'1") Affiliation: Special Fire Force Company 8 Rank: Second Class Soldier  !Originally a rookie member of Company 1, she was caught up in the treasonous plot of her superior officer Hoshimiya, and is currently being disciplined under Company 8's watch.! A tough girl with an unfortunate "lucky lecher lure" condition, she nevertheless has a pure heart.  Being a Third Generation, she is immune to being burnt by flames and can use her Ignition Ability to gird herself in pink flames, which grant her various cat-like traits, including cat ears, two forked tails and nails on her fingertips, an ability she dubbed "Nekomata". With her Ignition Ability active, Tamaki's agility and mobility is substantially increased, allowing her to run on all fours. She can use her forked-tails to generate a blast of fire, which is strong enough to break through building walls, restrain her targets in a circle of fire by lengthening them, or using them as a distress signal by the same process.

characters.name: Princess Hibana
characters.description: Hibana is a Third Generation pyrokinetic and Captain of the Special Fire Force Company 5.

characters.name: Karim Flam
characters.description: Karim is a second generation pyrotechnic, a Lieutenant of Special Fire Force Company 1, and priest of the Holy Sol Temple. He is a serious and cautious young man. He shows a high disrespect towards strangers, which can result in him insulting people.

characters.name: Konro Sagamiya
characters.description: Is a Third Generation pyrokinetic and is the Lieutenant of Special Fire Force Company 7. He is a very loyal subordinate of Benimaru Shinmon, willing to sacrifice his health and life to protect his friend if needed.

characters.name: Shinra Kusakabe
characters.description: Height: 173 cm (5'8") Affiliation: Special Fire Force Company 8 Rank: Second Class Soldier  Since being accused of using his powers to cause the fire that took his family, his face's habit of tensing up into a bizarre smile when he gets nervous has earned him the derisive nickname of "devil". He joined the Fire Force to achieve his dream of becoming a hero and saving people from the fear of the flames, as well as uncover the truth behind his family's death twelve years ago.  Though a newcomer in the Special Fire Force, Shinra has posed a challenge to experienced members of the force and has even defeated a Captain. Being a Fire Soldier, Shinra is experienced in rescuing people and is strong enough to carry four people out of a building. While he mostly relies on his Ignition Ability in combat, he has exhibited skill in ordinary fighting as well, being able to pin an opponent to the ground and break their guard with a sturdy kick, as well as being capable of defending himself from ground-breaking attacks.

characters.name: Iris
characters.description: Height: 154 cm (5'0) Affiliation: Special Fire Force Company 8 Rank: Nun  A sister of the Holy Sol Temple, her prayers are an indispensable part of extinguishing Infernals. Personality-wise she is no less than an angel.

characters.name: Akitaru Oubi
characters.description: Height: 189 cm (6'2") Affiliation: Special Fire Force Company 8 Rank: Captain  The popular and charismatic leader of the newly established Company 8. His goal is to investigate the other companies and uncover the truth about spontaneous human combustion. He has no powers, but uses his finely-honed muscles as a weapon in a battle style that's on even par with [Benimaru](https://anilist.co/character/130848)'s. Loves bodybuilding to an almost creepy extent.  Despite not being a Pyrokinetic like most other known Battalion Commanders, Akitaru has a very fit physique, which allows him to face Infernals. In battle, he is seen using different weapons, suitable for the situation, like the Core Annihilating Pile Bunker or a fire fighting axe, which he can veil in white steam and thrust at the opponent. His weapons appear to be designed in order to impale an Infernal's core with low difficulty. He is able to carry up to 30kg of equipment each time he is on a mission to fight an Infernal. As a fire fighter, Akitaru was recognized enough to be decorated twice, though both were revoked due to actions prioritising saving citizens lives at the expense of defying orders.

characters.name: Maki Oze
characters.description: Height: 167 cm (5'6") Affiliation: Special Fire Force Company 8 Rank: First Class Fire Soldier  A former member of the military, she is an excellent fighter who controls fire. She's a cool lady but is mad about love stories, and her beauty is overshadowed by her "head full of flowers and wedding bells". She's friendly but goes berserk when anyone comments on her muscles. Apparently,​ she used to be slender.  Maki possesses Second Generation abilities, having adapted to Spontaneous Human Combustion by becoming able to control flames from a long distance. In doing so, she can handle herself against two Third Generations simultaneously, being able to extinguish and absorb their generated flames into a giant fireball. Maki's abilities provide defense for her entire team, as she can reflect incoming fire attacks and use an opponent's flames against them. While she is unable to deflect or redirect a fire with too much driving force, she is still able to alter its shape in order to reduce its impact.

characters.name: Takehisa Hinawa
characters.description: Height: 180 cm (5'11") Affiliation: Special Fire Force Company 8 Rank: Lieutenant  A dry, unemotional ex-military man, whose stern disciplina is feared among the new recruits. He helped Obi to found Company 8. He never allows the soldiers to play with fire. The gun he uses is a cherished memento from his friend who became an Infernal.  Takehisa is a Second Generation, who has awakened the ability to manipulate flames through the use of firearms, such as a machine gun or a pistol, which he wields on the battlefield. Takehisa's ability allows him to control the gunpowder inside bullets, making the impact they make stronger or weaker, depending on the situation. He can use this ability to make his bullets non-lethal.

characters.name: Arthur Boyle
characters.description: **Height:** 174 cm  He trained at the academy with [Shinra](https://anilist.co/character/120462/Kusakabe-Shinra). Although he follows his own personal code of chivalry as the self-proclaimed Knight King, he is incredibly stupid. But girls love him.   Being a Third Generation Pyrokinetic, Arthur has been identified by individuals as having a strong will of fire. By raising the temperature of the flames he creates, he can fabricate and control plasma, which either elevates or diminishes in relation to Arthur's disarrangement from reality. The more delusional he is, the stronger Arthur becomes.  Being able to use his Ignition Ability on hilt-like objects, Arthur can weld, cut through metal, and generate electricity. He mainly uses his ability on his blade-less sword Excalibur, which is most effective using his right hand and cannot be easily extinguished by an experienced Second Generation. Using it, he can deflect and fend off against flames.

characters.name: Tadatsuru Teori
characters.description: Tadatsuru Teori was a dollmaster and another Oddity specialist. Similar to Yozuru Kagenui, he specialized in immortal oddities. In particular, he specialized in dead oddities rather than living ones like Kagenui. As a stray specialist, Tadatsuru was obsessed with oddities and viewed them as beautiful creatures and even sometimes captured them for himself.  Tadatsuru was also involved in Izuko Gaen's group in college that included Meme Oshino, Yozuru Kagenui, and Deishuu Kaiki known as the Occult Research Club. Due to their different interests in oddities, Tadatsuru and Kagenui didn't get along well. After the group created Yotsugi Ononoki and she chose Kagenui over him as her master, they've been rivals ever since.

characters.name: Petra Leyte
characters.description: Petra is a bright and kind girl from Irlam Village. She likes [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) very much after he saved her from the Wolgarm incident.  !She became a maid at the Roswaal Mansion after Subaru came back from the witchcult incident. !

characters.name: Otto Suwen
characters.description: Otto Suwen is a merchant appearing in  Re:Zero. His remarkable misfortune always takes him to dangerous situations, from which he escapes thanks to his wit. Otto has gray hair that is mentioned to be as long as a gal game protagonist. He is said to be somewhat handsome if he has a serious expression. However, he is usually either retorting, shouting, or panicking, ruining his looks. He has a medium build, but has trained himself since he used to work as a merchant.

characters.name: Garfiel Tinsel
characters.description: Garfiel Tinsel is the former guardian of the Sanctuary and a member of the Emilia Camp. Introduced during Arc 4, he became one of the main supporting characters of the season. He's a half-beast human and [Frederica Baumann's](https://anilist.co/character/143378/Baumann-Frederica) half-brother. He can transform himself in a giant golden tiger that can deal powerful attacks but with a cost of losing his reason, so he uses this ability when he's pushed to the limit.  !Garfiel and Frederica lived together until she left when he was around 4 years old and he hadn't seen her since until their reunion 10 years later during the Sanctuary incident. After seeing his mother's "death" during the trial at a young age, he began to fear the outside world, causing him to try and protect the Sanctuary.!

characters.name: Rem
characters.description: Height: 154 cm (5'1")  Rem is one of the twin maids working for [Roswaal L Mathers](https://anilist.co/character/90182/Mathers-L-Roswaal). She has medium length sky blue hair that covers her right eye, large light blue eyes, and young features. She also has hair clips towards left side of her hair, flower-shaped ribbon on the same side of her hair, and a maid hairband. She looks nearly identical to her sister [Ram](https://anilist.co/character/88576) apart from her hair, eyes, and ribbon coloring. She usually wears a maid uniform, and since her chest is slightly larger than her sister's, she secretly changes the measurements to hide it. Rem tends to speak in a superficially polite manner and sometimes acts without thinking. She holds both respect to the point of worship and guilt toward her sister for an incident in the past. Because of her respect and guilt toward her sister, she used to think of herself as inferior.

characters.name: Meili Portroute
characters.description: One of the children that lives in the village within [Roswaal](https://anilist.co/character/90182)'s region. She's timid, though is friendly, such as when she introduces a small dog to [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573).  !Meili Portroute is a Demon Beast User.!

characters.name: Hitomi Shizuki
characters.description: Madoka and Sayaka's classmate and friend, who is quite popular with the boys. She attends after-school classes in Piano, Japanese dance and Tea ceremony, feeling obliged to make time for them even when she might reasonably be expected to focus on her studies.    !She has feelings for Kyousuke, just like Sayaka.!  (Source: Puella Magi Wikia)

characters.name: Kyuubey
characters.description: He is a familiar who can grant any wish to a certain girl, on the condition that she becomes a Puella Magi and fights against witches.  !When someone makes a contract with him, he extracts their soul and places it inside a Soul Gem, replacing their body with a shell that's more resilient to fighting witches.  He has made contracts with Mami, Kyoko, Homura, and Sayaka, and shows particular interest in making Madoka a Puella Magi. It is unknown if there are other familiars besides him. He can only be seen or heard by Puella Magi and those who have potential to become a Puella Magi. He also disposes of used Grief Seeds for the Puella Magi, because, if they are used too extensively, the witch could become reborn from the Grief Seed. He also constantly tries to find chances to persuade girls who have potential to become Puella Magi to form a contract with him, despite the fact that he knows the dangers that Puella Magi face. Much to his dismay, he cannot force a girl to become a Puella Magi.  He doesn't fully understand human values and questions any perceived differences between himself and humans. For example, when Madoka claims that he is cruel for forming contracts with girls and turning them into Puella Magi, he compares his actions to the act of humans slaughtering livestock, saying that, unlike humans, who show a lack of interest and sympathy for other creatures' values when it comes to their own survival, he at least recognizes humans as being sentient beings and tries to negotiate with them. Therefore, Kyuubey is neither evil nor good, just a survivor like everyone else. !
