Although in love with Yu, she takes for granted that they've known each other for years and didn't stop to think about his feelings when she hangs out with Koyuki or Haruki. She doesn't think much of Koyuki's intention to take her out to something she likes, thinking that his intentions were completely platonic.  She often compares herself to Miou and Akari in terms of what to be as girls and as fellow artists, given that they're always winning critical reception and Natsuki is very small time. She tries to hold herself to standards she can't reach and doesn't know what she wants out of life. When touching upon subjects with heavy weight to them, she dances around ideas by shifting the conversation to something else, and saves the conversation for a later date.

characters.name: Kotarou Enomoto
characters.description: Height: 160 cm (5'3″)  The younger brother of Natsuki Enomoto. Like his sister, Kotaro is a very emotive person. He's very quick to anger and annoy.

characters.name: Koyuki Ayase
characters.description: **Height:** 163 cm (5'4")  Koyuki was never really confident in himself throughout the story, especially from being picked on for his effeminate looks and name. In school activities, he didn't participate in many of them due to his lack of self-confidence and his weak constitution. He does, however, enjoy reading manga, and bonded with Natsuki because of it.  When it comes to love, he seems to have made peace with the fact that Natsuki liked someone else, and advises those that talk to him about love to not make the same mistakes he himself made.

characters.name: Sena Narumi
characters.description: **Height:** 160 cm (5'2")  Sena, in concept, is the kind of person girls would look up to and the type of girl boys would like to date. She is positive, friendly, and has strong self worth, preferring to live true to herself. Where family is concerned, she shows her support on her sleeve. Her personality ends up inspiring other cast members such as Arisa and her younger sister. Where it concerns romance, Sena is shy at first, but once in the relationship she's best described as assertive. Rather than being led around by her lover, Sena instead initiates contact in dates.  She is a teen fashion model, having been scouted in middle school. Besides being a public personality, Sena is also a fashion designer and the in-universe creator of the HANICOS makeup brand and the Honey×Honey fashion brand.  (Source: Love Committee Wiki)

characters.name: Ken Shibasaki
characters.description: **Height:** 167 cm (5'5")  Ken's major priority is women, and he doesn't like to hide it. Often seen flirting around with his female classmates, Ken enjoys talking about them and frequently goes on dates with different girls. Despite his lax attitude with them, Ken is nicer to girls than he is with guys, and looks out for them from afar rather than actively. With friends, he's nothing but cheerful and joking, often teasing them to their annoyance. His seemingly carefree attitude does hide a serious side underneath, but he buries it under positive interactions and playful banter. Whatever criticism he gets is also seemingly washed over, but he takes it to heart and stews over it when he's not interacting with friends. Back when he was a child, he was much more shy and not likely to stand out. He couldn't make any friends as a result, and cried often. His personality change in middle and high school reflects that.

characters.name: Koudai Yamamoto
characters.description: **Height:** 172 cm (5'8")  A Sakuragaoka High School student in Class 1-1, and a friend and member of the "Idiot Trio" consisting of himself, Kotaro Enomoto, and Ken Shibasaki.  Of the Idiot Trio, Kodai is by far the most levelheaded member. He's not one to lose his head over minor inconveniences, but does make his anger and displeasure known in subtle ways, such as a change of tone or sarcasm. Otherwise he's quiet and out of the way, watching everyone from the sidelines. Has a calm personality.  In addition, he's attentive and willing to hear his friends and others out. Whenever Ken or Kotaro have the chance to talk to him alone, they always end up spilling out their thoughts, and he's ready to provide support or an answer to their worries.

characters.name: Arisa Takamizawa
characters.description: **Height:** 150 cm (4'9")  Arisa is one of the first year students in Sakuragaoka High School, a friend of Kotaro Enomoto, and the primary love interest of Ken Shibasaki.  In middle school, Arisa was shown to be somewhat submissive until the bullying incident, going along with what the rest of the class says or does even if she was uncomfortable with it. It was a big weak point for her, given how compassionate she is otherwise, but she is one to own up to her feelings if given a proper push. She's a very courageous and outgoing girl following the incident, however. She's willing to stick up for her friends, offers them her protection, and also tries to talk with them more. She still has problems with communicating though, given that she feels insecure about the incident and she hates the feeling of being alone.   (Source: Love Committee Wikia)

characters.name: Shinjiro Aragaki
characters.description: Height: 177 cm (5'10") Persona: Castor  Shinjiro is Akihiko’s good friend, as well as a Senior in Gekkoukan High School. In battle, Shinjiro wields a hefty axe and relies on his brute strength. His Persona uses physical attacks. Tough-talking, foul-mouthed Shinjiro was one of the original Persona users who made up SEES, alongside Akihiko and Mitsuru. However, during one fateful mission his Persona went out of control and accidentally killed an innocent bystander: Ken’s mother. Shinjiro forced himself away from the group after the incident. He began skipping school and living as an outcast. He also started doing shady deals with Strega, in order to get drugs that could help control his Persona. Shinjiro and Akihiko stayed in touch, but Shinjiro refused Akihiko's invitations to rejoin SEES until he learned that Ken had signed up for the group. He was fully aware of Ken's desire for revenge and ready to take responsibility for his actions. Though he put on a brave front, the guilt of having killed an innocent woman ate away at him.       ! On the second Full Moon mission after he rejoined SEES, Shinjiro meets Ken at the site where Ken's mother was killed. Shinjiro has no intentions to resist to Ken's attempt to extract revenge, but warns the boy that if he carries, he could end up just like Shinjiro. As Ken struggles to go through with his plan, the two are interrupted by Takaya. Takaya takes a shot at Ken and Shinjiro jumps in front of the bullet, ending his own life. He earns Ken's respect and inspires Akihiko's resolve with this final sacrifice. Later the members of SEES discover that the drugs Shinjiro was taking were slowly killing him. During his final confrontation with Nyx, the Main Character hears Shinjiro's voice cheering him on, along with the voices of the living SEES members.!

characters.name: Pharos
characters.description: A mysterious young boy who the main character sees in his dreams from time to time. The boy speaks of "The Fall" and the end, but his memories seem to be fragmented. He feels a strong bond of friendship with the Main Character.     !After all twelve of the Arcana Shadows are defeated, Pharos regains his memories and leaves the Main Character's mind. It turns out that Pharos was a part of Death that Aigis imprisoned within the Main Character when the Main Character was only a small child. When Pharos escapes the Main Character's psyche, he takes on the physical form of Ryoji Mochizuki. !

characters.name: Elizabeth
characters.description: Elizabeth resides in the Velvet Room with Igor. Elizabeth's tendencies to act on impulse and to not take dangerous things and situations seriously often result in either baffling or even enraging (often the enemy) those involved in the crisis with her surprisingly cool demeanor. However, she is often humorously disrespectful towards her brother Theodore, such as feeding dog food to him without his prior knowledge, and in the Q series, would often force him to wear strange clothing when he is in charge of a service. While Igor takes care of Persona Fusions, Elizabeth watches over the Persona Compendium and gives the Main Character bounties to complete with rewards in return. If the player chooses to start the second playthrough, a new request will open which asks you to defeat her, the ultimate opponent. If the player chooses to accept the request, she reveals herself to be a Persona-user just like the Main Character, also capable of switching between multiple Personae mid-battle. She can be considered the "ultimate opponent" seeing as she is much stronger than "Nyx Avatar" and the fabled "Reaper". !In Persona 4, she leaves the Velvet Room to free the soul of the Protagonist of Persona 3 from the seal of Nyx. Her older sister Margaret has taken over as Igor's assistant and the holder of the Persona Compendium.!

characters.name: Igor
characters.description: A mysterious, long-nosed gentleman who resides in the Velvet Room. As in the other Persona games, Igor's purpose is to assist the player in acquiring new powers and Persona. At the end of the game, because the Main Character has fulfilled his contract, Igor uses the power of the Main Character's social links to forge a Persona of the World Arcana with the power to change reality. Igor states that he had never thought to see such power during his lifetime. He also makes an appearance in the anime sequel, Persona -trinity soul-, meeting with the protagonist Shin Kanzato as a fortune teller. He tells Shin that they have met before in the Velvet Room.

characters.name: Saichi Sugimoto
characters.description: A demobilized soldier who survived the Russo-Japanese War in 1904. He served in the 1st Division of the Imperial Japanese Army and fought in the battle of 203 Hill. He was feared for his savage fighting style and amazing toughness on the battle field, and was known as "Immortal Sugimoto". He decides to make money to save his dead comrade [Toraji](https://anilist.co/character/131880)'s wife, [Umeko](https://anilist.co/character/131882).

characters.name: Hyakunosuke Ogata
characters.description: Ogata is the former Superior Private of the 7th Division and a member of [Hijikata](https://anilist.co/character/125422/Hijikata-Toshizou)'s Group. Loyal only to himself, Ogata is pursuing the gold for his own reason, unknown to anyone.  Ogata is analytical and coldblooded, a proud sniper who is used to examining things from afar and evaluating circumstances in order to best take advantage of them. Even when at a disadvantage, he keeps his nerve and takes the most efficient course of action. He is also known for his marksmanship, a skill he honed since his childhood. He is ruthless and doesn't hesitate to kill, although he is aware that wanton slaughter is counterproductive, and would rather escape a fight he can't win than throw himself into it impulsively.  On the surface, Ogata is capable of acting amiable and polite; in order to achieve his goals, he can lie and deceive others. He is prone to caustic remarks and may openly look down on some people. Ogata also likes to snark about any perceived absurdity and incompetence, especially if it comes to warfare and keeping one's gun safe. Although he is generally emotionless and indifferent to others, Ogata seems to be a very proud man who doesn't like to be doubted. If challenged, he would attempt to do a task that someone says would be difficult for him. He has a habit of slicking his hair back, as well as exhaling through his nose when praised.  !Ogata can speak Russian, something which seems to be a secret or not well known, as [Koito](https://anilist.co/character/128971/Koito-Otonoshin) was surprised to hear him speak the language.!  (Source: Golden Kamuy Wiki)

characters.name: Genjirou Tanigaki
characters.description: The Private First Class of the 7th Division and a Matagi of Tohoku. He seems to have a frail and low self-esteem, being shown to cry easily under heavy criticism.  Tanigaki is a Japanese man from Akita, around the age of [Sugimoto](https://anilist.co/character/124704/Sugimoto-Saichi) and the Nikaidou twins, with a muscular body and body hair. He has dark brown eyes, short, black hair, a thin beard along his jawline, and thick eyebrows. Since his and Nihei Tetsuzou's fight against Sugimoto's group, he has a little scar on his right cheek from a wound caused by Sugimoto's knife.

characters.name: Tokushirou Tsurumi
characters.description: Likes: Japanese sweets (Wagashi) Dislikes: Alcohol  Leader of the 7th Division and one of the antagonists of the series.  Tsurumi has an unpredictable, mildly histrionic and erratic behaviour. However, In the past, Tsurumi was normal and was even a brave Japanese officer who fought at the front during the Russo-Japanese war.  Receiving a shrapnel in the head and the general bitterness at the poor treatment his division has received after the war has made Tsurumi psychotic and violent, though some of his manipulative tendencies may have been present even before the injury. He is prone to threatening people and personally inflicting physical injury on his enemies but hides his brutal tendencies under a veneer of sophistication and sympathy. He also genuinely admires the macabre work of Edogai and develops a friendship with him. Tsurumi never becomes angry, but coldly manifests his rage with a brutal gesture, perhaps due to his brain damage.  Tsurumi aims to take over Hokkaido and is very ruthless in his methods. He kills anyone in his way or threatens his plan. He seems to still hold the men under his command in high regard but hates traitors. He has shown a level of care for his subordinates as seen when he tries to get Nikaidou to eat his food and provide prosthetic limbs for him.  Tsurumi is also a very charismatic and manipulative man that can sway the minds of other people with a powerful and explosive speech. As a result, he is not above lying to other people if it is to get what he desires, such as loyal and strong followers.

characters.name: Tatsuma Ushiyama
characters.description: One of the Abashiri Convicts. Ushiyama is a pragmatic and serious criminal. Aiming to steal the Ainu gold, Ushiyama is focused on his mission and always threads with prudence, regularly offering reasonable advice to Hijikata.  He is also a womanizer. Ushiyama lusts after any beautiful woman he comes across and is very direct when he solicits sex. It is his main way of distracting himself. He claims that in a relationship, a man's penis is the most important factor, but says that it has to be "gentlemanly".  As a judoka, Ushiyama relishes fights and challenges. When he met Sugimoto, he was impressed favorably by his strength and befriended him. He likes to fight and had a great time clashing with Sugimoto, being disappointed when it was interrupted. Ushiyama is confident in his fighting prowess to the point he will challenge a (weakened) bear in combat and even briefly taunts it about spreading his legend among bears when he forces it to flee.

characters.name: Kouhei Nikaidou
characters.description: Kouhei Nikaidou is the Private First Class of the 7th Division and Youhei's older twin brother.  Like his brother, he has a well accented face with a thin, pointed nose. His eyes have the rounded shape of black color equal to his hair cut very short. He is seen wearing the uniform of his ward.  !After the death of his twin brother Youhei, Nikaidou became focused on revenge against Sugimoto.  He seems to have a strong craving for morphine as just the mere mention of it was able to get his full attention.!  !Kouhei loses a multitude of his body parts throughout the story. He lost: His left ear to a bear when hunting for Tanigaki, his right ear when Tsurumi cut it off after catching him following said hunt, his right leg to Hijikata's ambush inside Edogai's house as well as his right hand when he tried to shoot Sugimoto after his failed ambush in Abashiri Prison.  He gets prosthetic limbs for his leg and hand made by Narizou Arisaka. The prosthetic limb has a hidden gun in it.  !

characters.name: Otonoshin Koito
characters.description: Koito Otonoshin is a Second Lieutenant of the 7th Division.  Koito is a tall, dark-skinned man with dark hair. He has his side part slicked down to the left. His eyebrows are usually furrowed, with two larger sections towards the center, and furrow wrinkles up his forehead. His eyes are black, thin, and have deep eye bags.  Because Koito is from the Satsuma Province, which is located in the southern tip of Japan, his dialect slips out sometimes. This often happens when he is excited or nervous. However, this dialect cannot be understood by most Japanese speakers.

characters.name: Toshizou Hijikata
characters.description: Hijikata is the vice-commander of the Shinsengumi and leader of his group. Despite being emprisoned for decades, he remains energetic and optimistic.  Hijikata is very ambitious despite his old age and plans to take over Hokkaido and create his own country in defiance of Japan. To do so, he takes swift and decisive action to search for the gold. As a former Shinsengumi, Hijikata is ruthless and doesn't hesitate to kill his opponents. Always smiling, Hijikata is flamboyant and regularly boasts about his ambitions and prowess despite his age. He is civil toward people but merciless against his enemies, always shouting to his men to kill every opponent. Hijikata considers that in battle, the best soldiers are those ready to die fighting.  (Source: Golden Kamuy Wiki)

characters.name: Shinpachi Nagakura
characters.description: Nagakura Shinpachi is a member of Hijikata's Group and regarded as the best swordsman in the Shinsengumi.

characters.name: Yoshitake Shiraishi
characters.description: One of the Abashiri Convicts who travels with Sugimoto's Group.   Shiraishi is carefree and goofy, and prefers to sneak his way out of trouble. He is also rather immature. Most of the time, Shiraishi lacks seriousness and prefers to spend time on frivolous pursuits like gambling or eating rather than looking for the gold. He also likes pretty women; his backstory involves him searching for a woman he fell in love with through a sloppy drawing.  Shiraishi has a roguish personality. Because he lacks strength, he prefers to flee danger but is confident in his ability to escape any bond. He tends to keep his calm when in danger as a result and given time, can psychologically dominate his guards and manipulate them.  Shiraishi is based on the real life figure _Yoshie Shiratori_ who is known for having escaped from prison at least four times.

characters.name: Asirpa
characters.description: Asirpa is an Ainu girl who finds [Sugimoto](https://anilist.co/character/124704/Sugimoto-Saichi) when he is attacked by a bear. Her father was one of the Ainu killed by the Japanese who stole the Ainu gold. Her Japanese name is Asuko Kochoube (小蝶辺明日子).  From a young age, Asirpa was trained by her father to become a hunter. As such, she possesses many skills that are necessary for a successful hunter: trapping, poison brewing, knowledge of traditional medicine, archery, deep knowledge of Hokkaido's flora and fauna, harsh winter survival. Asirpa is also a great cook and can prepare many traditional Ainu dishes from the animals she hunts, along with what she forages in the forest.

characters.name: Kiroranke
characters.description: An Ainu and an old friend of Asirpa's father.

characters.name: Ex
characters.description: Position: Legendary Holy Sword Special Skills: Resonates with the wielder's magical power to increase sharpness. Can cut through any kind of magic.  A holy sword that can only be used by the chosen one. Best in close combat out of The Three Great Holy Swords. The day before Princess was captured, the blade portion was detached and sent for repairs. The current blade is merely a temporary replacement.

characters.name: Youki
characters.description: Position: Lieutorment (Intermediate Torturer) Special Skills: Reflex based games. Making potato chips from scratch.  During her school years she was active in the Basketball Club. She received even more chocolate than the most popular boys did on Valentine's Day. Interested in silver accessories but can't afford them.

characters.name: Hime
characters.description: Position: Princess, Commander of The Third Legion of The Imperial Army  Eldest daughter of the king, and commander of The Third Legion of The Imperial Army. While The Third Legion is only considered average, Princess herself would outskill even the top ranks of The First Legion in one-on-one combat, or so they say. Has a younger sister.   Her special skills are sword techniques and swordsmanship in general as well as FPS games.

characters.name: Inki
characters.description: Position: Lieutorment (Intermediate Torturer) Favorite Food: Fugashi, okaki, and lobster. Special Skills: Strategy games, claw machines.  She joined The Basketball Club at Youki's invitation, but ended up quitting on the first day. Good at housework since both her parents have careers. She has two younger brothers.

characters.name: Maou
characters.description: **Favorite Food:** Beer, plum wine, mayonnaise, and curry.  He is the most powerful and invincible three-eyed monster, standing at the pinnacle of all demons. He has a terrifying, charismatic presence and a dignified appearance, but his true face is that of a doting father who dotes on his only daughter, [Maomao](https://anilist.co/character/151038/Maomao). He also has an otaku side, such as following voice actors and watching Sunday morning TV shows.

characters.name: Giant
characters.description: Position: Class 4 Warrior and Junior Torturer Favorite Food: Manju, Miso Soup, and Chikuzenni. Special Skills: Coming up with travel plans, sauna.  No one has ever seen Giant fight or perform a torture. She is great at maintaining and cleaning bathrooms. "When in doubt about travel plans, go to Giant" is a saying within the Hellhorde.

characters.name: Jimochi
characters.description: **Favorite Food:** Sweets and snacks.  He is an "honorary knight" who has served the kingdom for many years and been awarded medals for his numerous military achievements. After retiring, he serves the kingdom as a butler and is tasked with keeping a strict watch over the princess, but he has a bit of a soft spot for her, secretly buying her sweets on the way home from lessons or making detours to Chinese restaurants.

characters.name: Krall
characters.description: Position: Top-Class Warrior and Harm-Marshall (Senior Torturer) Favorite Food:  Trendy foods, Cute foods, Yakiniku. Special Skills: Controlling fierce beasts at will. Learned to swim after taking lessons and now excels at long-distance swimming.  Besides combat, she can use the power of beasts to plow wasteland into fields and demolish abandoned towns to free up the land. Never leaves leftovers if the food is good.

characters.name: Gilga
characters.description: **Favorite Food:** Caesar salad and prosciutto.  Weaponsmith and Junior Torturer. Obtained her Torturer license specifically to “torture” the Holy Sword [Ex](https://anilist.co/character/151040/Ex). She wields her weapons with undeniable skill, relentlessly tormenting Ex. She's on friendly terms with [Torture](https://anilist.co/character/151039/Tortura-Torture) in private, addressing her with the informal “-chan” suffix.

characters.name: Vanilla Peschutz
characters.description: Position: Harm-Marshal (Senior Tourturer) Favorite Food:  Roast Beef, Scones. Special Skills: Daughter of the illustrious Peschutz line. Excels at everything (self-proclaimed.) Good at needle felting to make small mascots (according to her parents.)  The Vampire Clan has been around for a long time. Nowadays they don't suck blood directly but instead eat foods rich in iron for nourishment. Their clan is sensitive to the sun. If they spend a long time in sunshine, their skin will get red and irritated the next day.

characters.name: Lulune
characters.description: Position: Bookstore Employee Favorite Food: Chocolate Cake, Anything filled with Whipped Cream, Ramen, Karaage. Special Skills: Cracking eggs with one hand. Doing the back hip circle. Quick at calculating multiples of seven. Great at playing tag.  She's basically a housewife, but she occasionally helps out at her parents' bookstore. She likes landscape photography books and illustrated encyclopedias.

characters.name: Kanadge
characters.description: **Favorite Food:** Steak and sushi.  An excellent aide to the Demon King. Rumor has it that he is the second most powerful in the Demon King's army in terms of combat. He originally joined the Demon King's army as a part-time cleaner, but due to a manpower shortage he began helping out in various ways, eventually becoming a close aide to the Demon King.

characters.name: Maomao
characters.description: Position: Hyper Senior Apprentice Torturer Favorite Food: French Fries, Chocolate Ice Cream, and Apple Juice. Special Skills: Kendama.  Hell-Lord's only daughter. She works as an apprentice torturer to gain experience, but since her rank is Hyper Senior Apprentice, she outranks even The Grand Inquisitor. Her salary is getting a piece of candy when going shopping with her mom.

characters.name: Tortura Torture
characters.description: Position: Grand Inquisitor (Supreme Torturer) Favorite Food: Sake, Wine, Squid Shiokara, Anchovies, and Chocolate. Special Skills: "Torture" with good, sewing.  She was scouted to join Hellhorde after they witnessed her reaction to delicious food at a restaurant. She always visits her parents during every holiday. Her younger sister and her sister's husband live at her parents' house, so Torture has been telling them to just clear out and repurpose her old room. But if they actually went through with it, she'd secretly miss it.

characters.name: Mashirao Ojiro
characters.description: Height: 169 cm (5'6") Quirk: Tail  Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School.  Mashirao has a very calm and noble attitude and a profound sense of dignity, which prevents him from accepting results he doesn't feel he earned with his own abilities. He is also described as a hard worker. Along with a strong sense of dignity, Mashirao can be described as sheepish and bashful, not very often enjoying the spotlight and being easily embarrassed. A recurring joke is that others view Mashirao as "plain," which profoundly upsets him.  Mashirao's Quirk is that he has a long, powerful, sturdy tail. His tail effectively functions as a third arm that he can use to grab things. Furthermore, it's attack power is strong enough to break objects made of metal, he can wrap it around enemies, and it can support Mashirao's body weight. Mashirao is incredibly adept at using his tail, combining it with his knowledge of martial arts to engage enemies in close-range combat, performing fast and acrobatic moves. His tail can also increase his speed and mobility by whipping it down against the ground to use it like a springboard.  (Source: My Hero Academia Wiki)

characters.name: Mezou Shouji
characters.description: Height: 187 cm (6'2") Quirk: Dupli-Arms  Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School.  Shouji is friendly and gentle, and he will work nicely with anyone. He is not the type to hold grudges, showing no ill will towards those that harm him unwillingly. Shouji is entirely selfless and willing to risk his life for anyone. He can be empathetic and understanding, but still shows a sense of maturity and responsibility that prevents him from acting under emotional impulses. He is very protective of his classmates, especially if they are hurt or injured. He is also quite thick-skinned, as he said he is used to being feared due to his appearance.  Shouji's Quirk grants him a set of tentacles alongside his arms. He can transform the tips of these tentacles to replicate other parts of his body (ex: mouth, ears, eyes). The duplicated body parts are more efficient than the originals; as a result, Mezo is able to hear better, see-through more angles at a time, and they grant him much higher degrees of strength. He uses these arms to talk most of the time through duplicate mouths, rather than his actual mouth.

characters.name: Nejire Hadou
characters.description: Height: 164 cm (5'4") Occupation: Student Quirk: Wave Motion (ability to convert body's vitality into energy that can discharge as blast waves)  She is third-year student at U.A. High School and is part of The Big 3 _(the strongest three hero students in all of Japan)_.   Nejire is very enthusiastic, affable and cheery, and is always seen moving. She shows great interest in people's unique physical features and is easily distracted by them. She seems to like knowing more than others, but not in a proud way, as she just enjoys explaining things to people and sharing her knowledge.  Despite her happy-go-lucky personality, Nejire is fierce in battle. When the situation calls for it, Nejire can be very calm and focused. Her curiosity never seems to extend to the enemy and she always maintains her focus on taking them down.

characters.name: Ryou Kurokiba
characters.description: Ryou Kurokiba is a 92nd Toutsuki Generation Student and Alice Nakiri's aide.  Generally lazy and gloomy, Ryou's personality drastically shifts once he puts on his bandana, becoming aggressive, short-tempered, and brash. He grew up in a port town in Denmark, where he became the head chef of a pub due to his commanding personality and great skill. Due to his heritage, he is an expert in seafood and he can judge the quality of any and all seafood with only a glance. Mainly seen to be beside Alice Nakiri and has known her since childhood.

characters.name: Shun Ibusaki
characters.description: Shun is presumably known his senior, Isshiki Satoshi better than anyone else as he was stayed much longer than the rest of the Polar Star Gang.  Unlike his passionate room mates, Shun is very realistic on the terms and very serious upon making his style in perfection. Shun is also a quiet student who prefer speak only whenever is considered as crucial by many. It is also once claimed that he is a calculative chef whose choose to act wisely over hesitation.

characters.name: Takumi Aldini
characters.description: Height: 168 cm  Takumi is the oldest nephew of the owner of the Trattoria Aldini, a trattoria (family-style restaurant) located in Florence, Italy. He is half-Japanese but, unlike his brother [Isami](https://anilist.co/character/85785/Aldini-Isami), appears more European – with blond hair and blue eyes – and is noted as being extremely handsome, having fan clubs in Toutsuki Academy and his hometown. He enrolled in Tōtsuki at the behest of his uncle, taking with him his mezzaluna (two-handed knife) and a bottle of homemade olive oil as a good luck charm. His specialty is Italian cuisine, although many professional chefs noted that he has a broad vision; like [Souma](https://anilist.co/character/75216/Yukihira-Souma), he will incorporate ingredients and methods from other culinary styles to create inventive dishes, and can modify his recipes while cooking. He is very kind and supportive of his less-skilled brother, to the point of risking his pride to defend Isami's honor.  Takumi has a fierce (and somewhat one-sided) rivalry with Sōma. Takumi sees Sōma as someone similar to himself – both having grown-up working at small family restaurants – and a worthy rival, and jumps at any chance to compete with him. He frequently tries to challenge Sōma to informal cooking challenges (usually leading to an embarrassing situation for himself), hoping to one day defeat Sōma in a formal Shokugeki. Despite their rivalry, both he and Sōma greatly respect each other, and likely view each other as friends outside of the arena.  Takumi and his brother Isami are the main characters of the Shokugeki no Soma – Fratelli Aldini spinoff manga which focuses on their time in Italy before going to Tōtsuki Academy.

characters.name: Fumio Daimidou
characters.description: She is the warden and guardian of Polar Star Dormitory.

characters.name: Urara Kawashima
characters.description: Urara is a 92nd Toutsuki Generation student and a popular idol at Toutsuki Culinary Academy. She is often an emcee for many of the academy's grand events.

characters.name: Minaho Ono
characters.description: Teacher at Karasuno High School. She is often seen teaching [Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/64769/Shouyou-Hinata)'s classes, overseeing tests, and working in the staff room. She supervises Hinata and [Kageyama](https://anilist.co/character/64771/Tobio-Kageyama) while they took their make-up exams and encourages them to do well afterward. When the Karasuno boys' team won an important match, she joined the students in opening the windows and cheering to welcome them back. She attends the Karasuno vs. Shiratorizawa match and tells the [Vice Principal](https://anilist.co/character/290203/Kyoutou) that their hastily-assembled cheering section had not been practiced enough.

characters.name: Koutarou Bokuto
characters.description: Height: 185.3 cm  Bokuto is a third year student at Fukurodani Academy and is its volleyball team's captain and wing spiker. His spikes pack a powerful punch that others can struggle to receive. Despite this, Bokuto has a tendency to not doing well in the middle of games when getting shut out. Luckily, [Akaashi](https://anilist.co/character/88938) has a whole list of things Bokuto does and tries his best to bring Bokuto back up to his usual self. Besides Akaashi, Bokuto is friends with a few other rival team's players, such as [Kuroo](https://anilist.co/character/71269) and sorta friends with [Tsukishima](https://anilist.co/character/67329).

characters.name: Keiji Akaashi
characters.description: Height: 182.3 cm  A second year at Fukurodani Academy, and its volleyball team's vice-captain and setter. Akaashi is often calm and collected, though he does have times where he begins to get worried about things. More often than not, he has to handle Bokuto and all of his antics during the game. When such happens, Akaashi usually thinks of some way to bring Bokuto into peak condition again, though there are times where he struggles with doing so.

characters.name: Kazuki Sanada
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Dankichi Hama
characters.description: A former friend and rival of Kamogawa and Nekota. In his younger days, Hama boxed along with the two, but never managed to reach their level, partially due to his unusually fragile jaw. Nevertheless, he is a brilliant tactician who, since having left Japan for Mexico, is renowned for his successful training of several champions, including Sanada Kazuki. Hama still harbors deep feelings of rivalry towards Kamogawa, and strives to one day train a boxer that can defeat Makunouchi or Takamura. He is currently the trainer of Alexander Volg Zangief in America.  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Jikkyou Announcer
characters.description: The defining voice of the Ippo franchise, the ring announcer is with us throughout every liver blow, gazelle punch, and Dempsey roll of every match. His approach to color commentating makes Howard Cosell look like Max Kellerman and is often more enthusiastic and aggressive than the fighters in the ring. He is unrivaled on the mic and unbiased toward the fights, refusing to shy away from controversial criticisms and insisting on calling it how he sees it. Many life lessons can be learned from this great man, whose mysterious past, or even name may never be revealed.

characters.name: Meiling Li
characters.description: Meiling Li is a character that appears only in the anime adaptation of Cardcaptor Sakura. Introduced in episode 19, she is Syaoran Li's cousin and self-proclaimed fiancée. As children living in Hong Kong, they both trained in martial arts under the tutelage of Wang Wei. One night her pet bird escaped from his cage, and the normally quiet and withdrawn Syaoran told her not to cry, then left. After spending hours in the rain, he returned with the bird and Meiling was both grateful and touched. From that day, she devoted herself to him, eventually declaring that she liked him above all others and, reasoning that he liked her as well, she declared them to be engaged. At the same time, she promised that if he ever found someone he liked more than her, she would give him up.  In coming to Tokyo, Meiling intends to help Syaoran gather the Clow Cards, and actively dislikes Sakura. As the series progresses, Meiling develops a grudging respect for Sakura that turns into a good friendship by the time Meiling returns to Hong Kong in episode 43. During her initial visit, Meiling seemed to recognize that Syaoran was falling in love with Sakura, but it wasn't until she briefly returned in episode 60 that she fully acknowledges and accepts Sakura as the person Syaoran loves. Wanting to keep his promise, Syaoran attempts to tell her that he loves Sakura, but Meiling interrupts and tells him that she knows because he is now calling Sakura by her first name, something he only does for his sisters and herself. She smiles at Syaoran with tears in her eyes and declares that the engagement is called off, then quickly leaves. Meiling spends the night at Tomoyo Daidōji's house to release all of her sadness through much screaming and tears without burdening Syaoran. At the end of the episode, Meiling returns home and is not seen again in the main series. She returns in the second movie, with Syaoran, and together with Tomoyo tries to help Sakura confess her own feelings to him.  Unlike Syaoran, Meiling has no magical abilities, relying solely on her physical fighting abilities and a healthy dose of pride. Her lack of powers, however, results in her hindering more than helping Syaoran in most battles against the cards. She challenges the The Fight card in episode 20, and was nearly badly wounded and had to be rescued by Syaoran. Recognizing that she was being a burden, Meiling grew upset and lashed out at Syaoran. However, she was then able to be an aid to him while fighting The Twin card, as their years of practicing martial arts together enables them to match the card's synchronized fighting style.  The character of Meiling is voiced by Yukana Nogami. In the English adaptation Cardcaptors her name is changed to Meilin Rae and her relationship with Syaoran is changed from cousins to childhood friends. She is voiced by Nicole Oliver. In the English dub of the second movie, she is voiced by Julie Maddalena.

characters.name: Souichi Tomoe
characters.description: Souichi Tomoe is generally referred to simply as "Professor Tomoe", and the English dub refers to him as "Doctor" Tomoe. He first appears in Episode 90 of the anime and Act 25 of the manga.    In the manga Tomoe is outright malevolent. He joins the Death Busters of his own free will after a lab fire that killed his older wife, Keiko and seriously wounded his young daughter Hotaru Tomoe. He later turns himself into Germatoid to fight Sailor Moon but is killed after being hit by Sailor Moon's Rainbow Moon Heartache. He dies in the manga and does not come back.    In the anime he is a more sympathetic character. He displays bizarre, but hilariously over dramatic mannerisms, which are often a source of unexpected humor. It is never specified whether these are mannerisms of Germatoid or repressed aspects of his personality, since little is known of him before or after the possession. His normal personality does show through at times, however, revealing him to be a kind and loving father. At the end of S, he is shown wheelchair-bound in a hospital with no memory of any of his Death Buster activities. He has taken it upon himself to re-raise the now infant Hotaru.    Professor Tomoe makes one more appearance in the anime, namely in episode 167 (the first episode of the Sailor Stars season), when Sailor Pluto arrives to take baby Hotaru from him. In this episode, he is seen without his glasses, and no longer relies on a wheelchair, indicating that his condition is improving. He is never seen or heard of after that.

characters.name: Hotaru Tomoe
characters.description: With people who do not know or understand her well, Hotaru is extremely shy and socially awkward, due to her powers and intelligence, but only at first. With her close friends and family, she is a sweet, gentle, young woman with great warmth and spirit. She tends to be independent, having been alone and taking care of herself for quite some time. Hotaru grew up very much alone, sick, and an outcast, shunned by her classmates who were frightened of her. It was not until she met [Chibi-Usa](https://anilist.co/character/2827/Chibiusa) that she, at last, had a true friend.

characters.name: Koishi Herikawa
characters.description: **Height**: 154 cm  Koishi is one of [Kei](https://anilist.co/character/2908)'s closest friends who also pursues a romantic relationship with him, but discovers her affection for one of her teachers, [Yamada](https://anilist.co/character/4561). This inappropriate relationship is only ever hinted at, but it's more than obvious that something is going on between them when Yamada is confronted by the principal about him seeing Yamada and a girl from their school walking together. Her parents own a grocery store and she often has to go to deliver food that people ordered.  Koishi has a happy-disposition to her personality and is only ever seen crying when it comes to matters that involve Kei. One of the things [Ichigo](https://anilist.co/character/3110) would get irritated at was that Koishi would never act on her urges and in effect, she waits too long, and by the time she does tell Kei her true feelings, he's already hopelessly in love with [Mizuho](https://anilist.co/character/2763).

characters.name: Kaede Misumi
characters.description: One of [Kei](https://anilist.co/character/2908)'s friends, Kaede tends to be a rather shy girl most of the time. Despite her shyness, during an accidental visit to her hotel room by a sleep-deprived [Hyousuke](https://anilist.co/character/4546), in which he mistakenly climbed into her bed, she awoke from a lightly inebriated slumber and claimed that he had appeared to her in a dream which now seems to have come true. She then sweetly confesses her love for him and proceeds to seduce him. The two become inseparable and are seen together throughout the series.

characters.name: Hyousuke Magumo
characters.description: A brash student Hyousuke aspires to attend college at Tokyo University and become a professional statesman, much like his brother. Hyousuke's demeanor is initially that of a shallow attention-seeker, but after he becomes romantically involved with [Kaede](https://anilist.co/character/4545), a deeper and much more sensitive and reflective side is revealed. Kaede confirms to [Ichigo](https://anilist.co/character/3110) and [Koishi](https://anilist.co/character/4544) that the private Hyousuke is actually a very different person; of him, she says "He's a gentleman and he's sweet." Of [Kei](https://anilist.co/character/2908)'s group of friends, he tends to be the most hyperactive of them all and often does the strangest things too.

characters.name: Matagu Shidou
characters.description: A rather serious student who is also into astronomy, Matagu seems to be the most hopeless of the cast, a classic "nerd". He is much less confident and self-assured than [Hyousuke](https://anilist.co/character/4546), or even [Kei](https://anilist.co/character/2908), leading one to conclude that he suffers from crippling shyness. His stated fondest dream is to meet with "an alien creature from outer space", totally unaware of the fact that his teacher certainly qualifies as such, and that he has had several conversations with his life's dream in a very normal setting. He even considered to confess his love to her, but his shyness put a halt to his plans.

characters.name: Ichigo Morino
characters.description: A young woman who is seemingly wise beyond her apparent years, and who associates with very few friends. Her physical development was stunted due to her "standstills", in the same way that they affect [Kei](https://anilist.co/character/2908). Ichigo's loss of time and her sense of life cruelly having passed her by due to the illness tends to cause her to have a much more cynical and serious demeanor than is normal for someone of her seeming age. In order to prevent the triggering of "standstills", her emotional expression is very subdued.  !At one point, she confesses to Kei, that had they met earlier and revealed their mutual affliction to each other sooner, they might have become closer.!

characters.name: Minoru Edajima
characters.description: [Kei](https://anilist.co/character/2908)'s uncle and doctor of the local clinic. Minoru is something of a lecherous rogue, continually making wolfish comments regarding the attractiveness of passing women. He even does within earshot of his [wife](https://anilist.co/character/27207), who often retaliates with a measured degree of physical violence.

characters.name: Konoha Edajima
characters.description: [Kei](https://anilist.co/character/2908)'s aunt and nurse of the local clinic. A warm, kind-hearted and quite attractive woman who puts up with her [husband](https://anilist.co/character/27206)'s behavior only so much before she starts to get really angry at him. It is evident that she is the more mature member of their pair, and is quite able to curb Minoru's wayward eye and lecherous comments with a significant look or gesture. She is not above using a small degree of force to cause her husband to "heel" if his behavior gets too outrageous. She seems very sexually amorous towards her husband and loves him deeply. She is very supportive of Kei and [Mizuho](https://anilist.co/character/2763)'s relationship, backing Minoru's initial lie to the Headmaster about the couple being married, and then providing a second-hand wedding dress for Mizuho to wear in a private ceremony with only her, Mizuho, Kei and Minoru present.

characters.name: Miruru
characters.description: Another computer intelligence hologram, dressed in female-like clothing. The implication is that both [Marie](https://anilist.co/character/7254) and Miruru are in fact commlinks for the ships, themselves. In other words, the ships house self-aware AI's capable of emotions, which are reflected in the actions of the two miniature beings. Seems also to be romantically involved with Marie.

characters.name: Mizuho Kazami
characters.description: Height: 170 cm  Status: Galaxy Federation resident observer  Mizuho is no ordinary high school teacher. She is actually a resident observer for the Galaxy Federation. Right after she lands on Earth, [Kei](https://anilist.co/character/2908) sees her materialize. The next morning by the lake, he discovers that she is his homeroom teacher, and his neighbor. Mizuho has many different personalities. Though she is 23, and her father was human, she knows little to nothing about Earth except a love of the best candy in Japan. She has two living relatives, her [mother](https://anilist.co/character/5264) and [sister](https://anilist.co/character/12094). Her sister, Maho, threatens Kei every time she sees him, and more than once tried to kill him.

characters.name: Hatsuho Kazami
characters.description: [Mizuho](https://anilist.co/character/2763)'s mother, who is very fond of [Kei](https://anilist.co/character/2908), whom she claims resembles her late husband. She is a very sensual, self-assured, bold but subtly assertive woman. She is not above playfully teasing her oldest daughter and son-in-law, demanding to know intimate details regarding their relationship. She greatly resembles Mizuho, with the exception of having purplish hair instead of magenta, and a small beauty mark on her chin.

characters.name: Marie
characters.description: A quasi-organic master control program for [Mizuho](https://anilist.co/character/2763)'s ship. Totally self-repairing and maintenance free. Hovers around in an innertube and on occasion plays a miniature guitar. Due to [Kei](https://anilist.co/character/2908) fearfully striking 'him' during an initial escape attempt when Mizuho revealed her true identity, Marie's programming became scrambled, endangering both Kei and Mizuho. Communicating partly through indistinct sounds and through gestures, Marie is essentially a portable link to the ship's operating system.   !'He' is also capable of emotion, as witnessed by the romantic relationship formed between 'himself' and [Miruru](https://anilist.co/character/27208) and his sorrow at their parting.!  !Additionally, in the OVA, 'he' and Miruru are implied to have sex, and both of them will become embarrassed when they see others display affection. The implication provided in the series' extras is that Marie and Miruru are but extensions of the ships themselves, and thus are the ships.!

characters.name: Kei Kusanagi
characters.description: **Height:** 155 cm  Kei is living the life of a fifteen-year-old boy. He has a unique disease that causes his body to shut down into a death-like state whenever he becomes too stressed or depressed. He calls this a "standstill". The amount of time he remains in a standstill is random, usually lasting a few minutes to a few hours. However, one time, he went to a standstill and didn't come out for three years. So although everyone thinks he's 15, he is really 18. He discovers that his new teacher, [Mizuho Kazami](https://anilist.co/character/2763), is actually an alien whose mission is to observe Earth. Due to a big misunderstanding, Kei has to choose between letting her secret out or getting married to her.   !At first, he is hesitant about the whole ordeal, but eventually, he falls in love and what ensues are comedic and dramatic situations which he must overcome to live a happy life with his new wife.!

characters.name: Maho Kazami
characters.description: [Mizuho](https://anilist.co/character/2763)'s younger sister, whom she is very close to. She initially refused to accept the fact that [Kei](https://anilist.co/character/2908) is married to her, but she eventually warms up to him.

characters.name: Leonardo da Vinci
characters.description: Leonardo is an individual from the 15th-16th century, revered as one of the greatest geniuses of human history.   Often called The Almighty for his vast knowledge and deep mastery of every craft, from Arts to Science. Despite not being from a long-running lineage of Magi, and not having any Magic Crests, DaVinci still excelled at Magecraft thanks to diligent study.   DaVinci is the Third successful Summoning performed at Chaldea. Summoned when the system was still incomplete, she had limited time at her disposal, but curious about Chaldea's circumstances, and convinced by [Romani](https://anilist.co/character/137154/Archaman-Romani), she decided to stick around. To do so she created a duplicate puppet to act as her Master through a masqueraded contract. This is also the reason why she can't fight, she needs a real Master to actually become a full-fledged Heroic Spirit.   Though normally male, when summoned he takes the appearance of Mona Lisa. He pursued ideal beauty in life so he is content in becoming the embodiment of ideal beauty in death.

characters.name: Ozymandias
characters.description: Rider's True Name is Ozymandias, a person from the 13th14th Century BC. The third Pharaoh of the Nineteenth Dynasty of Egypt who governed over a vast empire, also bearing the title of The greatest hero of ancient Egypt.  He believes that his invocation was given by the need to save the world from its current state, to sort the current holder of a broken humanity, and that those who oppose him should be burned by his power.  A wise ruler and exemplary statesman who, while fighting the Hittites, eventually made peace and brought about a thriving prosperity to ancient Egypt by means of "cultural exchange and interaction". Ozymandias shows a personality of a person with a big ego, seeing himself as a god, but does not go as far as disrespecting the gods of his time. Unlike other demigods or beings with Divinity, Ozymandias is one that is not contrary to the law of the heavens. Unlike Gilgamesh, he freely declares his True Name, Ozymandias, believing that the world should kneel by the return of his radiant presence.

characters.name: Gawain
characters.description: Height: 180cm  One of the Knights of the Round Table that appeared in the Arthurian legends, also known as the White Knight of the Round Table. If King Arthur was the night, the symbol of the moon itself, then Sir Gawain was the day, which shoulders the sun. He acted as [King Arthur](https://anilist.co/character/497)'s impersonator in the royal castle of Camelot. In other words, he was one of the candidates to substitute the King after his fall. He is the bearer of the sister-sword to Excalibur, Excalibur Galatine.  In Fate/Extra, !he's summoned by [Leonardo B. Harwey](https://anilist.co/character/127156) as a Saber-class Servant for the Moon Holy Grail War, bein the last Servant that [Hakuno Kishinami](https://anilist.co/character/84485) faces. Later, with their defeat, Leo finally learns of defeat and thanks Gawain for his services; Gawain points out to him that he was honored to witness an honorable king before fading away.!  In Fate/Grand Order Camelot, !Gawain, along with the other Knights who swore allegiance to the [Lion King](https://anilist.co/character/497), slew the remainder of the Round Table (including his little sister Gareth), and was, like the others, given a divine Gift to help him "pacify" the people of the Singularity, that being the Gift of Nightlessness: making the sun shine anywhere he goes even at night ensuring he is at his peak at all times. Gawain is placed in charge of the Holy Gate, the entrance to the White City of Camelot.!

characters.name: Fou
characters.description: Fou is one of the main characters of Fate/Grand Order, acting as a mascot of sorts. It's a squirrel-like creature, "a cute animal" that appears to be able to freely walk around the Chaldea Security Organization.   It is met by Fujimaru while it's alongside Mash and accompanies the two in their travels to different Singularities.  !Fou is Merlin's familiar and a creature belonging to the Beast class, holding the title of Beast IV!

characters.name: Agravain
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Petra Ral
characters.description: Height: 158 cm (5'2") Affiliation: Survey Corps; Soldier, Special Operations Squad. Relatives: [Father](https://anilist.co/character/131987/Petra-no-Chichi)  Petra Ral is a soldier of the Survey Corps hand-picked by [Captain Levi](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) to join the Special Operations Squad.  Petra is a very kind and caring woman, going out of her way to look after and guiding [Eren Yaeger](https://anilist.co/character/40882/Eren-Yeager) when he was first admitted to the squad. She seemed to have the most attachment to Eren among Levi Squad, as she was often the only one shown to actually worry about him and his wellbeing, at least at first. Although all of Levi's squad wished for Eren's unconditional trust, it was ultimately Petra who convinced him to do so.   Despite her kind nature, Petra was a conditioned soldier with a quick reaction time against perceived danger. She displays extreme loyalty to her leaders, superiors and their orders, and cares deeply for her team, although she tends to be at odds with [Oluo Bozad](https://anilist.co/character/71687/Oluo-Bozard) due to his irritating tendency to try and imitate Levi. She greatly looks up to Levi as her superior and is deeply devoted to him, willing to completely dedicate her life to his cause. It is implied that she may harbor romantic feelings for her captain.

characters.name: Bart
characters.description: Original anime character. He is a Noble in the District of Marquis and friend of Pixis, who challenges him to leisurely games of chess. In the anime, as Pixis makes to leave upon learning of the invasion of Trost in the year 850, he tries to prevent him from going to the battlefield and instead have Pixis and his men stay and protect him and his property, viewing the lowly commoners being attacked as trash.    (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Oluo Bozard
characters.description: Height: 173 cm (5'8") Affiliations: Survey Corps; Soldier, Special Operations Squad Relatives: [Mother](https://anilist.co/character/131991/Oluo-no-Haha), [Father](https://anilist.co/character/131994/Oluo-no-Chichi), Several Siblings.  Oruo Bozad is a soldier of the Survey Corps hand-picked by [Captain Levi](https://anilist.co/character/45627/Levi) for the Special Operations Squad for his especially high Titan kill record.  Oruo is a very self-confident, outspoken individual, and enjoys boasting about his own prowess. Despite his obnoxious demeanor, he is admittedly one of the best out of Levi Squad; having the highest kill count out of his peers, bested only by Levi. This only helps fuel his haughty nature. Though Oruo tries to come across as self-important, his cockiness is rarely taken seriously, and he is also shown to be somewhat clumsy, frequently biting his own tongue on accident while riding horses. Oruo also frequently attempts to imitate Levi, such as his rough speech and confident attitude, much to the frustration of one of his fellow teammates, [Petra Ral](https://anilist.co/character/62501).

characters.name: Moses
characters.description: He was a member of the Scouting Legion and was the first person killed by a Titan at the start of the series. When the Recon Corps squad returns to the District of Shiganshina, his mother starts asking for him, and the Squad leader, gives her all that remained of him- his right arm. In the manga his name is Brown (ブラウン), although it is changed to Moses in the anime. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Hugo
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Moses no Haha
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Xiaomi Mao
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Sitan Guo Wangzi
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Chiya
characters.description: Chiya is the main antagonist of Scissor Seven (刺客伍六七) in Season 2. He’s one of the seven Shadow Assassins of Xuanwu. He is possessed by the Blood Demon that gives him his powers. He had a history with Chairman Jiang.

characters.name: Feng Wang
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Putong Cike
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Phil
characters.description: A member of the Garrison.

characters.name: Mikasa no Haha
characters.description: Mikasa's mother.  First Appearance Anime: Ep. 6 A woman of Oriental heritage appearing to be in her mid thirties. She appeared to be a kind and loving mother, holding value in keeping with tradition. When her and Mikasa's lives were threatened, she quickly turned into a fierce mother, trying to do whatever was necessary to protect Mikasa.

characters.name: Tiona Hiryute
characters.description: Race: Amazoness Height: 165 cm (5'5") Affiliation: Loki Familia Level: 6 Skills: Berserk • Intense Heat Weapon: Urga • Blade Rolan  Tiona Hiryute is a first class adventurer and an executive member of the Loki Familia. She is the younger twin of the Hiryute Sisters. [Tione](https://anilist.co/character/127209/Hiryute-Tione) and Tiona were born in Telskyura and were forced to join the Kali Familia from the moment they were born. Both sisters didn't know who their parents were, but knew that they were sisters. She reached Level 2 on the same day Tione did after killing an Amazoness she knew in a fight to the death. Soon after, both sisters became students to Argana and Bache. Around a year after reaching Level 2, Tiona found her first hero story. The day before her seventh birthday, Tiona asked Kali to let her and Tione leave the country, which Kali granted a couple days later, much to the sisters' surprise. The sisters traveled across the land, temporarily joining different Familia for a year, during which both sisters reached Level 3. They arrived at Orario years later when they were 12 years old. After agreeing to join the Familia of the adventurer that defeated them, they proceeded to defeat everyone that challenged them, only to lose to [Finn](https://anilist.co/character/142538/Deimne-Finn) and [Gareth](https://anilist.co/character/142542/Landrock-Gareth) when they were challenged by the Loki Familia. Following a dungeon expedition they went on shortly after joining, both sisters reached Level 4.  Tiona is an overly energetic Amazoness woman who likes teasing people, but is a caring friend. She isn't the type to use her brain, which she admits herself, and has a complex about her chest size compared to other women. She is also fond of hero stories and is almost equally as knowledgeable about the topic as [Bell](https://anilist.co/character/88860/Cranel-Bell) is. She also seems to be more caring than her sister, as seen when she let [Wiene](https://anilist.co/character/146907/Wiene) live.

characters.name: Hermes
characters.description: Race: God Height: 177 cm (5'10") Affiliation: Hermes Familia  Hermes is the head of the Hermes Familia. At first glance, Hermes has a casual and playful personality. However, his true nature is someone who is sharp, shrewd, and cunning, becoming serious if needs be. He is eloquent in speech as he is skilled in holding his own when it comes to sounding other people. Later on, he gains an interest in [Bell](https://anilist.co/character/88860/Cranel-Bell) and does whatever he can to make him into a hero, such as convincing [Ryuu](https://anilist.co/character/88890/Lion-Ryuu) to help him or getting rid of [Ishtar](https://anilist.co/character/146789/Ishtar). If needs be, he will clash with allies, as shown when he was willing to sacrifice a number of Xenos in order to restore Bell's reputation despite working with [Ouranos](https://anilist.co/character/134228/Uranus) to protect them.

characters.name: Takemikazuchi
characters.description: Race: God Height: 176 cm (5'9") , 183 cm (6'0") with geta Affiliation: Takemikazuchi Familia    Takemikazuchi is a God and the head of the Takemikazuchi Familia. Takemikazuchi is friendly with [Hestia](https://anilist.co/character/87654/Hestia) and has taught her many things such as the dogeza. He is kind to his Familia members. He is also a natural gigolo, and is clueless to how his actions affect others around him, which makes him come out as insensitive.

characters.name: Mr. Outside
characters.description: An unseen and mysterious character who chooses twelve Japanese citizens as Seleção and gives them the special Noblesse ("nobility" in French) phones. Mr. OUTSIDE gives the Seleção the mission to bring stability to their own country in whatever way they wish to. However, he/she will send "Supporters" to kill them if they use up their money before they can complete it, or do not meet the requirements to accomplish the mission.   (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Rindou Kobayashi
characters.description: Height: 171 cm  Rindou Kobayashi is a 90th Generation Tōtsuki Academy alumna and the previous Second Seat of the Elite Ten Council who formerly serves as one of the Senior Officers of Central.

characters.name: Momo Akanegakubo
characters.description: 90th Generation student of Tōtsuki Culinary Academy and !the current 3rd seat of the Elite Ten Council after being promoted from the 4th seat during the Azami Administration.!  (Source: Shokugeki no Souma Wikia)

characters.name: Yuuki Yoshino
characters.description: She is a student at Tōtsuki Culinary Academy and a resident of Polar Star Dormitory. She and the other resident students from his hostel befriended with their fellow roommate Yukihira Soma and also aware to Soma's talent as one of the finest and unique of all. She is also a roommate and friend to her fellow student, Tadokoro Megumi and Sakaki Ryoko.  Yuki is more focus on animal meat as her main cuisine. Unlike Ikumi, the meat master in any meat culinary, Yuki often used the animal hunted game from domestic poultry to any other animals (like rabbits and deer) as her main theme. Yuki's cutting skill could be yet

characters.name: Noriko Paku
characters.description: Noriko is Izumo's best friend but quits the cram school because she did not understand the classes and she was failing.

characters.name: Kasugaya Shizuri Castiella
characters.description: Race: Ogre/Blood Servant Epithet: Paladiness  Kasugaya Shizuri Castiella is a female character with a fair complexion and white hair who is often seen wearing a white shirt with a black tie and purple skirt.  ! She has two horns that poke out from her head, though they are usually hidden underneath a nun's veil. !

characters.name: Yuiri Haba
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Avrora Florestina
characters.description: The previous Fourth Progenitor, a young girl who passed her title to Kojou after her death.

characters.name: Haman Karn
characters.description: The leader of the renegade Zeons who took refuge at the asteroid base Axis. As the daughter of the admiral who led the exodus to Axis, Haman took over her late father's role, and at age sixteen found herself in charge of this community of dispirited Zeon exiles. Despite her youth, Haman's charisma, guile, and remarkable Newtype abilities enabled her to rally the Axis refugees for their triumphant return to the Earth Sphere. While nominally just a regent to the child heir Mineva Zabi, Haman is in truth the unchallenged master of the Axis forces, who seeks to restore the Zabi dynasty in order to seize power for herself.    !It is important to note however that Haman was not always the way she was in Zeta Gundam and Gundam ZZ. The manga Char's Deleted Affair and its mini prequel Haman's Deleted Affair, reveal that Haman had a sweet disposition as a young teenager. The latter manga reveals that Haman grew up in Axis after the One Year War, never having seen the Earth, and had to endure a hard life growing up as Axis was not well suited to support life, and it was not any better with the looming threat of the Federation possibly attacking them. The former manga also shows she was a romantic of sorts, as she became romantically involved with Zeon's Red Comet, Char Aznable. Though CDA also reaffirms what was said in HDA, as Haman had to train to be a soldier and possibly felt obligated to protect the people on Axis, viewing their treatment by the Federation as unjust. Thus Haman's personality in the anime is a result of her troubled upbringing, never having had the chance to be a child and enjoy life, Haman became dark, cold, and isolated from the rest of the world, which she states in Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ, is what made her stronger and is her strength.!

characters.name: Kamille Bidan
characters.description: Kamille was raised in the newly constructed Green Noa 2 in Side 7. There he encounters several Titan soldiers harassing the fellow citizens. This angers him and Kamille eventually decides to join the AEUG and help them steal one of the prototype Gundams his father had made for the Titans. Then, after watching his mother and father be killed by the Titans, Kamille promises to himself to destroy the Federation and the Titans.

characters.name: Shaymin
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Absol
characters.description: A Dark-type Pokémon, said to bring bad luck and cause misfortune whenever it appears. However, its horn is actually acutely sensitive to warning signs of natural disasters, and it often attempts to warn humans of them.  Using the Absolite, it can Mega-Evolve into Mega Absol.  In the sixth movie, it attempts to take Jirachi back to its home.  [Gou](https://anilist.co/character/146667/Gou) has one on his team during the events of 2019's series, and in *Pokémon Try Adventure*, Toki has one named Absou.

characters.name: Giratina
characters.description: Giratina is a large, gray, draconic Pokémon with three gold half-rings on each side of its long neck. Its head has a gold crown-like object surrounding it with two large horns pointing sideways. A thick black stripe runs vertically along its front with five red horizontal stripes. In its Altered Forme, it has two large black ghostly wings with three red tips on each that can resemble claws. These wings can change shape as if made of a liquid or gas. Its six legs are thick and have golden claws. Two golden half-circles similar to those on its neck are on each side of each leg, resembling shackles. It has a tail.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

characters.name: Schneizel el Britannia
characters.description: **Height:** 200 cm (6'7")  Schneizel el Britannia is the Second Prince of the Britannian Imperial Family and the Prime Minister of the Holy Britannian Empire.

characters.name: Shalltear Bloodfallen
characters.description: The Guardian of the First, Second, and Third floors of Nazarick, she has the form of a beautiful vampire girl. She's also in love with [Momonga](https://anilist.co/character/89103). She and [Albedo](https://anilist.co/character/89122) constantly clash for his attention. While the two don't mind sharing Momonga, they still fight for superiority and who would ultimately appeal to Momonga. Shalltear is one of the most powerful guardians, allegedly capable of going toe-to-toe with Albedo.  !Due to an incident where she is subjected to mind control by a member of the Black Scripture, she ends up unintentionally rebelling against Nazarick.!

characters.name: Nigun Grid Luin
characters.description: Nigun Grid Luin (ニグン・グリッド・ルーイン) was the captain of the Sunlight Scripture of the Slane Theocracy. He was ordered by the Cardinals to assassinate the Re-Estize Kingdom's strongest warrior, Gazef Stronoff.

characters.name: Narberal Gamma
characters.description: One of the Pleiades, combat maids of the Tenth floor under [Sebas Tian](https://anilist.co/character/89155). She's a Doppelgänger and, because she's one of the most human-looking of the maids, she is [Momonga](https://anilist.co/character/89103)'s companion in his exploration of the new world disguised as adventurers. Narberal takes great pride in this duty, often "wearing" it like a badge of honor. However, like most in Nazarick, she holds great disdain towards humans. This proves troublesome, as she becomes incredibly violent when human males make advances on her.   While operating as a member of the adventuring guild, "Darkness", Narberal operates under the alias of "Nabe", which becomes "Nabe, the Beautiful Lady" when Darkness becomes famous. Narberal's beauty has been compared to that of the "Golden Princess of Re-Estize" by many of the country's inhabitants.

characters.name: Yuri Alpha
characters.description: The Vice-Captain, but de facto leader of the Pleiades. She is a Dullahan who uses a choker to keep her head attached to the rest of her body, causing her to appear to be human. She specializes in unarmed combat and uses Gauntlets in battle. She is programmed to behave like a teacher, because her creator was one, and the other Pleiades look up to her like a big sister. Like Sebas, she holds a primarily neutral stance towards outsiders, but unlike him, her sense of justice is not so strong that she'd help people like him.(Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Mare Bello Fiore
characters.description: One of the Guardians of the Sixth floor of Nazarick alongside his twin sister [Aura](https://anilist.co/character/89129). He's rather shy and calm in comparison to his sister, although he can fight and be ruthless when necessary. Like his sister, Mare is a Dark Elf. Mare specializes in Druid magic, capable of twisting the earth to his whims.

characters.name: Nfirea Bareare
characters.description: Race: Human Affiliation: Sorcerer Kingdom, Re-Estize Kingdom (Formerly) Family: Lizzie Bareare (Grandmother), Enri Emmot (Wife), Nemu Emmot (Sister-In-Law) Occupation: Herbalist, Potion Maker Residence: E-Rantel (Formerly), Carne Village (Currently) Birthday: Middle Wind Month 18th Day Hobby: Alchemical Experiments.  Nfirea is described as a nice, calm and timid person. He works hard at making potions with his grandmother every day. He also has a minor inferiority complex, due to comparing himself to Ainz. At a young age, Nfirea Bareare was raised by his grandmother Lizzie Bareare after his parents died; he only has murky impressions of them. His grandmother made him her apprentice and taught him everything she knew about herbs, alchemy, and potion-making. He met Enri Emmot while delivering potions to Carne Village and developed feelings for her.

characters.name: Hamusuke
characters.description: Hamsuke resembles a giant Djungarian hamster with a long snake tail. Six sigils dot her silvery fur.  Before being inducted in the Great Tomb of Nazarick, Hamusuke was very boastful and prideful of her ability and power as the "Virtuous King of the Forest." However, since meeting [Momonga](https://anilist.co/character/89103) and witnessing the power of the denizens of Nazarick, she has seen how vastly inferior she is. She accepts this and swears loyalty to Momonga, willing to do anything to please his master and earn his keep.

characters.name: Dyne Woodwonder
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Takashi Yamazaki
characters.description: Grade: 4th - 6th   Takashi Yamazaki is a student in Sakura Kinomoto's class, and the only male student in the class to be referred to by name before the introduction of Syaoran Li. The character is named after film director, Takashi Yamazaki, who is a friend of the series creators, CLAMP. Throughout the series, Yamazaki's defining trait is his ability to fabricate highly detailed fake stories and histories about practically any subject. While most of his classmates see through these fabrications, Sakura and Syaoran often believe them.   Fellow classmate [Chiharu Mihara](https://anilist.co/character/7134/Chiharu-Mihara) often interrupts his stories so others know when he is lying, and proceeds to punish him for lying by pretending to strangle him or by dragging him away by his collar. While the two often seem to be arguing, they are actually a couple and have known one another since kindergarten. She is the only girl in the series that he addresses by her first name.  In the Cardcaptors English adaptation, all hints of his relationship with Chiharu are removed. Instead, they are said to be cousins and the Chiharu's joking strangling of Yamazaki is considered to be sibling rivalry.

characters.name: Maki Matsumoto
characters.description: She is the owner of a stuffed doll shop called Twin Bells.

characters.name: Riina Tada
characters.description: **Height:** 152 cm **Hometown:** Tokyo, Japan  Always wearing headphones and with a deep love for the culture, Riina aims to become the very definition of a rock star. However, Riina lacks musical knowledge and experience with the genre, so she often comes across as a bit of a poser. Despite this, Riina’s commitment to becoming her ideal rockin’ idol self is strong. She admires [Natsuki Kimura](https://anilist.co/character/120508/Kimura-Natsuki), and wants to become someone like her.  Riina doesn’t like portraying a more feminine image at first. She says she'd prefer a purely rock star aesthetic, but she can't help herself and gravitates towards more cutesy looks. In more recent cards, she's started to come closer to the rock star image she loves; even learning to play guitar under Natsuki's tutelage. Initially having Riina admire Natsuki, both of them developed a very strong and mutual bond towards each other over time and are quite often seen together.  Riina lives with her parents and seems to have a very close relationship with her family. Whether she has any siblings is unknown. In a Puchiderella line Riina mentions that at school she is fairly reserved, and she wants to her passionate side as an idol. Riina has confirmed that as a student, she is the type that crams before tests and then forgets the information afterwards.  Riina has been shown to be very insecure about her lack of guitar skills and often worries that she cannot become a real rock idol because of it. Even so, Riina always comes to understand that with the power of her straightforward enthusiasm and determination, she can still be rockin’.

characters.name: Uzuki Shimamura
characters.description: **Height:** 159 cm **Hometown:** Tokyo, Japan  An extraordinarily ordinary girl, Uzuki is always positive and bright, showing dedication towards being an idol. Her ordinary personality and her smile are seen as her defining traits. She's so average in fact that it's almost bizarre, counting such feats as consistently scoring right in the middle of her school's exam rankings, or always running around the middle of the pack in sporting events, or having never drawn any fortune but the average Good Luck over the course of 17 New Year's celebrations.  Despite feelings of insecurity due to her averageness, Uzuki always pushes forward with a smile on her face. Initially overlooked during the start of Cinderella Girls, Uzuki managed to become popular for being unpopular.

characters.name: Rin Shibuya
characters.description: **Height:** 165 cm  **Hometown:** Tokyo, Japan  Rin tends to be the “straight man” in joke sequences, and is sometimes overly serious to a comedic point. While she tends to be cool and harsh, she does have a sweet side that she occasionally shows others. She is self-conscious that her default expression comes off as unfriendly. Her cool, level headed demeanor is put to the test when she's stuck in the same room as Ranko Kanzaki, Kaede Takagaki and Riina Tada.

characters.name: Mio Honda
characters.description: **Height:** 161 cm **Hometown:** Chiba Prefecture, Japan  Mio has a habit of nicknaming the people around her, much like the Futami Twins, and is the origin for Rin Shibuya being called Shiburin and Uzuki Shimamura being called Shimamu. She is considered to be the comedic one of the trio.

characters.name: Minami Nitta
characters.description: **Height:** 165 cm **Hometown:** Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan  Minami is a college student who loves to try out as many different things as possible, and being an idol was one of the things she wanted to give a try. She is in her college's lacrosse team and is very good at the sport, just like she's really good at most of the things she tries. Despite her accomplishments, she became an idol to live up to her full potential and better herself. Family is very important to her, and she wants to be a big sister to the younger idols. She has a little brother, and her "Papa" is rather protective of her. She is considered to be a great older sister by both him and her fellow idols.

characters.name: Chieri Ogata
characters.description: Height: 153 cm Hometown: Mie Prefecture, Japan  Shy with a gentle heart, Chieri is an easily stressed but hardworking young girl. Starting off feeling unfit to be an idol, Chieri suffers from a case of social anxiety not wanting to draw attention to herself. She wanted to change this by becoming an idol and changing her weak-willed self. Mustering up all the courage she could, she auditioned to be an idol.
