Despite the theory he advances in which Haruhi is the equivalent of God, Itsuki says that there are many differing lines of speculation about Haruhi within "The Agency." Itsuki himself does not believe in a singular God, nor does he regard Haruhi as such, although he reveals that he has colleagues that do. Apparently, most of the questions that he raises about Haruhi's true nature are philosophical in nature and do not necessarily represent his personal beliefs. Itsuki also reveals that the majority of "The Agency" advocates observing Haruhi instead of doing anything that might provoke her.     Out of the three Brigade members, Kyon is the least fond of Itsuki. He often finds himself annoyed with Itsuki's plastic smile, his willingness to acquiesce to Haruhi's outrageous schemes, playful teasing and his various forays into his psychological and philosophical theories. He is also distrustful of Itsuki's intentions, comparing him to [Yuki Nagato](https://anilist.co/character/249/Yuki-Nagato) when it comes to deciphering his expressions.!

characters.name: Ryouko Asakura
characters.description: At first, Ryouko appears to be a compassionate and hard-working high school girl. One of Kyon's friends, Taniguchi, places her in the top three first-year girls in the school with a grade of AA+: indicative of her pleasant personality, beauty, and athleticism. Her enormous popularity made her the unanimous choice for class president of Kyon's homeroom class. She also showed particular concern about how Haruhi had distanced herself from the rest of the class.     !However, it turns out that she is Yuki's backup, and as such, is also another "humanoid interface".!

characters.name: Kenichi Okamura
characters.description: Kenichi Okamura is Yousen High's power forward.

characters.name: Bazuso
characters.description: Bazuso was exaggerated in stature, and stood much taller than other men. Although he was killed before he could be seen without his armor, it can be inferred that his physique was very muscular due to the excessive size of his weapon, as well as the incredible size and weight of his armor.  Bazuso was a violent and brash man. He was greatly arrogant and seemingly viewed himself as superior to his foes, taunting those reluctant to attack him and loudly goading his enemies right in front of him. He bore an insatiable drive for combat and possessed incredible physical strength, which allowed him to easily slay anyone who challenged him. However, after Guts emerged as the victor of their duel and mortally wounded Bazuso, he attempted to yield before Guts finished him off.  Bazuso's strength and fighting ability became infamous throughout the battlefield. It is said that he once successfully took on over thirty men in combat, earning him the moniker of "Thirty-Man Slayer", and that he defeated a bear by himself, both of which were testaments to his incredible physical strength. Bazuso was strong enough to send men flying with a single swing of his battleaxe, even when using just one arm.  Bazuso wielded a large battleaxe during his fight against Guts. Due to his fearsome reputation, one can assume that he was very skilled in wielding it. Furthermore, the size of the battleaxe complimented Bazuso's height, giving him a wide reach in combat.  Placed in charge of a fortress under siege by a band of mercenaries, Bazuso leaves the group frozen in fear on sight, intimidated by the immense reputation of the battleaxe wielding man. As Bazuso taunts his enemies, Guts, a young independent mercenary, puts himself forward to remedy the problem; he tells his employer that he will kill Bazuso in exchange for seven pieces of gold. Though Bazuso intends to humor Guts in accepting his duel, expecting to kill the young swordsman with little effort, the ensuing battle is fought on equal terms. After an exchange of blows, Guts is fortunate enough to be able to damage Bazuso's battleaxe and deliver a powerful slash to his waist, forcing the colossal man to his knees. In his final moments, Bazuso attempts to yield for his life; Guts quickly drives his sword down into the neutralized man's head, splitting it half-way, one of Bazuso's eyes dislodged from the impact. It is Guts' triumph over Bazuso that earns him the attention of the Band of the Falcon, and more specifically, Griffith.

characters.name: Jouichirou Yukihira
characters.description: The father of Sōma Yukihira, and owner of the diner Yukihira in the Sumire Shopping District. His passion for cooking knows no bounds and his skill is world-class. As the sole parental-figure and family member in Sōma's life, he is a mentor, teacher, and rival to his son. Like Sōma, Jōichirō is laid-back but professional and has a serious side that emerges when he is cooking. The two share the same habit of creating horrible experimental dishes. Jōichirō is supportive of his son but does occasionally like to see Sōma stressed and frustrated by challenging him to many cook-offs – always ending in Jōichirō's victory – to show him how much he has to grow. He left home to work abroad and sent his son to Tōtsuki Academy, telling Sōma that he needs to succeed in Tōtsuki if he ever wants to surpass him.

characters.name: Howzer
characters.description: Hauser is a Holy Knight, a colleague and partner of Gilthunder, and a subordinate of the Great Holy Knight, Dreyfus. He wears a set of Holy Knight armor and has short light-colored curled up hair. Hauser demonstrates a lot of self confidence and is very optimistic, which is the complete opposite of Gilthunder's personality; he is also shown to be somewhat naive and stupid.

characters.name: Masa
characters.description: Tatsu's former subordinate.

characters.name: Miku
characters.description: Tatsu's wife. A graphic designer who loves Policure

characters.description: No description available.

characters.description: No description available.

characters.description: Torajirou was part of a yakuza gang that had a rivalry with Tatsu. He became a food truck owner after serving time in prison.

characters.description: Buka is a police officer.

characters.description: Boss lady of the Tori Clan. Currently employed in a supermarket to maintain income after the loss of her husband, the former Tori Clan leader

characters.description: Ryouta is a child from one of Tatsu's neighbors.

characters.name: Tatsu
characters.description: An ex-yakuza who now lives peacefully as a househusband.

characters.name: Shamisen
characters.description: Shamisen is a stray cat selected by Haruhi to play the role of Yuki's familiar for their film "The Adventures of Mikuru Asahina", Shamisen is unusual in the sense that he is a male calico cat. During the filming of the movie, Haruhi's reality-altering powers temporarily give Shamisen the ability to speak. He is adopted by Kyon after the completion of the movie, and is given the nickname "Shami" by his sister.

characters.name: Tomoyuki Shinoda
characters.description: The chief trainer of Aoki Masaru, Kimura Tatsuya, and Itagaki Manabu, Shinoda carries out Coach Kamogawa's tradition of strict training. Aoki and Kimura have even referred to him as "The mud-fighter producing trainer from hell".   Though arguably the least prominent of the main characters, he is shown to still have a good boxer's eye. He is the creator of the inspirational pun Gattsu de Gattsun Gattsun da!

characters.name: Tatsuya Chichi
characters.description: He is the father of [Kimura Tatsuya](https://anilist.co/character/847/Tatsuya-Kimura) and married to [his mother](https://anilist.co/character/51689). He also owns and runs Kimura Gardening.

characters.name: Gaia Nomura
characters.description: The leader of a mercenary group who fought Baki. He was once a reckless mercenary called Nomura who loved killing. However, after facing the "ultimate fear" when faced with a firing squad during the Ugandan Bush War, he lost his hair and the personality of Gaia manifested from Nomura, as well as gaining supersensory ability. It is said that Gaia is Yujiro's equal in combat. However, when it comes to jungle warfare, he is considered to be the king and he is often called as "Mr.War" and "War god". As a evidence of his ability, he and his mercenary team was hired by the JGSDF as a instructor for non-conventional warfare, and they defeated an entire company of soldiers including a Type 90 Tank in a training battle with ease. As Nomura he is best described as a weakling who acts as a medic for the team. However, when the situation is right and his adrenaline starts pumping, the Gaia personality will manifest itself to fight. He utterly despises Yujiro, stating he is nothing but a thrill seeker that fights for pleasure. He fights Baki and honorably loses to him. When he crossed paths with Yujiro, Gaia told him that Baki is a better warrior than Yujiro can ever be before the two fight (even though he loses miserably). Gaia makes a surprising appearance in the 'Search of Our Strongest Hero' manga by replacing Jack Hammer during his fight with the Russian convict Sikorsky. He proceeds to defeat Sikorsky with ease, and terrorises Sikorsky into admitting defeat. His three philosophies when fighting are one, take care of your body and give it rest; two, free your body from the control of your mind; and finally, use every part of your surroundings as a weapon. In the current series, he no longer works for the JGSDF, and is seen working as a bodyguard for the new American president.

characters.name: Morio  Sonoda
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Dorian
characters.description: Dorian is a great Chinese Kenpo fighter from the United States.  Of all the five convicts, he is most notable for using a wide variety of tools during fights, such as flammable materials and lightweight wire.

characters.name: Anos Voldigoad
characters.description: Species: Mixed Blood (currently), Demon (formerly)  Anos is the reincarnation of the man who was feared as the Demon King of Tyranny 2,000 years ago. He is resolute, stalwart, and invincible. His absolute power instils a veritable self-confidence that is only surpassed by his ego. Because of his overwhelming prowess, Anos possesses an easy going attitude and an unrivalled sense of perseverance when facing any challenge that may come his way.  Despite his title as the Demon King, Anos has a definitive moral compass and generally has a kind and caring outlook. He takes a great interest in the well-being of not only his family, but also his subordinates and followers, and is quick to reward them for their loyalty. He is willing to go through great lengths to assist in their development, in order for them to reach their full potential. Other people may see him as cruel, but his personal creed is not to kill people needlessly. Even if he would never admit it, Anos is very protective of his fellow subordinates and followers.  While Anos is not inherently evil, his chaotic and sometimes ruthless methods when dealing with his enemies, earned him his title. While he originally never proclaimed himself as the Demon King, he has openly embraced it as the rest of the world views him as such. Those who oppose him, fear his power, and are threatened by the mere fact that a single man possesses such power.   (Source: Maou Gakuin wiki)

characters.name: Misha Necron
characters.description: Misha is a student at Delzogade, the Demon King Academy. She quickly becomes friends with [Anos](https://anilist.co/character/138595/Voldigoad-Anos) after they meet. Her magic power is quite high among most students at Delzogade.

characters.name: Kanon
characters.description: Kanon is a hero that battles against Anos. He seems to have a mutual respect with Anos, with both of them understanding each other. Before Anos was slain by Kanon, Anos wished they could be friends in 2000 years, should they ever meet.

characters.name: Dai Seirei Reno
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Ivis Necron
characters.description: One of the Seven Elder Demon Emperors created by Anos, as well as the head of the Necron family.

characters.name: Shin Reglia
characters.description: Right hand of Demon King [Anos Voldigoad](https://anilist.co/character/138595) and the most powerful swordsman among the demons.

characters.name: Sasha Necron
characters.description: A member of the House of Necron and direct descendant of [Ivis Necron](https://anilist.co/character/186471/Necron-Ivis). Sasha Necron is called the, "Witch of Destruction," by others.  She has the Demon Eyes of Destruction, which allow her to destroy anything she chooses within her field of view.   Sasha is the older sister of [Misha Necron](https://anilist.co/character/138596/Necron-Misha). Sasha has a cold personality towards her sister, calling her a, "defective doll." Towards others, she acts superior and above them, due to her status. Though she does act as such, she is able to respect others and be friendly towards them.

characters.name: Misa Ilioroagu
characters.description: **Misa Ilioroagu** is Anos' classmate, and shows herself as skeptical about the current society in which pure-blooded demons are favored. !She is the spirit that was formed from the rumors and traditions of the fictional Demon King Avos Dilhevia! !She is the daughter of Great Spirit Reno and Spirit King Shin Regalia.!

characters.name: Lay Glanzudlii
characters.description: Lay Glanzudlii is a member of the Generation of Chaos, commonly known as "The Demon Sword Saint" and a transfer student at Demon King Academy.   !He is the reincarnation of the Hero Kanon.!

characters.name: Eleonore Bianca
characters.description: Eleonore is a humanoid magic. She specializes in root magic and is able to create root clones (Zeshia & Diego). She harbours no ill feelings towards the demons and is considered a failure due to her lack of hatred towards the demons. !She later becomes Anos' magic.!

characters.name: Gaios Anzem
characters.description: Gaios Anzem is one of the Seven Elder Demon Emperors created by Anos Voldigoad.

characters.name: Melheis Boran
characters.description: Melheis Boran is one of the Seven Elder Demon Emperors created by Anos Voldigoad.

characters.name: Ran Gotanda
characters.description: Ran is Dan's younger sister and is currently attending a private girls' school. She is in her third year of middle school and is the student council president. Ran apparently has feelings for Ichika.

characters.name: Dan Gotanda
characters.description: He's a friend of Ichika's back in middle school and Ran's older brother.

characters.name: Pan
characters.description: Pan is a fictional character in the manga and anime series Dragon Ball Z, as well as Dragon Ball GT. She is a Human-Saiyajin quarter breed. In the original Japanese version, she was voiced by Yuko Minaguchi, while she is voiced by Elise Baughman in the FUNimation dub and by Caitlynne Medrek in the Blue Water Studios redubs. It should be noted that Pan's name comes from the Pan of Roman (as well as others) mythology. That means that, at first glance, she appears to have been named after her mother Videl rather than her father Gohan. However, closer inspection reveals a double-pun on behalf of author Akira Toriyama, in that Pan is also the Japanese and Spanish word for bread, continuing her father's food-based name as well as her mother's god-religion-based name.    Pan is introduced in the series following the ten year interval between the defeat of Majin Buu and the end of the written Dragon Ball series. In the series, Pan is daughter of the primary character named Son Gohan, and as a result, the granddaughter of the main character named Son Goku. Pan is the only original character in the series with the most diluted Saiyajin heritage, and as a result, it was stated in the Daizenshuu that she didn't have the ability to become a Super Saiyajin. However, this is later contradicted by the Dragon Ball GT Perfect file books that stated that she could have ascended if she trained hard enough. It was also stated by Toriyama that the simple reason to Pan's inability to become a Super Saiyajin was that he could not come up with a logical design for a female Super Saiyajin; being that most of the Super Saiyajin traits are typical of males, and not females.    As Pan only appears for three chapters in the manga, her later life is elaborated on in the anime-only series called Dragon Ball GT, where she is seen as a young girl who travels the galaxy with her grandfather Goku, and Trunks, the half-Saiyajin son of the characters Vegeta and Bulma. In the final episode of Dragon Ball GT, Pan is seen as an old woman, being over 100 years old. She is the grandmother to the character named Son Goku Jr., who has the ability to become a Super Saiyajin. This contridicts the Daizenshuu that stated that characters who possessed less then half-Saiyajin heritage did not have the ability to become Super Saiyajins because of diluted blood-lines.

characters.name: Bra
characters.description: Bra is the second child (after Trunks) of Bulma and Vegeta. Unlike Pan who acts tomboyish, Bra acts feminine and sticks around her mom. Like Bulma, Bra has blue hair in the anime and purple hair in the manga. Her father doesn't appear to make a point of encouraging her to train (like he does to her brother Trunks), but the two are quite close, as it becomes apparent in Dragon Ball GT, where Vegeta proves to be very protective of his daughter on multiple occasions. During the Baby Saga, Bra (along with the rest of the world) is possessed by Baby. She is one of the four characters who help Baby become stronger; after this, however, her role is greatly reduced. Although she has never been seen in combat (She'd rather shop than train), except when Baby had her under his control, she does have the ability to fly through use of her ki.    *Wikipedia

characters.name: Shen Long
characters.description: Shen Long is the wish granting dragon of Earth. The Shen Long of the Black Star Dragon Balls is red, opposed to the Shen Long of Earth who is green.  Shen Long can be summoned by gathering all seven of the Dragon Balls of Earth. Shen Long can bestow any wish as long as it does not exceed the power of his creator, who must be still alive (i.e. Kami or Dende).   Multiple times in the Dragon Ball series, Shen Long threatens to kill the summoner if they do not say a wish on time, or if they do not say a wish at all. Shen Long cannot bring back a person from the dead more than once. The Dragon Balls cannot be used for 365 Earth days after a wish is made, as they turn to stone. The Earth Dragon Balls are relatively small, each about the size of a large orange, much smaller than the Namekian Dragon Balls, which are the size of beach balls. The base for Shen Long is a stone statue kept by his creator. If Shen Long is killed, the Dragon Balls turn to stone. The statue also shatters. If the creator or another Namekian wishes to, they can rebuild the statue to give life back to Shen Long and the Dragon Balls. This happened after Shen Long granted Demon King Piccolo's wish for youth.    While Kami and Piccolo weren't merged, Shen Long could only grant one wish. After Dende brought him back to life, he was able to grant two wishes (three if the first does not revive more than one at a time). If the summoner wants, he can only make one wish. This makes the Dragon Balls turn to stone for only six months.  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Mr. Popo
characters.description: Mr. Popo is an immortal djinn who lives with [Kami](https://anilist.co/character/6108/Kami) in Kami's Lookout and is bound there eternally as the gardener and caretaker. He has served every other Kami (God/Guardian) of the Earth since the beginning of time. He was trained by the recent Kami himself and trained [Goku](https://anilist.co/character/246/Son-Gokuu) for 3 years in order to fight [Piccolo](https://anilist.co/character/914/Piccolo).

characters.name: Miyahira-sensei
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Toubaru-sensei
characters.description: A teacher of literature at the school [Reina](https://anilist.co/character/121703) and her friends attend. She has a unique way of describing things.  (Source: Official Site, translated, edited)

characters.name: Reina Aharen
characters.description: A small, timid, and unfathomable girl who grows attached to [Raidou](https://anilist.co/character/121704/Raidou-Shouta) after he begins talking to her. She has a bad sense of distance.  !She eventually confesses her love to Raidou.!

characters.name: Shouta Raidou
characters.description: A tall, calm, and generally nice guy who looks after [Reina Aharen](https://anilist.co/character/121703/Aharen-Reina). He wants to help her with her problems, despite them not being his own to deal with.

characters.name: Ishikawa
characters.description: A friend of Raido.

characters.name: Hanako Satou
characters.description: A friend of Raido.

characters.name: Riku Tamanaha
characters.description: Riku Tamanaha is a kind and cheerful girl who is also very shy and has a fear of interpersonal relationships. She is a kogyaru, a type of gyaru who is known for her fashionable style and outgoing personality. However, Tamanaha's shyness often prevents her from expressing herself fully, and she often overthinks situations and makes herself anxious. This is due to a past experience where she was too clingy to her friends in elementary school, which ended up pushing them away.  Despite her shyness, Tamanaha is very determined to make friends in high school. She is especially eager to be friends with Aharen again, but she is afraid of being rejected. However, Aharen is actually very happy to see her again and they quickly become friends.  Tamanaha is a likable character who is easy to root for. She is relatable to many people who struggle with social anxiety, and her story is one of hope and redemption.

characters.name: Futaba
characters.description: Little girl with black hair. She considers herself a rival of Aharen.

characters.name: Atsushi
characters.description: A neighborhood elementary school boy. He calls Reina "Aha-Ou-sama" (Lord). He is completely oblivious to the affection of his childhood friend Futaba, and always treats her ill.

characters.description: Younger brother to Reina Aharen. He occasionally likes to wear his older sister's clothes, which fooled Raidou into thinking he was Reina.

characters.name: Asami Segawa
characters.description: She is a priestess and the mother of Hiro Segawa.

characters.name: Ritsuko Amano
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Shion Asuma
characters.description: A second-year student at Megurogawa Academy and classmate of Nagi Umino.

characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Nagi Umino
characters.description: Nagi is a second-year student at Megurogawa Gakuen. He is the biological son of a hotel tycoon, but due to a mix-up after his birth is raised by a different family.  Nagi seems to be obsessed with studying to the point that he studies day and night in order to achieve top marks. He is quite capable in pretty much everything, whether it is housework or schoolwork, proving his culinary skills multiple times by preparing delicious dishes everyday. He is a free-willed and determined person with a stubborn attitude to never give up. He is also naïve when it comes to the girls around him. Yet his kindhearted nature means that he will protect the ones that he cares about by doing everything in his power to help them.

characters.name: Youhei Umino
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Hiro Segawa
characters.description: Hiro Segawa is the love interest of Nagi Umino.

characters.name: Sachi Umino
characters.description: Sachi Umino is the sister of [Nagi Umino](https://anilist.co/character/166730/Nagi-Umino).

characters.name: Erika Amano
characters.description: **Height:** 160 cm  Erika Amano is a second-year student at Orpheus Jogakuin but transfers to Megurokawa Gakuen. She is a popular social media celebrity and the biological daughter of the family that raised Nagi.

characters.name: Flora
characters.description: **Race:** Vampire  Flora is a skilled witch who arrived at Hiraku's house searching for Loo. She is also a researcher interested in fermentation, which led her to move to the village. She contributed to the farm by introducing the first two heads of cattle and her knowledge of potion making.

characters.name: Yuuri
characters.description: Yuuri is a demon and the daughter of the current reigning demon king, Gargard. She holds the rank of Princess. She is considered to be the most important ranking member of the royal family (She is not the heir, since Demon Kings are appointed). Like all Demons, she has incredible magical powers.

characters.name: Senna
characters.description: **Race:** Beastman  Senna is the leader and representative of the Beastmen immigrants who migrated from Howling Village to Hiraku's village. She is also the daughter of the former chief of Howling Village.

characters.name: Hiraku Machio
characters.description: **Race:** Human  Hiraku Machio is the main protagonist of Isekai Nonbiri Nouka series. He was resurrected with a healthy body, the ability to speak the common tongue, and the All-Purpose Farming Tool (AFT) by God. Despite being unable to use magic, he cultivates the forest to create farmland and a village, with the help of the wolves Kuro and Yuki, the demon spider Zabuton, and even humanoid species.

characters.name: Loo
characters.description: Race: Vampire Affiliation: Taiju Village, Kingdom of Galbart (Formerly)  Loo is a Female Vampire, who stumbles into Hiraku's farm during his early days of living in the formidable forest of death. On the run, with no where to turn, she falls in love with Hiraku who by this time has not seen another person since coming to the world. She can change her body/age to suit her needs to survive. She is a skilled magician as well as a farmer who works at Hiraku's farm. At first she viewed Hiraku's farm (now a village) as a place she can hide from the nobles and now she views it as home.  !She and Hiraku had a kid named Alfred.!

characters.name: Tier
characters.description: **Race:** Angel  Tier is one of the main characters of Isekai Nonbiri Nouka series. She is an angel with celestial magical powers and bird-like wings that allow her to fly. She is part of the Angel of Annihilation tribe, specializing in golem magic. Tier visits the forest in search of Loo, her frenemy, and ends up living there with Hiraku and Loo.

characters.name: Ria
characters.description: **Race:** High Elf  Ria is the leader of a group of high-elf girls who wandered in the forest after their village was destroyed by humans in a war. They were homeless for 200 years until Tier brought them to Hiraku's farm. Ria is a reliable construction enthusiast and contributes to the farm by establishing a smithy and bringing other technologies such as building construction and baking. After meeting Hiraku and his friends, Ria decides to live with them.

characters.name: Doraim
characters.description: Doraim is the dragon tribe's leader. Royalty and defender of his domain which lies south of the Taiju Village in the western mountains. His lands, acts as a defensive post for civilization, since its situated between the Forest of Death & the lesser known Iron Forest.  While a powerful being, his personality quite a normal being, with taste for drink (such as the Taiju Village in particular). After the defeat of the rare firebreathing wild Wyvern at the hands of Hiraku Machio, he felt such a being must be befriended (he also fears). After becoming fast friends, and discovering the fantastic food & drink the village had to offer. His personal assistant Guchi, must drag him back to his duties as the Gate Keeper in the mountains or he would never leave.  He was such a frequent visitor his own daughter, Lastismun, became gravely concern that he was cheating on his wife, Graffalun, only to find he was over indulging at the Taiju Village, now having a guest home.  After his daughter, attempted to attack the village, he ordered her to remain there to get better acquainted with them and cool down her temper.

characters.name: Fraurem Chrome
characters.description: Fraurem Chrome is a demon and daughter of Demon King advisor, Bizel Chrome, she is hard working girl. She was sent to Taiju Village by her father as his representative. Originally thought to be spy, she turned out to be normal resident.

characters.name: Ann
characters.description: **Race:** Oni  Ann is an Oni and represents the Oni Maids who now live in the village with Flora. Formerly working for Loo and Flora, she now also looks after Hiraku and his family in the forest.

characters.name: Hakuren
characters.description: **Race:** Dragon  Hakuren is the older sister of Doraim and Rasuti's aunt. She initially attacks the village upon hearing that her niece, Rasuti, has a boyfriend, but is eventually repelled by Hiraku and decides to settle down in the village.

characters.name: Graffaloon
characters.description: A white dragon who is Doraim's wife and Rasutisumoon's mother.

characters.name: Rasutisumoon
characters.description: **Race:** Dragon  Rasutisumoon is the daughter of Doraim and Graffaloon, who requested her to serve as a diplomat in Hiraku's village. She later takes charge of the village's diplomatic relations.

characters.name: Akane Shinjou
characters.description: !Also known as Zegga (ゼッガー Zeggā) in her Kaiju form) is one of the main characters and alongside Alexis Kerib, she served as a central antagonist in SSSS.Gridman.!  Akane is noted to be a kind and popular girl, liked by all her classmates, and especially admired by Utsumi. !However, behind that facade lies a mentally troubled individual with sociopathic tendencies, easily harboring petty grudges against anyone who wrongs her, even if it was an accident. She is also shown to be extremely manipulative and violent.!

characters.name: Anosillus 2-daime
characters.description: She is a mysterious girl who somehow knows of the secrets of the world. Similar to Anti, she is really a kaiju in human form. However, unlike the other kaiju, she was not created by Akane Shinjo.

characters.name: Tomoya Aki
characters.description: Occupation: Student / Executive producer / Director / Scenario writer / Manager  Tomoya is described as a 'hardcore geek'. However, he is one of the three most notable students at Toyogasaki Academy, along with [Utaha Kasumigaoka](https://anilist.co/character/88750/Utaha-Kasumigaoka) and [Eriri Spencer Sawamura](https://anilist.co/character/88749/Eriri-Spencer-Sawamura), due to his strong advocating of otaku culture at the school.  Tomoya is an otaku and prefers reading comics and light novels, watching anime, and playing visual novels above anything else. He is an enthusiastic fan of [Utaha](https://anilist.co/character/88750/Utaha-Kasumigaoka)'s novel Koisuru Metronome. He is the founder and representative member of Blessing Software, serving as the producer, director and programmer. He is also the manager of [Michiru](https://anilist.co/character/88752/Michiru-Hyoudou)'s cover band "Icy Tail". When motivated, especially by otaku-related factors, he can be shown to be very hardworking. After his encounter with [Megumi Kato](https://anilist.co/character/88748/Megumi-Katou), his strong desire to make his dream game drives him to take up several jobs for funding. He is extremely tenacious and would do anything to get what he wants, but is easily distracted. He was a typical consumer otaku who would spend the money at his part-time job on anime and games, but his money and time are later devoted to his own games. He is very friendly despite his eccentric personality, and he has a strong sense of morals and conviction when dealing with others.

characters.name: Megumi Katou
characters.description: Height: 160 cm (5'3") Occupation: Student / Assistant Director / Main Heroine  Megumi Kato is the classmate of [Tomoya Aki](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki), who is hardly noticed by others. After Tomoya had met her during the fate summons, she inspired him to make a dating sim game, featuring her as his Main Heroine. However, he is disappointed by her real personality. She is one of the main characters of the [Saenai Heroine no Sodatekata](https://anilist.co/anime/20657/Saenai-Heroine-no-Sodatekata/) series and is essentially the inspiration for the series title.

characters.name: Eriri Sawamura
characters.description: Height: 158 cm (5’2”) Occupation: Student / Illustrator / Painter  Eriri Spencer Sawamura is [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki)'s childhood friend. She is a student of class 2G art club. She wears two hats as a student and a doujinshi artist. Eriri is one of the most beautiful girls to attend to Toyogasaki High School. Her family is very affluent. Her father is an English diplomat and she lives in a mansion. She is the secret illustrator for a famous doujinshi circle called ''Egoistic Lily'' under the alias Eri Kashiwagi when she participates in doujin activities. She was greatly influenced by her fujoshi mother and otaku father. She was the illustrator for Blessing Software.

characters.name: Utaha Kasumigaoka
characters.description: Height: 169 cm (5’6”) Occupation: Student / Author / Scenario Writer  Utaha Kasumigaoka is an up-and-coming young novelist and a student in class 3C who has a secret identity as a writer.  She is a hardworking girl who easily finishes writing their game's plot in the span of a night. Her usual disinterested expression gives off the impression that she is an unapproachable person. When she is with the people in [Tomoya Aki](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki)'s circle, she reverts to her disdainful self who enjoys making sarcastic remarks. She seems to be calm and quiet, but she actually has a sharp tongue. Utaha can be a little aggressive. Utaha is also very intelligent and is the smartest student in the school. She even writes plays for the drama club as a hobby. She is also a little bit self-centered, but she never talks back to her parents, making her well-mannered. However, when [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki) complimented her one time, she acted like a shy, embarrassed girl instead of her usual cold self and called [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki) by his first name instead of Rinri-kun.

characters.name: Izumi Hashima
characters.description: Height: 157 cm (5'2") Occupation: Student / Illustrator   Izumi Hashima is a student in class 3A of Honoda Junior High School and a supporting-main character in the [Saenai Heroine no Sodatekata](https://anilist.co/anime/20657/Saenai-Heroine-no-Sodatekata/) series. She later attends the same high school as [Tomoya Aki](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki), the Toyogasaki High School.  When she was younger, Izumi used to be very outgoing and active and played with the boys. But after being introduced to the world of otaku by [Tomoya Aki](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki), she has become immersed in the fandom. Over all, Izumi has shown to very cheerful and glad, as she usually is seen with a smile on her lips. She usually is seen playing around, especially with [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki). Izumi is also very air-headed and childish and she rarely gives up on something that she really wants or likes. She has also shown to be quite matured.

characters.name: Michiru Hyoudou
characters.description: Height: 174cm (5'8")  Michiru Hyodo is [Tomoya Aki](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki)'s cousin/childhood friend (and by far his longest standing friend). She is a student in class 3, in the second year of Tsubaki Girls' Senior High School.  Michiru would have been a well-rounded student if not for her poor academic performance. She is fickle and naturally good at anything she does. [Tomoya Aki](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki) once noted that Michiru had a lot of useless talents. She is not interested in anything but her band and music, and enjoys playing the guitar. Michiru had a prejudice against otaku culture and wasn't happy about [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki) being an otaku and tried to get him out of his 'nerd phase' until Tokino Himekawa, Echika Mizuhara and Ranko Morioka (band members) told her they were all otaku. Michiru is a kind and caring girl, but she can also be childish sometimes and she also seems to be naturally cheerful as she is usually seen with a smile on her face. However, she also has shown to be serious and mature. It is hinted that she has feelings for [Tomoya](https://anilist.co/character/88747/Tomoya-Aki), though its not completely clear due to her slightly impassive personality.

characters.name: Sonoko Machida
characters.description: Sonoko Machida works at Fujikawa Shoten and is Utaha Kasumigaoka's editor.  She is a calm, collected and hardworking young woman who is also very mature but she acts childish at times.

characters.name: Ranko Morioka
characters.description: Ranko Morioka is the oboist of the Icy tail band who is a is a casual otaku fan.  She is a quiet and calm girl who also seems to be experienced in Data Processing.

characters.name: Echika Mizuhara
characters.description: Echika Mizuhara is another oboist of the Icy tail band who is a vocaloid addict.  She has shoulder-length purple hair that has a light purple colored hair band attached to her head and violet eyes.

characters.name: Tokino Himekawa
characters.description: Tokino Himekawa is another oboist of the Icy tail band who is a voice actor fanatic.  She is a petite girl that has purple shoulder-length hair that curls at the tip. She has purple eyes. Tokino is usually seen with normal Tsubaki Girls Senior school uniform.

characters.name: Iori Hashima
characters.description: Iori Hashima is the older brother of Izumi Hashima, Tomoya Aki's former best friend and the previous representative of Rouge en rouge.  Iori is friendly at first, and despite being soft-spoken, he can be a little cold, and he dislikes being ignored. He can be kind as well as shown when he helped Tomoya Aki when he was in a tight spot.

characters.name: Akane Kousaka
characters.description: The leader of doujin circle Rouge en rouge.

characters.name: Hiro Kurusu
characters.description: She is Takezou's classmate and joins the koto music club after hearing their first performance. She has knowledge of koto due to the influence of her grandmother. She becomes the koto music club's vice-president.

characters.name: Takezou Kurata
characters.description: President of koto music club. He's shy and weak in difficult situations. After his failure at the exam, depressed, Takezou saw his senpai's performance, where she was giving her all even though no one listened and koto's string had been broken. He was deeply moved by her performance, so he joined the club. After senpai's graduation, he became an only member of koto music club and had to find strength to protect it.

characters.name: Suzuka Takinami
characters.description: A math teacher at Tokise High and the Koto Club's advisor.  !Initially he feigned ignorance of his musical background, though it's later revealed that his parents are world renowned musicians. As a child, he had no interest in playing music whatsoever other than listening to it. When he was seven, his father discovered his talent for writing musical scores and quickly took upon him to brand his son as a child prodigy. Because of this, Suzuka began to disdain music but his interest is later revitalized after becoming the advisor for the Koto club. He often writes pieces for the club as well as gives practice advice, while leaving the actual koto teaching to Akira.!

characters.name: Isaki Kudou
characters.description: Height: 164 cm Relatives: [Gen Kudou](https://anilist.co/character/134571/) (Father, Deceased), [Chika Kudou](https://anilist.co/character/126137/) (Nephew)  Is the aunt of Chika Kudo who provides a place for him to live after his grandfather passes away.

characters.name: Mio Kanzaki
characters.description: Height: 172 cm Affiliation: Hakuto High School Occupation: Student  Mio Kanzaki is a 2nd year student at Hakuto High School and a member of its koto club.

characters.name: Kouta Mizuhara
characters.description: Kota Mizuhara is a second year student at Tokise High School and a member of the Tokise High School Koto Club.

characters.name: Satowa Houzuki
characters.description: Height: 158 cm (5'2")  Satowa is a first year student and the daughter of a famous koto family, Houzuki. She has been learning to play koto since she was little and has won many contests. Although she is a koto prodigy, Satowa was debarred from Houzukikai. She claims that she joined the koto music club because she wants to become known as "young virtuoso koto player that led a no-name school club to become number 1 in nation" when she makes professional debut. She loves koto.

characters.name: Michitaka Sakai
characters.description: Michitaka Sakai is a second year student at Tokise High School and a member of the Tokise High School Koto Club.

characters.name: Saneyasu Adachi
characters.description: Saneyasu is a second-year student at Tokise High School and a member of the Tokise High School Koto Club.

characters.name: Chiharu Houzuki
characters.description: Satowa's mother.

characters.name: Tetsuki Takaoka
characters.description: Tetsuki has been classmates with Chika since middle school. He's worried about his friend, because he knows Chika's circumstances. He seems to be a quiet person, but in reality he shows his true colors when fighting. He comes from wealthy family, his father is the director of a large hospital.

characters.name: Takeru Kurata
characters.description: Height: 170 cm Relatives: [Takezo Kurata](https://anilist.co/character/134561/Takezou-Kurata) (Older brother) Status: Active Affiliation: Meiryou High School Occupation: Student  The younger brother of Takezo Kurata and a student at Meiryou High School.

characters.name: Chika Kudou
characters.description: **Height:** 178 cm (5'10")  The first member to join Kurata in the club. Kudou brings with him a reputation for fighting and delinquency, which initially makes others distrustful of him. However, underneath his rough exterior is a kind heart who wants to honor his deceased grandfather by playing the koto.  !Prior to the start of the series, Chika was neglected by his father and was caused to live with his grandfather, [Gen Kudo](https://anilist.co/character/134571/Kudou-Gen), instead. During these days, Chika would always get into fights and is infamous because of this. Despite this, [Tetsuki Takaoka](https://anilist.co/character/134572/Takaoka-Tetsuki) was close to him and would often come to Gen's house to check up on Chika. Through his grandfather's attempts, and also Tetsuki's reaching outs, Kudo starts to become mellow. Unfortunately, the bad crowd he was hanging out with disliked this and set Chika up by ransacking his grandfather's house where he crafts kotos that he is blamed for this by the neighbors and the police. Not long after this incident, Gen passed away due to a heart disease and it is revealed that Chika now lives with his paternal aunt, [Isaki Kudo](https://anilist.co/character/134563/Kudou-Isaki), after Gen's passing.!

characters.name: Rody Soul
characters.description: Quirk: Soul  Original character from My Hero Academia The Movie: World Heroes' Mission.  Rody is a very carefree individual who always looks for an opportunity/job to support his younger brother and sister and make their lives better. He is a smooth liar and a good negotiator, able to talk his way out of most situations.

characters.name: Kaname Kuran
characters.description: **Height:** 184 cm    A pureblood vampire. He saved Yuuki from an attack by another vampire when she was little. Kaname is the class president of the Night Class, much feared and respected by the other Night Class students. While he is cold and authoritative towards his fellows in the Night Class, he is always kind and sweet to Yuuki. He has shown that he cares deeply for Yuuki ever since he saved her, and loves her in a romantic sense.   As a Pureblood, Kaname is capable of controlling lesser vampires, but he chooses not to exercise his powers, thus earning the respect of the Noble vampires. He shares the Chairman's hopes for peace between vampires and humans. He worked with the Chairman to create the Night Class at Cross Academy and with his presence, allows the Night Class to be kept in check. But the real reason Kaname agreed to attend the academy is so that he can be near Yuuki and protect her as she is his love.   !It turns out that he is Yuki's brother and fiance.!

characters.name: Sayori Wakaba
characters.description: Age: 15 - 16 years old  Height: 162 cm  Family !Sayori's family is with the Vampire Hunters Association. Her Father is the Councillor.!  Yuuki's dorm-mate and best friend since junior high, Yuuki often refers to her as Yori-chan. Yori seems to be one of the few girls who is not interested in the Night Class. She finds them a bit scary and stated that she would prefer someone from the day class. Yori is also very observant, as she notices a lot of things that happen to Yuuki, especially when she gets hurt or is very depressed.  Yori's part in the story is relatively small. She spends a lot of time worried about Yuki not geting enough sleep and having nightmares. She teases Yuki when Ichiru reveals that Zero  has feelings for Yuki and confirms Yori's suspicions, although the whole matter isn't clear to Yuki. Yori finds out that Yuki is a vampire after Aido protected her from a Level D vampire, who served Rido. Despite that fact, Yori still accepts Yuki and appeared to be more worried over the fact that she would lose her best friend. Because of the recent events at Cross Academy, she is taken to a safe place by Aidou on Kaname's orders. After the attack is over, she defends Aido when the other day class girls are afraid of him. Yori is one of the only day class students that know about vampire's existence, she now has a deeper friendship with Zero Kiryuu, even to be thought as Zero's girlfriend by Kaito (new teacher of Ethics starting from chapter 53). Kaito helps Yori to go to the vampire ball in chapter 53, having her stow away in his suitcase, which Zero freaks when she appears at the ball. Kaito and Zero promise to keep an eye on her while she goes find her best friend, Yuuki Kuran.    ! Yori was surprised after seeing Yuki in her vampire form. At that time, Yuki did not fully finish her transformation, and the only visible change in her was the appearance of her fangs and long hair. However, when Yori sees Yuki again at the party (in the Manga) she is astonished at the change of her best friend. Yuki, who was once the tiny day class student and the naive one, was now taller than Yori herself and was more mature. !

characters.name: Akatsuki Kain
characters.description: Aidou's cousin and another one of "Kaname-sama's right hand." His carefree attitude gets both him and Aido in trouble at times. His nickname is "Wild," despite the fact he is actually mellower than Aido. He tends to get blamed for the actions of other vampires, especially Aido, despite not being involved and ends up getting punished as a result. In a bonus story at the end of Volume 2 ("I Must've Been Born Under the "Victim of Circumstances" Star...") he also refers to Kaname as their "gang leader." He is incredibly perceptive and is frequently sensitive to others' feelings, most particularly with Aido and Ruka's. Also seems that he has feelings for Ruka and likes her.

characters.name: Hanabusa Aidou
characters.description: Nicknamed "Idol" by the Day Class girls. Along with his cousin Akatsuki Kain, Hanabusa Aido is known among the Night Class as "Kaname-sama's right hand," and he has a fierce admiration for Kaname. He possesses an upper-class vampire ability to control ice. He knows that Zero is a vampire, but keeps quiet about it. Aido can seem cheerful and friendly one moment, and cold and vindictive the next. He is not fond of Yuuki, but he tolerates her because Kaname cares for her. He is the only one to have witnessed Kaname kill Shizuka, but Aidou still looks up to Kaname and wants to lend Kaname his power to help find who killed Kaname's parents. Even though Kaname declined his offer so that Aidou wouldn't put himself in danger, Aidou is now researching behind Kaname's back in books and records to try to find who could possibly have been enemies of the Kurans and to find Kaname's secrets.     (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kaien Cross
characters.description: Yuuki's adoptive parent, who also took Zero into his home several years ago. Headmaster Cross dreams of peace between humans and vampires, and established the Night Class to promote understanding between the two races. Although he is often eccentric, he has a serious side as well. It is revealed that he is a former vampire hunter.   ! Kaien Cross was considered "History's Greatest Legendary Vampire Hunter" though he refused being called that way. !

characters.name: Ruka Souen
characters.description: Height: 167 cm  A female vampire popular with the Day Class students and is one of those are the most faithful and protective of Kaname. She seems to dislike Zero because Kaname acknowledges him and carries bitterness for Yuuki's place in Kaname's heart as her feelings for Kaname run deep. When Yuuki was younger and had not become one of the school's Guardians yet, she once witnessed Kaname drinking Ruka's blood when she paid Kaname a visit. Ruka has feelings for Kaname, although he does not reciprocate them and only drank her blood one time to keep himself from biting Yuuki.   ! In chapter 81 it is revealed that she has the ability to create illusions.!

characters.name: Senri Shiki
characters.description: Senri Shiki is one of the youngest Night Class members and works as a model with Rima Touya. He stands at 178 cm tall. Senri is usually the one sent out to hunt down a level E vampire. He is able to control and bend his blood at will. Senri's father is Rido Kuran, making him Kaname and Yuki's cousin, and his mother's uncle is part of the council. As part of a plan to resurrect himself, Rido possesses his son's body. During Rido's fight against Rima, Shiki is able to awaken within himself and attempt to regain control of his body. After Rido's revival, Senri regained consciousness of his body.

characters.name: Shizuka Hio
characters.description: The pureblood vampire who bit Zero; even her fellow vampires are uneasy around her. She is called "Mad Blooming Princess" by her fellow vampires. A manservant whom she loved (a former human vampire; said to have never fallen to Level E) was killed by a Kiryu vampire hunter. In retribution, she attacked the Kiryu family, killed the parents, turned their son Zero into a vampire, and took Zero's twin, Ichiru, in as a devoted servant.   !Shizuka's blood can prevent Zero from falling to Level E, and thus Yuuki risked her life for Zero to be able to drink Shizuka's blood. But Kaname killed Shizuka to protect Yuuki. Kaname drank her blood, but left some for Zero to drink as well. Unfortunately the blood was drunk by Ichiru who arrived at the scene first. Before dying, Shizuka warns Kaname that he will live in darkness and has summoned a sinister future for himself.!

characters.name: Toga Yagari
characters.description: The current top ranked vampire hunter, Toga Yagari, formerly trained Zero to be a vampire hunter. He had lost his right eye due to trying to save Zero long ago from a level E vampire. He showed up once at Cross Academy serving for a short while as a Night Class teacher to decide whether Zero is considered dangerous or not. He also appears briefly in volume five, when he appears shocked about the council's decision to punish Zero.  ! Yagari reviled that the level E that he killed to save Zero and that cost him his right eyes was actually his fiancee.!

characters.name: Maria Kurenai
characters.description: Maria Kurenai is a very distant relative of Shizuka Hio. She allows Shizuka to possess her body in exchange for being allowed to drink Shizuka's blood, which would strengthen her sickly body. Due to Shizuka's untimely death, this promise is never fulfilled. She seems to be fond of Ichiru, hugging Zero when she mistakes him for Ichiru, and asks Yuki to tell Zero that if he sees Ichiru, to tell him Maria wants to see him again.    !She returns to her family after Shizuka's death.When she sends an owl out to search for Ichiru, she witnesses Kaname's destruction of the Vampire Council and proceeds to spread the news. Maria returns to cross academy after Yuki reassembles the night class!  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Haruka Kuran
characters.description: Yuki's father and a pureblood vampire. Haruka was killed by his older brother, Rido Kuran, in his attempt to stop Rido from killing Yuki ten years ago. He revealed that the Vampire Council is trying to use pure blooded vampires status and the powerful blood to serve itself. He is the brother and husband of Juri Kuran. Before his death, he hugged Kaname and said that as a loving father, he did not want his child to enter the fight. It was stated that Haruka had been alive for nearly 3000 years and has known Juri for almost as long.

characters.name: Yuuki Cross
characters.description: Height: 156 cm    The adoptive daughter of the headmaster of Cross Academy, Yuuki is a member of the school's disciplinary committee (public morals committee in Japanese), which is the 'front' for the Guardians. Ten years prior to the events of "Vampire Knight," Yuuki was attacked by a vampire, but was rescued by Kaname. She has lost all memory of her life before the attack, and Headmaster Cross took her in as his own daughter. Yuuki loves Kaname, and even though she has witnessed his vampiric nature when he bit Ruka, she still couldn't stop loving him. However, she has also started to let Zero, a childhood friend, drink her blood, hoping to save him from madness. Yuuki is cheerful and easygoing, and thanks to her work as a Guardian she is good at keeping her cool in sticky situations. There have been hints that she is special, given that vampires are especially drawn to her blood. Her weapon of choice is the "Artemis Rod," an extensible staff she received from Headmaster Cross.

characters.name: Zero Kiryuu
characters.description: Height: 178 cm - 183 cm   Yuuki's childhood friend, Zero is also a Guardian and likewise on the disciplinary committee. Yuuki has been taking care of him as her little brother since he was brought into their home (the Headmaster's). His family, a line of vampire hunters, was murdered by the pure blood vampire Shizuka Hio when he was young. He harbors a deep hatred for vampires and claims to have taken on the role of Guardian to learn to hunt them better. In truth, Zero was bitten during the attack on his family, and have kept the secret that he was a vampire from Yuuki until he was no longer capable of controlling his vampiric urges.  Zero's body rejects the blood tablets that most vampires take to control their hunger. Drinking Yuuki's blood helps him maintain his sanity, but he is destined to become a Level E vampire eventually. He has started to accept his feelings towards Yuki and has gone as far as to almost kissing  her. Zero's weapon is the gun "Bloody Rose," given to him by Headmaster Cross. He made Yuuki promise that if he becomes a Level E vampire, she will kill him with that gun.

characters.name: Crow
characters.description: With the ability to imbue his words with mana, he is the Curse Blighted. Because anything he says will be affected by his mana, he normally wears a bird-like mask, which has earned him the name "Crow the Dark Raptor." During battle, he uses his Cursed Speech in order to support his comrades. His inability to speak freely, due to his curse, made him seem introverted and gloomy for a long time, but, with Lloyd's help, his powers are now under control, and he seems much more cheerful.   (Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

characters.name: Dian de Saloum
characters.description: The fourth prince of the Saloum Kingdom, and one of Lloyd's older brothers. While he had a fondness for magic from an early age, due to a lack of talent, at age 10 he chose to pursue blacksmithing instead, traveling to the neighboring kingdom of Bartram for his education in the subject. His dream is to create swords enchanted with magical power, with an eye towards establishing a Magic Swordsman Corps in Saloum. A dedicated craftsman with a rough edge, but a kind heart.   (Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

characters.name: Albert de Saloum
characters.description: The second prince of the Saloum Kingdom, and one of Lloyd's older brothers. The current heir to the throne with both martial and academic ability. Often at the center of attention in the palace, but lacking in arrogance, he treats his subordinates with care and has earned the backing of many parties. Albert has recognized Lloyd's talent with magic where others have overlooked it, and considers him a potential valuable ally for the future.   (Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

characters.name: Alieze de Saloum
characters.description: The sixth princess of the Saloum Kingdom, Lloyd's older sister. With her personal maid, Eris, she keeps a menagerie of her favorite animals in the castle's "Boxed Garden Tower", and spends her days leisurely looking after them. A laid-back and absent-minded girl who, much like her brothers, dotes on Lloyd. She possesses a magical power that lets her subconsciously connect with animals and monsters, resulting in even high-level creatures like a lesser fenrir being among her pets. She believes this is purely the result of the affection she shows them   (Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

characters.name: Shiro
characters.description: One of the four wild bearwolf monsters that live in the forest. After being doused in Lloyd's magic power he transforms into a white, fluffy form, earning him the name "Shiro." With a keen sense of smell and a massive body, he can transport Lloyd and Sylpha around with ease.   (Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

characters.name: Ren
characters.description: Part of the Assassins Guild, whose members all have bounties on their heads. Members of this guild are all born with a condition affecting their mana, known as “The Blighted”, and in Ren's case she is able to secrete poison through her skin, earning her the name "Ren the Poison Moth." Normally wears heavy clothing, and when her skin is exposed she is capable of spreading poison around an area. A bit of a tomboy, who has a shy personality thanks to her power.   (Source: Official Site)

characters.name: Tao
characters.description: A martial artist that uses a foreign breathing method that gives access to superhuman abilities, known as “Qi”. After a life dedicated wholly to training, she fled her dojo to become an adventurer in pursuit of a fateful meeting with a handsome man. However, she had little luck with finding adventuring comrades, and encounters Lloyd while traveling on her own. Has a weakness for pretty faces, with a cheerful and excited disposition.   (Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

characters.name: Sylpha
characters.description: [Lloyd](https://anilist.co/character/290877/de-Saloum-Lloyd)'s loyal maid, who serves the Kingdom of Saloum. In charge of his education and his protection. Has mastery with a blade that adventurers envy, along with the alias "The Silver Blade Princess." Seems very kind at first, but rigorous when it comes to training with a sword. She was a cold-hearted swordswoman in the past, and during battle that side of her surfaces.   (Source: Official Site)

characters.name: Galilea
characters.description: The Web Blighted, who converts the mana that covers his body into a sticky fluid. After Jade returns to his homeland for personal reasons, Galilea finds himself in charge of the Assassin's Guild. He fights by using a combination of his webs and his powerful frame. He understands his teammates personalities well, giving him effective command even during chaotic battles.   (Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

characters.name: Talia
characters.description: The Pain Blighted, whose ability allows her to link with anyone she sees, at which point she and her target will share any injuries either suffers. Given the nature of her power, she often harms herself as a tactic in battle, earning her the name "Talia the Hundred Pains." She has a self-sacrificing personality where she will endure pain willingly for the sake of her friends. She loves gossip, and often takes care of Ren as the only other girl in the guild.   (Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

characters.name: Babylon
characters.description: The Warp Blighted, whose joints are unnaturally flexible, allowing him to fit through even the smallest of spaces, like a rodent, earning him the name "Babylon the Giant Rat." A master of martial arts that utilizes his body's flexibility, he is recognizable by his small eyes that conceal his emotions. During combat he will laugh in a way that antagonizes his enemies. Though he seems aloof, much like the rest of the guild, he cares greatly for his companions, and is known for keeping a cool head, as well being a reliable decision maker.  (Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

characters.name: Lloyd de Saloum
characters.description: The seventh prince of the royal family that rules the Kingdom of Saloum. He was reincarnated and grows up with the memories of his previous life as a sorcerer. Although he's only ten years old, he has an enormous amount of sorcery knowledge and possesses mana that even terrifies demons. He's not interested in things such as succession to the throne, girls, or romance. Instead, his activities and desires are all focused on the research of his beloved sorcery and its practice.   (Source: Official Site)

characters.name: Grimoire
characters.description: A demon who uses the old magic and once drove the Kingdom of Saloum into the verge of collapse. After being sealed inside of a forbidden tome that was locked away in the kingdom's sealed archive for several centuries, he's released by Lloyd and they have their first encounter. But he becomes overwhelmed by Lloyd's immeasurable mana and sorcery and surrenders to him. After that, he turns into a cute familiar and serves Lloyd.   (Source: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability Official Site)

characters.name: Ifrit
characters.description: Ifrit is a high-ranking spirit; the ruler of flame which was sealed within Shizue Izawa by Demon Lord Leon Cromwell. He used to live in Dwelling of the Spirit before he was stolen by the "Blonde Demon" Leon Cromwell. After that, he was sealed within Shizue Izawa. As a result of this, it gave Shizue an extended lifespan.

characters.name: Gazel Dwargo
characters.description: Species: Dwarf Blessing / Divine Protection: Divine Protector of Ancestor Title: King of Armament Nation Dwargon. The king of Dwargon, Gazel Dwargo, the third generation king of Dwargon, but possesses a similar aura to that of his grandfather in his younger days. He is renowned as a great hero and celebrated as a wise king for his impartial rule.

characters.name: Kaval
characters.description: Kaval is the leader of his adventure's party, where he serves as the 'fighter' role. !Alongside Gido, he is also tasked as the secret bodyguard of Lady Elyune under the guise of an adventurer.!  (Source: Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken Wikia)

characters.name: Ellen
characters.description: Eren is an adventurer and a member of Kaval's Party. !She is actually the daughter of the Duke of Sorcerer's Dynasty Sarion Elalude, who ran off to be an adventurer due to her selfishness and free-spirited personality.!   (Source: Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken Wikia)

characters.name: Magna Swing
characters.description: Height: 169 cm  A member of the Black Bulls magic knight squad. Coming from Rayaka out in the countryside, he can easily bond with [Asta](https://anilist.co/character/123285/Asta) whom he is profoundly impressed by.  His magic allows him to form fireballs which he can hurl at targets. He uses them as baseballs for the unofficial welcoming ceremonies he holds for new recruits. He can also form a magic bat for hitting his fireballs.

characters.name: Finral Roulacase
characters.description: Height: 173 cm (5'8'')  He is a nobleman of House Vaude and a member of Clover Kingdom's Black Bull squad of the Magic Knights. He is from Tota, a village within the Clover Kingdom.

characters.name: Charlotte Roselei
characters.description: Height: 171 cm  Charlotte is a noblewoman of House Roselei and the captain of Clover Kingdom's Blue Rose squad of the Magic Knights.  She appears as a quiet, cold, and indifferent woman who keeps her emotions controlled and well hidden. She is constantly shown to appear as a rather stern woman, despite inwardly having an inward monologue that constantly appears to say calm down, especially around [Yami Sukehiro](https://anilist.co/character/124440/Sukehiro-Yami). She often does not respond to situations that go out of hand, preferring to appear indifferent and let things play out. She does respond well to emergencies and pressing concerns, performing her duties and moving swiftly to take care of any problems that come up. However, she still is capable of losing her composure and becoming annoyed, which almost always involves Yami teasing of her. She is also a lightweight when it comes to alcohol, barely able to finish a pint before becoming drunk.  Charlotte considers her duty to the kingdom to be her foremost responsibility, with little interest in the social aspects of life. Her beauty is quite noticeable when she chooses to show it, but she is more comfortable in plate mail than silk dresses and cares little for the opinions of most others. She also has a hard time being open with most people and expressing herself on occasion. That said, she often quips back at her fellow captains when they make rash decisions or do something she considers stupid, particularly Yami. However, she also has admiration for those who are competent and work hard, though she rarely ever shows it. Outwardly, she displays little interest in finding a husband and becomes angry when the subject is brought up, for which Yami repeatedly teases her and calls her "Spiny Prickly Queen."

characters.name: Noelle Silva
characters.description: Height: 161 cm (5'3")  Noelle Silva is a member of the Black Bulls and was inducted into the squad around the same time as [Asta](https://anilist.co/character/123285). She is the second daughter of one of the Clover Kingdom's royal families, House Silva, and the younger sister of the captain of the Silver Eagles, [Nozel Silva](https://anilist.co/character/124442). She likes sweets.  !Her family disowned her due to her lack of control on her magic and having [their mother](https://anilist.co/character/124972) die while giving birth to her.!

characters.name: Yuno
characters.description: Height: 172 cm (5'7")  Yuno was left, along with Asta, in front of a church in a village called Hage when he was an infant. He grew up at the church and spends most of his day with Asta. Sometime later, a thug tries to take his necklace away from him and sell it for money. Fortunately, Asta steps in and tries to take it back. In the end, the thug decided to leave without the necklace after Asta keeps charging at him. Since then, Yuno stopped crying and decides to take Asta's dream to be the Wizard King as his own as well.

characters.name: Asta
characters.description: Height: 155 cm (5'1")  An orphan who was left under the care of a church in the village of Hage. He dreams of becoming ​the Wizard King but is unable to use magic, so he trains to build up his physical strength. He is the wielder of a five-leaf clover anti-magic grimoire and is a 3rd Class Junior Magic Knight of the Clover Kingdom's Black Bull and Royal Knights squads.

characters.name: Julius Novachrono
characters.description: Height: 180 cm  The Wizard King of Clover Kingdom's Order of the Magic Knights. Fascinated by magic in all its forms, he eagerly seeks out and observes unusual magical abilities whenever possible. Those close to him know him for his boundless enthusiasm, excitement, and curiosity toward magic.  Chapter 333 spoiler: !It is revealed that Julius was born in a body with two souls, with the other being [Lucius Zogratis](https://anilist.co/character/319876)!

characters.name: Vanessa Enoteca
characters.description: Height: 170 cm  Originally from the Forest of Witches, Vanessa is a member of the Black Bull Brigade.

characters.name: William Vangeance
characters.description: Height: 172 cm  William Vangeance is the captain of Clover Kingdom's Golden Dawn squad of the Magic Knights. He is currently the closest person to becoming the next Wizard King.

characters.name: Nozel Silva
characters.description: Height: 177 cm  Nozel is a nobleman and the oldest son of the Clover Kingdom's ruling family, House Silva. He is also the captain of the Silver Eagle squad of the Magic Knights. !He is also the son of Acier Silva, the older brother of Nebra Silva, Solid Silva and Noelle Silva, and the cousin of Kirsch Vermilion and Mimosa Vermilion.!

characters.name: Grey
characters.description: Species: Human Affinity: Transformation Height: 159cm  A 3rd Class Junior Magic Knight of Clover Kingdom's Black Bull squad.

characters.name: Conrad Leto
characters.description: The 27th Wizard King of the Clover Kingdom's Magic Knights.

characters.name: Yami Sukehiro
characters.description: Height: 183 cm  Yami Sukehiro is a foreigner from the Land of the Sun and the first captain of the Clover Kingdom's Black Bulls squad of the Magic Knights. !He is also a former member of the Grey Deer squad.!

characters.name: Ruruka Andou
characters.description: Height: 162 cm (5'4") Talent: Ultimate Confectioner  During her time in Class 76th at Hope's Peak Academy.  In Future Arc, she is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 8 Director. Her responsibility as the director is assistance in procuring stable food sources. She, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

characters.name: Junko Enoshima
characters.description: Height: 169 cm (5'7") Talent: Gyaru  Junko is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant in the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Gyaru (超高校級のギャル), or Ultimate Fashionista in the English localization.  Junko is talkative, charismatic, and can be hotheaded at times.  !It is discovered that the girl who introduced herself as Junko wasn't really Junko at all, but actually Mukuro Ikusaba, her twin sister, the Ultimate Soldier. She was the "victim" of the fifth murder, her body having been used to create a fake crime scene. The real Junko, the younger twin who she switched places with, was the mastermind behind Monokuma, as well as the Tragedy.!  !Junko's real personality and mannerisms are erratic and unstable, switching through several "personalities" at the drop of a hat, which she says is because she gets bored easily. Junko is incredibly manipulative and cunning, having orchestrated the Tragedy. She is obsessed with despair and finds it to be the most enjoyable emotion in the world.!  !It is eventually revealed that her true talent is that of Super High School Level Analytical Prowess. This ability allows her to quickly analyze her surroundings with superhuman speed, detailed thinking, and memorization, giving her the ability to predict the future with near-perfect accuracy, as well as be able to learn and understand new skills by just seeing it once. This ability is also what gave Junko her "Ultimate Fashionista" title: because she's able to predict trends, she can predict what will become popular with society.!

characters.name: Chisa Yukizome
characters.description: Height: 161 cm (5'3") Talent: Ultimate Housekeeper  She was later Class 77-B's homeroom teacher, and then the Future Foundation's Branch 5 Office Director responsible for the inquiry and secret intelligence regarding Despair. She, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.

characters.name: Chiaki Nanami
characters.description: Height: 160 cm (5'2") Talent: Ultimate Gamer  A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip.   Chiaki normally has a quiet and sleepy disposition, but she becomes a lot more lively when discussing games and concentrates hard when playing. She has a number of unusual habits, such as dozing off while playing games and taking long pauses during her conversations to think about everything she wants to say. She sometimes even sleeps while standing and forgets to breathe when she's playing games. She also quite often uses gaming terms and references, and has a habit of ending her sentences with an uncertain note, such as with "...I think", or "Maybe...". [Hajime](https://anilist.co/character/90007/Hinata-Hajime) has told her that he wishes she had a more positive catchphrase.  Chiaki is very calm, and she once mentioned that she has never screamed. She often helps Hajime Hinata during the Class Trials and provides important points. She can be stern and bluntly honest, even at times forgetting to take other people's feelings into consideration. However, Chiaki truly does care about and wants to protect everyone. She dislikes killing more than anything and she gets very serious about the topic. She is the nicest towards [Monomi](https://anilist.co/character/73237/Monomi) and she is very understanding towards [Nagito Komaeda](https://anilist.co/character/73227/Komaeda-Nagito), even though his actions frustrate her.  !Nanami is actually revealed to be an AI created by Alter Ego to be a mole for the Future Foundation.!

characters.name: Mukuro Ikusaba
characters.description: Height: 169 cm (5'7") Talent: Soldier  Mukuro is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Soldier (超高校級の軍人), or Ultimate Soldier in the English localization.  !During the Killing School Life, Mukuro disguised as her younger twin sister, Junko Enoshima, and joined the remaining fifteen students to carry out Junko's plan. However, Mukuro ended up being killed by her: shortly after the first murder, Mukuro was supposed to follow a plan she had agreed on with her sister, but on a whim, Junko decided to kill her for real and Mukuro was brutally impaled by Monokuma with numerous spears, dubbed "Heavenly Spear, Gungnir". This incident misled the other students into thinking that “Junko” was killed.!

characters.name: Tiffania Westwood
characters.description: Height: 160 cm (5'3")   A well endowed half-elf who Saito remembered as !"the big-breasted fairy who saved his life" when he was about to be killed by Albion's massive forces in the last episode of the second season.!   !She is also the master of Saito.!  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Guiche de Gramont
characters.description: Height: 175 cm Familiar: A Giant Mole, Verdante    Guiche is Louise's classmate, despite being in love with Montmorency, is a conceited playboy who cannot decide which girl he really wants. He always carries an artificial rose with him, the stem of which is his wand. He also likes to dote upon his familiar, a giant mole named Verdante. As his familiar indicates, his speciality is earth magic. He is named after Antoine V de Gramont, Duke of Guiche, a French military figure.

characters.name: Wales Tudor
characters.description: Prince of Albion and Henrietta's cousin. He and Henrietta had a romantic relationship, but is faced with their status as cousins. His vow to the water spirits is to one day be able to show his feeling to Henrietta without needing to hide it from the public. He is killed by Wardes and in the second season, revived to abduct Henrietta to Albion but killed again.  Wales is a triangle wind mage, and in the second season, he showed that nobles of royal heritage can combine their magical power with other royals and create power above pentagram grade (possibly up to decagram grade with two pentagram mages).

characters.name: Louise Françoise Le Blanc de La Vallière
characters.description: Height: 153 cm Familiar: A Knight (newly appointed), Hiraga Saito  Louise Françoise Le Blanc de La Vallière is the main female character. She is a second-year student at the Tristain Academy of Magic and a terrible mage who is often scorned by her fellow classmates. Because every spell she casts fails, she is nicknamed "Louise the Zero" after her zero success rate and zero attributes. The third daughter of the noble family La Vallière who owns the northeastern territory of Tristain.   !The Familiar of Zero F, the final episode, she gets married to Saito.!  *She is named after Françoise Louise de La Vallière, a French mistress to Louis XIV of France from 1661 to 1667.*

characters.name: Henrietta de Tristain
characters.description: Height: 158 cm (5'2")   The Princess of Tristain. She is loved by her nationals and is also an old friend of Louise. Later, she becomes the queen of Tristain and decides to defend Tristain from the Albion invasion after the assassination of the Albion prince.  She is named after Henrietta Anne, the youngest daughter of Charles I of England and sister of Charles II of England.    !She has a crush on Saito.!

characters.name: Saito Hiraga
characters.description: Height: 172 cm (5'8")   Saito is a student from Tokyo, Japan. One day, his laptop got broken and he decided to repair it; however, learning of the expensive fee for repair, he does not continue the repair, thinking of applying for a part-time job. As he walks down the streets, a mysterious portal appears before him, which can be only seen by him. He touches it out of curiosity, but it sucks him up despite his attempts to break free from it. Upon getting sucked, he arrives in Halkeginia as summoned by Louise de la Vallière as her familiar.

characters.name: Scarron
characters.description: Scarron runs the Maid Cafe/Inn "The Charming Fairy". He speaks and dresses like a woman even though he looks very masculine. His has his employees call him "ma madamoiselle" instead of "master".

characters.name: Eléonore Albertine Le Blanc de La Blois de La Vallière
