Jinpachi and Issei are the first reincarnated moon characters that Alice and Rin encounter. Jinpachi is the only character who closely resembles his former incarnation. Aside from the way they part their hair, Gyokuran and Jinpachi are virtually identical. He also retains the power to use "ki" (energy) blasts, and this is first shown when he uses this ki to defeat a group of thugs.  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Mokuren
characters.description: Flower: Lily Magnolia (Represents a love of nature) Reincarnated as: Alice Sakaguchi  Mokuren was the team's biologist. She was a gorgeous woman with long blonde hair. All of the male scientists except Shion fell in love with her after attending her final performance as a Kiches Sarjalian on Shia, before leaving for ZKK-101. She has been obsessed with Earth since her childhood and longed to live among the humans she observed. Mokuren was a special and extremely rare subset of Sarches, psychics, known as a "Kiches Sarjalian". Kiches are blessed with the gifts of growth by the goddess Sarjalim. The word "Kiche" is used to refer to the mark on her forehead, which consists of four red dots. A Kiches powers manifest themselves as plant empathy and plant growth through song at a young age, and eventually even human empathy and healing at a very old age and high level of experience.  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Sakura Kokushou
characters.description: Reincationation of: Shusuran.    Sakura Kokushou started having moon dreams around the same time as the others. Sakura attends the same school as Daisuke. They discover each other during a near-fatal traffic accident while on a field trip. Sakura screamed for Sarjalim to save her as the bus was in an uncontrolled skid. Sarjalim was the goddess that the moon scientists worshipped. Daisuke heard this and realized that they had been having the same dreams. Sakura physically resembles Enju. Shusuran had short red hair, and Sakura confessed that she always wished that she had Enju's thick, lustrous hair.    Source: Wikipedia

characters.name: Haruhiko Kazama
characters.description: !Reincarnation of Shukaido!  Haruhiko, unlike Sakura and Daisuke, does not see the advertisement in Boo! magazine. Rin runs into him in a uniform store and realizes who he is. Haruhiko is racked with guilt over the terrible thing he did to Shion in his previous life. As such he does everything that Rin tells him, !including claiming that he is the reincarnation of Shion.! This turns out to be an inspired move. Between Rin's machinations and their piecing together of their moon memories, the other reincarnates begin to fear Haruhiko and what he may be doing to them, even though Haruhiko has not actually done a single thing to any of them. Haruhiko has a very weak heart, due to his excessive use of his ESP when he was younger. Haruhiko resembles Shion physically, because Shukaido was obsessed with him when he died. This was explained when Haruhiko mentions that his mother is half Indian (making Haruhiko 3/4 Japanese and 1/4 Indian).  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Daisuke Dobashi
characters.description: Reincarnation of: Hiiragi.    Chronologically speaking, Daisuke started having the moon dreams first, as he started having them when he was seven (Rin recovered his memories at an even younger age, but at a later time, since Rin is much younger than Daisuke). Daisuke spends very little time on-panel in the manga, so not much is known about him. However, he does not trust Haruhiko, whom he believes to be Shion. He is also the only one who realizes the danger that collecting all of the passwords would pose, making it much more difficult for Rin to collect them all.    Source: Wikipedia.

characters.name: Issei Nishikiori
characters.description: Reincarnation of Enju.  Issei was reborn in a male body because he believed that he could be closer to Gyokuran's next incarnation if they were both males (without the drama of a heterosexual relationship). Issei retains Enju's powers of telepathy. This telepathy caused Jinpachi to start having the moon dreams as well—and it also means that Issei and Jinpachi have the same dreams every night. The close friendship between Enju and Shushuran lasts two lifetimes. When Sakura and Issei meet in the real world, they become best friends once again. Sakura is desperate for Issei to get over his unrequited love for Jinpachi and move on. At the end of the manga, the two of them become engaged. In Boku wo Tsutsumu Tsuki no Hikari, they are married but have been unable to conceive. Eventually, after more than five years of marriage, they discover that they are expecting their first child. Naturally, since he was a male, Issei doesn't physically resemble his former incarnation, Enju, although Sakura does, since Sakura admired Enju's hair.  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Shion
characters.description: Flower: Tartarian Aster (Grows well in poor soil) !Reincarnated as: Rin Kobayashi!  Shion was a war orphan born on the moon of Tess who was rescued and sent to Shia from the middle of the conflict on Tess for control of the Homeworld. Shion possessed strong psychic powers and controlled them with ease. He also had a first-rate mind and became a renowned engineer. Shion had serious emotional problems. As an orphan, he did not have a family until he was taken in by a foster father around age six. He was slowly but surely starting to trust and love his foster father, when a terrible accident occurred and his foster father died. He never truly trusted any of his friends, not even his childhood friend Gyokuran, whom Shion ended up hating because of Gyokuran's moral upstandingness and that he was everything that Shion could never be.  Shion was the only male member of the team who did not fawn over Mokuren. In fact, he completely despised her. !When it became clear to him that Gyokuran, his childhood rival, was completely obsessed with Mokuren, Shion decided to take advantage of this while sitting in the brig of the Moon Base by "getting to Mokuren first" in order to destroy Gyokuran's being on the most basic level. As a side benefit of this action, he intended to defile the sanctity of the Sarjalim faith, which had abandoned him so many times in the past, by ruining the last of Sarjalim's sacred avatars. And so, he struck a bargain with Mokuren when she came by to give him his lunch one day: "I love you, give up your Kiches powers (virginity) and I will reconcile with Gyokuran, no matter what it takes.". To this deal, surprisingly, Mokuren agreed. But during the act, Mokuren had a change of heart and resisted, but Shion did not listen and continued, effectively raping her. Afterwards, Mokuren took up ill and Gyokuran, enraged at Shion's perceived actions, demanded permanent exile for Shion. Mokuren, upon hearing of this, pulled herself together and declared that she and Shion had become engaged, and that Gyokuran would let him out of the brig NOW. At this pronouncement, Gyokuran was forced to release Shion from the brig, and Mokuren and Shion moved into Mokuren's quarters together. It is the confusion surrounding these events by all parties involved and not involved that leads to the underlying cause of the dark and terrible nature of the plot of the manga series.!  Shion was the last of the moon team to die. He had been inoculated against the virus that was killing them, so lived alone for nine years after Mokuren died. He was unable to commit suicide because Mokuren warned him that people who commit suicide will not be reincarnated. !This is why Rin is nine years younger than everyone else.! After Mokuren's death, Shion went insane. The cold, ruthless side that Rin sometimes displays is Shion's, and his plan is to make Shukaido suffer. In the sequel, "Boku wo Tsutsumu Tsuki no Hikari": !which takes place fifteen years later, Rin is married to Alice and they have two children: a son named Ren and later a daughter named Chimako. Rin was 16 when his son was born, and was 18 when he married Alice.!  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Taiga Aisaka
characters.description: Height: 145 cm  Taiga is a girl in [Ryuuji's](https://anilist.co/character/12295) class. She has a well-regulated and beautiful appearance though is unable to stomach company from others. Due to her often snapping at others in brutal ways and her short stature, she is given the nickname "Palmtop Tiger". Her under-developed body and the added nickname has given her a complex which in turn serves to give her a negative attitude and facial expression. Essentially, Taiga gets upset easily and is considerably clumsy. She is also brutally honest, typically when she is lashing out at someone. Due to her cute looks (described as a doll by Ryuuji), she often gets confessions of love by boys, but she turns down every one of them, including [Yuusaku Kitamura](https://anilist.co/character/12306) (which she later regrets).  Despite coming from a well-to-do family, her life with them is very difficult because of various problems. [Her father's](https://anilist.co/character/62271) business went bankrupt and he ran away, leaving Taiga in the care of [her mother](https://anilist.co/character/80715) who was already remarried and had a new family of her own. Taiga has difficulty getting along with her step-father and half-sibling and since then, she has taken to living on her own. Since she came from a privileged household, she does not know how to do any domestic chores. When she meets Ryuuji and learns of his domestic talents, she ends up relying on Ryuuji to clean up after her. Aside from sleeping in her own house, and going to school, she spends most of her time at Ryuuji's house; so much so that she is considered a member of his family. At the beginning of the story, she is infatuated with his best friend Yuusaku Kitamura and gets nervous every time he appears around her. Due to this, Taiga and Ryuuji team up to help each other get into a relationship with each other's best friend.    !Though she treats Ryuuji badly at first, her feelings begin to change as she spends more time with him. They later become a couple.!

characters.name: Ryuuji Takasu
characters.description: Height: 172 cm (5'7")  The series' main protagonist, Ryuuji is a seventeen-year-old high school student in his second year, class 2-C. Due to biological inheritance, his sanpaku eyes make him look like an intimidating delinquent and causes many misunderstandings. He lives in a fatherless family with just his mother, and due to this, Ryuuji has learned to be self-sufficient. He is good at cooking and keeps everything in his house clean (to the point of obsession), and also excels at sewing. He holds a crush on [Minori Kushieda](https://anilist.co/character/12305), a girl in his class. He has a pet, parakeet named "[Inko-chan](https://anilist.co/character/17059)" ("inko" literally means "parakeet" in Japanese). Ryuuji often helps [Taiga](https://anilist.co/character/12064) with domestic chores which she is unable to perform. At school, he is known as "the only person able to stop the palmtop tiger", referring to Taiga's nickname. Due to the misunderstandings of his look, he tends to look down on himself and lacks self-confidence. Despite this, he is rather calm in most situations. He is responsible, smart and has great grades, even when compared to [Yuusaku Kitamura](https://anilist.co/character/12306), his best friend. He is dense when it comes to girls' feelings, especially about things between him, Taiga, Minori and [Ami](https://anilist.co/character/13725). His feelings and relationship to Taiga begin to change as he spends more time with her throughout the series.

characters.name: Maya Kihara
characters.description: Maya is a female student in Ryūji's class who often hangs out with Nanako. She is a kogal. She has a crush on Yūsaku, and she circuitously opposes the idea of Taiga and Yūsaku being a couple, although she wants Taiga and Ryūji to be together.

characters.name: Minori Kushieda
characters.description: Height: 163 cm  Minori is a girl in [Ryuuji](https://anilist.co/character/12295/Takasu-Ryuuji)'s class, and is a close friend to [Taiga](https://anilist.co/character/12064/Aisaka-Taiga). She is also known by the pet name "Minorin". In contrast to the negative Taiga, Minori is always smiling and cheerful, but is also a natural airhead, though it is suggested that her airhead ways may be a facade. She is very athletic and is the captain of the girl's softball club at school, though at the same time she holds many part-time jobs. She is a glutton when it comes to food, but is also constantly combating dieting.   !Toward the end of the anime, she reveals that she also likes Ryuuji but has given up on him in order to let Ryuuji and Taiga be together.!

characters.name: Yuusaku Kitamura
characters.description: Yuusaku is a male student in Ryuuji's class, and is his best friend. He is the vice-president of the student council, the class representative, and captain of the boy's softball club at school. Yuusaku wears glasses, and has a diligent personality. He thinks he is poor at talking to girls, though Ryuuji observes otherwise. During his time as the vice-president of the student council, he eventually falls in love with the student council president, Sumire Kanou. A running gag is that he will appear out of nowhere behind Taiga and Ryuuji when they are discussing a "plan of attack" to get their crushes. Like Minori, he has an unusual personality, but oftentimes it is an expression of his friendship and appreciation.    !Yuusaku also had feelings for Taiga, but was rejected straight away.!

characters.name: Hisamitsu Noto
characters.description: Hisamitsu is a male student in Ryuuji's class who wears glasses. He was also in Ryuuji's class the previous year and is on good terms with him. Noto begins to develop feelings for Maya Kihara which become more apparent following an argument they had during the class winter ski trip.

characters.name: Yuri Koigakubo
characters.description: Yuri is the twenty-nine-year-old homeroom teacher of Ryūji's class (though she turns thirty in the fifth volume of the light novels). She likes to do things at her own pace and is timid towards Taiga's way of speaking out. Since her twenties are almost over, Yuri is in a hurry to get married soon and she even tries to dress well so as to be able to get into a relationship quicker. After she becomes thirty without getting married, she develops a twisted and depressed personality, which does not help that when Taiga talks about her, she emphases her single status.  She is fairly concerned over the well-being and grades of her students and tries her best to help them. During the Winter, she banned Haruta from Christmas Activities to get him to study for exams.

characters.name: Yasuko Takasu
characters.description: Yasuko is [Ryuuji](https://anilist.co/character/12295)'s thirty-three-year-old mother, though she refers to herself as eternally twenty-three. Soon after Ryūji was born, her husband died which left her to raise her son by herself. She works at a hostess bar named Bishamonten Kuni where she goes by the name "Mirano" and single-handedly supports her two-member family financially. However, she has a childish personality and since she works, she entrusts the household chores to Ryuuji. She instantly takes a liking to [Taiga](https://anilist.co/character/12064) and already regards her as a member of her family. (Source: Wikipedia)     !Later in the show, Yasuko reveals that Ryuuji's father didn't die. He basically abandoned the two of them, leaving Yasuko to raise their son by herself.!

characters.name: Nanako Kashii
characters.description: Nanako is a female student in Ryūji's class who often hangs out with Maya and Ami.

characters.name: Ami Kawashima
characters.description: Height: 165 cm  Ami is [Yuusaku](https://anilist.co/character/12306)'s childhood friend who transfers into his class midway through their second year of high school. She is very beautiful and even works as a model, though after she transfers school, she temporarily stops modeling. However, she still continues to go to the gym readily and maintains a slim figure. She is always kind and generous towards others, though this is merely a deception. In truth, she is arrogant and will not hesitate to use others for her own benefit. During her first meeting with [Taiga](https://anilist.co/character/12064), Ami showed her true colors, but the tables were turned when Taiga threw a counterattack back at her. Since then, Ami and Taiga have been enemies, though Ami still sometimes envies Taiga since she can always be honest. It's hinted at, mostly through her childhood friend Yuusaku, that she's like this because she hasn't really known any other life than her modeling, which is part of the reason she moved to their hometown to attend school there.  Which is why, through her affiliations with Taiga and [Ryuuji](https://anilist.co/character/12295), Ami eventually develops more of a "middle ground" personality, signified with her losing her temper and taking out her frustrations on a stalker fan. While this doesn't mean that she automatically becomes friends with Taiga, the two of them also meet halfway to some extent, thus running into arguments far less frequently. She can still be somewhat manipulative and mischievous, but her "gravure airhead" personality is almost entirely abandoned for a more outspoken one, and she's even helped out her newfound friends, including Taiga, on occasion. At some point, she even showed some interest in Ryuuji.   !Ami is also the first one to realize that Taiga and Ryuuji have feelings for each other, and is constantly hinting Ryuuji to pursue Taiga.!

characters.name: Kouji Haruta
characters.description: Kōji is a male student in Ryūji's class who has long hair and is on good terms with him. He is regarded as a class 'idiot' and that opinion is deepened by his poor school marks and overly energetic behavior. His childish pranks often target Taiga and he has been the victim of her violent outbursts.

characters.name: Mirai Sasaki
characters.description: Height: 200 cm (6'6¾") Birthplace: Tokyo, Japan Quirk: Foresight  A Pro Hero and [Mirio Togata](https://anilist.co/character/123527)'s mentor. He was formerly [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224)'s sidekick and was considered to be the brains behind All Might's hero operation before opening his own hero agency.   Sir Nighteye is a lean but muscular man with a clean, well-kept appearance. Unlike most Pro Heroes, he seems to prefer plain office clothes (a plain white suit with gold buttons, a white dress shirt, and a red tie with white dots) instead of an elaborate hero costume.   Sir Nighteye maintains a stoic and intimidating presence, with a cold and sharp glare, but that is only the side of his personality that he shows in public. He greatly values humor and actually requires people to make him laugh before he acknowledes them. Nighteye believes that humor and energy are vital elements for the future of society and punishes subordinates that fail to display those qualities.

characters.name: Mirio Togata
characters.description: Height: 181 cm (5'11") Occupation: Student Affiliation: U.A. High School Quirk: Permeation  He is third-year student at U.A. High School and is part of The Big 3 _(the strongest three hero students in all of Japan)_.   Before [Izuku Midoriya](https://anilist.co/character/89028/Midoriya-Izuku), Mirio was the top candidate for [All Might](https://anilist.co/character/89224/Yagi-Toshinori)'s successor and inheritor of One For All. His Quirk, Permeation, gives him the ability to become intangible, letting him pass through any tangible matter; he can phase through walls and/or the ground, as well as let enemy attacks pass through him harmlessly.

characters.name: Eri
characters.description: Height: 110 cm  Quirk: Rewind  Eri is a child with bandages all over her body. She wears a white short sleeve dress and has a small horn on the right side of her forehead and has white, long, choppy, unkempt hair. She also has red eyes. Under her bandages, her arms are shown to have numerous scars.  !Eri is the key source to [Kai Chisaki's](https://anilist.co/character/126357/Kai-Chisaki) operation to manufacture a Quirk-Destroying Drug. She is the granddaughter of the Eight Precepts of Death's boss!

characters.name: Kai Chisaki
characters.description: Height: 179 cm (5'10") Quirk: Overhaul  Kai Chisaki, also known by the villain name Overhaul, is the Yakuza Captain of the Shie Hassaikai.  Overhaul is a mysophobic, antisocial sociopath obsessed with returning the world to the way it was before the Quirk phenomenon. Due to a combination of an old theory claiming Quirks derived from rats and his own mysophobia, Overhaul believes that Quirks are actually a plague on humanity, having infected people with "syndromes" of heroism and villainy. He looks down upon those that use their abilities for either purpose, referring to acts of heroic sacrifice or petty crime as "sicknesses". Overhaul is extremely determined to his ambition of eradicating Quirks, not only due to his own personal phobias, but also because such a thing would allow the yakuza to reclaim the power they once held over society.   Kai's Quirk "Overhaul" grants him the ability to disassemble anything he touches, as well as reassemble it in any configuration he desires, effectively giving him full control over matter. Kai can disassemble people to kill them or reassemble them to heal their wounds. He can also do this to himself and even merge his body with others, even allowing him to use their Quirks

characters.name: Akaza
characters.description: Height: 173 cm (5'8")  A member of the Twelve Demon Moons, holding the position of Upper Moon Three.  !While he was human, his name was Hakuji.!

characters.name: Chifuyu Matsuno
characters.description: Height: 168 cm  Chifuyu is the vice-captain of the First Division of Tokyo Manji gang and [Baji](https://anilist.co/character/145343)'s best friend.  !He is the first one to get to know about [Takemichi](https://anilist.co/character/145342)'s time leap ability. After that, he regularly helps Takemichi to think about saving the future.!  !Takemichi sought his help in order to team up and face Kanto Manji, the newest [Mikey](https://anilist.co/character/145341)'s gang. He also demands that their team should be called Thousand Winters. Chifuyu also made the uniforms.!

characters.name: Ken Ryuuguji
characters.description: Height: 185 cm (6'1")  Draken is [Mikey](https://anilist.co/character/145341/Manjirou-Sano)'s best friend and one of the founders of Toman.   Draken is a muscular teenager who is exceptionally tall for his age. His head is shaven on the sides and back to expose his signature dragon tattoo on his left temple. His blonde hair is long on the top of his head and kept in a neat braid. Draken is a serious teen who lives in a brothel, he does not know his biological parents and was 'taken in' by the owners of the brothel.  !His mother was a prostitute who abandoned him at birth and died when he was two years old.!  !In the future, Draken owns a bike shop, and is a member of Brahman.!

characters.name: Takashi Mitsuya
characters.description: Height: 170 cm  Mitsuya is the Captain of the Second Division of the Tokyo Manji Gang. He is a calm, levelheaded person who is also the source of positivity in the gang. Despite his rough upbringing, he tackles every day with a smile. Mitsuya is a pacifist, preferring to not get into an altercation if possible, but at the same time, will not hesitate to fight in order to protect what is dear to him.  Older brother of [Luna Mitsuya](https://anilist.co/character/272864/Mitsuya-Luna) & Mana Mitsuya. He is a childhood friend of [Draken](https://anilist.co/character/145345/Ken-Ryuuguji).

characters.name: Naoto Tachibana
characters.description: Height: 148 cm (past), 175 cm (present)  Hinata's younger brother. He very much resembles his father.  Naoto is a righteous individual who is also determined to also save his sister. He has a no-nonsense personality and is usually unamused by others' humorous advances. He is also willing to embrace far-fetched possibilities, such as the fact that Takemichi can time-travel, and even make his own hypotheses about it.  !Before the first time travel, he died together with Hinata. However, after he was warned of his death by Hanagaki and was subsequently saved, he grew up to become a detective and ended up playing a key role in Hanagaki's ability to travel through time.! !Naoto is the key to activating Takemichi's supernatural time-travel ability. Whether in the past or present, as long as the two shake hands, Takemichi will be transferred to the present (if he is in the past), or the past (if he is in the present). He is also the only person who is aware of the consequences caused by Takemichi's time-traveling aside from Takemichi thus far.!

characters.name: Nahoya Kawata
characters.description: Height: 170 cm  Captain of the Fourth Division of the Tokyo Manji Gang. Brother to [Souya Kawata](https://anilist.co/character/168678/Souya-Kawata).

characters.name: Atsushi Sendou
characters.description: One of Takemichi's best friends in middle school. ! It's revealed that he is the person who pushed Takemichi in front of the train at the start of the story.!

characters.name: Takuya Yamamoto
characters.description: Takuya Yamamoto is one of Takemichi's middle school friends and also his childhood friend.

characters.name: Tetta Kisaki
characters.description: Kisaki is the principal antagonist of Tokyo Revengers. He's especially known for rising to the top of the Toman at full speed.   Kisaki is a ruthless, cunning, and ambitious individual who will stop at nothing to achieve his goals. Although average in stature, his power to rule with fear makes even those stronger than he obey him. The entirety of his actions in the entire story revolves around becoming the most powerful and influential criminal in Tokyo.  ! He is also known for organizing the murder of Hinata Tachibana many times. ! !He is later ran over and killed by a truck after a long chase!

characters.name: Hinata Tachibana
characters.description: Height: 153 cm  Hinata Tachibana is the girlfriend of [Takemichi Hanagaki](https://anilist.co/character/145342/Hanagaki-Takemichi) who is the primary reason for Takemichi's desire to change the past. In 2005, Hinata is a 14 year old girl.   Hinata has light brown eyes and wears her rosy brown hair a little longer than before: it goes beyond her shoulders. She is seen wearing a long black dress with embroidered flowers. She also wears a necklace around her neck, materializing her relationship with Takemichi Hanagaki during their middle school years.  Hinata has a very outgoing and upbeat personality who is highly optimistic and always finds ways to make undesirable situations better. Even when others become demoralized or despair, Hinata remains strong in order to push them forward.  !On July 4, 2017, Hinata will be killed during a brawl between two Tokyo gangs, along with her brother [Naoto Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/167843/Tachibana-Naoto).!

characters.name: Manjirou Sano
characters.description: Height: 162 cm  He is a founding member and the leader of Tokyo Manji Gang.   Mikey is usually a carefree teenager who loves to joke and play pranks around those he considers his close friends. He cares for them greatly and is determined to protect their honor. He rarely shows any sign of weakness, as he believes himself to be the foundation and support for Toman, and if the pillar himself were to display weakness, Toman would also be weakened.  !Younger brother of [Shinichiro](https://anilist.co/character/221297/Shinichirou-Sano), older half brother of [Emma](https://anilist.co/character/171924/Emma-Sano) and younger "adoptive" brother of [Izana](https://anilist.co/character/170484/Izana-Kurokawa)!  !In the future, it is revealed that Mikey is the leader of the gang "Bonten" ,which is considered Japan's current worst criminal organization.!  !During the high school timeline it is revealed that Mikey is the leader of the "Kanto Manji Gang".!

characters.name: Takemichi Hanagaki
characters.description: Height: 165 cm  Takemichi learns that the girl he dated in middle school—the only girl he ever dated—has died. Then, after an accident he finds himself in a time leap back to his middle school years. He vows to change the future and save the girl, and to do that he aims to rise to the top of the Kantou region's most brutal delinquent gang.  !After the fight with Valhalla he becomes the First division Capitan of Toman.!  !He later became the eleventh President of the Black Dragons as well as the captain of the First Division of the Tokyo Manji Gang, and a member of Brahman.!  !Takemichi is also the president and founder (with [Chifuyu Matsuno](https://anilist.co/character/145344/Matsuno-Chifuyu)) of the Thousand Winters (later renamed as Tokyo Manji), created to defeat Kanto Manji.!

characters.name: Keisuke Baji
characters.description: Height: 175 cm  Captain of the 1st division and one of the founders of the Tokyo Manji Gang.  Baji has a wild personality. He loves the thrill of adrenaline and [Mikey](https://anilist.co/character/145341) himself says that he would punch someone out on the street for no apparent reason, only because he feels like it. In combat, he is never without his trademark grin.

characters.name: Hae-In Cha
characters.description: Guild: Hunters Guild Class: Sword Fighter Affiliations: Jeju Island Raid Party, [Song Chi-Yul](https://anilist.co/character/136073/ChiYul--Song)’s Dojo (Disciple)  Cha Hae-In is the Vice-Guild Master of the Hunters Guild. She is an S rank hunter and the 9th ranked hunter in South Korea. She possesses the unique ability of mana smell and hates the smell of hunters except for [Sung Jin-Woo](https://anilist.co/character/129928/JinWoo-Sung).

characters.name: Jin-A Seong
characters.description: Younger sister of [Jin-U](https://anilist.co/character/129928).

characters.name: Jin-U Seong
characters.description: Class: Mage Relative(s): [Park Kyung-Hye](https://anilist.co/character/209396/KyungHye-Park) (Mother), [Sung Jin-Ah](https://anilist.co/character/138791/JinAh-Sung) (Sister), ![Sung Il-Hwan](https://anilist.co/character/138790/IlHwan-Sung) (Father), [Cha Hae-In](https://anilist.co/character/138789/HaeIn-Cha) (Wife), [Sung Su-Ho](https://anilist.co/character/306654/Suho-Sung) (Son), [Yoo Jin-Ho](https://anilist.co/character/136076/JinHo-Yoo) (Brother in Law)!  !Guild: Ahjin Guild (Guild Master) Affiliation: Korean Hunters Association (helper), White Tiger Guild (helper), Hunters Guild (helper), Knights Guild (helper), Ahjin Guild (Guild Master)!  Seong Jin-U is the protagonist of [Solo Leveling](https://anilist.co/manga/105398/Solo-Leveling/) and is known as an infamously weak E-Rank Hunter. He is a humble and benevolent individual who cares deeply for his family and has an ardent desire to become stronger. As a result, he shares a close relationship with his sister and his mother, and rarely wastes an opportunity to refine his skills and gain more power.  !He becomes an S-Rank hunter after being given a chance to become stronger by the System.!

characters.name: Chi-Yul Song
characters.description: Magic Type: Fire  Korean C-Rank Hunter and kumdo teacher. He is also one of Jinwoo's old friends, having known him since he was a E-Rank Hunter.

characters.name: Jong-In Choi
characters.description: Choi Jong-In is one of the 10 S-Rank Hunters of South Korea. He is also the Guild Master of the Hunters Guild.

characters.name: Geon-Hui Go
characters.description: Go Gun-Hee (고건희) is a South Korean S-Rank Hunter and the Chairman of the Korean Hunters Association.

characters.name: Jin-Ho Yu
characters.description: Class: Tanker Guild: !Ahjin Guild (Vice-Guild Master)!  Yoo Jin-Ho is a D rank hunter and is [Jin-U Seong](https://anilist.co/character/129928/JinWoo-Sung)'s faithful assistant and combat partner.

characters.name: Yun-Ho Baek
characters.description: He is a S rank hunter and master of the White Tiger guild.

characters.name: Beom-Shik Park
characters.description: Park Gi-Sool is a Korean D-Rank Hunter and a good friend of Sangshik Kim. !He was tragically killed during the first Double Dungeon Incident when a statue sliced him clean in half from behind.!

characters.name: Jin-Cheol U
characters.description: An A rank hunter that works for Hunter's association of Korea.

characters.name: Sang-Sik Kim
characters.description: Sang-Sik Kim is a Korean D-Rank Hunter. !He was a survivor of the Double Dungeon. He was tragically killed by [Tae-Shik Kang](https://anilist.co/character/181155/TaeShik-Kang) after accidentally witnessing him kill a man during a raid.!

characters.name: Echidna
characters.description: Echidna is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Greed. She has a strong thirst for knowledge along with a curiosity for the unknown, which defines her behavior. Echidna is described as black hearted, being unable to empathize with others and their feelings due to a lack of understanding. She will do anything to gain knowledge, be it deceit or employed sophistry.

characters.name: Frederica Baumann
characters.description: Frederica Baumann is a maid working for [Roswaal L. Mathers](https://anilist.co/character/90182/Mathers-Roswaal) and a member of the Emilia Camp. She quit her job as a maid a few months before [Subaru's](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) appearance, but returned after [Ram](https://anilist.co/character/88576/Ram) couldn't manage the mansion !after [Rem](https://anilist.co/character/88575/Rem) had her name and memories eaten. !  !She is the half-sister of [Garfiel Tinsel](https://anilist.co/character/133847/Tinsel-Garfiel).!

characters.name: Ryuuzu Meyer
characters.description: Ryuuzu was a half-elf who lived in the Sanctuary during the era of the witches, 400 years ago. She was used by [Echidna](https://anilist.co/character/129330/Echidna) in order to activate the Sanctuary's barrier. During Echidna's immortality experiments, she created copies of Ryuzu and tasked them with protecting the Sanctuary.

characters.name: Kazuhito Narita
characters.description: Team: Karasuno High Height: 180.2 cm  Year: 2nd Year, class 4   Narita, Ennoshita and Kinoshita are 2nd years who couldn't keep up with the training when old Ukai returned and that's why they left volleyball club. However after some time they came back because they realized that they still want to play volleyball, though coach Ukai was no longer there. Ennoshita called them ''disgraceful'' 2nd years.

characters.name: Akira Saitou
characters.description: Assistant boys' volleyball coach for Shiratorizawa Academy

characters.name: Gabimaru
characters.description: Race: Human Tao Attribute: Fire Occupation: Shinobi Affiliation: Iwagakure (Formerly)  Gabimaru is an elite shinobi assassin formerly from Iwagakure. He is the husband of [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/151771/Yui) and the son-in-law to the [chief of Iwagakure](https://anilist.co/character/301607/Osa).  Gabimaru is calm, level-headed and rarely shows any emotions. He is calm to the point where he is unfazed by any sort of crisis, such as being executed or when he is confronted and attacked by a strong enemy. As noted by [Sagiri](https://anilist.co/character/137263/Sagiri), once Gabimaru calms down he tends to complain. He prefers to stick with his main objective at hand and not get tangled with anything else that doesn't involve his goals. Although he is viewed as being obnoxious (mainly by Sagiri), he can also be respectful and polite at times.  !During his time in Iwagakure, Gabimaru was known and admired by his peers for his cruelty and ruthless killings of his victims, but after being married to Yui, Gabimaru underwent a major change. Even though he was influenced by his leader's words of ridding himself of his emotions to become strong, Gabimaru was also influenced by Yui's kind and caring nature into believing that having emotions made him truly strong and would turn him into a true warrior. This overwrote his cruel nature as a ninja and made him want to avoid unnecessary killing.!  He served as Iwagakure's most infamous shinobi until he was betrayed by his village for wanting to abandon his role as a murderer and live a peaceful life with his wife, resulting in him being handed over to the authorities to be executed. However, after the shogun calls for convict criminals to acquire the Elixir of Life from the dangerous island known as Kotaku, in exchange for a pardon for their past crimes, Gabimaru accepts the invitation to be a part of the competition mission in order to reunite with Yui and live the life he so desired. Upon taking the mission, Yamada Asaemon Sagiri was chosen as his assigned monitor.  !Shortly after, Gabimaru becomes a part of a united front formed from the remaining surviving criminals and executioners to defeat Lord Tensen, work together in capturing the elixir, and have everyone escape the island.!

characters.name: Touma
characters.description: Race: Human Tao Attribute: Earth Occupation: Asaemon (Unofficial) Affiliation: Yamada Clan  Toma is a relatively new member of the Yamada clan trying to rise in their ranks and is the assigned monitor of [Chobe Aza](https://anilist.co/character/137269/Chobe-Aza).  ! He turns out to be the younger brother of Chobe Aza and had a mission of infiltrating the Yamada clan to rescue him from prison. !  Toma believes that the key to surviving in life is adapting to ones environment. Toma tends to act rather unfriendly when someone tries to communicate with him on friendly terms. He also displays a cocky attitude.  ! He is very caring and loyal to Chobe since he has been his protector since they were children and stresses out whenever harm comes to him. Because of how his father died fighting for his allies, Toma is reluctant to cooperate with anyone except for his brother. In his own eye, Toma views himself as an extension of his brother instead of an ally and stated that the bandits that followed the two were merely pawns for them to use. However, Toma soon realizes that his reliance on his brother to protect him interferes with his growth rate to look after himself. !  ! Toma and Chobe were born as sons to a retainer under the service of the daimyō of Akō Domain, Asano Takunori. However, after Asano Takunori attacked the court official Kira Yoshinaka at Edo Castle, he was sentenced to commit seppuku. As a result, their father and the rest of the retainers had their status removed and were left as ronin, leaving their family in poverty. Their mother eventually died of an illness and their father was executed for being a part of the Akō Incident, leaving the two siblings left alone to defend for themselves. They were eventually taken by bandits who planned on selling them but later came to live amongst them after Chobe managed to become their leader. !

characters.name: Nurugai
characters.description: Height: 138 cm Race: Human Tao Attribute: Water  Nurugai is the last remaining member of the Sanka and a wrongly convicted death-row criminal. Her assigned monitor is [Tenza](https://anilist.co/character/137265/Tenza).  Nurugai looks down on samurai, viewing them as stupid. Her disdain for them stems from the fact that they were partially responsible for killing her people. Because of this incident, Nurugai feels a strong guilt for leading her village's extermination, even believed that the reason why she is on a dangerous mission is because she was receiving divine punishment for her actions and accepted death.   Nurugai was raised with the Sanka Mountain People in a village where she had lived with her grandfather. Nurugai and her grandfather were in a friendly, familial relationship where she would learn off her grandfather's wisdom. Her village however were considered rebels against the current shogunate, refusing to submit to [Tokugawa](https://anilist.co/character/301606/Nariyoshi-Tokugawa). Because of this, samurai were sent to locate the hillside tribes they defined as Emishis. One day, Nurugai crossed paths with a party of lost men, encouraging Nurugai to offer her help by seeking rest in the security of her village. Nurugai recognized her mistake when she realised that these men were samurai under the order of Tokugawa, who began a mass killing of her village that would leave her as the sole survivor.

characters.name: Sagiri
characters.description: Race: Human Tao Attribute: Wood Occupation: Asaemon Affiliation: Yamada Clan Rank: 12th Relative: [Kichiji](https://anilist.co/character/302527/Kichiji) (Father)  Yamada Asaemon Sagiri is the 12th rank Asaemon in the Yamada Clan. After the shogun sent criminals to Kotaku to find the Elixir of Life, she was tasked with being [Gabimaru](https://anilist.co/character/137260/Gabimaru)'s executioner.  Sagiri generally displays a calm demeanor when taking on her role as an executioner. However, after landing on Kotaku, she allowed herself to act casual around others as long as she continued to do her job. She is very polite and caring towards her fellow Asaemon members, despite the fact that she is aware that some view her as being unworthy of becoming a samurai. However, she is not afraid to speak her mind and to stand up for herself. Though she takes matters seriously, Sagiri does possess a sense of humor, often laughing at [Shion](https://anilist.co/character/137267/Shion)'s jokes.   !After her experience with working successfully with criminals and witnessing the deaths of her fellow clansmen, Sagiri resolved to abandon her role as an executioner on the mission and viewed everyone that came not as a criminal or an executioner but as allies so they can work together to return home safely.!  When she was young, Sagiri watched as her father skillfully decapitated a condemned performer with a single swing of his sword. From that day she became inspired to walk the path of an executioner and achieve the same level of skill as her father. As she began her training on how to wield a sword, Sagiri was looked down on by her fellow Yamada members, as well as her father, for being a female following the path of a samurai. Sagiri was also shunned by other children because of the clan's bad reputation. Despite the harsh treatment she faced, Sagiri managed to earn her name as a Yamada Asaemon.

characters.name: Gantetsusai Tamiya
characters.description: Race: Human Age: Unknown Tao Attribute: Fire  Tamiya Gantetsusai formerly known as Tetsunosuke is a renown master swordsman known throughout as the Blade Dragon and Eight Provinces Unparalleled.  He considers fighting to be fun and lives to seek out and battle strong opponents that can make him feel a thrill whenever he has to draw his blade. Even when critically injured, Gantetsusai's carries a satisfied smile from the adrenaline he gets from fighting and feels as though as he is becoming stronger with each injury. However, he is not very disciplined, preferring to recklessly fight his opponents head on without thinking of a clear strategy, or listen to his allies, and hates it when others try to interfere in his enjoyment. Gantetsusai also has a perverted side as he took note and commented on [Yuzuriha](https://anilist.co/character/137270/Yuzuriha)'s physique during the selection process. Despite his perverted behavior, Gantetsusai has morals as he felt disgusted of the thought of the Dōshi using [Mei](https://anilist.co/character/148755/Mei) for sexual intercourse to complete their Tao training.  !Gantetsusai has a massive ego and wishes to go down in history as a legendary figure. He believes that by performing extraordinary feats and people remembering his name throughout generations is the true form of immortality rather than gaining the Elixir of Life.!  At a young age, Tetsunosuke was trained in the art of swordsmanship. After being defeated by his master, Tetsunosuke asked how he was able to despite his old age. He explains to Tetsunosuke that he has become greedy with wanting to become stronger and says that he must throw away his strength in order to see everything in what he has left. Despite this lesson, Tetsunosuke was unable to understand what his master was telling him. As he grew up, Tetsunosuke renamed himself to Tamiya Gantetsusai and went around searching for strong opponents, eventually making a name for himself as a fame swordsman.

characters.name: Tenza
characters.description: Height: 176 cm (5'9")  Tenza is the 10th rank Asaemon in the Yamada Clan. After [the shogun](https://anilist.co/character/301606/Tokugawa-Nariyoshi) sent criminals to Kotaku to find the Elixir of Life, he was chosen as [Nurugai's](https://anilist.co/character/137262/Nurugai) assigned monitor. From youth, Tenza started off on the streets but was eventually picked up by [Shion](https://anilist.co/character/137267/Shion) and made into his apprentice in the Yamada Clan.   Tenza is energetic and confident. He is a practitioner of bushido, taking in the lesson of continuing on forward no matter what is blocking his way. Tenza is also extremely righteous and does not let his duties as an Asaemon get in the way of doing what is right. He believes that Nurugai is innocent and does not deserve to die on the island. Although righteous he is, Tenza does not think things through, believing that without the elixir he would be able to convince his superiors to turn a blind eye. Tenza has a strong will to protect the people he cares about.

characters.name: Senta
characters.description: Race: Human  Yamada Asaemon Senta is the 5th rank Asaemon in the Yamada Clan. After the shogun sent criminals to Kotaku to find the Elixir of Life, he was tasked with being [Yuzuriha's](https://anilist.co/character/137270/Yuzuriha) executioner.  Senta is very nervous around others and tends to frequently sweat. He usually remains in the background and goes along with whatever is happening around him but will speak up when he feels that whatever he has to say would be helpful. Senta is capable of assessing the situation and makes good judgements as to how to approach them. He dislikes his role of killing people but feels that he has no choice in the matter and chooses to abandon his dream of becoming an artist. After observing Yuzuriha, he becomes envious and enchanted by her innate freedom. Despite his nervous demeanor, Senta is fearless and stands his ground no matter who he is up against.

characters.name: Shion
characters.description: Height: 178 cm Race: Human  Tao Attribute: Wood  Shion is the 4th rank Asaemon of the Yamada clan and is the one chosen to be [Akaginu](https://anilist.co/character/302523/Akaginu)'s monitor.   Shion is a strict but kind man. He is well aware of the brutal nature of his work as an executioner, opting to spend the rest of his time helping others. Like the other Asaemon, he possesses a strong loyalty to the Yamada clan. Shion also has a witty sense of humor, often making puns and jokes regarding his eyesight, which has become a major part of his character to the people around him. Shion is shown to be fearless, showing no fear or hesitation when facing extremely strong enemies.

characters.name: Fuchi
characters.description: Height: 148 cm Race: Human Tao Attribute: Metal Occupation: Asaemon Affiliation: Yamada Clan Rank: 9th  Yamada Asaemon Fuchi is the 9th rank Asaemon in the Yamada Clan and was chosen to be [Tamiya Gantetsusai](https://anilist.co/character/137264/Gantetsusai-Tamiya)'s assigned monitor.   Fuchi is a rational thinker that has a good sense of judgement in situations and carries a no-nonsense view when it comes to matters that he deems are unscientific, pointless, and illogical. He has great pride as a Yamada Asaemon and does not tolerate anybody speaking disgracefully about the Yamada clan. He is very close with his Asaemon comrades and gives them nicknames instead of using honourifics. Even though the Yamada clan mainly deal with testing new swords and executions, Fuchi preferrs, and has a deep passion, for studying the human anatomy to improve medical science that came with the trade. He whole-heartedly believes that anatomical research would save lives and despises those who thought so little of this study.  !Although he was an executioner, after his experience working together with the surviving convicts, Fuchi found that both "crime" and "evil" were entirely different from one another, with Tamiya Gantetsusai as an example. From a scientific view point, Fuchi found that samurai and criminals were not so different since they are structured the same and had a will to live, which was reason enough for the survivors to band together in trying to return home.!  !With both him and Gantetsusai badly injured Fuchi musters up the rest of his strength to administer first aid to Gantetsusai instead of himself resulting in him dying. In his last thoughts, Fuchi warns [Shugen](https://anilist.co/character/148752/Shugen) not to underestimate the survivors since they are not willing to die easily and wishes the best of luck to both his allies and enemies.!

characters.name: Choubei Aza
characters.description: Race: Human (Formerly), !Semi-Immortal Human! Tao Attribute: Metal Occupation: Bandit  Aza Chobe also known as the Bandit King, is a well-known bandit leader in Iyo that is responsible for multiple crimes committed.  Chobe is an extremely barbaric individual who attacks anyone or anything that poses as a threat to him. He prefers to do things of his own accord and would rather resort to violence than talk things through. Chobe is also very sadistic whenever he engages in fights with his enemies, Chobe always stuck to taking on the role of the villain, and holds grudges to those that have bested him. Although he tends to act like a brute, Chobe is a rationale thinker that knows what is the best course of action in a serious situation.  !Chobe and [Toma](https://anilist.co/character/137261/Touma) were born as sons to a retainer under the service of the daimyō of Akō Domain, Asano Takunori. However, after Asano Takunori attacked the court official Kira Yoshinaka at Edo Castle, he was sentenced to commit seppuku. As a result, their father and the rest of the retainers had their status removed and were left as ronin, leaving their family in poverty. They were eventually taken by bandits who planned on selling them but later came to live amongst them after Chobe managed to become their leader.!

characters.name: Yuzuriha
characters.description: Height: 160 cm Race: Human Age: Unknown Tao Attribute: Earth Occupation: Kunoichi  Yuzuriha also known as Yuzuriha of the Keishu, is a kunoichi and one of the few criminals recruited to acquire the Elixir of Life.  Yuzuriha is friendly and cheerful around others with a typical teenage girl personality. She is shown to be carefree and prefers to do things at her own pace. Because of her reputation as a criminal, Yuzuriha has no problems when it comes to killing or who she has to sacrifice to achieve a goal. Underneath her friendly attitude, Yuzuriha's true nature is that of a complete narcissist, only focusing on her own well-being and shows little concern for others. This attitude stemmed from her past vow to her little sister to live only for the both of them. As a kunoichi, Yuzuriha uses her charms to get what she wants, but despite that she is shown to be a terrible liar after trying to make up her backstory.  !Though selfish, Yuzuriha can show compassion to others. As Senta was dying, she consoled him and had him die in peace by making him forget about his duties as an Asaemon and gave him the last bit of freedom he had to think about what he wanted to imagine as his last memory.!  !Despite her beautiful appearence, with her mucus abilities she actually hides a body full of scars.!  Yuzuriha grew up in a shinobi village living with her little sister, [Saya](https://anilist.co/character/306735/Saya), who was suffering from an incurable disease and eventually died. From then on, Yuzuriha swore to live her life for the both of them and started her career as a kunoichi. Sometime ago, Yuzuriha raided the Sagiwa Castle and defeated the retainers defending it.

characters.name: Eizen
characters.description: Height: 180 cm Race: Human Tao Attribute: Unknown Occupation: Asaemon Affiliation: Yamada Clan Rank: 1st  Eizen is the 1st rank Asaemon in the Yamada clan. He joined the Kotaku island expedition and was assigned to keep watch over the criminal, [Rokurōta](https://anilist.co/character/302052/Rokurouta).  Eizen has great pride for the Yamada clan and believes that no task is impossible for them when it came to executing people, such as his assigned criminal Rokurōta. As an executioner, Eizen acts professional in his line of work as he knows that defiling the execution grounds by trying to bring pain to the condemned with his blade would defile the magistrate and he follows the Yamada clan's ideal way of ending lives by cutting his victims with no pain or emotion, a concept which he tried to impart to a young [Shugen](https://anilist.co/character/148752/Shugen).   Eizen is also kind and caring as he promised to look after Shugen when he was young, which brought a great influence to him in the present. Like his fellow clan members, Eizen believes that women in the Yamada clan should not follow the path of a samurai and is antagonistic when [Sagiri](https://anilist.co/character/137263/Sagiri) took the shogun's mission.  ! Upon arriving to Kotaku, Eizen is almost instantly crushed by Rokurōta and dies. Shugen becomes devastated after finding Eizen's corpse and took the time to lay his soul to rest despite the fact that his team was being under attack. His death went on to impact Shugen on his mission a lot as he vowed to kill everyone on the island to avenge his master. !  Eizen has a profound influence on Shugen as he is the one person the young man looks up to the most.

characters.name: Shinya Hiiragi
characters.description: Height: 183 cm (6'0") Race: Human Affiliation: Japanese Imperial Demon Army Section: Moon Demon Squad Demon Weapon Series: Black Demon Series Demon: Byakomaru  A Major General of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army. Although he has a high capacity for spellcraft since childhood, Shinya is not comfortable with being with the Hiiragi Family. Shinya is shown to be a gentle and cool man. He does not get angry easily, even when being insulted by Seishirō.   He is seen smiling pleasantly all the time, even in tough spots. He has a lighthearted and breezy personality. Shinya is shown to be very loyal to his friends, such as Guren. He is also very observant and perceptive, and easily grasps Guren's emotions.

characters.name: Guren Ichinose
characters.description: Height: 183 cm (6'0") Race: Human Section: Moon Demon Squad  Demon Weapon Series: Black Demon  Demon: Mahiru-no Yo  He is a Lieutenant Colonel of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and the commanding officer of the Vampire Extermination Unit, Moon Demon Company.  Guren would become a wise leader who values teamwork, co-operation and friends, and determined those were necessary to ensure the survival of the human race from demons and vampires. Sometimes pretending to be lazy, in truth, he really works hard. He keeps many secrets to himself, and has no difficulty lying about them. When enduring hardships in battle, he will focus on winning and take the most direct path to that.

characters.name: Yuuichirou Hyakuya
characters.description: Height: 170 cm (5'7")  Yuuichirou is a member of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and Shinoa Hiragi's squad in the Moon Demon Company. He, along with Mikaela Hyakuya, possesses the "Seraph" gene, which is relevant to the forbidden taboo and the focal point of the story, "Seraph of the End".  Yuuichirou seems to be an excellent swordsman, as he was trained by Guren himself. He is also a "seraph of the end" with 1/10th of him being not human; he may have been experimented on by the Hyakuya, but this is unclear since the adults in charge of him were killed minutes after he arrived at the orphanage.

characters.name: Shinoa Hiiragi
characters.description: Height: 150 cm (4'11")  Shinoa Hiiragi is Guren's sergeant and one of the squad leaders of the Moon Demon Company. She is appointed to supervise Yuuichirou during his suspension from the Japanese Imperial Demon Army for his reckless behavior. She is sarcastic and enjoys teasing others, especially Yuuichirou.   Her Demon Weapon is Shikama Douji (四鎌童子, lit. Four-Scythe Child), a manifestation-type demon weapon which takes the form of a large scythe, but can be condensed into a pen-like object. She can call out the demon, which she fondly addresses as "Shi," inhabiting it out of the weapon to attack an enemy. Her primary ability is to detect anything that comes within the attack radius of her scythe.  Despite being a member of the distinguished Hiiragi family, Shinoa is uninterested in their internal power struggle. Moreover, due to her sister's legacy, she is generally shunned by the upper echelon of the army. However, she is loyal to Guren and to the members of her squad.   A childhood lacking in familial warmth left Shinoa with little understanding of the importance of friendship and camaraderie. She is moved by Yuuichirou's unwavering loyalty to the members of his squad, who he considers his family, and wants to foster the same feelings for them herself.

characters.name: Shihou Kimizuki
characters.description: Height: 177 cm (5'9") Race: Human  Kimizuki is a serious and diligent person. He is competitive against Yuuichirou Hyakuya. He earned the highest test scores in their class, and he is angry when Yuuichirou appears out of nowhere and may earn Cursed Gear before him. He is hot-headed and tends to get in fights with both Mitsuba and Yuuichirou.  He is tidy and skilled at cooking. When his friends are unconscious or injured, he is the first to take care of them, whether it be nursing them or giving them his jacket to keep them warm.  Although the other members of his squad quickly refer to each other on a first-name basis, he is the only member the others address with his surname. Kimizuki has very high intelligence and was at the top of his class in all subjects, and regularly earned perfect scores. He earned 100s on each of his Latin, English, and Japanese spellcraft exams. He is on par with Yuichiro on skills of swordsmanship.

characters.name: Mitsuba Sanguu
characters.description: Birthday: July 7, 2004 Height: 155cm (5'1") Weight: 44kg (97 lbs) Race: Human Affiliation: Japanese Imperial Demon Army Section: Moon Demon Squad Demon Weapon Series: Dakini Demon: Tenjiryū  A member of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and a member of Yuu's team of the Moon Demon Squad. She also the younger sister of Aoi Sanguu.  Mitsuba is shown to be a serious and by-the-book soldier, who dislikes those who break the formation and commit to individual action. In reality, she is a talkative, selfish girl. Despite this, she gets jealous easily. Mitsuba appears to be the most talkative girl in her group.

characters.name: Mikaela Hyakuya
characters.description: Height: 173 cm (5'8")  The deuteragonist of the Owari no Seraph series. He is an incomplete vampire and a servant of Third Progenitor [Krul Tepes](https://anilist.co/character/88899/Tepes-Krul). He was human until Krul Tepes forced him to drink her blood. He, along with [Yuuichirou Hyakuya](https://anilist.co/character/83015/Hyakuya-Yuuichirou), possesses the "Seraph" gene, which is relevant to the forbidden taboo and the focal point of the story, "Seraph of the End."  He wields a red colored sword. When he orders it to drink his blood, it sprouts thorny vines that pierce his hand. His strength grows in proportion to the amount of his blood the sword drinks.

characters.name: Yoichi Saotome
characters.description: Height: 165 cm (5'5") Race: Human Affiliation: Japanese Imperial Demon Army Section: Moon Demon Squad Demon Weapon Series: Black Demon Series Demon: Gekkouin  He is a member of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and Shinoa Hīragi's squad in the Moon Demon Company.  Yoichi has an equilibrium of kindness and altruism, giving him an optimistic and sweet personality. This gives him a strong mental balance against his demon, who takes the form of his sister. He lacked passion to kill vampires and fight and avenge his sister originally, but as he got to know his new "family", he began to see the reason that he was there. Yoichi does dislike conflict amongst friends, but conflict on the battle field doesn't bother him anymore. As time passed, Yoichi is shown to be much more confident with his skills, sniping down three Horsemen at ease by himself.  Yoichi is usually the peace maker around Shinoa's Squad. Yuichiro and Kimizuki are usually fighting, and Yoichi often ends up in the middle of it. He has developed a love for his "family" that impacted his personality greatly. He used to get very nervous and stutter a lot, but the closer he got to the Squad, the more confident he got. He doesn't question his self-worth as much as before, and instead focuses more on protecting his new "family".

characters.name: Crowley Eusford
characters.description: Crowley is a Thirteenth Progenitor among vampires and a member of Seventh Progenitor Ferid Bathory's faction. However, he hides his strength under Ferid's orders and is actually equal in strength to a Seventh Progenitor. Crowley is calm and brave which makes him a patient vampire who enjoys fighting any opponent. Even when he is in a tight spot, he remains calm with a pleasant smile.  Despite sticking to Ferid, he appears to be emotionally detached from him, such as throwing the latter out of the bus as "revenge". Crowley also appears to be quite unimpressed with Ferid half of the time, calling his antics "stupid" and even sympathizing for the children getting dragged into the mess that Ferid created. He also doesn't appear to trust Ferid and is not afraid to be blunt to him for it.

characters.name: Mito Juujou
characters.description: She is a Colonel of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and a member of Guren's squad in the Moon Demon Company. She is also the daughter of the prestigious Jujo family.

characters.name: Hinata Sakaguchi
characters.description: Hinata Sakaguchi is an otherworlder and the leader of the Imperial Guards under the Pope's direct command. Along with Yuuki and Class S, she's a former student of Shizue Izawa.  !At first she thought monsters should all be exterminated. But after her fight with Rimuru, she was convinced that Rimuru is not evil.!

characters.name: Frey
characters.description: "Sky Queen" Frey is an ex-Demon Lord and currently a subordinate of [Demon Lord Milim Nava](https://anilist.co/character/128036/Nava-Milim). She often scolds Milim for playing around when she is supposed to be working.

characters.name: Ryouta Sekiguchi
characters.description: One of the children who were incompletely summoned. Ryota has a shy personality, but he generally gets along well with Kenya.

characters.name: Akira Otoishi
characters.description: Akira was one of the many people Keicho Nijimura shot with the Bow and Arrow while trying to find a stand user capable of killing his mutated father. Akira was one the many lucky ones to develop a stand after which point he became interested in them and how to create them. To further his goal on studying them he needed the Bow and Arrow which he forcefully took from Keicho leading to Keicho's death. From there on he tormented several people, among them Josuke while trying to improve in the use of his guitar skills.  (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Wiki)

characters.name: Yukako Yamagishi
characters.description: Height: 167 cm  Yukako is a student in love with Koichi Hirose. At first she was very aggressive in her affections towards him, jealously attacking what she believed were potential rivals in love and even going so far as to kidnap him and threaten his life should he not return her feelings and not appreciate her efforts to "change him into a better person" – she had picked up false rumors that he was insufferable, false rumors that were spread by Josuke and Okuyasu in order to help Koichi in turning her away from him; unfortunately for them, their measures had the opposite effect.   Later in the story, Yukako, still lovestruck, seemed to have learned from her mistake in trying to force Koichi. Unhappy about her unrequited love she made use of the services offered by Aya Tsuji's beauty enhancing Cinderella stand, which rendered her into a bewitchingly attractive woman in the eyes of Koichi - for a price and a certain time limit, during which she was to use a special lipstick in order to uphold the "magic" i.e. the stand's power.    !The stand allowed her to grow closer to Koichi, who, after some trials and tribulations, warmed up to her and willingly became her boyfriend. !

characters.name: Rohan Kishibe
characters.description: Rohan is a mangaka that first appears as an antagonist to [Koichi](https://anilist.co/character/24496/Hirose-Kouichi) and Toshizaku when they go to his house for an autograph. After they try to sneak a peek of the new issue of his manga he uses his stand Heaven's Door to make neither of them able to attack him. Then he reads their memories and in doing so finds out about [Josuke](https://anilist.co/character/13085/Higashikata-Jousuke), [Okuyasu](https://anilist.co/character/28991/Nijimura-Okuyasu) and everyone else in the story so far, but only according to how Koichi sees them. Then he decides to use them as materials for his manga. After using Koichi as his personal "Inspiration" Okuyasu and Josuke find out about where Koichi has been going by following him. They defeat him and leave him in the hospital for a while.  In the Jojolands Universe he appears as rich japanese who owns a Villa on Hawai'i Island and as a second antagonist who fight with [Jodio](https://anilist.co/character/298895/Joestar-Jodio), [Dragona](https://anilist.co/character/298896/Joestar-Dragona), [Paco](https://anilist.co/character/298904/Laburantes-Paco) and [Usagi](https://anilist.co/character/306164/Alohaoe-Usagi). Furthermore, he saves in his safe the diamond which Jodio and his group want to steal and two Lava Rocks.

characters.name: Mikitaka Hasekura
characters.description: Mikitaka first appears in chapter 378 (I Am An Alien! 1). He claims he's a 216 year old alien from the Mclon system looking for a planet for his people to live in. His job is piloting a space shuttle and his hobby is raising small pets. He possesses the ability to assume any physical form he desires. Although he can take a form vastly smaller than his normal mass, and can separate himself into several components in the process, it is not known if he can take on a much larger form. On the negative side, if exposed to a siren or similar sound, he suffers a painful rash until the sound stops. It was never revealed in the manga whether Mikitaka is a delusional stand user activated by the Arrow or truly an extraterrestrial life-form (he gives his full name as Nu Mikitakazo Nshi). According to JOJO!A-GO-GO artbook, his stand's name is Earth, Wind And Fire.

characters.name: Yoshikage Kira
characters.description: **Height:** 175 cm (5'9")  Kira is a man who longs for a simple life, and doesn't wish to be bothered. Although he reveals many talents, this yearning shows in his dislike of coming in first, as the cast eventually realizes. He becomes quite bothered when someone disrupts his "simplicity", and goes to extreme lengths to get it back. He keeps a collection of his own fingernail clippings, and believes when they grow quickly he has trouble. Kira also has a bizarre fetish for the female hand, stemming from an erotic fascination with the hands of the Mona Lisa. Unfortunately, his desire has never extended to the rest of the female person. This results in his murdering women in order to acquire their (severed) hands as "girlfriends"—when one "girlfriend" begins to decay, he goes off in search of a replacement.  Originally, Kira murdered his victims by stabbing them so viciously they were left with horrific back wounds (their hideous nature is implied by the fact that the reader is never actually shown [Reimi](https://anilist.co/character/90167/Sugimoto-Reimi)'s wound). However, his Stand, Killer Queen, eventually awoke from his desire to leave no evidence behind of his killings—hence its ability to make its victims completely disintegrate. He now lets Killer Queen annihilate his victims (except for his "girlfriend"-hands), letting everyone else think that the victims have simply gone missing. Even if the number of missing attracts attention (as it eventually does), no one would have any reason to suspect that Kira was involved.

characters.name: Okuyasu Nijimura
characters.description: Okuyasu isn't exactly the brightest character in the Jojo story, and tended to rely on his elder brother Keicho to make hard decisions. After his brother died, he sought revenge against the User of Red Hot Chili Pepper, Akira Otoishi. During this time and the following events surrounding Yoshikage Kira, he became fast friends with Josuke and Koichi.   Okuyasu tends to be jealous of Koichi's relationship with Yukako, and enjoys Tonio's cooking. He also befriends Shigechi, after doing battle with his Harvest with Josuke.   !This friendship is why he became further enraged when Shigechi was killed by Yoshikage Kira. !  !Okuyasu's father is a bizarre creature, mutated by Dio's spores when Okuyasu was only 7. He rather dislikes Rohan because of what Rohan tried to do to him when they first met.!

characters.name: Jousuke Higashikata
characters.description: Height: 185 cm Nationality: Japanese  Josuke is the illegitimate son of [Jotaro](https://anilist.co/character/4003/Kuujou-Joutarou)'s grandfather, [Joseph Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/6356/Joestar-Joseph).  He is a caring, popular, and slightly naive teenager. Inspired by his police officer grandfather's (on his mother's side) sense of justice, he isn't afraid to fight for those in need. He is confronted by Jotaro with the need to eradicate evil Stand users from his hometown, Morioh. He refuses at first, believing that it is not any of his business. However, he quickly changes his mind when his policeman grandfather is killed by a criminal Stand user. With a vow paralleling that of [Peter Parker](https://anilist.co/character/154717/Parker-Peter), Josuke decides to deliver justice to evil Stand users in his grandfather's place.  Josuke's Stand power, Crazy Diamond, is a melee Stand with short range (3m). Crazy Diamond has the ability of "restoration".

characters.name: Aiha
characters.description: Aiha (藍巴) is one of Bishamonten's Shinki. As a Shinki, she takes the form of a medieval suit of armour with a long skirt.

characters.name: Nayu
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Rose Oriana
characters.description: Race: Human  Rosa Oriana is a noble Princess from the Oriana kingdom. She is known for being a genius in art in her kingdom. However, she came to Midgar Royal Spellsword Academy in order to learn swordsmanship.  !Later [Alpha](https://anilist.co/character/162246/Alpha) discovered Rose, who became a fugitive for assassinating her father and was then offered membership into Shadow Garden.!

characters.name: Cid Kagenou
characters.description: Race: Human  Cid Kagenou, under the moniker of "Shadow," is the founder and leader of the secret organization "Shadow Garden." He founded the organization to help realize his fantasy of becoming an “Eminence in Shadow". However, unbeknownst to him, his fabrications are often revealed to be quite genuine in reality. Cid is the reincarnation of Minoru Kagenou.   (Source: The Eminence in Shadow Wiki)

characters.name: Alpha
characters.description: Race: Elf  Alpha is the second-in-command of Shadow Garden. After being cured of Demon Possession by [Cid Kagenou](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Cid-Kagenou), she would devote her life to his cause, becoming the first member to be recruited into his organization, Shadow Garden.   !She is the descendant of the elf [Hero Olivier](https://anilist.co/character/204203/Olivier).!

characters.name: Beta
characters.description: Race: Elf  Beta is the second member of Shadow Garden, supporting her master [Shadow](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Cid-Kagenou) against the Order of Diabolos.   !Outside of her Shadow Garden activities, she adopts the identity of Natsume Kafka, an up-and-coming author of numerous original pieces of literature.!

characters.name: Gamma
characters.description: Race: Elf  Gamma is a member of Shadow Garden, being third of the original Seven Shadows as well as the director of the Mitsugoshi Company. Despite her lack of coordination, Gamma's knowledge has allowed her to recreate many of the items described by her master [Shadow](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Cid-Kagenou) to sell as Mitsugoshi's exclusive products.  (Source: To Be a Power in the Shadows! Wiki)

characters.name: Delta
characters.description: Race: Beastkin  Delta is a member of Shadow Garden, being fourth of the original Shadow Seven to join the organization after her Demonic Possession was healed by her master [Shadow](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Cid-Kagenou). As the most physically gifted of the Seven, Delta is also often the most destructive and brutal of the group due to her lack of sense and self-control.  (Source: To Be a Power in the Shadows! Wiki)

characters.name: Epsilon
characters.description: Race: Elf  Epsilon is the fifth member of Shadow Garden. Due to her insecurities with having a flat-chest, she manipulated her slime bodysuit every year to slowly increase the mass on her chest, eventually developing a fake large breast. As a consequence of this, she developed extreme magic control earning her the title, "The Precision."

characters.name: Nu
characters.description: Race: Human  Nu is the thirteenth member of Shadow Garden and an employee of Mitsugoshi Company.   (Source: To Be a Power in the Shadows! Wiki)

characters.name: Iris  Midgar
characters.description: Race: Human  Iris Midgar is the first princess of the Kingdom of Midgar and older sister of [Alexia Midgar](https://anilist.co/character/168799/Alexia-Midgar). She is also leader of the Crimson Order.   (Source: *The Eminence in Shadow* Wiki)

characters.name: Aurora
characters.description: Race: Human  A woman known as the Calamity Witch who once brought chaos and destruction to the world. In the Goddess' Trial in the Sacred Land, she is summoned in reaction to Cid's presence and does battle with him in the form of Shadow. Her body is sealed in the sanctuary, and after helping Cid to escape she disappears together with its destruction.   !Aurora's true identity is the great demon Diabolos but it is unknown if she founded the Order of Diabolos or cursed the three heroes with possession. !

characters.name: Claire Kagenou
characters.description: Race: Human  Claire is the older sister of [Cid Kagenou](https://anilist.co/character/136837/Cid-Kagenou) and heir to the Kagenou Family.  (Source: To Be a Power in the Shadows! Wiki)

characters.name: Alexia Midgar
characters.description: Race: Human  Alexia Midgar is the second princess of the Kingdom of Midgar and younger sister of [Iris Midgar](https://anilist.co/character/204204/Iris--Midgar). She is also a student of Midgar Royal Spellsword Academy.  (Source: To Be a Power in the Shadows! Wiki)

characters.name: Yui to Ui no Haha
characters.description: [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa) and [Ui](https://anilist.co/character/19571/Ui-Hirasawa)'s mother. She is usually away with their father so [Ui](https://anilist.co/character/19571/Ui-Hirasawa) is left to do all of the chores and take care of [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa).

characters.name: Satoshi Tainaka
characters.description: Satoshi is [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka)'s younger brother. He appears when [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka) is walking home with him from the movies. He then ventures of with a friend from school he saw on the way home. He seems to respect his sister [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka) but still acts like a normal boy.  Satoshi seems to be a bit more mature than [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka), usually saying things like "Geez, be more careful next time" when he has to take care of the problems she caused. Satoshi knows Mio because she and [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka) have been friends for so long, but becomes shy when [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka) brings the rest of the Light Music Club home without telling him ([Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka) supposed it as a "rebellious phase"). He is also curious about his sister's doing and eavesdrops sometimes at her door (for example, when Mio and [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka) were practicing for their class play, [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka) finds out that Satoshi is laughing outside her room as she practices her dialogue). He also dislikes cold weather. Although he sometimes laughs about his sister or tells her to be quiet when she practices in her room, he still respects her and asks her for permission to hang out with his friends.

characters.name: Jun Suzuki
characters.description: **Role:** Bassist **Instrument:** Bass Guitar  Jun is [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/21173/Azusa-Nakano)'s and [Ui](https://anilist.co/character/19571/Ui-Hirasawa)'s classmate who often hangs out with the latter. Jun is generally a playful and easygoing girl, but she is sometimes rude without realizing it, compelling [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/21173/Azusa-Nakano) to reprimand her. [Ui](https://anilist.co/character/19571/Ui-Hirasawa) tries to get her to join the light music club but ultimately fails due to a strange visit to the club room. However, she starts to regret it when she hears about all the activities the club does. She has a pet cat and plays the bass.   Jun has an older brother, Atsushi Suzuki, nicknamed Acchan by her. He plays the bass at a university and helps Jun on "secret training sessions" because she apparently "still sucks at bass".

characters.name: Yui Hirasawa
characters.description: Height: 156 cm  Yui Hirasawa is one of the 5 main characters in K-ON!. She's also the main protagonist. She is the air-headed lead guitarist and vocalist of the band Ho-kago Tea Time.  Having misunderstood that "light music" equals "easy music" (like whistling), she joined the Light Music Club and picked up guitar with absolutely no prior experience. She plays a Gibson Pre-'08 Les Paul Standard '50s in Heritage Cherry Sunburst. She names it Giita, which quite literally means "guitar".

characters.name: Mio Akiyama
characters.description: Height: 160 cm  Mio Akiyama is one of the five main characters in K-ON! She is a passionate and technical left-handed musician and writer who serves as the bassist, second vocalist and main lyricist of the band Ho-kago Tea Time. She is a kind and warm girl, albeit very shy and sensitive. Despite her timid streak, she often finds herself as the voice of reason amongst her bandmates, who often rely on her sensibility when in trouble.   She plays a left-handed Fender Japan '62 Reissue Jazz Bass in 3-Tone Sunburst.

characters.name: Ritsu Tainaka
