characters.description: Height: 154 cm    Ritsu Tainaka, called Ricchan by [Tsumugi Kotobuki](https://anilist.co/character/19568/Tsumugi-Kotobuki) and [Yui Hirasawa](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa), is one of the 5 main characters in K-ON!.  She is the self-appointed president of the Light Music Club and the drummer of the band Ho-kago Tea Time. She was the one who rebooted the Light Music Club when it was on the verge of being disbanded, and has become the natural leader of the club since then.  Ritsu plays a yellow Rick Marotta Signature Yamaha Hipgig drum kit with an add-on floor tom (in the opening credits only) combined with a cymbal set from Avedis Zildjian, though is shown playing a white Yamaha Absolute Series drumkit in the anime's closing credits.

characters.name: Tsumugi Kotobuki
characters.description: Height: 157 cm  Tsumugi Kotobuki, otherwise known as Mugi is one of the 5 main characters in K-ON! She is a wealthy, cheery, cute girl with a gentle personality who plays the keyboard and is the main musical composer in the band Ho-kago Tea Time.  Mugi plays a Korg Triton Extreme 76-key keyboard, though she is also seen playing a Korg RK-100 keytar in the closing credits of the first season.

characters.name: Sawako Yamanaka
characters.description: Height: 165 cm   Sawako is the adviser for the wind instrument club at Yui's school. An alumna of the school and a former member of the light music club, she does not want people to know she was formerly a member of a heavy metal band, thus she covers up by being mild and gentle to her co-workers and especially to students. She is forced to be the adviser of the light music club, as Ritsu blackmails her after the girls learn of her past, though it is unknown whether she stopped being the adviser for the wind instrument club as the story progresses. Though she has a mature and gentle demeanor in the school, Sawako, affectionately addressed as "Sawa-chan" by both Ritsu and Yui, displays a totally different, completely authentic character when she is alone with the light music club. In reality, she is a rather wild, lazy and quite an irresponsible teacher who enjoys dressing up the light music club in, sometimes embarrassing, cosplay costumes, much to the dislike of Mio. She names the club band ''After School Tea Time'' after the members take too long deciding on a name themselves, and to maintain the secrecy on her heavy-metal image. She once momentarily pitches in for Yui with her Gibson Flying V electric guitar. Sawako once owned a Gibson SG Standard guitar given by her dad's friend, but she kept it in the music room because she thought it was not in a playing condition anymore.  Her surname is taken from [the pillows](https://anilist.co/staff/100327/the-pillows) vocalist/guitarist [Sawao Yamanaka](https://anilist.co/staff/172230/Sawao-Yamanaka).

characters.name: Nodoka Manabe
characters.description: **Height:** 158 cm  Nodoka is [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa)'s childhood friend and confidant who is a member of the school's student council. As a normal, well-mannered and intelligent girl, she is generally taken aback by the light music club's odd behavior, and easily gets annoyed with [Ritsu](https://anilist.co/character/19567/Ritsu-Tainaka) whenever she forgets to fill in the club's application forms. She shares the same class as [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/19566/Mio-Akiyama) in their second year, who appreciates her companionship tremendously, as being the only person [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/19566/Mio-Akiyama) knows in her class. In her third year, she becomes the student council president.

characters.name: Azusa Nakano
characters.description: Height: 150 cm  Azusa Nakano, nicknamed "Azu-nyan" by [Yui Hirasawa](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa), is a main character in the K-ON! series. She is a second year student at Sakuragaoka High School. She decided to join the Light Music Club after seeing the band's performance in the school festival, and thus became Ho-kago Tea Time's second guitarist.  Azusa plays a Fender Japan '69 Reissue Mustang in Candy Apple Red.

characters.name: Ui Hirasawa
characters.description: **Height:** 154 cm   Ui is [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa)'s younger sister, who begins the story as a third-year junior high school student, but later enters [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa)'s high school the following year in the same class as [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/21173/Azusa-Nakano). Unlike her older sister, Ui is mature, responsible and handles household chores well, though she still shares a strong relationship with [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa) and has a great deal of love and respect for her older sister. Despite being a year younger than [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa), she is nearly identical to her with her hair down and is even once able to fool the club. She possesses some of her sister's musical gift, and has a great talent for playing the guitar—she became capable of playing with the rest of the light music club band after only a few days of practice ([Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa) was sick, so Ui dressed up as [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa) to help the band out). She takes particularly good care of [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/19565/Yui-Hirasawa) and strives to look after her even at the risk of her own health. Ui is actually considered as the ultimate groupie for her sister's band and supports them with all her heart. She occasionally provides a narrative to the story. She is in the same class as [Azusa](https://anilist.co/character/21173/Azusa-Nakano) and hangs out with her sometimes.

characters.name: Gin Doujima
characters.description: Graduated from Tootsuki Culinary Academy, he is one of the respected legends of both his former school and Tootsuki Academy Alumni that is among the few who successfully graduated his academy with flying colors, thus became one of the proficient members of Tootsuki Resort as his graduation. As a living legend, Doujima is skillful in both culinary and board administration due to his talents in both culinary and managements that he handle the kitchen solo without the assistance of any chef around him. It is due to his professional discipline and tenacity, he is both respected and feared by many students and lecturers alike in his former academy.   As the legend by the students of the Tootsuki Culinary Academy, Doujima is believed to possesses all styles of cooking to create much unique cuisine in different way. Usually handle the kitchen solo, Doujima has no problem to make 100 different meals thanks to his vast knowledge of ingredients as well of the varieties of cuisine.     (Source: Shokugeki no Souma Wikia)

characters.name: Komekko
characters.description: Komekko is [Megumin](https://anilist.co/character/89361)'s adorable younger sister. She is a young Crimson Demon and the only Crimson Magic kid around her age.

characters.name: Arue
characters.description: Arue is one of Megumin's old classmates and the third highest scoring student in her class, only trailing behind Megumin and Yunyun respectively. She's an aspiring author and, according to herself, the most voluptuous among the Crimson Demons.

characters.name: Dodonko
characters.description: She is a member of the Crimson Demons and Megumin's former classmate alongside Funifura.

characters.name: Funifura
characters.description: She is a member of the Crimson Demons and Megumin's former classmate alongside Dodonko.

characters.name: Hyoizaburoo
characters.description: Hyoizaburoo is [Megumin](https://anilist.co/character/89361)'s father and a magic item craftsman.

characters.name: Santouka  Taneda
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Touji Souya
characters.description: The current meijin. He has longed for a rival like [Rei](https://anilist.co/character/21044). Similar to Rei, he became a professional shogi player in middle school.

characters.name: Yuusuke Takahashi
characters.description: A middle school student. A childhood friend and classmate of Hinata's, they are quite close to each other. He is the son of a milkman. He is the ace of his school's baseball team and aims to be a pro. Since Rei became a shōgi pro in middle school, Yūsuke greatly looks up to him. In order to realize his dream to become a professional, he wishes to proceed to a high school in Shikoku to participate in the kōshien baseball tournament.

characters.name: Issa Matsumoto
characters.description: 26 years old. Five dan. He is 181 centimeters tall. A quite expressive and enthusiastic person, he can be aggressive at times as well. He comes from the countryside. He is a fan of Akari.

characters.name: Masachika Kouda
characters.description: Rei's shōgi teacher. He was both Rei's father's friend and rival in shogi. He cared for Rei like he did for his children and taught him shogi.

characters.name: Rei Kiriyama
characters.description: Occupation: Shogi Player Height: 170cm (5'6'')  He is the main protagonist, whose progression is explored through the series. He is a teenage professional shogi player, currently ranked at 5th-dan. He is widely lauded in the shogi community as the fifth shogi player to become a professional in middle school. Using his salary combined with his life savings, he lives in his own apartment while juggling between his official matches and high school. By the time the story begins, Rei is also a frequent visitor of the Kawamoto residence, where the family treats him as one of their own despite his initial reluctance to become close with them.

characters.name: Kyouko Kouda
characters.description: Kouda's daughter. She is four years older than Rei. Beautiful and hot tempered, Kyouko seems to hold a grudge on Rei as she has the habit of exercising a negative influence on him by discouraging him on purpose before his official matches.

characters.name: Akari Kawamoto
characters.description: Akari is the eldest of three Kawamoto sisters.  After her mother and grandmother’s death, she stepped in as the parent figure for her younger sisters. In the mornings she helps her elderly grandfather run a traditional wagashi shop, and in the evenings she works as a hostess at a bar, which her aunt manages.

characters.name: Hinata Kawamoto
characters.description: Occupation: Student  Hinata Kawamoto, often called Hina, is the middle child of the Kawamoto siblings and a middle school student whose positive attitude inspires [Rei](https://anilist.co/character/21044/) to try to overcome his depression.

characters.name: Harunobu Nikaidou
characters.description: Rei's self-proclaimed "best friend" and "lifelong rival". A four-dan, he has played with Rei since they were children. Even though he might appear to be healthy, he is in fact in poor health. He is from a good family. He is modeled after real-life shōgi player Satoshi Murayama.

characters.name: Momo Kawamoto
characters.description: The youngest of the three sisters. A preschool student, she attends a daycare center. Pure and innocent, she has a bit of a selfish streak at times. Her favorite anime character is Bodoro (modelled on My Neighbour Totoro's Totoro). She calls Rei, "Rei-chan".

characters.name: Ayumu Kouda
characters.description: Kōda's son and Kyōko's younger brother. He is of the same age as Rei. After losing to Rei in shogi, he stopped playing at all, and afterwards started confining himself to his room and only playing video games.

characters.name: Tatsuyuki Misumi
characters.description: 26 years old. Six dan. He is often called "Sumisu" (for "Smith"). He is 180 centimeters tall. A bit aloof, he gets along well with Matsumoto.

characters.name: Ottarl
characters.description: Race: Boaz Height: 210 cm (6'11") Affiliation: Freya Familia Level: 7 Skills: Vana Arganture • Stortus Ottar Magic: Hildis Vini Weapon: Supreme Black Sword • Greataxe • Great Hammer  Ottar is the captain of the Freya Familia and is currently the only Level 7 in Orario. When Ottar was a child, he was abandoned without even having known his own name. Freya found him dying in an alley somewhere and told him he was beautiful and took him into her Familia. She also gave him his name at this time. Due to her material support and emotional warmth, Freya would become everything to Ottar. Two years after joining her Familia, Ottar would become Level 2. Around this time, Mia joined the Freya Familia at the request of Freya in order to train Ottar. Ottar clashed a few times with the Zeus and Hera Familias before they were defeated by the One Eyed Black Dragon and were forced out of Orario. Each time ended in him being defeated. At some point in the past, Ottar half-killed a Balor, the Monster Rex of the 49th floor. Later, after learning about Ais defeating Udaeus by herself, he also defeated Udaeus by himself while managing to obtain the Udaeus' sword. He reached Level 6 fifteen years before his battle with Udaeus and Level 7 after defeating Zald seven years before the same battle.  Ottar is extremely loyal to Freya and will follow her orders. He is shown to not feel any jealousy toward Freya's interest in Bell and does not allow anyone to insult Freya, becoming enraged if anyone does so. Despite being a member of the Freya Familia, he has been shown to help others, such as when he used an elixir on Mikoto after she used an Ignis Fatuus. Ottar believes the opposite of Eina, believing that adventurers would never break out their shell if they didn't adventure. He is also one of the few adventurers who are still active that has clashed with the Zeus and Hera Familias. His personality is greatly influenced by his experiences facing them.

characters.name: Wiene
characters.description: Race: Xenos  Height: 150 cm (4'11") Affiliation: Xenos • Hestia Familia • Ouranos Level: 2+ (estimate)  Wiene is a mysterious female Vouivre born in the middle floors of the Dungeon. It is later revealed that she is one of the Xenos.   Wiene has the ability to speak even though she is a monster due to her being a Xenos. She is kind, helping a young boy even though people regarded monsters as evil. Wiene grew attached to the Hestia Familia, particularly Bell and Haruhime. Wiene doesn't like to wear clothes, as she refused to wear them and she even tried to get rid of the cape she was wearing due to the hot temperatures she was not used to before being convinced to keep it on. Originally, Wiene had more of a cowardly nature, influenced by all of the evil intent people had toward monsters, including the citizen's rejection of her even though she saved a boy. However, after she was reborn, she becomes much more courageous, reminding herself that Bell saved her even though people would scorn him for it.

characters.name: Seishirou Hiiragi
characters.description: Seishiro Hiiragi is a Major General of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army.

characters.name: Erika
characters.description: A girl that is sensitive to new trends. She seems to speak foreign accents very well, and she is found usually hanging around with Fujita Megumi's group.

characters.name: Mii
characters.description: Mii-chan is a female student who belongs to Megumi's circle of friends.

characters.name: Kenken
characters.description: Kenken is a member of the three-member delinquent group together with Atsushi and Mario.

characters.name: Yagi
characters.description: Yagi is a female student who belongs to Aina's circle of friends.

characters.name: Yoshinobu Kubota
characters.description: Kubota is a rather stocky young man with a heavy build and frizzy, wavy hair that parts in the middle. He seems on the shorter side compared to his peers and had a round nose with small, brown eyes and freckles on his cheeks. He befriends Sakamoto early on and endures many hardships through his High School career.

characters.name: Atsushi Maeda
characters.description: A classmate in class 1-2, and one of the delinquent trio. His trademark is a red hat. Along with Kenken and Mario, he targets Sakamoto for bullying, but gets rebutted each and every time. He has since become a friend of his after Sakamoto helped rescue him and his friends when they were trapped in a room and accidentally lit the room with cigarettes. It is shown in a later episode that he has since switched to blowing bubbles. It has been hinted that he is harbouring a crush on Sakamoto, often blushing in his presence, stating how cool Sakamoto is, and even ordering a "smile to-go".

characters.name: Shigeru Kobayashi
characters.description: The homeroom teacher for class 1-2. Guides his students using his life experiences where he has overcome many dangerous situations.

characters.name: Morita
characters.description: Morita is one of Sakamoto's classmates.

characters.name: Sakamoto
characters.description: Height: 180 cm (5'10.9")  Sakamoto is the protagonist of the series who is a model student for all in his school. He is the perfect man who can solve any problem with a kind yet calm persona. Because of this, many girls fall for him, and his male classmates resent him. Although he acts strangely sometimes (such as doing weird poses or acting sneakily), it only adds to his coolness. Sakamoto has a range of "secret skills" which allow him to do various things, such as catch bugs or blow bubbles.

characters.name: Aina Kuronuma
characters.description: Kuronuma Aina is a female student in Sakamoto's class who falls for him. She is very popular among boys but has no interest for anyone else except Sakamoto, which makes her disliked by other girls. She charms the boys to do her bidding by making them fall in love with her through 'love lessons', which turned out to be totally invalid to Sakamoto.

characters.name: Yasuda
characters.description: Yasuda is one of Sakamoto's classmates.

characters.name: Tanaka
characters.description: Tanaka is a female student who belongs to Aina's circle of friends.

characters.name: Luck Gandor
characters.description: Intelligent executive of the Mafia Gandor Family. The third of the brothers and childhood friend of Firo, having grown up in the same apartment block.  Although he and his brothers lead the Gandor family, Luck's close ties with Firo makes the Gandors allies of the Martillo Family. He is always calm and level-headed, preferring to resort to violence only when necessary. When that time approaches, he does not hesitate to eliminate his opponent while still maintaining his calm demeanor. Sometimes with a faint smile on his face, which according to Firo, is just a pretense to look cool. Luck intentionally pretends to be ruthless because he believes that he is not suited to be a mafia.

characters.name: Maiza Avaro
characters.description: Bookkeeper of the Martillo family and one of the Advena Avis immortals. His younger brother, Gretto, was one of the first to be "devoured" for knowledge of the elixir's recipe.   !In the 1970s, he leaves his post as bookkeeper to Firo and along with Czes begins searching for the rest immortals to inform them of Szilard's death.! (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Nice Holystone
characters.description: Nice Holystone is a bomb enthusiast and the girlfriend of Jacuzzi Splot. She co-leads Jacuzzi's Gang.  Nice's skin is marred by scars (on the right side of her face and across her arms) thanks to an accident in her youth. She covers her empty right eye socket with an eye patch, and wears glasses due to the damage incurred to her left eye.   In contrast to her odd and intimidating appearance, Nice is exceedingly polite when she speaks with everyone—except for Jacuzzi, with whom she speaks casually at his request. Her first love has been explosions from a young age and she is always excited at the prospect of experimenting with them or otherwise utilizing them.  She is crafty and plans ahead, going so far as to hide a cherry bomb in her empty eye socket in case of emergencies. Nice only truly lets loose when she is not accompanied by Jacuzzi.  Nice loves Jacuzzi, and is very considerate of his feelings; she exhibits great patience with him in general. Still, romance is not her forte; their first kiss on the Flying Pussyfoot left her flushed and embarrassed. She will take a leadership role when Jacuzzi is emotionally distraught or otherwise incapacitated and has the respect of all the gang members, some even considering her more of a leader than Jacuzzi.

characters.name: Jacuzzi Splot
characters.description: A crybaby who is nonetheless capable of exceptional courage and leadership ability when the situation calls for it. At first, Jacuzzi seems almost cripplingly shy, even with a tendency to stutter in front of strangers. However, when his loved ones are in danger, he will summon the strength to face his problems directly, even though he'll continue to cry. After a member of his gang was killed, Jacuzzi robbed a record number of neighborhood stores, clutching a machine gun as tears stream down his face. Jacuzzi went out and received his "sword tattoo" on his face when Nice, his romantic partner, was injured in an explosives accident, so that they would both be similarly marked.

characters.name: Isaac Dian
characters.description: Issac Dian forms one half of the bumbling thief couple, who seem to cross into everybody's story in one way or another. He's in love with [Miria](https://anilist.co/character/3796/), and they've robbed everything and anything, from doors to the entire Genoard household. He's completely clueless, super eccentric and happy-go-lucky to the point you can't stop laughing from his bold and sometimes completely weird actions.    He has a cameo appearance in Durarara!!

characters.name: Ennis
characters.description: Szilard's homunculus, though not his first creation. She was created to unthinkingly execute his every command; recently, however, she has been gaining emotions as well as independent thought, as a result of 'devouring' an alchemist threatening Szilard's life.  !She later helps Firo, giving him the necessary knowledge to destroy Szilard, and afterwards moves in with him as his roommate.!  !Ennis eventually reciprocates Firo's feelings, marrying him in the 1980s and taking his surname 'Prochainezo'; two decades later, the couple honeymoon aboard the cruise ship Entrance in 2002, with Czeslaw tagging along.!

characters.name: Firo Prochainezo
characters.description: The youngest executive of Manhattan's Martillo Family Camorra. Firo is surprisingly friendly, humorous and compassionate, but he is a skilled fighter and can be ruthless or even vengeful towards those who bring harm to the people he cares about. He became a complete immortal in November 1930 after accidentally drinking Szilard Quates' immortality elixir. In the same year he falls in love with Ennis, and despite the fact that she initially is unsure of her affection due to her underdeveloped emotional capabilities, they live together as roommates and gradually she reciprocates Firo's feelings.  !Firo has unconscious issues with femininity due to a childhood incident wherein he was mistaken for a girl and nearly molested. His complex about being called girly suggests a lingering stigma, but this does not mean he dislikes women—on the contrary, he treats them with chivalry, never harming them and considering any man who does so as scum. He is also shy when it comes to romance and refrains from taking the initiative even when his feelings are obvious, as shown with his relationship with Ennis. All of these traits can be traced back to the incident from his childhood, making it one of the most formative events of his life.!  !Firo marries Ennis in the early 1980s and the two honeymoon aboard the yacht ship Entrance in 2002.!

characters.name: Miria Harvent
characters.description: Another eccentric thief, she is the partner and lover of [Isaac Dian](https://anilist.co/character/3662). Miria wholeheartedly believes and supports everything Isaac says, often even going so far as to mimic his body language. Together they appear extremely stupid, whimsical and oblivious, but they have great affection for the people they meet, whom they always make a big impression on and always believe the best of them.    She has a cameo appearance in Durarara!!

characters.name: Czesław Meyer
characters.description: The youngest Advenna Avis immortal. His guardian, Ferment, tortured him to test the limits of immortality. Czeslaw manages to devour Ferment, ending his suffering. Unfortunately, he learns from Fermet's memories that he was simply being tortured for Femet's own self-satisfaction. As a result, Czeslaw becomes paranoid and trusts no one, making it his mission to devour other immortals before they can devour him.  In the 1930's it appears he cares little for the lives of others, even requesting that a large group of people be killed so he could find an immortal among them. However, after meeting Isaac and Miria and being forgiven by Maiza, he stops hunting other immortals and moves in with Ennis and Firo.   !In the 1970's, he begins searching for the rest of the Advenna Avis immortals with Maiza to inform them of Szilard's death. In 2001 they find Elmer in a secluded European village. They return to New York while Elmer, Sylvie and Nile head to Japan to search for Denkuro.!

characters.name: Chane Laforet
characters.description: The beautiful, dagger wielding daughter of Huey Laforet. Although her father is one of the original immortals who had been aboard the Advena Avis in 1711, she is actually mortal.   Chane is thoroughly devoted and at a young age, she requested that Huey remove her voice so that she would be unable to reveal his secrets to anyone.   !In 1931, Chane boarded the Flying Pussyfoot as part of the terrorist group that wished to use its passengers as hostages, in order to negotiate Huey's release from prison. Chane did not approve of the terrorists' methods, and knew they only wished to obtain Huey in order to gain access to his secrets about Immortality. She also knew that at some point, the group planned to betray and kill her. Yet, she went along with their plans in order to see how much they would be able to accomplish.   While aboard the Flying Pussyfoot, Chane has a run-in with the sadistic assassin Ladd Russo, from the Russo Mafia Family. They engage in a fierce battle, where Chane's fighting skills impress and delight Ladd. The fight is eventually interrupted by the "Rail Tracer," who takes a liking to Chane and proposes to her. The proposal shocks the young girl as it is the first time someone has ever professed love to her. At the Rail Tracer's request, she engraves her reply to him into the train's roof.  After the events aboard the Flying Pussyfoot, Chane is taken in and cared for by Jacuzzi Splot and his gang. Their kindness confuses Chane, who does not understand why they went out of their way to help her as she is a stranger and member of the terrorist group.   While in their company, she is kidnapped by Graham Spector who mistakes her for Eve Genoard. At Graham's warehouse, she surprises the young man and his gang by attacking him with her daggers, thus revealing to them that she is not Eve. Her battle skills impress Graham, who begins to get excited at the prospect of fighting her. However, Jacuzzi interrupts the fight as he intends to rescue Chane. It does not take long before Nice Holystone and the rest of Jacuzzi's gang also show up to help both Jacuzzi and Chane. Chane is dumbfounded by their actions, and is shocked even more when the Rail Tracer also shows up to her aid.  Once again, the Rail Tracer, who is in fact Claire Stanfield (aka. Vino), an assassin for the Gandor family, confesses his love and says that she does not have to fall in love with him right away, but asks her if they could start out as friends and she could try to. She agrees. !

characters.name: Ladd Russo
characters.description: Ladd is a sadistic hit-man for the Russo family. His love for acts of violence truly shows in the maniacal glee he exhibits while fighting or killing. He is exceptionally skilled in hand-to-hand combat—particularly boxing—and the use of firearms. He is most happy while killing people that think they will never die and by seeing dead people or hearing gunfights. Ladd is deeply in love with his fiancée, Lua, although he expresses it through a passionate promise to kill her someday.

characters.name: Claire Stanfield
characters.description: The youngest train conductor for the Flying Pussy Foot, he tells [Miria](https://anilist.co/character/3796/) and [Isaac](https://anilist.co/character/3662/) the story of the dreaded "Rail-Tracer", a story about a brutish beast that causes passengers in a train to disappear one by one. He also seems to be the only one who knows how to stop the Rail Tracer...  !It is later revealed he was raised with the Gandor brothers, and is considered part of their family, as well as being the Rail Tracer aforementioned. He works as an assassin under the name of 'Vino' (he is called Vino because he completely destroys his victims making them look like they have been drenched in wine "Vino is Italian for wine"). He proposes to [Chane](https://anilist.co/character/7092/) on their first meeting and promises to find her again. He later does so, in the OVA.!

characters.name: Laura Stuart
characters.description: The Archbishop of Necessarius and also the English Anglican Church. Despite being the Archbishop, she looks like an eighteen-year-old girl with long blonde hair that's 2.5 times her height; other than that, few details about her are unknown. She speaks funny Japanese, courtesy of Tsuchimikado Motoharu teaching her, though it was mentioned on a few occasions by Aleister and Stiyl as sounding 'weird', with Stiyl going further telling her it was a mistake to think of Tsuchimikado, who goes after his own sister, as a 'normal' Japanese person and learning Japanese from that source.  She loves baths and has a collection of the latest designs of baths from Academy City, courtesy of Aleister as a gift to sweeten relations between the two sides, in addition to other technology such as the latest design of washing machines given to the Necessarius female dormitories.    ! She might sound simple and irresponsible, but behind her smile lies a cold and calculating personality, with Stiyl mentioning she does things on both ends of the scale that it balances out to the point where it's impossible to tell whether she's good or evil as she is described as "no one is better than her in manipulating human feelings, rationality, interests, ethics, and necessary values" and "the hidden dragon among magicians, she’s somehow able to get to the top, and it’s not done cheaply." . An example of this is Laura being the one who designed the "John's Pen" mode of Index and lied to people that Index must get her memory erased every year, as a attempt to maintain control of the grimoire library Index holds. She does as many good things as she does evil things. On the balance of good and evil, she’s keeping an intricate balance.  Another example of Laura's viciousness is when Index is under the control of Fiamma, she plans to forcibly use the remaining controller to prevent Fiamma having access to the girmoire collection Index have, even if it would put even more intense burdens onto Index. Stiyl rejects this move and delibrately stays with Index to prevent Laura doing anything, and plans to kill Laura if it means saving Index. Laura then activated her controller blocking Fiamma's signal, forcing Index into John's Pen mode and tries to fight back. Laura then coerced Stiyl into fighting Index, saying she is giving him a chance to do something to solve the problem at hand, and she'll step in with the controller regardless if he fails. All that was done with a seemingly sincere smile on Laura's face showing no outward malice.  Laura prefers to work behind the scenes if possible, and let others like Kanzaki or Stiyl deal with meeting with other factions face-to-face. She is also a close friend of Elizard, the two having known each other for years. !

characters.name: Index Librorum Prohibitorum
characters.description: Height: 148 cm (4'10") Classification: Magician Affiliation: Anglican Church Ability: Spell Intercept  Index, also known by her full name Index Librorum Prohibitorum, is one of the main heroines and the titular character of the series. She is a young nun from Necessarius, a branch of the Church of England.   Index is small in stature and has a petite build. About 14 or 15 years old, she has thigh-length, silvery-blue hair with very white skin and large green eyes. She also wears a white robe with golden embroidery sewed onto every edge of it, the Walking Church.

characters.name: Touma Kamijou
characters.description: Height: 168 cm Classification: Esper (technically) Esper Power: Imagine Breaker Power Level: 0 (technically)  The main protagonist of Toaru Majutsu no Index and a supporting character in Toaru Kagaku no Railgun. He has the lowest psychic rank possible at Level 0—largely because the people testing psychic abilities cannot detect or classify his abilities. His power is Imagine Breaker, a power which negates all magic, psychic, or divine powers but also his own good luck. Due to the nature of his power, the founder of Academy City considers him neither a Psychic nor a Magician but rather a normal person with a unique ability. He tends to stay away from trouble but possesses a strong sense of justice, albeit somewhat shallow and dogmatic. He is a smart student and knowledgeable about certain subjects yet is a failure in his esper studies. While he is an idealist for the hopes of other people, ironically he is cynical about himself possibly because of his powers.

characters.name: Pierce Aogami
characters.description: Height: 180 cm (5'10") Classification: Esper    Tōma's friend and classmate. A funny individual who tends to see Tōma's bad luck, who he calls "Kami-yan", in a different way. He is a self-confessed pervert, lolicon and masochist who enjoys being punished by his teacher, Tsukuyomi. He is always seen with Motoharu. Together with him, Motoharu and Tōma, they are known as the three idiots in their class, as not only do they have the lowest test scores but also they are all level 0's except the latter two have good reasons for being that way.  "Pierce Aogami" is actually a nickname that means "Blue Hair With Piercings"; his real name has not yet been revealed.

characters.name: Motoharu Tsuchimikado
characters.description: Height: 176cm (5'9") Classification: ! Magician-Esper hybrid !  Affiliation: ! Necessarius, GROUP (Leader) !    A blond teenager who is always seen with sunglasses and wearing an Aloha shirt. He is a friend and classmate of Tōma who just happens to be his next-door neighbor at the dormitory they're staying at. While he seem like a normal, average teenager, there's more to him than meets the eye.   !Secretly, Tsuchimikado is actually a former agent of Necessarius who became a freelance spy for Necessarius, Academy City, and other unknown organizations; the leaders of both Necessarius and Academy City are both aware of this but have decided to let him be for the time being. His sorcery name is Fallere825, 'the back-stabber'.!   !He was formerly a skilled Onmyōji as his family are descendants of Abe no Seimei but gave up his abilities when he went under the ESP development curriculum. He has a younger step-sister named Maika, whom he is also in love with, and for this he is known as the Shisukon Gunsō (シスコン軍曹, "Sis-com Sergeant"?). He is also a member of one of Academy City's secret organizations, the "GROUP". His ESP ability is the Level 0 Auto Regeneration (肉体再生, Nikutai Saisei?, lit. "Body Regeneration"). Due to this power, he can still use magic as he can repair the damage done to his body, making him the only successful psychic/magician hybrid. Despite these advantages, he avoids using magic except in the most desperate situations as he cannot avoid the extreme pain caused by using it.! (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Stiyl Magnus
characters.description: Height: 200cm (6.56 ft) Classification: Magician, Priest Affiliation: Anglican Church (Necessarius)  A sorcerer from Necessarius. His sorcery name is Fortis931. He is an extremely heavy smoker; he claims a world without nicotine would be hell. He specializes in using flames and is able to use a flame sword or summon a 3000 degree Celsius fire called Innocentius ("King of Witch Hunters") to battle his enemies. Despite his looks, he is actually fourteen-years-old and ironically is physically weak. He mostly has a bad temper but is actually kind, as he cares about Index very much and his failure to save her life without losing her memories was his greatest regret. When he learns the Church lied to him and Kaori about Index's condition, he decides to disobey orders to capture Index and let her live her life.  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Last Order
characters.description: Misaka clone No. 20001, she is the administrator of the Misaka Network and the fail-safe mechanism in case the Sisters got out of control. She is not designed to function independently and survive for long outside a culture container, and appears to be only about ten years old.  Unlike her previous clone sisters, she is capable of showing emotions and has a close relationship with [Mikoto](https://anilist.co/character/13701/Misaka-Mikoto), [Misaka Imouto](https://anilist.co/character/17729/MISAKA-10032) and [Accelerator](https://anilist.co/character/13917/Accelerator).

characters.name: Aisa Himegami
characters.description: Height: 160 cm Classification: Esper (Gemstone)    A quiet young girl with a rather blunt personality who wears Miko attire.   !While she may seem normal, she is also known as "Deep Blood" and has the ability to kill vampires when they approach her, as her blood's smell attracts them. However, it made her miserable because it killed her family and friends that were turned into vampires. This prompts her to go to Academy City, hoping to find a way to get rid of her powers, until she meets the alchemist Aureolus Izzard. She cooperates with him because he told her that her blood can be used to save the life of a person he cared for (Index) in return for helping her get rid of her powers.!  !When Aureolus learns Index's life was already saved by Tōma and tries to kill him, Aisa attempts to defend Tōma, which prompts Aureolus to use his alchemy to try to kill her as she was now useless to him. Her life was saved by Tōma who dispelled the spell on her with his right hand. When she asks Tōma about why he saved her, he told her that he did not have a reason to rescue her. After the incident, she lives with Tōma and Index but later moves to Komoe's apartment and wears a magical power-blocking cross, which enables her to live what she had always wanted: a normal life. She was formerly a student at Kirigaoka Academy for Girls, one of the five elite schools of Academy City, but was transfer to Tōma's school when her sponsor, Aureolus Izzard mysteriously disappear thus ending her enrollment at Kirigaoka Academy. Ever since Tōma saved her life, Aisa started to have feelings for him, which is ironic as she once joked that Tōma's life was like a dating sim. !

characters.name: Kaori Kanzaki
characters.description: Height: 175cm  Classification: Magician Affiliation: Necessarius, Amakusa-Style Remix of Church (Priestess)    A  sorceress from Necessarius. Unlike her partner Stiyl, she uses magic to magically strengthen her body. Her sorcery name is Salvere000. She uses a 2 meter long katana (which actually is a Nodachi) called "Seven Heavens Seven Swords" as her weapon. She has a special attack called Nanasen (七閃, Nanasen? "Seven Flash") that uses her katana and some wires. She used to be a kind woman who treated Index like a sister, but when Index's memories were deleted by Necessarius, Kaori changed into a cold and silent woman as Index no longer remembered her and consequentially did not trust her.   After Touma saves Index's life and her current memories, she decides to stay in Academy City to be with Index and protect her.  Later in the novels, more of her past is revealed. Not only is Kaori a skilled swordswoman, but she is a Catholic Saint possessing the "Stigma" — the ability to call upon God's power — and the former leader of the Amakusa Catholics. However, Kaori left the group as she resented that she had been fated since birth to become its leader, which led her to despise the concept of luck and fortune. Though she is Catholic, she joined Necessarius in hopes of changing her fate and befriended Index, developing a sisterly relationship with her. The repeated failed attempts to make Index remember her after each memory erasure resulted in her cold personality as Kaori began to accept that no matter how much a person tries, no one can change their destiny. She begins to show a kinder side to herself after Touma saves Index (thus giving her hope that anyone can defy their destiny) and gradually falls in love with him after he helps her face her past with the Amakusa Catholics, becoming more prone to showing emotion and sometimes showing a little embarrassment if she is with him. She is the protagonist of her own spin-off mini light novel bundled with the Toaru Kagaku no Railgun DVDs.

characters.name: Kikyou Yoshikawa
characters.description: Academy City's researcher. She was in charge of the "Level 6 Shift" project. Even after the project was put to a stop, she kept herself in the laboratory, creating a vaccine for the virus program that Ao Amai put in Last Order. She is shot by Amai while trying to protect Accelerator and Last Order but recovers and is later released from the hospital along with Accelerator and Last Order.

characters.name: Youdai Matsumoto
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Ren Kaji
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Jien Yanagita
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Touma Hiragi
characters.description: A third-year student at Furin High School in Class 1. One of the Four Kings of Bofurin, Hiragi is the leader of the Tamon Team. Hiragi is highly strung and possesses a strong sense of responsibility, often finding himself being pushed around by the overly gracious Umemiya. He's also a hard worker who can't let go of his stomach pain medicine. He possesses true martial arts ability, proven to be one of the best at his craft. He is an understanding person who loyally supports Umemiya.  (Source: WIND BREAKER Official Website)

characters.name: Akihiko Nirei
characters.description: **Height:** 163 cm   A first-year student at Furin High School in Class 1. Nirei is weak at fighting, but his frank personality livens up the room — he's the life of the class. He wants to protect the town more than anybody else and thus has always aspired to become a student at Furin High School. Nirei always carries a notepad and pen in his chest pocket. He's a well-informed person whose hobby is collecting and analyzing data on people he thinks are cool.   (Source: WIND BREAKER Official Website)

characters.name: Kyoutarou Sugishita
characters.description: **Height:** 192 cm  A first-year student at Furin High School in Class 1. Sugishita's a mad dog and quite talented — he's the only one who's been allowed to call himself "Bofurin" since middle school. His motivation and driving force come from his excessive loyalty and devotion to Umemiya - whatever Umemiya says, goes. He's usually quiet and has a unique sway as he walks. When he gets mad, though, he's the most unpredictable of them all.   (Source: WIND BREAKER Official Website)

characters.name: Hayato Suou
characters.description: **Height:** 174 cm  A first-year student at Furin High School in Class 1. Suo has a refreshing smile and is pleasant to everyone he meets, but his outrageous jokes can cause chaos to the people around him. Despite his pleasantness, he can present an icy personality that leaves no tolerance for people who lack decorum. Suo's an enigma as he usually shows no emotions nor reveals his true feelings. He has a unique fighting style that resembles both kung fu and aikido.   (Source: WIND BREAKER Official Website)

characters.name: Hajime Umemiya
characters.description: **Height:** 188cm  A third-year student at Furin High School in Class 1. Umemiya is Bofurin's representative, meaning he stands at the top. With his friendly smile and amicable personality, he's a charismatic man who garners absolute trust from the people around him — not just the students at Furin High School but also from people around town. He's not just physically strong, however — with the tenacity to handle anything thrown his way, his very existence can overwhelm the people around him in a single shout. He likes to grow vegetables as a hobby.  (Source: WIND BREAKER Official Website)

characters.name: Taiga Tsugeura
characters.description: Height: 181 cm  A first-year student at Furin High School in Class 1. Always lifting weights and never without his protein shake, Tsugeura possesses a bright and honest personality that makes all his friends admire him. However, due to his constant state of high energy, his friends can also find him to be a pain in the butt at times. A lover of "virtues" as a way of life, he asks everyone he meets for the first time about their virtues. He’s a regular at the Muscle Power restaurant and recommends their protein okonomiyaki.  (Source: WIND BREAKER Official Website)

characters.name: Mitsuki Kiryuu
characters.description: Height: 165cm  A first-year student at Furin High School in Class 1. Toshiyuki’s gentle-mannered personality and thoughtfulness make him popular with the ladies, but he’s no pushover — his fighting abilities are the real deal. A lover of games, he'll play them whenever he has some free time, making it his daily routine to try and get game login bonuses. He likes to add “chan” to his close friends’ names as a term of endearment. He is revered as one of the five strongest of his grade.  (Source: WIND BREAKER Official Website, edited)

characters.name: Kotoha Tachibana
characters.description: Kotoha works at Café Pothos. Her friendly and brave personality makes her seem like an adult, but just like Sakura and the others, she’s only 16. As manager of Café Pothos, she serves the best menu to the students at Furin High School and the local townspeople everyday. She will admonish Sakura for his actions from time to time.  (Source: WIND BREAKER Official Website)

characters.name: Haruka Sakura
characters.description: Height: 169 cm  Haruka Sakura is a high school student in his first year. He attends Fuurin, a school known as a delinquent school, with aspirations to reach the top. He admires strong people. Rejected by others for his rough appearance, being alone was natural for him.  Hated by others and sitting at the bottom of the social strata, Sakura believes fighting is his only saving grace and that by winning those fights, he thinks he can feel his worth. He tries to keep an image of a ruthless and tough exterior, but in reality, he is kind-hearted. He easily gets embarrassed by compliments on his good acts.   (Source: Official Website)

characters.name: Walter C. Dornez
characters.description: Walter C. Dornez is the butler of Integra Hellsing, but is at the same time a deadly combatant, wielding high-velocity microfilament wires (dubbed by fans "The Dental Floss Of Doom"), and fought together with Alucard in the Second World War to stop a certain groups attempt at creating an undead army.

characters.name: Enrico Maxwell
characters.description: Enrico Maxwell is the leader of the Vatican's Special Section XIII, the Iscariot Organization. He is a bitter rival of Integra and the Hellsing organization, but establishes a form of cooperation with Hellsing when fighting Millenium.  But can Integra and the others truly trust him?

characters.name: Jan Valentine
characters.description: The youngest of the Valentine brothers, Jan is a maniacal thug and an artificial vampire. He does not have any high class vampire abilities, and utilizes two P90s.  During the assault on Hellsing HQ, he fought Seras and Walter while hunting for Integra, and was eventually remotely killed by Millennium in order to seal his lips.

characters.name: Doc
characters.description: The Doc is, as his nickname implies, a doctor, though of the rather questionable sort.  He is the mastermind behind Millennium's artificial vampires, and has not aged since the second world war. He  is also in the possession of a peculiar remote controller, controlling many different aspects of the Millennium war machine.

characters.name: Seras Victoria
characters.description: Affiliations: Hellsing Organization, London Metropolitan Police (Former; Firearms Specialist)  A policewoman sent to investigate the troubles at Cheddar Village, her squad is killed and she is nearly raped and killed by the mad vampire priest inhabiting the dead village but is "saved" when [Alucard](https://anilist.co/character/601/Alucard) sends a bullet through her to kill the priest. On the verge of death, she allows Alucard to turn her into a vampire​ and joins Hellsing as Alucard's minion.  She is reluctant to embrace her new powers at first, but gradually comes to terms with what she is, and eventually discovers her true powers after a certain event.

characters.name: Arthur Hellsing
characters.description: Descendant of the eccentric and brilliant Abraham Van Helsing, Arthur's tireless efforts in the cultivation of the Hellsing Organization coupled with his expansive knowledge of midians, sought to protect England from occult threat for decades. Arthur was the proud father of his daughter, Integra, and at his deathbed pronounced her official head of the Hellsing Organization much to his brother's displeasure.  (Source: Call To Arms)

characters.name: Leif aka Huger
characters.description: Leif aka Huger and his girlfriend Jessica were a couple of low level youngster vampires misguided into a belief that they can become immortal by killing off 13 random families on a road. They've managed to kill 4 before clashing with Hellsing operatives to our pair's great surprise.  In Hellsing manga vampire boyfriend's name has never been mentioned so in different adaptations authors went with different versions: in Hellsing TV series he is called "Leif" multiple times while in Hellsing Ultimate character's name is never spoken out loud, yet noted as "Huger" in the end credits of episode one.

characters.name: Alucard
characters.description: Height: 220 cm (7'2")  The secret weapon of the Hellsing organization, Alucard is a vampire specializing in killing other vampires. At first glance, he seems to be nothing but a rather odd gunman, but when he truly unleashes his powers, it becomes quite clear that he is not a mortal. After walking the night for half a millennium, he is constantly seeking a worthy opponent, and with his powers of regeneration, strength, and shape-shifting, not to mention his army of familiars, he lays waste to any of his master's enemies.      !However, beneath his cool and heartless exterior lurks a dark and tragic past, and a longing for the only thing an immortal can never have.!   Several of the typical weaknesses of vampires have no effect on him, like sunlight, as he claimed in chapter 13: "Sunlight is not my greatest enemy...  I just HATE it!" He can also travel over running water without any problem.

characters.name: Integra Fairbrook Wingates Hellsing
characters.description: Sir Integra Hellsing is a noblewoman member of the Protestant Knights who is the head and last member of the Hellsing family, the Bureau Director of the Hellsing Organization, and the current master of Hellsing's vampire, Alucard. Integra is usually a collected individual, rarely allowing her emotions to get in the way of business. However, she is sometimes prone to fits of anger. The Hellsing family is "on a mission from God", and she values her duties to protect the United Kingdom and the Anglican Church above everything else. For her, failure is not tolerated, especially her own. She runs the Hellsing Organization with charisma and patriotism, and she is one of the few people who can stand up to the force of Alucard's personality and command his respect.  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Alexander Anderson
characters.description: Alexander Anderson is the trump card of Iscariot - section XIII, the secret organization of the Catholic church created to fight the undead.  Little is known about his background, other than his many nicknames and victories, and his biotech regeneration. Anderson first meets Alucard on a mission in Northern Ireland, and their paths cross many times afterwards. Anderson is seemingly possessed by the thought of defeating Alucard...How far is he willing to go in order to defeat his foe?

characters.name: Goushi Asougi
characters.description: A male player who is Pitohui's acquaintance and longtime friend. Asougi Goushi, known as M in Gun Gale Online, is one of the main characters of the Sword Art Online Alternative "Gun Gale Online" spin-off series.  He is a giant man, over 190 centimeters tall, and is good at medium to long-range combat, and is especially good at sniping. He is calm, has excellent strategy planning skills, and serves as the team's staff officer.

characters.name: Miyu Shinohara
characters.description: Shinohara Miyu, known as Fukaziroh in ALfheim Online and Gun Gale Online, is one of the main characters in the Gun Gale Online spin-off series. She is a long-time friend of Kohiruimaki Karen from her hometown Hokkaido in the real world. She plays ALfheim Online as a Sylph but occasionally converts her account to Gun Gale Online to participate in Squad Jam tournaments.  Taking advantage of her high strength, she fights with two six-barreled grenade launchers in GGO.

characters.name: Pitohui
characters.description: A tall beautiful woman with a tattoo on her cheek, Pitohui is a player in Gun Gale Online and LLENN's first friend in the game. She is a veteran GGO player and is a mysterious person whose only secret is that she is a gun enthusiast who uses a different gun every time she plays.  !It is later revealed that her real name is Kanzaki Erza.!

characters.name: Shirley
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Moe Annaka
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Kana Fujisawa
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Saki Nitobe
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Shiori Noguchi
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Milana Shidrowa
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Clarence
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Karen Kohiruimaki
characters.description: Height: 183cm (6'0")  Karen is a female college student who has a complex about her tall figure and has a poor social disposition because of it. In Gun Gale Online, she obtains a dream "chibi" avatar less than 150 centimeters in height that dons a full-body pink uniform.  She has excellent agility and specializes in close-range combat that utilizes her speed. She loves cute things, and all of her equipment is pink. Her main arm is P90 and she calls it "P-Chan".

characters.name: Cariot Incindia Wiseman
characters.description: One of the Magia Vende.

characters.name: Zeo Thorzeus Reinbolt
characters.description: One of the Magia Vende.

characters.name: Wignall Lindor
characters.description: Height: 176 cm (5'9")  An elf who transferred to the academy from Alfswood, located in the far north Urbus region. In accordance with elven customs, he only permits physical contact with those he has deemed worthy. Shares the same dream as a certain no-talent. He specializes in wind and illusion magic.

characters.name: Sion Ulster
characters.description: Height: 171 cm (5'7")  Heir to house Ulster, a renowned line of fire mages. He has one younger sister. Following a certain incident during his first year at the academy, he became painfully aware of Will and began to see him as a rival.

characters.name: Will Serfort
characters.description: Height: 168 cm (5'6") Race: Lyzance  Will Serfort is a sixth year student at the Regarden Magical Academy shunned by most students and faculty due to his lack of magical aptitude. To make up for his lack of magic, Will trains his body and swordsmanship in the dungeon.

characters.name: Colette Loire
characters.description: Race: Resans Height: 164 cm (5'5")  Only daughter of house Loire, a fallen family of nobles. She specializes in earth magic, but struggles considerably with any spell requiring precision. Colette befriended [Will](https://anilist.co/character/212394/Serfort-Will) following a certain incident during her first year at the academy.

characters.name: Edward Serfence
characters.description: Height: 177 cm (5'9")  An ascendant who made it to the top of the Tower, earning the qualification to become Magia Vander, before being defeated by another candidate. He now works as a professor at Regarden Magical Academy, where he teaches Dark Magic and History and Origins of Magic. Ten years ago, he was one of a group of problem children who enlisted to fight in the Great War despite still being students.

characters.name: Kiki
characters.description: Will's familiar and pet. Kiki is a carbuncle, capable of casting reflective magic to protect Will in emergencies.

characters.name: Rosti Naumann
characters.description: Height: 170 cm (5'7")  A skilled magical artificer and Will's roommate. His boundless affection for Will is enough to make Colette nervous. While lacking any natural gift for artificing, he has become a great talent and often devises various magical items under the pretense of making them for Will.

characters.name: Elfaria Serfort
characters.description: Height: 163 cm (5'4") Race: Lyzance  A true prodigy and the youngest Magia Vander in history, she watches over a certain young man from her windowsill in the Tower. Those close to her say she is an easygoing Magia Vander who likes to play the saint. [Will's](https://anilist.co/character/212394/Will-Serfort) childhood friend who specializes in ice magic.

characters.name: Workner Norgram
characters.description: Height: 178 cm (5'10)  Professor of Magizoology. As one of the few people who understands Will, he always worries when Will pushes himself too hard. Though he tends to show his love for his students by being strict with them, this has made him an object of terror at the academy. He has earned various nicknames, including "Remedial Teacher from Hell," "Four-Eyed Fiend," "Magical Creature Nut," and "Immortal Workner," and is feared by friend and foe alike.

characters.name: Puri-Puri Prisoner
characters.description: Occupation: Superhero  Level: S-Class; Rank 17  Puri-Puri Prisoner is a flamboyant, openly homosexual superhero. He takes an interest in other, up-and-coming heroes and criminals; an interest which led to his titular jail sentence, as he kept attacking them. Criminals that he apprehends are then added to his harem.

characters.name: Zombieman
characters.description: Race: Human-Mutant Abilities: Regeneration S-Class: Rank 8 Affiliation: Hero Association  Personality: Zombieman is stated to be nihilistic, possibly due to the fact that he has "died" several times, therefore he is always calm. In addition, he prefers to work as a lone wolf and dislikes gathering, although he still respects common courtesy. However, he appears to have a sadistic side, since he enjoys killings that create rivers of blood, he is also shown to be a rather smart individual, with detective-like thinking. In comparison to the other S-Class heroes, Zombieman is more thoughtful and respectful.  Abilities: Zombieman possesses one of the best regeneration capabilities in the series. He is able to regenerate any part of his body no matter how severe the injury is, and he was able to heal his broken arms in an instant. He needs only a few minutes to recover from an extremely mutilated state and regrow his left arm, however this regeneration does not give Zombieman full immortality, as he will die if he is reduced to mincemeat. Zombieman has an incredible threshold for extensive physical activity, displaying one of the most impressive feats of stamina in the series and being able to fight for hours on end while his expedient recovery rate handles the more serious of injuries he suffers.

characters.name: Kamikaze
characters.description: Race: Human Abilities: Superhuman Physical Prowess, Master Swordsmanship Occupation: Superhero, Swordsmanship Teacher Affiliation: Hero Association, Council of Swordmasters Level: S-Class Rank 4  Personality: Atomic Samurai has a rather prideful and jocular personality as seen when he refused to shake Saitama's hand, telling him that he only acknowledges the strong, and telling Saitama that he would greet him properly only if he makes it to the higher ranks of S-Class. Atomic Samurai also enjoys his swordplay and makes a game out of it, often taunting monsters and showing off as he cuts them to pieces, Kamikaze also is straightforward to a humorous degree in many ways, and is incredibly confident and cocky.  Abilities: Atomic Samurai is one of the top S-Class heroes. He is regarded as one of the most powerful of them, and the strongest backup hero in the Hero Association, he is also considered Earth's strongest swordsman. Atomic Samurai possesses extreme levels of speed, being able to cut his opponents to pieces in the blink of an eye using his sword.

characters.name: Isamu
characters.description: Height: 135cm (4'5") Race: Human Occupation: Superhero Level: S-Class; Rank: 5 Affiliation: Heroes Association  Child Emperor is a young boy with large eyes. He wears a plain T-shirt with two buttons both of which are buttoned, along with a black school bag on his back.  As a genius, the Child Emperor values education, which can be seen when he mentions about going to cram school even after hearing about the Earth being in danger. He easily becomes infuriated when being labeled as childish by others. He is very analytical, observing the situation and formulating plans in a calm and collected manner.

characters.name: Isabella York
characters.description: Isabella York is the daughter of the York family that is closely related to the Drossel Royal Family. She had trouble fitting in with the nobility as she can't follow etiquette and mannerism of the nobles in her school, making her some sort of outcast.  !She is an illegitimate daughter of the York family, she used to live in poverty with her adopted sister, Taylor Bartlett. Before becoming Isabella York, she goes by the name of Amy Bartlett. The condition she proposed to the York family is to take care of Taylor in exchange for her cooperation to become the daughter of York family!

characters.name: Taylor Bartlett
characters.description: Taylor Bartlett is Amy Bartlett's adoptive sister. Her sister, Amy picked her up from the streets despite barely managing to make ends meet for herself.  !When Amy was taken as the York's daughter, Taylor was sent to an orphanage where she spent years apart from her sister, Amy. It's not until Benedict delivered Amy's letters to her that she start to reminiscence the day she spent with her sister, Amy.!

characters.name: Roland
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Nerine
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Luculia Marlborough
characters.description: Luculia is a graduate of the Auto Memories Doll Training School and a novice Auto Memories Doll. Luculia and Violet became friends as fellow classmates at the training school, and she is the one who helped Violet graduate and earn her licence.  She is shown to be a kind and considerate person who is willing to go out of her way to assist others, such as her offering Violet some of her food the first day they met as well as attempting to help her write a letter to Gilbert. Despite a tragic backstory, she is shown to carry a positive attitude and cheerful demeanor when around other people, but tends to be more quiet and solemn when alone. She is expressive and sociable, but she struggles to communicate her own feelings, particularly regarding her brother.

characters.name: Iris Cannary
characters.description: Iris Cannary is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. A rookie Auto Memories Doll with an unyielding spirit who works at CH Postal Company, Iris admires young working women and is enthusiastic about quickly making a name for herself in the industry.  !As a child, she became friends with a boy named Emonn Snow and the two were very close. Iris was in love with him, and she had also supposedly convinced herself that her feelings were reciprocated. Because of that, she confessed to him before they graduated school, but he rejected her confession. The emotional pain caused by Emonn's rejection was what caused her to leave her hometown to become an Auto Memories Doll.!

characters.name: Cattleya Baudelaire
characters.description: Cattleya Baudelaire is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. Being a figurehead Auto Memories Doll who works for the CH Postal Company, Cattleya never stops being requested and often takes on clients with love troubles. She works alongside [Violet](https://anilist.co/character/90169/Evergarden-Violet) and has been close with [Hodgins](https://anilist.co/character/124799/Hodgins-Claudia) since before the company was established, joining as one of its initial employees.

characters.name: Benedict Blue
characters.description: Benedict Blue (ベネディクト・ブルー, Benedikuto Burū?) is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. He is a postman working at the CH Postal Company. He has known Hodgins since before the company's establishment and has had a brusque attitude towards him since he started working there.

characters.name: Erica Brown
characters.description: Erica Brown is a character in the Violet Evergarden series. She is an Auto Memories Doll who has been working at the CH Postal Company for a while. She is not good at communicating and isn't confident in her work.  !Erica is an anime-original character.!

characters.name: Violet Evergarden
characters.description: Height: 161 cm  Violet is described as a very beautiful young woman, being almost doll-like in appearance, with light-blue eyes, a fair complexion, and a slender frame. She is noted for her womanly semblance. She has waist-length golden hair with locks that frame her face. She either has her hair untied, in a low ponytail, or, after becoming a Doll, pulled up into two braided buns with two red ribbons. Due to losing her arms in the war, Violet received maneuverable prosthetic arms made of adamant silver. After the end of the war and on normal occasions, Violet is often seen wearing a white blouse, a green skirt and a pair of heeled brown boots.  !Growing up as an orphaned child soldier in the army who was treated as a mere tool, Violet was not educated like a regular human being and did not understand human feelings well. She was raised and grew up as a person who had feelings, but couldn't perceive or express them. For this reason, she could be mistaken as emotionless, or apathetic. Even before she was found and taken into the army, she couldn't speak or understand speech, only understanding orders to kill. She did not possess any sense of right or wrong from the start; she didn't understand what could be considered righteous or erroneous. She merely chased after the adults who gave her orders. She followed the idea of "kill or be killed," thus she could kill countless people without feeling guilt or remorse. She did anything that was asked of her and always followed orders, which was a trait from her life as a soldier. Even after the war ended and she was discharged from the military, Violet had a habit of using words back from her life as a soldier; saluting, disliking being defenseless, and doing tasks without taking any breaks. She also continued to think of herself as a "tool" and believed that it would be appropriate to discard her if she can no longer be used as a weapon.!   Violet is also aloof, expressionless and is said to have the attitude and the presence of a doll. Her expressions are mostly deadpan, so it is hard to tell her mood changes. This is why she sometimes has trouble expressing her own feelings and comes off as expressionless, which makes it difficult to get through her, but she will give a smile from time to time. Through her work as a Doll where she helps people write heartfelt letters, she slowly learns about human emotions, leading her to become more skilled at writing letters and conveying her clients' feelings, as well as becoming understanding of others. She is proven to be a good listener and someone who always thinks about other people's happiness.

characters.name: Claudia Hodgins
characters.description: A former army commander. He founded the CH postal company and serves as president.  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Takahiro Mizusawa
characters.description: He is a popular, gregarious and good-looking classmate of Fumiya Tomozaki who's part of Shuuji Nakamura's clique, and often considered as the smartest and most level-headed member of the group. Takahiro usually attracts the attention of girls and is an extremely smooth talker, with Fumiya considering him as a role model on the way he speaks. He is also perceptive enough to notice the changes surrounding Fumiya, including the fact that the latter is intentionally changing his demeanor. As he naturally puts up a façade in front of other people, he noticed similarities between himself and Aoi, and realized that she is the one girl he can't deceive with his speech. Thus, he developed a romantic attraction to Aoi, to which his confession was rejected. He strives to gain a greater status and presence in order to attract Aoi's attention. Despite neither Aoi nor Fumiya showing any romantic interest with each other, he considers Fumiya as his romantic rival.

characters.name: Yuuzu Izumi
characters.description: As someone who dislikes conflict, she is often unwilling to take a stand against Erika's unreasonable actions. She is in love with Shuuji, so she decides to learn how to play Tackfam in order to be his practice partner. She ends up asking Fumiya to be her tutor in Tackfam, which eventually leads to a friendship between the two.

characters.name: Hanabi Natsubayashi
characters.description: Hanabi is a blunt and unsociable classmate of Fumiya Tomozaki. She has a close friendship with Mimimi who is her polar opposite. Her blunt nature often leaves her disliked. Once, it got her into trouble as she openly condemned Erika's actions of harassment and bullying, thus making her the target of bullying herself.

characters.name: Mika Akiyama
characters.description: Mika is Mao's friend and part of Erika's clique.

characters.name: Kyouya Hashiguchi
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Takei
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Tomozaki no Imouto
characters.description: Tomozaki's younger sister, who frequently expresses her dislike to her brother.

characters.name: Minami Nanami
characters.description: **Height:** 162 cm (5'3.2")  She is an energetic, mischievous, and popular classmate of [Fumiya Tomozaki](https://anilist.co/character/136978) who is in the track and field club together with [Aoi Hinami](https://anilist.co/character/136977). She has a close friendship with [Hanabi Natsubayashi](https://anilist.co/character/161223). Although she maintains a cheerful demeanor, in truth she has insecurities about herself and her personality that gives in easily to not ruin the mood. She is also known to be quite persistent in what she wants to achieve, such as pestering the lonely Hanabi into being her friend.

characters.name: Aoi Hinami
characters.description: Aoi is [Tomozaki](https://anilist.co/character/136978)'s classmate, and the number two ranked player at the fighting game 'Tackfam'. She excels at everything she tries due to her hard-working attitude, so much so that many regard her as being outright perfect. To most people, she seems like a happy-go-lucky, carefree student. However, Tomozaki soon learns that she's a very serious, accommodating, supportive, yet somewhat harsh and rude person.

characters.name: Fumiya Tomozaki
characters.description: Fumiya Tomozaki is a high school student who is a friendless loner and an outcast in school. To escape from his lonely existence, he dedicated himself to a fighting game called Attack Family, or 'Tackfam' for short, so much so that he's the number one ranked player in Japan, his username being nanashi.   Tomozaki sees himself as a "bottom-tier character" in life: someone born unlucky and destined for loneliness. However, after meeting his online rival, [Aoi Hinami](https://anilist.co/character/136977/Aoi-Hinami), he agrees to learn from her how to socialize and improve himself, treating life as a game to be mastered.

characters.name: Fuuka Kikuchi
characters.description: Fuuka is a reserved and book-loving classmate of [Fumiya](https://anilist.co/character/136978/Tomozaki-Fumiya) who often spends time at the library. As she is an aspiring novelist, she loves to speculate about and study different people's motives for their actions and experiences that shaped them to who they are today.   Her favorite author is Michael Andi.

characters.name: Jouji Saiga
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Sakuya Togane
characters.description: Togane has narrow gray eyes and long black hair whose bangs curl. His attire consists of a black suit with a gray and green vest worn over a white shirt and black tie. His collar points seem to be tucked under the vest. He is an Enforcer in Division 1 of the Public Safety Bureau.  (Source: PSYCHO-PASS Wiki)

characters.name: Kirito Kamui
characters.description: Kirito Kamui is a person who cannot be detected by any scanners or by the Dominators themselves. He aids and abets criminals, including Akira Kitazawa, with his ability to clarify their Hues. !The reason why a dominator or a scanner could not detect him was because after a plane crash he was reconstructed in surgery with the remains of the other victims!

characters.name: Risa Aoyanagi
characters.description: !Possibly a container or vessel for the Sibyl System, as hinted on various episodes and scenes.!

characters.name: Yasuo Hazuki
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Kimie Kamata
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Hina Hanetachi
characters.description: She is a second year student in High School and a member of the school Newspaper Club who is in love with [Amatsuyu Kisaragi](https://anilist.co/character/138900).

characters.name: Asaka Mayama
characters.description: Leader of the Charisma group.

characters.name: Sumireko Sanshokuin
characters.description: Sumireko Sanshokuin is one of the three initial heroines introduced in the series. Her nickname, Pansy, is a wordplay from her full name 三色院菫子. When the 院 and 子 removed, the remaining character (三色菫) form the Japanese name for Viola tricolor or Wild Pansy flower. She is usually called by her nickname to those who are close to her. Initially introduced as a librarian committee member with a petite build and plain face, she spends her time observing people who come to the library and somehow took interest in [Kisaragi Amatsuyu](https://anilist.co/character/138900). She is known to be gloomy by the majority of the student. She usually ties her hair in braids. In actuality, she hid her true looks behind plain getup and a "sarashi" to bind her chest to make it smaller than it actually is. Amatsuyu describes her true looks as "Big Breasted Cuties". In her true form, she is admittedly beautiful, even rivaling the school's beauty queens, [Cosmos](https://anilist.co/character/138899) and [Himawari](https://anilist.co/character/138898). Her personality is generally polite to her peers, only turning sharp-tongued when interacting with Amatsuyu. She is shown to be a rather observant character, as she is able to assess a situation from the sideline. She also has above-average intellect, shown by her capability to tutor her fellow friends. Beneath her gloom and timid look, she hides a strong charismatic presence. Although she is beautiful, she is not comfortable showing people her true form as she stated that she'd only let Amatsuyu see her in her true form when asked to change her looks in general by Amatsuyu. She is good at Classic Literature. She doesn't like Math.   She is the original affection object of Taiyou Oga. The thing she wants the most is "a preserved, confined, and ornamented Joro". When asked whether she wants a dog or a cat, she picked Amatsuyu, reinforcing the fact of her infatuation for Amatsuyu. She also has never read a manga before. She compared herself to a chameleon, alluding to her double-faced nature that hides her true look to blend with the background. She likes to stalk Amatsuyu, as she stated that it'll be the most likely thing for her to do first thing in the morning. She's a morning person. She likes Western Food. Her favorite season is Spring. She hates eating konyaku and she also hates cars.

characters.name: Aoi Hinata
characters.description: Aoi Hinata is a second year high school student and is also the ace of the school's Tennis Club.

characters.name: Amatsuyu Kisaragi
characters.description: Amatsuyu Kisaragi, nicknamed Joro (如雨露 Jōro )is a second year High School student and the Student Council secretary (being replaced during the Confession Arc) who is the object of affection of [Sumireko Sanshokuin](https://anilist.co/character/138897), [Sakura Akino](https://anilist.co/character/138899), [Aoi Hinata](https://anilist.co/character/138898), [Asaka Mayama](https://anilist.co/character/152047) and [Hina Hanetachi](https://anilist.co/character/149583).

characters.name: Sakura Akino
characters.description: Sakura Akino is a third-year high school student and the Student Council President who is in love with [Taiyo Oga](https://anilist.co/character/138901).

characters.name: Taiyou Ooga
characters.description: Taiyou Ooga is a second year High School student and the ace of the school Baseball Club. He is in love with Sumireko Sanshokuin and was once the target of affection of Aoi Hinata and Sakura Akino.

characters.name: Chiharu Youki
characters.description: Youki Chiharu is the newest transfer student in [Amatsuyu Kisaragi](https://anilist.co/character/138900)'s class. Her nickname, Tsubaki, is derived from the combination of the second character of her given name (春) and surname (木), resulting in (椿) which is the Japanese name for _Toona sinensis_  or Chinese Mahogany flower. She declared an unwavering love and loyalty to Kisaragi on her first day of transferring, which irritates some of the previous heroine present in the class. She promised Amatsuyu that she'll become a girl that will love him "unconditionally, gentle and will do anything for him" while kissing his hand, making a dramatic spectacle for the class to see.

characters.name: Luna Kusami
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Momo Sakurabara
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Fatla
