characters.description: Wields shikigami that follow her around and call her ojou-sama. She needs element to survive, it has not fully been stated what exactly she is. But she has said to herself that she can't leave the tenbi area because the element doesn't flow as fully elsewhere.    !Which is why she went out to get a stone full of element so she could travel to the training grounds for the summer vacation.   She stated that Takeru Ohyama is her mortal enemy after she saw the mark on his chest. Although its has yet to be confirmed if she still feels that way as she has kissed him on a few occasions leaving the cast a bit bewildered and annoyed. She can give her shikigami life and bring them into the real world so everyone can see them, giving them a human body in which they can fight with. It is hinted that she has a weakness for cute things, specifically rare and inexpensive stuff animal toys when she forgave the Finians when they tricked her because if she forgave them, she can have the rare king penguin stoffed toy. She is also deathly afraid of ghosts and other supernatural beings. Even becoming scared of a scary story that the story-teller openly admit that he made up the half rest of the story.!  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Inaho Kushiya
characters.description: Self proclaimed fiancée of Takeru Ooyama. She feels strongly for Takeru Ooyama, and although he doesn't remember her much she has decided to wait until he fully does.     Her maken, "Kamudo", takes the shape of a gauntlet that when brandished, greatly increases her strength and speed as demonstrated in chapter 7 when she used it to protect Takeru and the cat (later named Monji) he had saved by breaking a huge rock falling on them and then rushing in front of them to deflect the broken fragments. However, overusing it puts enough stress on her to knock her unconscious.

characters.name: Kimi Satou
characters.description: She is the secretary of the student council as well as a member of the disciplinary committee. She seems to enjoy Yaoi manga. Her maken is called "Comic Star" which allows her to alter the state of physical objects and allows her to use her imagination to project special effects from Manga into reality.

characters.name: Minori Rokujo
characters.description: Ditzy tomboyish principal of Tenbi Academy. She is the one that allowed Takeru, Haruno, Inaho, and Himegami to all live under the same roof. She brandishes incredible power and control over Element as she was able to break through amazingly powerful barriers with her bare hands, thanks to nothing more than her self-proclaimed "fighting spirit". She was in the Maken-Ki of the school before it became an all-girl's school.

characters.name: Aki Nijou
characters.description: The school nurse. She is also the staff-advisor (sort of a "teacher overseer") of Maken-Ki. She was in the Maken-Ki of the school before it became an all-girl's school. She has absurdly huge breasts, possibly the largest of the cast, which attracts the attention of all male students and the envy of girls around her.

characters.name: Chacha Akaza
characters.description: A 2nd year student at Tenbi Academy and a member of the disciplinary committee. Her maken is called "Maken Scale Compressor" which allows her to alter the volume and mass of inanimate objects.

characters.name: Furan Takaki
characters.description: Furan Takaki is the President of the Student Council Security Division and a senior at Tenbi Academy. She is strict regarding school rules and especially strict towards men, having androphobia due to trauma she experienced in the past. Her Maken is Habaya, a bow that shoots arrows of light - she normally wears her hair in braids and wears glasses, but both come off when she uses it.

characters.name: Azuki Shinatsu
characters.description: She is one of the four students to be selected to show how to duel on the first day. She uses air magic, which she uses shoes to allow her to be in mid-flight. Also she is a member of the Maken-ki club which calms down disturbances in the co-ed school.

characters.name: Upa
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Chen Wei
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Alice
characters.description: Alice is an Alamos Town local who works part time as a hot-air balloon tour guide. She is able to calm any Pokémon by playing a song using a leaf whistle, playing a version of "Oración", which was taught to her by her grandmother. She continues to study music and regularly visits Godey's garden to play to the wild Pokémon.

characters.name: Tonio
characters.description: Tonio is the great-grandson of the great architect Godey. A resident of Alamos Town, he has taken up the responsibility of investigating the strange occurrences in the space-time rift. He has a crush on Alice, another resident of Alamos Town, who believes that Tonio saved her after she fell off a high ledge.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

characters.name: Ashram
characters.description: Known as the "Black Knight", Ashram is a highly skilled warrior and the former retainer and right-hand aide of Emperor Beld. He served Beld during the War of Heroes, and was sent in the front to deal with any possible resistance.

characters.name: Wagnard
characters.description: Emperor Beld had placed trust in Wagnard, the powerful wizard of dark magic; however, was this trust ill-placed?  However others may see him, Wagnard has but one true master: the Goddess of Destruction, Kardis. He knows what is necessary to revive Kardis and gain dominion over Lodoss once and for all. First, he must retrieve the Scepter of Domination from the dragon Shooting Star. For this, Wagnard convinced Ashram to retrieve it for his own glory. Second, he must sacrifice a High Elf, and he sends the Dark Elf Pirotess to find probably the most suitable High Elf he can think of: Deedlit!  Wagnard's allies ultimately retrieve the Scepter of Domination, stealing it from Ashram, and he realizes that Kardis is stirring even now. With the Scepter, Wagnard intends to control the Goddess of Destruction and become a god himself. Wagnard uses his increased power to reach Deedlit, the key to Kardis' full resurrection

characters.name: Deedlit
characters.description: Deedlit is a High Elf from the Faery Realm. She has a great appreciation for nature, and her magic always exhibits elemental forces, such as wind and water. She also wields a thin elven sword. She can be incredibly fast and can match the attacks of dark elves like Pirotess.  Despite her occasional haughtiness (especially to Ghim), Deedlit is quite knowledgeable, always cautioning her comrades of potential dangers. She also has a fascination with and affection for Parn, and it greatly frustrates her when he doesn't seem to return her attention. Throughout the ambiguous development of their relationship she remains loyal to him and stays by his side regardless.  As a High Elf, Deedlit possesses eternal life, making her a target for the dark wizard Wagnard, who requires a High Elf sacrifice to complete the ritual to revive the goddess of darkness, Kardis.

characters.name: Karla
characters.description: Karla, the Grey Witch, is an ambiguous character responsible for shaping the history of the accursed island of Lodoss. She is the only survivor of an ancient Magic Kingdom and has lived for more than 500 years. Her physical self has perished long ago, but her soul (embedded in a golden circlet) possesses a human host from time to time so that she can have a body. After the fall of the Magic Kingdom she believes the only way for Lodoss not to be destroyed is to keep a balance between peace and chaos. So when there is war, she creates peace; when there is peace, she provokes war. Karla claims that in this way Lodoss will never collapse. For these years she has been changing her hosts, watching and manipulating the history of Lodoss.   !In the era that we encounter in RLW, Karla seems to be siding with Beld (the Marmo king) and Ashram. Therefore, she is considered to be evil by Parn and his partners. However, she actually does not care which side will win as long as there is not too much peace or too much chaos. She has first started wars by helping Beld; now she offers to help Parn and his comrades to create peace. Finally, peace is brought to Lodoss and Karla disappears but she will be back when the balance of history becomes tilted again...!  (Source: oocities.org)

characters.name: Leylia
characters.description: Leylia had cared for Ghim after he had been seriously injured. She and Ghim had grown to be quite close...until a dark force came from out of nowhere and snatched Leylia away.  The Leylia Ghim sees next is not Leylia but rather the vessel of Karla. Ghim is outraged, but he becomes convinced that he can free Leylia from the ghost. He would ulitmately give his life to free hers.  Upon her return with Slayn, Leylia then discovers that the crisis is not yet over, and she sets out with Slayn to help. She wishes to atone for the evils she committed while Karla possessed her. At the same time, she appreciates Slayn's company. As they cross Flaim, she and Slayn are stunned by a stunning flash of light. Deedlit had guided them to him so that he may be saved.  When Leylia realizes that Deedlit had been taken away, she realized what Wagnard is planning, for only the power of an eternal High Elf can revive Kardis

characters.name: Shiris
characters.description: After the War of Heroes, Shiris and her partner Orson found themselves without work, which really irritated them. Then, when they discover Parn, Woodchuck, Etoh, and Deedlit riding toward a quiet village, they took them to be Marmo soldiers and attacked. Only after Deedlit points out the obvious and Parn disarms her does Shiris relent. She soon realizes her mistake. She and Orson will eventually come to Parn and Deedlit's aid since she knows full well the fury her Berserker partner can unleash.  Shiris tries not to show her feelings for Parn, and she hates it when Orson talks to her about it. They normally would just go about their business, but the darkness makes her realize the terrible danger. She changes her mind and comes to Parn's side once more, and as Parn rides to his destiny, she and Orson ride out with a mission of their own.

characters.name: Parn
characters.description: Parn grew up in a more or less peaceful village, with the only real concern being a nearby goblin tribe. As a child, he was ostracised by the others, because his father had a black mark against his name (although the details are never discussed), and was killed in a war with the country of Flaim before his name could be restored.  Growing up, Parn idolized his father, remembering him as a great man, despite what the others had to say about him and knowing him only as a man of honor. Never knowing the circumstances of his father's fall from grace, he knew his father only as a kind and gentle man with a warrior's spirit.  Parn had a best friend by the name of Etoh, who left the village to become a priest of Falis, the Supreme God, a couple of years before the story begins. He was also a good friend with the mayor's daughter, and may have even been childhood sweethearts with her, although this is only implied.

characters.name: Kashue
characters.description: King Kashue, the Mercenary King, had gained his name by uniting the desert kingdoms with his sword. Now the king of the unified Kingdom of Flaim, he comes to King Fahn's aid in the war against Marmo.  Soon after the war ended, activity began to stir at Fire Dragon Mountain. Shooting Star has awakened! He sets out there with his men to attempt to stop the ancient dragon.  Parn has always had a fondness for the Mercenary King, but Kashue did not become a king for nothing. He refuses Parn's help at first because of his recklessness, but he realizes that without another path to take, Parn would follow him anyway (such as when he followed Kashue to Fire Dragon Mountain). And then, he learns of the rising darkness on Marmo, and King Kashue sees what must be done. He sends the call out to all kingdoms of Lodoss to rise up and face the rising forces of Marmo in one final battle, and the scope is enormous. Even the ancient dragons Narse and Mycin will clash.

characters.name: Pirotessa  Merestianna
characters.description: She is among the best of the dark elves, a figure of graceful beauty and deadly skill. Only two have been known to match Pirotess' abilities: Deedlit, a High Elf, and Ashram, whose own skill goes beyond what would normally be possible for a human.  Pirotess and Deedlit will ultimately meet face to face as Wagnard orders Pirotess to capture the High Elf to use as the sacrifice to revive Kardis. Alone, the odds may have been even, but Pirotess had brought some help. But even Pirotess has to be cautious when Shiris and Orson join Parn. Even Dark Elves fear the Berserkers of Hyuri.  Pirotess is loyal to Ashram and will seldom leave his side. Even upon orders from Wagnard to capture Deedlit, when she finds that she cannot, she joins Ashram at Fire Dragon Mountain instead of returning to Marmo. She realizes the sheer power Shooting Star possessess, and she dedicates herself to protecting Ashram, even if it means her own life in the process.

characters.name: Saji Crossroad
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Ribbons Almark
characters.description: A mysterious boy assisting Alejandro Corner. He, like Tieria and Nena, seems to also be able to interface with Veda, his eyes glowing with a rainbow-ish, digital hue when he does so.     After the end of season 1,  !He has now taken control of Veda and now has plans for the world he Envisions with Innovator.!

characters.name: Lockon Stratos
characters.description: Aliases: Lockon Stratos, Neil Dylandy (season 1 real name), Lyle Dylandy (season 2 real name), Gene-1 (his Kataron code name)   Nationality:[/b] Irish   Allegiance: Celestial Being / Kataron   Rank: Gundam Meister   Mobile Weapon: GN-006 Cherudim Gundam     Known relatives:  Lindsay Dylandy (Mother; Deceased)  Owen Dylandy (Father; Deceased)  Amy Dylandy (Younger sister, Deceased)     !Neil Dylandy (Twin brother, Former Gundam Meister, Deceased)!    First introduced breifly in episode 9 of the first season.     A member of Kataron/Cataron invited to join Celestial Being be Setsuna under the code name of Lockon Stratos.  The previous Lockon Stratos was Neil Dylandy, his twin brother.  Though he says he has no exerience with mobile suits, it seems he knows much more than he says he knows. In episode 3, he is told that he only needs to distract the enemy A-Laws, but he ends up shooting a couple units down. (even going as far as to snipe the head off of one)    He seems to be passing information from Celestial Being along to the Kataron resistance group.

characters.description: Height: 155 cm

characters.name: Oshtor
characters.description: The Imperial General of the Right. One of the Twin Shields of Yamato, along with Mikazuchi. His face is always covered by a mask. He is skilled in both the arts of war and peace, earning him the trust of both the people and the emperor.  Oshtor came from a low-ranking family that was noble only in name. Wanting to become a soldier like his father, he left his hometown and became a rank-and-file guard. He intended to return home after rising through the ranks, but instead was promoted to the Imperial Guard of the Right after his deeds caught the Mikado's attention.  !In order to interact with the citizenry in ways that his high station made difficult, he often assumed a disguise and the alias Ukon, concealing his true identity.!  !Oshtor possessed a strong sense of justice. According to Nekone, he didn't trust people easily, but he immediately recognized the talent of Haku and Kuon and took a liking to the pair. He was firmly loyal to Yamato, willing to be executed for a crime of which he was innocent if it would maintain the peace of the realm.!  !Afraid that Oshtor would lose his life to Vurai, Nekone tries to help him, however his intervention deviates Oshtor's attack from Vurai. Haku tries to protect Nekone from Vurai but Oshtor sacrifices his life, saving Haku and Nekone. After defeating Vurai, Oshtor entrusts Nekone and Anju to Haku, therefore passing the Akuruka to him, with Haku now taking up Oshtor's mantle.!

characters.name: Atuy
characters.description: A cheerful, fearless girl eternally in search of true love. Her temperament vacillates between bubbly and — when a spear is put into her capable hands — violently fearsome, and her pet Kurarin, a jellyfish-like creature, can often be found perched atop her head like a hat. She speaks with a refined, albeit provincial accent. She is the daughter of the Eight Pillar General, Soyankekur the Mariner, and is the princess of Shayhoro. Living her entire life with the sea, her name itself is a homage to the goddess worshipped by Shayhoro's sailor, Atuykarounkami who is said to be a fierce and kind Goddess that protects the sailor who also had bad luck with men, as every man she set her eyes upon met a tragic death, or so the tales said.

characters.name: Kuon
characters.description: A traveler hailing from land faraway from Yamato. A herbalist by trade, she is the one who saved Haku from the gigantic monstrosity. She styled herself as "Haku's guardian", taking upon herself the responsibility of caring for Haku until she deems that he can stand on his own. She is shown to harbor a great interest in ancient ruins and has the nobility air around her as some would say.  !She is the Princess of Tuskur. Originally, she was to be sent to Yamato as a diplomatic representative of their kingdom but she decided to run away from her homeland and is now wandering the land of Yamato as the "plain traveler Kuon"!  !She is the biological daughter of Hakuowlo and Yuzuha, Tuskur's first owlo and the lawful half of the mortal form of the God-like being known as Uitsulnemetia. She carries in her blood the power of Primal Origin, the source of great power, due to her father's nature.!

characters.name: Nekone
characters.description: Ukon's younger sister, hailing from the land of Ennakamuy, a genius scholar widely considered to be a child prodigy, having passed the extremely rigorous imperial exam at a younger age than anyone before her, earning her the title of "Scholar of Philosophy". Even so, she is not made an official scholar due to her young age. While she speaks in an overly rigid, formal manner to seem more mature than she really is, she's known to be fond of sweets and intensely attached to her elder sibling. Her area of specialty is the study of ancient civilizations. She and her brother is considered a noble, albeit a fallen one and so she knew the etiquette to nobility.

characters.name: Haku
characters.description: Finding himself collapsed in the middle of nowhere with barely any clothes on his back, he was rescued by Kuon and given a name. Having lost his memories: his real identity is a mystery. Neither hard-working nor earnest, his quick thinking is this young man's biggest asset. His complete lack of physical strength greatly worries Kuon.  !After multiples conversation with "Mito", he learned he's Mikado's brother the "father" of Yamato. In his earlier life he was a smart hacker, and it's because of his hacking of the database of the "iceman project" the mikado was able to create Akuruturuka for example. Haku was also one of the last humankind's suvivor with his brother after the great calamity that turned every human into Tartari. Before the beginning of the story he's voluntary to become a subject experience for a experience to immunize to Tartari's curse and he was put under cryogenization. He's also the uncle of Anju who is the clone of his deceased niece.!  !During the climax of Itsuwari no Kamen, he searches for Nekone after she flees, because she was afraid her brother would lose his life in front of Vurai. Oshtor has an advantage and Nekone tries to help him, however his intervention deviates Oshtor's attack from Vurai. Haku tries to protect Nekone from Vurai but Oshtor sacrifices his life, saving Haku and Nekone. Oshtor's soul finally found peace, leaving Haku entrusted with his sister and the princess. For the sake of his friends, and to fulfill his promise, Haku casts aside the name he was given and inherit his fallen friend's mask, choosing to live on as Oshtor.!

characters.name: Rulutieh
characters.description: The youngest princess of Kujyuri, one of several countries that comprise the great empire of Yamato. While delicate and cripplingly shy, she is nonetheless charming, graceful, and down-to-earth. When Haku and his companions encounter her, she is accompanying her nation's tribute to the Mikado on its way to the Imperial Capital. Cares deeply for her pet hororon bird, Cocopo.

characters.name: Nosuri
characters.description: A self-professed "noble thief" and the vivacious, buxom leader of a band of Robin Hood-style outlaws she named after herself, the Nosuri Thieves. She has a penchant for the dramatic, and her younger brother Ougi can eternally be found at her side, facilitating her grandiose schemes. Hailing from the clan of an honor-bound warrior, Evenkuruga, she is a stalwart character with a strong sense of justice, a trait most notable in the Evenkurugan society. She was later hired alongside her younger brother as Oshtor's agent acting under Haku's command in exchange for erasing their past crimes. Her lifelong goal is to restore her fallen house's honor.

characters.name: Ukon
characters.description: A traveler and mercenary captain Haku and Kuon encounter in a remote Kujyuri village. While rough around the edges and a little boisterous, he commands immense respect from his men and is currently contracted to escort a caravan of offerings to the Imperial Capital.  !The persona Ukon himself is a guise created by Oshtor to remain incognito where his Imperial Guard title can't reach or should never mingle with. As Oshtor deals with matters concerning state security and military affairs, Ukon deals with matters that requires subtlety and discretion.!

characters.name: Kiwru
characters.description: An amiable young prince of Ennakamuy, another nation within Yamato. Though meek, small in stature, and often painfully naïve, he applies himself tirelessly to his combat practice and aspirations of greatness. Shares an oath of sworn brotherhood with Oshtor.

characters.name: Ougi
characters.description: Nosuri's devoted younger brother and her right-hand man in leading the Nosuri Thieves. Remarkably polite, efficient, and cunning. He is skilled in infiltration, intelligence-gathering, and psychological warfare. He is also an Evenkurugan, like her sister. He is also quite the sharp young man, able to notice the changes in his surrounding quite perceptively. He is able to mask his presence to the point that he seems to appear out of nowhere to many people.

characters.name: Syueron
characters.description: **Height:** 191 cm  Syueron is a human from Hole and he was the former owner of the shop that became the Hungry Bug. At his shop, Syueron sold tea and desserts that were very popular with magic users and thus he became a target of the Magic-User haters of Hole.

characters.name: Gyouza Otoko
characters.description: He is The Gyoza Fairy, currently residing in this restaurant called "Hungry Bug". His body is made of raw gyoza, he is as large as a beer can, but he is invisible to humans. His job is to make gyoza taste delicious. He does things like cooling the beer with pure willpower or putting in some chili oil for those who forgot to. However! He has no mercy for wretches who make light of gyoza!

characters.name: Jack Walker
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Manaphy
characters.description: Manaphy is a small, blue, aquatic Pokémon with stubby feet and club-like arms that are longer than its body. It has a red gem on its chest and a yellow dot below the gem. Its onion-shaped head has a pair of long blue antennae, which have small spheres on the ends. Its irises are dark blue with yellow sclerae, and there are two yellow dots of "eyelash" markings extending from the eyes.  Eighty percent of Manaphy's body is made of water. It is highly susceptible to its environment and swims long distances to return to its birthplace. It is born with a special power that allows it to bond with any Pokémon. Manaphy can switch the perspective of people, and Pokémon, with each other using its former signature move, Heart Swap.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

characters.name: Seijuurou Hiko
characters.description: The thirteenth successor to the sword art of Hiten Mitsurugi-Ryu, Hiko Seijuro saved young Shinta from marauding bandits who killed his companions. Hiko then took care of Shinta, and renamed him Kenshin ("Heart of Sword") after claiming that Shinta was not a good name for a swordsman. He became angry and disappointed with Kenshin, because he ran away to join the rebellion against the Tokugawa regime. He shut himself away from the rest of the world; he lives as a potter close to the forest near Kyoto. In Seisouhen/Reflection, he also realizes that the Hiten Mitsurugi-Ryu no longer seems relevant in the changing world, as he remarks to Yahiko: "The only thing that doesn't seem to change is the moon."  Hiko is perhaps the strongest swordsman around; he is way too superior even to Kenshin. Although the two are comparable in speed, Hiko possesses a superior sense of judgement in combat and the superhuman strength (hidden, and even suppressed, underneath his heavy cloak) to wield Hiten Mitsurugi Ryu to its maximum. After fifteen years, master and student meet once more. It is then that Kenshin will complete his training, if Kenshin can survive Hiko's ego.  The cloak is not only distinctive for all Hiten Mitsurugi masters, but it also serves to strengthen them in peacetime. Even when conflict is not at the door, Hiko remains in training just by wearing it, as it is composed of several heavy materials that weigh him down and force him to work out because of counter-springs with pressure of around 37.5 kilograms. Watsuki mentions in the manga that he based the billowy capes' image on Spawn of Image Comics by Todd McFarlane (the size of the collar pieces was reduced in the anime).  The name Hiko Seijuro is in fact a title granted to each succeeding master of Hiten Mitsurugi-Ryu. Since Hiko Seijuro II, each new master has discarded his own name in favor of the name of the creator of Hiten Mitsurugi-Ryu. As Kenshin declines to take the name "Hiko Seijuro XIV", his master is the last man ever to be known as Hiko Seijuro.

characters.name: Konohamaru Sarutobi
characters.description: Konohamaru named after the village he lives in: Konoha, is the grandson of the Third Hokage and by extension the nephew of Asuma Sarutobi. Konohamaru usually hangs out with his two friends, Udon and Moegi. Together, they call themselves the "Konohamaru Corps" ("Konohamaru Ninja Squad" in the English dub).   In Part II they are teamed together under the leadership of Ebisu, Konohamaru's former tutor.  At the start of the series, Konohamaru feels unacknowledged due to his status as the Hokage's grandson. As such, he frequently attempts to defeat his grandfather in battle so that he can become Hokage himself and earn the recognition he desires. Once meeting Naruto Uzumaki, Konohamaru realizes that he can't become Hokage by simply attacking his grandfather and will need to train hard to accomplish this goal.

characters.name: Butler Hakushaku
characters.description: Count Butler is the main antagonist of the third movie. He claims to be a genius zoologist, but in reality, he is actually a poacher searching for the Crowning Treasure horns on Crown Island. He is assisted by Hotdog and Heaby.  (Source: One Piece wiki)

characters.name: Mobambi
characters.description: Mobambi is a character that appears in the third movie, and is currently the king of Crown Island. Before he came to the island, he once wore a blue shirt and pants. He has red hair with a ponytail sticking up and a scar on his chest. He wears a beige loincloth. He also has on an armband and a locket with a picture of his father inside.  (Source: One Piece Fandom Wiki)

characters.name: Framboise Charle
characters.description: A reporter on Galette's side, his job is to take the role of the announcer during battle broadcasts, and he does that with passion.

characters.name: Cinque Izumi
characters.description: A 13-year-old half-Japanese, half-British Earthling summoned to the alternate world of Flonyado, the Kingdom of Biscotti Republic as Princess Millhiore's "Warrior". He wields the Divine Sword of Biscotti, Palladion, a weapon that can assume different forms depending of its owner (in Cinque's hands, it becomes a staff). He has a cheerful and straightforward personality, always going at his own pace. Athletic and acrobatic, he loves sports as well. Was a first-year middle school student in Japan's International School prior to the summon. He can fire destructive energy beams from the tip of Palladion. Seems to have feelings of attraction towards Millhiore.  Note: Official romanisation of "Cinque" was taken from New Type publication.

characters.name: Couvert Eschenbach Pastillage
characters.description: The First Princess of Pastillage who is still in-training as her country's next ruler. She has deep friendly relations with Millhiore and Leonmitchelli, and looks up to become a ruler like them.

characters.name: Millhiore Firianno Biscotti
characters.description: The 14-year-old Princess of Biscotti Republic, she has a gentle and hardworking personality. As the representative leader of the nation, she is loved by everyone in the nation. She is also a singer at the same time, holding events and concerts and appearing in person in front of everyone despite her status. She is also the one who summoned Cinque to Flonyard in the first place, by sending her dog familiar, Tatsumaki, to open up a portal on Earth while Cinque attempted to jump off from some heights in school (because of his love for circus acrobatic acts), and is the owner of one of Divine Swords pair, Excelide. Seems to have fallen for Cinque at first sight, but was unaware that a summoned hero can't return to his homeworld and only found about that when it was too late.

characters.name: Éclair Martinozzi
characters.description: A female Knight of Biscotti, as well as the captain of the Imperial Guards unit directly under Millhiore's command. Has been training as a knight since her childhood, she is proficient in dual-sword wielding. She bears great admiration towards Millhiore and holds her with utmost respect. She is always troubled by Cinque's "ignorance of the ways of the world", and has a very serious attitude, albeit stubborn. Plays the role of the straight man to Cinque's funny man. A running gag is that she has a complex about her ears, as they are smaller in size and drooping down as compared to other characters'. Tsundere towards Cinque. She can unleash shockwaves from her blade.

characters.name: Loran Martinozzi
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Leonmitchelli Galette des Rois
characters.description: Affectionately known as Leo-hime. She often says "call me Your Highness". Leader, as well as the Princess of Galette Lion Army, which is the enemy nation that aims to invade Biscotti. Despite that, Leo and Millhiore are childhood friends and are as close as sisters. A brave warrior, she uses heavy armor and weapons in battle. Has to carry the burden of living up to the expectations of the battle-loving people of Galette. She talks with a masculine tone, similar to that of an old man (frequently uses washi and jaa).

characters.name: Nanami Takatsuki
characters.description: Cinque's older cousin and an acquaintance to Becky. She is also Cinque's rival in the Iron Athletics (アイアンアスレチック Aian Asurechikku?), a game closely related to Ninja Warrior. In the second season, Nanami is summoned to Flonyard by Leonmitchelle to serve as a heroine under her, in the same fashion as Cinque is chosen as Milhiore's hero.

characters.name: Rebecca Anderson
characters.description: A 13-year-old Earthling who studies at Japan's International School, and also a friend of Cinque's. She has a busybody attitude, and is the one who understands Cinque the best. She goes to Cinque's house every morning to wake him up for school. Loves fashion, games, manga, and fantasy-themed novels. She was looking forward to a promise that she made with Cinque, that "her family (she and her mother) and Cinque's family (Cinque and his parents) would go flower viewing during the last three days of Spring Break". She loves Cinque.   !In S2 despite her lack of athletic abilities she was chosen by princess Couvert to serve as a heroine under her, in the same fashion as Cinque is chosen as Millhiore's.   Her large experience in FPS games makes her perfect as wizard-type hero.!

characters.name: Gaul Galette des Rois
characters.description: 13 years old. Leo's younger brother, as well as the Prince of Galette. A confident and powerful warrior of Galette, albeit hot-blooded. His battle style resembles Cinque's, making use of light armor and agile movements. Seems to connect to Cinque through battles, and views him as a rival. Fights honorably, like his sister. Directly under his command are General Godwin, Imperial Guard trio "Genoise", etc. A Prince that everyone of Galette adores.

characters.name: Iris
characters.description: Iris is the female protagonist in Pocket Monsters Best Wishes. Her main Pokémon is Kibago.She also has an Doryuzu that has been with her since it was a Mogurew as well as an Emonga.   She is a citizen of the Dragon Village who has been tasked by the village's elder to go on a journey with her Kibago to raise it to become a great Ononokus. After meeting up with Satoshi, she decides to join him on his journey through the Isshu region.

characters.name: Dent
characters.description: Dent is one of the three gym leaders of Striaton City. He is the brother of Pod and Corn, his fellow gym leaders. He is recognized as an A-rank Pokemon Sommelier, a person who has the ability to check the compatibility and closeness between a trainer and his/her Pokemon. After being defeated by Ash in a gym battle he decided to join Ash through his journey in the Unova Region. He is the group's navigator and cook.  Dent has a love for playing detective and trains. He enjoys solving mysteries with scientific explanations, and he is a huge fan of Nimbasa City's subway system. He dislikes the Pokemon Purrloin, saying he had a bad experience with one in the past, but refuses to talk about it.  Dent's vintage Pokemon is his Pansage. He has also acquired a Dwebble, which has evolved into a Crustle, and a Stunfisk while traveling.

characters.name: Adeku
characters.description: Alder is the champion of the Unova region. Alder made his debut in BW034 during a flashback of Trip's childhood. He was battling a Trainer in the middle of town with his Bouffalant as Trip spectated in awe. After the battle, the Champion approached the child and allowed him to pet and feed Bouffalant. He then inspired Trip to train hard when he got older, and the two shook hands.

characters.name: Meloetta
characters.description: Meloetta has a femininely anthropomorphic figure with musical bar-style streaks in its hair, quarter notes for its arms and hands and pupil-less eyes resembling whole notes. It has a jewel on its forehead and a black headpiece that seems to be shaped like a treble clef which doubles as an attached microphone such as one often used by singers. Its ovular head seems to be a third of its body's height and about half its height in width. In its Aria Forme, it has light blue eyes and flowing, wavy hair with light-blue ovals that resemble whole notes. In its Pirouette Forme, it has auburn hair that seems to be stylized in a high bun and red eyes. In either Forme, its midriff and eyes match its hair.  (Source: Bulbapedia)

characters.name: Si Xu
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Lingyu Zhang
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Shayan Feng
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Chulan  Zhang
characters.description: Height: 180 cm  He seems lazy but easy-going, complains, is actually meticulous, and has a heart far beyond others. Sometimes he even makes some "shameless" behaviours to achieve his own goals, so he is nicknamed "Don't Shake Bilian", a Chinese Slang for Shameless but he himself doesn't care and accepts it happily. He has a changeable personality and seems to be a contradictory individual. He has tried his best to trace Feng Baobao's life and protect her. He once said in his heart that it doesn't matter whether others like him or not. As long as he likes Sister Baoer, it's enough. He is a person who has more rational elements than emotional elements.

characters.name: Baobao Feng
characters.description: Abilities: Martial arts

characters.name: Xingtong Feng
characters.description: Fourth child of the Feng family.

characters.name: San Xu
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Ye Wang
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Qing Zhuge
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Shifune Tsuzuki
characters.description: The owner of the Live House SPACE where the band Glitter*Green often performs. She is quite strict and has a no-nonsense personality and very high standards when it comes to music. The cast always referred to her as "Owner" instead of her real name.  Shifune was a member of a nationally renowned band that had live tours. To dispel the image that "livehouses are scary", she launched the livehouse SPACE where anyone was able to perform. However, after a band did not finish their performance she began to hold auditions to determine if a band is suitable to stand on the SPACE stage.  (Source: BanG Dream! Wikia)

characters.name: Noah's Ark
characters.description: Child prodigy Hiroki Sawada who—by the age of ten—is already a MIT grad student and has developed a DNA Tracker software. He has been under the guardianship of Thomas Schindler, owner of the software giant Schindler, Inc., since his mother died. One night, in a heavily guarded room at the top of the Schindler building where Hiroki lives, he finishes an artificial intelligence system, Noah's Ark, and sends the software through the telephone lines. The guards become suspicious and try to enter his room. They discover that Hiroki leapt off the building to his death.

characters.name: Tamiko Shinshi
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Shigeki Arakawa
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Enishi Yukishiro
characters.description: When Enishi was an infant, his mother died and he was raised by his older sister, Tomoe. She raised him herself, becoming both sister and mother to him, and he grew to love her quite dearly. When Tomoe became engaged to Kiyosato Akira, Enishi reluctantly accepted him because Kiyosato truly made Tomoe happy and she loved him. Kiyosato later joined the Mimawarigumi believing that the sombre Tomoe would be happy if he became a hero, only to be killed by Hitokiri Battōsai (Himura Kenshin) for the new era. Tomoe left her brother behind to seek revenge, working with spies from the Shogunate to do so. Enishi became consumed by his loneliness to bring her back to Edo (now Tokyo) so they could be together.   When he was about ten, Enishi ran away from Edo, disappearing for seven months. He discovered the location of Tomoe through the Shogun agency and soon appeared before her, revealing that he was the Shogun agency's contact sent to Tomoe. While he believed that he was helping Tomoe's revenge, he did not know Tomoe had grown to love Kenshin, despite the fact he killed Kiyosato. She sent him away, hoping to protect Kenshin, leaving her brother angry and confused by her actions. After witnessing Kenshin's accidental killing of Tomoe, his hair turned snow white from the stress and grief of losing her. Enishi became more unstable and swore Jinchū (Man's Punishment) to be brought down on Kenshin's head for destroying his sister's happiness and then killing her. He disappeared to China, where he is taken in by a kind and wealthy family after suffering months of hardship in the wilderness. He later killed them all and took their money, unable to bear seeing how happy they were.      In 1878, he returned to Japan after becoming a powerful overlord in the Chinese underworld (almost forgetting to how to speak Japanese in the process) and began his Jinchū campaign with his "comrades".    (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Aritomo Yamagata
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Reiko Akiba
characters.description: Reiko is a great soprano who, in the movie, sings several songs like Amazing Grace or Ave Maria.

characters.name: Karl Gustav Kempff
characters.description: Karl Gustav Kempff was an admiral of the Galactic Empire.

characters.name: Aki
characters.description: The loader and gunner of Jatkosota High School's BT-42

characters.name: Klara
characters.description: A member of the Pravda High School team. She often speaks Russian in front of [Katyusha](https://anilist.co/character/72663/Katyusha) who cannot understand what she is saying.

characters.name: Spark
characters.description: Spark is a young man who wants to be a knight, but he is unable to because he made a bad decision once and tried to take on some of the dark elves by himself rather than going to get help. Because of this King Kashue feels he is not ready to become a knight yet, but he respects Spark so he lets him lead a band of merceneries in hope of trying to stop Wagnard the evil wizard from resurrecting Kardis, the Goddess of Destruction. Although Spark is young, he is very brave and determined. Along the way to find Wagnard, he falls in love with Neese, the daughter of Slayn and Leilia. Unfortunately it is little Neese's destiny to be sacrificed in order for Kardis to come back. Now Spark is more determined than ever to win back the girl he loves. Well, that's all I'll say since I don't want to spoil anything for anyone!

characters.name: Leaf
characters.description: half/elf mercenary recruited to help Spark Her father was an elf and her mother was a human. half elves are also granted the powers of Shaman

characters.name: Daigo Shigeno
characters.description: [Goro](https://anilist.co/character/467) and [Kaoru](https://anilist.co/character/10835)'s son. [Izumi](https://anilist.co/character/40441)'s younger brother. Daigo had always dreamed of becoming a great baseball player just like his father and retired major leaguer, Goro Shigeno. He eventually joined the Mifune Dolphins, only to be despaired by the results of his mediocre progress.   Feeling unable to reach heights just like his father, Daigo gives up on baseball entirely with no motivation or goal in his life. Two years later, a new transfer student from America arrives and the crossroads of destiny begins to turn again for Daigo.

characters.name: Izumi Shigeno
characters.description: ![Goro's](https://anilist.co/character/467) and [Kaoru's](https://anilist.co/character/10835) daughter. [Daigo's](https://anilist.co/character/40457/Daigo-Shigeno) older sister.!

characters.name: Mahoro Andou
characters.description: Mahoro is the Vesper android that has only a year left to live. She decides to become a maid, and work for Suguru Misato. She loves to cook, clean, and even take baths with Suguru. She also has a strong sense of morality and when she finds an ecchi magazine in Suguru's room, she'll confiscate it.

characters.name: Suguru Misato
characters.description: Suguru is a lonely boy, that decides to hire Mahoro to keep his unruly house in order. He's usually quiet, and nervous. He's afraid of standing up for himself, but after meeting Mahoro he learns how to become more confident about himself.

characters.name: Minawa Ando
characters.description: Minawa is a clutzy Cyborg from the Management forces. She runs away from them to prevent her from being scrapped like her best friend CODE:369. When she is found by Mahoro and Suguru, she is taken in and given the name Minawa, taking the role of Mahoro's little sister.

characters.name: Toshiya Hamaguchi
characters.description: Hamaguchi is the more excitable and vocal of Suguru’s male friends. He also has the tendency to speak before even thinking. Hamaguchi also gets help with his homework from Suguru. And when Mahoro isn’t around, Suguru allows Hamaguchi to read from Suguru’s “secret stash”.

characters.name: Miyuki Sakura
characters.description: Miyuki is one of Suguru's childhood friends. She helps her parents run a public bath house. Acting like a tomboy most of the time, she has some attraction to Suguru.

characters.name: Rin Todoroki
characters.description: Rin is one of Suguru's friends. She hangs out with Miyuki and Chizuko most of the time, and proves herself as the most mature one of the group, not just in personality but in body as well.

characters.name: Kiyomi Kawahara
characters.description: Kawahara is the more mature of Suguru’s male friends. He is less out-spoken than Hamaguchi and acts as a foil to Hamaguchi’s outbursts. Kawahara also takes Kendo class and admires Suguru’s fortitude knowing that his parents have passed away.

characters.name: Chizuko Ooe
characters.description: Chizuko is another of Suguru's friends. She loves eating and she likes to taste everyone of Mahoro's foods. She also tries to sell Ecchi magazines to Suguru (since her father is in the buisness of making them) but is always stopped by Mahoro.

characters.name: Saori Shikijou
characters.description: Saori is Suguru's math teacher. She oftenly thinks dirty thoughts of her and Suguru and wants to teach him how to become a real man. But as always is thwarted by Mahoro. She and Mahoro always have compentions among each other.

characters.name: Tsubaki Sawabe
characters.description: Tsubaki is Kousei's childhood friend and next-door neighbor, who treats him like a little brother. She is athletic and part of the softball club in school. Often dismayed at Kousei's inability to move on after his mother's death, she attempts to get him to play the piano again in order to make a clear decision about his future.

characters.name: Kaori Miyazono
characters.description: **Height:** 157 cm  Kaori is [Tsubaki's](https://anilist.co/character/69409) classmate, a free-spirited violinist who had drawn many criticisms from the judge panel due to her unwillingness to follow the score, but is highly favored by her audience. Kaori met [Kousei](https://anilist.co/character/69407) when she requested Tsubaki to set her up with [Watari](https://anilist.co/character/69405).

characters.name: Takeshi Aiza
characters.description: Takeshi is a pianist of the same year as Kousei, who aimed to surpass him since watching him play at a young age. For that, Takeshi would even abandon a competition in Europe in order to compete with Kousei.   (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Emi Igawa
characters.description: Emi is a pianist of the same year as Kousei, who decided to become a pianist after listening to Kousei play at the age of 5. Emi is very emotional and her piano performance often depends on her mood on that day.

characters.name: Saki Arima
characters.description: Saki is Kousei's strict mother who demands Kousei play the piano to perfection, often beating him up for small mistakes. While she did not plan to make Kousei a pianist at first, her realization of Kousei's talents and her own illness made her decide to give Kousei a strict foundation in piano in order to be able to find his own style, and a living, afterwards.

characters.name: Hiroko Seto
characters.description: Hiroko is a nationally famous pianist and Saki's friend during college days. She was the one who discovered Kousei's talents in piano and suggested Saki to make him a pianist.

characters.name: Nagi Aiza
characters.description: Nagi is Takeshi's little sister who pretended to ask for tutelage from Hiroko in order to scout her brother's rival, Kousei.

characters.name: Ryouta Watari
characters.description: Ryouta is Kousei and Tsubaki's childhood friend who is also the captain of the school's soccer team. He is extremely popular with girls, often adopting a frivolous attitude. However, he does once in a while come up with good insight.

characters.name: Kousei Arima
characters.description: Kousei is formerly a child prodigy in playing piano, often dubbed as the "Human Metronome". He was able to play the piano with extreme precision and discipline and thus had won many competitions across Japan.

characters.name: Momo Ayase
characters.description: After making friends with [Ken Takakura](https://anilist.co/character/222593), who she calls "Okarun" (due to refusing to call him by the same name as the actor she idolizes), Momo wishes to help restore his body back to normal after being cursed by a yokai and must overcome other paranormal activities that are involved.

characters.name: Ken Takakura
characters.description: He is a young male student with a firm belief that UFOs and aliens exist. Upon meeting [Momo Ayase](https://anilist.co/character/222594/Ayase-Momo) and taking up on her challenge to see if ghosts were real, Okarun became cursed by a yokai known as the [Turbo-Granny](https://anilist.co/character/239956/Turbo-Babaa) and seeks to return to normal.

characters.name: Seiko Ayase
characters.description: [Momo Ayase](https://anilist.co/character/222594/Ayase-Momo)'s grandmother. Despite being a grandmother, Seiko possesses a youthful appearance that does not match her age and is recognized as being quite beautiful.

characters.name: Jin Enjouji
characters.description: Jin Enjouji is [Momo Ayase](https://anilist.co/character/222594/Momo-Ayase)'s childhood friend and first crush. After his parents were hospitalized as a result of his house being haunted, Enjouji moved in with Momo and [Seiko](https://anilist.co/character/234824/Seiko-Ayase) and transferred over to Momo's school.   Jiji comes off as being a very hyper-active young man who likes to express himself with dramatic mannerisms and expressions. He also has a habit of usually ending his sentences with strange verbal tics and is known to be very athletic and enjoy sports, primarily soccer. Past his initial over-the-top presentation, Jiji is a good-natured guy who deeply values his friendships and is committed to protecting those close to him, striving to improve himself and act as a reliable ally in moments of danger. Despite his immaturity, Jiji demonstrates a strong sense of accountability and empathy.   !He later gets possessed by a mountain yokai called [the Evil Eye](https://anilist.co/character/309809/Jashi). Thus, whenever he touches cold water, Evil Eye comes out, and when he touches hot water, he is himself.!

characters.name: Hana
characters.description: Hana is an anthropomorphized anatomical model that resides with Ayase and Seiko.

characters.name: Tarou
characters.description: Taro is an anthropomorphized anatomical model that resides at Ayase's and Takakura's school.

characters.name: Penny Chinkosu
characters.description: Peeny-Weeny, also known as the Dover Demon, is a Dover Demon's Race, he works for the Serpo in order to earn money for [his son's](https://anilist.co/character/270706/) blood transfusion.

characters.name: Turbo Babaa
characters.description: The yokai took on the form of a very elderly woman with long white shaggy hair and eyes that were stuck looking to the sides. When possessing her targets, she has her victims transform into a mirror image of herself, albeit with a large mouth with teeth that is capable of biting off body parts.  !After having her consciousness extracted from [Okarun](https://anilist.co/character/222593/Takakura-Ken), the Turbo-Granny is forced to inhabit a maneki-neko doll.!

characters.name: Aira Shiratori
characters.description: Relatives: [Father](https://anilist.co/character/349655/Aira-no-Chichi)  After becoming aware of the existence of the supernatural after collecting a mysterious golden ball, Aira proclaims herself as the "chosen one" that is on a mission to protect the world from evil and directs her attention towards [Momo Ayase](https://anilist.co/character/222594/Momo-Ayase), believing that she is a demon that has to be stopped after seeing her use her psychic powers. Aira revels in her social status as the popular girl at Kami High and strives to maintain her reputation. Outwardly, she appears sweet, innocent, and somewhat air headed. However, internally, she is far more vain and prideful, a side she only shows to people she becomes close with. Whilst antagonistic towards Momo, she harbors feelings towards her close friend [Okarun](https://anilist.co/character/222593/Ken-Takakura).  !She later gains the powers of a powerful spirit named [Acrobatic Silky](https://anilist.co/character/245467/Acrobatic-Sarasara) and becomes allies / friends with Momo and Okarun, learning to be more mindful of her actions and being more open with her true self.!

characters.name: Itachi
characters.description: A bandit who betrayed Dororo's father Hibukuro and sided with the authorities.

characters.name: Mio
characters.description: Mio is a young girl who lived in an abandoned temple with orphans who lost their parents in the war. She is kind and caring as she tends to put others in priority instead of herself.

characters.name: Osushi Niki
characters.description: She is Tanosuke's younger sister and a girl who cares deeply for her brother. She begs Hyakkimaru to spare Tanosuke's life, but after her brother dies, she directs her resentment toward Hyakkimaru and drives him out of the village. In contrast, she bids Dororo a kind farewell, telling him to take care of himself.

characters.name: Biwamaru
characters.description: Biwamaru (sometimes Biwa Maru) is a blind, itinerant acupuncture doctor, who wanders around Japan curing all sorts of ailments with miraculous speed. He is extremely disheveled in appearance, dressed in rags and walking with a twisted stick as a cane, and a rough bundle on his back. Biwamaru is effective, like Black Jack, an unlicensed doctor, since his practices are considered to be quackery by the medical establishment, while Biwamaru considers it barbaric to cut open a patient to cure them. This, as with Dr. Kiriko, Biwamaru is another nemesis who is too similar to Black Jack for the two to forgive their differences. Biwamaru also features in Tezuka’s best-known samurai manga, Dororo.  !When Biwamaru came to Black Jack's town in issue #126 'The Blind Doctor of Acupuncture,' (6/7/1976) it was hatred at first sight, as each dismissed the other as a quack, though neither was able to deny the effectiveness of the other’s treatments. To make matters worse, Biwamaru charges nothing for his services, in contrast with Black Jack's outrageous fees, leading to criticism of Black Jack by the local community. Their interaction here effectively degenerated into each attempting repeatedly to prove that the other was a quack, and generally failing, though teaching each other bitter lessons about the limitations of their methods.  The two met again not long afterwards in issue #141, 'Death of Hyojisai' (The Master Forger, Two People at the Thermal Bath) when they met at a hot spring and discovered that both of them, out of dedication to their work, made regular pilgrimages to see the same world-famous master forger, who made scalpels for the one and needles for the other. On discovering that the forger was sick, the two compete to cure him, while the forger, Hyojisai, uses his own illness to teach the two that, skilled as they are, both are powerless in the face of fate. It is a bitter experience for both of them. The trailer for the upcoming Two Dark Doctors movie indicates that the film will include scenes from this issue.!  Notably, Biwamaru also appeared in Dororo as a blind musician and masters-swordsman. The crippled samurai Hyakkumaru, widely acknowledged as a prototype of Black Jack, encountered Biwamaru here and became his student in swordfighting, an interesting reversal of his role in Black Jack.

characters.name: Hyakkimaru
characters.description: Hyakkimaru is the central character of Tezuka's best-known samurai story, Dororo. A powerful warrior, Hyakkimaru is traveling on a long quest to retrieve 48 parts of his body which were sold to demons by his father at his birth. This is a very dramatic adventure series, with a great variety of unusual mythological creatures and demons, as well as bandits and other fierce foes. Gradually the grim experiences of his travels make Hyakkimaru more and more distant and grim, so as he recovers more and more of his human body he becomes at the same time less and less human.

characters.name: Dororo
characters.description: !Gender: Female!  After seeing his swordsmanship, Dororo decides to follow Hyakkimaru. Dororo was a thief before meeting Hyakkimaru.  !Dororo's bandit father Hibukuro was wounded by a samurai official and later died. Her mother froze to death while fleeing in the snow, but before she died she drew a map on Dororo's back to locate money hidden by her father at Bone Cape.  Hyakkimaru learns that Dororo is female with the latter continuously insisting she is a boy, though this is because her parents raised her as one.!

characters.name: Sukeroku
characters.description: He is the orphan that separates​ from his mother during the land split by the Banmon.

characters.name: Ojiya
characters.description: She is a bandit along with her husband, Hibukuro. She is the mother of Dororo.

characters.name: Hibukuro
characters.description: He is the leader of a bandit clan that is devoted into raiding samurai forts. He is the father of Dororo

characters.name: Makoto Takei
characters.description: He's the student council president of Kaibara Municipal High School at the start of the series.

characters.name: Collot
characters.description: English sheepdog who is part of the canine room 701 with Legoshi. He has a calm and friendly personality and is often seen offering rides to their smallest group member, Voss.

characters.name: Legoshi
characters.description: Height: 185 cm (debut), 187 cm (currently)  Our main character is the quiet and sensitive gray wolf Legoshi. Because of his fearsome appearance and odd habits he is widely mistaken to be a scary, bloodthirsty carnivore. Legoshi is wholly aware of this and does everything in his power to minimize himself and downplay his intimidating aspects. The series is largely about him coming to terms with his place in the world as a wolf.  Legoshi develops some complicated feelings for the rabbit [Haru](https://anilist.co/character/125169).  !He is a 1/4 komodo dragon, because of his grandfather [Gosha](https://anilist.co/character/132981).!

characters.name: Haru
characters.description: Species: Netherland dwarf rabbit  Haru is the lone member of Cherryton School's gardening club. She is earnest and forthright which, in addition to her sexual promiscuity, has earned her a sleazy reputation. Haru is broadly confident, but a defeatist side sometimes peeks through her facade. In spite of her caring nature she tends to keep people at an emotional distance.

characters.name: Louis
characters.description: Species: Red deer  The proud face of Cherryton's drama club. He has an enormous ego, but with acting skills like his this isn't surprising. He carries a number of personality complexes owing to his status as a deer, a species traditionally seen as carnivore fodder. While he has shown moments of genuine kindness he is also very emotionally manipulative.  Louis' greatest ambition is to achieve the rank of Beastar.  (Source: TV Tropes)

characters.name: Juno
characters.description: Species: Gray wolf  Juno is one of the five main characters of Beastars and is a member of the drama club on the actor team. A feminine, affable wolf, she wishes to become the next Beastar, competing against Louis.

characters.name: Gouhin
characters.description: A back alley psychiatrist who tries to rehabilitate carnivorous animals that crave meat. The wounds on his face were made by violent patients.   Despite his gruff appearance and rough character, he's gentle and caring.

characters.name: Jack
characters.description: Species: Labrador Retriever  Both one of [Legoshi](https://anilist.co/character/125168/Legoshi)'s roommates and his best friend for many years, Jack is a rather average guy. He is often weirded out by Legoshi's behavior, especially involving [Haru](https://anilist.co/character/125169/Haru), but he is always there for his best friend.

characters.name: Ibuki
characters.description: Occupation: Member of the Shishigumi  Ibuki is a Maasai lion in his mid-thirties with an athletic build. He has light golden-yellow fur, light brown mane, and sharp, slanted eyes with small black pupils. Ibuki has tattoos on the left side of his body from his time as a child going to be used for making hyperdrugs.

characters.name: Oguma
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Nimura Furuta
characters.description: Height: 175 cm !RC Type: Rinkaku!  !Kichimura Washuu is the primary antagonist of the Tokyo Ghoul series and the former Bureau Director of the CCG. He is involved in numerous organizations and is responsible for several major events of the series.!  !He was originally the illegitimate son of former CCG Chairman Tsuneyoshi Washuu and an agent of V raised in the Sunlit Garden.  To further his own agenda, he has used various identities to infiltrate organizations or build personal alliances. As a member of the Clowns, he was responsible for the Steel Beam Incident. He also joined the Ghoul Restaurant as PG, and has been a partner in Akihiro Kanou's ghoulification experiments. Like [Ken Kaneki](https://anilist.co/character/87275/Ken-Kaneki), he is an artificial one-eyed ghoul who possesses [Rize Kamishiro](https://anilist.co/character/88413/Rize-Kamishiro)'s kagune.!

characters.name: Yoshitoki Washuu
characters.description: Yoshitoki Washuu is the current Bureau Director of CCG's Main Office and Tsuneyoshi Washuu's son.

characters.name: Koutarou Amon
characters.description: Height: 191 cm (6'3")  A first class police investigator who investigates Ghouls, also known as a Dove. He comes to the 20th ward with his mentor, [Mado Kureo](https://anilist.co/character/88423), to investigate Ghoul incidents in the area. He has a strong sense of justice, fervently believing it is the right and moral thing to do to exterminate the Ghouls. He hunts the Ghouls in order to prevent more human children from becoming orphaned like himself, and he often works after hours to achieve his goals.  He wields a "Quinque" (a weapon made from the "Kagune" of a Ghoul) that has the appearance of a pole-arm with a large cylindrical bludgeon at the end.

characters.name: Juuzou Suzuya
characters.description: Height: 160 cm (5'3")  A Rank 3 Ghoul Investigator. In the past, he went by the name Rei Suzuya. He is the partner of [Yukinori Shinohara](https://anilist.co/character/88408). He is a young man with androgynous appearance. He has many stitches used as both first-aid and fashion. His hair is tied with a stitching string in a roman numeral 13 pattern, with large pupils that leaves an eerie and frightening impression.

characters.name: Uta
characters.description: Height: 177 cm  A ghoul that has his own art studio where he makes masks for other ghouls. He has a lot of piercings and tattoos on his body, making him look pretty intimidating, even as a normal-looking human. He's the one who also made a mask for Kaneki.

characters.name: Masae Kyan
characters.description: She is the mother of [Reki](https://anilist.co/character/195120/Reki-Kyan).

characters.name: Langa Hasegawa
characters.description: Height: 178 cm (5'10") Talent: Snowboarding, Skateboarding  At first glance, Langa appears to be a very stoic young man, barely showing any emotions. But on the inside, he’s more complex and appears to be more confident.  Langa is a teenage boy with blue hair that grows past his ears and blue eyes. He is above average height as he’s taller than [Reki](https://anilist.co/character/195120/Reki-Kyan). Throughout the series, Langa wears the average high school uniform of black pants, a yellow jacket, and a white button-down shirt. But when he associates with [Reki](https://anilist.co/character/195120/Reki-Kyan) he wears baggy clothes consisting of dark pants, a blue coat, and a gray-colored shirt.  Langa was born in Canada to a Japanese mother and Canadian father and grew up snowboarding. As a teenager, he and his mother moved to Okinawa to start anew.

characters.name: Hiromi Higa
characters.description: In his normal life, as a florist, Shadow looks friendly and kind to his customers. However, entering the middle of the night and S, he changes his attitude to be arrogant, bad, and rude which is thought to be his outlet whenever he experiences unpleasant things during the day.

characters.name: Kaoru Sakurayashiki
characters.description: Height: 182 cm  Kaoru is calm intellectual, well-known even outside of "S" as a famous and successful AI calligrapher. He's been shown to treat clients and strangers with polite respect, but is often prickly towards those closest to him, most prominently his fellow "S" member and childhood friend [Kojiro Nanjo](https://anilist.co/character/195123). Kaoru is also notably competitive when skateboarding - but does truly trust and care for those who he considers his friends.

characters.name: Tadashi  Kikuchi
characters.description: He is Ainosuke Shindo's secretary and the person who originally taught him to skate.

characters.name: Reki Kyan
characters.description: Height: 176 cm (5'9") Talent: Skateboarding; Woodworking  Reki is a second year of high school student who loves skateboarding. He gets caught up in the underground skateboarding race "S". Reki has wild, red spiky hair and sports a trio-color bandana around his head. Moreover, he has amber-colored eyes and is of a light complexion. He is of average height and appears to have a lithe figure. He wears baggy dark-blue pants and sweater combo, with a yellow shirt underneath, similar to the skater-boy look.  (Source: Sk8 Wiki)

characters.name: Miya Chinen
characters.description: Height: 158 cm (5'2") Talent: Skateboarding, Talking to cats  Miya Chinen is a character in the SK8 the Infinity anime series who is an elite middle school student and candidate for Japan's national team. Miya is seen as a carefree boy. He is interested in skating, but not portrayed as obsessed like some of his competitors in "S," an underground and dangerous skateboard race at an abandoned mine.  As a child Miya loved skating and had fun with it. As he grew up, he began improving and received awards for it. However, this lead to his friends assuming that he saw them as "sidekicks" and looked down on them. Furthermore, this resulted in Miya losing his friends, eventually bringing about his negative outlook towards friendship as a whole.

characters.name: Ainosuke Shindou
characters.description: Zodiac: Taurus Affiliation: Diet Member Relatives: 3 Unnamed Aunts; Aiichirou Shindou (father) Talent: Skateboarding  He can use an ability called "Love Hug" which allows him to seem like he is riding uphill.

characters.name: Kojirou Nanjou
characters.description: Height: 189 cm Talent: Cooking Affiliation: Sialaluce (restaurant)  He is a skilled skater and a founding member of "S", he uses his unique build and status to skate in an aggressive, movement-oriented manner.   Despite his aura of hostility towards [Cherry Blossom](https://anilist.co/character/195118/Sakurayashiki-Kaoru), they are good friends, who have the utmost confidence in each other and their abilities. He is shown to be deeply attached to Kaoru, being the person for whom Kaoru sneaks out of the hospital after his injury, and the one who carried Kaoru when he passed out after [Adam](https://anilist.co/character/195122/Shindou-Ainosuke)'s attack. Kojiro and Kaoru were shown to be close, using each other's first name in addition to the childhood friend aspect. Kojiro is extremely loyal to Kaoru and so is Kaoru.  Kojiro has a "papa bear" mentality and appears as a father figure to the young boys, giving them advice and noticing things that are wrong with them. He is very open-minded and kind to the young boys, trying to help them whenever he can.  He helps [Reki](https://anilist.co/character/195120/Kyan-Reki) overcome his doubts and often picks him up when he is afraid he might do something reckless. He talks to Reki when he is depressed, trying to help him regain his self-esteem. He notices the little things in the younger boy's behavior and his playboy personality fades as he shows support. He not only helps Reki, but also Langa to rekindle his friendship with Reki.  He often has a teasing aspect to his entity, but underneath his playboy exterior, he is a very loyal, watchful, and relaxed person who enjoys helping others.

characters.name: Natsuki Aki
characters.description: is a nurse who works for the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force (JGSDF) and was assigned by Kikuoka Seijirou to oversee Kirigaya Kazuto's medical condition at «Chiyoda Hospital» when he was hospitalized as well as during his rehabilitation. She is later assigned to watch over Kazuto during the «Death Gun» incident and after Kazuto is injected with succinylcholine.

characters.name: Renly
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Louis de Sade
characters.description: He is a Vampire of the Crimson Moon. Louis had been born into the De Sade aristocracy alongside the likes of Veronica and Dominique de Sade, however because of certain circumstances Count de Sade sent him to live with his grandfather permanently. While living with his grandfather, Louis would come to meet Noé Archiviste and the two would become close friends.  ! Early in his life Louis was assessed as a potential Curse-Bearer and later thanks to his grandfather would become consciously aware of his condition, which lead him down a path allowing him to resist Charlatan's attempts to control him. Despite this however, when Noé organized a plan to help Mina escape her imminent execution following her diagnosis as a Curse-Bearer - Louis' fear for Noé and Dominique's safety would allow Charlatan the opportunity he'd been waiting for. Louis would proceed to save Noé and Dominique by killing Mina, only to go rogue himself and kill Fanny and Gilles as well. In the end, Louis was killed by his own grandfather when Noé was unable to do so himself by Louis' request. !

characters.name: Dante
characters.description: Race: Dhampir Occupation: Information Broker Partner: 	Johann (now), Riche (now), Vanitas (former)  Dante is a Dhampir acting as an insurance broker and jack-of-all-trades, he often partners with Vanitas, selling him information or working alongside him in pursuit of Curse-Bearing Vampires.  Dante tends to be rather carefree when dealing with Vanitas - though he is easily annoyed by his employer and partner - particularly when Vanitas addresses him as "Baldy." The two often take jabs at each other playfully, though in reality they enjoy each other's company. In a lot of instances Dante shows that he is very protective of those closest to him by nature. Dante is scared of dark and creepy places, like the catacombs and the forest.

characters.name: Sensei
characters.description: The Master belongs to the de Sade aristocracy - being the grandfather of Dominique de Sade - and is widely feared by many.  (Source: Pandora Hearts Wikia)

characters.name: Noé Archiviste
characters.description: Race: Vampire Height: 187 cm (6'1") Occupation: Student Partner: 	Vanitas  Noé is a gentleman vampire.  His story began when he received a letter from The Teacher, which explained that The Teacher wanted Noé to fly to Paris immediately, as there had been rumors that The Book of Vanitas had been found there. The Teacher then specifically ordered Noé to discern The Book of Vanitas' true nature.

characters.name: Sougetsu no Kyuuketsuki Vanitas
characters.description: Vanitas of the Blue Moon is a vampire. According to legend, they were born under the Blue Moon and were the ostensible creator of the Book of Vanitas and the disease Malnomen. It was their intent to destroy vampires through the corruption of their True Name, hoping to take revenge for a lifetime of prosecution for their birth. This power would be passed onto their kin, prophesied to bring about the end of all vampires.  (Source: Mochizuki Jun Wiki)

characters.name: Amelia Ruth
characters.description: Amelia Ruth is a woman Noé meets during a trip to Paris aboard La Baleine.  !Amelia, a vampire, was stricken with a malady that warped her true name, becoming Eglantine, the Prison of Briars, and lashed out at Noé shortly after meeting him. Vanitas managed to cure Amelia's ailment with the Book of Vanitas, revealing her true name to be Florifel, She Who Guides Spring. After being cured by Vanitas, Amelia was left on La Baleine and later taken into custody by Count Parks Orlok. Thanks to the efforts of Vanitas and Noé, Amelia was released from her previously scheduled execution under the condition that she remain under Count Orlok's watch in case she experienced a relapse. She is currently employed as a maid at Hôtel Chouchou.!

characters.name: Vanitas
characters.description: Race: Human Height: 176 cm (5'9") Occupation: Doctor Partner: 	Noé Archiviste (now), Dante (former)  Vanitas is an average human being who inherited his name and the Book of Vanitas from the infamous vampire.  He seems to often take nothing seriously and almost always has a broad grin on his face. He acts more on emotions than thought most of the time since his plans are normally reckless. Also carries a mischievous air around him.   ! When he was just a child, his parents were killed by a vampire. He was saved by the chasseurs and taken in. They trained him to become a chasseur but somewhere along the line, Vanitas caught Doctor Moreau's eye and became his research subject. According to Moreau, Vanitas went through multiple experiments that nearly killed him, and yet he never cried nor complained. The experiments continued until he and "no. 71" were rescued from Moreau's lab by Vanitas of the Blue Moon. Unlike no. 71, Vanitas hated Vanitas of the Blue Moon. The events that occurred afterwards are unknown, but Vanitas acquired the Book of Vanitas at some point. Since receiving the Book of Vanitas, Vanitas has dedicated his life to curing Curse-Bearing Vampires and considers himself a doctor of sorts as a result; using the power of the Book of Vanitas to restore a Curse-Bearer's true name. !

characters.name: Parks Orlok
characters.description: Parks Orlok is the appointed representative of the Vampires by The Queen following the war between humans and Vampires; tasked with maintaining a balance between the human and Vampire worlds by watching over Vampire-related activities.  (Source: The Mochizuki Wiki)

characters.name: Riche
characters.description: Race: Dhampir Occupation: Information Broker Partner: 	Dante, Johann  Riche is a Dhampir who acts as an Information Broker. Often partnered with fellow Dhampirs, Dante and Johann, Riche commonly works on cases in relation to Curse-Bearing Vampires.  Riche is a very scholarly and passionate woman, who often gets carried away talking about what interests her. She is also quick to apologize after sharing her knowledge, as she is self-conscious of her habit to overshare and ramble. She can be very competitive with her fellow information-brokers, but also cares for others deeply.

characters.name: Ayato Amagiri
characters.description: He transfers to Seidoukan Academy to investigate his sister's disappearance and to figure out what he is supposed to do (!he later says that it is to protect Julis!).  Ayato sports a friendly, polite, and helpful personality with a penchant for ending up in awkward situations. He is indiscriminate as to who he is being friendly to and is helpful to a fault, as well as being a bit naive. However, underneath the soft facade lies a person with an indomitable will who always tries to do the right thing, regardless of the potential trouble that he will get himself into.

characters.name: Kirin Toudou
characters.description: Kirin is the top-ranking student of Seidoukan Academy. She is a shy and quiet girl who becomes the academy's top student as a 13 year-old and has not lost to anyone until Ayato challenges her a second time. She does not have a personal lux but rather carries a katana (Senbakiri) around as a weapon which often makes her greatly marveled by others as she tops the former No. 1 spot just by using a katana.

characters.name: Saya Sasamiya
characters.description: Saya is Ayato's childhood friend. She moved abroad six years ago due to her father's career. She seems to be an air-headed stoic who has trouble waking up in the morning and is directionally-challenged. She uses a 38th generation Lux grenade launcher Helnekrom but later switches to a type 41 Gleaming Form - twin particle guns Waidenholt and Type 34 wave Motion heavy artillery Ark Van Ders for the Phoenix. Like Kirin, she enters the Phoenix for her father's sake.

characters.name: Claudia Enfield
characters.description: Claudia is the second highest ranking student of Seidoukan Academy and its Student Council President. She recommended [Ayato](https://anilist.co/character/89058)'s transfer to the academy. She has held the position of President since junior high.

characters.name: Haruka Amagiri
characters.description: Ayato's older sister. She is the one that taught Ayato the family fighting style. She entered school five years prior to Ayato's entrance to Seidoukan Academy but disappeared half a year later. She also participated in the unofficial underground Eclipse tournament. She once wielded the Ser-Versta; however, all records of her and including those pertaining to Lux have been erased.

characters.name: Priscilla Urzaiz
characters.description: She is Irene's younger sister. She cares deeply for her sister, Irene, and is a lot more level-headed than her.

characters.name: Camilla Pareto
characters.description: A student from Arlequint Academy and member of Ferrovious (Lions Faction). She is indebted to Ernesta and the two share a close relationship.

characters.name: Ernesta Kuhne
characters.description: A student from Arlequint Academy and leader of Pygmalion (Sculptor Faction). A genius at making puppets, she wants AIs to be treated as equal to humans and sees AR-D and RM-C as her children.

characters.name: Julis Alexia von Riessfeld
characters.description: Julis is the fifth ranking student of Seidoukan Academy and is Lieseltania's First Princess. Her full name is Julis-Alexia Marie Florentia Renate von Riessfelt. She wields a rapier-type lux called Aspera Spina which she uses during the Phoenix tournament and bears the image of a flower for her power - control over flames.  She warms to [Ayato](https://anilist.co/character/89058/Amagiri-Ayato), unlike the other students with whom she is distant.
