Although born a Martian, she considers all Martians her enemies and wonders how Princess Asselyum is able to live alongside humans.  Although having the age and appearance of a young girl, she has a lot of knowledge about  Martian and Earth machinery/weaponry. She shows that she is also able to drive vehicles, properly use firearms, and pilot a Kataphrakt.

characters.name: Lemrina Vers Envers
characters.description: Asseylum Vers Allusia's half-sister. The two princesses share the same paternal lineage, but have different mothers. She hates her royal heritage and even though she knows she's only a tool to activate the Aldnoah Drive, she continues with her mission since it makes her feel useful, befriending Slaine. She also pretends to be Asseylum in a message that urges to continue the war, with only Inaho suspecting she's an impostor.  Lemrina is a shrewd girl and is familiar of how Vers Empire's politics works. She is a good actress and manipulator, and keenly aware of her social standing and usefulness only as a tool to activate Aldnoah. She rarely shows her true nature to others.

characters.name: Yuki  Kaizuka
characters.description: Height: 168 cm  A warrant officer of the UFE (United Forces of Earth) and a pilot for the Mustang Platoon. She is a woman of average height with straight black hair that reaches her back and side bangs that ends right above her hazel eyes. She is mostly seen with her soldier's uniform which consists of a plain white dress shirt, a blue tie, and a navy blue pencil skirt.  Not much is known about her past except that her parents passed away when she was at a young age and her brother, [Inaho](https://anilist.co/character/88173/Inaho-Kaizuka), was only a baby. The two of them grew up at a government foster facility and later on began living together in an apartment. Unfortunately for Yuki, she was not prepared to raise her younger brother as a parental figure resulting in Inaho taking care of her instead. Currently, she is an instructor at Shinawara high school and is the pilot of the KG-7 Areion Terran Kataphrakt.  Being an easy-going and carefree woman, she often relies on her younger brother, Inaho, to take care of her who often has to wake her up and cook for her.  However, she shows that she is able to be serious and focused on her goal when needed. Yuki is also a very caring person, often worrying about others and putting their safety above herself, especially when it comes to Inaho. She greatly cares for her younger brother and often worries about him.   Yuki shows that she is a skilled pilot when piloting the KG-7 Areion during the second Earth-Mars War.

characters.name: Calm Craftman
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Hakuno Kishinami
characters.description: Hakuno Kishinami is the protagonist of Fate/Extra and Fate/Extra CCC, acting as the Master of Saber, Archer, Caster, or Gilgamesh depending on which is chosen. The character is male or female depending on player preference, and their name and a nickname can be selected as well. The male protagonist has brown hair and eyes and wears the standard male school uniform of Tsukumihara Academy, and wears a black t-shirt beneath his jacket.  !In Fate/Extra Last Encore, Hakuno is an existence brought about after Twice H. Pieceman decided that it was worthless to try to guide humanity's path, ceasing the Moon Holy Grail War and shutting down the Moon Cell's systems. The Moon Cell normally allowed for the emotions of those who die to be set free, but the closing of the Angelica Cage changed that process. As regrets of the deceased were no longer disassembled and purified, they began to congregate, and the regrets of the many "victors", people who were slain by Twice upon reaching the Angelica Cage, caused a new existence to awaken to bear the burden of their grudges. Hakuno became a "mass of death" in the shape of female Hakuno Kishinami's components.!  (Source: Type-Moon Wiki)

characters.name: Kotarou Fuuma
characters.description: Fuuma Kotarou is the fifth leader of the Fuuma clan, serving Ujitsuna, successor of Hojo Soun.

characters.name: Banyue
characters.description: She was the Imperial Preceptor of the fallen Banyue kingdom. She was claimed a traitor by its people after allowing the invading army into the city. !She had first met Xie Lian over 200 years ago. He took care of her as she was an orphan as a child!

characters.name: Qing Mu
characters.description: Mu Qing is a supporting character in Heaven Official's Blessing.  Mu Qing is a Martial God who oversees the southwest. Eight hundred years ago, he was the personal attendant of Xie Lian. He abandoned the Prince to take care of his mother when Xie Lian descended from Heaven for the first time.

characters.name: Xin Feng
characters.description: Feng Xin is a supporting character in Heaven Official's Blessing.   Feng Xin is a Martial God who oversees the southeast. Eight hundred years ago, he was the imperial bodyguard of Xie Lian and later, the first general of the Crown Prince's Palace Hall.

characters.name: Qingxuan Shi
characters.description: He is one of the Five Elemental Masters in the Heavenly Court. Since he is often worshiped as a female version of himself and often transforms into a woman, he was given the nickname.  He is the younger brother of the Shi Wudu and one of the Four Famous Tales - "The Young Lord Who Pours Wine" (少君倾酒).

characters.name: Ming Pei
characters.description: Pei Ming, titled as General Ming Guang, is the Martial God of the North with nine thousand temples dedicated to his palace. He is one of the Four Famous Tales: "The General Who Broke His Sword", as well as a member of The Three Tumors.

characters.name: Yi Ming
characters.description: Yi Ming is one of the Five Elemental Masters in the Heavenly Court.

characters.name: Lian Xie
characters.description: Height: 178 cm Weapons: Ruoye, Fang Xin  Xie Lian is the main protagonist of the Chinese web novel _Heaven Official's Blessing_.  He was widely known throughout the Xian Le nation as the beloved yet strange prince. Never showing interest in what was considered normal for a prince, he simply declared, "I want to save the common people!" Through practice, hard work, and insight beyond his years, he perfected his cultivation and ascended to the Heavens at the age of 17. He owns a special silk band called Ruoye.  After multiple unfortunate events, he was twice banished from the Heavens. 800 years later, he returns for the third time with an immense crash.

characters.name: Cheng Hua
characters.description: Height: 190 cm - 185 cm (San Lang)  Hua Cheng is the deuteragonist and main love interest in Heaven Official's Blessing.  One of the Four Great Calamities, Hua Cheng is the most famed of the three Devastation-class Demons in the Ghost World, thus he is entitled the Ghost King. When he first emerged, he challenged 33 gods and won, making his name as the scourge of the Heavenly Officials overnight.  !His most famous moniker, Crimson Rain Sought Flower, was attained during his early days as a supreme. After he annihilated [Qi Rong](https://anilist.co/character/261438/Qi-Rong)'s lair and causing blood rain to fall, he found a lone white flower struggling under the heavy rainfall. Until the downpour ceased, Hua Cheng stood by this flower and shielded it from the rain with his red umbrella.!  !Just like any other ghost, Hua Cheng's only weakness is his ashes. Hua Cheng's ashes were modelled into a diamond ring that he entrusted to [Xie Lian](https://anilist.co/character/149589/Xie-Lian). When asked if his ashes were sufficiently protected, he stated that if the hiding place of his ashes were to be destroyed, then he would no longer have any reason to exist and might as well disappear.!

characters.name: Wen Ling
characters.description: Lingwen is the foremost Civil Goddess in the Heavenly Court and one of the notorious Three Tumors.

characters.name: Kengo Dojima
characters.description: He is a member of the newspaper club and full of strength and creativity.

characters.name: Jougorou Kobato
characters.description: A male high school student at Funato High School. Since he was young, he wanted to be a detective, but his penchant for putting himself into other's matters led to others becoming more distant from him.

characters.name: Yuki Osanai
characters.description: A high school student at Funato High School, who has been Jougorou's friend since they were in junior high school. She likes sweets.

characters.name: Glorio
characters.description: Glorio is a demon from the Demon Realm. An enigmatic gunman working for Dr. Arinsu in the First Demon World, he is instructed to bring Goku to the Demon Realm in hopes of using his strength to gather the Demon Realm Dragon Balls and overthrow the current Supreme Demon King, Gomah.

characters.name: Panzy
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Kirie Fujyou
characters.description: Height: 165 cm  A girl who was sick in a hospital bed. She has long hair, wearing all white. She could barely move and she was starting to lose her eye sight as well. Her parents and younger brother died soon after she got sick and she didn't get any visitors. She wouldn't last long and has always been looking out of the window. She must have been so lonely. Although she was scared of dying, that feeling of death was the only thing she was able to make her realize that she was alive.

characters.name: Akitaka Suzurigi
characters.description: Akitaka was a former yakuza in his early thirties who was hired by the Ryougi family as the butler in charge of Shiki Ryougi's education. He was trusted with handling all of the household affairs, following Shiki around like a shadow.

characters.name: Fujino Asagami
characters.description: Height: 155 cm  Classmate and friend to [Azaka](https://anilist.co/character/5268/Kokutou-Azaka), both students of Reien Girl's Academy. !A murderer in secret, her ability to feel pain was numbed since childhood to seal off her powers. Terrified of being seen as an abnormality, she hides her condition.   Her murders are seemingly a way of giving her inner peace.   Fujino has the special ability to bend space/objects with her mind which she uses as a murder weapon, twisting the bodies of her victims until they are no more than broken bags of meat. She later also gains clairvoyance in conjunction with her power which allows her to bend objects without having to be able to see them.   In the sixth movie, Fujino appears briefly during the opening narrative, using a cane to walk with Azaka helping her down a flight of stairs.!

characters.name: Mofu Usaki
characters.description: Mofu Usaki is world-renowned neurosurgeon who does surgeries on a microscopic scale and undertakes at least 800 surgeries a year. She also stars in the liveshow "Lie or Truth? ESP!!"

characters.name: Amamiya
characters.description: Amamiya is the leader of the First Investigative Division of the Metropolitan Police Department and Totomaru Isshiki's superior.

characters.name: Spitz Fire
characters.description: Tracking instructor at B.L.U.E

characters.name: Chikori Monki
characters.description: A crime reporter at Lime Weekly.

characters.name: Omito Kawasemi
characters.description: A police detective at the Aichi Prefectural Police and the detective with the highest number of solved cases in the entire country. Because of this, he is already considered for police superintendent general.

characters.name: Winter Moriarty
characters.description: Fourth child of the M. Family.

characters.name: Mylo Moriarty
characters.description: Current head child and first child of the M. Family.

characters.name: Ron Kamonohashi
characters.description: A talented detective and the student with the highest grades in Detective Training Academy BLUE's history. As his detective license was revoked after an incident five years ago, he has partnered up with Totomaru Isshiki to still be able to solve cases.  !Later, it is confirmed that Ron Kamonohashi isn't the true culprit behind the Bloody Field Trip, but "Shachi". It was to ruin his detective life.!

characters.name: Totomaru Isshiki
characters.description: Totomaru Isshiki, frequently shortened to Toto, is a police detective of the Metropolitan Police Department. He helps Ron Kamonohashi investigate cases by pretending to be the one who solves them.
