characters.description: Height: 185 cm (6')   Mitsuyoshi is a tall, tan skinned young man with dark brown combed back hair. His attire often consists of casual clothes, his ever-present sunglasses, piercings, a silver necklace, two rings on each hand, a cigarette, and the occasional wrist band. Also, according to the manga, Mitsuyoshi's eyes strongly resemble [Haru](https://anilist.co/character/37687/Yoshida-Haru) and [Yuuzan](https://anilist.co/character/53087/Yoshida-Yuuzan)'s father's eyes, which is why he wears sunglasses constantly; so the two siblings do not hate him.

characters.name: Asako Natsume
characters.description: Height: 157 cm    She was a classmate of [Shizuku](https://anilist.co/character/37685/Mizutani-Shizuku) who one day asks for help in a re-test that she must not fail. She's revealed to be active on the web, where she has a blog, on which she even posted to need two strands of Mitti's hair to complete a ritual that'd assure them to become best friends. She's good at sports. She has poor grades, and does not have any friends outside of the internet. She was bullied and ostracized by her friends and classmates in the past, due to her popularity with the boys. She falls in love with [Mitsuyoshi Misawa](https://anilist.co/character/64079/Misawa-Mitsuyoshi) and is often comforted by [Souhei Sasahara](https://anilist.co/character/52617/Sasahara-Souhei) when her love attempts fail. She is voiced by Yuiko Tatsumi in drama CD.

characters.name: Shizuku Mizutani
characters.description: Height: 158 cm (5'2")  A high school student who is only interested about studying and getting the top grades in the class. She appears indifferent towards everything outside of studying.

characters.name: Haru Yoshida
characters.description: Height: 178 cm (5'10")  Haru is the male protagonist of the story. He is a high school student who sits next to Shizuku in class. He is a delinquent boy who is absent for a long time after getting in a fight early in the story. Despite being a trouble maker, he is a passionate boy who helps others and can achieve high grades with little effort. He does not like going to school because most people see him as a threat and are afraid of him, saddening him as he is unable to make real friends. After meeting Shizuku, he takes her as his first real friend and starts to attend school, falling in love with her in the process. He also keeps a rooster and brings it to school everyday, despite his teacher's disapproval. He has somewhat of a perverted mind, openly saying to Shizuku that he would "do" her and has "dirty thoughts" about her. It is unclear whether or not he actually thinks before he speaks.    !At first, Haru was shown to be a delinquent, but as the story unfolds, it was revealed that he was rather a shy and innocent boy. However, he has bipolar tendencies, most likely the result of not interacting with many people in the past.!

characters.name: Yuuzan Yoshida
characters.description: Height: 176 cm    Haru's older brother. He loves sweet things and is often seen eating them. He especially loves donuts. He and his brother don't really get along with each other. Although Yuuzan tries to get closer to his younger brother and understand him, Haru doesn't accept him. However Yuuzan claims Haru has a brother complex, though this is denied by Haru himself.     He came to take Haru back home upon their father's request for Haru to attend a nearer school, where he has more leverage, although Yuuzan does want Haru to continue going to school with Shizuku.

characters.name: Schwi Dola
characters.description: Schwi was the first Ex-machina to be introduced in Tet's story. In the story she seeks to understand the human heart and was found by Riku. She looks like a young human but with several differences, being two tails coming out from her back and other machine like features protruding from around her body. She bears many similarities with Shiro.  Her behavior is similar to that of a stereotypical artificial intelligence. She can absorb and process data and intelligence very quickly and act in the appropriate manner, a unique characteristic of her race. However, she seems to have difficulty in comprehending emotions and desires, otherwise characterized by her as the heart.

characters.name: Couronna Dola
characters.description: One of the colonists in Tet's story and the supposed older sister of Riku. She was also the founder of Elchea after the Great War and is Stephanie Dola's direct ancestor.  Couronna has a very similar appearance to Stephanie Dola; however, her hair is slightly longer and darker. She cares about Riku, going as far as calling herself his sister after he had lost his family. Though she is a mere Imanity, she seems to be sensitive to things, as she was able to figure out that Shuvi was not an Imanity right away.

characters.name: Riku Dola
characters.description: Riku was an 18 years old Imanity who lived during the Great War on Disboard. He was one of the main protagonists in Tet's story. He encountered Shuvi while going on an expedition and brought her to his colony after having lost in a game against her (albeit willingly).  He bears many similarities with Sora, being his black hair, slender body, black eyes and his face. Riku is a master strategist and manipulator, much like Sora. He is capable of duping even the matriarch of the Nilvalen family (known as the strongest and smartest Elf at the time) into giving out valuable information, albeit at the cost of his health.

characters.name: Sheena
characters.description: The former queen and the biological mother of [Bojji](https://anilist.co/character/209532/).

characters.name: Despa
characters.description: [Desha](https://anilist.co/character/244202/)'s brother and ![Ouken](https://anilist.co/character/260808/)'s brother.!

characters.name: Bebin
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Domas
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Apeas
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Bojji
characters.description: The firstborn prince of the Bosse Kingdom. Bojji was born abnormally small, weak, and deaf. He is a powerless prince who has lived his life under the shadow of his father, the legendary [King Bosse](https://anilist.co/character/244198/). He wants to be the world's greatest king, following his father  Bojji is extremely hard-working and sincere, and these traits draw people towards him even if they can't always understand him.  !He learns how to wield a sword thanks to [Despa](https://anilist.co/character/244201/). Despa helps him overcome his physical limitations, by making use of his agility and precision It was later revealed that the reason why he is so weak is because back when his father was still a wandering adventurer, he made a deal with a demon to take the strength from his yet-unborn first son (Bojji) and give it to him. This made Bosse the strongest man in the world, but took away the physical strength of Bojji in turn.!

characters.name: Kage
characters.description: Kage is a literal shadow who becomes [Bojji](https://anilist.co/character/209532/Bojji)’s first friend.

characters.name: Hokuro
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Yun
characters.description: Height: 162 cm Race: Human  In Princess Yona's group, he is the healer and genius.  He is an outstanding curious intellectual. He can say mean things, but he's a caring pretty boy. He was born in a poor village of the Fire Tribe.

characters.name: Ki-Ja
characters.description: Height: 175 cm Race: Dragon  He is the white dragon of the group. He has dragon claws on his right hand, which is said to have ten times the strength of a normal human's.  !In a side chapter focused on Kija, he (when he was a child) had secretly went to see his father (who was on deathbed). However his father was too weak to realise who it was and thought it was the granny. He had asked if it was okay for him to touch that child (Kija) now that his right hand was back to being a normal human hand. Kija, upon hearing this leapt onto the bed and hugged his father. His father died shortly after saying "Kija" when he realised it was him.!

characters.name: Ao
characters.description: Ao is Shin-Ah's squirrel companion and friend, who is named after the previous Seiryuu by Shin-Ah.  Ao is a goofy and mischievous yet adorable squirrel, often playing around and making poses that match the person she is riding on. She likes to eat a lot which makes her bite on random things, like Yona's earrings or Shin-Ah's finger. She tries to make people (specifically Shin-Ah or Yona) cheer up if they are feeling down or sad by rubbing their face or acting cute.

characters.name: Shin-Ah
characters.description: Height: 180 cm Race: Dragon  He is the blue dragon and has dragon eyes that allows him to see great distances. Shin-Ah's dragon eyes are also capable of disrupting the nerves of anyone he glares at until it kills them.  !Later in the story, his power was explained in more detail. His victims are subject to fatal hallucinations. In extreme cases he can cause their entire bodies to stop functioning, including their hearts. However, he does not have full control over this power and will lose himself to the blue dragon's murderous willpower. When he finishes using that ability, he himself becomes paralyzed as a result, making the power a double-edged sword.!  !He almost lost complete control when [Yona](https://anilist.co/character/43814/Yona) was captured by some bandits (they were in the fire tribe and Shinah was assigned to protect Yona), causing them to have hallucinations after his mask was knocked off by a bandit. However, she wasn’t afraid of his power and saved him from losing to his power (though it wasn’t easy because he lost himself and didn’t recognize her). He was scared that he wouldn’t be able to stay by Yona’s side anymore and she would hate him because of this. But she reassured his importance to her and to continue to stay with the group.!  He is also voiced by Sanae Kobayashi.

characters.name: Yona
characters.description: Height: 157 cm Race: Human  The spoiled princess of the Kouka kingdom, who has a crush on her cousin and childhood friend [Soo-won](https://anilist.co/character/88670). Soo-won comforted her when she lost her mother in young age. She hates her crimson red hair. Her bodyguard is the other childhood friend, the general [Son Hak](https://anilist.co/character/43815) who she finds really annoying.  As the princess and the only heir of the Kouka Kingdom, Yona was raised with extreme care and gets whatever she wants, for example, beautiful accessories and clothing. This lead her to being a spoilt princess. After some life-changing events, Yona developed into a strong young lady who lives for the people of Kouka Kingdom, while also paying back the friends who helped her survive.  !After Soo-won kills her father in front of her eyes in order to become the new king, she has to run from the castle with Son Hak. !  !She is the reincarnation of the red dragon.!  !She later confesses her love to Son Hak.!

characters.name: Hak Son
characters.description: **Height:** 188 cm  He is the former chief and general of the Wind Tribe. He is famously known as Thunder Beast for his fighting skills that were said to be unrivalled by anyone, earning him the title of "strongest soldier in the kingdom".  !He is in love with [Yona](https://anilist.co/character/43814/Yona). Even when Yona was unaware of his feelings, every now and then, Hak couldn't help but display his affection towards her.!

characters.name: Jae-Ha
characters.description: Height: 188 cm Race: Dragon  He is the descendant of the Green Dragon and possesses the power of a dragon in his right leg. His power allows him to jump high and long distances that almost make it look like he can fly. It also makes his leg incredibly strong and lethal when used to kick. He's a big flirt, he doesn't care whether it's a man or a girl.  !Twenty-five years ago, Jae-ha was born in the Village of Ryokuryuu and Garou, the previous Ryokuryuu, took care of him. During his childhood, he was confined in chains within his room to prevent him from escaping the village and also from repeating the tragedy that happened eighty-five years ago. On his every attempt to flee, he was always stopped by Garou and he was beat up as punishment.!

characters.name: Zeno
characters.description: Height: 166 cm Race: Dragon  He is the yellow dragon and has a really strong body.  !He joins the group immediately after the Awa arc. Later on it's revealed that he was watching Yona ever since she was chased out of Hiryuu castle to see if she was fit to use the power of the four dragons. After the events in Awa he decided that he wanted to follow her, so he showed up at the campfire.!  !In chapter 100, it is revealed that he is immortal, and that he is the original dragon warrior who received the blood of the Yellow Dragon. His power worked by having certain areas of his body being seriously injured before having that part regenerating back quickly. This was why when he appeared to be a normal human when Hak tried to test whether his body was indestructible (he was not seriously injured). While his body is regenerating, scales appear on the places where his wounds were, making his body as hard as steel. According to Zeno himself, during regeneration his physical power is no less than Kija's dragon arm or Jae-Ha's dragon leg.!  !He was married in the past to a sickly girl named Kaya.!

characters.name: Rory Mercury
characters.description: A demigoddess and an apostle of Emroy, the god of darkness, war, violence and death. She is widely known as Rory the Reaper due to her wielding of her halberd as a scythe, slaughtering those who offend Emroy, and those she views are worthy of being punished by death.  Her gothic lolita dress is an outfit for priestesses. In terms of age, she is the third-youngest Apostle of the Twelve Apostles.  (Source: Gate - Thus the JSDF Fought There! Wiki)

characters.name: Lelei la Lelena
characters.description: Lelei is generally an emotionless girl, with her face constantly fixed in an expressionless look. She is usually calm and silent amongst her friends and would always speak in a collected way. She rarely raises her voice, even in dire situations.  However, there are cases where she displays her emotions, such as surprise and awe when she was saved by the JSDF when she was nearly stomped by a horse.  She is a student of Grand Master Cato El Altestan, having moved in with him to the outskirts of Coda village when she was nearly 10 years old.

characters.name: Tuka Luna Marceau
characters.description: This beautiful elf girl is the only survivor from her village, which was destroyed by the dragon. She was very dedicated to her father, who died protecting her. Saved by Japanese soldiers, Tuka Luna lives among the refugees in their military camp.  !Unable to cope with the loss of her father, she first acts as though he is staying at the base, insisting on two rooms and extra portions of meals. Her mental stability deteriorates over time and eventually, she latches onto Itami, calling him "father." In an effort to bring her to her senses, Itami brings Tuka along on the hunt for the Flame Dragon and forces her to aid in its defeat. Having avenged her father, she recovers — but refuses to stop calling Itami "father," claiming it had become a habit.  (Source: Gate - Thus the JSDF Fought There! Wiki)!

characters.name: Youji Itami
characters.description: Itami is an otaku who loves to read doujinshi and online novels. Work is nothing more then something that provides an income source for his interest. Itami is a selfless person, he will help anyone who need help no matter if it's friend or enemy. He also cares about other people who he hasn't met before as seen when he immediately saved a japanese woman who was Zorzal's slave. Itami doesn't like the idea of slavery in Special Region. He can become friends with almost anyone no matter what their race is, and he doesn't seem to be bothered by that. Unlike other people in Special Region. He is desctibed as a bland man, but there is something captivating about him as stated by Rory. Itami gets along quite well with his ex-wife Risa, despite her occasionally begging him for money.  (Source: Gate Wiki)

characters.name: Tarou Kanou
characters.description: The Japanese Minister of Defence and Minister for Problem Measures of the Special Region. His otaku interests are well known among the Japanese public. He was also an otaku acquaintance of [Itami](https://anilist.co/character/89065/Itami-Youji) in the past.

characters.name: Piña Co Lada
characters.description: The daughter of the Emperor Molt Sol Augustus and his concubine, Countess Nell. She has two brothers, Zorzal El Caesar and Diabo El Caesar both of whom were candidates for the next Emperor. She is also the leader of Rose-Order of Knights.  !Later she becomes a mediator between Japan and her empire, and gets strongly influenced by the otaku culture.!

characters.name: Takeo Kurata
characters.description: Sergeant 3rd Class in Itami Youji's Third Reconnaissance Platoon. An extreme otaku like Itami, and often happily discusses otaku topics with his superior. Has a fetish for cat ears.

characters.name: Mari Kurokawa
characters.description: Sergeant First Class of Japan Self-Defense Forces and one of the female members of Itami's Third Recon Team. She also serves as the team's medic, and usually speaks in a calm and reserved manner, but has shown to be sharp tongued when she thinks the situation warrants it.

characters.name: Hakobiya
characters.description: Height: 185 cm (6'1") Estimated Prison Sentence: 745 years  Courier grew up being forced to transport things by adults. He has confidence in his work and is somewhat of a workaholic. He doesn't speak often, but when he does, he has the right words for the situation. He has a habit of clicking his tongue, and his favorite food is takoyaki.

characters.name: Ippanjin
characters.description: Height: 165 cm (5'5")  She was just a regular girl, born in a regular family, worked like everyone else, and was leading a simple life. One misfortune after another got her involved in the crimes of Akudama. She’s a kind of person who doesn't get depressed, and she deals with problems optimistically.

characters.name: Hacker
characters.description: Height: 160 cm Weight: 47 kg Estimated Prison Sentence: 589 years   The Hacker is more excited the more difficult something is, but is completely apathetic to things he's uninterested in. He likes healthy jelly drinks.

characters.name: Chinpira
characters.description: Height: 175 cm Estimated Prison Sentence: 4 years  Chinpira is greedy and is involved with crimes for money. He tries to act bold, but ultimately, he's a coward who believes that "if you can't beat them, join them." However, thanks to his weakness, he can show consideration to his comrades. He's a pathological liar and likes ramen.

characters.name: Kenkaya
characters.description: Height: 200 cm Estimated Prison Sentence: 348 years  The Brawler is pure and straightforward. He believes that power is everything and doesn't care if he dies as long as he can fight strong enemies. He often fist bumps people and his favorite food is meat.

characters.name: Isha
characters.description: Height: 175 cm Estimated Prison Sentence: 432 years  The Doctor is a mad scientist who toys with people's lives for fun. She has a calm demeanor and speaks philosophically. She has a habit of messing with her nails, and her favorite foods are wine and cheese.

characters.name: Satsujinki
characters.description: Height: 185 cm (6'1")  An Akudama. His estimated prison sentence is 967 years.  Cutthroat's hobby is murder. Paradoxically, his usual behavior is innocent and almost childlike. He becomes unable to control his murderous impulses under certain conditions, especially when he sees the color red. Just simply seeing the color red makes him excited to the point of childlike giddiness. His favorite food is marshmallows and he has an extreme infatuation with [Swindler](https://anilist.co/character/163011/Ippanjin).

characters.name: Kuroneko
characters.description: The mysterious employer of the Akudama who speaks through a robotic black cat. They enlist the Akudama to rescue [Cutthroat](https://anilist.co/character/163013/Satsujinki) and later hijack the Shinkansen.  !They are later revealed to be an immortal boy attempting to—alongside his [sister](https://anilist.co/character/196158/Imouto)—escape their fates as vessels to maintain the Kanto supercomputer.!

characters.name: Imouto
characters.description: A mysterious girl. She is quiet, with little self-assertion. She tends to hide behind her [brother](https://anilist.co/character/188625/Kuroneko).

characters.name: Prushka
characters.description: Species: Human  Prushka is the adoptive daughter of the White Whistle Delver [Bondrewd](https://anilist.co/character/122463/Bondrewd). She lives with him at the Forward Operation Base.  Prushka is a cheerful and amiable girl who loves her adoptive father very much. She is incredibly devoted to him and would do anything to help him, holding him in higher regard than anyone else. Having lived the majority of her life in the 5th layer, she developed a strong curiosity for exploring and was fascinated by tales of others' travels through the Abyss. She is adventurous and quite brave, going on her own adventures through the 5th layer behind her father's back.  Due to her horrible past and the influence of her father, she developed an amazing mental fortitude, and became very obstinate, to the point of being willing to challenge the curse of the 5th layer multiple times just to learn more about it.

characters.name: Meinya
characters.description: **Race**: Meinastoirim  Meinya is [Prushka](https://anilist.co/character/122466/Prushka)'s pet given to her as a present from her adoptive father, [Bondrewd](https://anilist.co/character/122463/Bondrewd), as her 10th birthday present. Its name is a result of Prushka not being able to pronounce "Meinastilim" when it was given to her.  !Meinya later joins [Reg](https://anilist.co/character/122444/Reg), [Riko](https://anilist.co/character/122443/Riko), and [Nanachi](https://anilist.co/character/122445/Nanachi) on their adventure to the bottom of the Abyss.!  Meinya is a rabbit-sized creature called a Meinastilim, also known as a child of change. It has an oval-shaped body, stubby legs and feet, and large ears it uses to fly with. Its face is somewhat resemblant of a toad's as its pupils are slitted horizontally across the entire diameter of the eye. By sniffing Meinya's fur, [Riko](https://anilist.co/character/122443/Riko) and Prushka can navigate Ido Front without succumbing to the Curse.  !During [Reg](https://anilist.co/character/122444/Reg) and Bondrewd's fight, Bondrewd ejects several of his cartridges and begins to recite their names. Meinya interrupts him, running to one cartridge and, after sniffing and licking the contents, wailing over it. Bondrewd confirms that this cartridge contained Prushka.!  (Source: Made in Abyss Wiki, edited)

characters.name: Yukana Yame
characters.description: Height: 160 cm  A high school gyaru who is very soft and has a very close friend who's also a gyaru.

characters.name: Junichi Hashiba
characters.description: **Height:** 170 cm

characters.name: Yui Kashii
characters.description: Height: 165 cm  She is the classmate of [Junichi Hashiba](https://anilist.co/character/121831/Hashiba-Junichi).

characters.name: Ranko Honjou
characters.description: Height: 173 cm  A friend of [Yukana](https://anilist.co/character/121830).

characters.name: Keigo Ishida
characters.description: Height: 172 cm

characters.name: Minoru Kobayakawa
characters.description: Height: 179 cm  A self-professed and unapologetic loli-con, he dreams of one day dating a girl who will write him, "a love note written in crayon."

characters.name: Shinpei Sakamoto
characters.description: Height: 174 cm

characters.name: Shizune Fujinoki
characters.description: Height:140 cm  She is the childhood friend of Junichi Hashiba.

characters.name: Dramaturgy
characters.description: Dramaturgy is a giant man over 2 meters tall and carries two flamberge swords. He is the one who took [Kiss-shot's](https://anilist.co/character/23602/Oshino-Shinobu) right leg. It's implied he may be German in Tsubasa Sleeping. He is also a Vietnam War veteran.   !Even though he is a vampire hunter, he is a vampire himself!

characters.name: Guillotine Cutter
characters.description: Guillotine Cutter is the archbishop of a new religion he created in which believes that he is god. He is one of the three vampire hunters with Episode and Dramaturgy, who  !stole both of Kiss-shot's arms.!   !After he was defeated by Araragi, he attempts to slay a full-powered Kiss-Shot but is killed and consumed.!

characters.name: Kaito
characters.description: Kaito is Kei's childhood friend and the only human person in the entire country who makes an effort to help Kei despite the fact he is an Ajin.  Kaito is shown to be a very loyal and supportive friend for reasons not yet made known. Without hesitation, he helps Kei flee despite the fact that Kei had rejected him as a friend.  Though situations become increasingly worse, he appears to retain a very positive, determined attitude. He is very resourceful and though he is not as intelligent as Kei, he is able to make tactical decisions while they were on the run together.  (Source: Ajin Wiki)

characters.name: Satou
characters.description: Satou is an Ajin. He is referred to by officials such as [Yuu Tosaki](https://anilist.co/character/122294/Tosaki-Yuu) as Hat (帽子, Boshi). His real name is Samuel T. Owen.  While Satou's father is British and his mother is Chinese, he himself is from the United States of America. He was part of the United States Marine Corps in the past. Before dying for the first time he had a large x-shaped scar on the left side of his face and was missing his right leg.  He is passionate about video games and gaming in general.

characters.name: Masumi Okuyama
characters.description: He is an Ajin born with a weak leg. He is very knowledgable about guns and computers. (MAL)

characters.name: Izumi Shimomura
characters.description: Height: 155 cm  Izumi Shimomura is an Ajin. Her name is taken from her birth father's last name (Shimomura) and her mother's maiden name (Izumi). Her former name was Yoko Tainaka.   Izumi is a rather quiet and reserved individual, talking mainly when informing Tosaki about something. Her answers are usually short and to the point. Even though she is an Ajin, she chose to live between humans in secret and doesn't seem to be consumed completely by resentment towards humans despite her background. She seems to be quite intelligent and understanding, both towards Tosaki and when interrogating Nagai Kei's younger sister, Eriko. However, despite her initial stoic appearance, she can get embarrassed easily (for example when she said too much to Eriko and when Tosaki commented on her casual clothes). !Due to her past trauma caused by both of her parents and love life, she became very depressed and suicidal, often cutting herself and eventually ends up attempting suicide.!

characters.name: Yuu Tosaki
characters.description: Yuu Tosaki is a high-ranked member of the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare.  Generally, Tosaki has a commanding air about him and wears a serious expression. His answers are always short and to the point. He is also quite blunt and lacks patience.  He's quick to anger with certain triggers, such as multiple instances in which he snaps at the mispronunciation of his name - "Tozaki" as opposed to what he claims is correct, "Tosaki".  From the very start, Tosaki is shown to be morally ambiguous. It isn't above him to resort to violence through either his own force or those beneath him to get something done. If the consequences of his actions don't have a direct effect on him, his reaction is mild at best.  Tosaki relies heavily on Izumi Shimomura to protect him from the Ajin and their IBM with her own abilities, threatening her with the prospect of being locked up and experimented on if he dies.

characters.name: Kei Nagai
characters.description: Kei Nagai is an Ajin and the main protagonist of the series.  Kei was first shown with an academic, serious personality. He is very intelligent and hardworking with ambitions to be a doctor who cures illnesses that don't yet have a cure; specifically to cure his sister [Eriko](https://anilist.co/character/290487/Nagai-Eriko).  Despite Kei's lack of emotional investment in others, he seems to have strong personal values that he tries to live by. He demonstrates gratitude for [Kaito](https://anilist.co/character/120727/Kaito)'s help and cares about his welfare. He also doesn't begrudge [Satou](https://anilist.co/character/89797/Satou) for having killed others to free him, but does not support killing more people unnecessarily.  (Source: Ajin Wiki)

characters.name: Kou Nakano
characters.description: Kou Nakano is an Ajin.  Nakano is very considerate of others; !stating he wanted to help Kei with taking down Satō, and later helping Kei escape even after he locked him in a wrecked truck.! He was also concerned for Izumi, saying she shouldn't put herself in danger. He is also a bit clumsy compared with other characters and often doesn't know what's going on. As seen in the recent chapters, he is not good with coming up with plans and prefers to improvise instead. This results in him relying on Kei a lot with strategic plans, much to Kei's annoyance.   it is revealed that Kō had first died when changing a light bulb. He stacked a bunch of magazines on top of each other, and tripped. After that, he was left paralyzed on the floor for days, but no one came. He then most likely died of dehydration. It is also pointed out that Kō had abusive, or at least neglective, parents.

characters.name: Kouji Tanaka
characters.description: Kouji Tanaka is the second Ajin discovered in Japan. He is a partner to Satou.  Tanaka shows a rather large resentment towards humanity after the daily torture and experiments he was subjected to during his capture. Other than this, he is rather impassive; not really getting frustrated or angry in many situations, and is completely unresponsive to bloodshed and gore.  (Source: Ajin Wiki)

characters.name: Kou Tanaka
characters.description: Height: 176 cm (5'7")  Kou is a 3rd year at Kawanuma-higashi High School.

characters.name: Hikari Hazakura
characters.description: Height: 164 cm   Taka-kun's neighbor and childhood friend. Despite her constant teasing, they're always stuck together.

characters.name: Kana Kojima
characters.description: Height: 159 cm  A Japanese-language teacher.

characters.name: Rin Suzuki
characters.description: Height: 196 cm  A high school student feared by his giant stature and scary face, but at heart he is a kind person.  !Later he marries his teacher and they live together!

characters.name: Takashi Takahashi
characters.description: Height: 148 cm (4'8")  Takashi is a first year at Kawanuma-higashi High School and the student council treasurer.

characters.name: Ichirou Satou
characters.description: Height: 172 cm (5'6")  He's an 'average' high school student who somehow seems to get into ridiculous situations with his teacher, [Kana Kojima](https://anilist.co/character/135226/Kojima-Kana). He also has zero luck with girls.

characters.name: Mayu Matsukaze
characters.description: Height: 146 cm  A kind teacher revered as a saint by the students of the school. She's small, but has a big bust.

characters.name: Chizuru Tachibana
characters.description: Chizuru Tachibana is the 24 year old school nurse at Kawanuma East who is known as "Absolute Zero Tachibana" for her cold and expressionless attitude towards the students.

characters.name: Kanata Hoshijima
characters.description: Height: 181 cm (5'11") Hometown: Mousanish District  Kanata is naturally athletic and a steadfast person that wants to become a space explorer. He is also a very selfless person who would willingly help anyone in distress and would take any risks necessary to save them. He acts like a leader and wishes to be acknowledged as one by his comrades.   !Later in the story it's revealed that  the reason why he wants to become a space explorer was the influence of one of his middle school teacher's that passed away in a fatal accident that happened during a school trip. That accident was also the reason why Kanata started training to the point of becoming a decathlete. He competed in the decathlon event in the latest Under-20 World Championships and took home the overall bronze medal.!  !At the end of the series, he marries Aries Springs.!

characters.name: Quitterie Raffaeli
characters.description: Height: 157 cm (5'2") Hometown: Mousanish District  She likes being fashionable and doesn't feel comfortable around strange animals. Although she's not good at socialising, [Zack](https://anilist.co/character/139432/Walker-Zack) and her have been friends since they were little due to their parents being coworkers.  Quitterie's mother is the head doctor at a hospital and she wishes to become a doctor like her in the future, so she's studying medicine. She never knew her father.  !Later in the story it is revealed that she was actually raised solely by her family's servants. Because of that and the other kids' jealousness she never learnt how to interact with others normally and grew up a little self-centered and bossy.!  !She ends up marrying Zack.!

characters.name: Zack Walker
characters.description: Height: 185 cm (6'1") Weight: 76 kg (168 lbs.) Eye color: Blue Hometown: Mousanish District  Zack is a genius with an IQ of 200 whose field of expertise is space science. He even has a spaceship pilot's license. He and [Quitterie](https://anilist.co/character/122754/Raffaeli-Quitterie) have been friends since they were little due to their parents being coworkers.  !He ends up marrying Quitterie.!

characters.name: Charce Lacroix
characters.description: Height: 176 cm (5'9")  Charce is well-versed in biology and extremely curious about all living things. He's also an excellent cook.  !Although he was born and raised in the Royal Quarter of Vixia, Charce abandoned his home and moved into Caird's dormitory a few days before the school trip to Planet Mcpa started, but he kept it a secret from everyone.!  !In the end of the anime, Charce was revealed to be the group's saboteur, attempting to kill Group B-5 after a mission issued to him by its original, the king of the Royal Quarter of Vixia, Noah Vix.!

characters.name: Ulgar Zweig
characters.description: Hometown: Mousanish District Height: 165 cm (5'5")  Ulgar is a snarky person and extremely reserved, he is a lone wolf and tries to stay away from the group. His favourite piece of clothing is his knit cap from the popular fashion brand Rocket Rollance. He's a member of Group B-5, He treasures his beanie, and he is good with things like calculating trajectory.

characters.name: Yun-Hua Lu
characters.description: **Height:** 179 cm (5'10") **Hometown:** Mousanish District  Yun-Hua has a shy personality with a tendency to suppress any self-expression.

characters.name: Luca Esposito
characters.description: Height: 162 cm (5'4") Hometown: Mousanish District  Luca is deft with their hands and has a strong artistic sense.  !Luca is an intersex person and possesses both male and female sexual and reproductive organs. He currently identifies as male, but he explains how being male or female can feel fluid to him and can fluctuate by the day.!  !He was adopted and raised by Senator Marco Esposito.!

characters.name: Funicia Raffaeli
characters.description: Height: 136 cm (4'6") Weight: 31 kg (68 lbs.) Eye color: Violet Hometown: Mousanish District  Quitterie's little sister. Her favourite toy is a Beego hand puppet. Beego is the main character of her favourite cartoon show, _Animaroid B5_.   !Later in the story it's revealed that when her mother died, she was adopted into the Raffaeli family, making her Quitterie's stepsister.!

characters.name: Aries Spring
characters.description: Height: 162 cm (5'4") Hometown: Rosapop District  Aries is a very cheerful, optimistic, and spacey girl. According to her friends, she is also careless and can't take a hint. She is also a very grateful person that would repeatedly thank someone who helps her.  !Although she is a bit spacey, she actually has photographic memory.!  !In the end, she marries Kanata.!

characters.name: Misumi Tozawa
characters.description: Tozawa Misumi was a student at the Aeterna Girls' Academy, where she befriended her classmate [Yuuki Asuna](https://anilist.co/character/36828/Asuna-Yuuki). Being one of the 1,000 beta testers for Sword Art Online, Misumi encouraged Asuna to play the game with her in the official release.   !On November 6, 2022, Misumi became one of the 10,000 players trapped in the public release version Sword Art Online and temporarily formed a party with Asuna, until an accident in the field led her to believe that the latter had been killed by monsters. Since then, Misumi became one of the Clearers to help defeat the game's bosses in order to beat the game.!

characters.name: Takane Enomoto
characters.description: Species: Human  A strange program taking the shape of a young girl which has taken up residence inside [Shintaro](https://anilist.co/character/67167/Kisaragi-Shintarou)'s computer. She calls him "Master", and yet adores bothering him.  First appeared in Artifical Enemy. A naive cyber girl who lives in Shintaro's computer. She can possibly invade anything that uses electricity and gives her all in doing things that Shintaro hates. Was once a human, but lost her body in a certain experiment. She now possesses the power of immortality from her "opening eyes" ability.

characters.name: Tsubomi Kido
characters.description: A mysterious girl who has appeared before [Shintaro](https://anilist.co/character/67167/Kisaragi-Shintarou) in a shopping center. She's seemingly the leader of the Mekakushi Dan. First appeared in Blindfold Code. A girl that plays the role of the leader of the Mekakushi Dan. She's essentially good-natured, but struggles to keep the individual members, like [Kano](https://anilist.co/character/67943/Kano-Shuuya) and [Seto](https://anilist.co/character/67945/Seto-Kousuke), in line. Using her "eye concealing" ability, she can erase the perception towards objects within a certain distance of herself or her surroundings. She is most always seen listening to music through her earphones.

characters.name: Haruka Kokonose
characters.description: A mysterious albino with supposed amnesia that appeared at Hiyori's relative's house one day during the summer. He was once a human called Haruka Kokonose but somewhere before the current timeline, he was turned into a cyber-being. He is currently living at Hiyori's sister's house as a foster child. Not knowing about the normal world, he's rather my-pace (air-headed, lost, confused). He is known to possess a strong curiosity for the unknown.  Haruka Kokonose was a boy in high school with a severe illness. He would often get tired easily, collapse, and not be able to do much. Caring greatly for any friends he had, he was sweet and gentle. Not once was he combative. Haruka was particularly good at drawing, even going as far as to create his own video game character who was strong, unlike himself. He was good friends with Enomoto Takane before he had particularly terrible symptoms on August 15th. On that day, he disappeared and hasn't been seen since—until Konoha came along, with an apparent bout of amnesia. !On the day of Haruka's worsened symptoms, he was brought to a near-death experience, received Awakening Eyes, and his body remade into Konoha. Haruka rejected his changed body, leading him to remain trapped in the Kagerou Daze and for Konoha to be an empty vessel that the Snake of Awakening Eyes would control to act on Haruka's final wish to make more friends.! !Eventually, in Mekakucity Actors, Haruka is reunited with his body as Black Konoha, taking it over and leaving the Snake of Clearing Eyes to be stopped and ultimately disappear. With his reclaimed body, Haruka is given a chance at life once more, now with more friends than he could ever imagine, and Enomoto.!

characters.name: Shuuya Kano
characters.description: Kano is a young man who is part of the Mekakushi Dan. He outwardly has an unfocused, aloof personality and always has a smile on his face. Because he teases [Marry](https://anilist.co/character/67947/Kozakura-Mary), [Momo](https://anilist.co/character/67949/Kisaragi-Momo), and [Kido](https://anilist.co/character/67171/Kido-Tsubomi) a lot, he's often considered to be a flirt, but when it counts, he's worth relying on. His actual personality, which he hides behind his ability the majority of the time, is quite subdued and mature. !He seems to be mistrustful of others and carries around self-loathing tendencies, believing himself to be "useless". !  (Source: Kagerou Project Wikia)

characters.name: Kousuke Seto
characters.description: First appeared in Imagination Forest. A young man who belongs to the Mekakushi Dan and is from the same orphanage as Kido and Kano. He works as a florist at the shopping center as well as various other fields of work such as traffic control and newspaper delivery. He is also the person that invited Mary into the Mekakushi Dan. With his "eye-stealing" ability, he can read information from any target. However, he dislikes it because, "it's a power where you steal with glances, without needing communication," so he rarely uses it. He has a pet hamster named "Hanao." He also has a habit of wandering around where he shouldn't be.  (Source: Vocaloid Wikia)

characters.name: Me wo Samasu Hebi
characters.description: One of Azami's many snakes that is now connected to Kokonose's eye ability, Awakening Eyes. !The snake controls Haruka Kokonose's remade body, "Konoha", with its empty shell of a personality and fragmented memories. It acts on Kokonose's final wish to make friends, as Konoha. When separated from Konoha in the Kagerou Daze, the snake is more condescending and direct towards Kokonose.!

characters.name: Mary Kozakura
characters.description: First appeared in Imagination Forest. A 1/4-Medusa, 3/4-human girl.   Her parents told her “We’re medusae, so if we make eye contact with a human they’ll be turned to stone.” While growing up, she always stuck to their words and hid herself away from the world in the forest. Even after they died she continued to live alone. By chance, a boy named [Seto](https://anilist.co/character/67945/Seto-Kousuke) visited the forest and found her. He has since brought her to the outside world.   After coming to the Mekakushi Dan’s hideout, and joining the group, she leads a sideline life making fake flowers in her room which generate a very small income. When she went into town to buy ingredients, the first people she met were neighborhood children. They bullied her, and she was traumatized by the incident, so she rarely goes outside anymore. Her ability is to “make eye contact”, which allows her to temporarily stop the movement of whoever meets her gaze.

characters.name: Hibiya Amamiya
characters.description: First appeared in Heat-Haze Days. A boy that visits the city to take summer courses with Hiyori. He is known to be very mature for his age, yet has a cheeky personality. His quarrels with Momo are endless. On August 15, he becomes involved in a certain incident with Hiyori, but is the only one saved, and obtains the “eye focusing” ability under these circumstances.   (Source: Vocaloid Wikia)

characters.name: Shintarou Kisaragi
characters.description: The main protagonist of the manga and brother of Momo Kisaragi, Shintaro is a hikikomori and as such, he has a hard time dealing with people. He seems to be constantly bothered by Ene.  First appeared in Transparent Answer. A hikikomori (recluse/shut-in) young man with an IQ of 168. In middle school and high school, he performed at the top of his class in National Mock Examinations, but due to the suicide of a close friend (Ayano), he dropped out of his first year of high school. Subsequently, a mysterious software enters into his computer named "Ene," and, being unable to control her actions, his lifestyle is at a loss. Due to one of Ene's pranks, his computer breaks down, so both Ene and him go to the department store for shopping where they happen upon a group of terrorists. They end up stopping them together with the Mekakushi Dan. After this, he and Ene come to join the Mekakushi Dan.  !Shintaro's eye ability, given to him by Marry after promising long ago to "never forget this Tragedy", allows him to remember everything he sees. Unlike others, he does not visit the Kagerou Daze each Route to gain this ability and instead has it since before birth. When his ability is fully activated, he can remember events of past Routes and directly speak with the Snake of Retaining Eyes. In Manga Route 2, Ayano trades her life to become the snake for this ability.!

characters.name: Kahabell
characters.description: Ready to enforce justice no matter the common sense with her indomitable spirit, Kahabell's actions reflect that of a truly fanatical knight. She is also known to be rather sadistic as she enjoys the sensation of cutting the flesh of living things.

characters.name: Keita Torii
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Game Master
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Hosshi
characters.description: She's a character that appears before round 7 starts. She's a friend of Iu

characters.name: Yuusuke Yotsuya
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Yuka Tokitate
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Iu Shindou
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Kusue Hakozaki
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Zheren
characters.description: A mysterious merchant that Lawrence and Holo meet on their journey when they visit a monastery. He suggests a "get rich quick" scheme to Lawrence involving reminted coins.

characters.name: Marten Liebert
characters.description: He is a business worker for Hans Lemerio.

characters.name: Marhait Liechten
characters.description: The manager of the large Pattio branch of the Milone Company. He is a calm, cool, and collected man who speaks very politely.

characters.name: Holo
characters.description: Height: 160 cm (5'2)  Holo is a wolf harvest deity originally from a land in the north known as Yoitsu. She made a promise with men from a town called Pasloe where she would ensure the town would have good wheat harvests year after year. However, as time went on, the townspeople slowly started to forsake Holo and did not rely on her as they once did. As such, Holo escapes from town in [Lawrence's](https://anilist.co/character/7374/) wagon and started traveling with him to see how much the world has changed since she has been in Pasloe. Holo has chosen the form of a girl younger than Lawrence, though she still retains her large wolf tail and ears. Her true form is that of a very large wolf which many people revered and feared.    She refers to herself as the "Wise Wolf of Yoitsu" (ヨイツの賢狼). She is typically very haughty and self-sufficient, though due to her isolation for hundreds of years in Pasloe, she gradually feels very lonely, and sometimes shows a more fragile side of herself towards Lawrence, whom she relies on for company. Holo fears this loneliness, along with the difference in lifespans that she and Lawrence have, but hides it the best she can with jokes. She has a peculiar way of speaking, modeled after that of the oiran high-class courtesans. She is fond of delicious food and alcohol, but especially loves apples. She takes pride in her tail and takes special care of it, constantly combing and maintaining it.

characters.name: Kraft Lawrence
characters.description: Height: 178 cm (5'10'')   Kraft Lawrence is a twenty-five-year-old traveling peddler who goes from town to town buying and selling various things in order to make a living. When he was twelve, he became an apprentice to a merchant relative, and set out on his own at eighteen. His goal in life is to gather enough money to start his own shop, and he has already been traveling for seven years while gaining experience in the trade. He meets Holo one night and eventually agrees to her traveling with him. She helps him by providing her wisdom which helps to increase his profits and get him out of jams. Lawrence usually goes by his surname, only some who have known him for a long time, like Jakob Tarantino, the master of his guild, call him by his first name Kraft in the novel.

characters.name: Nora Arendt
characters.description: She is a skilled shepherdess from a church-town named Lubinheigen. Her companion in this profession is a well-trained sheep dog named Enekk.

characters.name: Fermi Amarty
characters.description: He is a young man who works as a fish broker.   !Amarty is in love with Holo. He wants Lawrence to sign a contract in order to buy Holo.!

characters.name: Dian Rubens
characters.description: Dian is an alchemist who is in the process of chronicling pagan tales and beliefs so as to print them in books.   !She is actually an immortal bird deity, similar to how Holo is a wolf deity.!

characters.name: Mark
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Kino
characters.description: **Gender**: Male **Hair Color**: Brown (2003 anime), blonde (2017 anime & manga) **Eye Color**: Brown (2003 anime), blue (2017 anime)  The original Kino was a young man who traveled by the same three-day rule that the main character, [Kino](https://anilist.co/character/87/Kino), does. His arrival in Land of Adults sparks the beginning of the story, and is Kino's inspiration to travel after they attempt to discover his past. Kino often make statements similar to the original Kino's and even quotes him on occasion.  Kino is a tall and very thin man when he arrived at Land of Adults. They note that he arrived on foot, and while ridiculed by the guards, he appeared to display immerse dignity. His first appearance shows him disheveled, wearing a black jacket with a long, dusty brown coat, with a tattered backpack. He also wore boots that the young Kino had never seen before. They note that his cheeks were sunken, and that due to the guards' ridicule, white insect powder clung to his hair. They also state that they are unable to understand the language that he sings in, and that he does so quite poorly.  Kino lived with his mother in a country by a large forest. Growing up, he told his mother that he would like to travel. He believed that the traveling related to not only his own growth, but also to the growth of his country. As the years passed, he traveled from his home more and more frequently.  Kino is shown to know how to repair machinery - he salvages and repairs a motorcycle which eventually is named Hermes, after an old motorcycle he had used to travel with before.  !He is blamed for the younger Kino's refusal for their grown-up operation, and attempts to leave the country before the situation escalates. However, he dies protecting the child when their father attempts to kill young Kino for disobeying their parents and the country's culture.!  (Source: Kino's Journey Wiki, edited)

characters.name: Shishou
characters.description: **Hair Color**: Black, grey **Eye Color**: Gray (2003 anime)  Shishou is a former traveler who traveled the world several years ago before settling down in a forest near the Land of Adults. She is considered both scoundrel and savior as she is hailed a hero in some countries and a wanted fugitive in others. She's very adept in military skills comparable to that of a seasoned tactical officer as well as extensible knowledge in situational survival, gun skills, and bartering. She's depicted as a leader and mentor. Her companion, Aibou, defers to her for decisions, and she skillfully mentors [Kino](https://anilist.co/character/87/Kino) in the usage of firearms. It is implied that she is also afraid of ghosts.  Shishou, in her old age, is noted to seem fragile. Despite this, she stands with excellent posture, with her gray hair tied back. At her forest home, she is dressed in a light green cardigan over slim pants and a white shirt. She also wields a persuader. In her youth, she had long black hair and wore elegant looking clothes.  In [Gakuen Kino](https://anilist.co/manga/41263/Gakuen-Kino/), Shishou is Kino's grandmother and secretly a world renown woman of incredible power both hailed and feared by all known only as Granny the Super.  (Source: Kino's Journey Wiki, edited)

characters.name: Riku
characters.description: **Hair Color**: White  Riku is the pet dog of [Shizu](https://anilist.co/character/13970/Shizu), and his loyal vassal. Despite being a dog, he is able to speak. He first appears alongside Shizu in the Land of Colosseum. He refers to his master as Master Shizu at all times. He's oftentimes the narrator of some of the chapters in which center around Shizu, [Ti](https://anilist.co/character/150047/Tifana) and himself.  Riku is a white Samoyed, with white busy fur. He states that while he always looks happy and smiling, that is not how he always feels. Being not only Shizu's pet, but also his only vassal, he cares strongly for his master's well being, and tries in vain to have Shizu reconsider his journey back home. Despite his master's insistence on continuing with his plan, his loyally stays alongside him. He's oftentimes designated as the ward of the children that he and Shizu come across and care for on their travels.  Riku, being a sidekick similar to how [Hermes](https://anilist.co/character/88/Hermes) is to [Kino](https://anilist.co/character/87/Kino), appears to have quite a rivalry with the motorrad. In the Anime, he's only spoken to Hermes, as Kino does not believe Riku can speak when told about the discussion Hermes had with him. In the 2003 anime, he also speaks to Shizu, but in the English version, only barks or whimpers to him in these instances. In the novels and the 2017 anime, Riku speaks to both Kino and Hermes  (Source: Kino's Journey Wiki, edited)

characters.name: Sakura
characters.description: Sakura is a girl from the country Kino visited in the last episode of the anime series. She shares many similarities to Kino, such as her parents also owning an inn. In the English version of the anime series, her name is changed to Lily in order to preserve the explanation that her name, pronounced slightly differently, becomes an insult. The children call her "Silly Willy" instead of "mekura" (盲, "mekura"? meaning "ignorant") and "dokura" (どくら, "dokura"? meaning "poison") in this version.       (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Shizu
characters.description: Shizu is a young man with a great talent for swordsmanship, weilding a katana. He travels in a buggy alongside his vassal and pet Samoyed, [Riku](https://anilist.co/character/15428/Riku), and eventually [Ti](https://anilist.co/character/150047/Tifana), a girl whom Riku and Shizu eventually take in.  [Kino](https://anilist.co/character/87/Kino)'s first impression of Shizu is of a peaceful martyr, despite participating in a tournament of death.  !Despite escaping the Land of the Coliseum as a child, he returns seven years later to participate in the tournament as a means to assassinate his father and end the tyranny.!  Kino and [Hermes](https://anilist.co/character/88/Hermes) occasionally meet up with Shizu and Riku during their travels, but Kino seems to only remember Riku's name.  (Source: Kino's Journey Wiki, edited)

characters.name: Kino
characters.description: Kino is the main character of [Kino's Journey](https://anilist.co/anime/486/Kinos-Journey/). They are a composed, stoic, and precocious teenager who travels with their motorrad, [Hermes](https://anilist.co/character/88/Hermes), in search of a country with specific desired characteristics. Their gender is ambiguous.  !In Land of Adults, Kino's sex is confirmed to be female. They borrow the name "Kino" from [Kino](https://anilist.co/character/3872/Kino) - a traveler they met before his death. Their birth name is left unstated, but there are implications in the anime that their name is "Sakura".!  Kino was born in the Land of Adults with the name of a flower. They dislike it as it resembles that of an insult, which resulted in them being teased. Their original name is never explicitly stated. Their father describes the flower that their named for as a bright red prairie flower that, while short lived, blooms in abundance in the fields just beyond the borders of their home country during their birthday.  Kino is a 15-year-old traveler. Although they appear apathetic at first, they are a caring and understanding person. They travel through different countries to experience their customs and understand their histories, but never stay longer than three days. They are afraid of settling down, because it would cause them to no longer be a traveler.  Kino is an excellent marksman with amazing speed, agility, and accuracy. They initially traveled with a revolver persuader "Canon" which takes six .44 caliber bullets that they used solely for the execution or maiming of other humans or hunting. They were later gifted with a semi-auto persuader, "Woodsman" which replaced their revolver's purpose of hunting. They use "Woodsman" if they are hunting down other humans without an intent to harm or kill. Kino is rarely known to use a sniper persuader "Flute," but when they do, it is used for hunting and long-distance combat. They make use of many knives hidden in various locations in their clothing for cooking, distraction, and close-combat. They also carry a ballistic knife that doubles as a triple-barrelled gun complete with a laser sight as a final deception tactic when they are cornered. They use all of their weapons with extreme proficiency, if not flawlessly.  While adept at being a survivalist, they have a knack to disappear with impeccable timing to prevent physical and/or emotional harm. They often monologue many times to Hermes that they are no "God" and will only take in their environment and the many countries that they visits as they are. Although they is persuaded many times to sway events into the favour of many people during their travels, they are never tempted to follow up proving their unwavering discipline to their principle; "The world is not beautiful; and that, in a way, lends it a sort of beauty." Their honesty is brutal, and their self-loyalty trumps all of their actions. However, they are known to assist others out of their own inconvenience simply because Kino wants to.  Kino has a sweet tooth; it is used as comic relief against a bleak backdrop of survival and hardships of traveling. Another source of comic relief is their preference for tidiness; they are vexed whenever they cannot maintain a well maintained physical figure/appearance.  In [Gakuen Kino](https://anilist.co/manga/41263/Gakuen-Kino/), Kino is a high school magical girl who defeats evil which appear in their world, known as Mysterious Bishoujo Gun Fighter Rider Kino.  (Sources: Kino's Journey Wiki (edited), Wikipedia)

characters.name: Hermes
characters.description: **Gender**: Male  Hermes is a talking motorrad who travels with [Kino](https://anilist.co/character/87/Kino) to various countries and lands.  Hermes was found broken in an alley by the original [Kino](https://anilist.co/character/3872/Kino) during his stay in the Land of Adults. The original Kino and the then eleven-year-old child fixed him, although at the time Hermes could not talk to them. The original Kino decided to give him the name Hermes, after their previous motorrad.  !After the original Kino is killed, [Kino](https://anilist.co/character/87/Kino) uses Hermes to escape the Land of Adults. They keep riding until they collapse into a field filled with flowers. Hermes calls them Kino, believing that to be their name, and they decide to accept the new name to honour their saviour's death.!  Hermes is often pessimistically realist, unbiased, and usually comes across as the comic relief character. He has a tendency to complain, which sometimes annoys Kino. Despite this, he is a very reliable companion both mentally and physically, as he is the only person who Kino can speak with about their innermost thoughts. He is naive and innocent in many ways, often believing things that are only meant as a joke. He also has a habit of trying to state famous quotes, but usually forgets or changes them, prompting Kino to correct him. Although Hermes can be interpreted as a caring companion towards Kino, Hermes however does not care whoever his rider is. His sole purpose is to provide speed while a rider provides him with a direction and balance. If Kino were to be killed, he would have to wait for an extended period of time before another traveler utilizes him as a mode of transportation. Kino is well aware of Hermes's purpose as a motorrad and fiercely protects him from anybody attempting to steal or damage him, as well as themself in order for Hermes to continue having a rider.  Hermes is also extremely intelligent in literal data. He can assess physical situations to an extremely complex degree but is annoyingly vague in expressing it. In the anime, he uses his knowledge to assess a mythical flying machine that was indeed able to fly provided with sufficient thrust.  In [Gakuen Kino](https://anilist.co/manga/41263/Gakuen-Kino/), Hermes is a cell phone strap. He is described as two canvas strips connected by a brass buckle with a Brough Superior SS100 engraved upon it. His personality has not changed.  (Source: Kino's Journey Wiki, edited)

characters.name: Amira
characters.description: A mysterious woman who fell from the sky. She, by all means, wants to reach the northern land called Helheim.  Amira is a very tall young woman with pale skin, violet eyes, and long, flowing, pink hair she ties in two ponytails. Her attire is somewhat unusual, consisting of a white blouse with a black vest above it, and a knee-length tan-colored shirt which acts as a coat, with a maroon and red vest covering her shoulders. She wears white and beige shorts, held up with a black belt, and two long, cowboy-looking boots with folded top edge, patched black in color.

characters.name: Favaro Leone
characters.description: Favaro makes his living as a bounty hunter. He can't live without women, money and wine. His life takes a turn when he meets [Amira](https://anilist.co/character/88554/Amira).  Favaro is a young man with an orange hair styled into an afro, and green eyes. He has a large X-shaped scar on his face. His armor consists of a left pauldron, plate on his left elbow, plates on both of his knees and plated boots.  Speaks with a carefree attitude and is somewhat of a self-proclaimed ladies' man. He doesn't like to be responsible for others and claims that he only watches out for himself.

characters.name: Kaisar Lidfard
characters.description: Kaisar used to be a knight from a prestigious family, but has since become a bounty hunter. He chases Favaro, blaming him for his current status.  Kaisar is a very tall man, with white pants, a green shirt with white stripes and golden buttons, and a dark green vest hung over it, with green arm covers and golden stripes on the wrists. He has his knight's sword sheathed in a navy blue scabbard on his left side at all times. At times he's seen in gray knight's armor; even when he takes the armor off he keeps the leggins of the armor on his legs. Can be often seen holding a knight's pose and usually bears himself with knightly demeanor.  He is a righteous man with a very strong sense of honor, and constantly follows his own ideal of justice. Kaisar is shown to be very empathetic and compassionate, as seen during his meeting with Rita. Because of his tragic past as a rebellious son who was distant from his family, Kaisar now highly values family and abhors other people who take their family for granted. Seems to have a crush on Amira, calling her a beauty on their first encounter.

characters.name: Cerberus
characters.description: Cerberus is the Guard Dog of Hades. She accompanies Azazel on his quest to find out who is behind the theft of the God Key.

characters.name: Bacchus
characters.description: Bacchus is the god that alongside Hamsa is in charge of giving the rewards to the bounty hunters after they have done their job. He is periodically drunk and his love for wine defines his personality. Doesn't tend to get involved in major events unless pushed.  A very tall, black man with a perky red nose and gray hair which is long on the back, and stretches to a beard around his chin tied in a ponytail with a golden tie, and the top of his head is bald.  Wears a long, thick, dark brown overcoat with light brown fur around the top edge and a brown shirt under it and turquoise pants and  large, brown shoes. He is always seen carrying a long, thick, brown staff with a silver top, which he often uses for fighting.  He nicknames Favaro as "Bomber Head", due to his afro.

characters.name: Rita
characters.description: Rita is a young child who lives in Nebelville, and is the daughter of the village doctor. She has short black hair and bangs, and usually wears a lopsided hat. She has somewhat of a quiet and timid personality.  !She is actually a young necromancer. One day a monster invaded the village and killed everyone, leaving her as the only survivor of the massacre. Alone and scared, Rita used the Black Bible to revive her parents and the dead villagers, and concealed all of them behind an magical mist that made the zombies look as if they were alive. For two hundred years she lived with the zombified remnants of the town until she was, in the end, bitten by her own parents. After being spared by Kaisar and becoming an undead, she now follows the former knight in his travels.!

characters.name: Jeanne d'Arc
characters.description: Jeanne d'Arc is a captain of the Orleans Knights. She is a strong, fearless, and honorable warrior.  She is a fairly tall, blonde woman with magenta eyes and fair skin. Most of her long hair is pulled back into a tail, leaving locks of hair on either side of her face and straight-cut bangs free. She is most frequently seen in plate-armor. The armor is white with red accents and consists of an asymmetrical breastplate, pauldrons, gauntlets, a skirt, and boots. The breastplate appears to belted into place over dark teal and brown cloth. Underneath the plating, she wears a long-sleeved top and gloves in dark red and striped maroon leggings

characters.name: Azazel
characters.description: He is the fallen angel since he dared to disobey the God himself. He now tries to get hold of the God's key.

characters.name: Spike Spiegel
characters.description: Height: 185 cm     Spike Spiegel is a tall and lean 27-year-old bounty hunter born on Mars.

characters.name: Faye Valentine
characters.description: One of the members of the bounty hunting crew in the anime series Cowboy Bebop. Although appearing to be no more than her 23 years alive suggests, Faye is actually upwards of 74-years-old, having been put into cryogenic freeze after a space shuttle accident. During the course of the series (set in 2071), Faye manages to cross paths with [Spike](https://anilist.co/character/1) and [Jet](https://anilist.co/character/3) twice before she finally makes herself at home aboard their ship the second time, much to the consternation and disapproval of the two men, both of whom have their own reservations about women in general. Faye herself is brash, egotistical, and quite lazy, despite taking plenty of time to pamper and care for her own appearance. Faye has also been placed under arrest several times in the series and spends much time in handcuffs on the ship. She, at times, expects the boys to take care of bounties for her, while she sits by idly to reap the benefits and eat all their food, another source of conflict.    Seemingly little more than a thorn in her partners’ sides, Faye is actually a well-rounded member of the team. She can handle herself exceptionally well for a woman of her slight appearance, displaying at least once in the series that she packs quite a mean punch. Adept at flying, Faye has stood her ground just as well as Spike has in an aerial dogfight in her ship Red Tail, at times even against Spike in an aerial dogfight. She also excels with guns, and is first seen in the series completely disabling a ship with a Heckler & Koch MP5, though she is immediately apprehended afterward. In the movie, she is seen with the same gun, in addition to her normal companion: a Glock 30. Where Faye really shines, however, is with her mouth. She has an almost unstoppable attitude, and even her sometimes innocent smile can be seen as dangerous. Sarcastic and presumptuous, she rarely appears weak or in need of support. She brags and takes care of herself, never trusting others, cheating and lying her way from one day to the next.

characters.name: Jet Black
characters.description: Jet, known on his home satellite as the "Black Dog" for his tenacity, is a 36-year-old former cop from Ganymede (a Jovian satellite) and acts as [Spike](https://anilist.co/character/1/Spiegel-Spike)'s foil during the series.  Physically, Jet is very tall with a muscular build. He wears a beard with no mustache, and is completely bald save for the back of his head. Spike acts lazy and uninterested, whereas Jet is hard working and a jack-of-all-trades. Jet was once an investigator in the Inter Solar System Police (ISSP) for many years until he lost his arm in an investigation that went awry when his corrupt partner (and friend at the time) betrayed him. His arm was replaced with a cybernetic limb (later revealed to be by choice, as biological replacements were possible, he wanted the fake arm as a reminder of what happened), yet his loss of limb coupled with the general corruption of the police force prompted Jet to quit the ISSP in disgust and become a freelance bounty hunter.  Jet also considers himself something of a renaissance man: he cultivates bonsai trees, cooks, enjoys jazz/blues music (he named his ship the Bebop, referring to a type of jazz), especially Charlie Parker, and even has interest in Goethe. As a character, Jet is the quintessential oyaji or "dad" even though he often wishes people would view him as a more brotherly figure (so as not to seem old).  Jet is skilled with handguns, typically carrying a pre-2004 Walther P99, as well as the use of the netgun. He is good with hand to hand combat as well. Unlike Spike, Jet tends to use more raw muscle than technique. He is also a great mechanic and pilot. Aside from the converted interplanetary fishing trawler vessel Bebop, Jet flies a smaller ship called Hammerhead. The Hammerhead appears to be a modified (Jet added larger engines and fuel tanks) salvage-craft that uses a mechanical arm equipped with a harpoon as its main weapon, which is somewhat analogous to his own mechanical arm. Both the Hammerhead and the Bebop are able to land on water, and have a fishing theme, most likely because Ganymede's surface is mostly covered with water (it is later revealed that the Bebop was originally a fishing ship that Jet "customized" with larger engines).  !During the series, it is revealed that Jet once lived with a woman named [Alisa](https://anilist.co/character/213076/Alisa), who left him because he was too controlling. Later they meet up again when Alisa's new boyfriend [Rhint](https://anilist.co/character/23687/Celonias-Rhint) is wanted for murder. Jet then ends up in a situation somewhat similar to that of [Vicious](https://anilist.co/character/2734/Vicious), where he must hunt down a woman who broke his heart, and her lover.  In a later episode, another Vicious/Spike parallel is set up when Jet finds out that it was his old partner [Fad](https://anilist.co/character/42425/Fad) who betrayed him (though in Jet's case, there was no love affair involved). Fad arranged for Jet's death in a setup, but he survived with only a missing arm and a scar on his face. It is worth noting that Jet managed to face the demons of his past and let them go, in contrast to Spike, who was killed when he confronted his. This is likely due to the contrast in the two approaches to the past. While Spike hid and fled from his past, Jet tracked it down and confronted it.!

characters.name: Vincent Volaju
characters.description: Main antagonist of the movie, Vincent is a rather melancholic introvert.  He was used as a test subject during the experimentation after the Titan War. He was the only survivor in a field of test subjects, ergo, the vaccine only he carried was successful. He was abandoned to die on Titan by the government, but somehow survived and returned to civilization. He has also loved Electra very deeply, but has suffered amnesia from his ordeal and does not remember.  His plan is to release the virus throughout the world, leaving only a handful of survivors. As a side-effect of the virus, Vincent was driven to insanity; which was also aided by the hallucination of golden butterflies he saw continuously (another side-effect of the infection). Vincent is in many ways a contrast to Spike. Aside from equal physical strength and similar physical appearances, Vincent and Spike are both men who consider themselves to be "dead" due to tragic incidents in their pasts, both kept alive by their love of a woman. The archetypal comparisons between the two have lead many fans to argue that the film itself is merely one of Spike's dreams, in which he confronts the guilt of his past and the end of his own life's situation.  Watanabe has declined to deny or confirm this. It has been stated that he may have been inspired by Bob Dylan and that his look is based on Vincent Gallo.

characters.name: Ein
characters.description: Ein is a Pembroke Welsh Corgi brought aboard the Bebop by Spike after a failed attempt to capture a bounty. Ein is a "data dog": while the televised series only briefly hints on the fact that this means Ein's brain was somehow enhanced drastically, the manga shows Ed accessing data stored in Ein's brain via a virtual reality-type interface with which she has a conversation with a human proprietor. It is obvious that Ein is abnormally intelligent, as he is able to answer the telephone, drive a car (just the wheel), use the SSW, play shōgi, and generally do a number of other things that an average canine should not be able to do, but he never talks in a human language during the show. He does, however, speak in Session 18 "Speak Like A Child" after the credits Ein tells Spike "Next Episode: Wild Horses". He is able to "speak" to other species, as demonstrated in Session 17, "Mushroom Samba" (he spoke to a cow with a subtitled bark of "Thanks", to which the cow has a subtitled moo back of "No problem"). It is likely that Ed is the only crew member with any idea of Ein's capabilities, as the other crew members are quick to dismiss Ein, and never seem to acknowledge him as more than a pet. Ein initially takes a shine to Jet, but when Ed joins the crew, he comes around to her as well. Frequently the two trade roles, with Ein expressing very human sentiments via facial expression and Ed regressing to a feral state. He went with Ed after she left the crew, probably because of his attachment to her. His name is a pun on the Japanese word for "dog" (犬 inu) but is also German for "one". "Ein" may also be short for "Einstein", after Albert Einstein, because of the extraordinary intelligence he possesses.

characters.name: Edward Wong Hau Pepelu Tivrusky IV
characters.description: Ed is an eccentric, resourceful, childlike, tomboyish, and intelligent teenager. Ed first encounters the Bebop and its crew when she hacks the ship on its way to Earth. After Ed helps the Bebop crew cash in the Earth hacker bounty, she insists on joining the crew. When [Faye](https://anilist.co/character/2/Valentine-Faye) tries to leave Earth without her, Ed hacks the Bebop and holds it hostage until she is permitted to join.  !Later in the story when the Bebop is back on Earth, the crew stumbles across an orphanage that Ed used to live in. After seeing some old friends there, Ed is informed that her father has come looking for her recently. Ed decides to make up a bounty on her father to convince [Spike](https://anilist.co/character/1/Spiegel-Spike) to find him. When Spike finds him, Ed decides to leave the Bebop with [Ein](https://anilist.co/character/4/Ein) to live with her father on Earth.!

characters.name: Electra Ovilo
characters.description: Electra Ovilo is a veteran of the Titan War. Her love for Vincent caused them to have a short-term relationship, during which Vincent transferred the vaccine to Electra. She is unaware of this until Vincent sets free the Nanomachines on the Monorail and she survives. She meets Spike by chance when he infiltrates a bio weapon lab fronting as a pharmaceutical company where she works. After a few more chance meetings, and witnessing his being shot and thrown from a monorail by Vincent, she teams up with the crew of the Bebop to put an end to Vincent's intent to destroy the population of Mars. The samples of her blood are used to make the vaccine that is spread over Alba city. In the end, it is she who shoots Vincent and kills him. She cries for him when he admits he remembers her and their love for one another as he is dying.   (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yakumo Yuurakutei
characters.description: A legendary rakugo performer who is haunted by his past. He refused to take in any apprentices until he met [Yotarou](https://anilist.co/character/89343/Yotarou).  As a child, Bon had originally trained as a dancer until damage to his leg left him unable to dance. Bon's mother, a geisha, sent him to train as a rakugo performer under the Seventh Generation [Yakumo Yuurakutei](https://anilist.co/character/369125/Yuurakutei-Yakumo) alongside [Shin](https://anilist.co/character/89346/Yuurakutei-Sukeroku), a boy who shows up unexpectedly and is accepted on a whim. While he proved to be adept at the basics of rakugo, and possessed impressive potential to memorize stories, his performances were stiff and lacked emotion and passion. Shin, with his impressive love for rakugo, quickly overtook him. As an apprentice, he was given the name "Kikuhiko." In an attempt to find his own style, Kikuhiko began performing 'bawdy and erotic' stories and discovered his strong ability to personify feminine characters.

characters.name: Sukeroku Yuurakutei
characters.description: Shin was the [Eighth Generation Yakumo's](https://anilist.co/character/89345/Yuurakutei-Yakumo) lifelong friend and partner growing up, and [Konatsu's](https://anilist.co/character/89707/Konatsu) father. Apprenticed under [Yakumo Yuurakutei](https://anilist.co/character/369125/Yuurakutei-Yakumo) alongside Bon, he was originally given the name "Hatsutarou," but rejected it to instead perform under the name "Sukeroku." As a shin'uchi, his unique and passionate style of performing quickly earns him a name and reputation in the rakugo community, but also strikes a nerve with the traditionalist members of the rakugo association.
