Sukeroku and Kikuhiko made a promise with each other to ensure rakugo's survival as an art form together—Sukeroku would practice rakugo that changed to appeal to the public and Kikuhiko would practice rakugo that never changed and stayed true to its roots. This promise would go unfulfilled when Sukeroku died a tragic death at a young age, but his impact on rakugo as an art never faded.  !As a penniless abandoned child, Shin found himself drawn to a rakugo street performer named Sukeroku, who trained him—making Shin the Second Generation Sukeroku. In his prime, the First Generation Sukeroku was apprenticed alongside the Seventh Generation Yakumo, who sabotaged him and caused his downfall.  When Sukeroku was forced to leave the Yuurakutei household due to both his callous disregard for higher-ranked rakugo performers and Yakumo's own insecurities, he eloped with [Miyokichi](https://anilist.co/character/89577/Miyokichi), with whom he fathered Konatsu. Sukeroku and Miyokichi both died in the titular lovers' suicide.!

characters.name: Amaken
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Matsuda
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Mangetsu Tsuburaya
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Miyokichi
characters.description: A mysterious woman who originally worked as a geisha, thanks to [Yakumo the 7th](https://anilist.co/character/369125/Yuurakutei-Yakumo)'s help. She normally supports [Kikuhiko](https://anilist.co/character/89345/Yuurakutei-Yakumo) by giving him encouragement and watching his rakugo performances.

characters.name: Konatsu
characters.description: Konatsu is the daughter of [Sukeroku](https://anilist.co/character/89346/) and [Miyokichi](https://anilist.co/character/89577/), and Yakumo the 8th's ward.   She normally fights back against what [Yakumo](https://anilist.co/character/89345/) says and wants, and will exhibit this sort of behaviour to anyone else she doesn't trust. She is also a great teacher of rakugo, although somewhat stern.

characters.name: Yotarou
characters.description: An ex-convict, recently released from prison, who seeks out apprenticeship under the legendary Eighth Generation [Yakumo Yuurakutei](https://anilist.co/character/89345/) after witnessing his rakugo performance. He is taken in as Yakumo's first ever student, and is given the name Yotarou (rakugo slang for "fool").  !After ten years of training under Yakumo, he is promoted the rank of shin'uchi. To celebrate, he shaves his head and takes on the title of the Third Generation Sukeroku Yuurakutei.!

characters.name: Renji Togashi
characters.description: Renji Togashi is 42 year old chef working at Kissuiso inn. He is Tohru's mentor and the Head chef. He gets nervous under pressure but is mostly calm and stern. He has an unusual taste in clothes.

characters.name: Satsuki Matsumae
characters.description: Ohana's mother, who works as a professional writer.   Satsuki is seen on bad terms with her own mother, calling her "the mother I've always hated".    !Satsuki had rejected her mother's wishes for her to inherit the inn, leaving her mother and brother to run it as she left for her own life. !  Due to her boyfriend writing her name on his papers, the debt he falls into forces Satsuki to make a moonlight escape from her normal life. As a result, Ohana is sent to her grandmother's inn due to the not-so-motherly nature of Satsuki.  She has a surprisingly infamous reputation at the Inn, being the first topic at hand when staff members talk to Ohana for the first time.

characters.name: Sui Shijima
characters.description: Ohana's grandmother that runs Kissuiso.

characters.name: Tomoe Wajima
characters.description: Senior serving attendant at Kissuisō who likes to gossip.  Tends to be jealous of any younger girls/woman that have a boyfriend.

characters.name: Ohana Matsumae
characters.description: **Height:** 160 cm  She is an energetic and mostly optimistic school girl. She was born in Tokyo, but is sent to live at her grandmother's inn, Kissuisō, when her mother elopes with her boyfriend to avoid debt. At her grandmother's request, she works at the inn as compensation for her residency. Before she leaves, her best friend, [Kouichi Tanemura](https://anilist.co/character/39195/Kouichi-Tanemura), confesses to her. However, he runs off before she can answer him. Ohana now feels awkward whenever she thinks about him. Her desire to help others usually backfires or goes unappreciated. As a result of her mother's poor parenting, she became independent at a young age and grew up with the mentality of relying on herself only. However, since she was working at Kissuisō, she has realized how tough it is to go through life alone and begins to rely on others. She goes to the same high school as [Minko](https://anilist.co/character/37212/Minko-Tsurugi), [Nako](https://anilist.co/character/37215/Nako-Oshimizu), and [Yuina](https://anilist.co/character/39194/Yuina-Wakura).   !After Kissuiso's temporary closing, she moves back to Tokyo with her mother.!

characters.name: Kouichi Tanemura
characters.description: Ohana's best friend, who is in love with her. He does things in a patient and round about manner.

characters.name: Minko Tsurugi
characters.description: Height: 165 cm (5'5")  Minko is an apprentice chef and resident at Kissuisō. She has a very cold demeanor, often telling [Ohana](https://anilist.co/character/36184/Ohana-Matsumae) to 'die' following their first encounter, though when this is considered too harsh by [Ohana](https://anilist.co/character/36184/Ohana-Matsumae), she settles for calling her a balut instead. Though she is hard working, she becomes passive when being scolded for her mistakes and is usually victim to [Ohana](https://anilist.co/character/36184/Ohana-Matsumae)'s mishaps. She displays great jealousy when [Ohana](https://anilist.co/character/36184/Ohana-Matsumae) is praised by other staff. She attends the same high school as [Ohana](https://anilist.co/character/36184/Ohana-Matsumae), [Nako](https://anilist.co/character/37215/Nako-Oshimizu) and [Yuina](https://anilist.co/character/39194/Yuina-Wakura)   !Minko is very popular among the boys in her class, but she turns down all of their love confessions as she secretly has a crush on Tohru. She discovers that Tohru has feelings for Ohana (although Ohana is oblivious to Tohru's feelings) and, as a result, feels jealous of Ohana.!  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Nako Oshimizu
characters.description: **Height:** 168 cm (5'6")   Nako is a cleaning maid and waitress working part-time at Kissuisō. She has a shy and timid personality, with a tendency to avoid unwanted social interaction. She is, however, confident about her swimming ability, having been swimming since she was three, she was nick named the "Kappa Girl". She attends the same high school as [Ohana](), [Minko](https://anilist.co/character/37212/Minko-Tsurugi) and [Yuina](https://anilist.co/character/39194/Yuina-Wakura).

characters.name: Morgana
characters.description: Height: 60 cm (Bipedal) - 50 cm (Cat, including tail) Initial Persona: Zorro Transforming Persona: Mercurius Fusion Persona: Diego  Morgana is an amnesiac that remembers almost nothing about his past or himself, believing that the cause is the distortions within Mementos. This causes him to lose his sense of self in the process and wishes to get it back. Despite his appearance of a mysterious cat-like creature, he believes himself to have been human. He theorizes the core of Mementos may have the answers, but access from most of it is blocked and he cannot go very deep. In order to achieve his goal, he began to investigate the Metaverse and checked on numerous Palaces for clues.  !Before being imprisoned and replaced by Yaldabaoth, Igor created Morgana out of the last remaining traces of human hope, and his role is to assist the protagonist in his journey.!

characters.name: Makoto Niijima
characters.description: Height: 164 cm  Arcana: Priestess Initial Persona: Johanna Transforming Persona: Anat Fusion Persona: Agnes  Makoto is a perfectionist who has a strong sense of responsibility. Like her previous Priestess counterparts, Makoto is intelligent, honest, and very hardworking. In truth, she is a very compassionate and understanding young lady who strives to ensure everyone is accounted for. She is Shujin Academy's student council president and lives a double life as a Phantom Thief.

characters.name: Haru Okumura
characters.description: Height: 158 cm Arcana: Empress Initial Persona: Milady Transforming Persona: Artarte Fusion Persona: Lucy  Haru has good communication and observational skills. She grew up with all the elegance and splendor. She finds it difficult to differentiate between those who truly value her as a friend and who merely want to use her for her family's status. After meeting and joining the Phantom Thieves, Haru becomes passionate and rebellious and eventually learns how to properly convey her mind and connect with others.

characters.name: Futaba Sakura
characters.description: Birth Name: Futaba Isshiki Height: 152 cm Arcana: Hermit Initial Persona: Necronomicon Transforming Persona: Prometheus Fusion Persona: Al Azif  A genius 15-year-old​ girl with otherworldly calculation and programming skills. Her interpersonal communication is extremely poor though, so she lives life as a shut-in with limited to no human interaction.

characters.name: Ann Takamaki
characters.description: Height: 168 cm Arcana: Lovers Initial Persona: Carmen Transforming Persona: Hecate Fusion Persona: Célestine  Ann Takamaki is a playable character from Persona 5. She is a student at Shujin Academy who lives a double life as a Phantom Thief. After being ridden with guilt of not helping her best friend Shiho Suzui who would fall victim to Suguru Kamoshida and would lose ties with her in the process, she would support her friends while facing, overcoming, and promising not to make the same mistake again.

characters.name: Gorou Akechi
characters.description: Height: 178 cm (5'10")  Akechi is a high school student who conducts a detective business. His abilities as a detective have been widely acclaimed, since he not only has solved numerous cases but is also able to deal with people from the investigation agency smoothly. His handsome features draw public attention, and people comment on him as “The Second Advent of the Detective Prince.” He represents the Justice Arcana.  !He works behind the scenes as the Black Mask responsible for many of the mental shutdown and psychotic breakdown incidents, acting as an assassin for [Shido](https://anilist.co/character/153729/Shido-Masayoshi)'s political gain.!

characters.name: Ren Amamiya
characters.description: Height: 175 cm (5'9") Initial Persona:  Arsène Ultimate Persona: !Satanael!  The protagonist of Persona 5. He is a transfer student at Shujin High School and is infamous due to his criminal record. He was transferred to Shujin on probation by the court due to the alleged assault filed against him. During his probation, he lives in the cellar of Cafe Leblanc owned by Sakura Sojiro, which is also his acting guardian.   Ren has a strong sense of justice, as noted by his fellow friends and confidants. He also has a strong will for rebellion, as noted by his Persona, Arsene. It is due to that strong will of rebellion that he could awaken his Persona and break free from the shackle of society. It is also noted by some people that Ren is very charismatic even though he appears as an unassuming and silent, sometimes airheaded person.  !It is revealed that the case of assault filed against him was a setup to keep Masayoshi Shido's name clean for the upcoming election. The woman Shido sexually harassed and the one Ren tried to protect was forced to testify against him, saying that he indeed assault Shido.!

characters.name: Ryuuji Sakamoto
characters.description: Height: 175 cm Arcana: Chariot Initial Persona: Captain Kidd Transforming Persona: Seiten Taisei Fusion Persona: William  Ryuuji is known as a disruptive "problem student" at school whose bad behavior causes all sorts of trouble for the teachers. His rebellious, mischievous, and disobedient nature are the perfect qualities to be a Phantom Thief. He is a bit short-tempered, easily taking offense from even the slightest of comments from others, and can sometimes even resort to violence.

characters.name: Yuusuke Kitagawa
characters.description: Height: 181.9 cm Arcana: Emperor Initial Persona: Goemon Transforming Persona:  Kamu Susano-o Fusion Persona: Gorokichi  Yusuke is a very composed and collected individual, and upon further inspection, this extends to a sense of methodical intelligence and a highly observant nature. He acts with poise and elegance, displayed by his eloquent, poetic way of speaking. He is able to remain calm even in dire circumstances, but can also act dramatically at times; others have pointed him out as weird, and even Yusuke admits that he can be seen as eccentric.

characters.name: Strength
characters.description: Height: 158 cm    Strength is Yuu's darken persona in the other world. She wears long black boots similar to Black Rock Shooter's, black spandex and a white flamed embroidered hooded scarf. She has a vertebra like tail with white hair. Her main weapons are her two large black "Ogre Fists" that she wears over her arms and are as big as she is.  In the TV series, she gained emotions when she established a connection with Yuu just as she was about to die following a fight with Black Rock Shooter. When Yuu preferred to live in her world than reality, Strength was forced to switch bodies with Yuu, although she doesn't cast a shadow. She inserted false memories of herself into Mato to make it seem like they've been friends for a long time, though she eventually came to like Mato herself. She has the ability to put herself or others into a comatose state, sending their mind into the body of their darken persona. At the series conclusion, she disappears into the wind, returning Yuu to her original body, although she revives later on to continue fighting.  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Mato Kuroi
characters.description: Height: 155 cm  Mato takes an interest in and speaks to a girl she sees the first day, Takanashi Yomi. They became best friends.  Black★Rock Shooter (OVA) Mato is an innocent and naive first year student in middle school. Outwardly, she is outgoing and excitable, but she is very awkward around people she does not know. Internally, she is sensitive and meek, but eventually learns to gain courage.  Black★Rock Shooter (Anime) Mato retains most of her appearance from the OVA, aside from wearing a different, non-seifuku school uniform. The patch of bandage on her right knee is gone, though she now has a bandaid on her right thigh. She is fond of philosophical musings, and often will vaguely say something that she sees (for instance, remarking "blooming" when seeing a patch of flowers) to no one in particular. Saya also describes her as the kind of person who has, until now, never hated anyone or have anyone hate her. Her favorite food is said to be curry.  She is very fond of the book Li'l Bird Li'l Bird Colorful Colors and reads it repeatedly.

characters.name: Yuu Koutari
characters.description: Height:150 cm    Black★Rock Shooter (OVA) Yuu has choppy tawny hair and hazel eyes. She is also very short in stature, much more so than Mato or Yomi. She wears the same school uniform as the former and latter. Yuu is excitable and perky; however, she is shown to have a dark side. She is also very possessive of Mato, and has an awkward time whenever she is hanging out with Yomi.  Black★Rock Shooter (Anime) Yuu's hair is more combed down, and not as choppy as it was in the anime. She also now wears an orange hairclip on her left side, and wears a school uniform different from her OVA appearance. Similar to her OVA incarnation, she is excitable and perky; she is also eager to tease Mato often. Unlike her OVA incarnation, however, she is perfectly comfortable with the idea of Mato having other friends, and in fact actively teases Mato about her friendship with "her Tiny Bird".  She is fond of skipping classes in favor of drinking coffee at the consultation room. Mato notes that she is trying to be mature for some reason, and indeed she takes concern over Mato's well-being. Mato also says that when she knew her in kindergarten, she was excessively more hyper, and often did "weird things". However, this personality is of Strength, who was in Yuu's body in the real world.   !The real Yuu, who was in Strength's body in the Otherworld, was a stoic and silent person who was constantly hurt by bullying and familial problems, and had a vast amount of knowledge of the "other selves" and the Otherworld. Though it seemed as if the pain didn't affect her, she was actually heavily affected by it, to the point where she switched places with Strength because the pain Strength had to endure in the Otherworld was much simpler, only needing to fight and not worry about anything else.!

characters.name: Dead Master
characters.description: Height: 167 cm    Dead Master has black hair and straight bangs, and neon green eyes. Her clothes consist of a simple Gothic lolita costume. She wears a black dress and a black bolero; her dress extends down to her thighs and is accented with a white ribbon attached to her waist. Dead Master also wears a pair of leggings and a pair of black pumps. She wears a pair of black gauntlets on each hand. On her head is a pair of long horns which resemble a pair of vertebrae with each tip made out of three tips joined at the end. Also has a pair of wings which sit low on her back. She fights with Dead Scythe, and she can also use chains.

characters.name: Black★Gold Saw
characters.description: Original Concept Black Gold Saw is a girl with red eyes and long black hair. A red flame shoots out from her right eye. She has a pair of curved black horns whose color turns to red as it reaches the tip. Like Dead Master, Black Gold Saw also has skeletal claws. Her outfit is similar to Black★Rock Shooter's except for the design of her jacket and her bikini top; her jacket extends into a worn-out cape which is dyed red at the end.  Her weapon of choice is a large sword with golden blade and a black saw-edge on its reverse side. It has a long handle with a skull-like object on top and a hilt shaped like a crescent; its name is King Saw.   Black★Rock Shooter (OVA) In the OVA, her jacket is shorter, and she also wears armoured boots with pointed crescent designs. Like all of the "other selves," her eyes have a circular pattern in them. Notably, Black Gold Saw's red flame is not present at all during her appearance.    Black★Rock Shooter (Anime) Her jacket seems to bear a little bit of resemblance to MEFE's clothing. Her sleeve have a red belt attached to it along with two white line running across just above the belt's line. Her jacket is tied together with a white ribbon. Her shorts is a little bit longer and had more details to it. Her belt is also different. Unlike the OVA design, she had no black thigh-high socks although her grieves are pretty much the same, except for some changes, notably at the base of the foot. Her claws are very much the same as that of BRSB now, but, it's still more skeletal. Her King Saw has a new look as well, with a very much shorter blade and a sawblade on the hilt.    Abilities Black Gold Saw has demonstrated many abilities in the 2012 anime, more than she ever did in the OVA. She may have some time or reality-altering abilities in terms of the Otherworld, as she managed to stop the destruction of Chariot's world as if she had stopped its time and had seemingly cut reality itself when driving Dead Master into the ground. She also has the ability to create beings, as she creates the strange hooded figures from a watering can. This watering can is also able to sprinkle a mirror-like surface on the ground that shows Saya's memories. She is also able to see things far away using her giant eyes as shown in Episode 1 and Episode 4. She can also summon a massive King Saw out of the ground.    (Source: Black★Rock Shooter Wiki)

characters.name: Yomi Takanashi
characters.description: Height: 160 cm    Yomi is a gentle, good-natured girl who speaks politely and calmly; she is very mature for her age. Her name literally means "No hawks, where little birds play." She is supposedly a member of a well-to-do family, staying for some time in Germany before moving to Mato's neighborhood. She also revealed that her frequent moving from one place to another has caused her to develop a sort of distant attitude towards others. However, she is prone to having very dark feelings of loneliness and jealousy; she tends to keep these to herself.   In the 2012 anime, Yomi's personality is somewhat different in that while she is still calm, reserved, and polite, she is also extremely aloof to the point where she is unwilling to make friends. Part of this is her attachment to Kagari Izuriha, both due to the fact that she blames herself for Kagari's injury and because catering to all of Kagari's demands was initially easier than coping with the mental trauma.  Unlike her OVA incarnation, she is more interested in things like art and bracelet making. Like Mato, she likes the book Li'l Bird Colorful Colors.

characters.name: Black★Rock Shooter
characters.description: Height: 163 cm    Black★Rock Shooter is the titular character and main protagonist of many projects, including the anime OVA Black★Rock Shooter, the RPG of the same name, the anime series and the manga Black★Rock Shooter Innocent Soul. She was an original concept created by huke who participated in the release of the song "Black★Rock Shooter" by supercell. She is voiced by Kana Hanazawa in the OVA and anime and by Maaya Sakamoto in the PSP game.    Her weapons consist of a black-hilted katana later named as Black Blade and a large gun called ★rock Cannon.  Black★Rock Shooter is given a personality in the OVA: she is depicted as a calm and collected girl, not speaking at all until her confrontation with Mato. She also does not focus on anything except the most important thing she has to do at the moment. She is shown to be very skilled in fighting.  Black★Rock Shooter in the anime seems to be more brutal than any other B★RS incarnation.

characters.name: Hiro Kuroi
characters.description: Mato's little brother. Although the two don't always get along, he considers his sister a good person.

characters.name: Togonosuke Makanai
characters.description: The former Prime Minister of Arbrau, he was ousted and forced to exile on an island within the Oceanian Federation. After Makanai meets up with Kudelia upon her arrival on Earth, he requests for Tekkadan to escort him to a plenary session of parliament in hopes for his re-election.

characters.name: Mikazuki Augus
characters.description: A member of the Martian private security firm CGS. Calm and collected, with a head for the big picture, he's undyingly loyal to his friends. The most experienced mobile weapon operator in CGS, he is assigned to pilot the Gundam Barbatos.  (Source: Gundam.info)

characters.name: Kudelia Aina Bernstein
characters.description: A young girl who agitates for Chryse's independence from Earth.

characters.name: Orga Itsuka
characters.description: A leader among the boys of CGS. Naturally gifted as a commander, and trusted implicitly by the others, he strives to live up to their admiration. He's especially close to [Mikazuki](https://anilist.co/character/89233/Augus-Mikazuki), who he's known since a very young age; their bond is closer than most blood brothers. His coup within CGS is launched to give the boys a place where they won't be betrayed anymore.  (Source: Gundam.info)

characters.name: Almiria Bauduin
characters.description: Engaged to McGillis at a young age, Almiria is enthusiastic of the arrangement and works to make sure she'll be a proper wife. She is the sister of Gaelio Bauduin.

characters.name: McGillis Fareed
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Azee Gurumin
characters.description: Azee is a pilot under Teiwaz with a cool personality, she carries out orders from Naze Turbine calmly during combat.   Azee is a highly skilled pilot and is easily far more capable than most pilots, even those who utilize the Alaya-Vijnana system. Only those of extreme skill and/or talent could be considered greater than herself. However, her skill only truly shines when she's fighting alongside her companion Lafter as both are highly trained to fight in sync with the other.  Not much is known of Azee's past other than that like Naze's other wives she was rescued from poor circumstances and accepted the offer to join his crew the Turbines years ago. Ever since then she has served as one of Naze's most skilled pilots, and one of his wives, alongside her partner Lafter, also a wife of Naze.   Unit: STH-05 Hyakuren STH-05R Rouei STH-16 Shiden STH-20 Hekija

characters.name: Hanazono
characters.description: **Occupation:** Spy **Affiliation:** Lamplight **Skills:** She has a knack on concocting poisons that can either paralyze or kill her targets.  Lily is one of the main protagonists in the Spy Classroom series. She is the team leader of Lamplight. She wants to become a spy due to her life being saved by one after she survived a poison gas attack during the Great War. Due to her concern for the Lamplight team and her own skills, she is designated by [Klaus](https://anilist.co/character/197206/Klaus) to be the team leader for Lamplight.

characters.name: Gujin
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Hyakki
characters.description: **Occupation:** Spy **Affiliation:** Lamplight **Skills:** She is good at stealing and is the most athletic member of the team.  Sibylla is one of the main protagonists in the Spy Classroom series. She was born into a gangster family, and she and her younger siblings were forced to help in gang activities. She has a strong sense of justice and wanted to be a spy to protect her younger siblings.

characters.name: Manamusume
characters.description: **Occupation:** Spy **Affiliation:** Lamplight **Skills:** She is skilled in disguises, and can even disguise herself as a man without being detected.  Grete is one of the main protagonists in the Spy Classroom series. She was the daughter of a politician but for some reason, she was forced out of her birthplace, and she seems to have decided to become a spy. Although she has an excellent brain, she has a deep-rooted distaste for men.

characters.name: Hyojin
characters.description: **Occupation:** Spy **Affiliation:** Lamplight **Skills:** She is a genius and excels in every skill, making her the most talented spy among the members of Lamplight   Monika is one of the main protagonists in the Spy Classroom series. She is the daughter of an artist, she ran away from home to become a spy, and within a short period of time, she became the top student at the training school. However, for some reason, she rapidly loses her ambition and is scouted by Lamplight after failing her grades.

characters.name: Yumegatari
characters.description: **Occupation:** Spy **Affiliation:** Lamplight **Skills:** She is both a master negotiator and a professional seductress, able to use her charms to extract information and achieve her goals.  Thea is one of the main protagonists in the Spy Classroom series. She is the oldest and most attractive member of Lamplight, and was the daughter of a newspaper company president and abducted when she was 11 as a hostage. However, she was saved by a spy who she admired and who became her inspiration to become one herself.

characters.name: Sougen
characters.description: **Occupation:** Spy **Affiliation:** Lamplight **Skills:** She has a talent for rearing and training animals, using her skills to train pet animals to perform tasks and assist her in various missions.  Sara is one of the main protagonists in the Spy Classroom series. She is a timid but kind-hearted girl who tends to add "ssu" at the end of her words. She is the daughter of a chef and restaurant owner in a rural town.

characters.name: Bouga
characters.description: **Occupation:** Spy **Affiliation:** Lamplight **Skills:** She is a talented engineer and serves as the resident tech expert, though her inventions have been known to cause mayhem, especially during her time at her old school.  Annette is one of the main protagonists in the Spy Classroom series. She has no memories from her past before she join training school, and she became a spy because of her special skills, without even knowing who she was.

characters.name: Klaus
characters.description: **Occupation:** Spy **Affiliation:** Lamplight, Inferno  Klaus is one of the main protagonists in the Spy Classroom series. He is the boss of Lamplight and a former member of Inferno, who re-established Lamplight after Inferno was wiped out. Self-proclaimed "the Greatest Spy in the World". Despite being "the Greatest Spy in the World", he is terrible at teaching as he does things intuitively.

characters.name: Yui Natsukawa
characters.description: A student of Seidou High School and one of the managers of the Seidou Baseball club.

characters.name: Masaru Katou
characters.description: Height: 192 cm  Masaru Katou has a good personality; he loves to help people and easily cares for everyone. His parents are dead so he is responsible for his younger brother who he is fiercely protective of. Katou usually takes the position of being a leader because he has good authority, but is unable to hurt others which hinders his performance in the game of Gantz.  Masaru Katou was [Kei Kurono](https://anilist.co/character/2867/Kurono-Kei)'s childhood friend. They meet each other again the day they die because Katou was trying to help a drunk off of the train line, with Kurono reluctantly lending him a hand.

characters.name: Kei Kishimoto
characters.description: Height: 160 cm   Kei Kishimoto appeared in the Gantz room naked due to her committing suicide in the bath. Originally Kurono is infatuated with Kishimoto. Yet Kishimoto doesn't feel the same way as she's very much in love with Katou, who reciprocates. Gantz gives her many nicknames such as "Big Tits" due to her incredibly large breasts.

characters.name: Joichiro Nishi
characters.description: Joichiro Nishi is a middle-school veteran of the Gantz world, having arrived there over a year before the beginning of the series. While running away from police officers after shoplifting, he fled onto an apartment building roof where he fell to his death.    Much like how Kurono started out, he is also selfish and has a Social Darwinist approach to life. Nishi is reluctant to reveal anything about the Gantz or himself, but he runs a web site where he posts information about it (carefully avoiding Gantz's rule about informing outsiders, which would in turn prove fatal). Gantz calls him "Mr. Nishi," which is rather interesting given how informally or derisively he refers to most of the other participants.      !Nishi is killed at the beginning of the Tanaka/Suzuki Alien mission, but after six months of existing only inside Gantz's memory banks, he is revived by Kaze at Kurono's request following the end of the Oni mission. Ostensibly, Kurono hopes that Nishi will be able to provide information about Gantz to the game players.     After being ostracized and bullied by his classmates, which ended with them hurling him out of the classroom window, he has killed all of them (except one girl who had a crush on him and did not support the rest in wanting to chase him out of the school). After this, civil armed forces are sent to kill Nishi. Nishi manages to kill many of the men sent to kill him, but after an intense battle with the armed forces he is severely wounded and was only able to avoid death because Gantz called the Hunters for a new mission.!

characters.name: Kei Kurono
characters.description: Height: 168 cm  Kei is a 10th grader summoned by Gantz, along with [Kato](https://anilist.co/character/3111/Masaru-Katou), after being hit by a subway train in an effort to help a hobo passed out on the tracks.  Initially Gantz refers to Kurono as "Bitch" and "Loser", though he settles on "Kurono" as the series progresses.

characters.name: Daichi Nozaki
characters.description: Featured only in the Anime. He is the only one who does not have a job or anything else.    He got killed from one of the bum hunters, Kajiura Ryuji, by a machine gun, while stepping before Kurono to take the shots, and save Kurono's life.

characters.name: Mika Kanda
characters.description: Shes a bookstore designer. And before she was taken by Gantz, she was stalked by a stalker. One day she got killed by her stalker.    Featured only in the Anime.    In the end of the mission, Kurono hold her in his arms after being seriously wounded by Hajime Muroto.

characters.name: Masanobu Hojo
characters.description: A former model who died after being hit by a truck driver who fell asleep. At his time of death, his stalker, Sadako, was on the back of the bike he borrowed to escape her. (from Wikipedia)

characters.name: Tetsuo Nemoto
characters.description: Has a wife and a son. Head of a small gang.

characters.name: Tomoe Enjou
characters.description: Height: 158 cm  In the middle of October 1998, he was attacked by bullies from his old school and saved by [Ryougi Shiki](https://anilist.co/character/3105/Ryougi-Shiki). He asked her to hide him at her place and admitted that he had killed his parents because of constant dreams of getting killed by his mother. The origin that he has is "worthlessness".

characters.name: Kiba
characters.description: The (more or less) leader of the "pack", Kiba follows his instincts towards Paradise. When he was young, his pack and family were slaughtered when the forest where he lived was burned to the ground by Jagara's troops. He was then raised by a native who told him that he had a purpose, explaining why the forest spared his life. This native told him that he would have a great journey ahead of him, and that journey was to find paradise. Kiba begins his quest for paradise in the hope that there he will finally find peace. He tends to be distrustful of humans, and in the early episodes is reluctant to take a human form, even when it's more convenient. He also has a 'love' for Cheza, which may only be due to the fact that she can lead them to paradise. Kiba seems to be an arctic wolf in the series.

characters.name: Tsume
characters.description: Tsume is a rough, self-reliant wolf. In the past, he was part of a pack. However, one day his pack was attacked by Jagara's troops and many of his friends were killed. During the fight, Tsume attempted to flee, leaving all of his dead and dying brethren behind. Because of this, the rest of his group disowned him and the leader attacked him, leaving him with a large X-shaped scar across his chest. He was filled with shame, and for many years after didn't associate with any other packs. However, he eventually meets Toboe, who at first seems to annoy him. But, deep down, Tsume feels sympathy and compassion for Toboe, who is the one who eventually convinces him to come with the rest of the "pack" to Paradise. He initially doesn't believe the stories of Paradise, and only follows the others out of an instinct to protect them and stay part of a pack. He often fights with Kiba. However, he does eventually become a believer and enjoy the company of his pack mates. After Kiba, he seems to be the best fighter among all the wolves and also seems to be more logical and observant than all the other wolves; thus it can be argued that he is the most intelligent. Tsume seems to be an Eurasian wolf or tundra wolf in the anime series.   (Source: Wikipedia)    Tsume's name means "claw" in Japanese.

characters.name: Hige
characters.description: Hige seems to know how to function the best in human society, even wearing a dog collar, although the true meaning behind his collar is revealed later in the series that is a tag/transmitter . He tends to use his intuition more than the others, but only when he's not thinking with his stomach instead. Hige is quite the ladies' man and is always on the look-out for a nice girl. He has the best sense of smell between the others. Hige seems to be a Mexican wolf in the series.   (Source: Wikipedia)    Hige's name means "beard" or "whiskers" in Japanese.

characters.name: Toboe
characters.description: Toboe is the youngest of the group often acting more like a puppy. Toboe was raised by an elderly woman as a pet. She gave Toboe his silver bracelets. Although she died, Toboe has an affection for humans that none of the other wolves can understand (with the exception of Blue). Toboe looks up to Tsume and usually follows him when the group splits up. He also seems to have the best hearing out of all of them. Toboe seems to be a red wolf or an Arabian Wolf in the series.   (Source: Wikipedia)    Toboe's name means "Howling" in Japanese.

characters.name: Cheza
characters.description: Cheza is the Flower Maiden, a girl who was artificially created from a Lunar Flower by the noble Darcia the First using the lost art of alchemy. First appearing in a state of suspended animation within a scientific research lab, she was awakened by the smell of wolf's blood spilled in the brief fight between Tsume and Kiba. After the wolves steal her away, she is pursued by various other characters, forcing the pack to protect her constantly. She shares a special bond with the wolves and is the key to finding Paradise.  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Darcia III
characters.description: An heir to a noble family line, Darcia became cursed along with the rest of his family when his grandfather attempted to artificially open the wolves' paradise with a machine.  This curse, referred to as 'paradise sickness' throughout the anime, also affected Darcia's lover, Harmona, who is ths rendered into a state of perpetual sleep.  Darcia kidnaps Cheza the flower maiden throughout the series to once again attempt to open the wolves' paradise and save himself and Harmona from their misery.  He has mysterious powers that involve his wolf's eye, which allows him to turn into a wolf in the OVA.    Written by NemoNowAndAlways

characters.name: Cher Degre
characters.description: A scientist involved in studying Cheza. She is fascinated by Cheza and desires to understand her and her purpose. She and Hubb were once married, but divorced after her work with Cheza became more important than her marriage. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Hubb Lebowski
characters.description: A police detective and ex-husband of Cher Degre. He is still very much in love with Cher and seeks to protect her, often half-jokingly asking if they still have a chance together. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Shigure Minazuki
characters.description: **Height:** 135 cm  The younger sister of Kashou Minazuki. She takes an almost mother-like pride in the catgirls she has trained. Despite her elegant demeanor, she has a gigantic brother complex which occasionally surfaces as love declarations for Kashou.

characters.name: Kashou Minazuki
characters.description: Kashou is very independent and knows how to take care of himself. Being focused on his self-sufficiency, he often isolates himself from others as much as he can.  Kashou is quite serious at times and always looks at reality. He isn't very sociable with others due to his independent demeanor. He'll occasionally avoid any opportunities to start a conversation. Apart from that, he's very nice and takes care of Chocola and Vanilla like little sisters.  As a descendant in a line of pastry chefs, Kashou likes to take pride in his cooking skills. He takes in a hobby of trying out new cooking methods to create the most delicious dishes. He treats every of his baking products with care and with great precision.

characters.name: Chocola
characters.description: **Breed:** Black Cat Mix **Height:** 152 cm  Chocola is a cheerful and energetic catgirl as [Kashou](https://anilist.co/character/130309/Minazuki-Kashou) himself describes her, 'happy-go-lucky.' She doesn't usually get upset, and even when she does, she often swings back to being as cheery as usual, though occasionally she can be genuinely sad about something. She is curious, and has a childlike outlook on things, which is fitting as she and [Vanilla](https://anilist.co/character/88788/Vanilla) are mentioned to be only 9 months old in human terms. She likes Kashou.

characters.name: Vanilla
characters.description: **Breed:** White Cat Mix **Height:** 149 cm  Vanilla is quiet, calm and very stoic. She rarely expresses her emotions, making her a somewhat of a kuudere character, as opposed to her sister's energetic, playful personality. She loves her twin sister [Chocola](https://anilist.co/character/88787/Chocola), and will accompany her always due to her siscon-like relationship towards her.

characters.name: Azuki
characters.description: **Breed:** Munchkin **Height:** 142 cm  The eldest catgirl of the Minazuki Family. She is quite full of energy, but can be rude and has a knack for bad mouthing her younger sisters, despite supposedly being the most grown up. Even so, she cares for her family and sometimes worries for their well-beings.

characters.name: Coconut
characters.description: **Breed:** Maine Coon **Height:** 168 cm  Coconut is the second youngest of the Minazuki catgirls. The others typically consider her to be cool, but Coconut yearns to instead be considered cute and doesn't seem to have much confidence in her body. She has low self-esteem due to her clumsiness and self-proclaimed lack of skills.

characters.name: Cacao
characters.description: Cacao (formerly Sugarcane, the name given by Azuki) is a stray cat found by Chocola when she went out to buy ponzu for tuna. Cacao followed Chocola until she arrived home. The Minaduki thought that this is a lost cat and they tried to find an owner for it but they couldn't find one. Now Cacao lives with Chocola and Vanilla in Kashou Minaduki's house because of Chocola's wish for her to stay there. "Cacao" is a name chosen by Shigure Minaduki and the Minaduki cat-girls later on.

characters.name: Cinnamon
characters.description: **Breed:** Scottish Fold **Height:** 150 cm  The third oldest catgirl in the Minazuki Familly. Cinnamon is typically shy and very cheerful. However, her somewhat active and perverted imagination causes her to interpret various everyday occurrences in a sexual manner and become aroused as a result. She seems rather shameless about this trait as she will do it in public or in front of customers of La Soleil.

characters.name: Maple
characters.description: **Breed:** American Curl **Height:** 157 cm  Maple knows her table manners and is quite knowledgeable in technology. She can easily be said to be the most independent and "mature" of the Minazuki catgirls. However, her elegance could be considered by some to be grating, such as Azuki. The way she acts can be compared to a typical American teenage girl, only way more elegant and refined. Also, she's rude to customers because whenever she walked past them, she hears things and says her opinion out loud.

characters.name: Sachiko Kasukabe
characters.description: She is the deceased grandmother of Hayato.

characters.name: Ouka Makuzawa
characters.description: Vocational student, studying fashion design.

characters.name: Riho Tsukishima
characters.description: A second year college student, and the oldest of the main cast. She's a former child actress who was once regarded as a child genius, but her popularity gradually declined as she grew up. Riho is the most calculating and devious of the girls, putting more thought into managing the cafe than the owner, Hayato, himself.

characters.name: Akane Hououji
characters.description: Part-time worker for the café. Writes music for her band.

characters.name: Hayato Kasukabe
characters.description: A Tokyo U student who returned to his Grandmother's café following her passing; now interim manager.

characters.name: Ami Tsuruga
characters.description: An energetic third-year high school student in the karate club, she works part-time at the Café. Her fighting style consists of moves from the Street Fighter series and other popular works.

characters.name: Shiragiku Ono
characters.description: A second year who attends the same college as Riho, and is the oldest of the main cast along with her. She is a talented cook who specializes in Japanese cuisine. Has a smell fetish. !She is revealed to be a childhood acquaintance of Hayato!

characters.name: Kikka Makusawa
characters.description: Ouka's younger twin sister.

characters.name: Zuikaku
characters.description: Carrier of the Sakura Empire's Fifth Carrier Division.

characters.name: Ayanami
characters.description: Fubuki-Class Destroyer. She has difficulty understanding things outside of fighting and is confused by certain human interactions. Her nickname is “The Demon”. Her verbal tic is “desu".

characters.name: Javelin
characters.description: J-Class Destroyer. A very cheerful and affectionate genki girl who wields a javelin.

characters.name: Laffey
characters.description: Benson-Class Destroyer. A sleepy girl who speaks in monotone and isn’t motivated by anything but fighting. Like her other sisters, she wears a pair of bunny ears. Also an avid drinker of Oxycola.

characters.name: Enterprise
characters.description: Faction: Eagle Union Class: Yorktown  Legendary Yorktown-class aircraft carrier Enterprise. She has a natural sense of responsibility and values teamwork most of all things. Her "Lucky E" passive in game is a reference to Enterprise's luck and resilience when it came to surviving battles.

characters.name: Akagi
characters.description: Akagi-Class Aircraft Carrier. A threatening and easily jealous sadist with yandere tendencies. In the anime, she acts possessive towards her sister, Kaga, while in the game and other adaptions it’s towards the Commander.

characters.name: Kaga
characters.description: Kaga-Class Aircraft Carrier. She loves to battle and is very attached to her older sister, Akagi.

characters.name: Belfast
characters.description: Edinburgh-Class Light Cruiser. As the head of the Royal Navy, she is very dutiful and affectionately calls the Commander “master”.

characters.name: Shoukaku
characters.description: Carrier of the Sakura Empire's Fifth Carrier Division. Older sister of Zuikaku.

characters.name: Izumi Curtis
characters.description: Nationality: Amestrian  Izumi Curtis, born Izumi Harnet, the teacher of Ed and Alphonse Elric, agreed to train the brothers to hone their alchemical abilities after their mother died. She expands their training with a regimen of philosophy, martial arts, and living off the land. Her methods are derived from her own alchemy training: in the manga and second anime, she was forced to survive in the northern region surrounding Briggs Fortress for a month (although it turns out she succeeded by stealing supplies from the northern fortress), whereas in the first anime she was taught by Dante. She thinks of the Elrics as her own sons, and although she severs her student-teacher ties with them after learning of their attempts with human transmutation (and similarly Ed's joining the State Military), she continues to do all she can to help them. She can be quite violent when punishing or sparring with the Elric brothers, so they tend to be deathly afraid of her. Her claim of "I'm a housewife!" while confronting Greed was a favorite scene of Arakawa's to draw.  Izumi and her husband Sig Curtis (シグ・カーティス, Shigu Kātisu) were expecting a child years before the start of the series; however, their son was stillborn. Izumi tried and failed to revive the child through human transmutation (an act that created Wrath in the first anime). The failed attempt took some of her internal organs, resulting in infertility, and causing her to periodically cough up blood. Izumi gained the ability to use alchemy without a transmutation circle after seeing the "truth."  In the manga, Izumi attracts the attention of the State Military for surviving the failed human transmutation. As she and her husband travel around Amestris in order to avoid the military, they eventually meet Ed and Al's father Hohenheim. He rearranges her insides to ease the blood flow, and persuades her to help collaborate in bringing down the State Military.

characters.name: Roy Mustang
characters.description: Roy Mustang is a state alchemist and officer in the Amestrian state military. A hero of the Ishval Civil War and [Edward Elric’s](https://anilist.co/character/11/Edward-Elric) superior officer, Mustang is a remarkably capable commander who plans to become the next Führer of Amestris.  On the surface, Mustang is presented as a shallow, self-absorbed, and incorrigible womanizer who is infamous among many of his colleagues and subordinates alike for the selfish and narcissistic aura he gives off. Easily as arrogant as Edward Elric, Mustang is one to act ostentatiously and appears to act mostly out of self-interest rather than any sort of philanthropy. He comes off to most as a sort of cocky layabout, shirking most of his duties and delegating his paperwork to subordinates while sitting idly at his desk with an amused smile on his face as he procrastinates, but is quick to take action when it appears that there is glory and military notoriety to be gained. Mustang is expertly manipulative and prone to think several steps ahead of those around him, giving him a remarkable talent for making subordinates act exactly as he wishes despite appearing not to have had a hand in their decisions - all traits which make the fact that he has managed to attain the lofty rank of colonel at such a young age a matter of public gossip.  At the core, Mustang is a remarkably devoted commander whose primary focus and personal duty is to his friends and subordinates. Though he hides it well behind a veil of cynicism and self-importance, Mustang is a man who cares deeply about the people who trust and support him and goes to great lengths to ensure their safety and well-being, even at the risk of his own. As a man with considerable power, Mustang considers himself a protector to those without and acts accordingly, earning the staunch loyalty of his most trusted compatriots.

characters.name: Riza Hawkeye
characters.description: Riza Hawkeye is Roy Mustang's most trusted subordinate. She carries out many of the tasks he is too lazy to do, acts as his personal assistant, and protects him from danger. She also doubles as his voice of reason, keeping cool in heated situations and scolding him when he allows his emotions to get in the way. Riza and Roy seem to share a close relationship in both adaptations of Fullmetal Alchemist; in the anime she identifies him as her most precious person, whereas in the manga she loses her resolve to live when believing he has been killed. Riza specializes in firearms, particularly sniper rifles, and can hit nearly any target with lethal accuracy. She adopts a dog, called Black Hayate in both the anime and the manga, which she raises with stern discipline; when Hayate goes to the bathroom inside, she shoots at the wall behind him to reinforce that doing so is bad.

characters.name: Gracia Hughes
characters.description: Maes Hughes's wife, and Elicia Hughes's mother, she is a kind and caring person. Gracia appears peripherally throughout the series and allows Winry to stay at her house when she is in Central and Sheska to frequently visit.   In the manga, it is revealed that she and Hughes met before he was sent out to the battlefield during the Ishval War.

characters.name: Edward Elric
characters.description: Birthplace: Resembool, Amestris Height: 1,65m Family: [Alphonse Elric](https://anilist.co/character/12/Alphonse-Elric) (brother), [Van Hohenheim](https://anilist.co/character/9792/Van-Hohenheim) (father), [Trisha Elric](https://anilist.co/character/10085/Trisha-Elric) (mother, deceased) Affiliations: State Military, [Pinako Rockbell](https://anilist.co/character/65/Pinako-Rockbell), [Izumi Curtis (teacher)](https://anilist.co/character/67/Izumi-Curtis), [Roy Mustang (Commander)](https://anilist.co/character/68/Roy-Mustang) Occupation: State Alchemist  Edward "Fullmetal Alchemist" Elric is a young alchemical prodigy. He is the youngest State Alchemist ever to be recognized by the Amestris State Military, having received the title at the age of 12. Ed's primary motivation throughout the series is to return his younger brother, Alphonse, to his original body, which was lost in a failed human transmutation. Edward, despite his occasional bouts of immaturity, is a selfless boy who gains a reputation as a "hero of the people" throughout his youth. Notably, he doesn't seem concerned about returning his own arm and leg, instead focusing entirely on Al's suffering.  Edward is small for his age, standing at only 149 cm (4'11"), however his body is that of an experienced martial artist, with noticeable muscles and a wealth of agility. Although he lacks both his right arm and left leg, Ed's ability to fight is not impaired, and is in fact improved, as he will often use alchemy to cause his metal arm to partly transform into a blade or shield. His heavy automail limbs are considered by him to be the very best in Amestris. They were made by his childhood friend, Winry Rockbell, and she is constantly working on them. He is able to think quickly, even in desperate situations, though can still be frightened into paralysis. These qualities, combined with his alchemical powers and physical strength, make him a formidable fighter.

characters.name: Alphonse Elric
characters.description: Birthplace: Resembool Family: [Edward Elric](https://anilist.co/character/11) (brother), [Trisha Elric](https://anilist.co/character/10085) (mother, deceased) Occupation: Alchemist  Alphonse Elric is a human child who lost his body during a forbidden alchemical transmutation to bring his deceased mother back to life, and had his soul transmuted into a suit of armor by his brother, Edward Elric.   Al's blood seal lies just below the base of the neck at the back of the suit, on the inside. It is drawn with Ed's blood. According to Edward, he needs to be careful whenever he reconstructs Alphonse's body because he must keep the blood seal intact during the transmutation. If the blood seal is removed, Al's soul will be lost.

characters.name: Alfons Heiderich
characters.description: A rocket engineer that bears a resemblance to Alphonse Elric and befriends Edward in the movie. He is fascinated by Ed's stories about his travels around his original world, but is unsure of whether he can believe in the fact that Ed came from another world where alchemy is real, and his brother looks like him. He is studying under the father of modern rocketry, and wants to prove the scientific worth of his fellow Germans by inventing a rocket that can actually be ridden. He also has his own reasons to do it as fast as possible - he is slowly succumbing to an unspecified disease that eventually causes him to cough up blood. This is most likely Tuberculosis as it fits all his symptoms and makes him keeping it a secret make much more sense.

characters.name: Winry Rockbell
characters.description: Birthplace: Resembool Occupation: Automail Mechanic  Family: [Pinako Rockbell](https://anilist.co/character/65/Rockbell-Pinako) (grandmother), Urey Rockbell (father, deceased), Sara Rockbell (mother, deceased) Affiliations: Rockbell Automail  Atelier Garfiel  A childhood friend of the central characters, the Elric brothers, she is often seen in their company throughout the series. She is evidently [Edward](https://anilist.co/character/11/Elric-Edward)'s love interest. Specializing in mechanical repair, specifically with automail, Winry services Edward's arm and leg whenever it is in need of repair or replacement.

characters.name: Youhei
characters.description: He is one of the Beastfallen, people who are born with the curse of a beast-like appearance and superhuman strength. Despite being mistreated in his life, he has maintained himself as a better person. He has a gruff attitude, but is in fact a very kind person. His name remains unknown, as he was warned by Zero not to give his name out to witches who could use his name to control him. Since then, he has been referred to simply as Mercenary.

characters.name: Albus
characters.description: **Gender:** !Female!  A young magician and member of the Sorcerers of Zero who encounters Zero and Youhei (Mercenary) during their travels.  Albus eventually joins them on their quest to find the Grimoire of Zero.  !It was later discovered that Albus is Sorena‘s granddaughter.!

characters.name: Holdem
characters.description: A werewolf Beastfallen.   He was originally a prince who ran away from his family when he was caught having an affair and ended up living with Sorena. He asked Sorena to make him a Beastfallen to hide his royal lineage so that he could live out his life in peace.  He was entrusted with taking care of Sorena's granddaughter (later revealed to be Albus) after Sorena was executed.

characters.name: Roux Cristasse
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Cervil
characters.description: He is a student at the Royal School of Magic in the Kingdom of Wenias, and the main protagonist of the series. As a result of his grades being at the bottom of the class, he was ordered to participate in special training as remedy to avoid expulsion.   Before awakening his powers, he was known to be unable to use spells. !He is actually born with limitless magic and can be considered to be more powerful than other mages. However, he was unable to control it during his early days at the academy!  !Later it is revealed by [Zero](https://anilist.co/character/126102/Zero) that he is her nephew, as well as the son of her brother, [Thirteen](https://anilist.co/character/142956/Juusanban).!

characters.name: Holt
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Coudeau
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Zero
characters.description: The title character. She is a witch, child-like in appearance, but presumably much older. She is proficient in both Sorcery and Magic, having developed the latter. Despite her immense knowledge, she is clueless with regards to basic knowledge, such as the value of gems and monetary transactions. Situations that may normally embarrass others, hold no problem for her. She employed Mercenary, after promising to grant him his true human form.

characters.name: Mukade
characters.description: Mukade (ムカデ, Mukade) is the main antagonist of Naruto Shippūden 4: The Lost Tower. Mukade's goal is revealed to be a dormant ley line within the ruins; he unleashes the power of the ley line, causing a light to envelop Naruto, sending him into the past, 20 years before the series began. Mukade also gets sent back time and change the past in his favour to become Minister of Rōran as Anrokuzan (アンロクザン, Anrokuzan).

characters.name: Saara
characters.description: Saara (サーラ, Sāra) was the former queen of Rōran before it was destroyed in Naruto Shippūden 4: The Lost Tower.

characters.name: Amber Idonokan
characters.description: The Princess of the Earth Ring.

characters.name: Nephrites Lomka
characters.description: The shut-in elf princess bearer of the Rings of Wind.

characters.name: Saphir Maasa
characters.description: Saphir is one of the twin princesses of the water country of Maasa. She takes on the roll of becoming Ring Princess and gives Satou the Ring of Water to help save her country from Empire influence and so her sister Saphira can be with Marse. She becomes his 4th wife.  She has strong magic powers but has a lazy personality.

characters.name: Krystal Nokanatika
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Haruto Satou
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Granart Needakitta
characters.description: The current princess and the strongest of the cat people bearer of the Rings of Fire.

characters.name: Alabaster
characters.description: Alabaster, the Great Sage. Called Gramps by Satou and Hime. Was able to create a portal to Earth, taking Hime with him to protect her and the Ring of Light.  Is very knowledgeable about the Ring King, the Abyss, magic, and the world.    Was involved with Sumaragdi at some point in his youth and the two were in love. He left to spare her the pain of seeing him grow old, since she will live much longer, being an elf.

characters.name: Morion Nokanatika
characters.description: Hime's younger sister.

characters.name: Nina Drango
characters.description: She is a bounty hunter who’s come to the big city to make a living. The citizens of the capital love her happy-go-lucky personality.

characters.name: Charioce XVII
characters.description: He is a calculating king who is willing to resort to any measure as long as it fits his goal. Fearing neither god nor demon, he wields forbidden power stolen from the gods themselves.

characters.name: Gauma
characters.description: !Age: 5000+!  Gauma is one of the main protagonists of SSSS.DYNAZENON. He is a mysterious man who befriended [Yomogi](https://anilist.co/character/169409/Yomogi-Asanaka) after the latter offered him food. He fights against the Kaiju Eugenicists using Dynazenon.  !5000 years ago, Gauma was one of the Kaiju Eugenicists, who brought fortune to a certain country (approximately somewhere in China) through the use of their power to control Kaiju. They were known as "dragon controllers" to the neighboring country. Juuga used to look up to Gauma as well. The princess of their country became interested in the power, but then the Kaiju Eugenicists were betrayed, while also betraying the country themselves. Gauma shifted his loyalty to the princess over his comrades and killed them. He then fell over and seemingly died, gaining the scars on his face in the process. At some point, before or after his death, Gauma received Dynazenon from the princess in the form of a dragon ornament. The princess (also his lover) placed his mummified remains together with other relics before killing herself to join Gauma in the afterlife.!

characters.name: Rimi Sakihata
characters.description: Rimi is one of the main characters in ChaoS;HEAd and is the main female protaganist.

characters.name: Sena Aoi
characters.description: Sena is a third-year student at Suimei Academy. Takumi first encounters her in a hallway at school but quickly excuses himself after facing her ominous glare. She is often seen standing around Shibuya holding a very long sword.

characters.name: Kozue Orihara
characters.description: Kozue is a second-year student that transfers into Suimei Academy early on in the story. She is not shown to be speaking but appears to have telepathic abilities. Kozue is in the same class as Takumi and appears to know him. She calls herself Kozupii

characters.name: Takumi Nishijou
characters.description: Height: 170 cm (5'7")  Takumi is a hikikomori and only attends school in order to fulfill the minimum for graduation requirements. He often and repeatedly notes that he is not interested in girls in the three-dimensional world and avoids conversations with others whenever possible. He prefers to engage in watching anime, playing eroge, and massively multiplayer online role-playing games. He is a second-year student at Suimei Academy.   !Out of egoism to not get killed he starts to investigate the so-called The New Generation Madness cases. Later in the story, he realizes that all he had lived for was fake and only happened in order for him to awaken his abilities. His catchphrase is: Whose eyes are those eyes.!  !Eventually, Taku awakens his gigalomaniac powers and uses his DI-Sword to defeat [Genichi Norose](https://anilist.co/character/17799/Norose-Genichi), the leader of N.O.Z.O.M.I., and destroys the Noah II artificial gigalomaniac device. This saves everyone from Norose’s diabolically evil plan of using the Noah II device to create a perfect utopia where everybody is happy and where the even more evil Committee of 300 will never be able to take power.!

characters.name: Yua Kusunoki
characters.description: Yua is a third-year student at Suimei Academy who seems to be stalking Takumi but later befriends him. She seems to be quite into anime and manga.

characters.name: Ayase Kishimoto
characters.description: Ayase is a third-year Suimei Academy student by day and vocalist by night. She sings for a popular indies rock band named "Phantasm". Her stage name is "FES". The lyrics in her songs appears to describe the events of the recent murders, leading the police to see her as a potential suspect.

characters.name: Robina Goodfellow
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: William Maryblood
characters.description: He is a lone human from the City of the Dead, born with vague memories of a past life and raised by a group of undead until the age of adulthood, he swore an oath to Gracefeel and leaves the city in search for adventure and civilisation while he restores the faith of his guardian deity.  He was brought to the City of the Dead as an infant by demons with the intention to be used as a sacrifice to break the seal placed upon the High King, however, he was found and taken in by a group of undead, these three undead were Blood, Mary, and Augustus.  William recalls that he had a previous life in Japan, he can only vaguely remember certain events and common knowledge, his previous life was lamentable which becomes his determination to lead a proper life in his current one.  (Source: Saihate no Paladin Wiki)

characters.name: Anna
characters.description: She is a priest dispatched by Bishop Bagley to assist William, she is one of the primary figures who handles the daily affairs in the city of Torch Port.

characters.name: Reystov
characters.description: Reystov was a highly skilled adventurer and companion of William. He retired as an adventurer and decided to settle down with his newly-wedded wife, Anna.

characters.name: Meneldor
characters.description: Meneldor is a half-elf outcast and most loyal friend of William. He was previously an adventurer and hunter.  He is a half-elf a mix race between humans and elves. His hair is silver that is tied up into a ponytail and his eyes are the colours of jade.  Meneldor was born in Grassland to the north, in the Great Forest of Erin where the elves live. Because of his mixture of elf and human blood he was an outcast and couldn't get along with any of the residents, he later decide to run away and become an adventurer. However, he was betrayed and poisoned by one of his companions, after killing the traitor and losing his comrades, he bumbled his way to a village in a weaken state where he was later found and taken in by Marple.  (Source: Saihate no Paladin Wiki)

characters.name: Stagnate
characters.description: Stagnate is a malice goddess associated with undeath. She is the adversary of William and becomes particularly interested. She obverse his journey and aids him despite them being foes.  !She later confesses her love towards him and offers to bear his child if he wishes.! She is mischievous and cunning. She adores humans and wants to eternalise heroes who shine the way for others. She feels remorse and ashamed of how her Echo acted in his final moments.

characters.name: Bart Bagley
characters.description: He is the head bishop that manages the temple in Whitesails.

characters.name: Paka
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Akatsuki Iride
characters.description: Akatsuki is one of the main characters and a member of the 13th District. His specialty is escape games.  Akatsuki is portrayed as a relatively nice and open-minded person who doesn't get mad easily, whether it is at something or someone. His patience—which may be on the more extreme end—has led to some members, most prominently Anya, to rely on him fairly often and/or view him as something like a brother, if not a friend.   In addition to not getting mad himself, Akatsuki also tries his best to make others around him happy. In fact, if someone tells him to do something, he'll do it without much hesitation if it will make that someone happy. Despite this though, there are some occasions when he doesn't follow orders, acting based on his own beliefs instead. He is shown to be a very calm and peaceful person, as he doesn't seem fazed when he sees monsters or other enemies.  (Source: Naka no Hito Genome Wikia, edited)

characters.name: Kaikoku Onigasaki
characters.description: Onigasaki is one of the main characters and a member of the 13th District. His specialty is traditional Japanese games, such as the Sengoku series.

characters.name: Karin Sarayashiki
characters.description: Karin Sarayashiki is a beautiful and popular horror-game streamer hailed as the #1 Female Game Streamer People Want to be Stepped on by online, known as "the Cursed Princess".   Despite coming across as initially aggressive and confrontational, she is actually easily scared despite being an avid player of horror games and can be sensitive and caring to her friends. She becomes [Yuzu](https://anilist.co/character/132428/Roromori-Yuzu)'s best female friend.

characters.name: Yuzu Roromori
characters.description: Roromori Yuzu is a cheerful puzzle-and-maze game streamer that enjoys teasing her teammates, especially Karin. She met Akatsuki online before and the two were planning to do a collaboration together before entering the game. Underneath her ditzy and sarcastic personality though, she harbors a genius-like intellect and an unhealthy obsession for Akatsuki. She is the oldest in the group, thus she's the leader.

characters.name: Himiko Inaba
characters.description: Himiko Inaba is a timid and kind nurturing-simulation game streamer who often helps out with domestic chores during emergencies. She carries flash grenades around for self-defense.

characters.name: Makino Aikawa
characters.description: Aikawa Makino is a quiet and handsome love-game streamer who sleeps almost all the time and lets his eyes do most of the talking for him. A running gag in the series is how anyone, male or female, who looks into his eyes for five seconds can be charmed by him.

characters.name: Zakuro Oshigiri
characters.description: Oshigiri Zakuro is a stealth-type game uploader, characterized by his masked mouth and ability to conceal his presence well even in real life. He is often stoic but harbors a shy side especially around women, which makes him a target of Yuzu's teasing.

characters.name: Anya Kudou
characters.description: He is a fighter-game uploader, which suits his often angry, cynical and violent attitude. This attitude partially stems from his sleep disorder which gives him regular periods of insomnia, causing him to have to take sleeping pills most of the time and take up game streaming to get rid of boredom during the night. He eventually befriends Akatsuki, but quarrels a lot with Zakuro throughout the series.

characters.name: Dokuro Mitsukai
characters.description: Height: 153 cm   Dokuro Mitsukai is a cute angelic assassin from the future brought back through time to kill Sakura Kusakabe, but instead tries to save him. Mostly, she is just like any other young girl but where other girls might shout or slap to express their displeasure, Dokuro draws her magical spiked tetsubo "Excalibolg" and brutally clubs her victim to death with it. She's also capable of bringing someone back to life with Excalibolg by chanting Pipiru piru piru pipiru pi (the refrain of the theme song in the opening credits). When she isn't brutally killing Sakura she teases him mercilessly, mostly using sexual innuendos.

characters.name: Zansu
characters.description: Zansu is yet another angel from the future who has accompanied Dokuro in the attempt to save Sakura's life. He has a very odd appearance, looking more like a biker gang member than an angel. He is unfortunately revealed to have some perverted tendencies. Every sentence Zansu says ends in "Zansu". He is frequently nude in the second series.    Source: wikipedia.org

characters.name: Minami
characters.description: The monitor of Sakura's and Dokuro-chan's class. Sceptic and mysterious girl.

characters.name: Sakura Kusakabe
characters.description: Sakura is a second year junior high school student whose life changed the day the "Bludgeoning Angel" Dokuro-chan appeared. From that day on, he went from the life of a normal boy to one filled with bloody clubbings by said angel. In the future, Sakura is apparently destined to create a technology that stops girls from aging after they reach the age of twelve years, which has led to Sakura gaining a reputation as a pedophile around his school. While not perverted by nature, Sakura still manages to get into tricky situations with Dokuro. He has a crush on his classmate and friend Shizuki Minakami, though he is too afraid to tell her, but soon he develops feelings for Dokuro despite the way she treats him.

characters.name: Hiroshi Miyamoto
characters.description: Sakura's classmate and the ace of the baseball team.

characters.name: Shizuki Minagami
characters.description: Shizuki is one of Sakura's good friends, and is also one of his classmates. She hangs out with Sakura most of the time, and is one of the more normal characters in the series as she never gets excited or otherwise when odd things begin to happen. Shizuki seems to have some feelings for Sakura. She is noteworthy among her classmates for being the only one who does not hold Sakura in contempt and believes him to be a good person.    Source: wikipedia.org

characters.name: Sabato Mihashigo
characters.description: Sabato is another angel sent from the future to assassinate Sakura before he can create his "Pedophile's World". Also with super-human strength, Sabato has ram horns on her head, and is unusually polite, even when threatening to kill Sakura, addressing people with the formal "-san" suffix after their names as opposed to the informal "-kun" or "-chan". After she was defeated, she began to live in a small cardboard box under a bridge; her living allowance is funded from an unknown source. Her weapon of choice is a deadly shock-baton called Durandal which according to Sabato can "char blue whales in the blink of an eye." "Durandal" is most likely a reference to Durendal, the sword of Charlemagne's paladin Roland.

characters.name: Zakuro Mitsukai
characters.description: Zakuro is Dokuro's younger nine-year-old angel sister, though she looks significantly older, and has a far larger bust size than her older sister. She has the super-human powers of most angels and wears a dress modeled after a naval officer's uniform, as well as an eyepatch on her left eye, for unknown reasons. Calm and soft-spoken, she is quite proficient in battle. Her weapon is a wet towel named "Eckilsax" which can be split into two or more for close combat, as well as stretching itself to bind the opponent. In the second anime series, she moves in with Sakura and Dokuro. She seems to get on well with Sakura, although she sometimes suggests that Dokuro kills Sakura.

characters.name: Anya Hepburn
characters.description: A new meister who has escaped her castle home to mingle with common people. This brought her to the DWMA and her meeting with Tsugumi and Meme.

characters.name: Meme Tatane
characters.description: A new 14-year-old meister at the DWMA. She is shy and ditzy but makes quick friends with Tsugumi.

characters.name: Tsugumi Harudori
characters.description: A 14-year-old Weapon from Japan, who still has to learn how to transform properly. She can transform into a halberd. She went to DWMA (Death Weapon Meister Academy) to become a hero.

characters.name: Boogiepop
characters.description: The shinigami whispered of among the female students of Shinyo Academy, few people know that Boogiepop actually exists. Rumors say that that Boogiepop is a reaper that kills people when they are at their most beautiful point in life. Unknown to them, Boogiepop is normally dormant, rising to the surface when enemies of the world appear. Boogiepop's appearance and voice are ambiguous: they seem both masculine and feminine at the same time. However, hidden beneath their signature black cloak and black, pipe-shaped hat, little is ever seen of them. Straight-faced and to the point, Boogiepop acts as mechanical as they claim to be. Although they are known to make "asymmetrical faces" from time to time. Boogiepop speaks in an archaic manner​ and seems fond of whistling the overture to Wagner's Die Meistersinger von Nürnberg.  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Nagi Kirima
characters.description: Known as the Fire Witch to many, Kirima has made few friends due the way she distances herself from others: she knows that she is too dangerous for 'normal' people to associate with. She has a messianic complex, and seeks to save the world from whatever may threaten it. As such, whenever there are unusual happenings within the city, Kirima can be found investigating what has happened. In the past, she had spent a period of time in hospital. A combination of the events from that period of her life, as well as the death of her father, the famous writer Kirima Seiichi, brought her to follow this path in life. Extremely gifted both physically and intellectually, she has the basic tools she needs to carry out her self-appointed mission.   (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Touka Miyashita
characters.description: The alternate protagonist of the Boogiepop Series. She is an ordinary student at Shinyo Academy, the girlfriend of Keiji Takeda, and a good friend of Kazuko Suema. Unbeknownst to most, though, including herself, Touka hosts the mysterious entity known as Boogiepop inside her mind.

characters.name: Kazuko Suema
characters.description: Suema was the last target of Dr. Kisugi, the serial killer of 5 years ago.   From this, Suema gained a very high interest in criminal psychology which makes her a bit of an outcast among her classmates.  After running into Nagi Kirima she also gains an interest in the supernatural occurrences in her city and through the course of the Boogiepop series she seeks to uncover the truth behind these incidents.

characters.name: Minako Yurihara
characters.description: An imperfect clone of Echoes (an alien sent to Earth to evaluate humanity) created by the Towa Organization and is considered a monster. It escaped from the lab it was created in, hoping to preserve its life.   "Manticore" means "man-eater".

characters.name: Boogiepop Phantom
characters.description: Boogiepop Phantom is an entity born in the electromagnetic field the moment Echoes' light appeared in the sky. Amongst the memories scattered by the light it could only find Boogiepop's attire, but not his face, and so chose the appearance of Minako Yurihara at random. He claims to be Boogiepop, but later renames himself Boogiepop Phantom out of respect for the original. He too confronts the enemies of the world, but has his own agenda in mind.

characters.name: Masami Saotome
characters.description: Masami Saotome is one of the antagonists of Boogiepop Wa Warawanai. He is a student at Shinyo Academy who would later become the Manticore's primary accomplice.

characters.name: Shannon
