He also doesn't like when he has to slow down to match the pace of others. However after joining Kansei Track and Field time he slowly learns what it really means to run.

characters.name: Yukihiko Iwakura
characters.description: Height: 170 cm (5'7)  Yukihiko Iwakura is one of the Aotake runners. He is a 4th-year law student at Kansei University and the resident of room 102 at Chikuseisou. Yuki is a rather slim yet lean young man. His skin is a pale peach color. He has side-swept black hair and an undercut. He also wears glasses and piercings on his ears. He is often seen wearing a blue sweatshirt and black pants. He is short-tempered and gets easily annoyed by his teammate's actions. However, he does care about his teammates and often jokes with them. He is very detail-oriented as seen when he points out Shindo's lower center of gravity. He is an avid clubber and often boasts the fact that he passed the lawyer's bar exam in one go to any girl he meets. Yuki was initially reluctant to run and was bent on defying Haiji's enthusiasm, but eventually got drawn into it as the others members did. He hates the smell of tobacco coming from Akihiro's smoking until he quit for running.

characters.name: Akihiro Hirata
characters.description: Height: 178 cm (5'10)  Akihiro Hirata is a 3rd-year science and engineering student at Kansei University. Hirata is resident of room 104 at Chikuseiso. Nico is the tallest among the Aotake runners with a muscular statue. He also has a light beard and chin-length brown hair, which he wears in a low ponytail. He is often seen in sweats. His nickname, Nico-chan-senpai, comes from the abbreviation of the word nicotine due to his past cigarette addiction. It is also seen that the residents of Aotake will just draw a cigarette doodle in place of his name on the chore chart. In an effort to stop smoking, he took up wire sculpting, quickly accumulating dozens of little metal figurines. Yuki later capitalizes on this and sells them to help fund the track team. Prior to entering Kansei University, he ran Track during high school but quit due to his coach. As Akihiro picked up running again under Haiji's influence, he stopped smoking and began to make small metallic figures as a substitute.

characters.name: Akane Kashiwazaki
characters.description: Height: 167 cm (5'6")  Nicknamed "Prince" because of his good looks, Prince is a 2nd year literature student at Kansei University. He is most notably known for having copious amounts of manga in his room and being the slowest runner in the group with the most unique running style. Prince currently stays in room 204 in Chikuseisou. Prince is rather inactive and occasionally speaks in dramatized speech. It is noted by Musa that he speaks in a more proper Japanese than the rest of the team. He began as one of the most reluctant and slowest members due to his lack of physical stamina and indoor tendencies. Akane picked up his training after Takashi had his family send over a treadmill for him to remain indoors to read manga. After finding true inspiration from his friends at Chikuseisou and Kakeru's presence, he pushes himself beyond his limitations.

characters.name: Haiji Kiyose
characters.description: Height: 170 cm (5'7)  Haiji Kiyose is the deuteragonist in the series Run with the Wind. He is a 4th year literature student in Kansei University Student and a long time resident of Chikuseisou. He is the resident of room 101 of Chikuseisou. He has a friendly and outgoing personality, but underneath has a bit of a manipulative side. He's never willing to compromise on his dreams, even if it means reasonably threatening his housemates in the process. Despite this, he is very caring towards his teammates. He has shown concern towards them throughout the show.    He is the cook of the Chikuseisou.

characters.name: Tarou Jou
characters.description: Height: 172 cm (5'8)  Tarō Jō is a 1st-year economics student at Kansei Univeristy. He is the older twin brother of Jirō Jō. He is a resident of room 201 at Chikuseisou. He and his brother played soccer for three years in high school. He goes by Jota and is nearly indistinguishable from his younger brother. The two think and act in tandem. Though he was originally driven by the intention to attract girls through running, Jota came to appreciate the sport. He wears green and purple accent running shoes.

characters.name: Cadis Etrama di Raizel
characters.description: Rai is a very elegant and mysterious Noble. He has no knowledge whatsoever of the 21st century, and will often become lost and confused especially with regards to modern day technology (such as using a cell phone). He is often used as the manhwa's comic relief with his love of ramen and the errors he makes with technology. He has fallen into a deep slumber for 820 years, and had woken up in an abandoned building in South Korea. After seeing what most of the humans on the streets were wearing, Rai took on the uniform of a student from Ye Ran High School, which is under the administration of Frankenstein, and inadvertently followed the students there.

characters.name: The Previous Lord
characters.description: Race: Noble  The previous Lord was a kind person and trusted the ones around him. He took a liking to humans and their traditions. He could at times be quite humorous calling Frankenstein a peacock, who returned him the favour by calling him a bugger. All in all, he seemed to have a quite easy going personality compared to his daughter, the current Lord. He displayed a fatherly nature towards her, nagging her for her unladylike behavior and warning her to be careful around guys since they can’t be trusted. He also cared for Rai and wished that he would become the next Lord instead of his daughter. He even gave Rai two silver crosses as a gift stating that it was a human tradition. One of them serves as Rai’s earring, the other one is located in Rai’s abandoned mansion in Lukedonia. His soul weapon is called Ragnarok. It takes the form of a beautiful decorated sword and it is supposed to be so powerful that humans associate it with the end of the world.  !The previous Lord went into eternal sleep 500 years ago, along with the other clan leaders, in order to free the next generation of their duty as Nobles and live their lives as they wish. He believed that it was time for the Nobles to change and leave it to the next generation. He truly cared for his daughter’s welfare and wished for her to escape her fate as the Lord, since the Lord’s life is burdened by huge responsibilities. Gejutel said to Rai that the previous Lord had wished to see him one last time before going into eternal sleep, but that he was nowhere to be found. He seemed quite keen on making Rai the next Lord, asking him several times to become the next leader of the Nobles but Rai would constantly decline. However, the previous Lord insisted because he wanted Rai to escape being the Noblesse, who faces an even harder fate than the Lord. In order to convince Rai, he even went as far as to hide a part of his soul weapon in a temple in Rai’s mansion.!  (Source: Wikipedia, Noblesse Wikia)

characters.name: M-24
characters.description: Age: Unknown (>25)  Race: Human (modified)  Occupation: (deceased)  Eye Color: White  Hair Color: (bald)    M-24 is a large, bulky, and muscular guy with purplish-tinted skin, who wears a black fedora with a gray turtleneck sweater, black jacket, and dark pants. Though he appears to be cruel and cold-hearted at first, it is later revealed that he can be very compassionate and caring towards others. He shares a very close relationship with M-21 because they were the only 2 remaining from their group. Together, they try to find out their comrades’ names. He even wished for M-21 to call him ‘older brother’ because he thinks that previously in his life, he had younger siblings.  M-24 was one of the first 100 humans (M-1 to M-100) that were experimented on by the Union. He is considered a failed experiment, like M-21, and he is dependent on pills from the union that prevent his body from deteriorating.  In time he has developed the ability of minor mind-control as a side effect of the experiments done on him. He helped M-21 to learn how he could withstand mind control by launching several attempts of mind control on him. He was also capable of producing ‘infected’ and control them.   !He dies in chapter 78: He is killed by Jake while trying to buy some time for Shinwoo and his friends to escape.!  !In Chapter 246, it is revealed that he was saved by Dr. Crombell and has not died. He is still an experiment, though, but has leveled up and stabilized.  He has escaped the lab and is on the run in the city where he eventually meets KSA agents and also Rai and others.  Several chapters later on M-21's request Frankenstein agrees to examine and treat M-24 personally and takes him to his own lab at home. M-24 keeps behaving strangely but because he remembers things only real M-24 would know, M-21 believes in him.   !However, in chapter 255 it was revealed by Yuri that this M-24 is in fact a fake - his real identity is Mark, a member of the same assassination team as Yuri. Mark has assumed M-24's identity to fulfill his infiltration mission (it's explained that he has absorbed a number of M-24's cells to gain some of his memories and abilities - along with his unstable body condition). There is no further explanation about the original M-24 at this point.!

characters.name: Frankenstein
characters.description: Frankenstein (Kor. 프랑켄슈타인) (commonly referred to as chairman by the children) is Rai's devoted servant. He supports Rai whole-heartedly and calls him "Master". He had tried searching for his master after Rai's apparent "disappearance."  Frankenstein is the principal/director of Ye Ran High School. He was stunned to find Rai in his school office after Rai had woken up and dressed in his school's uniform.  Frankenstein is a very cheerful and loyal person, especially toward his master, but can become quite serious and calculative when the situation calls for it. Although Frankenstein has shown somewhat of a sadistic side during his recurrent battles, like Rai, he is also compassionate towards human beings, especially towards the students in his school.   Frankenstein is immensely powerful but some of his powers had been sealed away by Rai due to him misusing them in the past. After 820 years of sealing, Rai has finally taken off the punishment. But whenever Frankenstein gets serious in fighting uses his full power, Rai shows a considerable amount of anxiety.    ! He is the "father" of human modification and enchantment. !

characters.name: M-21
characters.description: Gender: Male Race: Modified Age: Early 20s Hair Color: Silver Eye Color: Silver Affiliation: The Union, RK (Raizel Knights) Occupation: Union Agent (Formerly), Ye Ran Special Security (Currently)  M-21 was one of the Union's hundred human experiments carried out under Dr. Crombel. He was labelled as a failed experiment and along with M-24 was used by the Union as an agent, until M-24's sacrifice in a mission against the Noblesse had changed him; as a person and as an experiment. The Noblesse, Raizel, awakened M-21's powers that the Union failed to, and M-21 became his affiliate. With the Noblesse's support, M-21 searches for the names and memories he and his fellow failed experiments lost during Dr. Crombel's tests on them.  While typically distant and reserved, M-21 is straight-forward and, if need be, provocative and aggressive. He has a wild temper, but also a dog-like loyalty, having grown protective of other RK, Raizel and the human high-schoolers.

characters.name: Shin-Woo Han
characters.description: Han Shin-Woo, a student in Ye Ran High School, popular because of his excellent martial skills. On the day of Rai's awakening, he happens to meet him on the way to school and gradually becomes close to Rai at school, developing a bond which can be termed as friendship. Eventually he gets involved in many strange fights against people with extra-ordinary powers. Rai and Frankenstein rescues him and others from the mess everytime. Later he as well as the others are brainwashed for their own safety and so remember nothing of the strange happenings.  Shin-Woo is an energetic and athletic teenager with bright red hair. He is always seen with a bandage over the bridge of his nose. He is actually pretty good looking but not that many people realize it because of his behavior.  He is well-known within the city to be skilled in martial arts and feared by gangs. Shin-Woo is often shown sleeping (and drooling) in class and slacking off. Though he is shown as a lazy student, he is also very courageous and would protect his friends at all costs. He often tends to be late for school due to over sleeping. He has liked Yuna for a long time and it is disclosed that he confessed to her in past which led to an embarrassing situation. Since then they have been just good friends although Shin-Woo still has a liking for Yuna. Shin-Woo is also starting to like Seira.  Shin-Woo is an amazing Martial Artist excelling in Tae Kwon Do and Hapkido. He is well-known within the city to be skilled in martial arts and is feared by gangs. He is able to match the powers of M-24's Infected, and since then has been getting stronger.  Even for normal human parameters, it's been quoted that Shin-Woo possesses an incredible amount of strength, which he has displayed during his multiple battles; including those with the Infected.  It's been noted that one of Shin-Woo's most incredible atributes is his speed, shown as he instantly disappeared when he went to aid Yuna right after she yelled for help. Alongside his speed, his agility and reflexes have incresed during the progression of the series; to the point he was able to dodge one of Shark's attacks and counterattack at the same time.  Shin-Woo's most incredible strength relies in his durability, since he is able to endure attacks that would normaly kill a human being; as shown when he took a beating from Shark and was even able to stood up against him one more time right after he threatened to kill his friends.   (Source: Nobelesse wiki)

characters.name: Ik-Han Woo
characters.description: Woo Ik-Han (Kor. 우익한) is a regular human and best friends to Shinwoo, Yuna and Suyi, in addition to Regis, Seira and Rai. He spends most of his free time on his computer.  Ikhan is 157cm in height (about the same as Regis) and wears spectacles.  A running gag throughout the Manhwa is Ikhan's worry about his relatively short height. Initially, when Regis and Seira joined his class at school, Ikhan showed extreme intrest in the new students, which others supposed was Ikhan developing a crush on Seira. However, it is later revealed that Ikhan was rather enraptured by Regis, for Ikhan stated that he always wanted a fellow 'short' friend. Throughout his adventures, Ikhan is seen giving Regis foods and candies that are long and thin (such as Pocky) stating that he and Regis must eat them to grow taller (a pun on the stature of the food).  His hacking and computing skills are extremely proficient. He was able to match Tao's speeds when Tao tried to hack into Ikhan's uncle's police databases. He is also the best when it comes to computer games as it is mentioned by Shinwoo that Ikhan defeated him everytime. Ikhan also shows to be quite brainy rather than brawny, taking school very seriously compared to Shinwoo.  [noblesse.wikia]

characters.name: Perry Teitoku
characters.description: The ruler of the Gogol Empire, which is at war with the Jaicro Empire for control of the universe. He sends Dr. Gel to capture Dandy, claiming he is the key to the future of the universe. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Honey
characters.description: A blonde-haired waitress working at Boobies. She seems to enjoy the Aloha Oe crew's usual visits.

characters.name: Scarlet
characters.description: A collected, no nonsense inspector at the space alien registration center tasked with evaluating the aliens brought by Dandy and paying him accordingly when he brings her a worthy specimen. She is also a skilled fighter and can easily see through Dandy's tricks when he attempts to deceive her. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: QT
characters.description: A member of Dandy's crew, a robot that resembles and also operates as a vacuum cleaner. QT boasts being more intelligent and competent than its fellow crewmates, but its usefulness is stymied by problems caused by its outdated hardware such as memory shortages and battery outages. Despite being feminine in voice and some of its mannerisms, QT is referred to as a male by Dandy and Meow on several occasions.   (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Gel Hakase
characters.description: A gorilla-like scientist working for the Gogol Empire, Dr. Gel endlessly pursues Dandy from his spaceship.

characters.name: Dandy
characters.description: A dandy guy in space who works as an alien hunter. His age is unclear, but he is most likely in his late 20s. He does not care about little things and believes that his dream is somewhere in the world. He frequents "Boobies," a restaurant known for its voluptuous waitresses.

characters.name: Meow
characters.description: Contrary to expectations, he's not a genetically advanced cat, but he's actually an alien that lives on the planet, Betelgeuse. Meow is very carefree, as if he were raised with no constraints. At times he can come across as excessively lazy, preferring to play video games and read manga instead of working.

characters.name: Roberto De Niro
characters.description: A middle-ranking reporter for Bernardelli News Agency. Travels with Meryl as her educator. He is a drunkard who loves sake and is aloof, but he is a veteran who has overcome many battles.

characters.name: Yuuna Yunohana
characters.description: Height: 153 cm (5'0")  Yuuna is a ghost who is bound to the Yuragi Inn. She has no recollection of her life when she was alive and asks for Kogarashi's assistance in helping her discover who she was, developing an attachment to him in the process.

characters.name: Chisaki Miyazaki
characters.description: Height: 155 cm (5'1")  A girl who befriends Kogarashi after meeting him during the first day of high school. She is also a popular girl at school, known for her beauty.

characters.name: Yaya Fushiguro
characters.description: Height: 150 cm (4'11")  A timid girl who acts as a vessel for a cat god. She exhibits catlike behavior as well as having cat ears and a tail when she is possessed by it. Through their bond, she is able to call on its power whenever it is needed, and she can also warp in more cat gods through her body.

characters.name: Sagiri Ameno
characters.description: Height: 163 cm (5'4")  A ninja from the Chuuma Village. She hails from the Ameno house, a clan specializing in the art of demon slaying. She is dedicated to her duty as a ninja, spending time going on missions to destroy harmful supernatural creatures.   As a result of her upbringing, she has a stern personality and is often flustered when someone compliments her appearance.

characters.name: Kogarashi Fuyuzora
characters.description: Height: 174 cm (5'9")  The main protagonist of Yuragi-sou no Yuuna-san. A skillful psychic who banishes spirits through his punches. He is poor and used to be homeless before arriving at Yuragi Inn.

characters.name: Koyuzu Shigaraki
characters.description: Height: 125 cm (4'1")  Shigaraki Koyuzu is a Tanuki yokai who was stalking Miyazaki Chisaki. After confronting Fuyuzora Kogarashi she became a resident of Yuragi-sou.

characters.name: Nonko Arahabaki
characters.description: Height: 172 cm (5'8")  An oni who works as a manga author. She loves to drink alcohol, and as she becomes more intoxicated, her power as an oni grows. She is formerly a member of the Yoinozaka (宵ノ坂 Yoinozaka) family, one of the three great families in Japan, but left the clan and pursued her passion.

characters.name: Chitose Nakai
characters.description: Height: 135 cm (4'5")  A zashiki-warashi who is the caretaker of the Yuragi Inn. She has the power to manipulate the fortune of others, but she rarely uses it because of its potential consequences.

characters.name: Yu Kirino
characters.description: Height: 175 cm  Genius doctor and scientist with sadistic tendencies and extreme short-temper. She loves little boys.

characters.name: Rita Iizumi
characters.description: The Leader of Scavenger.

characters.name: Esther Rosenthal
characters.description: Classification: Magician  Esther first appears while being pursued by Anti-Skill. While escaping them, she enters a certain hospital and finds herself in Accelerator's room. She attempts to ask him about Last Order, however Accelerator doesn't notice her due to using his power to deflect sound away from him while reading. While she tries to get his attention, her pursuers catch up with her and manage to subdue her. She is later tied up with several belts including her mouth. Despite her bonds, she manages to get out during the scuffle between the Anti-Skill and Accelerator who has come to take her away for questioning as she carried a photo of Last Order. She later reappears before Accelerator, in his room, inquiring about the girl on the photo, Last Order.

characters.name: Mireille Grangeon
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Fam
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Ars Louvent
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Charlotte Wraith
characters.description: An orphan girl who lived without relatives in the castle city of Canare. She was on the run from slave traders when she was rescued by [Ars](https://anilist.co/character/305390/Ars-Louvent) and [Rietz](https://anilist.co/character/305393/Rietz-Muses).

characters.name: Rietz Muses
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Rosell Kischa
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Lycia Plaid
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Ayane Niikura
characters.description: Ayane is the student council secretary.

characters.name: Kei Misumi
characters.description: Rin's sister and school nurse.

characters.name: Makoto Sawatari
characters.description: Member of the public morals committee.

characters.name: Hayato Izumi
characters.description: A serious, intelligent character of the series, he becomes the vice president after losing to Ui Wakana's love campaign and her extroverted personiality. She soon moves into his apartment and informs him that their parents set them up in an arranged marriage when they were 3 while they were drunk.  At first, Hayato is opposed to the idea of a boy and girl living together and is upset how the arranged marriage isn't respecting their feelings. He also has trouble initiating kisses or other acts of romance or sexual pleasure. However, it is shown that once he has started, he becomes more sadistic and willing to engage with Ui.

characters.name: Ui Wakana
characters.description: The cheerful, outgoing title character of the series, she becomes the student council president from her campaign to spread love over the school, passing out condoms in the process. She moves in to Hayato's apartment as his fiancee in an arranged marriage. She is noticeably less serious at "home", slacking off and acting like a dependent, the opposite of a leader, with baby chicks appearing atop her head. Throughout the series she tries to please Hayato romantically and even sexually, knowing very little about how to do so.

characters.name: Rin Misumi
characters.description: The head of the Disciplinary Committee, she is strongly against Ui Wakana's love campaign, and is often disciplining couples who are hugging or holding hands. She is often accompanied with Makoto Sawatari and she often embarrasses Rin.!She eventually develops feelings for Hayato after he treats her kindly and helps her out.!  She joins the Disciplinary Committee because people believed that she would seduce boys with her large chest, and she wished to disclaim that rumor.

characters.name: Karen Fujisaki
characters.description: Fujisaki Karen is the student council treasurer. She is extremely devoted to Ui, harboring a perverted interest in her. She dislikes Hayato and often comes in conflict with him.

characters.name: Riku Kurihara
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Sara Iwami
characters.description: A senpai at the same school as Yuu and Fuuka, she is the younger sister of Hisashi.

characters.name: Makoto Mikasa
characters.description: A friend and classmate of Fuuka and Yuu. He has both British and German heritage in addition to Japanese. Mikasa is popular and well liked by everyone in class and considered to be very good looking. He appears to be particularly close to Fuuka, but not in a romantic way, as he is openly homosexual. !In the 163rd chapter, he confesses his feelings to his former teacher Tomomi.!

characters.name: Yamato Akitsuki
characters.description: The main protagonist of the story. He moved from his home in rural Hiroshima to his aunt’s dormitory in Tokyo to change himself. While checking out his new high school, he sees a beautiful high jumper practicing and falls in love at first sight. By chance, she happens to be his next door neighbor, Suzuka Asahina. Yamato is clumsy and has a carefree attitude, which often gets him into comprising situations. When the need arises, he can become focused and determined. He is exceedingly clueless when it comes to girls and their feelings. Although not the best in academics, he discovered a natural gift as a sprinter, and joined the track and field team.   (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Fuuka Akitsuki
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Koyuki Hinashi
characters.description: An up and coming idol whose CD "reached the top of the charts in just one week." She is a childhood friend of Yuu. She calls Yuu "Niko-kun" and he refers to her as "Tama-chan."  Fuuka is a big fan of her music, to the extent that listening to one of her songs makes her emotional enough to cry. One of Koyuki's songs was used as the theme for a popular movie ("Half & Half," a clever reference to another manga by the same mangaka.)  Though his sisters tease him that she would never respond to him if he contacted her now that she is famous, in reality she sent Yuu a message on Twitter.

characters.name: Yuu Haruna
characters.description: Yuu Haruna moved to Tokyo and started high school there because his parents were moved to America for business. He lives with his 3 sisters Hibiki, Maya, and Chitose. He uses Twitter often and posts about his life whenever he gets the opportunity. On his first day he meets Fuuka on the street where she bumps into him and falls over, with the way Yuu was standing with his phone in his hand checking Twitter Fuuka believes he was attempting to take a picture of her exposed panties while she was on the ground. She takes his phone and breaks it and they later find out they're in the same home room class the next day.  !When Fuuka dies in chapter 37, he refuses to attend her funeral and instead waits for her at the park.!

characters.name: Suzuka Asahina
characters.description: A talented female high jumper from Yokohama that was scouted by many famous high schools because of her skill. While in Tokyo, she lives in Ayano’s dormitory, next door to Yamato. She is a serious athlete that puts a lot of pressure on herself to perform so she does not disappoint others.    !At first, she has a cold attitude toward Yamato, but according to her sister, Suzuka only shows her arrogant and somewhat moody attitude to someone she likes. Because of her past with Kazuki, she was reluctant to express her feelings toward Yamato and ended up trying to push him away. After a while, she finally admits to herself and to Yamato that she has liked him since the first time they met, and they begin dating. Their relationship was rocky from the start because of Yamato’s carelessness and Suzuka's guarded attitude to her thoughts and feelings. She decides to take the offer to study abroad from Sasoka, claiming the training standards are higher and she will benefit more, but it was really because Yamato complimented her on how cool she looked during her high-jump. After the time-skip, Suzuka moved back into her room next door to Yamato. She, like Yamato, was recommended to Seijo University, which she plans on attending. After Yamato told her he wanted to rekindle their relationship, she was against the idea because she was afraid that if they date again, they will begin to hate each other and drift apart. When Yamato shows his devotion to her, they get back together. Things once again became unsettled after Yamato tries to further their relationship to a physical one. She reacted by slapping him when he groped her. After he apologies, she stated that she was simply nervous of the idea, but that if he wanted to, she would take that step forward. After being caught on their secret trip by her father, she is forced to move back home. During this time she feels ill. After Yamato works out the problems with her father, he convinces her to go get the illness checked out. When she comes out, she reveals that the illness was actually morning sickness, as she is three months pregnant. After much discussion between the two they both decided to keep the baby and get married, and decided to drop out of the university. Even though Yamato has to get employed to support his new family, Suzuka wants him to get a job in a company which has a track team. Just recently, their child was revealed to be a girl named Fuuka.!

characters.name: Xiao Liu
characters.description: Height: 183 cm  Liu Xiao is the younger brother of Liu Min and the second son in the Liu family.  He met Li Tianchen by chance when they were both children. Later on, he left to study abroad and finished his studies, returning to China a few months after the events of Liu Min's passing and the Li Tianchen incident. Soon after, he met with Li Tianchen again and stated his plan to "bring more parallel lines together"

characters.name: Ling Qiao
characters.description: Height: 160 cm  Current landlord of Time Photography Studio. Grew up with Cheng Xiaoshi. Acts as the middleman and picks up commissions for Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang.

characters.name: Xiaoshi Cheng
characters.description: Height: 180 cm Skills: Basketball, Photography  Manager of Time Photography Studio. Rough around the edges, but good at heart. Often acts impulsively. In order to save his studio from going out of business, he works together with Lu Guang, using their powers to enter photos and fulfill client requests.  He can enter the world inside a photo and possess the photographer's body, temporarily controlling their words and actions.

characters.name: Guang Lu
characters.description: Height: 175 cm Skills: Intelligence, Strategizing  Dislikes: Things being messed up after he's tidied them up, Plans being messed up Likes: Gourmet Food, Basketball, Reading, Sleeping, Sunbathing  Partner at Time Photography Studio. Calm and rational. Works together with Cheng Xiaoshi to fulfill client requests by acting as his guide and directing his actions.  He can foresee everything that happens inside a photo within 12 hours of it being taken; can share the consciousness of the person going into the photo through a high five and use this to direct their actions.

characters.name: Liz Smart
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Sitri Smart
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Krai Andrey
characters.description: Height: 173 cm  Krai is the leader of Grieving Souls, a party he started with his gifted childhood friends when they all strived to be the strongest party ever. Krai quickly realized he was not gifted like his childhood friends, he's in fact very weak only being able to fight with relics he has collected.  He's a level 8 hunter and is considered one of the strongest hunters in the city. Everyone thinks he's the smartest person in the city, thinking every word he says has a meaning, even if he's just joking around. Whatever he says is always taken very seriously and when the enemy knows he's nearby they always try to escape. But despite all this, he's unmotivated, sloppy, regular human being and doesn't want to get dragged into troublesome events. Generally, Krai always brings disasters along with him, much to the woe of the many.

characters.name: Ark Rodin
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Tino Shade
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Gark Welter
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Killiam
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Oreille
characters.description: A known underworld information broker and specialist for having vast information and knowledge on a number of subjects, she recruits Hei to take down the Section 3 convoy before he cuts off all contact with her. She is also known to the CIA, having met with one of their agents named Mr. Smith to locate Hei after he went rogue again.   !It is revealed that she had a relationship with Mao sometime in that past, and calls Mao by the name Ricardo.!   source: Wikipedia.   !It is eventually revealed that as part of Shion's plan Oreille and Doctor Pavlichenko has built a super computer that has all the records of the world, observed by the Doll Network and all memories of mankind gathered by the ME Network.!

characters.name: Kiko Kayanuma
characters.description: Kiko is Kurasawa Gai's secretary/assistant. Usually referred to as "flat-chested" by Gai, she's an upbeat, energetic girl who loves anime and cosplaying.  In fact, she prioritizes her two hobbies over her job responsibilities.

characters.name: Hei
characters.description: His codename is Hei, which means black in Chinese. Hei is a very talented contractor, his Messier Code is BK-201. Hei lives two lives in the series. In public he is Li Shengshun, a foreign exchange student from China. He is very nice and well mannered. He lives in the Umitsuki apartments and is always working a new part-time job.He has a huge appetite, not unlike most anime characters.  Hei's other life is of a Contractor called BK-201 and also the Black Reaper, mostly by other Contractors. Before becoming a contractor Hei was an assassin which earned him his nickname. Hei is usually seen on the job in a mask and a dark bullet proof coat.  Hei has the ability to manipulate electrons and can also disturb matter on a quantum level.

characters.name: Suou Pavlichenko
characters.description: The main female protagonist. A girl who lives in Vladivostok, Russia. In the Gemini of the Meteor story arc, Suou becomes involved in the war and machinations between the various groups and Contractors, and her life is forever changed when she meets Hei. She is Eurasian, with a Japanese mother and Russian father. She also has a twin brother, Shion, who uses a wheelchair. She is later revealed to have some form of contractor ability when she goes into mental shock, which awakens her latent powers. Her exact Contractor ability is not explicitly known, but with it, she is able to manifest an PTRD-41 from the meteor fragment she wears. Suou wields the rifle with ease and skill, though whether this is also part of her Contractor ability or not is unknown. Her remuneration involves folding paper into origami, though it is not known if her remuneration is folding origami.!It is later revealed that Suou was a copy that was made from her brother's ability. The real Suou had died when she was 5 years old at the University her parents were at.!!She also develops feelings for Hei later on.!

characters.name: July
characters.description: A young child most often seen being led around by April. He is a Doll whose observation powers rely on glass as a medium. He considers November and April to be his friends, a fact that initially astonishes Misaki and November as dolls are not supposed to think outside of their programming. April and July frequent November 11's roadside site of death with offers of a bouquet or cigarettes and a beer or two. In the third episode of the 2nd season, July assists Suou by helping her direct her new-found powers against the FSB and the MIAC, and later joins up with Hei's group, although his motivations for joining them remains unclear.      !However, it is implied later on that he has fallen in love with Suou. After he and Suou are killed by Izanami, they are both seen in the alternate world Shion created, with July being a normal boy instead of a doll. !   (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Mao
characters.description: His name means "cat" in Chinese. He is a Contractor who has lost his original body and now resides within that of a black cat. His messier code is HM-432. His brain is directly connected to a wireless network which enables him to send and receive information at any time, as well as subduing the natural instincts of the animals he possesses. Mao usually creates diversions for Hei in battle. Mao's ability is to possess the bodies of other animals. While he lost his remuneration along with his body, he must connect periodically with the wireless network or run the risk of having the animal's natural instincts take over.    !Near the end of the series, his wireless connection is cut off, eliminating his human consciousness and resulting in his 'death.' However, he had a backup network under the control of an unknown organization and he manages to reunite with Hei. It is likely that "Mao" is his codename; like Hei, his real name was never stated. He is also in hiding with Hei, residing in the body of Suou's pet squirrel Petya.!  Mao hates the Spring season as most cats would find a partner and try to have kittens.

characters.name: Misaki Kirihara
characters.description: The Section-Chief of the Foreign Affairs Section 4 who is investigating matters that concern Contractors. Misaki has long brown hair and glasses and rarely smiles or laughs. She has a strong sense of justice and a sharp intuition. Kirihara became a policewoman in order to protect the weak, has a distaste for smokers due to their smell, and is sensitive about the exposure of her body. She likes eating greasy food but claims to stay fit due to constantly moving around everyday as part of her job. Her father is Superintendent Supervisor Naoyasu Kirihara of the National Police Agency.   (Source: Wikipedia)     !It is hinted that she may have romantic feelings for Li Shun Sheng(Hei).  It was later revealed in the later part of special episode 26, that Hei's identity was revealed to her accidentally in a situation. In that particular episode, her subordinate,Yusuke Saito, has feelings for her and confessed it accidentally during a situation. Their memories of that incident however, was erased due to a however soon after verbalizing them his memory along with Kirihara's is erased due to a memory erasing substance accidentally released by Mao.!

characters.name: Takehito Kumagami
characters.description: Kumagami is a mysterious student at Hoshinoumi Academy. His ability is being able to locate anyone who possesses an ability. He has to get soaking wet while fully clothed in order to use his ability. He helps the student council find ability users.  !In episode 9, it is revealed that he was one of two people who were held captive in research lab. He is one of Yuu's friends who helped him prison break his brother Shunsuke.!  !In episode 11, he is kidnapped and tortured in a factory by mysterious people. After Yuu accidentally uses his collapse to bring the factory down, Pooh saves an unconscious Nao from the debris. He succumbs to death from his injuries while in Shunsuke's arms.!

characters.name: Iori Sekiguchi
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Yuu Otosaka
characters.description: Height: 174 cm (5' 8½") Ability: !Looting: an ability that allows its user to take over another person for 5 seconds. However, it can also be used to take abilities from other ability-wielders if they are possessed.! Affiliations: Hoshinoumi Academy student council  Yuu is a first-year student at Hoshinoumi Academy. He is rude and bad at studying. He usually behaves as if he were smart, but he is actually a chronic cheater. He says things which sound clever, and he is a narcissist. He has the ability to take over another person's body for five seconds.

characters.name: Nao Tomori
characters.description: Height: 154.5 cm (5’ 1") Ability: Imperfect Invisibility Affiliations: Hoshinoumi Academy student council  Nao is a first-year student and also the student council president of Hoshinoumi Academy. She has the ability to make herself invisible to any one person of her choosing at a time. She is a huge fan of the band Zhiend. She hates people who use their power for no good.

characters.name: Joujirou Takajou
characters.description: A first-year student and member of the student council. He can move at such high speeds that he looks like he's teleporting. However, he's not totally able to control where he stops, so he has to wear protective gear under his school uniform to prevent injury.  !Takajou lets his ability be plundered by Yuu for his plan to succeed. He no longer possesses his ability.!  (Source: Crunchyroll, edited)

characters.name: Yusa Kurobane
characters.description: Yusa is a first-year student and the vocalist for the band How-Low-Hello. She is able to speak to the dead. She uncontrollably channels her dead older sister Misa, who occasionally possesses her. When this occurs, her appearance changes, such as her eye color turning from blue to red.  !Misa lets Yuu plunder her abilities after hearing his plan from Nao. Before that she had written a letter to Yusa, after her ability is taken she reads it and starts crying knowing that she was with her and everyone the whole time. She no longer possesses any powers.!  (Source: Crunchyroll, edited)

characters.name: Ayumi Otosaka
characters.description: A middle-school student and [Yuu](https://anilist.co/character/88950/Otosaka-Yuu)'s younger sister. She likes stars. She is also a huge fan of the Idol [Yusa Nishimori](https://anilist.co/character/88953/Kurobane-Yusa).   !She awakens the ability to make everything around her collapse, but ultimately, this awakening leads to her death. In episode 6, during a lunch break at school, Ayumi is threatened with a box cutter by a jealous classmate; she begins to run, but is soon cornered. Instinctively, she uses her ability, which collapses both the roof above her and the floor below; killing her.!  !In episode 10, she is saved by her brother Yuu who traveled back in time using their brother [Shunsuke](https://anilist.co/character/125388/Otosaka-Shunsuke)'s ability of time leap. Her ability was plundered by Yuu after he had time leaped backwards, so she no longer has the ability.!

characters.name: Tadashi Karino
characters.description: Birthday: September 9  Tadashi ranks 5th in school and is the son of the school's director. He suffers from a bit of wanderlust, likes to travel alone and do whatever he wants or sees fit. He enjoys eating sweets, especially food made by Akira. He seems to end up as the character most comically attacked (frequently by Akira) because of his careless comments or reckless behavior.  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Akira Toudou
characters.description: Akira Toudo is the daughter of the owner of an airline company. Ranked 6th in 10th grade. She is very fond of Hikari, and often won't do anything unless Hikari wants to do it also. She is very enthusiastic about her afternoon tea.  !She was good friends with Yahiro and Kei as a child, but due to Yahiro's protective and somewhat selfish behavior (and a misunderstanding Yahiro never corrected), she avoids him as best she can. We later find out that the reason she is so fond of Hikari, is because as a child, Hikari was the only one who could stop her from crying. She loves Tadashi and later accidentally confesses this to him.!

characters.name: Ryuu Tsuji
characters.description: Birthday: May 4  Ryuu ranks 7th in the entire school cohort. He is the son of the CEO of a sports company and one of his family's clients is Yahiro's family. He is an animal lover and is very good at handling children. The twins, Megumi and Jun, are unusually close to him, considering they've been together all their childhood.   !It is hinted that perhaps he is smarter than 7th place, but spends the majority of the time during exams worrying about Jun and Megumi, the type that tend to become bored or sleep during tests.!  !In the manga, he falls in love with Finn, a girl who has to dress up as a boy for his country.!  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Hikari Hanazono
characters.description: Hikari is determined to beat Kei in any kind of competition, whether it be in organizing a school event or a wrestling match. She's a kind girl who always worries whether others are having fun. She is second place in 10th grade for best grades, but is sometimes lacking in common sense. Stubborn, proud, and hot-headed, Hikari never backs down from a challenge, especially one from Kei, as she is constantly looking for an opportunity to surpass him. She's good at everything except for cooking and teaching. Although she can handle her own in a fight (often against boys), Kei, nevetheless, gets irritated whenever she puts herself in danger, thus treating her more like a female than she does herself. Stupid when it comes to love, as Kei is in love with her and everyone knows except her...she is very dense. When Kei shows any affection to her, she usually regards it as a joke, or just plain scary. When Yahiro first told her Kei is in love with her, she first freaked out, then later laughed it off as an impossibility (since they "are rivals," it would be "too weird").   !She starts to fall in love with Kei in volume 4.!  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kei Takishima
characters.description: Kei is always a smooth winner, he's rarely seen stressed out or concerned unless it involves Hikari in trouble. He likes to refer to Hikari as "Number Two," or "Miss Rank Two" which never fails to provoke her.   He has the ability to remember anything he reads, including phone numbers. He excells at all subject from academics to athletics to martial arts. He usually prefers to do things on his own, until Hikari shows him how much fun it can be to work together with other people.   He is first in 10th grade for best grades. He is in love with Hikari, but she is too dense to notice it. Although he doesn't come straight out and admit it, it is common knowledge among the SA that he loves her, and Kei himself also doesn't deny it. The reason he hasn't confessed his love to her or asked her out is because he figured, knowing her, she'd probably just laugh it off (yes, for all her intellectual excellence, she is quite stupid/naive/innocent when it comes to love).   Although he is stoic most of the time and always keeps a calm facade under any circumstance, things involving Hikari are the only ones that bring out intense anxiety within him. It bothers him whenever Hikari pushes herself too hard, although it is for this very reason that he admires and respects her.   His birthday is on November 22nd.

characters.name: Megumi Yamamoto
characters.description: Birthday: February 14   Daughter of a famous violinist, she communicates by writing on a notepad. Megumi doesn't like to speak because she wants to protect her voice and only use it when singing. Instead, she writes on a sketchbook to communicate. Throughout the whole course of the anime and manga, she rarely speaks.    !After pretending to like Yahiro to make sure he would not disturb Akira and her new boyfriend, Tadashi, she eventually develops feelings for Yahiro, and sings to him. This is the first time that she is seen singing well. In the anime, after this, Yahiro and her begin to date, and they end up together.  In the manga, after this happens, she dates Yahiro for a while, but on New Years, when she admits her feelings for him, he turns her down. Megumi is aware that this is because he likes Akira.  Even when not dating her, Yahiro encouaged Megumi to sing, and helped her. He even tells her that he enjoys her singing. When hearing this Megumi began to cry, since simply hearing the words "I like" made her think of her feelings, and be upset. When Yahiro asked why she was crying, she tells him, and then runs away out of embarresment, afraid of his answer. Thanks to Yahiro, Megumi eventually ends up getting a singing contract, and things go well for her. Though he tells her that he does not return her feelings.  In the last chapter of the manga, he sees that Megumi was going to ask him on a date, but chickened out, and so he asked her out.!  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Jun Yamamoto
characters.description: Birthday: February 14   The brother of Megumi, he's usually a nice guy though not much is known about him. It is known that whenever he is kissed by a girl or major affection is going on, he turns into a bad boy (he has a split personality). He, too, has an odd attachment to Ryuu, but is dating Sakura. He is 3rd in 10th grade.   (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kaihei Ani
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Shoujo
characters.description: A girl from the wholesaler family. She is a big fan of Nami, says she is her "hope".

characters.name: Kaihei Otouto
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Reines El-Melloi Archisorte
characters.description: !Reines El-Melloi Archisorte is the current head of the El-Melloi faction after the death of [Kayneth El-Melloi Archibald](https://anilist.co/character/16028/Archibald-ElMelloi-Kayneth).!

characters.name: Gray
characters.description: [Lord El-Melloi II](https://anilist.co/character/16023/Velvet-Waver)'s assistant at the Mage's Association's Clock Tower.   ! Gray is a descendant of the Pendragon bloodline but the one she has now is not her original face. Her's is a family of grave keepers, running one of the many cemeteries across Britain that claim to be the resting place of King Arthur. Her relatives, and the whole village even, are a cult devoted to the worship of the King.  When Gray was born with a passing resemblance to [Artoria](https://anilist.co/character/497/Pendragon-Artoria), the cult interpreted it as a sign and enacted a plan that would have brought a second coming of the King. They used magic to synchronize Gray's essence with Artoria's, transforming her body into an exact replica for the King's soul to inhabit.   When Artoria was summoned in Fate/Zero, Gray's face changed to be identical to the King's and her family started to treat her as royalty and as an object of worship. She was no longer a person, just the embodiment of the King. This behavior, and the loss of her face, caused identity disorders within Gray.   When Artoria was summoned in Fate/Stay Night, Gray's body changed once more. A strand of her hair turned blonde, she gained regeneration abilities and a dragon mana engine (identical to Artoria's). !

characters.name: Kairi Shishigou
characters.description: Master of [Mordred Pendragon](https://anilist.co/character/55977/Pendragon-Mordred).

characters.name: Adam Dudley
characters.description: Adam Dudley, also known as The Emperor, is an American street fighter who represented "Boss Burger" during the Kengan Annihilation Tournament. After the tournament, he stayed in Japan, becoming an affiliated fighter within the Kengan matches. Adam's personality becomes readily apparent in his first appearance. He is very vulgar in the way he speaks, typically throwing profanity into nearly every sentence that leaves his mouth.

characters.name: Koishi Yamamoto
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Natsuki Hashiba
characters.description: Birthday: August 7 Zodiac sign: Leo Height: 171 cm Weight: 54 kg Class: 1-3  Natsuki is a shy boy with a good heart and dreaming nature. He's energetic, delusional, and like a girl when it comes to affairs of the heart. On the day his heart gets broken, he meets a mysterious girl who he can't stop thinking of.

characters.name: Keiichi Katakura
characters.description: Height: 175 cm Class: 1-3  Keiichi is an boy who knows what he wants. And what he wants is the ultimate masochist girlfriend who he can realize his sadistic fantasies with. Will he ever find her? Or will he have to raise one from scratch? His older brother is a teacher in their school.

characters.name: Tsuyoshi Naoe
characters.description: Height: 169 cm Class: 1-3  An otaku and unpredictable guy. Tsuyoshi looks like he's only interested in otaku stuff, so how come he's the only one of his group of friends with an actual, stable relationship?

characters.name: Mari Tsutsui
characters.description: Mari-chan is a tsundere girl who loves her best friend Anna and truly hates men. But above all, she hates Natsuki, who tries to steal Anna from her and Tomoya, who for some reason seems to be interested in Mari.

characters.name: Anna Kobayakawa
characters.description: Anna is a polite girl who's good at studies and who lives at her own pace. That is, until she meets Natsuki and finds herself spending more and more time with him. She's usually accompanied by her best friend Mari.

characters.name: Yukiko Asai
characters.description: Yukiko is always full of energy and positive thinking, which makes her quite an odd couple with her boyfriend Tsuyoshi. She loves cosplaying and has very good interpersonal skills. She goes to a different school than all the main characters.

characters.name: Nozomi Matsunaga
characters.description: Nozomi is Tomoya's little sister who will do everything to reach the heart of her love interest. Unfortunately for Tomoya, she falls in love with the last person he would want her to.

characters.name: Tomoya Matsunaga
characters.description: Height: 177 cm Class: 1-3  Tomoya is not only popular among girls, but he's also a player. A narcissistic guy who flirts and constantly and steals the hearts of many girls in his school. But what if there is one who doesn't fall for his good looks? He's a bit overprotective of his younger sister.  !He falls in love with Mari and confesses to her in chapter 20. Before that he often tried to flirt with her already which she coldly rejected as his games but in his confession he tells her that he's serious and she also believes him.!

characters.name: Yura Keikain
characters.description: Height: 143 cm Clan: Keikain House Affiliation: Kiyojuji Paranormal Patrol  Yura is an onmyoji of the Keikain House who specializes in shikigami. She is able to maintain four at once, impressing both [Nurarihyon](https://anilist.co/character/23307/Nurarihyon) and fellow onmyoji. She was trained by [Akifusa](https://anilist.co/character/31433/Keikain-Akifusa), who raised her to see yokai as evil. She seeks to complete her training by defeating Nurarihyon and then inheriting leadership of the Keikain household. After spending time with [Rikuo](https://anilist.co/character/12953/Nura-Rikuo) and being exposed to his yokai form, she begins to see how yokai are similar to people in that they are not all good or evil. She is a frugal girl who doesn't mind eating food that has fallen on the floor and is glad her shikigami don't require food. Her stomach growls at inopportune moments, but she doesn't seem to mind.

characters.name: Saori Maki
characters.description: **Height:** 160cm (5'2") **Affiliation:** Kiyojuji Paranormal Patrol    Rikuo's classmate and Natsumi's best friend. She is a member of Kiyojuji Paranormal Patrol.

characters.name: Natto Kozou
characters.description: Height: 40 cm  Clan: Nura Clan    One of the youkai who lives in the Nura house. His head is a natto and he consequently smells like natto. He often played with Rikuo when he was a child.

characters.name: Zen
characters.description: Height: 177 cm   Clan: Yakushi Clan   Affiliation: Nura Clan    Zen is a poisonous bird youkai who specializes in making medicine; however, his species has a short life-span that causes him to become weaker as he ages. He and Rikuo were childhood friends. After being betrayed and nearly killed, he was rescued by "Night" Rikuo. Due to this, he supports Rikuo unconditionally.

characters.name: Tsurara Oikawa
characters.description: Height: 150 cm   Clan: Nura Clan, Tsurara Clan   Affiliation: Kiyojuji Paranormal Patrol    Tsurara is Rikuo's trusted attendant. She follows him to school under a human guise known as Tsurara Oikawa. She is a Yuki Onna yokai. Around the Nura House, she sometimes acts as a cook who makes delicious but usually chilled or cold food.  She is fiercely loyal to Rikuo and will do anything for him. She gets visibly jealous when Rikuo mentions Kana and loves Rikuo deeply, though it is not clear if her love is romantic.

characters.name: Kana Ienaga
characters.description: Height: 152 cm Affiliation: Kiyojuji Paranormal Patrol  Kana is [Rikuo](https://anilist.co/character/12953/Nura-Rikuo)'s childhood friend and neighbor. She is an easily frightened girl who doesn't like the idea of yokai, yet ironically she often becomes embroiled in yokai-related incidents. She is hinted to have some affection for Rikuo, as she becomes jealous when she sees him spending time with [Tsurara](https://anilist.co/character/16599/Oikawa-Tsurara), and undeniably falls for his "night" form after he rescues her. She often worries about Rikuo's mental health, and is rather keen at noticing when he is upset over something but trying to keep it hidden.

characters.name: Rikuo Nura
characters.description: Height: 148 cm (human); 175 cm (yokai)  Rikuo Nura is 3/4 human and 1/4 yokai.  He is the son of Rihan and Wakana Nura and grandson of Nurarihyon and Yohime. He is the third and current head of the Nura Clan.  Due to having yokai blood in his lineage, Rikuo has two forms: one in which he takes a human form, and another where his yokai blood takes over and he becomes a full yokai. The former is frequently called his "day" form, whereas the latter is called his "night" form, as originally he was only able to maintain it during darkness.  Rikuo was originally reluctant to accept his yokai blood and his role as the successor to the Nura Clan because he was teased at school for talking about yokai. As he ages, he realizes he has the ability to protect both humans and yokai because of his heritage, and acknowledges himself as the third leader of the Nura Clan.  Rikuo has officially exchanged sakazuki with Zen, Kubinashi, Tsurara, Jami, Kappa, Kurotabo and Aotabo.

characters.name: Sensei
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: K
characters.description: K is a monk, living independently while seeking spiritual advancement. He was sent to college to become a medical student but used the money to study religion instead, thus infuriating his parents. Since then he has decided to live alone without relying on help from anyone. He later begins staying with his friend Sensei, who invited K to come live with him.   ! K later falls in love with Ojou-san, the daughter of the woman who he and Sensei are living under. He then commits suicide shortly after learning of Sensei and Ojou-san's engagement.!

characters.name: Kandata
characters.description: Kandata is a bandit who kills people without mercy. He is energetic and sadistic. He also sees fun and entertainment when committing crimes.     !In the end he is killed by the king and sent to "hell" where he becomes confused, scared, and lost. When the spider sends its thread down from heaven for Kandata, he pushes all of the "others" away so he can be the only one to climb out. However, his greediness pays the price and the thread snaps while the spider turns away. !    He appears in the story "The Spider's Thread" otherwise known as episode 11. The Mangaka of Bleach (Tite Kubo) designed him.

characters.name: Yoshihide
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Youzou Ooba
characters.description: Plagued by a maddening anxiety, the terrible disconnect between his own concept of happiness and the joy of the rest of the world, Yozo Oba plays the clown in his dissolute life, holding up a mask for those around him as he spirals ever downward, locked arm-in-arm with death.

characters.name: Takada
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Shigemaru
characters.description: Shigemaru is a mountain bandit who lives in a secluded hut along with his seven wives. He hunts wild animals for sustenance and robs travelers of their possessions. He believes Sakura (cherry blossom) trees can drive people mad.

characters.name: Akiko
characters.description: The wife of Shigemaru and a supposed beauty. Shigemaru fell madly in love with her, forcing him to obey her every will. They met when Shigemaru went hunting and happened to see them.     !She was originally another man's wife but Shigemaru craved for her and ended up killing Akiko's helper and husband. Upon returning to his house, he carried her because she threatened she won't be her wife if he did otherwise.    She ordered Shigemaru to kill his ex-wives or else she won't be his wife. So he killed every one of them except for the youngest which she also ordered to spare. When they finally moved to the city, she got bored and told Shigemaru to bring something fun home. Shigemaru beheaded the people she would request for i.e. priest, shrine maiden etc. Every night she would play with these heads with glee. In the end, Shigemaru realized that she was a demon. !

characters.name: Karin Miyoshi
characters.description: A second year in middle school, and member of the Hero Club. She is an experienced hero who transferred into [Yuuna](https://anilist.co/character/88636/Yuuki-Yuuna) and [Mimori](https://anilist.co/character/88637/Tougou-Mimori)'s class, joining the Hero Club to supervise the other heroes. Karin is depicted as a headstrong individual: stubborn, obstinate, and single-minded. She is very abrasive and finds it difficult when expressing her feelings towards others. However, she can't resist helping whenever someone is having trouble. She is rather self-confident and positive, initially believing her skills are far greater than the other members of the Hero Club. One could describe her as a "tsundere".  As a Hero, Karin dual-wields twin katana. She is also able to throw her katana to strike at range while being able to generate new ones. Karin also has powerful physical abilities and can sense things without being able to see them.

characters.name: Sonoko Nogi
characters.description: Height: 156 cm  Sonoko Nogi is one of the three main characters of the light novel Washio Sumi is a Hero. At the time of the story taking place, she's an elementary school 6th-year student chosen by Taisha to fight Vertexes as a Hero, along with Gin Minowa and Sumi Washio. She is a very easygoing girl who has a habit of spacing out. However, her cloud cuckoo lander personality masks a truly staggering intellect, and she can formulate plans in mere seconds. Sonoko is also a successful novelist who specializes in romance novels, and she enjoys imagining her female friends in romantic situations with each other.

characters.name: Yuuna Yuuki
characters.description: A second-year in middle school and member of the Hero Club. She prides herself on being a hero, helping out others in needs and always remaining optimistic.  She fights the Vertex with her armored gauntlets and greaves. Her fairy familiar, Gyuuki, allows her to condense energy in her fist for her signature move "Hero Punch".

characters.name: Mimori Tougou
characters.description: [Yuuna](https://anilist.co/character/88636/Yuuna-Yuuki)'s best friend and fellow classmate and club member who lives next door to her and often prefers to be called by her family name. Mimori takes pride in her national heritage and is always ready to defend her country and protect its people. She has lost the use of her legs, along with some of her memories, allegedly due to a car accident.  ! Two years before the main story, Mimori was adopted by the Washio family because of her high aptitude as a Hero Candidate. She went by the name Sumi Washio for the entirety of her time adopted by the Washio family. After her Mankai caused her memory loss, she was promptly returned to the Tougou family and was conveniently relocated by the Taisha as a neighbor to Yuuna. !

characters.name: Fuu Inubouzaki
characters.description: A third-year in middle school, president of the Hero Club, and older sister of [Itsuki](https://anilist.co/character/88639). She doesn’t bother with trivial issues, but she sees the big picture and inspires the others to follow her like a big sister. She loves her younger sister and friends very much. She is good at cooking and housekeeping, and loves eating.  As a Hero, Fuu wields a large greatsword. The size of her blade allows her to use it as a shield just as often as a sword. She can also use the power of her fairy, Inugami, to increase her sword's size and attack a wide area.

characters.name: Itsuki Inubouzaki
characters.description: A first-year in middle school and member of the Hero Club. She is Fuu's younger sister and respects her dearly. Unlike her older sister, Itsuki is very shy and timid. However, she is very kindhearted and enjoys helping people. She also becomes less shy around people she knows, and can even be snarky at times.  As a Hero, Itsuki fights with a tambourine-like ring lined with white flowers from which she can fire magical vines. These vines can ensnare and slice through enemies.

characters.name: Misaki Sakurada
characters.description: Ability: All for One  Misaki is the fifth of the nine Sakurada children and the third youngest daughter. She is twins with her brother Haruka. It is heavily hinted she has a crush on Haruka.  Her ability makes her able to duplicate herself up to 7 clones of herself. Each clone represents one of the 7 deadly sins. Since each copy excels in each of their aspects, Misaki gets annoyed that that makes her look bland in comparison as she doesn't excel in anything.

characters.name: Haruka Sakurada
characters.description: Ability: Lots of Next  Haruka is the sixth of the nine Sakurada children and the middle son. He is twins with his sister Misaki. He tends to be the straight man in the antics of his siblings and remains calm. He is not interested in becoming king, and instead supports Misaki by helping her in her campaign. It is slightly hinted he may have feelings for Misaki.  His ability makes him able to calculate the probabilities of any situation.

characters.name: Akane Sakurada
characters.description: Ability: Gravity Core  The main viewpoint character, Akane is the third daughter and fourth child of the Sakurada family. She hates being the center of attention and being followed by cameras all day. Her ability is Gravity Core, which allows her to manipulate the gravity of herself and anyone she touches, as well as allowing her to increase her speed and strength.

characters.name: Aoi Sakurada
characters.description: Abilities: Invisible Work, Absolute Order  Aoi is the first of the nine Sakurada children and the oldest daughter.  !She decides to withdraw from the elections as her true power which was kept secret from everyone was Absolute Order which makes people to follow her orders even though it's against their will.!

characters.name: Shuu Sakurada
characters.description: Ability: Transporter  Shuu is the second of the nine Sakurada children and the oldest son. He is twins with his sister Kanade.  His ability makes him able to teleport him and anyone he touches to a certain location.  Without realizing it, he has a crush on his childhood friend, Hana Satou. He ends up dating her, and she helps him with his campaigning program for the elections.

characters.name: Kanade Sakurada
characters.description: Ability: Heaven's Gate  Kanade is the third of the nine Sakurada children and the second oldest daughter. She is twins with her brother Shuu. She is also the vice president of the student council.  Her ability makes her able to materialize any object. However, the cost of the object is immediately removed from her savings.

characters.name: Hikari Sakurada
characters.description: Ability: God Hand  Hikari is the seventh of the nine Sakurada children and the second youngest daughter.  She later becomes an idol under the name Light Sakuraba and using her ability to make herself look older. She does that in an attempt to become more popular after getting inspired by another young idol, Sachiko. She doesn't seem to be very interested in becoming king, and instead focuses on her idol career.  Her ability makes her able to change the growth state of any living being for 24 hours.

characters.name: Shiori Sakurada
characters.description: Ability: Soulmate  Shiori is the last of the nine Sakurada children and the youngest daughter. Despite being very young, she's actually thoughtful and observant. She particularly cares for Teru and Aoi. She sometimes helps Teru during his speeches.  Her ability makes her able to communicate telepathically with animals and objects.

characters.name: Angrea
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Yaranaika
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Lulune
characters.description: She was a donkey before her evolution.

characters.name: Karen Kannazuki
characters.description: Kannazuki Karen one of the "heroes" along with Hiiragi Seiichi that were transferred into a different world.

characters.name: Destra
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Saria
characters.description: Saria is a level 700 beast-kin gorilla but after evolving with the help of the Fruit of evolution she becomes a woman, and from then can change back to her human form or the gorilla form easily, with also partial transformation.

characters.name: Seiichi Hiiragi
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Hayate Ayasaki
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Maria
characters.description: Height: 158 cm    Maria is Nagi's maid and surrogate older sister/mother, both appearing and acting in a manner more mature than people typical of her age. Because of this, even people near to her speak of her as if she is older than she really is, a pet peeve for her. A phrase she commonly responds back with is "I'm still a fresh seventeen year old".   She is the character with the most common sense, although her sense of value in money is as bad as Nagi's, and appears to be the one in charge of everything in Nagi's manor, since everyone from the head butler to the SP either obeys or fears her (or both in some cases). She is highly intelligent, somewhat devious, good at general housework and likes games of all kinds, though she is Katsaridaphobic, meaning she is deathly afraid of cockroaches, which she refers to as "the dark life-form that exists in the kitchen and other places". She has also proved capable of self-defense techniques in times of need. She is, however, poor at disguises, as seen multiple times when she tries to spy on Hayate and Nagi and is recognized instantly. Maria also placed her mark in Hakuou by being the youngest student council president at the age of 10 in her first year. She is one of the only people mentioned to be smarter than Nagi, this is the reason why Nagi made Maria her only maid. She started off as Nagi's tutor. But although she is highly intelligent, she has no clue about the "normal life". Like for instance, on the manga, she didn't know that there are other trains than bullet trains.

characters.name: Yukariko Sanzenin
characters.description: (Deceased)  Height: 152 cm  Weight: 40 kg    Deceased mother of Nagi. She often said to Nagi that she would always look after Nagi as the sky and the stars. According to Saginomiya Hatsuho, Isumi's mother, she had a similar face to Hayate - which might be one of the reasons why Nagi is so fond of him. Her grave is at Shimoda, and Nagi visits it every year.

characters.name: Koutarou Azumamiya
characters.description: Azumamiya is the master of Nonohara Kaede and a member of the kendo club. He is considered the weakest member of the club because his strikes are random and dangerous. He has a vulgar mouth, but it is Kaede's duty to refine him into a gentleman. When he is in trouble, he calls for Kaede to fight for him.    Both Koutarou and his butler Kaede are references to "Mahou Sensei Negima!"

characters.name: Hinagiku Katsura
characters.description: Height: 161 cm  Hinagiku is the current student council president, and kendo club president at Hakuou Academy, the school that Nagi, Isumi, and eventually Hayate attends. She is fifteen (later sixteen) and is an expert with swords, specifically kendo. She first meets Hayate when he gets lost on the huge Hakuou campus and invites him to the top of the clocktower, where only student council elites are allowed. She allows Hayate to call her by her first name and also seems to be infatuated by Hayate and his attractive personality.    Hinagiku is sometimes referred to as being rather masculine for a girl by other characters in the series. Miki suggests this is because Hinagiku is seen as being "cooler" than the boys, and the fact that she was rather domineering at a younger age. Her athleticism, competitiveness, and leadership position all also probably contribute to this view. Despite having such strong traits, Hinagiku is actually terrified of heights.

characters.name: Nagi Sanzenin
characters.description: Height: 138 cm  Nagi is the only heir to the Sanzenin fortune. She isn't just your average "rich girl". Calling her "rich" would be selling her short. The "Sanzenin fortune" is so large, throwing away 20 trillion yen in a red herring investment is considered a prank. Nagi is a short-tempered, spoiled, anti-social or socially withdrawn, hates to lose and to admit her faults, has a considerably hard time confessing her true feelings towards Hayate or anything in the fact of the matter, she acts immature a large portion of the time but is ultimately a good, educated girl. She is good at finance and likes to learn. Her mind is possessed with her own. She cares for her family and friends, but she doesn't want to show her concern directly. She usually tends to show her concern with "formal words". She is a tomboy and tsundere hikkikomori princess. Since going outside is very dangerous because of her status, Nagi favors staying at home. Not liking company in general, she lives away from her grandfather in a "small" (compared to the main Sanzenin estate) mansion with minimal staff. Despite her Otaku NEET-like lifestyle, she is intelligent enough to skip 3 grades at school, which even turns out to be one of Tokyo's most prestigious academies. She has an otaku-level hobby with manga, anime and video games, and draws her own manga. Her Otaku-level is high enough that she has submitted entries for multiple amateur manga competitions, though her entries never won.  Her only surviving family is her grandfather, whom she doesn't like, so she regards Maria as a mother or older sister figure, and warns Hayate not to touch Maria in any indecent way or she will never forgive him. She has a crush on Hayate, and has misunderstood Hayate thinking that he loves her.

characters.name: Dryden Fassa
characters.description: Dryden is Escaflowne's resident scruffy, bookish intellectual, irreverent to extremes and a master of sarcasm and verbal wit. Though egotistical, cynical, and downright cocky, he is deeply selfless and romantic. He is social and likes to talk with anybody on just about anything intellectual. He is quite possibly the most laid back character in the entire cast, and one of the precious few with a good sense of humor. He has a knack for irritating just about anybody with reserves or reverence for anything arbitrary, whether it be propriety, society, or the proper role of a father. Needless to say, he manages to nettle almost every single member of the cast at least once, some multiple times. His idea of flirting is flat-out advertising his assets (i.e. more or less "My intellect is second-to-none, I'm freaking rich, and I'm good-looking."), if that gives a good idea of how brash he can be, but in his (very) few serious moments his courting methods turn to solemn vows. He takes a passionate interest in esoteric and arcane topics of study, such as Atlantis and Guymelefs, the latter of which he collects not for their military force, but for their integrity of construction. Not only is he a first-class nerd, but he is a first-class nerd with heaps of style. He is a noble-born rich boy, but he dresses as though he just stumbled out of bed, ties his hair back messily, and wears the coolest glasses I have ever seen, period. He is somebody who can make you laugh and who can still laugh at himself and life, no matter how desolate things may seem or how many people he will piss off.  Dryden is the son of a jerk of an Astorian noble, Meiden Fassa, and runs his own lucrative merchant airship convoy. His father arranged for him to marry the princess of Astoria, Millerna Aston, a headstrong and intelligent woman with whom he fell in love and spent a great deal of the show trying to win, unsuccessfully. After their rather eventful wedding day and after realizing that she was still in love with Allen Schezar, he allowed Millerna to leave, no strings attached, with the promise that he would become a man worthy of her love. The question of whether or not Dryden ends up winning Millerna is unanswered by the end of the show. Dryden becomes king of Astoria after their marriage, which is fortunate considering that at the end of the war a far more competent king than Aston is in the throne. He is willing to negotiate with and listen to Folken after he leaves Zaibach, and he displays pacifist tendencies; the core of his strategic response to the Zaibach threat is economic sanctions. In the first scene in which he appears, he is allowing his pet mermaid, Sylvie, to go free after a goodbye kiss, despite his manager's protests regarding her monetary cost, to which Dryden replies "Don't be so frugal." He sold his entire merchant convoy to the Ispano to pay for Escaflowne's repair job and, in effect, Van's life, much to the distress of the manager who keeps flitting around and freaking out every time Dryden does something so liberal. Dryden was the narrator of Leon Schezar's diary as the party searched for Atlantis, and in the process managed to get on Allen's bad side. No surprise. Dryden is the manifestation of Allen's petty annoyances: disorder, casualty, and irreverence.   (Source: illusionarystage.net)

characters.name: Hitomi Kanzaki
characters.description: Hitomi is an ordinary school-girl with a crush on her track-team leader, Amano.  She meets and saves the life of Van, a young prince from that crossed a portal from a different world in order to slay a dragon. Transported to Van's world, Gaia, she finds her fate is intertwined with his, even if her heart still belongs to Amano and later Allen, a gallant knight who bears an uncanny resemblance to Amano.
