As his name implies, "Mamoru" means protector, while "Kusanagi" comes from "Kusanagi-no-tsurugi", the Grass-Cutting Sword, a blade supposedly given by the Japanese gods to the emperor.    -taken from Absolute Anime

characters.name: Rosé Tomas
characters.description: Rosé is from the city of Lior in a remote region of the East. She was a devout follower of Cornello's teachings because she felt that he would use his powers to bring her boyfriend, Kain, back to life. Instead, Cornello created a talking parrot chimera to mimic Kain's voice. When Rosé discovered this, he locked her in the room with it, using the incomplete Philosopher's Stone to get it to attack her. Al saved her, and together with Ed, they discredited Cornello.  In the 2003 anime:   !After Cornello's plan had been exposed and with her hope shattered, Rosé was forced to start over and persevere through hard times when the military intervened in Lior. Rosé was imprisoned by the military. When she is next shown, she is free and has a child. It is unknown how she got it, though it is implied that she was raped while in military custody. Scar uses her as the symbol of hope for the people of Lior, referred to as the Holy Mother. Later, seeing Edward paralyzed at the sight of Sloth, Rosé gets her voice back and uses what he told her before to snap him out of it. She became targeted as Dante's next vessel with the new Philosopher's Stone. Dante hypnotized Rosé, and her baby was used by Dante to open the Gate. While she's kept with Dante in the underground city, Edward finds her dancing alone in the ballroom under the trance. While the two of them are dancing, Rose tells Edward that she had been waiting for him. She then tells Ed that she loves him. Edward blushes and pushes her away, asking if she knows what she's saying and that they're "just friends". It is unclear if Rose said it under Dante's "hypnosis" or genuinely loves him. (In the Japanese dialogue, Rosé doesn't tell Ed that she loves him. Although, it is somewhat implied she might say it and Edward pushes her away and asks if Al was brought there.)  Edward's death breaks her trance. At the end of the anime, Rosé and her child appear to have moved to Risembool, living happily with Winry and Pinako.!  In the 2009 anime:   !Taking Ed's words to heart, she helps to rebuild the town, eventually reuniting with Alphonse Elric. She makes a comment on how she is depressed that Ed is not with them, admitting that she has really missed him and that she wishes to see him again. This causes Winry to become slightly jealous, something Al catches and taunts her with.  She later comments to Winry how she is thankful toward Ed for opening her eyes to the false belief and got the town moving on their accord.! (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Frieren
characters.description: Frieren is the protagonist of _Sousou no Frieren_ and [Fern](https://anilist.co/character/183965)'s master. She was the Mage of the Hero Party and traveled alongside Hero [Himmel](https://anilist.co/character/184311/Himmel), Warrior [Eisen](https://anilist.co/character/184312/Eisen), and Priest [Heiter](https://anilist.co/character/184310/Heiter) in a 10-year journey to defeat the Demon King.   She was a magic prodigy at a young age, with an impressive quantity of mana, which caught the interest of [Flamme](https://anilist.co/character/219733/Flamme), a human wizard who taught her everything there is to know about magic and mana control until she passed away. Frieren persists in collecting magic knowledge no matter how trivial it may be.

characters.name: Heiter
characters.description: A priest who is a part of the Hero's party. He later took care of [Fern](https://anilist.co/character/183965/Fern) until [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) arrived.

characters.name: Himmel
characters.description: Hero and Leader of the party that defeated the Demon King, and a self-proclaimed handsome narcissist. He cares about his friends and can't help but help those in need. He had a great influence on [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren), with whom he had adventures for 10 years.

characters.name: Eisen
characters.description: Dwarf warrior who was a part of the Hero's party, later became a mentor to [Stark](https://anilist.co/character/184313/Stark).

characters.name: Stark
characters.description: Stark is a warrior who fights alongside [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) and [Fern](https://anilist.co/character/183965/Fern). After his village was attacked by demons, he fled and became [Eisen](https://anilist.co/character/184312/Eisen)'s apprentice. At Eisen's instruction, he joined Frieren's party as their vanguard.

characters.name: Fern
characters.description: Fern is the young mage apprentice of [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) and accompanies her as a member of her party. She is an orphaned war refugee originally from the Southern Lands, later adopted by  [Heiter](https://anilist.co/character/184310/Heiter) and placed under Frieren's care.

characters.name: Sakura Hanazono
characters.description: **Height:** 156 cm   A good friend of Misaki's and one of the few female students at Seika High, Sakura is friendly and cheerful and, like the rest of the girls, relies on Misaki for protection from the wild behaviour of the boys.   !She is quite popular amongst the boys, but frequently rejects their confessions; in particular, she’s rejected ex-rugby captain Masaru Gouda (剛田将, Gōda Masaru) one hundred times. According to Shizuko, Sakura falls in love without carefully considering what the person is really like, as exampled by her persistent feelings for the two-faced, womanising singer Kuuga of a popular band from nearby Yumesaki High.!  She has high respect for Misaki and despite her constant happy and tolerant attitude, defends Misaki when Kuuga insults her. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Minako Ayuzawa
characters.description: Misaki's mother. She appears to be somewhat sickly, but does her best to support Misaki and Suzuna by working as a nurse at the hospital. Although she is grateful that Misaki is helping her with their financial problems, she also wants nothing more than for Misaki to have more fun and go out more often as a high school teenager. She becomes acquainted with Usui at the train station in chapter 35 and sees him as a very gentle person and the exact opposite of her husband.

characters.name: Hinata Shintani
characters.description: **Height:** 177 cm    **Debut:** Chapter 21  He is Misaki-chan's childhood friend. He can eat anything and still be hungry. He works at a gas station.    !Misaki-chan is Hinata's first love since elementary school, which was when Misaki-chan didn't hate guys. Eventually, after winning the cake eating contest, he finds out that Misaki works in the maid cafe. !

characters.name: Takumi Usui
characters.description: Height: 186 cm  One of the most popular boys at Seika High, Usui appears to take little interest in anything and prefers to observe things as they unfold, though proves to be extraordinarily talented in numerous areas.

characters.name: Misaki Ayuzawa
characters.description: Height: 165 cm   Misaki is the heroine of Kaichou wa Maid-sama!. She lives alone with her mother and her younger sister [Suzuna](https://anilist.co/character/27982/Ayuzawa-Suzuna), because her father abandoned them, leaving them with a huge debt.  !She then meets [Usui](https://anilist.co/character/14523/Usui-Takumi), who discovers her working as a maid at the maid café. Misaki thinks Usui will tell the whole school about her working there. Instead, he keeps it a secret under one condition: Misaki has to be his personal maid for the day in order to stay the student council president and keep her part-time job hidden from everyone else.!  !In the manga Usui and Misaki start dating.!  Anime only: !Ayuzawa is confused as to Usui's true feelings the whole series, but in the final episode, they both confess to each other and kiss.!

characters.name: Canute Svenson
characters.description: Birthyear: 996 Height: 170 cm  Canute is the prince of the Danes. He is initially portrayed as timid and womanly, with a bishounen appearance and inability to function without his retainer [Ragnar](https://anilist.co/character/82533). These traits, along with his strong Christianity, earn him the mockery of the Vikings with whom he works. !After Ragnar's death, however, he has a sharp reversal of personality, becomes strong and kingly, and develops an ambition to create utopia on earth before God's return. Towards this end, he plots to overthrow his father [Sweyn Forkbeard](https://anilist.co/character/27957) and take the crown of the Danes. Canute is based on the historical King Canute the Great, the most prominent Danish ruler of England.!

characters.name: Ketil
characters.description: Height: 175cm  Owner of a farm in Southern Denmark, and father of Thorgil and Olmar. !Thorfinn, Einar and Arnheid work his farm as slaves!

characters.name: Thorfinn Karlsefni
characters.description: Birthyear: 996 Height: 100 cm (6-7 years old), 153 cm (16-18 years old), 155 cm (19 years old)  Thorfinn is a courageous young man armed with two twin blades he inherited from his deceased [father](https://anilist.co/character/13021). He's traveling with [Askeladd](https://anilist.co/character/13020), who is the leader of a ruthless group of mercenaries who take jobs from whoever they think can offer them a reasonable reward. Besides, Askeladd is the man who killed Thorfinn's father, Thors, and the only reason Thorfinn is traveling with Askeladd is so he can defeat him in a duel and win back his father's pride. Thorfinn only wants to win his father's pride with a fair duel. Askeladd only agrees to these duels when Thorfinn completes a certain task (like bringing him the head of the opposing armies general on the battlefield).  He does not fight for the love of battle, but is still prone to losing his composure when in combat. This hotheadedness often costs him battles against more experienced opponents.

characters.name: Askeladd
characters.description: Askeladd is the commander of a small but powerful Viking band, which owed its success to Askeladd's exceptional intelligence. Ten years before the main Vinland Saga storyline, Askeladd accepted a contract to assassinate [Thors](https://anilist.co/character/13021), father of [Thorfinn](https://anilist.co/character/10138). During the Viking invasion and war in England, he manipulated Thorfinn's desire for revenge against him as a way of keeping the gifted young fighter in his service. Askeladd is one of the most skilled fighters in the series, and is particularly adept at predicting his opponents' moves in combat. Askeladd shares the name of Askeladden, a Norwegian folk character known for his cleverness.  !He is half-Danish and half-Welsh, being the son of a Welsh princess captured by a Viking raider. He believes in the legend of Avalon, which inspired him to support Prince [Canute](https://anilist.co/character/17438)'s bid for kingship of the Danes and ultimately sacrifices himself assassinating King [Sweyn](https://anilist.co/character/27957) in order to install Canute as the Danish King and to ensure the safety of Wales from Denmark.!

characters.name: Einar
characters.description: Height: 184 cm  Einar is a man from Northern England that was sold into slavery. He ends up in Denmark, where he meets [Thorfinn](https://anilist.co/character/10138). Together with him, Einar is working his way out of slavery by harvesting the land his master has lent to him and Thorfinn. !After [Arnheid's](https://anilist.co/character/75590) death, he and Thorfinn agree to create a country of peace in Vinland!

characters.name: Gamou
characters.description: **Height:** 168 cm (5'6")  A character with semi-long hair. She likes to make fun of people.

characters.name: Sakura
characters.description: **Height:** 157 cm (5'2")  A girl with a tan and soft wavy hair. She actually has a "haraguro" personality.  (Haraguro: a character that is kind or friendly on the outside but uses those traits as a means to manipulate others.)

characters.name: Yoshi
characters.description: **Height:** 160 cm (5'2")  A natural airheaded twintail girl. She is a moron who likes [Gamo-chan](https://anilist.co/character/145715) as she usually repeats or follows her up with something she has just said. Yoshi also seems to like animals as she’s been seen with a gorilla shirt and she has a pet dog. She also seems to be into cute things as she once accepted a “Squiddy” plush from [Nagatoro](https://anilist.co/character/124696) in return for [Senpai](https://anilist.co/character/124697) in a contest.

characters.name: Sana Sunomiya
characters.description: **Height:** 171 cm (5'7")  The art club president. She has long hair that frames her face with dark-brown eyes. Her personality is stern and serious based on her interactions with [Senpai](https://anilist.co/character/124697), but she treats him with respect unlike [Nagatoro](https://anilist.co/character/124696). She also bears a resemblance to a female character in one of the manga Senpai wrote.   [Sunomiya](https://anilist.co/character/226964/Sunomiya) is her younger cousin.

characters.name: Hayase Nagatoro
characters.description: **Height:** 150 cm (4'11")  A high school student that can suddenly pop-up anywhere and anytime. She is always crazy about her [Senpai](https://anilist.co/character/124697). She seems to be a member of the Swimming Club. Nagatoro is an energetic, athletic, popular and rather sadistic - but deep down very sweet - girl, often referred to as a "sadodere". She is part of a 'cool kids' clique together with her friends [Gamo-chan](https://anilist.co/character/145715/Maki-Gamo), [Yoshi](https://anilist.co/character/145718/Yoshi) and [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/145716/Sakura), and is a member of the swimming club, despite also having a liking for martial arts such as muay thai, boxing, capoeira and especially judo.  !Chapter 81 — there's major development between Nagatoro & [Naoto](https://anilist.co/character/124697/Naoto-Hachiouji) which reveals that Nagatoro is supposedly interested romantically in him and sets out a dare to get a kiss from him as a reward for beating her judo rival [Orihara](https://anilist.co/character/220340/Orihara)!

characters.name: Naoto Hachiouji
characters.description: Height: 176 cm (5'9")  As a high schooler and a member of the art club, he enjoys illustrating his own mangas and drawing still images of even his kouhai, [Nagatoro](https://anilist.co/character/124696), after meeting her. Naoto spends his time after school in the art club with Nagatoro on most days where the crazy antics ensue. He is an introvert, twitchy, loner, nerdy and shy aspiring artist, who tries to avoid social interaction with other people and doesn't seem to have any friends. He is also referred as closet-perv by Nagatoro.  !Naoto eventually notices his romantic feelings for [Nagatoro](https://anilist.co/character/124696/Hayase-Nagatoro) and sets out different scenarios to get closer with her and date her in the future.!

characters.name: Haruhi Fujioka
characters.description: Height: 155cm (5'1")   Haruhi Fujioka, the main heroine of the story, is an intelligent freshman attending the prestigious and expensive Ouran High School. She cut her hair short because of a little boy's gum that got stuck in it,  but this action caused the Host club to mistake her for a guy. However, unlike the other students, she is from a commoner family and got into Ouran through a scholarship. On her first day at school, she accidentally breaks a vase worth 8 million yen belonging to the Host Club. As a result, she is forced to work as a host to pay off her debt, and does so by disguising herself as a boy. Soon enough, she naturally takes to acting as a host to other girls, and even finds it enjoyable. However, she does not like to take time away from studying and often finds the antics of the other hosts to be annoying. Haruhi lives with her okama (cross dressing) father. As a result of her mother passing away when she was young, Haruhi has become very independent and never lets anyone worry about her. Although seemingly unflappable, she has a fear of thunderstorms.     !Haruhi was very popular back in middle school, and was confessed to at least once a month. However, like Tamaki, she is very dense when it comes to love, and has broken many hearts unintentionally. Later in the manga, she realizes her love for Tamaki, and begins to blush whenever he is around.  Eventually she leaves Japan to study abroad and, of course, the whole club joins her (even Honey and Mori!). In the last chapter of the manga there's a picture of Tamaki and her getting married.!

characters.name: Tamaki Suou
characters.description: Height: 183 cm (6’0")  Tamaki Suoh is the half-French half-Japanese founder and president of the Ouran High School Host Club. Tamaki is flamboyant, emotional, and narcissistic; however, he is extremely dedicated to his duties as a host. He is the “prince” host type, who can charm any girl with sweet talk, though he is always truthful in his compliments. To him, all girls are pretty, and the happiness of his guest is his greatest enjoyment.   Tamaki acts as the main comic relief in the series, exemplified in his extremely dense and naïve approach to his own feelings, and extreme emotional reactions to [Haruhi](https://anilist.co/character/18/Fujioka-Haruhi)’s comments about his stupidity. He has a family complex, as he asks Haruhi to call him “Daddy” and refers to [Kyoya](https://anilist.co/character/23/Ootori-Kyouya) as “Mommy”. He is shown to be partial to classical piano music and plays extremely well; one of his favorite pieces being [Mozart](https://anilist.co/staff/106768/Mozart-Wolfgang-Amadeus)’s Sonata for Two Pianos in D Major.     !Tamaki's full name is Rene Tamaki Richard Grantaine. His father, the superintendent of Ouran Academy, fell in love with Tamaki’s French mother and divorced his first wife to marry her. For that reason, Tamaki’s paternal grandmother harbors a strong hatred towards Tamaki. Nevertheless, he is constantly trying to get her to accept him as part of the Suoh family. Because of his family situation, Tamaki sees the Host Club as one big family and tries to maintain that illusion, to the extent of telling himself that his love for Haruhi is fatherly even when it is clearly not.  Later in the manga, Tamaki has been close to Haruhi even though he says it's almost like a father, but he says to Kanoya (who has been said to seem like Haruhi) while in a game that he says the reason why he hasn't been cheerful is because of his stricken love for Haruhi.!

characters.name: Mitsukuni Haninozuka
characters.description: Height: 145 cm (4'9") Grade: Third Year, Class A    Mitsukuni Haninozuka (a.k.a. Honey-senpai) is a cake-loving, childish senior with an elementary school appearance. He attracts customers with his “shotacon” cuteness – however, he is also extremely talented at fighting. He can send people flying with one kick, and has been told by the Japanese Defense Minister to never show his full power for fear of other countries thinking Japan had a weapon of mass destruction. He learned his skills from his father, the owner of a famous dojo. Because of him, Honey tried to act like a “real man” for some time, but after Tamaki convinced him that liking cute things was not bad, Honey dropped his façade and joined the host club along with Mori, his cousin and the person he is often seen around with. Honey carries a stuffed bunny named “Bun-bun” (in Japanese, it is called “Usa-chan”, an abbreviation of usagi, meaning rabbit) that his beloved grandmother made for him. Like Kyouya, Honey is very ill-tempered when he wakes up, and gets very violent towards those that disturb his sleep.

characters.name: Takashi Morinozuka
characters.description: Height: 192 cm (6'4")  Grade: Third Year, Class A   Takashi Morinozuka is a tall, stoic, but kind upperclassman who is Honey-senpai’s constant companion. The Morinozuka family had protected and served the Haninozuka family for many generations but marriage joined the families two generations ago, breaking the master-servant tradition. Despite that, Mori still faithfully protects Honey and attends to his wishes. His protectiveness extends to his classmates and fellow host club members, gaining him a certain level of respect. He does not talk very much and is considered the “wild” (“strong and silent” in the dub) type. However, when he is tired, he becomes uncharacteristically talkative and flirtatious. Mori’s hobbies include kendo and karate. He's the only member of the Host Club to call Honey-senpai by his first name.

characters.name: Hikaru Hitachiin
characters.description: Height: 175 cm (5'9")  Hikaru Hitachiin is a devious and childish first-year student who greatly enjoys toying with his fellow Host Club members [Haruhi](https://anilist.co/character/18/Fujioka-Haruhi) and [Tamaki](https://anilist.co/character/19/Suou-Tamaki) (whom he often calls, “My Lord”). He and his younger identical twin, [Kaoru](https://anilist.co/character/24/Hitachiin-Kaoru), are “little devil” type hosts who put on an act of “forbidden brotherly love” (with Hikaru as the seme) to draw in their clients. Unlike Tamaki, the Hitachiin brothers are wholly calculating in their customer relations; however, this is because of their deep dependency on each other, and a reluctance to let anyone into their world. They share a deep emotional bond, which was forged through a lonely childhood and the painful fact that no one could ever tell them apart without looking at the parting of their hair (Hikaru’s hair parts to the right; Kaoru’s parts to the left). Since Haruhi is the first person that can truthfully tell them apart, they greatly treasure her friendship. Haruhi has stated that Hikaru and Kaoru have their differences, despite being identical twins. Of the two, Hikaru is a little more in control of their twincest acts but is also more childish and immature than Kaoru though he is the older twin.  !Tamaki was the one who coerced the brothers into joining the Host Club in their last year of middle school. Since they told him they would join if he could guess which one was Hikaru, Tamaki repeatedly followed them around, tossing out random guesses as to who was Hikaru and who was Kaoru. They finally crumbled and decided to join, which was their first step towards a greater exposure to a world outside of their own. Later in the manga, both Hikaru and Kaoru fall in love with Haruhi; although she has already rejected him once, Hikaru is determined to not lose to Tamaki. Eventually, however, Hikaru accepts that Haruhi loves Tamaki, and instead encourages her to confess to him, saying he is over her and wants her and Tamaki to get together (although he always looks pained as he says this).!

characters.name: Kyouya Ootori
characters.description: Height: 180 cm (5’11”)    Kyouya Ootori, a second year student at Ouran Gakuen, is the sly and calculating vice-president of the Host Club founded by his best friend and polar opposite, Tamaki Suoh. Despite Tamaki being president, Kyoya truly runs the club and plays the role of a puppet-master behind the scenes, earning him the nickname “Shadow King”. He takes care of the Host Club’s expenses and will even sell items belonging to the host club members (such as Haruhi’s pencil) for profit. In his words, “use whatever is at hand, be it friend or foe.” Almost everything he does is for his own benefit, but he can occasionally display a selfless side. He is the third son of his very wealthy and influential family; thus, if he wants to take over his family's business, he must work extremely hard to meet his strict father’s high expectations. Also, Kyoya's bad temper when waking up in the morning has earned him the name “Low-Blood Pressure Evil Lord."

characters.name: Kaoru Hitachiin
characters.description: Height: 175 cm (5'9")   Kaoru Hitachiin is a devious and childish first-year student who greatly enjoys toying with his fellow Host Club members, [Haruhi](https://anilist.co/character/18/Fujioka-Haruhi) and [Tamaki](https://anilist.co/character/19/Suou-Tamaki) (whom he often calls “My Lord”). He and his older identical twin, [Hikaru](https://anilist.co/character/22/Hitachiin-Hikaru), are “little devil” type hosts who put on an act of “forbidden brotherly love” (with Kaoru as the uke) to draw in their clients. Unlike Tamaki, the Hitachiin brothers are wholly calculating in their customer relations; however, this is because of their deep dependency of each other and a reluctance to let anyone into their world. Hikaru and Kaoru share a deep emotional bond, which was forged through a lonely childhood and through the fact that no one could tell them apart without looking at the parting of their hair (Hikaru’s hair parts to the right; Kaoru’s parts to the left). Since Haruhi is the first person that can truthfully tell them apart, they greatly treasure her friendship. Haruhi has stated that Hikaru and Kaoru have their differences, despite being identical twins. Of the two, Kaoru is nicer, more mature, and considerate of others.

characters.name: Sakamoto
characters.description: A black cat who wears a scarf created by the [Professor](https://anilist.co/character/41055), which allows him to speak. Being technically older than both [Nano](https://anilist.co/character/10422) and the Professor, he speaks in a condescending tone towards them, though he occasionally succumbs to his catlike habits.  !In the last episode, it is revealed that Sakamoto used to be [Nakamura](https://anilist.co/character/44126)'s cat and was called "Taisho". Sakamoto does not want to return to Nakamura because she did not take good care of him, even though she had good intentions.!

characters.name: Mio Naganohara
characters.description: A bright and cheerful girl sporting light blue hair and pigtails held by two small wooden cubes. She has a crush on [Koujirou](https://anilist.co/character/41616). She's usually a calm and collected person who can support her friends whenever they're in a pinch. But she's a lot more sensitive than she lets on, and more often than not needs that support back in return.     !She is a fujoshi mangaka, going under the name Daisuke Naganohara.!

characters.name: Yuuko Aioi
characters.description: An energetic high school girl with short brown hair. One of her negative sides is that she is often too lazy to do her own homework and always copies from either [Mio](https://anilist.co/character/40081) or [Mai](https://anilist.co/character/10421).

characters.name: Mai Minakami
characters.description: A rather quiet girl who is very intelligent and often is seen with a book. She is seen to be multi-talented, excelling at using projectiles, arm wrestling, and especially pulling pranks, usually at the expense of [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/10418/Aioi-Yuuko). She also frequently enjoys carving Buddha and Drawing in her spare time.

characters.name: Nano Shinonome
characters.description: A robotic schoolgirl that was built by a [Professor](https://anilist.co/character/41055/Shinonome-Hakase). She often worries about keeping her identity as a robot from others, despite the fact that everyone already knows about it due to the noticeable wind-up key exposed on her back. Luckily most don't make a big fuss about it. Her limbs will sometimes fall apart, revealing dubious items that Professor has installed without her noticing, ranging from bean-firing-weapons to Swiss rolls. She is also the Professor's caretaker.  She wishes to live life as a normal girl and therefore really wants the wind-up key on her back removed.     !In the last episode, after her school friends come over for a surprise birthday party, Nano decides that although the key has been annoying, she prefers things the way they are. The Professor installs a new key on her back that looks the same but spins when Nano is happy.!

characters.name: Hakase Shinonome
characters.description: She is a young scientist, who despite her outstanding intelligence, still reflects her age.  She loves sharks and snacks, and constantly modifies Nano Shinonome, whom she created, to add strange and unusual functions such as a machine gun right hand and a swiss roll dispensing arm. Nano, most of the time, is unaware of these modifications until they are first used. However, Hakase always refuses to remove the obvious wind-up key from Nano's back cause she thinks that it’s cute, despite Nano's requests to do so.

characters.name: Kusunoki
characters.description: DA Commander.

characters.name: Takina Inoue
characters.description: Previously an exceptional Lycoris, but for some reason, she now works at Café LycoReco.  A realistic person with a distaste for inefficiency, she can be dissatisfied with [Chisato](https://anilist.co/character/260329/Nishikigi-Chisato), who is not a typical Lycoris.  She wants to see good results in her job at LycoReco.

characters.name: Chisato Nishikigi
characters.description: Said to be the strongest Lycoris of all time. She enjoys solving private-sector problems that the DA would not address. At Café LycoReco, she works joyfully and cheerfully as the self-proclaimed poster girl.  !Chisato has an artificial heart which was developed by Alan Institute, and can be broken by applying high voltages directly to it.!

characters.name: Mizuki Nakahara
characters.description: Previously a DA Intelligence Division member, she’s been with Chisato for a long time. In her desperate desire to marry, she took the job at the café in hopes of meeting her special someone.  Her routine includes a nightly drink while reading wedding magazines.

characters.name: Mika
characters.description: Lamenting the worsening of his eyesight as he grows older day after day, he is the surrogate parent gently overseeing his problematic employees.  Ohagi mochi and coffee, Japanese clothing and a café. It’s all about expressing a mix of Japanese and Western styles. He is the manager of the café with a traditional Japanese twist, "Café LycoReco”.  !In episode 7 of the anime, it is revealed that Mika is gay.!

characters.name: Kurumi
characters.description: A young runaway girl of unknown origins who loves all kinds of games. She’s a terrible employee who reluctantly works in exchange for lodging. She only looks forward to gaming parties with the café’s regulars come closing time.  !In some later episodes, it is revealed that Kurumi is actually the hacker Walnut.!

characters.name: Ikoma
characters.description: A headstrong and passionate young Steam Smith and inventor from Hinomoto who makes a living in Aragane Station making iron and steam engines. He and his good friend Takumi developed a weapon called "Tsuranuki Zutsu" in order to defeat the Kabane. Everyone makes light of him now, but he looks forward to a day when he will be triumphant.  !His hatred for the Kabane stems from past trauma, with his sister Hatsune dying by his hands folllowing a Kabane attack and Ikoma struggling to cope with his loss ever since.!

characters.name: Suzuki
characters.description: The train's chief mechanic, who's hair is styled like a 17th century wig and speaks with english phrases. Also served as narrator for each episodes' preview.

characters.name: Mumei
characters.description: A mysterious, arrogant and playful yet exceedingly strong and brave girl who arrives at Aragane Station with unclear intent. She's very proficient with firearms and thrown weaponry, as well as incredibly strong physically, being able to chop off a Kabane's head clean off - using a blade concealed in her sandal - with one swift kick.  Despite often appearing ruthless and full of bloodlust, she's great with kids.

characters.name: Ayame Yomogawa
characters.description: Ayame is the eldest daughter and heir of the Yomogawa family that governs Aragane Station. She is the user of the master key.

characters.name: Takumi
characters.description: Ikoma's friend and fellow steam smith. Though he's shocked by Ikoma's rashness, he admires how Ikoma isn't afraid of anyone.  (Source: ANN)

characters.name: Kajika
characters.description: Ikoma and Takumi's friend and fellow steam smith. She has a familial personality.  (Source: ANN)

characters.name: Tadakuni
characters.description: Height: 170 cm (5'7")  Tadakuni is a student in Sanada North Boys High who acts as the straight man of the group. He is usually involved in [Hidenori Tabata](https://anilist.co/character/50691) and [Yoshitake Tanaka](https://anilist.co/character/50693)'s wild ideas despite his disapproval. He has a younger sister who proves to be stronger than him and his friends. Gradually, he loses screen time and fades into the background, appearing even less than supporting characters.

characters.name: Hidenori Tabata
characters.description: **Height:** 175 cm (5'9")  A student at Sanada North Boys High. He is the glasses-wearing character of the main trio, of which he usually gets the group involved in his crazy schemes. His older brother used to be the ringleader of the group until he went off to college.  When his friends aren't around and he's alone with a girl, he over-thinks the situation.

characters.name: Yoshitake Tanaka
characters.description: Height: 172 cm (5'7")   The dyed blond character of the main trio, he usually goes along with Hidenori's schemes much to Tadakuni's disapproval. He was the masked Rubber Shooter in his childhood and also has a sister who is a year older than him.

characters.name: Takahiro no Tomodachi
characters.description: Appears in episode 11.

characters.name: Yoshitake no Ane
characters.description: The faceless, short-hair older sister of Yoshitake who does not get along with her brother. Strong and violent, she is the ringleader of the girls who shave off Motoharu's beard. She is also highly concerned about not getting a boyfriend. She has a crush on Hidenori's older brother, Yuusuke.

characters.name: Over Self-Conscious Woman
characters.description: Excessively self-conscious girl who likes teasing boys in a train.  Source: AniDB

characters.name: Haruhiro
characters.description: Race: Human Height: 170 cm, 172 cm (Volume 8) Class: Thief  The main viewpoint character and Thief of the group. Haruhiro is the most well-rounded character of the series as he is neither arrogant in his nature nor humble. He is generally helpful and always willing to help out his party members.  !He is later forced to become the group's leader after [Manato](https://anilist.co/character/89317/Manato)'s death. Eventually,​ he starts to pay more attention to his teammates' feelings, slowly improving as a leader.!

characters.name: Yume
characters.description: Race: Human Height: 159 cm Class: Hunter  Brave and energetic, Yume is the Hunter of the group. She also has a tendency to try and protect [Shihoru](https://anilist.co/character/89316/Shihoru) because of her shy and timid nature. She has a good friendship with [Haruhiro](https://anilist.co/character/89313/Haruhiro) and they seem to get along well.

characters.name: Ranta
characters.description: Race: Human Height: 168 cm, 170 cm (Volume 11) Class: Dark Knight  The Dark Knight of the group. He is brash, impulsive, and somewhat perverted, which leads him to constantly arguing with [Haruhiro](https://anilist.co/character/89313/Haruhiro). Ranta is the troublemaker of the group constantly causing problems and making rash decisions for he has a slight hint of arrogance in his character.

characters.name: Shihoru
characters.description: Race: Human Height: Unknown Class: Mage  The Mage of the group. She is shy, only opening up to [Yume](https://anilist.co/character/89314/Yume) and [Manato](https://anilist.co/character/89317/Manato) which led to a one-sided crush on him. Yume is constantly trying to get her to interact more with the group.  !Shihoru becomes completely heart broken because of Manato's death!

characters.name: Manato
characters.description: Class: Priest  Manato chose to become a Priest and ultimately assumed the role of the group's initial leader. He saw the positives in people and with that he was able to effectively strategize battle plans when the group began hunting goblins for the first time. As they progressed as a team, they began mapping out abandoned towns while hunting bigger goblin parties. !However, while resting the group was ambushed by more goblins than they were accustomed to. Effectively moving his party to retreat, a goblin archer was able to successfully hit Manato square in the back as they ran away successfully. He died soon after.  In a conversation after his death, Haruhiro mentioned that aside from missing his leadership and strategist plans, [Manato](https://anilist.co/character/89317/Manato) was also a defensive tank like [Moguzo](https://anilist.co/character/89318/Moguzo) and a front line attacker like [Ranta](https://anilist.co/character/89315/Ranta).!

characters.name: Moguzo
characters.description: Race: Human Height: 186cm Class: Knight  Moguzo is the tallest and heaviest member of the group and hence chose to become a member of the Warrior guild. He wears the most ironclad armor and wields a wide blade broadsword that comes up to shoulder height. Although he is the most physically imposing, he challenges Shihoru for being the most soft spoken. On several occasions he will allow his friends to sleep in and will take their turn at cooking breakfast in the morning. He somewhat remembers doing this before and finding joy out of it. He also would carve wooden figurines of noteworthy quality in his spare time.

characters.name: Mary
characters.description: Class: Priest  !Joining shortly after [Manato](https://anilist.co/character/89317/Manato)'s death, Mary effectively replaces him as the Priest of the party. Initially, there is a lot of friction between Mary and the rest of the team. She was actually a lot like Manato, but after a tragic incident that led to the death of some of her friends, she became cold and aloof. However, after [Haruhiro](https://anilist.co/character/89313/Haruhiro) tells her about their own situation, she slowly opens to her new party.!

characters.name: Project 2501
characters.description: Project 2501, also known as The Puppet Master from the film and manga, Ghost in the Shell is an artificial intelligence program secretly developed by Section 6 of Public Security that develops sapience.

characters.name: Goshenite
characters.description: Hardness: 7.5  A gem who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Morganite](https://anilist.co/character/123395/Morganite). Goshenite is gentle, kind to everyone, and always has a worried expression.  !Both Goshenite and Morganite are taken to the moon shortly after [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) loses their head and begins their 102-year rest.!

characters.name: Morganite
characters.description: Hardness: 7.5  A gem who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Goshenite](https://anilist.co/character/123392). Morganite is overconfident, reckless, and loves to tease [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite).  !Both Morganite and Goshenite are taken to the moon shortly after Phos loses their head and begins their 102-year rest.!

characters.name: Rutile
characters.description: **Hardness**: 6  A gem who works as a doctor. They repair cracked or broken gems and handle the management of herbs, pastes, powders, and other medical remedies. They are partners with the unstable [Padparadscha](https://anilist.co/character/124485/Padparadscha), whose body is actively being maintained. Besides repairs, Rutile is responsible for carrying out regular physical checkups and applying powder and saltwater resin to the gems' bodies.  Rutile is a workaholic takes their job very seriously. They are known to stay up all night if needed to put a gem back together. As a result, they are often tired and will take naps during the day. They are also a bit eccentric and sarcastic, and to take great pride in their job and research. They don't take well to having their medical authority questioned. Even so, they become easily embarrassed when pestered about things like love.  They are very close to Padparadscha. Hundreds of thousands of failed operations to fix them have not made them lose hope. They believe they cannot be called a doctor if they cannot solve Padparadscha's condition. They are extremely dedicated, bordering on obsessed with this task.  !Rutile's mental state is broken after [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) takes Padparadscha to the moon without telling anyone. They have become more impulsive and feral in nature, and have abandoned their job as a doctor.!

characters.name: Shinsha
characters.description: **Hardness**: 2  The only gem who goes on night patrol. Due to their body producing Mercury (which is harmful to gems and living things), they are isolated and insecure. They hate fighting and hate to be seen.  According to [Rutile](https://anilist.co/character/123399/Rutile), Cinnabar has an extraordinary amount of talent and combat ability, but is too much to handle due to their uncontrollable poison. Cinnabar's silver poison gathers faint light at night, which keeps them awake and aware while night patrolling. According to [Kongou](https://anilist.co/character/123394/Kongou), the night patrol is something Cinnabar came up with themselves. They used to spend their time during the day in Hollow Cape, waiting for the Lunarians to take them since they thought they may at least be of use to them. They are knowledgeable about things other gems don't know about.  [Phosphophyllite](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) was recommended by the gems to see Cinnabar for the encyclopedia. After accidentally hearing their secret and wish, Phos promises to help Cinnabar find a job more suited to them than night patrol, saying, "a fun job only you can do." When encountering Phos each time, Cinnabar seems doubtful of their words, but they are the only gem they regularly speak to. Although they try not to show it, they have a tiny sliver of hope that Phos will be able to fulfill their promise.  Cinnabar is able to pull out an abundant amount of mercury. They're able to manipulate it in the air, from a distance, and around them. They seem to not be in full control over it and sometimes release it without wanting to.

characters.name: Phosphophyllite
characters.description: **Hardness**: 3.5 !(legs: 7; head: 5)!  The main protagonist and the youngest gem when the story began. They're weak, brittle - not suited for battle - and their clumsiness makes them difficult to maintain any roles, even though they've always wanted to be useful. Phos' initial job was to make a natural history encyclopedia which they progressed very little on. They promised to help [Cinnabar](https://anilist.co/character/123384/Cinnabar) find a job suited for them as well.  Phos is a young, overconfident, clumsy, and naive gem, who is the only one capable of getting away with talking back to [Kongou](https://anilist.co/character/123394/Kongou). Many gems describe them as lazy and useless due to their fragility and incompetence, although Phos does display a drive to help Sensei and the others, often held back by their low hardness. There is an underlying way of how Phos acts and speaks about themselves that hints at them taking the “useless” and “lazy” comments to heart, and impacting their self-esteem. These facts indicate that Phos may have something of an inferiority complex. They settle with what they can do and constantly state that they will try better next time. Phos displays a change of personality over the course of the series, mainly due to maturing, trauma, and outside influences. This is mainly due to the fact that the gems are not equipped to deal with trauma.  Phosphophyllite wears a standard winter uniform and black shoes without socks, occasionally accompanied by long black gloves. Phos has mint-green features known by the gems and the Admirabilis as the Lunarians' favorite color. Their hair is short, originally just beneath the ears, but cut shorter in later chapters to imitate [Antarcticite](https://anilist.co/character/124307/Antarcticite)'s hairstyle.

characters.name: Bort
characters.description: Hardness: 10  One of the gems who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Diamond](https://anilist.co/character/123390/Diamond). Bort is a diamond-class gem whose hardness and toughness are top level. They are a calm yet ruthless warrior who excel at battles and are obsessed with combat. The other gems call them a "battle maniac".  Bort is an efficient and analytic fighter, often pointing out the flaws in the other gems' tactics in a blunt and straightforward manner. This causes them to be seen as cold and scary to the others, but also to be respected, looked up to, and seen as reliable. Despite their harsh personality, they do have a softer side.

characters.name: Diamond
characters.description: **Hardness**: 10  One of the gems who mainly does patrol duty. They're partners with [Bort](https://anilist.co/character/123389/Bort). Despite Diamond's high offensive power, their toughness is second-rate and easily broken. The other gems consider them lovely and a top fashion model.  Diamond is friendly, kind, and gentle. They appear to be relatively calm during battle, even when their situation isn't good. However, they are actually insecure and frustrated with their current body which, though being the hardest, shatters easily. They dislike being compared to Bort, although they admire their younger sibling a lot. They are perceptive regarding gems' inner feelings and relationships, though [Cinnabar](https://anilist.co/character/123384/Cinnabar) accuses them of seeing everything as some kind of romance. Despite Diamond's more gentle nature, they're very stubborn and tend to fight until they shatter. From Bort's point of view, Diamond is extremely reckless.  !Diamond is one of the gems who accompanies [Phos](https://anilist.co/character/123385/Phosphophyllite) to the moon. They tell Phos that they "want to go somewhere without Bort".!

characters.name: Touya Mochizuki
characters.description: Touya is a young boy who has come to this other world. For the most part, he is very well-mannered, but when he feels that those close to him could be harmed, he also has a side that will not hesitate.  (Source: Honey's Anime)

characters.name: Elze Silhoueska
characters.description: Elze is an adventurer equipped with gauntlets on both hands. She is the type who acts rather than talks and often pitches in before thinking. She is the older of the twins.  (Source: Honey's Anime)

characters.name: Linze Silhoueska
characters.description: Linze was in the city with her sister and right before they were tricked into something, Touya saved them. She is reserved, but there are times where she shows her inner strength. She is the younger of the twins.  (Source: Honey's Anime)

characters.name: Yae Kokonoe
characters.description: Born in the far eastern country of Eashen to a samurai family, Yae left her home to travel and hone her skills elsewhere. Touya's group crosses paths with her during their travels, helping to fend off a group of ruffians attacking her. Thereafter, she decides to accompany Touya on his travels.

characters.name: Yumina Urnea Belfast
characters.description: A Princess of Belfast, and daughter of King Tristwin and Queen Yuel. Yumina met Touya when he heals her father from an attempted poisoning. Yumina possess the Null magic "Mystic Eyes", an ability that comes from her Heterochromic Eyes which give her the ability to see a person's true nature. Due to this power, upon seeing the selfless and kind aura surrounding Touya after he saves her father, she asks to be engaged to him, believing that she will never find a better candidate to be her husband. She is also proficient with bows and arrows, often choosing to fight alongside a pack of hunting wolves summoned with her darkness attribute.

characters.name: Rene
characters.description: Originally a homeless pickpocketer, but after Touya rescued her from two other pickpockets going after her because of a territory problem, he decided to hire her to be a maid.

characters.name: Akihiko Asai
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Shinichi Sakurai
characters.description: Shinichi Sakurai is a tall, introverted college student with short brown hair. Shinichi enjoys peace and quiet and likes playing video games. He prefers to be left alone, but despite his objections, he often ends up hanging out with [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/130665/Hana-Uzaki). Shinichi works at a college café run by [Mr. Asai](https://anilist.co/character/169505/Akihiko-Asai).  !After learning his feelings for Hana, he quickly confesses resulting in the two going out.!

characters.name: Hana Uzaki
characters.description: Hana Uzaki is a short, silver-haired college student with an energetic personality. Her antics often annoy her senpai, [Shinichi](https://anilist.co/character/130664/).

characters.name: Kuso Cat
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Itsuhito Sakaki
characters.description: Itsuhito Sakaki is [Shinichi](https://anilist.co/character/130664/Shinichi-Sakurai)'s college classmate and friend. He likes to tease [Shinichi](https://anilist.co/character/130664/Shinichi-Sakurai) about [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/130665/Hana-Uzaki), and he tries to cooperate with [Ami](https://anilist.co/character/159410/Ami-Asai) to come up with plans to get [Shinichi](https://anilist.co/character/130664/Shinichi-Sakurai) and [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/130665/Hana-Uzaki) closer together.

characters.name: Ami Asai
characters.description: Ami Asai is Shinichi's coworker and [Mr. Asai](https://anilist.co/character/169505/Akihiko-Asai)'s daughter. She has medium length hair and wears glasses. Ami enjoys "people watching" and ogling attractive males, and she has a fond interest in watching the interactions between [Shinichi](https://anilist.co/character/130664/Shinichi-Sakurai) and [Hana](https://anilist.co/character/130665/Hana-Uzaki). Ami hopes to see Shinichi and Hana enter a relationship, although Ami herself seems to find Shinichi's athletic build attractive.

characters.name: Higuchi Chisato
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Tsugumi Aozora
characters.description: She is a feminine-presenting classmate who the Pastimers suspect of actually being male, leading them to go to great lengths to uncover Tsugumi's true identity. Tsugumi keeps their identity ambiguous and enjoys teasing the club in return.

characters.name: Kentarou Honda
characters.description: Younger brother of Hanako Honda.  Not much is known about him but he seems to show strong care for Hanako.

characters.name: Olivia
characters.description: A blonde-haired, blue-eyed girl who transferred into [Hanako](https://anilist.co/character/126452/)'s midde school. Both of her parents are non-Japanese, and her appearance might make you think she knows English, but she's actually really bad at it because she was born and raised in Japan. In fact, she can barely speak a word of English.  (Source: ANN)

characters.name: Hanako Honda
characters.description: An energetic and bright girl who can both play sports and hit the books. However, that doesn't mean she's the sharpest knife in the drawer. She admires popular girls with fulfilling lives, and she's currently part of her middle school's soft tennis team in order to become one herself. However, there seems to be no hope of her becoming popular anytime in the near future.  (Source: ANN)

characters.name: Kasumi Nomura
characters.description: A girl who appears to be a goody-two-shoes who reads book in the classroom after school, but she's actually extremely unskilled at English. She asks [Olivia](https://anilist.co/character/126451/) to teach her English. (Source: ANN)

characters.name: Miuna Shiodome
characters.description: A third grade elementary school girl whose mother, Miori (originally from Shioshishio), died when she was young. She met Akari a couple of times and played with her when Akari came to visit Miuna's mom and the family.

characters.name: Sayu Hisanuma
characters.description: A third grade elementary school girl with brown haired pigtails and eyes. She is Miuna's best friend who often instigates confrontations with sea people. She appears to have a crush on Kaname.   ! After the timeskip, she entered the same middle school as Hikari and the others. She also decided to be more serious at studying and becoming independent. !

characters.name: Manaka Mukaido
characters.description: The heroine, a middle school girl who is indecisive and prone to crying. She is best friends with [Hikari Sakishima](https://anilist.co/character/73067).

characters.name: Kaname Isaki
characters.description: One of four childhood friends from Shioshishio. He is [Hikari](https://anilist.co/character/73067/Sakishima-Hikari)'s best friend and is quiet and mature for his age. He is interested in [Chisaki](https://anilist.co/character/86227/Hiradaira-Chisaki) and cares deeply for her.

characters.name: Hikari Sakishima
characters.description: One of four childhood friends from Shioshishio. He has a short temper and usually scolds Manaka for her mistakes, though he has deep feelings for her. He is the son of Shioshishio's Chief Priest, who serves the Sea God.

characters.name: Tsumugu Kihara
characters.description: A boy from the surface whose grandfather is a fisherman. One day, he meets [Manaka](https://anilist.co/character/73065/Mukaido-Manaka) when she is caught in his net. He is quiet, stoic, and very interested in the underwater world.

characters.name: Chisaki Hiradaira
characters.description: A calm and compassionate 14-year-old middle school student from Shioshishio, a village located in the sea. Chisaki is the childhood friend of [Manaka](https://anilist.co/character/73065/Mukaido-Manaka), [Hikari](https://anilist.co/character/73067/Sakishima-Hikari), and [Kaname](https://anilist.co/character/86313/Isaki-Kaname), and together they attend Mihama Junior High School, which is located in the surface town of Oshiooshi. She attempts to act mature in most situations, putting her friends' feelings before her own, but her temper can flare up whenever she gets especially frustrated - in particular towards [Tsumugu](https://anilist.co/character/86225/Kihara-Tsumugu), whose new presence she believes is spoiling the harmonious relationship between her friends.   Chisaki harbors an unrequited crush on Hikari, although he is unaware of her feelings. She also has a complex about her body​ and hates change to the point where it hinders her own emotional development.  !Chisaki is the only one of her childhood friends left on the surface after the disaster at the Ofunehiki festival leaves Shioshishio in a state of forced hibernation, and she grows to be five years older than the three of them, feeling guilty for not only living peacefully away from her home in their absence, but for falling in love with Tsumugu in the process too. She aspires to become a nurse after Tsumugu's grandfather, who took Chisaki in after she was left homeless, collapses due to deteriorating health.!

characters.name: Nashetania Loei Piena Augustra
characters.description: Though she is the princess of the large kingdom Piena, she is a wild and free girl, full of mischief. She is the Saint of Blades.  !She was the seventh brave who activated the barrier around the temple.!

characters.name: Fremy Speeddraw
characters.description: A girl whose cool indifference won’t allow others to get close. As the Saint of Gunpowder she uses guns and bullets in battle.

characters.name: Adlet Mayer
characters.description: A young boy who calls himself the strongest man in the world. He fights with a mastery of various secret weapons.

characters.name: Mora Chester
characters.description: An extremely serious and intellectual woman. She serves as the leader of the Saints and is the Saint of Mountains.

characters.name: Goldof Auora
characters.description: A young knight completely devoted to Nashetania, he wields a giant spear.

characters.name: Hans Humpty
characters.description: A strange man who mimics a cat as he talks. He fences with an unworldly and peculiar skill.

characters.name: Chamo Rosso
characters.description: A proud girl who is called the most powerful warrior of the current age. She is the Saint of Swamps.

characters.name: Rafał
characters.description: Rafal is a child prodigy who at the age of twelve was planning to advance to college and major in theology. One day, he meets [Hubert](https://anilist.co/character/280000/Hubert) and is fascinated by the beauty of the heliocentric theory.

characters.name: Oczy
characters.description: Pessimistic and afraid of looking up at the sky, this private police duelist by trade goes on an unlikely astronomical quest. “Oczy” is the plural word of “oko”, the Polish word for “eye”.

characters.name: Draka
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Schmitt
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Nowak
characters.description: Novak is a former mercenary and current inquisitor. He doesn't particularly believe in the church's dogma, but wants to maintain a peaceful society for the sake of his daughter.

characters.name: Jolenta
characters.description: Jolenta is an astronomy research assistant. She is restricted in her studies because she is a woman.

characters.name: Badeni
characters.description: Badeni is a monk in search of the "moment that makes life special." As a result of that, his eyes were burned out and he was moved to a rural village. He has an extraordinary amount of knowledge and the ability to calculate.

characters.name: Reiko Terayama
characters.description: Reiko Terayama is the daughter of Daitaku Terayama; one of the richest men in Kyoto. In public Reiko is beautiful, elegant and well mannered. However, secretly she has an obsession with her motorbike she calls her "bimo". She has a distaste for men and prefers her "bimo" over them. But as soon as she met Kintaro Oe her views change...

characters.name: Kintarou Ooe
characters.description: Kintaro "The Golden Boy" Oe is the 25-year-old protagonist of the anime, manga, and OVA series "Golden Boy." As a "Tokyo University Department of Law" dropout, he is studying the way of life by traveling with his bike through Japan. Although he dropped out, he mastered the entire curriculum. This fact combined with his knowledge of the human behavior and psyche lets one assume that he is indeed quite intelligent. He goes from place to place, applying for whatever job he can, instead of sticking to one occupation.

characters.name: Ayuko Hayamizu
characters.description: Golden girl No.4. An olympic gold medalist and swimming instructor that runs her own swimming school. Ayuko is very dominant and disciplined, she requires a lot of involvment in work from her staff. Furthermore her methods of learning need some changes, because they're not suitable for students. Kintaro is about to influence her attitude.

characters.name: Chie
characters.description: Chie is a cel-painter at the animation studio where Kintarou works as an errand-boy.

characters.name: Naoko Katsuda
characters.description: Relatives: Juzo Katsuda (father), Noriko Katsuda (mother)  Naoko is the daughter of a powerful local politician and Noriko Katsuda and the friend of Yuka Kanzaki who has employed Kintaro Oe as part of his campaign team to run for a third term as mayor.

characters.name: Noriko
characters.description: Golden girl No.3. Dreams about arranging flowers for her beloved one. Her parents run a noodle restaurant. She is looking for true love and is very shy and sensitive. She contends with marrying a rich businessman from yakuza. Kintaro helps her with making the right decision.

characters.name: Onna Shachou
characters.description: She is the owner of a software company in episode one. She is a strong, independent and intelligent woman. Moreover she is really hot and wears expensive, sexy clothes. She does not believe in showing sincerity to men because of their true intentions, that's why she never employs men. Kintaro is the first man to work in her office.

characters.name: Balgo Ywain Parks
characters.description: Race: Human, Dragon Type: Dragonclad Affiliation: Wing Bind  A human who became a Dragonclad after living with Selvie for 10 years and being bitten by him. He is currently looked after by Noel Niihashi and Ninny Spangcole.

characters.name: Billy Banx Jr.
characters.description: Billy Banx Jr. is a member of the Pipers of Wing Bind and Noel Niihashi and Ninny Spangcole's commanding officer. He was briefly a member of the Sabres until he was demoted for laziness.

characters.name: Noel Niihashi
characters.description: Race: Human Affiliation: Wing Bind Profession: Witch, High School Student Position: 1st Order Conservation, Ranger "Pipers" Partner: [Ninny Spangcole](https://anilist.co/character/127130/Ninny-Spangcole) Base of Operations: Reverse London  A Witch working for Wing Bind in Reverse London. She is the partner of Ninny Spangcole.

characters.name: Ninny Spangcole
characters.description: Race: Human Affiliation: Wing Bind Profession: Witch, Singer Position: 2nd Order Conservation, Ranger "Pipers" Partner: [Noel Niihashi](https://anilist.co/character/127129) Base of Operations: Reverse London  A Witch working for Wing Bind in Reverse London. She is the partner of Noel Niihashi.

characters.name: Osushi
characters.description: Race: Dragon Type: Disguiser/Dark Dragon Owner: [Balgo Parks](https://anilist.co/character/185999/Balgo-Ywain-Parks)  A Dragon masquerading as Balgo Parks's pet dog in London. In his dog form, Osushi is a small Pomeranian with light-colored fur and dark paws. In his Dark Dragon form, Osushi is a large, black dragon with a light underbelly, four thick legs and two enormous wings. He is heavily scaled and possesses many sharp teeth.

characters.name: Akuto Sai
characters.description: Akuto Sai was left on the door steps of a church by a strange woman. He grows up and transfers into the Constant Academy for Magical Arts, wanting to be a high priest. He meets Junko Hattori on the train to the school, and forms a pact with her to make the world a better place. The predicting spirit Yata Garasu predicts that he will be a Demon Lord upon graduation. Yata's predictions have never been wrong, and everyone becomes afraid of him as a result. Even so, he still tries to do the right thing when situations happen around him and he is shown to have an incredible amount of power within him, shown when he absorbs a demon dog's mana to revert it back to normal, something which a normal mage is unable to do. He struggles from time to time when his power comes forth and attempts to use the destructive energies to help instead of harm. Sai aims to become part of his country's highest order of magicians and contribute to society.     !Later, he learns to manage his evil powers, so he can use them on his own will. He normally uses them when he gets angry.     When he reminisce his past better, he remembers that, when he was a child, he wanted to destroy the "Gods" -that actually are Giant Computer Systems-.    When he was attacked by Junko, he carries her and tells her that after it was all over, he would take good care of her.!

characters.name: Korone
characters.description: Korone is a Liladan (リラダン Riradan?), a race of androids, sent by the government to observe Akuto 24/7. She is usually emotionless and stolid, but occasionally curious when it comes to certain things. However, she does display human characteristics on occasion; particularly, she enjoys teasing Akuto, often doing ecchi things in front of him. She sleeps in a small storage closet in Akuto's dorm and has numerous firearms and other items stored inside her handbag, a sort of hammerspace. Korone has the ability to read other people's emotions and can detect an individual's mana levels. She, like all Liladans, can be temporarily deactivated by pulling a switch resembling a rabbit's tail located on her lower back. She starts having feelings for Sai.

characters.name: Junko Hattori
characters.description: Junko is introduced in episode one of the anime. She's very skilled with a short blade and wooden sword, both of which she carries or summons. She also has a tsundere nature, often becoming embarrassed and misunderstanding situations because of that. She comes from a Suharaist family that protects the Empire and is very strict about upholding the values that were taught to her.   !She wants to marry Sai Akuto and even temporarily removed herself from her family to aid Sai when he was in trouble, trying to destroy the Gods and save Keena. As Sai was about to leave on  Peterhausen, he told her that when he gets back he will take good care of her.!

characters.name: Hiroshi Miwa
characters.description: A boy who thinks Akuto Sai is amazing and always bugs him by pretending to be brothers and calling Sai "Demon King". He often states that he is Sai's most loyal follower.     ! soon it shows that he is the reincanation of a Hero, who later recovers his powers, becoming a monster-slayer superhero called Brave. !

characters.name: Keena Soga
characters.description: A weird girl who seems to have some kind of relationship with Akuto, who she calls Aa-chan. She is astonishingly optimistic. Her special abilities are disappearing, flying and eating amazing amounts of rice, to the point that, when she has to grow a plant using her mana, the plant takes the form of a rice plant. Her hair has two sprouts on the top that wag depending on how she feels.

characters.name: Eiko Teruya
characters.description: She just transfered to the school but seems to know what Etou Fujiko is up to. She also states that she was just going to tease Sai Akuto a little but now that she knows he is cute he will be seeing a lot more of her. She also stated that once she gets attached to something she can't leave it alone.

characters.name: Fujiko Etou
characters.description: Fujiko Etou is the current head of the Etou family, the head of the girl's dorms at Constant Academy, and the only person who understands Akuto's current situation. Her older brother, the Etou's previous head, was killed after failing a mission, causing Fujiko to become the new head of the family, though for unexplained reasons, she kept her brother's (revived) head, which is kept in a jar-like container filled with fluid. She is the leader of an underground movement that uses black magick (magic) for evil purposes and plans to use Akuto's demon powers once he becomes Demon Lord for her own purposes.    (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yuuto Itou
characters.description: An innocent high school otaku and best friend of [Tsutsui](https://anilist.co/character/83235/Tsutsui--Hikari). He is known for wearing cat ears on his head often causing his classmates to distance themselves from Yuuto. He is a very caring and kind person who supports Tsutsui in every way he can.  Ito is very kind and cares for his friends. He is awkward when meeting new people.

characters.name: Hikari Tsutsui
characters.description: An awkward otaku who has bad luck with relationships but is ironically dating [Igarashi Iroha](https://anilist.co/character/83237/Iroha-Igarashi). He has a very timid personality which often leads others to push him around.

characters.name: Iroha Igarashi
characters.description: A beautiful and flashy high school student dating [Tsutsui](https://anilist.co/character/83235/Tsutsui--Hikari). She is a very honest and easy-going person often fooling around with her close friends.   Iroha is a very honest girl who is a little bit shy, but not all that much and she is also quite easy-going and can get jealous rather easily. She doesn't like it when others say rude things about her friends.

characters.name: Sumie Ayado
characters.description: A shy high school student and otaku. Due to her very timid personality, she is often seen isolating herself from other classmates. She views Tsutsui greatly due to their similar interests and views Iroha as an idol, wishing to be like her.

characters.name: Arisa Ishino
characters.description: An outgoing high school student friends with [Tsutsui](https://anilist.co/character/83235/Tsutsui--Hikari) and [Iroha](https://anilist.co/character/83237/Iroha-Igarashi). She has a hard time judging other people and is gullible, often being misled by boys.  Arisa is a bit nosy and is a bad judge of character, but she is still friendly enough to become friends with Hikari Tsutsui and Iroha Igarashi, despite their reputations.

characters.name: Mitsuya Takanashi
characters.description: A popular and handsome high school student. He has feelings for [Iroha](https://anilist.co/character/83237/Iroha-Igarashi) and often flirts with her in hopes of making her his girlfriend. He views [Tsutsui](https://anilist.co/character/83235/Tsutsui--Hikari) as his rival and is incredibly jealous of him to the point where he spreads false rumors about him.  Takanashi was initially snobbish, deceptive, and arrogant to the point of ruining Hikari Tsutsui reputation just so he could have a chance with Iroha Igarashi by spreading rumors that Hikari was a lolicon. Later though, after witnessing the gravity of his actions, he begins to feel a bit of remorse and eventually apologizes to Hikari's family along with his younger sister who assisted him with this act. He eventually begins to tag along with Hikari and his group of friends more. He begins to act more like a friend to Hikari as the story progresses and starts to care more about Arisa Ishino, although he continuously denied it that this hints he is having feelings for her and plays into the "tsundere" trope.  !Post time leap he gets married to Arisa Ishino and they have a child!

characters.name: Victoria Samanark
characters.description: The elder sister of the duke, and a brilliant sorcerer. Both her parents were human, but she was born a half-elf and chose the path of a sorcerer. Her favorite is pudding a la mode.  (Source: Official Site

characters.name: Adelheid
characters.description: The first princess of the empire. While on sick leave at the palace villa, she began visiting Nekoya regularly and began to gradually recover. Her favorite is chocolate parfaits.  (Source: Official Site)

characters.name: Aletta
characters.description: A young demon girl who found Western Restaurant Nekoya while jobless and down on her luck, and ended up being hired there. Through the people she’s met at Nekoya, she’s found some job leads back in her own world, as well. She always looks forward to eating the master’s cooking on meal breaks.  (Source: Official Site)

characters.name: Kuro
characters.description: The avatar of a black dragon who, like Aletta, works at Western Restaurant Nekoya. When she comes to the restaurant, she takes the form of an elf girl and uses her power of telepathy to speak to others. She has a bit of an obsession with chicken curry.  (Source: Official Site)

characters.name: Shareef
characters.description: The prince who made iced coffee popular in the Land of Sand. He has fallen for the "Lovely Lady" Adelheid. His favorite is coffee floats.  (Source: Official Site)

characters.name: Tenshu
characters.description: The owner of Western Restaurant Nekoya, a historic restaurant in the basement of a multi-tenant building in one corner of a shopping district. He inherited the restaurant from his father ten years ago. He is skilled at cooking not only Western cuisine, but Japanese, Chinese, and even desserts, among many other dishes.  (Source: Official Site)
