It was this incident that made Lux decide to join Fugil's coup d'etat and pilot the "Bahamut" though he has since forgotten the incident after several years.!

characters.name: Lux Arcadia
characters.description: He was a prince from the Empire that was destroyed five years ago due to the coup d'état. He is a Drag-Knight who is called the “Weakest Undefeated” and also the "Black Hero". He is also the user of the Divine Drag-Ride "Bahamut". (Source: saijakumuhainobahamut.wikia.com)

characters.name: Yoruka Kirihime
characters.description: She was the princess of the fallen nation of Koto, later becoming an assassin for the Old Arcadia Empire and then a student of the New Kingdom's Royal Officer Academy.

characters.name: Yuuji Endou
characters.description: A dirty loan shark with ties to the yakuza. He lends out large sums of money to the desperate, but charges an absurd (and illegal) interest rate. He tracks down Kaiji after a client of his, Furuhata, disappeared without repaying a loan, which Kaiji cosigned in an act of weakness. Recognizing Kaiji could never repay the loan, Endō offers him the opportunity to board the gambling ship Espoir, where he would be able repay his debt and make some money as well.  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yukio Tonegawa
characters.description: Kazutaka Hyoudou's right-hand man and the CEO of the Teiai Corporation. He oversees the majority of Teiai's diabolic gambles and possesses keen powers of observation.

characters.name: Kaiji Itou
characters.description: The main character of the story. Kaiji is poor, downtrodden and lazy - he lives by himself in a slum and is constantly in debt. He bides his time by playing cheap gambling games with neighbors, though he always loses. In spite of this, when his life is in danger, he displays a remarkable hidden capacity for gambling, which allows him to endure the hardships he faces. He is shouldered with a 3,850,000 yen debt at the beginning of the story by a coworker who convinced him into consigning a loan, leaving Kaiji with the full weight of the debt compounded over a year. Though he started off as somewhat of a naive man, he quickly develops into a clever and thoughtful gambler after his first experience on the Espoir.

characters.name: Kazutaka Hyoudou
characters.description: Wealthy socialite and president of the powerful financial consulting firm "Love Emperor", not to mention owner and sponsor of underground gambling tournaments like those onboard Espoir. Hyōdō Kazutaka is believed to be seventy years old and worth several hundred billion yen. Driven mad by wealth, conventional hobbies fail to entertain him, so he funds gambling tournaments to watch the destitute of society struggle against overwhelming terror and despair.  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Miharu Kiryuu
characters.description: Height: 157 cm  (5'2")  He is a very polite and elegant vampire with absolutely no filter. He will say whatever is on his mind, no matter how rude it is. He doesn't drink blood but uses his soul-stealing ability to absorb vital energy of others. He joins the Otogi household as Nico's fourth familiar.

characters.name: Nemu Miyao
characters.description: Height: 152 cm  (5'0")  A witch from a venerable household who specializes in shape-shifting magic and can turn into a cat. Falling asleep turns her back. She wants to make [Morihito](https://anilist.co/character/207344/) her familiar.

characters.name: Keigo Magami
characters.description: Height: 176 cm  (5'9")  Nico's classmate and self-proclaimed hipster. He was a figure skater until an accident forced him to retire.  !He's actually a werewolf, and seeing any crescent shape brings out his other [personality](https://anilist.co/character/301197/).!

characters.name: Kanshi Kazamatsuri
characters.description: Height: 164 cm  (5'5")  A tengu. Due to clan differences, he didn't like [Morihito](https://anilist.co/character/207344/) at first. He's highly sociable and makes friends easily. He joins the Otogi household as [Nico's](https://anilist.co/character/207345/) familiar.

characters.name: Morihito Otogi
characters.description: Height: 181 cm  (5'11")  An ogre. Strong and level-headed, he's had his hands full ever since his childhood friend [Nico](https://anilist.co/character/207345/) returned. Nico's nickname for him is "Moi."

characters.name: Nico Wakatsuki
characters.description: Height: 159 cm (5'3")  A witch. Clumsy and goofy, she has a tendency to let compliments go straight to her head. Her dream is to be a great witch who helps others.  Due to being the Witch of Thousand, a type of witch that is born every 1000 years that is able to use various spells unlike normal witches, she is targeted by a group of Black Witches. Her childhood friend and first love, [Morihito](https://anilist.co/character/207344/), is assigned the task of being her familiar and protecting her from harm.

characters.name: Hideki Motosuwa
characters.description: **Height:** 178 cm (5'10'')  Hideki Motosuwa is a student who is attempting to qualify for university by studying at the Seki cram school in Tokyo. He's an honest and kind teenager who was raised on a farm, and unfortunately for him, has no experience with women. He has a very active imagination, which tends to result in him talking to himself in public. Hideki is interested in finding a girlfriend and has a great desire to have a Persocom—a computer shaped in the form of a human who can do all sorts of things. Although he cannot afford one, his luck holds out when he finds one lying in a garbage dump on his way home from the groceries, which he names [Chii](https://anilist.co/character/227/Chii).

characters.name: Chii
characters.description: Height: 152 cm (5'0")  Chii is a Persocom who is found by [Hideki Motosuwa](https://anilist.co/character/225) in a garbage dump. At first, she is only able to say "Chii", thus earning her that name. Later on, she is taught various things, and is eventually able to communicate with other people.  !She is a Chobit, a legendary Persocom that is capable of thinking independently and feeling human emotions. Her real name is Elda. She was created to be a "little sister" to Freya, the first Chobit, after Chitose Hibiya noticed Freya becoming increasingly sad. After Freya eventually breaks down, Elda takes Freya's mind into her own in an attempt to save her. In the manga, this causes her own memories to reset. In the anime, Hibiya resets Elda's memories in order to find the One just for her.  Chi has a special program installed on her designed to connect to every persocom on the planet. In the manga, if Chi fails to find the One just for her, she would delete the ability for persocoms to recognize humans from one another. In the anime, if Chi does find the One just for her, the program would give all persocoms the ability to feel real emotions.!

characters.name: Sumomo
characters.description: Sumomo is a mobile persocom - which is the persocom equivalent of a laptop computer. She is programmed to be cute and tends to be quite hyperactive, for example her morning 'wakey wakey exercises'.     At the beginning of the series, Shinbo uses Sumomo in an attempt to analyze Chi, and Sumomo is nearly broken in the process, requiring new main memory, and in the manga, a new video card as well. Once Kotoko joined Hideki, she quickly came to the conclusion that Sumomo was crazy, with her nonsensical ways. Sumomo's password after being received by Hideki is Chobits (case sensitive) and ちょびっツ　(case sensitive because of the katakana at the end)

characters.name: Hiroyasu Ueda
characters.description: Hiroyasu Ueda  is the owner of Chiroru, a local bakery which Yumi once worked in and which Chi ends up working at. He, too, has suffered a trauma involving persocoms.    !When he first opened his bakery, he bought a persocom to help with math and accounting, which he admits he is terrible at. He eventually fell in love with this persocom and then married her, but she developed a hard disk fault which resulted in the gradual degradation of her memory, until she remembered almost nothing at all.  Rarely, she would suddenly recall small fragments of memories from her life with Hiroyasu. He could not bring himself to have her repaired because her memories might be lost completely in the process of transferring them to a new hard drive, and he felt she would not be the same person if this happened. Soon, her memory degraded to the point that she could not remember anything for more than a few seconds at a time, and Hiroyasu had keep a constant watch on her to prevent her from wandering away. One night while walking with his persocom, Hiroyasu, lost in thought, walked into the middle of the street, unaware of an oncoming car. In one final moment of clarity, his persocom pushed him out of the way, and was herself run over. Her last words to Hiroyasu were, "Konnichiwa."!   !Hiroyasu and Yumi Omura were in love in the past, but broke up when Yumi quit her job at the bakery when she discovered that the persocom he married was named "Yumi" and feared she would never live up to the other Yumi. Through the help of Chi and Hideki, he and Yumi resume their relationship.!

characters.name: Noboru Maeda
characters.description: Maeda Noboru, nicknamed Suppon (Turtle). He has been detained for theft, con, dine-and-ditch, and many other crimes which could not be fully investigated during his detention.    Maeda is one of the seven protagonists in RAINBOW. He is the smallest guy in the group and the most cunning in the team. Other than An-chan, he seems to get along with Jou best,  most probably because of them being same aged and both being orphans.

characters.name: Tadayoshi Tooyama
characters.description: One of the seven main protagonists of RAINBOW. Nicknamed Heitai (Army Corps/ Soldier), he has been detained for acts of violence and false imprisonments. He ruthlessly struck his mother's boyfriend, seriously injuring the man.

characters.name: Jou Yokosuka
characters.description: Yokosuka Jou, nicknamed Joe is one of the seven protagonist of RAINBOW. He has been detained for 2 years for violence after being forced to have intergender relationships. He inflicted injuries requiring three months of recovery on the person who attempted to violate him.    Joe is weak by nature. He offered Sakuragi a cigarette in the first day to beg for mercy as Sakuragi took all six of them on in a fight started by Mario.    He has a younger sister named Megumi.

characters.name: Ryuuji Nomoto
characters.description: Nomoto Ryuji, nickname Baremoto, which means "Uncovered" has been detained for con, usurpation, and theft. He frequently committed crimes in shopping centers.    Nomoto is one of the seven protagonists of RAINBOW. He wears glasses and have a character of being an observer. Sakuragi used his glasses to refract sunbeam to light the cigarette which Joe gave to him.

characters.name: Rokurouta Sakuragi
characters.description: Sakuragi Rokurouta, referred as 'An-chan' by his cell mates, is the oldest of the seven protagonists in Rainbow. He is strong and has great boxing technique which he used to take on all the six new comers when Mario instigated a fight.  Although it seemed he looked down upon the six new cell mates in the beginning, which lead to a fight he won with ease, the six new cell mates found out later that Sakuragi is in reality a guy worthy to look upon and soon start to refer him as An-chan, which can be translated as an 'intimate bro'.  The reason why Sakuragi has been detained is unknown. Rumors are he killed his own parents. It seems Sakuragi holds the key to lead the six new comers to the outside world when they end their detention in two years time.   !In episode 4, it is revealed that he didn't really kill his father. His father was depressed that he survived a war where his sons died, and Sakuragi said harsh things to him because he didn't understand, causing his father to commit suicide. Sakuragi blames himself, and keeps insisting that he's the reason his father is dead.!  ! In episode 12, after being stabbed by Ishihara, he goes to see Mario Minakami's boxing match, but is shot down by American soldiers on his way there.!

characters.name: Mario Minakami
characters.description: Minakami Mario is one of the seven main protagonists in RAINBOW. Nicknamed Mario has been detained to two years of confinement in the Shonan Special Disciplinary School. He was found guilty of inflicting grave injuries on one of his teachers who attempted an act of violence towards a female student.  Mario is strong willed and hates being looked down upon. He was the first one to start a fight in day one soon after being confined in a cell with Sakuragi.

characters.name: Jinno
characters.description: Perhaps one of the most noble and tragic characters  Once known as the boy Jinnosuke, he is perhaps the only friend Afro Samurai has ever known. Once a charismatic and young sub-leader of a secret sword school, fate destines that Jinnosuke get horribly disfigured and trapped into the powerful and twisted mechanical teddy bear helmet which earns him the name Kuma(which means "bear" in Japanese).  With his two-sword technique still in tact and even further enhanced by his cybernetic implants, Kuma is nearly unstoppable. Too bad that underneath this frighteningly powerful warrior, is still the troubled mind of a good friend whose life light was snuffed out too early...

characters.name: Brother One
characters.description: The leader of the Empty Seven, who believes that obtaining both headbands will lead to immortality and godhood. He has a golden robotic left arm, which he can switch out for a machine gun.

characters.name: Rokutarou
characters.description: Rokutarou, Afro's father, was the Number One at the beginning of the series, who lost his title and life to Justice when he decapitated him. How he attained the Number One headband, what he did during his time as Number One, and how long he'd had it prior to Justice killing him remains unclear.

characters.name: Afro Samurai
characters.description: The holder of the title "Number Two," Afro is out to hunt down Justice, the man who killed his father for the rank of "Number One." From the time he was a child, Afro honed his skills as a swordsman; his style typically consists of wielding his sword with only his right hand while his left continues to hold on to his sheath, although during his fight with Jinno, he held his sword with both hands to compensate for Jinno's dual wielding speed. He is a very quiet individual, likely because the life of the "Number Two" does not allow him to have any close relationships with anyone, so when approached by others he says very little, if anything.  Although he seems cold, he is still haunted by his memories and past relationships; Justice later remarks that Afro, like his father, is still "soft inside." He also has a fondness for lemonade.   !The only times Afro had shown any extreme emotional reactions were when he fought the Sword Master for the Number Two Headband, and when fighting Justice who reminds Afro of his father's tragic death.  At the end of the series, he kills Justice and becomes the "Number One", but is almost impaled by one of Justice's spikes only to survive by having the spike go through his afro and skim that top of his head, thus saving Afro from death.  After the 'death' of Ninja Ninja, Afro seemed to be able to show himself more emotionally seen when he sheds tears for 'killing' Jinno before facing Justice and by his casual conversation with Jinno before facing him for the second time.!

characters.name: Ninja Ninja
characters.description: The white haired companion of Afro Samurai. Afro's herald, hype-man and a real trash-talker; Ninja Ninja bears witness to Afro Samurai's search for Justice. Ninja Ninja is a force of nature - mischievous, highly-strung and dangerously irresponsible. When something is going down he'll split as fast as his veneer of cool. It's sometimes hard to tell if Ninja Ninja is Afro's ally or his enemy.   !Acknowledged by Afro alone through his gazes in Ninja Ninja's direction and his liking for telling the white haired wonder to "shut up", it is revealed in the last episode that Ninja Ninja was merely an illusion created from Afro's feelings of guilt and regret from killing his Master for the "Number Two" headband. Ninja Ninja also seems to represent fear and hesitation, since he constantly advises Afro to avoid fighting when they meet a very strong opponent. Almost like Afro's subconscious screaming out to him. !

characters.name: Remon Yamano
characters.description: Height: 139 cm (4'7")   Class: 3rd Year    A short, third year high school student with a petite appearance and a distinctive voice. She is generally cold towards people, but befriends Ichika when they first meet. She is good at picking locks and can be quite mischievous, such as when she makes the rest of the group drink an alcoholic drink, then records them sleeping. She seems devious, as though everything she does has an ulterior motive. Since she claims to have written a script for Lucas in Hollywood (implying George Lucas), she ends up being the writer for the group's movie. She thinks of Ichika as her best friend. Remon is somewhat sarcastic, usually laughing like "uhuhu", although she is almost always seen smiling.     !Though, she is 17 years old it is hinted that she could be much older that what she claims, since in one episode she did claim to be eternally 17. It is also suggested that she probably was once a classmate of Tetsurou's elder sister Minami Ogura.  In episode 12 it is confirmed that she is the high-ranked agent of Japanese branch of "Men in Black"!

characters.name: Kaito Kirishima
characters.description: Height: 158 cm (5'2") Class: 1st Year  The main protagonist is a student in his first year of high school. He is an avid videographer, and is constantly out recording things. Others sometimes refer to him as "The Director". He's seemingly aware of Tanigawa's feelings for him, nonetheless he seems to have a genuine interest for Ichika. He has day dreams of conversing with Ichika and talks out loud sometimes during them. This may even lead to misunderstandings in a comical sense.

characters.name: Mio Kitahara
characters.description: Height: 157 cm (5'2") Class: 1st Year  A beautiful girl who is quite shy, but has pretty lewd thoughts sometimes. A good friend of Tanigawa. She has feelings for Tetsuro and her thoughts seem to innocently go in a sexual direction.

characters.name: Tetsurou Ishigaki
characters.description: Height: 177 cm (5'9") Class: 1st Year  A close, easygoing friend of Kaito and Tanigawa. He knows of her feelings for Kaito and encourages a relationship between the two. He seems to be an all-around savvy guy with females and is easily able to smooth-talk a female teacher into giving out Ichika's body measurements. He is known to be quite handsome in his class, even in the eyes of the teachers.

characters.name: Kanna Tanigawa
characters.description: Height: 152 cm (5') Class: 1st Year  [Kaito](https://anilist.co/character/47299/Kaito-Kirishima)'s classmate. She seems to have a crush on him, and gets jealous when he talks about other girls.

characters.name: Ichika Takatsuki
characters.description: Height: 163 cm (5'3") Class: 3rd Year  !A 3rd year student who stands out due to her red hair. The main female protagonist is an alien come to Earth who acts to save [Kaito](https://anilist.co/character/47299/Kirishima-Kaito) from the injuries he sustains when her ship crash-lands. Being an alien unaccustomed to life on Earth, her actions may seem weird in the eyes of others, but she is quick to correct herself, if only to hide the fact that she's an alien. She is kind, polite, friendly and a good cook. Like her "best friend" [Remon Yamano](https://anilist.co/character/47297/Yamano-Remon), she is a third-year student in Kaito's high school.!

characters.name: Satsuki Miyanoshita
characters.description: Satsuki is the main character of the show. She moves with her father and her young brother Keichirou to the hometown of her deceased mother, where she finds that her mother confronted several evil entities that haunted the town, which included Amanojaku, and wrote all her supernatural experiences in a diary, which is entitled "The Ghost Journal."  Satsuki is very strong, brave, and determined, but sometimes bit moody, mostly because of Hajime trying to see her underpants. In the Spanish Dub, she was named "Claire". Her nickname in the Animax dub is Suki.

characters.name: Momoko Koigakubo
characters.description: Momoko is a 6th grader and Satsuki's best friend. She seems to fear nothing, even in very dangerous situations, and is very brave when it comes to helping Satsuki and the gang confront the ghosts. She also seems to have a psychic connection with Satsuki's mother. In the Spanish Dub, she was named as "Nicole"

characters.name: Hajime Aoyama
characters.description: Hajime is Satsuki's neighbor. He is always strong and courageous to help defeat the ghosts, but though he says that this is very brave, he is actually a coward. Despite this, he is one of the most reliable of Satsuki's friends and has saved her on more than one occasion. Hajime also has a naughty habit of flipping girls' skirts, and his constant victim is no other than Satsuki. This results in frequent comic moments. Throughout the anime, it seems that Hajime and Satsuki develop mutual crushes on each other (not that they'd admit it).    (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Reo Kakinoki
characters.description: Reo is Hajime's friend and has a big obsession with paranormal themes, and proclaims himself as a respected paranormal researcher. However, whenever Reo finds a clue pertaining to the existence of supernatural entities, it seems that the clue turns against him. Like Hajime, he tries to be brave but is actually just a coward.

characters.name: Amanojaku
characters.description: Amanojaku is a powerful entity that, long ago, was sealed by Satsuki's mother in a tree in the mountains, but was finally released from his magic prison due to urbanization. However, he did not have his freedom long, as Satsuki sealed him (by accident) in the body of her pet cat, Kaya. At first, Amanojaku is hostile toward the kids and takes great pleasure in seeing them in trouble, but throughout the series he develops somewhat of a care for them, especially for Satsuki and Keiichirou.

characters.name: Keiichirou Miyanoshita
characters.description: Keiichirou is Satsuki's young brother. He is easily frightened by many things and is seen crying sometimes, but he shows courage where it counts to help in defeating the ghosts. He creates a special friendship with the ghost Amanojaku.

characters.name: Terminus Est
characters.description: Est is Kamito's contracted spirit. She is a powerful sword spirit. In elemental waffe form she transforms into a sword known as Demon Slayer, Demon King Killing Sacred Sword, or The Sacred Sword of Severian.

characters.name: Ellis Fahrengart
characters.description: Ellis Fahrengart is a captain of the Sylphid Knights and a member Team Scarlet. She is the elementalist of the wind spirit Simorgh. Though she is armed with a sword, her main weapon is a lance which is an elemental waffe which her contract spirit transforms into.

characters.name: Fianna Ray Ordesia
characters.description: Fianna Ray Ordesia is a member of Team Scarlet and the so called the Lost Queen. She is the contractor of the light spirit Georgios.  She excels in ritual Kagura, which have many uses such as combat support, resealing, driving spirits mad, etc.

characters.name: Kamito Kazehaya
characters.description: The main character of this story, who suddenly sees Claire while she's washing herself. He eventually becomes her slave spirit.   !He is actually Ren Ashbell, the strongest blade dancer.!

characters.name: Claire Rouge
characters.description: Claire Rouge is the leader of Team Scarlet and an elementalist using the flame spirit Scarlet.

characters.name: Rinslet Laurenfrost
characters.description: Rinslet Laurenfrost is Claire's childhood friend and self proclaimed rival. She is a Member of Team Scarlet and elementalist using the ice wolf spirit Fenrir.

characters.name: Hatsuna Wakabayashi
characters.description: Hatsuna is a magician who escaped the laboratory. She has the ability to resurrect herself so cannot be killed by any physical harm. However, she will still die if she stops consuming pills.

characters.name: Kana Tachibana
characters.description: Kana is a magician who escaped the laboratory with Kuroha and is her roommate. Kana is paralyzed and cannot talk without her keyboard and has good intentions though she can be quite mouthy and rude. She has the ability to predict how and when people are going to die.

characters.name: Kazumi Schlierenzauer
characters.description: Kazumi is a half-Austrian magician who speaks Japanese with a Kansai accent. Her power is hacking computer systems.  She, also has feelings for Ryouta that she would try to seduce him and even go naked in front of him.

characters.name: Kotori Takatori
characters.description: Kotori has the ability to switch with other people and things as well as allowing others to come with her when she uses her powers. However she can only use her powers once which then causes her to hang up. Despite this handicap, her ability has often come into place in vital situations. She is not familiar with other magicians when still lived in the lab.  Kotori is a clumsy but soft-hearted girl. She gets nervous easily, and when that happens, she will start to stutter. She likes all kinds of desserts and does eat a lot of food.

characters.name: Ryouta Murakami
characters.description: The main character with high intellect and a photographic memory. He wants to be an astronomer who works at NASA due to a promise he made with his childhood friend Kuroneko. After meeting the magic users, he decides to provide shelter to them at an abandoned observatory despite knowing that their pursuers have orders to kill whoever comes in contact with them, usually coming with plans to have their location concealed while looking for ways to provide the medicine they need to keep living while helping them to live their lives as normal as possible.

characters.name: Neko Kuroha
characters.description: Being a magician Kuroha has the power to destroy any inanimate object, as well as transferring power when in direct contact with organic beings. Her power is so strong that while being in the lab, she had to undergo multiple extensive tests. As a result, Kuroha has almost completely forgotten her childhood memories, with only a few bits of emotion lingering.  Although usually gentle and caring, she can be short-tempered when embarrassed. She easily gets jealous when Murakami is "too close" to other girls (especially when Kazumi is seducing Murakami) and she would use her magic to destroy things around unconsciously. She is very puzzled by this reaction.

characters.name: Takeru Kusanagi
characters.description: The main male protagonist of the series, the twin brother of [Kiseki](https://anilist.co/character/150876), and the hapless leader of the titular 35th Test Platoon more infamously known as the "Small Fry Platoon". He is one of the last surviving members of the Kusanagi Clan as well as one of the only remaining blade users in the world, a lifestyle that he is constantly taunted for. He is contracted to [Lapis Lazuili](https://anilist.co/character/89258).  (Source: AntiMagic Academy Wiki)

characters.name: Lapis Lazuli
characters.description: A Relic Eater contracted to Takeru Kusanagi. Her true classification is that of a Sacred Treasure Type Magical Heritage, Mistelteinn who was previously wielded by one of Takeru's ancestors, Mikoto Kusanagi. Unlike other magical heritages, she prefers staying in her human form.  Lapis is solely fixated on her contractor and shows no concern over anyone else unless they involve themselves with her contractor. Even if addressed, she never responded to anyone other than Takeru, but in time she came to acknowledge others but mostly because of their importance to Takeru. She speaks with a monotone and subservient voice but is known to get extremely jealous and critical of herself if Takeru were to admire or even think about using another blade. Understandably, she is very proud of her abilities as a top-class blade. She soon becomes jealous of Takeru's interactions with his teammates, often becoming silent and unresponsive if she feels that she has been ignored for too long.  (Source: AntiMagic Wiki)

characters.name: Mari Nikaidou
characters.description: A witch most famously known as the Witch of Aurora, based off her ancient Aurora attribute. She was formerly a conscript member of Valhalla before becoming the first enrolled witch in the Anti-Magic Academy where she joined the 35th Test Platoon.   Mari is a selfless girl whose only reason in joining Valhalla was so that she could safeguard the children she grew up with in an orphanage in the outskirts of town. Her sense of justice is strong but her motivation mostly comes from her affection towards Takeru Kusanagi, often competing with others and complaining how she never gets any of her romantics "flags" raised. However, over time she begins to cherish her teammates as well.  Mari's prodigious magic ability makes her fairly confident in her abilities and she carries herself with a proud demeanor. Due to comparatively small chest however, she is frequently teased by her teammates and is at great odds with fellow platoon member Ouka Ootori, who embodies the two things Mari can't stand the most: having a large chest and, more importantly, despising magic.  (Source: AntiMagic Academy)

characters.name: Ouka Ootori
characters.description: The primary female protagonist of the series. She was a former Dullahan of the Inquisition's EXE before her demotion had her sent back into the Anti-Magic Academy and assigned to the infamous 35th Test Platoon. She is contracted to Vlad.  Fueled by a deep hatred for magic and vengeance in her heart, Ouka dedicated her entire life towards combating against witches and the likes. This led to her keen mind and tactical insight while her mercilessness also stemmed from her efficiency. Her social skills deteriorated, rather, never had the chance to form properly due to her overly-diligent work ethic. Where magic was involved, Ouka would hunt perpetrators and, more often than not, shoot first before asking any questions.  Even outside of work, Ouka's lack of social skills left her with nothing but work to focus on. She made it a point to work alone as to minimize the chances of getting too attached with others and suffering through loss if they happened to die given the dangerous profession. Takeru's insistence eventually had her slowly warm up to making friends and have others to rely on. Ouka's thirst for vengeance was eventually replaced with her intent to protect the ones she cared for. However, she still retained her terrible social skills to anyone outside of her team with the main concern regarding her being "unable to read the mood".  (Source: AntiMagic Academy Wiki)

characters.name: Usagi Saionji
characters.description: The 35th Platoon's prodigious sniper with a crippling case of stage fright. She hails from a high-class family with ties to the Inquisition's higher ups.  Usagi is a simple girl with simple motivations to become a sanctioned Inquisitor. Her high-class upbringing has her speak with a very dignified and refined manner, a trait that is not fully "appreciated" in the platoon as she is treated like a child by nearly all of her teammates. Usagi is very quick to anger and her emotions are easily read on her expressive face. She is also very haughty but only to the extent when she accomplishes something noteworthy.  Her major problem lies in her anxiety and how it obscures her natural talent as a sniper. Thinking over a situation and how her mistakes might cost her teammate's life has her panic and unable to pull the trigger, essentially making her useless under pressure.  (Source: AntiMagic Academy Wiki)

characters.name: Ikaruga Suginami
characters.description: The 35th Platoon's technological expert and Takeru's oldest friend. !She was formerly affiliated with the Alchemists as she is a product of the Suginami Design Children Project.!  Ikaruga is an extremely laid-back individual with habits that resemble a shut in. She speaks with a knowledgeable yet relaxed tone but she has a tough time, rather, she rarely cares to add any honorifics or speak in a tone that would be considered respectful. She states that she doesn't care for normal people and only took interest in the ones who "stick out". Ikaruga mostly sticks to the sidelines during her teammate's banters to pursue her own work and only chimes in when there was a fight that needed to be broken up, a sexual joke or moment to capitalize on, or when her expertise was needed.  She notably has the most "maternal" instincts on the team and looks out for the others as much as Takeru does.  (Source: AntiMagic Academy Wiki)

characters.name: Arashi Nikaidou
characters.description: Saint Liliana High School student attending the 2nd year and the President of the Student Council, Arashi has a ponytail and is seen often wearing an eye-patch on her right eye. Under the eye-patch is usually a red-colored contact lens. She is also seen often carrying a real katana. She is also known to not wear any underwear at all. She has the 1st grades on 3rd year and has powerful leadership, that she can't only handle most Student Council chores by herself, but also take control most of the school's activity.     !She is a bisexual and very aggressive sexually, even to that point that she has over 30 lovers, which has given her the nickname "Predator". However, later in the story she decides to separate peacefully with her lovers and aims to seduce and make Student Council as her harem for time being.!  !She is actually the cousin of [Akito](https://anilist.co/character/54725) before his adoption by his current parents, and she also knows that Akito is adopted, and decided to support him the way she can. She also knows that Kouichirou Shindo is Akito's pen name.!

characters.name: Akito Himenokouji
characters.description: The main protagonist. Akito recently reunited with his sister, after being separated for six years, and transferred into Saint Liliana High School class 2A. He is generally lazy and hopes to live a normal life, but he will also work with his full strength to achieve his goal.  He started to take care of his sister when he was young, however when their parents died, the siblings got separated when adopted by two different families. After secretly arranging for years he was finally reunited with her and moved out to live by themselves, but only to have find out that she has a brother complex, that developed while they were separated at youth.  !It is later revealed that he was actually adopted by his parents, and has no blood relationship with his sister, but he choose to keep this as a secret, especially to his sister.!  He loves to trick [Akiko](https://anilist.co/character/54513), or watching others trick her. He is quite over-protective of Akiko, and people around him often comment about this as having a serious sister complex, although both he and Akiko strongly deny this.  Since the siblings are now living by themselves, he secretly makes their living by writing porn novels of brother-sister incest under the pen name "Kouichirou Shindo", and has become a famous author. He is given the job as student counsel's "vice-assistant of proxy of secretary", that [Arashi](https://anilist.co/character/54723) happily claims that's a fabricated position for her underground lover; technically, his is the assistant of the secretary, Akiko.

characters.name: Ginbei Haruomi Sawatari
characters.description: Akito's childhood friend. Despite having a boyish name and talking mood, Ginbee is a girl and secretly has feeling toward Akito. Due to family issue, she was taught as a boy and cannot work herself, living only on her family's financial support. She later transferred into Saint Liliana High School and became the accountant of the student council. Despite the fact she even dared to move and transfer schools to follow Akito, Akito often refers to her as his best (normal) friend unintentionally, which disappoints her greatly. She has a habit of mumbling about Akito's unawareness whenever Akito overlooks her feeling.  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Anastasia Nasuhara
characters.description: Saint Liliana High School second-year student and the Vice-President of the Student Council, and the daughter of the owner of Nasuhara industry, a world-wide company. Anastasia has Russian and American parents. She has a cold personality and often asks strange questions, such as asking Akito if he is a cherry boy when they first met. She is the rival of Akiko and is proud of that she wins a small bit on almost everything, including height, grades, breast size, the rank during Miss Saint Liliana High School Election, and Student Council rank. However, she is extremely weak at house chores due to her wealthy family, to the point that she will gladly admit it and escape her chores. She also loves cute things, and not only keeps lots of plush dolls in her room, but also love to play with Arisa.   !Despite being a rival of Akiko, she goes very well with Akito and confessed to him on his first day to school. Although Akito hasn't gotten a chance to answer due to the chaotic situation that the confession brings on afterwards.! Anastasia demands that Akito calls her Ana, but laughs at him for calling a girl "hole" (because Ana means hole in Japanese) whenever he does so.  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Akiko Himenokouji
characters.description: Saint Liliana High School Second year student. Akiko is [Akito](https://anilist.co/character/54725)'s sister, and has a pretty appearance and polite manners. However, she has very serious brother-complex, and is taking a very active way to seduce Akito. She is also very proud of her brother complex and makes no effort of concealing it. She is the secretary of Saint Liliana High School Student Council, but is very reluctant when Akito interacts with other Student Council members.  !She doesn't know that Akito has no blood relationship with her and believes that they are twins; according to their deceased mother, Akiko will probably sexually assault her brother once she learns this fact. As for now, believing that they are blood related siblings, and respecting her brother's will is the only barrier that stops her from doing so.!  !She is a fan of Kouichirou Shindo, and wishes her brother would be as aggressive as the brother in Kouichirou Shindo's novel; however she hasn't notice that Kouichirou Shindo is her brother, and the beginning of Kouichirou Shindo's novel is based on their relationship.!

characters.name: Arisa Takanomiya
characters.description: !Daughter of [Akito](https://anilist.co/character/54725)'s adoptive family and also his fiancée.!  Arisa is a genius, despite being only 12 years old, she has already graduated from a famous university, and her essay is on multiple famous professional magazines. She is also good at house chores. At the end of the 4th novel, she moved in to live with the Student Council members. While most of the Student Council members prefer to say that the engagement doesn't count due to her age, [Akiko](https://anilist.co/character/54513) is the only one that views her as a love rival. However, after an argument of who is better for Akito, the two worked together as they noticed that Akito sees both of them as his sisters. She has a habit of going silent and showing emotions on her face, which is so cute that people who see it can't resist accepting her will.

characters.name: Michela McFarlane
characters.description: A friend of [Oliver](https://anilist.co/character/258618/Oliver-Horn)'s and a member of the Sword Roses. Chela is a proud young lady and the eldest daughter of the noble house of McFarlane, one of the five oldest families in Yelgland, and among the elite in the Magical World. She is an incredibly skilled mage, and often serves as the Sword Roses' voice of reason alongside Oliver as the two most mature members of the group.

characters.name: Katie Aalto
characters.description: A friend of [Oliver](https://anilist.co/character/258618/Oliver-Horn)'s and a member of the Sword Roses. Katie has very strong ideals compared to the typical mage, desiring to reform magical society's treatment of demi-humans. She appears to have a crush on Oliver and in contrast often finds herself at odds with [Guy](https://anilist.co/character/258621/Guy-Greenwood), although they remain close friends and seem to have a slight cooking rivalry amongst themselves.

characters.name: Oliver Horn
characters.description: Oliver attends Kimberly Magic Academy to better refine his vast skills. Upon arriving, he meets the likes of [Nanao](https://anilist.co/character/258620/Nanao-Hibiya), [Chela](https://anilist.co/character/258624/Michela-McFarlane), [Katie](https://anilist.co/character/258626/Katie-Aalto), [Guy](https://anilist.co/character/258621/Guy-Greenwood), and [Pete](https://anilist.co/character/258623/Pete-Reston), their tight-knit bond eventually leading to the formation of the Sword Roses alliance.  Oliver is a gentle, rational, thoughtful and caring boy. Although less outwardly emotional than others, he’s intelligent, brave and cares for his friends. Oliver generally takes every situation calmly but can quickly lose his temper when someone he's close to is harmed.  !In reality, his goal in attending Kimberly is to systematically eliminate every Kimberly instructor involved in the torture and murder of his mother, [Chloe Halford](https://anilist.co/character/341944/Chloe-Halford). To achieve this, he uses the powerful Fourth Spellblade Chloe originally possessed.!

characters.name: Nanao Hibiya
characters.description: Hailing from Tourikueisen in the distant country of Yamatsukuni, Nanao is a samurai girl who was offered a second chance at life by Theodore McFarlane. She attends Kimberly at his behest and finds a new purpose in life in crossing blades with [Oliver Horn](https://anilist.co/character/258618/Oliver-Horn). She is a noble and cheerful person who holds honor in high regards, and a good fight even moreso.

characters.name: Guy Greenwood
characters.description: A friend of [Oliver](https://anilist.co/character/258618/Oliver-Horn)'s and a member of the Sword Roses. Guy is cheerful and friendly, with a frank and pleasant personality and great thoughtfulness and concern towards his friends. He's unusually talented with the use of magical flora.  !Guy later awakens as a curse user and has to temporarily leave the Sword Roses until he is able to control his powers, which upsets his friends, particularly [Katie](https://anilist.co/character/258626/Katie-Aalto).!

characters.name: Pete Reston
characters.description: A friend of [Oliver](https://anilist.co/character/258618/Oliver-Horn)'s and a member of the Sword Roses. Pete is a mage born into a nonmagical family that enters Kimberly after scoring well on their difficult entrance exam. he forms a strong bond with the Sword Roses, who support him in his learning about the magical world and becoming stronger in it.  !It is later revealed that Pete is reversi. This means that his body can change sex.!

characters.name: Kizuna Hida
characters.description: He´s the second child of Hida Nayuta, younger brother and lover of Hida Reiri, adopted older brother to Hida Setsuna as well as the first-person who obtains HHG on Earth/Lemuria and the only male HHG pilot on Lemuria. After being expelled from Ataraxia by his mother, he lived as a regular student until he was called back by his sister after she learns his secret abilities and made him the captain of Amaterasu.

characters.name: Aine Chidorigafuchi
characters.description: She is one of prominent members of Ataraxia's Amaterasu who is famed for mastering Heart Hybrid Gear much quicker than her comrades, specifically [Kizuna](https://anilist.co/character/89664/Hida-Kizuna). !It is later revealed that she is also known as Aines Synclavia the lost princess of Vatlantis Empire before her amnesia.!

characters.name: Hayuru Himekawa
characters.description: Hayuru is the ace of Japan and an esteemed member of the Amaterasu. She is a member of Ataraxia's Morals Committee and an extremely strict woman.  Hayuru is a beautiful young woman with long eyelashes and blue eyes. She has long black hair with hime-style which is decorated with red ribbons, that keep her hairstyle into twin-tails. She has a slender figure yet Hayuru does have well-developed bust and voluptuous buttocks. Furthermore, she wears the usual academic uniform. In privacy, she sometimes wears a headdress with cat ears.  Her Neros looks like a device that gives the image of a sharp bladed tool. An armament that looks similar to a Japanese katana is fixed at the waist, while eight long and slender mechanical parts float on her back. In other words, she looks somewhat like a samurai from the Edo period, which is reflected by her personality.

characters.name: Yurishia Farandole
characters.description: Yurishia is a beautiful young woman with typical features of Caucasian descent, having blonde hair, blue eyes, and white skin. She looks more mature compared to her age. Kizuna described her as glamorous and perfect.  Her Heart Hybrid Gear looks like a protector with beautiful material. The sleek surface reflects the surrounding light and gold lines of light is running inside it. It has a small surface area which makes one feel uneasy whether it could really accomplish its role as a protector.  There are also weapons integrated on the back and around the waist. The two large units stretching out from the back, the Differential Frames (Offensive Mobile Particle Engine) divides the energy they produce for propulsive power and the particle cannon. The units have a mobile style where Yurisia can move them freely using her will, leaving no blind spot for her.

characters.name: Reiri Hida
characters.description: Hida Reiri is the principal and commander of Ataraxia. She becomes the leader of Ataraxia after it became an independent country. She is the daughter of Hida Nayuta, as well as the older sister and semi-secret lover of Hida Kizuna and adopted older sister Hida Setsuna. Carrying the heavy responsibility of protecting her world from the threats brought by the AU Conflict , Reiri was the one who started the Heart Hybrid program.

characters.name: Sylvia Silkcut
characters.description: Sylvia Silkcut is a beautiful young girl with purple eyes and short bob-cut blonde hair with a hairpin in it. She usually wears her school uniform. She has a petite body and is considered very cute by everyone. Other female members of Amaterasu often tempt her.

characters.name: Kumado
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Mikan Akemi
characters.description: She is a childhood friend of [Asahi Kuromine](https://anilist.co/character/89084/Kuromine-Asahi) and constantly bullies him.

characters.name: Youko Shiragami
characters.description: Youko is a classmate of [Asahi](https://anilist.co/character/89084/Kuromine-Asahi) and the daughter of a human and a vampire. Though she has long canine teeth, many other typical vampyric characteristics are downplayed, such as only getting tanned in sunlight or feeling guilty when entering a room uninvited. She has a Kansai accent, but speaks in honorifics so as not to expose her teeth. While initially coming across as haughty, her true personality is bubbly and absent minded. Her dream is to become a cool beauty, but has yet to accomplish this goal. Though initially friendly with Asahi, she develops romantic feelings for him, but keeps them to herself because she believes Asahi to like [Aizawa](https://anilist.co/character/89085/Aizawa-Nagisa). She is also often hungry, due to not being able to eat lunch for fear of revealing her teeth.

characters.name: Asahi Kuromine
characters.description: He is a second-year high school student who has trouble keeping secrets, earning him the nickname of "ana no aita zaru" (A bag full of holes), or "anazaru" for short.  One day, he discovers that his crush, [Youko Shiragami](https://anilist.co/character/89018/Shiragami-Youko), is secretly a vampire and, as a result, must try to keep her secret to avoid her having to leave school.

characters.name: Nagisa Aizawa
characters.description: Nagisa is a classmate of [Asahi](https://anilist.co/character/89084/Kuromine-Asahi) and [Yōko](https://anilist.co/character/89018/Shiragami-Youko), and is also a small alien in a robotic exoskeleton. Initially the love interest of Asahi before the series began, she turned him down believing that her secret would be discovered if she started a relationship with him.

characters.name: Akane Koumoto
characters.description: Koumoto Akane is the principal of the school [Kuromine](https://anilist.co/character/89084/Kuromine-Asahi) attends. Though young in appearance she is actually thousands of years old. Despite her age and power she actually behaves very immaturely and is obsessed with snacks.  She is a devil; however, the only indication of this are the two large horns that grow out of her head which she has passed off as a fashion accessory that can be removed at any time, but in reality she uses an illusion to make it look like she can remove the horns.

characters.name: Shizu Delta
characters.description: One of the members of the battle maids originally created by someone except for Tabula Smaragdina.  CZ2I28 Delta is an automaton battle maid and member of the "Pleiades Six Stars," the battle maid squad of the Great Tomb of Nazarick.  CZ2128 appears emotionless and has a silent nature. Her Karma is relatively high, which makes her, along with Yuri Alpha, one of the two "safe" Pleiades to humans. Though she usually ignores conversations from humans, sometimes there is a possibility to communicate with her. She hates cannibalism and likes cute things, such as Eclair.

characters.name: Neia Baraja
characters.description: Neia Baraja is a Squire serving in the Holy Kingdom Liberation Army and the daughter of Pavel Baraja. While initially a low-ranking member of the Paladin Order, she became recognized as a hero after playing a vital role in the liberation of the Northern Holy Kingdom.  Neia is a woman with short blonde hair and beady black eyes slanted upwards, giving the impression that she was constantly glaring at others. On the other hand, the dark circles around her eyes made people think that she was the kind of person who hung around with criminals in seedy back alleys. She also carries a sword at her waist, emblazoned with the crest of the Holy Kingdom's knight order. Additionally, she adorns a blackish cape around her attire.

characters.name: Momoyo Kawakami
characters.description: **Height:** 173 cm  As the oldest member of the Kazama Family, Momoyo is seen as the older sister of the group. She also has a brother-sister type of relationship with Yamato. As such, she'll occasionally pick on him, while also go out of her way to look out for him. Momoyo is considered to be the strongest fighter in the world, second only to her grandfather. She is friends and rivals with Kuki Ageha from KimiAru.

characters.name: Yukie Mayuzumi
characters.description: **Height:** 167 cm **Weapon of choice:** Sword **Favorite word:** admiration  Yukie Mayuzumi is a first-year student and new member of the Kazama family. Having been alone for most of her life due to being the only daughter of the famed Mayuzumi dojo, she's shy, eccentric, yet eager to become friends with 100 people at her new school. However, Mayuzumi often experiences small panic attacks that contort her face into an intimidating glare, carries a sword around, and regularly converses with her phone strap, scaring away potential new friends.

characters.name: Christiane Friedrich
characters.description: Height: 163 cm  Weapon of choice: Rapier  Christiane is a transfer student from Germany that knows little about Japan outside of what she had seen in jidaigeki dramas.

characters.name: Kazuko Kawakami
characters.description: **Height:** 159 cm **Weapon of choice:** Naginata  Kazuko Kawakami is the second daughter of the Kawakami family, and Yamato's classmate. Kawakami is known for her cheerful demeanor and never-give-up attitude. She has a crush on Yamato.  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yamato Naoe
characters.description: Height: 171 cm  The protagonist of the series. As a master tactician, Yamato helps the group form plans to minimize the chances of his friends getting hurt. He prefers using brains, not strength and likes to bet with opponents using different tricks which Christiane does not admire, since he will try anything to win. He is also the tactician of the "Kazama family". People say his father "abandoned" Japan and left everyone they cared for, but Yamato doesn't believe it. He's also very perverted and said he loves seeing naked girls. His main weapon is a lightsaber.

characters.name: Miyako Shiina
characters.description: **Height:** 155 cm  **Weapon of Choice:** Bow    One of Yamato's childhood friends. She seems cute and shy at first glance, but is actually quite assertive. Miyako is hopelessly in love with Yamato despite his refusals to her advances and does her best to catch him off guard. She often wakes him up in ways most men can only dream of...

characters.name: Joker
characters.description: The Joker is a master criminal with a clown-like appearance, and is considered one of the most infamous criminals within Gotham City.

characters.name: Rick Flag
characters.description: Elite solider who commands the villains. Ultra stoic. Although he is supposed to oversee the villains, often thrown away by their chaotic natures.

characters.name: Christopher Smith
characters.description: A hulking macho man and violent vigilante determined to achieve peace at all costs. He possesses a twisted sense of justice and considers himself a superhero.

characters.name: Basil Karlo
characters.description: A struggling movie actor and loquacious, chatty narcissist. A shape-changer made of living clay, he freely changes his appearance in battle.

characters.name: Nanaue
characters.description: A shark-like humanoid who has the IQ of a kindergartener. A pure and innocent soul, he is solely preoccupied with satisfying his appetite.

characters.name: Harleen Quinzel
characters.description: Gotham City’s Mistress of Mayhem. A former psychiatrist and The Joker’s love interest who possesses exceptional agility and a sharp intellect. Her wild and unpredictable behavior wreaks havoc wherever she goes.

characters.name: Asahi Kashiwagi
characters.description: He is an ordinary high school boy who can be found anywhere. One day, however, he suddenly finds himself caught in a love storm with five transfer students.

characters.name: Mongfa Bai
characters.description: Bai has a calm and easy-going personality. To her students, she is more like an older sister than a teacher. She is a strong person at school, but when she goes home, she can be a bit childish and a bit of a screw-up. She also has a clumsy side. She is a teacher from China.

characters.name: Ilya Ilyukhin
characters.description: Ilya Ilyukhin is a transfer student from Bulgaria (Russia in the manga from chapter 2 onwards).  In anime episode 4/manga chapter 8: !her true gender is revealed as female when she undresses at a ryokan.!

characters.name: Aoi Izumisawa
characters.description: Aoi is a cheerful and honest yet reticent girl with a knack for household work. She is also a bright, energetic and straightforward girl who transferred to the Asahi's class. Being a modest person, she is the leader of the class. She is also a jealous type.

characters.name: Amelia Irving
characters.description: Amelia is an innocent, but also clumsy and selfish girl. She expresses her affection directly and tends to go out of control. She has a personality that makes it difficult for her to speak her mind, making her a "tsundere". She is a transfer student from the United States.

characters.name: Karin Istel
characters.description: Karin is sometimes self-conscious, but she has a cheerful personality and is well-liked by everyone around her. She is also active as a model and is gaining popularity in Japan. She is a transfer student from Germany.

characters.name: Yuuto Kidou
characters.description: He wears goggles and a red cape. Originally from Teikoku. The reason why he plays for Teikoku is for his sister, Haruna Otonashi. He was forced to win 3 constructive soccer championships in order to be with her again, so he decided not to contact her for 6 years, leading Otonashi to believe she gets in his way. After seeing Kageyama's wrongdoings, he and the rest of Teikoku quit. Eventually, Kidou joins Endo's team, changing his cape to blue but changes it back to red in the FFI arc.

characters.name: Chiranosuke
characters.description: A cat spirit who acts as [Yuuta's](https://anilist.co/character/88902/Yuuta-Iridatsu) guide to being a ghost. He enjoys drinking sake and seems to reside in room 203.

characters.name: Yuuta Iridatsu
characters.description: Resident of room 103 in Korai House, who becomes a ghost through a mysterious out of body experience. He tries to keep a cool facade, but he has a strong sense of justice, compassion, and naivete. When he sees a girl's underwear, he gets a strong nosebleed and loses consciousness.   !In episode 6, it is revealed that Yuuta is biologically female. His registered legal name is Yuu Iridatsu (伊里達 遊).!  !Yuuta, originally Pine, had a body-switching accident, which resulted in Yūta's soul taking over [Chiyoko's](https://anilist.co/character/88903) body. Consequently, Yuuta has a male soul but a female body. In spite of this, Yuuta considers himself male.!

characters.name: Mikatan Narugino
characters.description: Mikatan is very positive and happy, as well as caring for her friends. She lives in room 101 and is a member of the idol group "She's Mei." In her free time, she also is a masked hero of justice named "Strange Juice" who uses super strength and a giant straw to fight evil. ! As a child she grew up in a research lab under the name Chiyoko, but in an accident her soul ended up in the body of her friend [Guriko.](https://anilist.co/character/232658) ! !She is currently, in the history where humanity lives on, in her original body (the body [Yuuta](https://anilist.co/character/88902/Yuuta-Iridatsu) was using) with black hair.!

characters.name: Ito Hikiotani
characters.description: A shut-in game junky who lives in room 102 of Korai House. She's enrolled at a prestigious girl's school but is not going to class, instead spending her time on FPS games.

characters.name: Meika Daihatsu
characters.description: Occupation: Hacker  A genius inventor who loves her grandfather.

characters.name: Rabura Chichibu
characters.description: A fake spirit medium with a gyaru fashion sense who lives in Room 202 of Korai House. Her family has been mediums for generations so she followed the same path but she actually doesn't believe in ghosts. She has a pet turtle and is a friend of [Yuuta's](https://anilist.co/character/88902/Yuuta-Iridatsu) sister.

characters.name: Michiru Morishita
characters.description: Height: 155cm   Michiru is a first-year student and Isara's classmate. She is a newcomer who joined Shokken just before the student council election. She has a habit of staying out late at night.

characters.name: Isara Aomi
characters.description: Height: 160cm   Isara is a first year student who is a special economic scholar. It is revealed that her family (which consists of her, her two little brothers and her mother) is poor, forcing her to work part time at a fast food restaurant. Because of this, she is constantly being bullied; however, she always manages to keep a smile on her face.

characters.name: Mifuyu Kiba
characters.description: Height: 166cm    Best friend of Chisato. Due to her frail health, she was hospitalized for a long time and thus having to repeat a year, she grew a complex due to that but was overcome with the help of Chisato and Yuki. She also has a habit of citing old jokes, explaining it by the fact she's a year older.

characters.name: Chisato Sumiyoshi
characters.description: Height: 158cm  Yuuki's childhood friend and the founder of the Food Research Club. She has an impressive record of being in the same class as Yuuki since grade school. Due to an unknown incident, Chisato hates chocolate. Chisato is shown as a tsundere who harbors feelings for Yuuki since the beginning of the story.

characters.name: Yuuki Oojima
characters.description: Yuuki is a second-year student at Takafuji Academy, who lives in an apartment with his mother. His father died when he was a child. He is a member of Shokken.

characters.name: Satsuki Shinonome
characters.description: Satsuki is Yuuki's main opponent during the student council elections. She is Hazuki Shinonome's little sister. Satsuki is a kind and gentle girl who also loves Yuuki's famous "Oojima Roll", but denies this. She also calls Yuuki "Pekojima-kun".

characters.name: Tarou Ootsuki
characters.description: Ootsuki is the foreman of Kaiji's gang in the underground labor camp.   While he initially appears to be kind and helpful, in reality, he is just setting Kaiji up for an even bigger fall.  He is the mastermind behind the dice game Chinchirorin.

characters.name: Kongou
characters.description: "The super-dreadnought fitted with Western technology at Vickers in England, Kongou has arrived! Even in the Pacific Theatre, I'll use the power of my speed to be of great use! Look forward to it!" - Kongou  Kongou has long brown hair tied into buns on either side of her head. She and her sister ships are typically seen wearing a modified shrine maiden outfit with thigh high boots. Since she was built in England and shipped to Japan, she tends to speak in broken English and loves drinking tea. She is very affectionate towards the admiral and is always trying to win his heart.

characters.name: Kaga
characters.description: A calm and no-nonsense bow-wielding shipgirl based on the real-life Japanese aircraft carrier Kaga. Sister ship to [Akagi](https://anilist.co/character/174622/Akagi).  In the *Shimakaze Tsumujikaze no Shoujo* manga, she's given a considerably darker characterization than in the first anime and *Fubuki, Ganbarimasu* 4koma, as she states her siblings "never got a chance to be born" and deems her very existence a mistake. However, she ends up bonding with Shimakaze over their mutual feelings.

characters.name: Fubuki
characters.description: "I am Fubuki, the first ship of the special type destroyers, designed under the Washington Naval Treaty, that were beyond existing ship classification and shocked the world. Based on our design, a lot of following fleet-type destroyers were built. Yes sir, I'll do my best!" - Fubuki

characters.name: Mutsuki
characters.description: "The first Imperial Navy destroyer to be loaded with the powerful large-type 61cm torpedoes, Mutsuki! While I'm a old model, I'll give it my all on the front!"

characters.name: Nagato
characters.description: Nagato serves as the Admiral's Secretary Ship with Mutsu always alongside her.   She is calm and collected and carries a serious, intimidating air about her wherever she goes, making sure the other fleet girls abide by the Navy's rules. She apparently has a thing for squirrels and can't stand spicy food.

characters.name: Akagi
characters.description: Akagi has long brown hair flowing down straightly. She wears a chest protector (muneate) over white and red clothes and wields a bow and arrows. Her flight decks, one on right arm and another around her waist, features katakana ア(A), referring to her real-life identification mark. Akagi is shown as a compassionate woman with a gentle, easy-going  personality and she has a massive appetite.

characters.name: Senpai
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Kurokami no Otome
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Ichiya Suzaku
characters.description: Ichiya Suzaku is the head of Tokyo City. He is cool and has a large amount of pride, and he despises inefficiency. He secretly longs to be a hero. He hates [Kasumi](https://anilist.co/character/89383/Chigusa-Kasumi).   His power is that he can manipulate gravity with a gauntlet.

characters.name: Canaria Utara
characters.description: Canaria is the subhead of Tokyo City. Her self-professed title is "The Botherer to Suzaku." She is weak, and tries hard at everything she does. Her catchphrase is "When you're in trouble, smile."   She activates her power by singing.

characters.name: Maihime Tenkawa
characters.description: Maihime Tenkawa is the head of Kanagawa City. She is the "strongest princess" who has reigned at the top of Kanagawa for a long time. She is idealistic and has a one-track mind, and her blunt behavior makes her stand out.   She is proud of her incredible physical strength, and she uses a sword that she can push energy into that will blast away her opponents in one hit.

characters.name: Hotaru Rindo
characters.description: Hotaru Rindo is the subhead of Kanagawa City. She has a calm and composed disposition, and is only nice to [Hime](https://anilist.co/character/89380/Tenkawa-Maihime). Her eyes are so uncommonly observant that she can read her opponents' actions. Her other strong point is her observation of Hime.   Her weapon is a katana, and her power is that she can make contact through her eyes.

characters.name: Asuha Chigusa
characters.description: Asuha Chigusa is the head of Chiba City. She is Kasumi's younger sister, and she's usually pretty listless, but can become trigger happy with her gun in the blink of an eye.   She wields two guns, and her power is controlling the movements of material objects.

characters.name: Kasumi Chigusa
characters.description: Kasumi Chigusa is the subhead of Chiba City. He is cynical and a realist. He often boasts of his own failures, and he is only sympathetic to his younger sister [Asuha](https://anilist.co/character/89382/Chigusa-Asuha).   His weapon is a sniper rifle, and his power is incredible hearing, which allows him to use echolocation to search for things.

characters.name: Yukimi Togakushi
characters.description: Yukimi is the Literature Club president and a member of the Supernatural Club. Her only appearance is in Kakegurui Twin. She used to own a gambling den, but it attracted practically no guests.

characters.name: Tsuzura Hanatemari
characters.description: In spite of coming from a wealthy family, Tsuzura could not gamble well, and was quickly turned into a housepet. Fortunately, thanks to Mary Saotome, whom she had known since elementary school, she learned about gambling and started believing in herself.

characters.name: Hyouta Ashikaga
characters.description: Year 1, class A at Yubiwa Academy Middle School. Ace of the track and field team.   He wears a uniform that has been modified to look like shorts. Ever since he entered the school wearing such a uniform, all the girls who saw it stopped shortening their skirts and started wearing black stockings. He has a well-developed face and is ridiculed for being like the archangel who bosses other angels. He insists on exposing his legs even in winter. He is a member of the Detective Club's physical strength and mobility section. Despite his cute appearance, he often acts carelessly and makes dangerous comments.  !Has been kidnapped three times in the past. His parents are divorced.!  (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Michiru Fukuroi
characters.description: Year 2, class A at Yubiwa Academy Middle School.   He is a dangerous person who tops the "ranking of students who should never be involved in the school." He is known as "the bossman" outside of school, but he is also a good cook and has a family-oriented side. He has a habit of using a lot of satirical metaphors.

characters.name: Sousaku Yubiwa
characters.description: Year 1, class A at Yubiwa Academy Middle School.   He is the heir and de facto president of the Yubiwa Foundation, the parent organization of the Yubiwa Academy. As a child prodigy with both financial and artistic talents, he is a member of the Detective Club's art team. He is expressionless and of few words, but only Manabu can read his thoughts. Usually only speaks twice in each book.

characters.name: Nagahiro Sakiguchi
characters.description: Year 3, class A at Yubiwa Academy Middle School. Former student council president. Vice leader of the Pretty Boy Detective Club.  He has a fiancée who is in the first grade of elementary school, so he has been ridiculed as a lolicon, but he denies it. He says, "I'm not a lolicon. It's just that my fiancée, whom my parents decided on their own, happens to be six years old." He has been the president of the student council for three consecutive years since his speech as the representative of the new students when he entered the school. He has a beautiful voice, which he admits to himself and others, and is good at not only making speeches but also copying vocal cords. He is the liaison officer for the Detective Club. He is a soft-spoken honor student.

characters.name: Mayumi Doujima
characters.description: The one and only female member of the Pretty Boy Detective Club. Mayumi is a beautiful girl, though she cross-dresses when in the club. Students often call her literal starry eyes beautiful, though she does not like being called beautiful at all. Due to this, she wears glasses to make her starry eyes less prominent.

characters.name: Manabu Soutouin
characters.description: The leader of the Pretty Boy Detective Club. Also known as "Manabu the Aesthete." Mayumi calls him "the leader."  He is so stupid that he claims to be uneducated and acts cheerfully and arrogantly without reading the atmosphere, but always seeks beauty and will not do anything that goes against aesthetics. Although he often does nothing but gives orders, he is recognized as a leader by the group.  !It's revealed at the end of the first volume that he's a 5th grade at Yubiwa Academy Elementary School.!

characters.name: Kokoro Kouki
characters.description: Miku's classmate at Yuyu who is very friendly and energetic. She grew up in Southeast Asia. Because she does not go to Gatagata, she cannot be an official member of the DIY Club and is instead an external member.

characters.name: Rei Yasaku
characters.description: A third year student at Gatagata and head of the DIY Club. She has a strong passion for DIY, although this has led to some weird rumors about her around the school. Her family runs the Waku Waku Wan Wan hardware store.

characters.name: Serufu Yua
characters.description: A laid-back first year of high school who grew up in a relaxed family. She has a delusional habit and soon becomes empty, hitting a wall or falling on the road and she is constantly injured. Even if the shirt sticks out, or if she has a terrible sleep, she doesn't care about "Oh, well!". Her hobby is graffiti.

characters.name: Takumi Hikage
characters.description: A shy first year student at Gatagata and Serufu's classmate, who also joins the DIY Club.

characters.name: Juliet Queen Elizabeth VIII
characters.description: A 12-year-old child genius from America who ended up enrolling at Gatagata instead of Yuyu due to a kanji mixup and is staying at Miku's house. As she doesn't like her full name, she received the nickname "Jobko" from Serufu after she hears her say "Good job!". She uses her genius skills and state-of-the-art technology to assist with her DIY projects.

characters.name: Miku Suride
characters.description: Serufu's childhood friend and neighbor who attends Yuyu Girls' Vocational High School for technology as a first-year student. She is nicknamed "Purin" by Serufu (and subsequently "Pudding" by Jobko) due to her habit of getting easily worked up and is often not honest about her feelings, particularly when it comes to Serufu.

characters.name: Sernia Iori Flameheart
characters.description: Height: 168cm Class: 1-C    A stubborn girl with pigtails that look like drills. She’s from a very rich family and won’t take crap from anyone. Has a tsundere personality.

characters.name: Sanae Shikikagami
characters.description: A clumsy large-breasted girl training to be a maid. She often trips over absolutely nothing and has very low self-esteem.

characters.name: Kaoru Daichi
characters.description: Stubborn butler in training at the school. He is boarded up with Akiharu. He’s good at keeping his feelings to himself and doesn’t want Akiharu interfering with his life.   !It's later found out that Kaoru is actually a girl and has feelings for Hino.!

characters.name: Pina Estor
characters.description: She is a VIP student in school.   The crown, she wears, represents the nobility as 1st princess from a Northern European Kingdom of Suforu    Her love for Japaneses Animes is the reason why she goes to Japan to study.    Her current favorite Anime is Magical Diva, who is voiced by Rie Kugimiya.

characters.name: Akiharu Hino
characters.description: Hino Akiharu lost his parents when he was small and was adopted into his uncle's family. But he noticed his uncle is after the inheritance of his parents, so he decides to enter a boarding school, Hakureiryou high school. However his delinquent boy-like appearance frightens the girls, who make up the majority of the students. Being unable to get along with the classmates, Akiharu meets his childhood girlfriend Saikyou Tomomi.

characters.name: Tomomi Saikyou
characters.description: Hino's childhood girlfriend who he encounters at the school. She has a sweet and kind exterior, but is actually very scary.

characters.name: Kanata Sorami
characters.description: Height: 157 cm (5'1")  Loves the trumpet. She's a new army recruit who enlisted to learn how to play. A bright and positive person, Kanata brims with curiosity and is easily moved. She sometimes has problems reading the atmosphere, but that ignorance causes her to be happy. She has perfect pitch, but her performances still need work.

characters.name: Rio Kazumiya
characters.description: Kanata's senior trumpeter who gives her guidance. Her field is correspondence. She speaks in a strong-minded and curt manner, but she has a kind disposition.!In episode 10 it is revealed she is actually a Helvetian princess and Iliya's half-sister.!

characters.name: Kureha Suminoya
characters.description: The platoon gunner. A new member of the party who also receives Rio's guidance; Kanata's heart burns with rivalry. She's a strong-willed and obstinate person, but she's actually delicate!?

characters.name: Noël Kannagi
characters.description: The mechanic and driver. Taciturn. She spends most of her time repairing the Takemikazuchi.

characters.name: Filicia Heideman
characters.description: Platoon captain of the 1211th squad. Tank commander. She is open-minded and tolerant, and she is a good older sister/mother figure to her unit members. She is usually gentle, but she can become strict at a moment's notice.!Her former troop was killed on the battlefield. She was the only one left alive. !

characters.name: Yumina
characters.description: A nun. She has a gentle and modest personality. She resides in the church orphanage and cares for the children living there.

characters.name: Shougo Mikadono
characters.description: The male protagonist who is the heir to the Mikadono Group. For him to take over, he needs to graduate from school as well as finding a life partner. However, things become complicated as he learns that he has a younger sister who is watching over him as well as attending the same school. He has a scar on his forehead from an accident when he was a kid, which caused him to lose bits of his memories.   !In the last novels, he chooses Konoe as his lover, but also gets to know that she is also his sister. However, Shougo is not Kumagorou's biological son; for some reason,  Kumagorou and Shougo's mother, Kanoko, were unable to conceive a child together and Kanoko gave birth to Shougo through artificial insemination with another man.!

characters.name: Konoe Tsuruma
characters.description: A young girl who attends the same school as Shougo and also the first friend he makes on his first day of his new life. Very curious and believing in destined meetings, she is in the same class as Shougo as well as the class representative. She loves creme puffs. Her father is a leading engineering designer of electronic devices, who designed one of the special cellphones that she used to deceive Shougo.     !She revealed later that she was Shougo's childhood friend and feels responsible for the accident that landed him in hospital. She tells Shougo, "When we were kids, I wanted to be your sister. I figured we could be together forever that way."!  !In the last two novels, it is revealed that Konoe is actually Shougo's sister. However, Konoe is Kumagorou's biological daughter but she's not really Shougo's sister because Shougo is not Kumagorou's biological son.!

characters.name: Miyabi Kannagi
characters.description: One of Shougo's friends and a tsundere. She is in love with Shougo and even said she wants to marry him.   !It's later revealed that she met Shougo when he was recovering from an injury in the hospital and he played with her; they even had a pretend wedding. !  !According to the Vol. 8 of the novel series, it is revealed by DNA test that she's not actually Shougo's sister - but his cousin.! Her family owns a clothing line.   ! In the anime, it is revealed that she is Shougo's real sister.!

characters.name: Rinka Kunitachi
characters.description: A first-year and student council vice-president of Miryuuin Academy. Was bred in a royal family. After Shougo transferred into Miryuuin, Konoe calls her "a princess to the core." Rinka keeps the Student Council President in line and is shown to be very good at dancing. She is a more distant aloof character who has a tendency to be competitive.  !Rinka later revealed that school director Genda asked her to find Shougo's sister so that he can have leverage when working for the Mikadono Group. Rinka used Sagara's phone when making a fake sister announcement and threaten the director. Shougo sooner found out her scheme by using Konoe's phone. Shougo volunteered himself to pretend to be her lover so that her engagement to the director's son would be invalid. However, she told her parents about Shougo and broken the engagement to be with him.!

characters.name: Mei Sagara
characters.description: A third-year bespectacled girl who dresses as a witch and runs a little sister cafe called "Lyrical Sisters".  !She was abandoned when she was one or two years old and was adopted by a university professor because of her mathematical intellect. The cosplay café belonged to her adopted mother, but she soon past away because of illness. She lived with her father in Massachusetts after that, but returned after earning enough money and bought back the cosplay café.!  !It's revealed that she knows Shougo's real sister and does not want her to be exposed to Mikadono family because she is an illegitimate child.
