Now, as a former resident of Satellite, he must hide his past from the rest of society. He is very arrogant and overconfident, but still has a strong conscience. His signature card is also a Synchro monster, Red Daemon's Dragon. He plays a "Swarm" Deck, focusing on quickly Tuning weaker monsters together to summon his Dragon. Jack is one of the five Signers, the chosen ones of the People of the Stars, and carries the Crimson Dragon's Wings.    (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Klaudia Valentz
characters.description: Height: 164 cm  Klaudia is the daughter of wealthy travelling merchant. She possesses a refined aura and kind personality. She has an interest in music and practices playing the flute, but hides it from her father. When visiting Kurken Island she makes friends with [Ryza](https://anilist.co/character/223350/Stout-Reisalin), [Lent](https://anilist.co/character/300891/Marslink-Lent) and [Tao](https://anilist.co/character/300892/Mongarten-Tao), and becomes one of the members of the secret hideout. Together they share many adventures over the summer.

characters.name: Lila Decyrus
characters.description: Height: 164 cm  As a member of the fallen Oren race in the Underworld, she strives a goal to eliminate the remaining problems left by the extinct Klint Kingdom, and avenge her homeland from the Philscuha's invasion together with [Empel Vollmer](https://anilist.co/character/300893/Vollmer-Empel).

characters.name: Reisalin Stout
characters.description: Height: 161 cm  An ordinary girl whose unique characteristic is the fact that she is just that - ordinary. Ryza has a wild and tomboyish personality with a strong sense of justice. While she can be stubborn in her convictions, her heart is in the right place. Her whole world is turned upside down during an extraordinary encounter...

characters.name: Lent Marslink
characters.description: Height: 179 cm  Lent is a childhood friend of Ryza and Tao, who, together, aims to venture out to the mainland and explore the world out from their homeland. Furthermore, as an aspiring adventurer, he wants to be a known man who travels past the restricted and unknown places of which no one ever been before so that he can be acknowledged for who he can become, and overshadow his now drunk abusive father

characters.name: Tao Mongarten
characters.description: Height: 170 cm  Tao is childhood friends with Ryza and Lent who, together, aims to venture out to the mainland and explore the world out from their homeland, although he is the most hesitant out of the group to actually join the voyage. His family owns old books that contain ancient language and aims to discover and learn it as they travel.

characters.name: Empel Vollmer
characters.description: Height: 172 cm  Empel is a wandering alchemist investigating the ruins of the Klint Kingdom together with Lila Decyrus. Due to an injury, he is unable to perform advanced techniques but teaches Ryza the world of Alchemy as she has the talent. He apparently has a sweet tooth that enjoys all kinds of sweets, of which he would often buy dozens of them

characters.name: Noel
characters.description: A mysterious blue-haired girl whom Nonoka first met seven years ago.

characters.name: Nonoka Komiya
characters.description: The main heroine who returns to Lake Kiriya after moving away seven years ago. She lives with her father as her mother has passed away due to illness.

characters.name: Yuzuki Mizusaka
characters.description: An energetic girl who has a strong dislike for the saucer. She also seems to be on bad terms with her twin brother, Souta.

characters.name: Koharu Shiihara
characters.description: An airheaded girl who works as a poster girl for a local shop.

characters.name: Shione Togawa
characters.description: A stern girl who enjoys photography. She was once Nonoka's best friend but grew to hate her after she moved away.

characters.name: Souta Mizusaka
characters.description: Yuzuki's twin brother.

characters.name: Airi Sena
characters.description: Height: 158cm (5'2)  Airi is a second-year student at Yuihime Girls' Academy and the principal's daughter. At first, she was against the merger and rejected the male students from Kagamidai Academy. She is elected as a class representative alongside Shingo, and has the best grades among all second-year students.  (Source: Wikipedia, Official)

characters.name: Miu Amaha
characters.description: Height: 146cm  Miu is a third-year student of Yuihime Girls' Academy. She lives in a house nearby the school with her mother and two cats. She is the founder and president of the Neko Club, a school club to care for various animals. She works part-time at a maid café named Dolce to earn money for activity of the club; the Neko Club is not official club, so the club's budget is not supplied by the school. She is very kind around Shingo and tries to not leave Airi out of things. She is eldest but shortest among the main characters. She calls Angelina by her Japanese name Nanatsu.      !She later becomes the girlfriend of Shingo. !

characters.name: Angelina Nanatsu Sewell
characters.description: Height: 155cm   Angelina is a second-year student at Yuihime Girls' Academy. Unlike other female students, she does not wear school uniform, and always wears a maid costume. She is a "stray maid" and wants to come across her master in the future. She is in Shingo's class and tries to help in the assimilation of the students from Kagamidai Academy. Her father is Japanese and her mother is British, but she speaks only Japanese because she was born and brought up in Japan. She has a cheerful personality and is very good at housekeeping such as cooking and cleaning, but is weak at general educational subjects such as English and mathematics. She later becomes Shingo's maid and refers to him as master.

characters.name: Sana Inui
characters.description: Height: 148 cm   Sana is a second-year student at Yuihime Girls' Academy and Airi's childhood friend. She likes Miu very much and joined the Neko Club just to be close to her. She initially acts kind to the male students from Kagamidai Academy, but later changes her attitude because she actually hates boys. She especially dislikes Shingo and often calls him "kuzu-mushi".    !In the final episode she becomes the new president of the Neko Club.!   (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Sakuno Uryuu
characters.description: Height: 162cm  Sakuno is Shingo's younger stepsister and first-year student of Kagamidai Academy; her father remarried Shingo's mother about ten years ago. She has a quiet personality and is good at cooking, but has a poor sense of direction and often gets lost. She was selected as a test student with her brother, and transfered to Yuihime Girls' Academy to participate in 1-T, the first-year test class. She happened to meet Airi at night of September 30, the day before the transferring on October 1. She became close friends with Airi at that time. She often goes shopping to Kume Mart, too. She is youngest but tallest among the main female characters.   (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Shingo Uryuu
characters.description: Height: 175 cm (5'8")  Shingo is the main protagonist and is a second-year student at Kagamidai Academy. He is very hardworking and kind. He was selected as a test student and transferred to Yuihime Girls' Academy to participate in 2-T, the second-year test class. He was elected the class representative. He quickly makes friends with several girls at Yuihime Girls' Academy, though Airi does not want to get along with him or any of the other boys. He was sickly and asthmatic in his childhood, but he is in good health now. His parents are busy with their work and are seldom at home.

characters.name: Senya
characters.description: Senya is a demon hunter with his father Jinun.  Senya was experimented on and given 1000 demons inside of his body by the Dangaishu  !In the second half of the manga, he later becomes the main character of the series. With Tama, Tsukiko, and Nau, they try to free Jinka.!

characters.name: Tsukiko
characters.description: Senya's partner. Tsukiko is a timid and reserved girl who harbors deep feelings for Senya. Often trying to help Senya she feels that she causes more trouble than actually stopping it.  (Source: MAL)

characters.name: Shinsuke Hyoudou
characters.description: Shinsuke was just a traveling ronin when he met Jinka and Tama. He was fascinated with their abilities and offered information to be able to follow them.

characters.name: Tama Youko
characters.description: A very ambitious and sassy several hundred year old fox katawara. Alongside her human brother, [Jinka](https://anilist.co/character/27221/Jinka-Yamato), she travels the lands in order to try and rid the world of humans and katawara committing evil deeds and spread peace and kindness.

characters.name: Jinka Yamato
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Nau
characters.description: A water god that follows [Senya](https://anilist.co/character/146191) and [Tsukiko](https://anilist.co/character/146192). Nau can change it's appearance and become stronger when around water.

characters.name: Sana Hidaka
characters.description: Sana is the main protagonist of the series. He left Sakuranomori during his childhood, and during the beginning of the series he comes back to live by himself in the apartment building owned by Aoi's parents.   !He was bullied in school after moving to another city. That even leads him to attempting a suicide. He always wears a watch to hide the scars left after this. This is also why he is afraid of knives.! (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Shuusuke Wakatsuki
characters.description: Shuusuke is one of the four childhood friends Sana left behind when he moved, and is still one of his new friends when he returned. He is the best friend of Sana and the only male besides Sana himself of the five friends. He is the younger twin of Shuri Wakatsuki. Yuzuki refers him as the bottom of the Wakatsuki twins.  !Shuusuke, along with his sister Shuri, are abused by their father who is obsessed with being promoted. They live with him, along with a woman who lives with them for their father's money and for sex. Their real mother died before the beginning of the series. To hide the truth about their torn apart family, the twins act silly and light-hearted when in the presence of others.!

characters.name: Nanaka Yatsushiro
characters.description: Main heroine of the series. Nanaka is one of Sana's friends, and seemed to have feelings for Sana. When Sana returns to town after five years, her personality has completely changed from sweet and caring to a cold demeanor, and moody. When she meets Sana again after he returned she slaps him for apparently not knowing who she was. She still seems to have romantic feeling as she gets jealous whenever Sana is with another girl (especially Asami).

characters.name: Aoi Oribe
characters.description: Aoi is Sana's cousin and her parents own the apartment building that Sana lives in. She prefers to be called Aoi-chan instead of Aoi-san, despite the fact that she is a year older than Sana. She wears glasses and has a busty physique. She loves to read books and is very energetic and clumsy. She has a very high-pitched voice and has a child-like character.

characters.name: Shuri Wakatsuki
characters.description: Shuri Wakatsuki and her twin brother Syūsuke were close friends of Sana Hidaka  before he moved away.     !Shuri, along with Shuusuke, are abused by their father who is obsessed with being promoted. They live with him, along with a woman who lives with them for father's money and sex. Their real mother died prior to the beginning of the series. To hide the truth about their torn apart family, the twins act silly and light-hearted when in the presence of others.!

characters.name: Asami Hoshino
characters.description: Date of Birth: October 28, 1991   Asami is a friend of Sana's and is in her second year. Asami seems to have a very gentle personality, and even volunteers at an old folk's home; she often asks Sana to come too, who is happy to oblige.   !However, she actually has a very vindictive personality. She takes revenge on people who hurt her.   In the anime, she had a crush on Shuri and when she confesses to her, Shuri says they should just be friends. Angered, Asami writes a letter to the school, accusing that Shuri and Shuusuke are lovers. Later on, she invites Shuri and Sana to the hospital to visit a sick lady so she could see how much she hurt Shuri. To her surprise, Shuri seems fine. At the hospital, the sick lady takes a knife and tries to kill Shuri, but Asami runs to protect her and is stabbed instead. She lives to realize that she should not hate Shuri anymore.!

characters.name: Fiona Beckford
characters.description: She is Lisa's classmate and best friend, she is also the closest to a family that Lisa could ever have. She very protective of Lisa that she is very much a tsundere around Takahiro and even despise him that she would often calling him names. It is hinted that both she and Lisa share the same kind family problems where they both feel alone and abandoned.

characters.name: Celia Cumani Aintree
characters.description: The winner of the jousting competitions during both her first and second year at the academy and is regarded as a prodigy in jousting.  Celia also has excellent grades and has been the president of the student council for consecutive years.

characters.name: Mio Kisaki
characters.description: A friend of Takahiro's and also lives quite close to him. Mio enjoys watching jousting competitions and strongly believes that Takahiro will eventually recover from his injury and return to competing.

characters.name: Takahiro Mizuno
characters.description: Protagonist of Walkure Romanze. Takahiro was a very good athlete in the junior competitions but has since left the scene due to an injury he incurred during a championship finals match.

characters.name: Noel Marres Ascot
characters.description: A daughter of a marquess family. Her jousting skills are top class. Noel puts in all she has got into the competitions because she promised her younger sister that she would never lose when she is competing in front of her.

characters.name: Lisa Eostre
characters.description: A first year student at the academy but is regarded as a very promising rookie. No one in the first year class is able to stand up to her.

characters.name: Ayane Okusora
characters.description: A serious treasurer of Abydos's Countermeasures Committee. The type of girl who values principles and rules, she does her earnest to restore Abydos High.

characters.name: Sensei
characters.description: A teacher with a strange affinity for military tactics, Sensei is the advisor for SCHALE. With the help of Arona and the students of various academies, Sensei keeps the peace in Kivotos while getting into wacky antics with the city's students, guiding them to be better while getting closer to them.    In-game, Sensei is the player's self-insert character, allowing the player to imagine their sex or any appearance they want for themselves.

characters.name: Shiroko Sunaookami
characters.description: Academy: Abydos High School Year: 2nd Year Height: 155 cm (5'1")  Shiroko is a member of the Countermeasures Committee and the deuteragonist. She is the sports-loving field captain of the Abydos High School and a girl of few words, who rarely shows her emotions. Despite her aloof appearance, Shiroko deeply cares about Abydos High School and is willing to do anything to help her friends towards their goal of revitalizing the school. Shiroko is a soft-spoken girl who cares deeply for her friends. She is generally calm and reserved but can hyperfocus on certain interests, sometimes becoming oblivious to how others would react to them. She often bikes and walks distances of 10s of kilometers, which she considers average.

characters.name: Nonomi Izayoi
characters.description: Academy: Abydos High School Year: 2nd Year Height: 5'2"  Izayoi Nonomi is one of the students studying in Abydos High School who wields a Machine Gun with green accents and the Abydos insignia.  She has an emotional and gentle personality, and she serves as a mental support for the Committee, many of whom have extreme personalities. Despite not mentioning it herself, she comes from a wealthy family, and most of the snacks for the Council are funded by her.

characters.name: Serika Kuromi
characters.description: Academy: Abydos High School Year: 1st Year Height: 5'0"

characters.name: Hoshino Takanashi
characters.description: Academy: Abydos High School Year: 3rd Year Height: 145cm (4'9")  Vice president of the Abydos Student Council and president of the Foreclosure Task Force.  Acts like a tired old timer, and would rather play pranks and nap than do actual work. This often gets her in trouble with her fellow task force members, but once she's on a mission, she fights on the frontlines harder than anyone else to keep her friends safe.  Hoshino's hobbies include napping and procrastinating.

characters.name: Buntarou Houjou
characters.description: Buntarou is a hard-working and popular young man with many friends and strikes good vibes with those he meets. Apart from going to high school, he also works part-time at a ramen shop after school for income since he lives alone.

characters.name: Teruha Andou
characters.description: Teruha is one of Buntarou's classmate. She works part-time as a maid at a cafe in Akihabara.

characters.name: Atomu Kai
characters.description: One of Buntarou's childhood friend and classmate.

characters.name: Yuuka Kobayakawa
characters.description: An energetic and talkative student. She is an active and talented member of her school's drama club. She loves acting and eating snacks and is close friends with Buntarou.

characters.name: Sayuki Kuroda
characters.description: She is an otaku who aims to make a Bishoujo game. She is an odd loner who is frank, assertive and a bit condescending. She always like to wear black. She is also Bunta's classmate, whom she recruited to help her in making a Bishoujo game.  It is suggested that she is also an avid gamer and a chunnibyou, based on her style of clothes, manner of speaking and her concepts of gaming.

characters.name: Uguisu Yuuki
characters.description: Buntarou's underclassman. She is one of the top ranked illustrators on Pixi.

characters.name: Nao Kaizaki
characters.description: Nao is a candidate for dragon pilot at Gifu Air Base , who has a strong fighting instinct and always provoke a fight to anyone around. Her mother was also a dragon pilot. Although Nao was the prime candidate for dragon pilot until Hisone showed up, dragons didn't accept her. Being jealous of Hisone who was chosen by Masotan, Nao keeps teasing her. But she actually is such a hard worker.

characters.name: El Hoshino
characters.description: El works at Tsuiki Air Base in Fukuoka Prefecture as a dragon pilot. She is cool and dignified, very good at both academics and sports. El believes that she should be the ace among other pilots. But in fact her depth of understanding of OTF(dragons) is very low and her co-workers find it difficult to deal with her. She pilots a dragon disguising F-2A fighter aircraft.

characters.name: Liliko Kinutsugai
characters.description: Liliko is a cool and clever dragon pilot at Misawa Air Base in Aomori Prefecture. She cannot help imagining worst-case scenario for everything, and always has negative thoughts. She fears catching others' eyes, always half crying and cannot live without handkerchiefs. Liliko is very competent and pilots a dragon which disguises E-2C, the Airborne Early Warning aircraft.

characters.name: Mayumi Hitomi
characters.description: Mayumi works at Iruma Air Base in Saitama Prefecture as a dragon pilot. She is big, slow, powerful and always smiling calmly. When she was working at a zoo, an employee of Iruma Air Base witnessed that all savage animals were attached to her and scouted her for a dragon pilot. Mayumi understands dragons and tells their feeling to other pilots. She pilots a dragon which mimics C-1, the transport aircraft.

characters.name: Haruto Okonogi
characters.description: Maintenance worker at Gifu Base, takes care of Masotan. Both Natsume and Hisone are in love with him.

characters.name: Hisone Amakasu
characters.description: Hisone is a rookie pilot at Gifu base of Japan Air Self-Defense Force (JASDF). She is a very honest person who can never lie, and this leads her to hurt people unconsciously. Early in her career she encountered a dragon, Masotan, and was swallowed by him. This is how he chose Hiosone as his pilot. She gradually gets a thrill to fly with Masotan, and decides to live her life with the legendary dragon.

characters.name: Momo Minamoto
characters.description: Height: 157 cm (5'2")  Momo is a high-school student that works as an agent for the intelligence agency Tsukikage.

characters.name: Hatsume Aoba
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Mei Yachiyo
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Goe Ishikawa
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Fuu Sagami
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Yuki Hanzoumon
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Suou
characters.description: [Tokiwa's](https://anilist.co/character/321930/Tokiwa) college classmate who offered the mixer. She works at a crossdressing bar with [Fuji](https://anilist.co/character/321928/Fuji) and [Kohaku](https://anilist.co/character/321929/Kohaku) where she plays a handsome prince character. She attracts attention from women whenever she crossdresses.

characters.name: Fuji
characters.description: Fuji works at the same crossdressing bar as [Suou](https://anilist.co/character/321927/Suou) and [Kohaku](https://anilist.co/character/321929/Kohaku) with a persona of a calm and collected guy with purple hair. Both in and out of character, she has an lethargic attitude but she is very attentive to her surroundings and supports others from behind the scenes. In her free time, she draws doujinshi and is always searching for reference material for her works.

characters.name: Kohaku
characters.description: Kohaku works at the same crossdressing bar as [Suou](https://anilist.co/character/321927/Suou) and [Fuji](https://anilist.co/character/321928/Fuji) with an aggressive "Ore-sama" persona which she struggles through with trial-and-error. Her earnest personality contrasts with the absurdity of Suou and Fuji's antics.

characters.name: Tokiwa
characters.description: A normal college student who is classmates with [Suou.](https://anilist.co/character/321927/Suou) His thickheaded nature overcomes the charms of the crossdressing women.

characters.name: Asagi
characters.description: Asagi is a college student and [Tokiwa's](https://anilist.co/character/321930/Tokiwa) friend. He has a friendly and immature personality, as well as a curiosity in all sorts of things. Somehow, he hit it off with [Fuji](https://anilist.co/character/321928/Fuji) and he helps her with her doujinshi.

characters.name: Hagi
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Saki Miyanaga
characters.description: Height: 155 cm (5'1") Position: Captain  Saki Miyanaga is a first-year student at Kiyosumi High School in Nagano Prefecture and the title character of the manga "Saki". She grew up playing mahjong with members of her family but came to dislike the game because she would lose her  _otoshidama_ (New Year's money) if she lost and be scolded if she won. Because of this Saki, developed the ability to end her games with a net score of ±0 in order to avoid winning and losing against them. Over the years, this playing style became a subconscious habit, and she no longer attempts to win a mahjong match.  After her parents separated, Saki remained with her father in Nagano while her older sister Teru moved to Tokyo with her mother. She eventually lost touch with her sister but is aware that Teru has become a top mahjong player in her high school. Upon entering Kiyosumi, Saki is invited by her childhood friend Kyoutarou Suga to visit the school's mahjong club. She reluctantly agrees and proceeds to play several rounds with fellow first-year students Nodoka Haramura and Yuuki Kataoka. Club president Hisa Takei becomes aware of Saki's ability to manipulate her score during the match, to the other members' astonishment.  Both Nodoka and Hisa confront Saki, and she agrees to return to the mahjong club for another match. Saki continues to display the ability to manipulate her score, but Hisa develops a strategy for her to be able to win the match rather end it with no net score. Upon experiencing the excitement of winning a mahjong match against people outside her family, Saki decides to join the club. She grows close to Nodoka and makes a promise with her to reach the national team tournament, where Saki seeks to reconcile with Teru.   !Saki has a tendency to end her games with the special  _yaku_ called " _rinshan kaihou_", obtained when a player declares  _tsumo_ by drawing a tile from the dead wall after she declares _kan_. The yaku's name literally translates to "a flower that blooms on a mountain ridge". Not coincidentally, the kanji for her given name also means "to bloom".!  Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 宮長咲基 instead

characters.name: Nodoka Haramura
characters.description: Height: 154 cm (5'1") Position: Vice captain  Nodoka Haramura is a first-year student at Kiyosumi High School in Nagano Prefecture and a protagonist in the manga "Saki". She is also a supporting character in the spin-off manga "Saki: Achiga-hen episode of side-A". She has played online mahjong since a young girl and develops a eventually passion for it. Her father, who works as an attorney, disapproves of Nodoka's interest but does not prohibit it. Because of her mother's work assignment, her family usually moves to a different city every two to three years.  Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 原邑和加 instead

characters.name: Yuuki Kataoka
characters.description: Position: Vanguard  Yuuki is a high school first-year student who attends the same school as Saki and is a member of the mahjong club. She is highly skilled, though cannot stay focused and makes more mistakes as the game progresses, so she is made the first to play at the mahjong tournament. She is often seen eating tacos, which increases her skill when playing mahjong. Additionally, food with names similar to tacos, like takoyaki can increase her skill partially as well.  Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 片丘優季 instead

characters.name: Kyoutarou Suga
characters.description: A first year student and one of the new recruits for the Kiyosumi Mahjong club, but is not as talented as the rest of the members due to the fact that he is new to the game. As such, he is sent to perform menial tasks more than actually practice.  He is attracted to Nodoka due to her physique but so far these feelings are unrequited by Nodoka. He is constantly abused by Yuuki but pays no attention to her pranking ways. He is close with Saki since he has known her since Middle School, but tends to use her to get small things, such as a Ladies' Lunch. Nonetheless, he cares for all of his fellow club members and most likely doesn't mind helping them out, despite being harassed by most of the members.

characters.name: Hisa Takei
characters.description: Position: Lieutenant  A third year student and the president of the Kiyosumi Mahjong Club. She is also the president of the Student Congress Coucil at Kiyosumi High School, heavily emphasizing the "Congress" part of the name.  A very intelligent and confident girl, she is able to effectively read the weaknesses and strengths of people, inside and outside of Mahjong, and apparently is a seasoned veteran of Mahjong, even to the point of being on friendly terms with a Professional Mahjong player. She is also able to comprehend concepts quicker than most,  !the most prominent example being that she mostly, if not fully, understood what was going on behind Touka's misplays against Momoko in the finals sooner than most of her fellow players.! Her playstyle revolves around taking chances; while risky, she takes her time, waiting for effective hands that often come out of nowhere, surprising her opponents and taking advantage of their cautious play-style. She always takes in the flow of the game in stride, finding opportunities in what other players may find to be dead-end scenarios. Despite the risks she takes, she prefers to play this way, believing it to truly reflect who she is and that she wins more easily when betting against the odds.  Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named Hisashi Takei (竹居久史) instead

characters.name: Mako Someya
characters.description: Position: Sergeant  A second year student and member of the Kiyosumi Mahjong Club, being the first member to join under Takei Hisa's leadership. Her family runs a mahjong cafe, which was former mahjong parlor. Being surrounded by Mahjong ever since she was young, Mako is familiar with many scenarios during the course of a game and is able to recall them during gameplay when taking off her glasses.  Note: Their gender is swapped in [Saki re: King's Tile Draw](https://anilist.co/manga/116824/Saki-re-Kings-Tile-Draw/) and are named 染屋真工 instead

characters.name: Tanzaburou Toujima
characters.description: A 40-year-old man who dreams of becoming a Kamen Rider. He earns money from part-time jobs and trains in the mountains, which allows him to fight on equal terms with a bear. He dreams of one day being transformed into Shocker, but when faced with reality, he sells off all of his precious Kamen Rider merchandise so that they won't end up as trash if he dies alone. In the midst of this despair, he visits a summer festival where he encounters a robber dressed as Shocker, buys a Kamen Rider No. 1 mask from a stall, calls himself Kamen Rider, and fights evil. A man who is so passionate that he transforms into Kamen Rider for real.

characters.name: Hachirou Nakao
characters.description: A gangster who admires Shocker. Due to the harshness of his childhood, he has doubts about the existence of Kamen Rider, the hero of justice who never saved him, and is devoted to Shocker. During a conflict between gangs, he encounters Spider Man, is pierced through the body, and seems to have lost his life, but when he wakes up, he has become a Shocker fighter.

characters.name: Mitsuha Shimamura
characters.description: [Ichiyo's](https://anilist.co/character/368780) younger brother. A man who admires Riderman. He usually works as the manager of a family restaurant and is in a relationship with [Yukarisu](https://anilist.co/character/368778/) an employee. He is such a big fan that he boasts that of all the Kamen Riders, Riderman is his biggest fan, and in battle he uses the attached arms and a fighting style based on Aikido to toy with his enemies.

characters.name: Yukarisu
characters.description: A high school girl who works at [Mitsuha's](https://anilist.co/character/368777) family restaurant. She is in a relationship with Mitsuha, the manager. However, her true identity is that of a female fighter whose mission is to monitor and execute anyone who notices the presence of Shocker. When Mitsuha and her friends notice the presence of Shocker, she attacks Toujima and his friends in an attempt to kill them all in one fell swoop.

characters.name: Yuriko Okada
characters.description: A high school teacher who aspires to become the next Electronic Wave Humanoid Tackle. She encountered Kamen Rider Stronger as a child and became a passionate fan of the Electronic Wave Humanoid Tackle. After Tackle's death, she resolved to become Tackle herself, and while she was training every day in preparation for the Shocker attack, she witnessed the news of the Shocker attack. She is usually cool, but when it comes to talking about Tackle, she can get too excited.

characters.name: Ichiyo Shimamura
characters.description: [Mitsuha's](https://anilist.co/character/368777) older brother. A man who fully transforms into Kamen Rider V3. He has no doubt that V3 is the strongest rider, and in order to embody that identity, he has mastered all kinds of martial arts and has high combat abilities. Because "his soul is V3," he does not need to use tools to transform when fighting, and instead faces evil with just his body.

characters.name: Arthur de Richemont
characters.description: Arthur de Richemont is one of the main characters of the Ulysses: Jeanne d'Arc to Renkin no Kishi light novel and the main protagonists of the anime series. She is the Princess Knight of the Principality of Brittany located in the northwestern part of France. She is also one of Montmorency's childhood friends, and the young boy's secret love since when they studied at the Knights Academy.   !When the French army is wiped away in the battle of Azincourt, her broken sword has been found on the battlefield by Montmorency, pursuing the boy to think her dead. However it's later revealed that she's been captured by the English.!  (Source: Ulysses: Jeanne d'Arc to Renkin no Kishi Wikia)

characters.name: Jeanne d'Arc
characters.description: A twelve-year-old young girl from Domremy with a kind and gentle personality. After having been mortally wounded by the English when Domremy was attacked, Montmorency put half of his Philosopher's Stone into her body to save her life, making her the new Ulysses. Due to her young age and having only half of the stone in her body, Jeanne can become Ulysses for only three minutes; in this form, she turns into a powerful and almost invincible fighter. At the same time, Jeanne becomes extremely brutal and sadistic due to the stone amplifying her arrogance. (Wikipedia)

characters.name: La Hire
characters.description: La Hire is one of the main characters of the Ulysses: Jeanne d'Arc to Renkin no Kishi light novel and the main protagonists of the anime series. She is the commander of a mercenary unit sent by Charlotte to protect Domremy and the rest of Lorraine.  (Source: Ulysses: Jeanne d'Arc to Renkin no Kishi Wiki)

characters.name: Charlotte
characters.description: Charlotte de Valois is one of the main characters of the Ulysses: Jeanne d'Arc to Renkin no Kishi light novel and the main protagonists of the anime series. She is Princess of the Kingdom of France.  (Source: Ulysses: Jeanne d'Arc to Renkin no Kishi Wiki)

characters.name: Montmorency
characters.description: A young alchemist in search of a way to unveil the secret behind the Philosopher's Stone and become a Ulysses, a supreme being with the power to create a worldwide utopia.  !He met Jeanne and used half of the stone to save her life, he has sworn to protect her and make sure that her fate of holy savior of France is fulfilled. ! !Once forced to swallow the other half of the stone to save Jeanne, he too has become an Ulysses, gaining the power to turn wind and air into an unbreakable shield. ! (Wikipedia)

characters.name: Astaroth
characters.description: The immortal Queen of the Fairies and the guardian of the Philosopher's Stone, called in the human world by Montmorency to help him become a Ulysses. She loves to provoke Montmorency and scold him for his lack of experience. As long as the Philosopher Stone exists, as its guardian she'll not be allowed to die.  (Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kaoru Mashiko
characters.description: Kaoru Mashiko is a first year at Osafune Girl's Academy. Her sword is Nenekirimaru. She is taciturn and does not freely expend energy to trouble herself. She uses the very masculine first-person pronoun "ore." Even though she is short she is a power fighter who can wield a huge sword. She is accompanied by her guardian beast Nene, an aratama. She acts annoyed by [Ellen](https://anilist.co/character/122002/Kohagura-Ellen) but actually puts a lot of trust in her.

characters.name: Ellen Kohagura
characters.description: Ellen Kohagura is a first year at Osafune Girl's Academy. Her sword is Echizen Yasutsugu. Her father is Japanese and her mother is American. She has an innocent personality and is frequently smiling to set the mood. Kaoru is her partner. Never shy around strangers, she nicknames people right away.

characters.name: Kanami Etou
characters.description: Kanami Etou is a second-year student in the middle division of Minoseki Academy. Her sword is Chidori. She's in the middle division, but she has the sword skills to be a representative for the school. She is a cheerful and positive girl who has many friends. She is a sword technique enthusiast, to the point that her eyes change color when someone talks about techniques. She especially loves sword matches.

characters.name: Hiyori Juujou
characters.description: Hiyori Juujou, a third-year student in the middle division of Hiragi Gakukan. Her sword is Kogarasumaru. She is serious, cool, and stoic. She has the strongest sense of responsibility among the Toji, and once she decides on something, she doesn't bend. Her sword skills center on speed, and even among the Toji, her skills are among the best.

characters.name: Mai Yanase
characters.description: Mai Yanase, a second-year student in the middle division of Minoseki Academy. Her sword is Magoroku Kanemoto. She and her younger sister are the daughters of the leader of the rising "Yanase Group" conglomerate. She is a typical big sister who is very caring, and she possesses superior sword skills. Her hobby is making sweets, and she's most confident in making cookies.

characters.name: Sayaka Itomi
characters.description: Sayaka Itomi, a first-year student in the middle division of Kamabu Girls Academy. Her sword is Myouhou Muramasa. She is young, but she is a genius Toji. She handles her duties with ease, but she has a hard time communicating with the people around her.

characters.name: Chisa Shiraishi
characters.description: **Height:** 147 cm (4'10")  Chisa Shiraishi is a member of the Hoshimi Production group Sunny Peace. She is a student at Hikarigasaki High School and her image color is light pink. She is the younger sister of [Saki Shiraishi](https://anilist.co/character/153569/).  Chisa is a timid girl who always seems to be hiding behind her sister, Saki. Because she has been protected by her sister, she has grown up to be an inward-looking child in contrast to her sister. In order to break out of her shell and overcome her own complex, she knocked on the door of the office. She has a good fashion sense and shows her talent by coordinating Saki's personal clothes.

characters.name: Shizuku Hyodo
characters.description: **Height:** 150 cm (4'11")  Shizuku Hyodo is a member of the Hoshimi Production group Sunny Peace. She is a student at Hikarigasaki High School and her image color is pastel green.  Shizuku is a quiet girl and a gloomy idol fan who lurks in the shadows. However, when it comes to the subject of idols, she is very talkative. She is a celebrity within the idol fan world, where even older and more experienced fans will take notice of her. She works hard on her idol activities with her rich knowledge, but she has a hard time dancing and practicing the basics due to her lack of physical strength.

characters.name: Suzu Narumiya
characters.description: **Height:** 142 cm (4'8")  Suzu Narumiya is a member of the Hoshimi Production group Tsuki no Tempest. She is a student at Uruha Girls' Private School's middle school division and her image color is yellow.  Suzu is a confident, clumsy and easily teased young lady. Although she has a cocky and high-spirited attitude, she has an innocence towards idols and her clumsy side makes her hard to hate; she is warmly admired by the people around her. She visits Hoshimi Production as an escape from her own personal troubles. She is a devotee of [Mana](https://anilist.co/character/164062/), calling her "Mana-sama" and collects her CDs and other goods.

characters.name: Kouhei Makino
characters.description: Kouhei Makino is the manager of the idols at Hoshimi Production and is the same age as [Mana Nagase](https://anilist.co/character/164062/). He is a good-natured person who doesn't know when to say no. He doesn't have any particular skills, but he supports the idols with honest work.  He went to high school with Mana Nagase and was close friends with her.

characters.name: Mana Nagase
characters.description: **Height:** 158 cm (5'2")  Mana Nagase is a solo idol under Hoshimi Production. She is the older sister of [Kotono Nagase](https://anilist.co/character/153565/) and her image color is pink. She grew up in Hoshimi City and attended both Hoshimi Middle School and Hoshimi Private High School. She became an idol during her time as a high school student and performed at the school festivals while being a student.  Mana is an idol who makes everyone around her smile just by being there. She is one of those rare beings who have a star quality that is out of reach, but at the same time has an unpretentious friendliness. After her debut, she quickly gained popularity and became known as a "starry miracle". She is an idol with excellent singing and performance skills, and she has a remarkable passion for live performances.  Within Hoshimi Production, Mana is closest with [Haruko Saeki](https://anilist.co/character/153573/). When she first joined, Haruko was the oldest girl in the company and became like an older sister to Mana. They have been close since her debut.

characters.name: Kotono Nagase
characters.description: **Height:** 162 cm (5'4")  Kotono Nagase is the leader and a member of the Hoshimi Production group Tsuki no Tempest. She is a student at Hoshimi Private High School and her image color is dark blue. She is the younger sister of [Mana Nagase](https://anilist.co/character/164062/Mana-Nagase).  Despite her cold look, Kotono is a rookie idol with a secret passion. Kotono is a lonely idol who fights with great regret. She is not very good at socializing; she wasn't the type to have many friends to begin with, but after an incident a few years ago, she began to cut off relations with others she was close with. From then on, she started practising on her own, concentrating on becoming an idol. She has a strong desire to reach the top, to reach her sister's level, and is very strict with herself and others.

characters.name: The Major
characters.description: A first Lieutenant of SS in WWII, The Major was ordered by Hitler to lead the project of creating an army of Nazi vampires. Upon the defeat brought by Alucard and Walter in Poland, The Major and his officers escaped to South America. The original purpose of the Vampire project was to ensure Germany victory in WWII, but The Major now has his own agenda, preaching of endless war and destruction, and seems to pay no heed to who will be victorious.  The Major claims to be human, although he have somehow managed to retain his youth since WWII, possibly by alterations done by Doc.   !It appears from Hellsing Ultimate OVA 10 that The Major's body for the series was that of a robot (or of a cyborg) and he may have in fact been long dead.!

characters.name: Robin Sena
characters.description: A calm and quiet 15-year-old craft user.  She was assigned as a replacement to STN-J. Her partner is [Amon](https://anilist.co/character/300/), who at first ignored her, doing missions with other members of STN-J. But later when Robin's accuracy improves, Amon takes her on more missions with him.  Her craft is pyrokinetic, which incinerates anything she wishes and puts her eye on.

characters.name: Amon
characters.description: A serious and mysterious S-class Hunter and [Robin](https://anilist.co/character/299/)'s partner.  Amon's mother was a witch and his father a seed, indicating he carries the dormant witch trait. Once Robin accepts her fate as the "Eve of Witches," Amon volunteers to be a watchman who will terminate her if she becomes destructive. The reactions of the other characters show that he is believed to be alive.

characters.name: Michael Lee
characters.description: Michael is a hacker and the technical support expert in the STN-J. He is confined to the STN-J building 24/7 by the director Zaizen after being caught hacking into the STN-J's computer network (the only network he was unable to avoid detection in, as he states to Robin). Zaizen had given him the option of either working for STN-J or being killed on the spot, and Michael had opted for the former.        Michael somewhat avoids Robin at first, but then begins to warm up to her, particularly when Robin stays behind in the office at night to accompany him. Michael is able to dig up extensive information about various witches, police reports, and the like, all the while covering his tracks. In the end, he is finally given permission to leave STN-J headquarters.

characters.name: Haruto Sakaki
characters.description: Haruto Sakaki is a Hunter working with the STN-J. He is brash, slightly hot-tempered, ambitious, and supportive. He often rushes into danger during hunts, and this often produces regrettable results. He is the newest member of the group after Robin, and is initially afraid of being replaced when she arrives. Sakaki is not biased about choosing friends however, and welcomes Robin to the crew. As with Amon, Sakaki does not show any superhuman ability. However, he is later hunted by Zaizen, suggesting that Sakaki is an unawakened "seed." He is saved via direct intervention of Robin, Amon, Doujima and Nagira. When that attack on Sakaki fails, they realized that Karasuma is left alone, presumed to be attacked and captured at the same time.        He later helps Robin infiltrate the Factory to save Karasuma, and provides covering fire while Michael attempts to get an elevator back online. He is confirmed alive after Factory's collapse, Michael mentions that he still hunts witches at the end of the series.

characters.name: Yurika Doujima
characters.description: Dōjima is portrayed as as carefree, lazy, vain, and immature; and she would sooner go shopping than go on a mission any chance she gets. She is consistently late for work and rarely does anything around the office, getting much negative attention from Kosaka. According to her, her parents had STN-J act as her "caretakers" and have the authority to get STN-J in trouble. She is a disappointment to the other STN-J members most of the time by doing the most minimal work during missions, and ditching them immediately when her task is finished. Dōjima does not warm up to Robin at first and mockingly calling her "Amon's Girl", but towards the end of the series she begins to take a liking for Robin calling her "Little Robin". She also begins to do a little more work and proves she has more insight and perception of her surroundings than originally presumed. Revealed to be a Solomon intelligence operative, Dōjima was sent by Solomon to the STN-J to uncover more information about the Orbo. In the end, she escapes the Factory with Nagira, who hid Robin after Amon saves her. After the attack on the Factory, she finally begins doing a good job in hunting witches.

characters.name: Miho Karasuma
characters.description: The second in command. She has the ability to read people or past occurrences from objects.

characters.name: Christopher Thorndyke
characters.description: Christopher Thorndyke, also known as Chris, was first introduced into Sonic X during the first episode when he rescued Sonic after having fallen into their pool. He lives in a large mansion and both his parents work, his mother a movie star and his father the owner of a large company, they are hardly ever at home, but when emergency strikes they'll rush home. Chris' parents are very overprotective of him.    During Sonic X, Chris develops a very strong bond with Sonic, seeing him as one of his very best friends. He tends to be a bit of a crybaby, but he still tries to be strong.

characters.name: Sonic the Hedgehog
characters.description: The titular main protagonist of the Sonic the Hedgehog series and SEGA's mascot. He is an anthropomorphic hedgehog known for his ability to run faster than the speed of sound, hence his name. As his species implies, Sonic can also roll up into a concussive ball, primarily to attack enemies.  Born on Christmas Island, Sonic abandoned his home at an early age to pursue a life of adventures. He has spent most of his life traveling around the world and beyond, usually accompanied by his best friend, [Tails](https://anilist.co/character/6377). In his journeys, he has defended his world and others from various threats, especially his arch-nemesis, [Dr. Eggman](https://anilist.co/character/6672).  During his many adventures, Sonic has traveled from the ends of the world to the far reaches of space and time, earning many titles, allies, and foes. Known for his attitude and somewhat short temper, yet strong sense of justice and love for freedom, Sonic's victories have made him a celebrated hero. However, he remains indifferent to his fame, preferring to live on his own terms.

characters.name: Amy Rose
characters.description: A young hedgehog who also happens to be [Sonic](https://anilist.co/character/2882/)'s most loyal fan. Madly in love with the blue hedgehog, Amy is often seen trying to track him down, and thus finds herself mixed up in the conflicts between [Eggman](https://anilist.co/character/6672) as well. Hardly a damsel in distress, Amy is one of the most powerful characters with her Piko Piko Hammer, though she often finds herself using it simply for comic relief. Of course, if Sonic is threatened, Amy will quickly step in to save him.

characters.name: Knuckles the Echidna
characters.description: An anthropomorphic echidna and the current guardian of the Master Emerald, a powerful ancient gemstone which is kept on Angel Island. Guarding it is his solemn duty to protect from anyone seeking to abuse it, as well as the sole surviving descendant of the echidna race from the Knuckles Clan. Known for his powerful and wild nature, his dominant traits are his super strength and the two spike-like knuckles on each of his gloves, from which his name is derived from, and which he can dig and climb walls with. He can also trap the wind under his dreadlocks to glide through the air. Knuckles is also one of [Sonic the Hedgehog](https://anilist.co/character/2882)'s oldest friends and rivals.  (Source: Sonic Wiki Zone)

characters.name: Miles Prower
characters.description: The name "Miles Prower" is a pun on "miles per hour", a reference to the famed speed of the Sonic the Hedgehog series. He is a young, male, golden-yellow, anthropomorphic fox with two tails (similar to the mythological kitsune, or "yoko", which was often depicted with up to nine), hence the nickname. He is able to use his two tails to propel himself into the air like a helicopter for a limited time. His debut was in October 16, 1992, taking part in the 8-bit version of Sonic the Hedgehog 2; the 16-bit version was released that November. Viewing [Sonic](https://anilist.co/character/2882) as somewhat of an older brother, Tails looks up to the hedgehog and aspires to be like him. Though lacking confidence in his abilities as well as experience, Tails does things in a more logical sense than Sonic, often using his ability with machines to turn the tides.

characters.name: Ivo Robotnik
characters.description: Height: 6'1" Weight: 282.2 lbs Occupation: Self-proclaimed genius scientist  Robotnik is the villain of the Sonic universe in most games, a genius scientist with an IQ of 300. He is always attempting to destroy parts of the world to make it home to his super-city so he can then attain world domination, only to be stopped by [Sonic](https://anilist.co/character/2882) and his friends every time. On two occasions he has used a scientific experiment and an ancient monster to achieve his plans, both of which fail ([Shadow the Hedgehog](https://anilist.co/character/6379) and [Chaos](https://anilist.co/character/14758), respectively). He doesn't fight himself all that often and usually builds robots to carry out his dirty work, powered by small animals. Some of his more notable inventions include the Egg Carrier (a flying fortress), the Death Egg (a space station), the Egg Mobile (his aerial transportation vehicle), [Metal Sonic](https://anilist.co/character/17655) (a robotic clone of Sonic), among many other things. His grandfather was also a genius scientist, [Gerald Robotnik](https://anilist.co/character/14753), who originally created Shadow the Hedgehog via [Black Doom](https://anilist.co/character/355457)'s DNA.

characters.name: Kouki Nakano
characters.description: A second-year at Sakaneko High School, and a member of the anime research club. His good looks make him popular with the girls. But he is secretly a fan of idol anime. Whenever the topic of a conversation turns to his interests, he undergoes a complete personality change. Minoa looks up to him as a good upperclassman who helped her out in her time of need.  (Source: Official site, ANN)

characters.name: Kai Musashisakai
characters.description: A second-year at Sakaneko High School, and a member of the anime research club. He likes action anime centering on supernatural powers. People tend to stay away from him due to his delusions of grandeur and frequent usage of lines used by action anime protagonists. He is frequently called "Kaikai" by those who know him, even though he hates that name. Ever since Kouki ignored Kai's questionable conduct to talk to him, he has been good friends with him.  (Source: Official site, ANN)

characters.name: Miko Kouenji
characters.description: Minoa's classmate, and a normal student in both looks and personality. She tries not to stand out, and on breaks, she just flips through a novel in the classroom. Recently, she has been getting into novels of the kind that people who pretend they have superpowers. She tends to watch anime that are adaptations of novels, even though her love for the original novel remains strong. She dreams of being a novelist, and secretly uploads her writing online.  (Source: Official site, ANN)

characters.name: Arisu Kamiigusa
characters.description: Minoa's classmate and the scion of a well-off family, with one of her parents being the president of a major company. Her air of good upbringing tends to radiate around her even if she doesn't say a single word. Because of this, even though she likes anime, she has had no one to talk to about it. She tends to think that money can solve any dilemma. Although she exudes a domineering self-confidence, she is actually frequently lonely.  (Source: Official site, ANN)

characters.name: Minoa Asagaya
characters.description: A first-year at Sakaneko High School, and a beginner at anime. Her tendency to get wrapped up in things led her to be a member of the anime research club. The shows she is personally interested in tend to swing back and forth between the influences of the different members of the club. She still has no favorite anime. She is clumsy, but very goal-driven, and is quick to offer a retort.  (Source: Official site, ANN)

characters.name: Erika Aoyama
characters.description: A third-year at Sakaneko High School, the president of the anime research club, and Minoa's upperclassman. She generally watches all kinds of anime, but holds a particular fondness for magical girl anime for young girls. She likes to cosplay. She previously lived in the United States due to her parents' job.  (Source: Official site, ANN)

characters.name: Anzu Yamasaki
characters.description: Part of the Osaka Gantz Team.     She first sees Kato Masaru help a family from one of the aliens. Bewildered by his actions, she asks him what he was doing. When he responded that he was saving the family, she immediately laughs at him. Initially she follows him around while waiting for him to show a contradiction in his actions and words. When he does not show one and even puts himself in danger to save others, she leaves his side. Feeling strangely guilty, she returns to help Kato defeat the alien he was facing. Unfortunately she gets in his way more than anything else and Kato ends up rescuing her.   Yamasaki continues to follow Kato throughout the next few chapters, and finds herself attracted to his kindness and compassion. In the end she tells him about her son (she feels closer to Kato after he tells her of a similar situation between himself and his younger brother). After Kato announces that he will act as bait for the 100 point alien, Yamasaki asks Kato if he and his brother will move in with her and her son. In order to make this reality, she vows to not let Kato die no matter what.

characters.name: Reika Shimohira
characters.description: She is a beautiful, young and popular idol. Like almost everyone else, she is caught in the line of fire during [Izumi](https://anilist.co/character/5518/Izumi-Shion)'s killing spree in Shinjuku. She develops a crush on [Kurono](https://anilist.co/character/2867/Kurono-Kei) after seeing him in action during her first night as a participant in the game. Surprisingly enough, she proves to be a formidable opponent against the Aliens.     (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Reiji  Senda
characters.description: Senda Reiji (仙田礼二) is the head of the Shinjuku Ward Nocturnal Community Relations Division. He joined at the same time as Seo. He guessed that Arata just picked the answers that he liked on the entrance exam. He scouted Kyouichi for the department.  Personality Reiji is a lackadaisical man, with his working style being amicable, everyone works well under his lead.

characters.name: Yuki
characters.description: Yuki (ユキ) is one of the Another, the name of the Nekomata first seen in the series hiding in Miyako Arata's house.

characters.name: Himezuka Seo
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Huehuecoyotl
characters.description: Kohaku (琥珀) is one of the Another who has settled in Miyako Arata's house. Their gender is unknown, but as Another, they are revered as a god of music, dance and festivities, they are also famous as a god of evil that makes people boredom fight in boredom as a form of enjoyment. Appearance Kohaku's gender is unknown, but his human form is that of a beautiful lady-like visage with long indigo hair that extends to their feet. Their amber colored eyes is their signature as it's popular to both Another and humans as a beast-like color and their eye color gave Abe no Seimei the idea of naming them as Kohaku which literally means amber 琥珀 in Japanese.  Kohaku, who also known as Huehuecoyotl (ウェウェコヨトル) is an Another who is first seen wreaking havoc in different wards of Japan.

characters.name: Arata  Miyako
characters.description: Miyako Arata (宮古新) is the main character of the story. As he just recently climbed the stage of adulthood, when he took the civil examination, he was assigned to Shinjuku Ward Nocturnal Community Relations Division, not knowing that he would be dealing with Another instead of civilians. Appearance Arata sports wavy auburn hair with bangs and red eyes. His appearance is a complete copy of his predecessor Abe no Seimei, so much that it becomes a thorn in his way when Another of every race talks to him as if he was Seimei himself. Personality He has a very gentle personality, and talks with the Another about many issues, and takes time to understand their feelings and to settle disputes peacefully. In the manga, Arata was rather direct with his words while in the anime, he speaks his mind and has a lot of expressions.

characters.name: Kyouichi  Sakaki
characters.description: Sakaki Kyouichi (榊京一) is the shift leader of the team in Nocturnal Community Relations Division in Shinjuku Ward. Appearance Kyoichi sports a glasses and a well trimmed hairstyle. As he was a former famous host, even as a government servant he was still popular with women.

characters.name: Ace Trappola
characters.description: Grade: Freshman/Class A (No.25) Height: 172cm Homeland: Queendom of Roses  A first-year student in Heartslabyul. Ace is a witty, bright kid, though he can be mischievous at times. Since he and Deuce are both Heartslabyul freshmen in the same class, they regard one another with amicable antagonism.

characters.name: Grim
characters.description: A devilish, mischievous creature that resembles a cat. His origins are unknown, but he wishes to become a student at Night Raven College to become the "greatest mage." Despite Grim's nature, he can be nice and does appreciate his friends over time.

characters.name: Deuce Spade
characters.description: A first-year student in Heartslabyul. Deuce is rather serious about being at school, but often unorganised. In the past, he was a delinquent, though he vowed to become a better person for his mother.

characters.name: Riddle Rosehearts
characters.description: A second-year in Heartslabyul and its harsh dorm leader. Riddle is considered a tyrant by practically everyone in the Heartslabyul dorm due to the extremely strict rules he makes others follow. Those that do not obey the rules and say "Yes, lord Riddle" receive Off with Your Head, which is Riddle's unique magic that prevents the afflicted person from using magic. !In the game, Riddle overblots and goes on a rampage. Eventually being defeated and knocked back to his senses. His strictness is due to his mother being extremely strict on him, thus causing him to follow suit with what he was taught and doing the same with others. At present, he is much nicer and relaxed with the rules! Riddle is childhood friends with Trey, though they don't seem nothing like it. Also, Floyd often teases Riddle to his dismay.

characters.name: Yuuken Enma
characters.description: Not much is known about him. He rescued the kendo club in his high school, which was on the verge of disbanding, by recruiting five more people to join it.  He's responsible, caring, and determine young man. He has a habit of helping and saving people even though he just met them. He is willing to help his fellow kendo club member's training for the upcoming kendo tournament. He isn't shown to be afraid of ghosts, but instead to be amazing that he can see ghosts without having any magic powers. Yuuken is good at persuading people when he tries to make Ace and Deuce to get together against the Overblot miner even though they don’t get along very well.

characters.name: Rinko Jerrard
characters.description: Rinko Jerrard comes from a rich family and in the past many people had pretended to be her friend so that she would buy them things. Disillusioned with the seeming coldheartedness of the world, she succumbs to Robert's hypnotic charisma and joins the Ten. Initially, Rinko has a crush on Robert since he treats her as a real friend but she eventually sees Robert for what he really is and joins up with Ueki, indeed becoming his guardian and constant caretaker.    Rinko's Celestial King Candidate is a man named Nikay, one of Margarette's followers whom she hasn't seen since the battle began. She loves all animals, taking an immediate liking to Tenko, but her weakness for cute things makes her vulnerable to Ban's power. Note that it is wise not to insult her no matter what, for she has a side to her that makes her incredibly unhealthy for the person who insults her. She doesn't seem to realise that she has this "evil" side and fortunately for her, she forgets whatever her "evil" side says or does. This "evil" side seems to be activated whenever someone insults her.

characters.name: Ai Mori
characters.description: !Ability: Changesher opponent into a glasses-lover! Ai Mori is one of Ueki's classmates at Hinokuni Junior High School. When in a casual mood, Ai is usually upbeat and friendly, although she is often shown with a very shallow side, initially believing that all power-users (with the exception of Ueki) are dangerous enemies that can't be trusted. Still, Ai cares deeply for her friends, especially Ueki. She discovers Ueki's power early on, coming to a rather unusual conclusion and at first believing him to be an alien. Upon learning of the competition Ueki is in, she decides to back him up, to keep him from losing all his talents and disappearing because of it.    She is strict with Ueki at times, especially when he looks like he is about to do something rash. Ai continuously tries to be his voice of reason, although her shallow antics and outspoken personality often annoys him.      !Later on in the series, she is given an ability by the King of the Celestial World Candidate, Inumaru, during Ueki's fight with Sano. However, her power's condition is that her opponent must perform a goody-two-shoes pose (raising the right leg backwards while putting both of the fists close to the mouth region). Once this power is activated, her opponent falls totally in love with glasses (usually Ai's) and will do anything to keep them from harm, like listening to Ai's orders or even defeat themselves. Also, they will not attack because they may accidentally break the glasses, and will do anything to prevent Ai from breaking them.!    The food she cooks tends to look rather odd and off-putting (usually with squirming octopus tentacles), but it still tastes good. It seems she may have a crush on Ueki as she often blushes when she sees him (especially when the manga series come to an end), but it is not admitted in the series.

characters.name: Tenko
characters.description: Tenko is a Heavenly Beast who is something of a mutation among his kind (he is born as an ancient version of Heavenly Beast, which is a ferocious-looking Godzilla-sized fox-like creature instead of an adorable cat-sized genetically-engineered house pet). He is treated very poorly by Heavenly Beings and Ueki is the first to actually treat him with some kindness and respect. He is able to detect the power level of Heavenly Beings (his eyes lights up and changes colour to red depending on which level the Heavenly Being is on) and because of his mutations has a bigger version of what is called the "awakening organ" that can awaken the hidden powers within Ueki.

characters.name: Hideyoshi Soya
characters.description: Ability: Turn voices into portraits  His ability is to turn voices into portraits can make voices come out of them. The condition is that he needs to bend his fingers or toes. He is a power user that Ueki and Mori meet. He is prone to deception, using various novelty gags and tricks in a fight such as soy sauce bomber. He looks out for a group of kids at a place called the Sun House.    His first King of the Celestial World Candidate, Nero, was a kind heavenly being that did not want to become the King of the Celestial World; he simply wanted to help out humans which he did at the Sun House. Soya offered to become gifted so that Nero could stay longer on Earth. Unfortunately, he helped Soya during a fight and was sent to Hell. Then, Soya received a new King of the Celestial World Candidate, Zack, whom he hates for turning out to be a jerk and wanting him to join forces with a nasty bunch of power users. He agrees to help Ueki when he hears that they can save Nero. Although sometimes cowardly and weak when Soya performs his sneak attacks in conjunction with his power he can be a formidable foe. In one occasion, he put his portraits on Sano's towels, then turned them back to voices in order to launch a sonic attack on Team Marylin. In addition, his ability to use his opponent voices as well work with his tricks making it easier to deceive his foes.     !At the end of the series, Ai refers him as the useless member of Team Ueki. In anime, Ai refers to him as the secret savior because he gave ueki one last zai before Ueki disappeared when he was hit by Ueki's Kurogane.!     (Source : Wikipedia)

characters.name: Kousuke Ueki
characters.description: Ability: Change trash into trees Ability Level 2:  !Undo the opponent's power!       Kousuke Ueki is the main character in the series. He is in Class 1-C at Hinokuni Junior High School. Ueki's ability is given to him by Kobayashi (a.k.a. Mr. K), who is also Ueki's homeroom teacher.   !His level 2 power is to undo the opponent's power. He can use more than one sacred treasure weapon at the same time because of his given ability.!      Ueki is a genuinely kind person who is always trying to help people out. He is an unusually calm individual, and doesn't care about what happens to him. He can be found snoozing in class, letting children use him as a target for shooting soccer balls (or in one case, a surfboard) and also calling the police without panicking when he faces a gang of rowdy teenagers. He cares for people around him, even going as far as saving Robert Haydn from falling debris in the Dogura Mansion. He is a bit of a simpleton who constantly uses his ability against non-gifted, but that is because he just can't stand seeing these nasty folks defying his sense of justice. Even though he constantly loses his talents (and gains fairly useless ones when he wins), he believes that he can still make do by putting even more effort into succeeding. !Ueki is actually a heavenly being sent to Earth by his father in order to take part in this tournament. Being a heavenly being allows him powers beyond his tree-making skills. He is still training in the use of these powers.!      According to a short profile of the main characters of The Law of Ueki (published in the end of manga vol. 16 by the author), Ueki's hobbies include cleaning up his town. In the first volume of the manga, Ueki is seen planting trees in the town park. Despite his power to change trash into trees may look weak in the eyes of others, it is actually quite different from other powers. Other power-users only have the ability to change item A to item B; for example from beads to bombs and from water to fire. But Ueki's power is different in the sense when he changes trash into trees, part of the tree can become trash, which he can change into trees again. In other words, it is a repeatable cycle.

characters.name: Seiichirou Sano
characters.description: Sano can change towels into iron by holding his breath, however sharp-eyed fans can see that sometimes it appears to be voice-activated instead. But after he gives the commands, he is sometimes left with a second or two to stop breathing in.    Sano, a 9th grader at Inaho Junior High School, was known as the Genius of Robert's Ten while he was part of it. But he had joined because the leader of Robert's Ten (Karlpaccho) had placed a Death Pentagon on Sano's King of the Celestial World Candidate Inumaru that would kill him by removing all his blood unless he listened to Robert.    Sano can be creative with his power, creating shields, springboards (spring) and even boomerangs which he calls "boomerang cutter".     !His Level 2 makes his steel towels into powerful magnets. Seems to possess a ridiculous amount of his necessary towels, pulling them out of his robe in rapid succession. He even has an emergency towel tied around his forehead.!    He has a burn over his left eye which was caused during an accident with a hot spring. Still, he does love those hot springs and hopes to get the blank talent to obtain the talent of discovery in order to find a hot spring of his own.    (source : wikipedia)

characters.name: Natsusa Yuzuki
characters.description: Height: 170cm Player position: Backs (left wing)

characters.name: Seiichirou Jingyouji
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Ibuki Ueoka
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Ikuto Yufu
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Yasunari Tsuru
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Gakuto Zaitsu
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Yuu Mashiro
characters.description: No description available.

characters.name: Marilla Cuthbert
characters.description: A crisp, practical, no-nonsense woman who completely disapproves of Anne's wild imagination, although she does grow to love the orphan. Her sense of humour develops greatly upon Anne's arrival, and Mrs. Lynde states that she became "mellow".

characters.name: Minnie May Barry
characters.description: Diana's even plumper younger sister. She tags along and plays a pivotal role when she gets croup and Anne nurses her.

characters.name: Diana Barry
characters.description: Anne's dearest friend and kindred spirit. Anne and Diana become best friends from the moment they meet. She is the only girl of Anne's age who lives close to Green Gables. While Anne does not think Diana is very imaginative, Diana is noted for being pretty, merry and very amiable. She is often puzzled by Anne's extreme imagination, but she does have a little imagination of her own.

characters.name: Gilbert Blythe
characters.description: Gilbert first tried to get Anne's attention by pulling her hair and calling her "Carrots". Anne hit him over the head with her slate and refused to have anything to do with him. Even though Gilbert apologizes shortly after the incident, Anne remains scornful toward him for a few years, but Gilbert never abandons his quest for her friendship. Anne forgives Gilbert by the end of the book and the two become friends - and eventually marry in a later book in the series, "Anne's House of Dreams". (Gilbert's father was Marilla's girlhood sweetheart. Marilla seems to find a special satisfaction in the fact that Anne and Gilbert finally become friends.)

characters.name: Anne Shirley
characters.description: Anne is a very talkative little girl, who is always talking to everyone and she even likes to talk alone. She likes to give "poetic" names to things she likes, and has a huge imagination. Anne is a real tomboy and deeply dislikes her red hair. Very warm hearted, she's a loyal friend and daughter, captivating everyone around her with her originality.  Anne Shirley is a girl raised in an orphanage who is accidentally sent to [Miss Marilla Cuthbert](https://anilist.co/character/37178/Cuthbert-Marilla) and [Mr. Matthew Cuthbert](https://anilist.co/character/37146/Cuthbert-Matthew), who had originally requested a boy. At first unwanted, she gradually becomes an irreplaceable member of their family.

characters.name: Matthew Cuthbert
characters.description: Marilla's brother, a shy, awkward man who takes a liking to Anne from the start. The two become fast friends. He is far less talkative than Anne, but is a very good listener. He also sometimes lets Anne have things which Marilla considers too frivolous, such as a dress with puffed sleeves.

characters.name: Mipple
characters.description: Mipple is the Princess of Hope from the Garden of Light. She, like Honoka, is generally more reserved than her male counterpart. She's always sticking up for Porun, though, once he comes on the scene, and that tends to cause problems between her and Mepple. She resides predominantly with Honoka and ends all her sentences with the word "mipo".

characters.name: Pollun
characters.description: Pollun is the Prince of the Garden of Light. He is sent to Earth after it is discovered that the Evil King is back. The Queen gives a cryptic statement about his powers aiding Pretty Cure. Later, when Wisdom is in trouble, Wisdom places the power of the Rainbow Stones into Porun without his knowledge. This gives him the ability to remain in his regular form as well as the ability to communicate with various people from the Garden of Light. When communicating with members of the Garden of Light, he turns into what looks like a mini computer and everyone can hear what is said and communicate openly. He also grants Pretty Cure the power of light which gives them their Rainbow Bracelets. He tends to be extremely selfish and think only of himself. He is quite childish and has a lot of energy. He can get a little annoying at times and definitely annoys Mepple. He lives predominantly with Nagisa in Pretty Cure and with Hikari in Max Heart. He tends to end his sentences with "popo".

characters.name: Honoka Yukishiro
characters.description: Honoka Yukishiro is the quiet and reserved one, but that does not keep her from having her own friends and following. She can be quite strict and evil when the situation calls for it. Her alter ego is Cure White. Her specialty is the science club, where she is looked up to by the others. Honoka hasn't had many friends, but the few she has seem to be really close to her. It has also been noted that she's relatively popular with the boys, though she seems to have little interest in them. She has a love and friendship bond with Kiriya during the first season, and realized it in the second season. She lives with her grandmother and their dog, Chuutaro. Her parents are art dealers and spend most of their time overseas. They return once a year for Honoka's birthday. Despite their prolonged absences, they seem to have a good relationship with their daughter.

characters.name: Mepple
characters.description: Mepple is the chosen protector of the Princess of Hope. Because of this, he and Mipple have a "lovey-dovey" relationship. He tends to be a little more agitating, constantly making fun of Nagisa as they get into arguments. He is also mildly jealous of Porun and wishes Porun would act less selfish at times. However, Mepple is just as selfish, constantly eating or whining about being hungry and noting to himself that Nagisa is easy to manipulate. He resides with Nagisa and ends his sentences with "mepo". Both Mipple and Mepple can only stay in their Garden of Light forms for a short time before growing tired, so they generally take energy-saving forms resembling cellphones.

characters.name: Yamatonokami Yasusada
characters.description: A uchigatana said to have been wielded by Okita Souji of the Shinsengumi. Much like [Kashuu Kiyomitsu](https://anilist.co/character/121631/Kashuu-Kiyomitsu), it is a difficult blade to handle—one that chooses its wielder. For this reason, it is said to have been relatively inexpensive.   At first glance, he appears unassuming; yet, when it comes to combat...

characters.name: Kashuu Kiyomitsu
characters.description: The uchigatana that is said to have been used by Shinsengumi's Okita Souji.   Perhaps because he was born in an impoverished environment, he believes that as long as he keeps himself pretty he will be loved by his owner. Seemingly the polar opposite of [Yamatonokami Yasusada](https://anilist.co/character/120569/Yamatonokami-Yasusada) with whom he quarrels all the time, they are good friends in reality.

characters.name: Softon
characters.description: His head resembles soft serve ice cream (hence his name). He was the guardian of the "Jet Black Room" of C-Block's "Aitsuhage Tower"(some fans think he was the vice commander). Softon uses "Babiron (Babylon) Shinken" (in the English dub, he fights by channeling the power of "the Goddess Blabs-A-Lot", a not-too-obvious pun: Blabs-A-Lot = Babble on = Babylon).  Perhaps not coincidentally, the shape of his head also resembles the typical manga depiction of poop. In promotional color artwork for the manga, his head is colored brown, whereas in the anime, it is colored pink (which is not a U.S. TV edit).
